[Awards] 2026 40th Korean Dance Festival Awards Ceremony

Among a total of 20 works presented at <2026 40th Korean Dance Festival - The Path, Trace of the Body>, the Grand Prize, Excellent Work Award, General Audience Special Award, and Best Dance Dance Performance Award will be selected in the large theater category, and the Grand Prize, Excellent Choreography Award, and Special Jury Award will be selected in the small theater category. In particular, this year, in order to recognize the choreographers who showed good choreography and work, we were able to recognize the hard work of great dancers by awarding certificates of “Dance Artist of the Year” to the eight people selected in the grand theater category. 


[Synopsis]

[Opening invitation performance] The opening invitation performance begins with a performance by the honorary chairman of the Korea Dance Association and continues with meaningful projects with the board of directors and works showing the current state of Korean creative dance.

The opening invitational performance of the Korean Dance Festival will be decorated with excellent works by many artists who have come together for the Korean Dance Festival. First, <Sounds of the Night> by honorary chairman Deok-kyung Yoon, who led the Korean Dance Association as chairman for over 10 years, will be presented. <Sounds of the Night> is a solo dance piece composed by Hwang Byeong-ki, inspired by Ahn Jung-sik's oriental painting 'Seongjaesugando (聲在樹間圖)' and premiered at the '1990 Contemporary Dance Artists Exhibition'. This is a work that expresses the dense moments, the resonance amplified in silence.

A special stage that highlights this year’s Korean Dance Festival! <Dance, the Excitement> by the Korean Dance Festival 40th Anniversary Project Team will be presented. <Dance, the Excitement>, a work that can be enjoyed by people of all ages and genders, was first performed in 1982 and is a work that seeks to complete another layer created through the unity of the audience and dancers. A coexistence structure is formed through communication between the dancers, performers, and the audience in the work, and the work is maximized through visual mise-en-scène production through the combination of object performance and modern music, theatrical elements, and modern wear of traditional costumes. For this stage of <Dance, the Excitement>, 10 dance artists, including Lim Hyun-seon, Lee Ae-hyun, and Kim Yong-cheol, who are board members of the Korea Dance Association, came together for this Korean Dance Festival. In celebration of the 40th anniversary of the Korean Dance Festival, another ‘exciting’ stage will be performed by the artists of the Korea Dance Association. 

Lastly, <Resonance and Mystery>, a work by Jeon Su-hyeon of Altimeets, which won the Best Work Award in the Grand Theater category at the 39th Korean Dance Festival in 2025, will be performed. Choreographer Jeon Soo-hyun's <Resonance and Mystery> is a work that talks about the timeless resonance and rebirth of our words, music, and art. The energy of the group dance that seems to shake the ground and the resonance through the deconstruction and recombination of Korean art are presented.  The opening performance of this Korean Dance Festival, where you can experience the history, present, and new resonance of Korean dance through three works, will convey the deep emotion of dance to the audience.

[Main Performance] 2026 40th Korean Dance Festival <The Path, Trace of the Body> A new performance by 20 choreographers!

The main performance of the Korean Dance Festival will be a competition stage for works with the theme of ‘The Path, the trace of the body’. The large theater division consists of new works presented by eight choreographers at the Arko Arts Theater's main theater, while the small theater division presents experimental and unique new works by twelve choreographers at the Cotton Hall of the Performing Arts Center of Dongduk Women's University. The Korean Dance Festival, which is held in a competition format, is positioned as a dance art festival that discovers the next generation of choreographers in the Korean dance world by selecting the best and best works, expands the representative repertoire of Korean creative dance, and leads new artistic attempts.

[Closing Invitation Performance and Awards Ceremony] A closing invitation performance where you can see works that have been in sync with the revival of Korean creative dance and award-winning works with a new sense.

You can see <Yeom> by Kang Miri Hall Dance Company, which has led the revival of Korean creative dance in the Busan area through creative work since the 1980s, at the closing invitation performance. The work <Yeom (念)> is a work that deeply interprets Seungmu, and has been evaluated as ‘an experiment on the limits of Korean traditional dance, another experiment on the overflow, and an inevitable work that must be done.’ <Yeom (念)>, which solidifies the identity and position of Korean creative dance by crossing the transformation and deconstruction of traditional dance, is expected to brighten the stage of this closing invitation performance.

Following this, <Strangers> by Dance us project Kim Hyeon-seon, winner of the Excellence Award in the Grand Theater category at the 39th Korean Dance Festival in 2025, will be performed. People who cannot mix in a certain place are expressed as strangers, and contain the message that anyone can be a stranger, so differences must be acknowledged and coexist.

At the final awards ceremony, the award-winning works that graced the 2026 40th Korean Dance Festival <The Path, Trace of the Body> will be announced. Out of a total of 20 works, the Grand Prize, Excellence Award, Audience Special Award, and Best Dance Award will be selected in the large theater category, and the Grand Prize, Excellence Award for Choreography, and Special Jury Award will be selected in the small theater category. In addition, we will be awarding ‘Dance Artist of the Year’ certificates to the eight choreographers selected in the Grand Theater category and the Best Click Award, which can be said to be the popular award of the pre-event Seoul Street Dance film, so please show your interest.

Please join us for the 2026 40th Korean Dance Festival <The Path, Trace of the Body>, which unfolds the 40 layers of time that Korean creative dance has accumulated, and the new movements that will be layered on top of them.

【性能介绍】

[活动前1] 

第32届国内学术会议<韩国舞蹈节40年的记录与未来的话语>

作为韩国舞蹈节40周年的预热活动，将举办国内学术会议<韩国舞蹈节40年的记录与对未来的讨论>作为预热活动。本次学术会议与韩国舞蹈协会下属机构韩国舞蹈研究会联合举办，将对韩国舞蹈节40年来积累的韩国创意舞蹈的趋势和成就进行学术概述，重新解读其艺术价值和当代意义，并进行研究报告以寻求未来的方向和话语。韩国创意舞蹈与学术界讨论论坛将于 4 月 3 日星期五下午 1 点举行。在艺术家之家的多功能厅。

【会前活动2】<魅力系列-首尔街舞电影>

通过韩国舞蹈捕捉首尔这座迷人的城市。韩国舞者走访过去、现在和未来共存、其美丽被全世界认可的首尔街道和空间，并通过舞蹈表达它们。作为韩国舞蹈节前期活动而备受关注的“魅力系列-首尔街头舞蹈电影”迄今为止，记录了城市与舞蹈相遇的场景，在首尔乙支路、西顺罗路、清溪川、宗庙赛街、光化门太平路、成均馆路、西村路、首尔开放松岘绿色广场等首尔各地重新描绘了韩国舞蹈的魅力。车站、解放村、芦原孔陵林道。

这部舞蹈电影预计将更加凸显韩国舞蹈节40周年，2025年第39届韩国舞蹈节小剧场部门评审团特别奖获得者朴哲善在古德水边生态公园中行走，而在小剧场部门中展现令人印象深刻的作品的梁智秀在西大门监狱中跳舞，预计将更加凸显韩国舞蹈节40周年。此外，最佳点击奖将颁发给点击量较高的作品，以表彰编舞者在创作活动中所付出的努力，并有助于作品向公众传播，在未来的创作活动中取得有意义的成果。 4月6日（星期一）杨智秀和7日（星期二）朴哲善的视频将于晚上7点30分通过“韩国舞蹈协会”YouTube频道公开，无论身在何处，都可以随时随地在首尔街头跳舞。

[周边活动]40周年档案展<韩国舞蹈节40年，那段时光的记录> 

为纪念韩国舞蹈节40周年，作为附带活动，将举办《韩国舞蹈节40年，当时的记录》档案展。本次展览旨在归档从第一届韩国舞蹈节到第40届韩国舞蹈节积累的表演数据，分享其变化的流程和记录，系统地审视韩国创意舞蹈的谱系和话语。通过各种档案资料，您可以看到韩国创意舞蹈在韩国舞蹈节40年来的变化和扩展。

此次档案展在Arko艺术剧院主剧场大厅举行，通过照片和视频捕捉韩国舞蹈节40年来的精彩瞬间，与观众分享韩国创意舞蹈的历史和流程。展览《韩国舞蹈节40年，当时的记录》可于4月8日星期三至4月19日星期日在Arko艺术剧院主剧院大厅免费观看。

<2026第40届韩国舞蹈节-身体的轨迹、轨迹>共20件作品中，大剧场部门将评选出大奖、优秀作品奖、普通观众特别奖、最佳舞蹈表演奖，小剧场部门将评选出大奖、优秀编舞奖、评审团特别奖。特别是，今年，为了表彰表现出良好编舞和工作的编舞家，我们向大剧院组中选出的八位舞蹈家颁发了“年度舞蹈艺术家”证书，以表彰伟大舞蹈家的辛勤工作。 


[剧情简介]

[开幕邀请表演] 开幕邀请表演以韩国舞蹈协会名誉主席的表演开始，随后与董事会进行有意义的项目以及展示韩国创意舞蹈现状的作品。

韩国舞蹈节的开幕邀请演出将由众多汇聚韩国舞蹈节的艺术家的优秀作品装点。首先将呈现担任韩国舞蹈协会会长10多年的名誉会长尹德京的《夜之声》。 《夜之声》是黄秉基以安正植的东方绘画《声在树间图》为灵感创作的独舞作品，在“1990当代舞蹈艺术家展”上首演。这是一部表达密集时刻、在沉默中放大的共鸣的作品。

今年韩国舞蹈节的亮点特别舞台！韩国舞蹈节40周年纪念项目组将呈现《舞蹈，兴奋》。 《舞动吧》是一部男女老少都可以欣赏的作品，于1982年首演，是一部力求通过观众和舞者的团结创造出另一层次的作品。作品中舞者、表演者和观众之间的交流形成共存结构，并通过物体表演与现代音乐、戏剧元素、传统服饰的现代穿着相结合的视觉布景制作将作品最大化。在《舞动吧》的舞台上，韩国舞蹈协会理事林贤善、李爱贤、金容哲等10位舞蹈艺术家齐聚一堂，共襄盛举。为庆祝韩国舞蹈节40周年，韩国舞蹈协会的艺术家们将带来另一个“激动人心”的舞台。 

最后将演出荣获2025年第39届韩国舞蹈节大剧场部门最佳作品奖的Altimeets全秀贤的作品《共鸣与神秘》。编舞家全秀贤的《共鸣与神秘》是一部讲述我们的语言、音乐和艺术的永恒共鸣和重生的作品。呈现出群舞仿佛地动山摇的能量，以及通过韩国艺术的解构和重组产生的共鸣。  本届韩国舞蹈节的开幕表演，通过三部作品感受韩国舞蹈的历史、现在和新的共鸣，将舞蹈的深沉情感传递给观众。

【主要演出】2026第40届韩国舞蹈节<身体的轨迹>20位编舞家的全新表演！

韩国舞蹈节的主要表演将以“路径，身体的痕迹”为主题的作品比赛舞台。大剧场部门由8位编舞家在Arko艺术剧院主剧场呈现的新作品组成，小剧场部门则在同德女子大学表演艺术中心的棉花厅呈现12位编舞家的实验性和独特的新作品。以竞赛形式举办的韩国舞蹈节定位为通过评选最优秀、最优秀的作品，发现韩国舞蹈界下一代编舞家、拓展韩国创意舞蹈的代表曲目、引领新的艺术尝试的舞蹈艺术节。

[闭幕邀请表演及颁奖典礼] 闭幕邀请表演，您可以看到与韩国创意舞蹈复兴同步的作品以及具有新感觉的获奖作品。

在闭幕邀请表演中，可以看到自20世纪80年代以来通过创作引领釜山地区韩国创意舞蹈复兴的姜美里霍尔舞蹈团的《Yeom》。作品《念》是对胜无进行深度诠释的作品，被评价为“对韩国传统舞蹈极限的一次实验，又是一次溢出的实验，是必然要做的作品”。通过对传统舞蹈的改造和解构，巩固了韩国创意舞蹈的身份和地位的《念》，有望为本次闭幕邀请演出的舞台增光添彩。

接下来，将演出2025年第39届韩国舞蹈节大剧场部门优秀奖得主Dance us Project金贤善的《陌生人》。不能在某个地方混在一起的人被表达为陌生人，并包含任何人都可以是陌生人的信息，因此必须承认差异并共存。

在最终颁奖典礼上，将揭晓2026年第40届韩国舞蹈节《身体的轨迹》的获奖作品。共20件作品中，大剧场类将评选出大奖、优秀奖、观众特别奖、最佳舞蹈奖，小剧场类将评选出大奖、编舞优秀奖、评审团特别奖。此外，我们还将为大剧场组选出的八位编舞者颁发“年度舞蹈艺术家”证书以及最佳点击奖，这可以说是活动前首尔街舞电影的热门奖项，请大家关注。

请与我们一起参加2026年第40届韩国舞蹈节《身体的路径、痕迹》，它将展现韩国创意舞蹈积累的40层时间，以及将在其之上分层的新动作。

【公演紹介】

[事前イベント1] 

第32回国内学術大会<韓国舞踊祭典40年の記録と未来のための談論>

韓国舞踊祭典40周年の事前行事として、国内学術大会「韓国舞踊祭典40年の記録と未来のための談論」が事前行事として開催されます。 （社）韓国ダンス協会の算術館である韓国舞踊研究学会とともに開催する今回の学術大会では、過去40年間韓国舞踊祭典が蓄積してきた韓国創作ダンスの流れと成果を学術的に眺望し、その芸術的価値と時代的意味を再解釈し、今後の方向と談論を模索する研究発表者韓国創作ダンスと学術が出会う談論の場を4月3日（金）午後1時、芸術家の家多目的ホールで会うことができます。

[事前イベント2] <魅力シリーズ - ソウルの街Dance Film>

魅力の都市ソウルを韓国ダンスに盛り込む。過去と現在、そして未来が共存し、世界的にその美しさを認められているソウルの街と空間を韓国舞踊家たちが訪ねて踊って表現する。韓国舞踊祭典の事前行事として注目されている「魅力シリーズ - ソウルの街Dance Film」はこれまで乙支路、ソスンラギル、チョンゲチョン、ジョンミョサイギル、光化門太平路、成均館路、ソチョンギル、開かれたソンヒョン緑地広場、ソウル駅、解放村、ノウォンゴンリョンの森都市と踊りが出会う場面を記録してきた。

今回のダンスフィルムは去る2025第39回韓国舞踊祭典の小劇場部門審査委員特別賞受賞者であるパク・チョルスンが高徳水変生態公園を、小劇場部門で印象深い作品を披露したヤン・ジスが西大門刑務所を踊りながら特別な舞踊を繰り広げた特別な舞台また、高い視聴回数を記録した作品には、ベストクリック賞を授与し、振付者たちの創作活動に対する労苦を致し、作品の大衆的拡散と今後の創作活動に意味のある成果につながるようにする予定です。 4月6日(月)ヤン・ジス、7日(火)パク・チョルスンの映像が「韓国ダンス協会」YouTubeチャンネルを通じて午後7時30分に公開され、いつでもどこでも場所にこだわらずソウルの街を踊ることができます。

【付帯行事】40周年記念アーカイブ展示＜韓国舞踊祭典40年、その時間の記録＞ 

韓国舞踊祭典40周年を記念して付帯行事アーカイブ展示<韓国舞踊祭典40年、その時間の記録>が行われます。今回の展示は、第1回韓国舞踊祭典から第40回に至るまで蓄積された公演資料をアーカイブしてその変化の流れと記録を共有し、韓国創作踊りの系譜と談論を体系的に見ることができるように企画されました。韓国舞踊祭典が歩んできた40年の時間の中で韓国創作踊りがどのように変化して拡張されてきたかを様々な記録資料を通じてお会いできます。

アルコ芸術劇場大劇場ロビーで行われる今回のアーカイブ展示は、韓国舞踊祭典40年の瞬間を写真と映像で盛り上げ、韓国創作踊りの歴史と流れを観客たちと分かち合おうとします。 ＜韓国舞踊祭典40年、その時間の記録＞ 展示は4月8日(水)から4月19日(日)までアルコ芸術劇場大劇場ロビーで無料で観覧できます。

[授賞式] 2026第40回韓国舞踊祭典授賞式

<2026 第40回韓国舞踊祭典 - The Path、体の軌跡>で発表された合計20の作品のうち大劇場部門で最優秀、優秀作品賞と一般観客特別賞、Best Danceダンス演技賞が、小劇場部門で最優秀、優秀振付賞、審査委員特別賞が特に今年は良い振付と作品を見せた振付者のために大劇場部門に選ばれた8人を「今年のダンス作家」選定証書授与とともに素晴らしい踊り手たちの労苦も治めることができるようになった。 


[シノプシス]

[開幕招待公演]韓国ダンス協会名誉理事長の舞台を皮切りに、李写真陣が共にする重要なプロジェクトと韓国創作ダンスの現在を見せる作品まで続く開幕招待公演

韓国舞踊祭典の開幕招待公演は韓国舞踊祭典のために心を集めた多くの芸術家たちの素晴らしい作品で飾られます。まず、10年余りの理事長として韓国ダンス協会を率いた名誉理事長のユン・ドクギョンの「夜の声」が広がります。 「夜の声」は、安中式の東洋画「聲在樹間圖」にインスピレーションを受け、ファン・ビョンギ先生が作曲した曲を「1990現代ダンス作家展」で初演した独務作品です。静けさの中で増幅される響き、その密度の高い瞬間を表現する作品です。

今年の韓国舞踊祭典を輝かせる特別舞台！韓国舞踊祭典40周年プロジェクトチームの<ダンス、その命名>が繰り広げられます。男女野荘 誰でも楽しめる作品である<ダンス、その命名>は1982年初演され、観客やダンサーが合一を通じて生成されるまた別の層の完成を図る作品です。作品の中のダンサーと演奏者、そして観客たちとのコミュニケーションにより、共生構造が形成され、物事演奏と現代音楽の接木、演喜性を演劇的要素と伝統ダブルスの現代的着用で視覚的な美装セン演出で作品を最大化した作品です。今回の「ダンス、その命名」の舞台は韓国ダンス協会の理事陣であるイム・ヒョンソン、イ・エヒョン、キム・ヨンチョルなど10人のダンス芸術家たちが今回の韓国舞踊祭典のために心を集めました。韓国舞踊祭典40周年を迎え、韓国ダンス協会芸術家たちが共に作り出すもう一つの「神命」の舞台が繰り広げられる予定です。 

最後に2025第39回韓国舞踊祭典大劇場部門最優秀作品賞の栄誉を抱いた（社）舞踊団Altimeetsチョン・スヒョンの作品＜共鳴と謎＞が公演されます。チョン・スヒョン振付者の「共鳴と謎」は、私たちの言葉と音楽、芸術の時間を超えた共鳴と再誕生を語る作品です。地を鳴らすような軍務のエネルギー、韓国芸術の解体と組換えを通じた響きをプレゼントします。  3作品を通じて韓国ダンスの歴史と現在、そして新たな響きに出会える今回の韓国舞踊祭展開幕招待公演は観客の皆さんに深いダンスの感動を伝えます。

[本公演] 2026 第40回韓国舞踊祭典<The Path、体の軌跡> 20人の振付師が披露する新作舞台！

韓国舞踊祭典の本公演は〈The Path、体の軌跡〉をテーマにした作品の競演舞台で繰り広げられます。大劇場部門はアルコ芸術劇場大劇場で8人の振付師が披露する新作で構成され、小劇場部門は東徳女子大学公演芸術センターコットンホールで12人の振付家が実験的で個性ある新作を披露します。競演形式で行われる韓国舞踊祭典は、最優秀および優秀作品選定を通じて韓国舞踊界の次世代振付家を発掘し、韓国創作ダンスの代表レパートリーを拡張し、新しい芸術的試みを導く舞踊芸術祭りに位置しています。

【閉幕招待公演及び授賞式】韓国創作踊りの復興と共にした作品、そして新たな感覚の受賞作に出会える閉幕招待公演

1980年代からこれまで創作作業を続け、釜山地域の韓国創作踊りの復興を導いてきたカンミリ割舞踊団の「炎」を閉幕招待公演でお会いできます。作品「炎」は、乗務を深く解釈した作品で、「韓国伝統踊りの限界に対する実験であり、あふれのもう一つの実験であり、必ずしなければならない必然的な作業だ」という評価を聞いたことがあります。伝統踊りの変容と解体を行き来して韓国創作踊りのアイデンティティと立地を固めた「炎」は、今回の閉幕招待公演の舞台をさらに輝かせる予定です。

続いて2025年第39回韓国舞踊祭典大劇場部門優秀作品賞受賞作であるDance us projectキム・ヒョンソンの<異邦人たち>が公演される。どんなところに混ざらないのかを異邦人として表現し、誰もが異邦人になることができるので、その違いを認めて共存しなければならないというメッセージが含まれています。

最後に行われる授賞式では、2026第40回韓国舞踊祭典「The Path、体の軌跡」を輝かせた受賞作品を発表します。全20作品のうち大劇場部門で最優秀、優秀作品賞と観客特別賞、そしてBest Danceダンス演技賞が、小劇場部門で最優秀、優秀振付賞、審査委員特別賞が選ばれます。また、大劇場部門に選ばれた8人の振付家たちに授与される「今年のダンス作家」選定証書と事前行事ソウルの街Dance filmの人気賞といえるベストClick賞まで授与される予定なので、多くの関心お願いします。

韓国創作踊りが積み重ねてきた四十重の時間、そしてその上に重なる新たなジェスチャーが繰り広げられる今回の2026第40回韓国舞踊祭典<The Path, 体の軌跡>を一緒にしてください。

키안 솔타니 & 박재홍 듀오 리사이틀.zh: Kian Soltani & Jaehong Park 二重奏演奏会

[공연소개]\n‘깊은 음악성과 독보적인 존재감’으로 세계 무대의 주목을.en:
[Performance introduction]
Cellist Kian Soltani, who has been attracting attention on the world stage for his ‘deep musicality and unique presence,’ and pianist Jaehong Park, who has rapidly expanded his presence through international competitions, will present a duo recital.
Soltani, resident artist of the Iceland Symphony Orchestra, has been described as a “remarkable cellist” by The Times and “perfection itself” by Gramophone. As an exclusive artist for Deutsche Grammophon, he has performed with world-class orchestras such as the Berlin Staatskapelle, Munich Philharmonic, and NHK Symphony.
Jaehong Park gained international fame by winning the 2021 Ferruccio Busoni International Piano Competition with four special awards, and has proven his musical capabilities by winning the Cleveland International Young Artist Piano Competition and the Gina Bakauer Competition.
On this stage, the program continues with Reza Valli, Schubert, and Rachmaninoff, naturally revealing each person's musical roots and interpretations. Soltani's cello, with its deep lyricism and sophisticated technique, and Jaehong Park's piano, with its wide tone and solid structure, form a dense ensemble in close harmony. This duo recital, completed by the combination of experience accumulated on the international stage and mature musicianship, will be a time to present the depth of sincere chamber music beyond glamour.

[공연소개]\n‘깊은 음악성과 독보적인 존재감’으로 세계 무대의 주목을.zh:
【性能介绍】
因“深厚的音乐性和独特的存在感”而在世界舞台上受到关注的大提琴家基安·索尔塔尼和通过国际比赛迅速扩大影响力的钢琴家朴载宏将带来一场二重奏独奏会。
索尔塔尼是冰岛交响乐团的常驻艺术家，被《泰晤士报》形容为“杰出的大提琴演奏家”，被《留声机》形容为“完美本身”。作为德意志留声机公司的专属艺术家，他曾与柏林国家管弦乐团、慕尼黑爱乐乐团、NHK交响乐团等世界一流乐团合作演出。
Jaehong Park 凭借在 2021 年费鲁吉奥·布索尼国际钢琴比赛中获得四项特别奖项而赢得国际声誉，并通过在克利夫兰国际青年艺术家钢琴比赛和吉娜·巴考尔比赛中获胜证明了他的音乐能力。
在这个舞台上，节目继续由礼萨·瓦利、舒伯特和拉赫玛尼诺夫表演，自然地揭示了每个人的音乐根源和诠释。索尔塔尼的大提琴具有深厚的抒情性和高超的技巧，朴载弘的钢琴具有宽广的音调和坚实的结构，形成了紧密和谐的密集合奏。这场由国际舞台积累的经验与成熟的音乐修养相结合完成的二人独奏音乐会，将呈现出真诚的室内乐超越魅力的深度。

[공연소개]\n\n지난 2023년 9월, 서울 세종문화회관 대극장에서 성.en:
[Performance introduction]

Since the ‘King Of Popera - King of Popera’ recital commemorating the 25th anniversary of his debut, which was grandly held at the Sejong Center for the Performing Arts in Seoul in September 2023, the ‘original popera star’ Lim Hyung-joo (40, Distinguished Professor of Vocal Music at Rome City University of the Arts) is holding a paid recital in Seoul for the first time in three years!

 
Became the first Korean to receive the UN Peace Medal, completely conquered the three major halls of Carnegie Hall in the U.S. with a solo performance, signed an exclusive album distribution contract with one of the world's top four record labels, received Japan's NHK's 'Red and White Song Concert' and both the U.S. Obama & Trump Presidential Awards, was a voting member and judge of the U.S. Grammy Award, had a private audience and performance with Pope Francis, was awarded the title of FRSA for life by the Royal Society of Arts and was awarded the title of FRSA by the Royal Society of Korea, received a commendation from the President of the Republic of Korea and is the youngest recipient of the National Merit in history. Lim Hyeong-ju, a true popera legend born in Korea, including the Dongbaekjang Medal, will hold a New Year's recital with the subtitle 'Popera Sensation!' at Yeongsan Art Hall in Yeouido, Seoul at 7:30 pm on March 20th.

 
In this performance, Lim Hyeong-ju will present to the audience the elegant, gorgeous, lyrical and grand 'essence of popera', including 'Become a Thousand Winds' and 'I Hope You Are Happy (KBS Cheerful Girl Chunhyang OST)', classical music, pop music, musicals, pop songs, and even special 7080 dance songs, with the fantastic accompaniment of the Korean National Philharmonic Ensemble, of which he has served as music director for a long time.

 
There is no doubt that a lot of public attention will be paid to his beautiful and affectionate songs that are closer to his friendly appearance that removes his mysticism, such as his recent appearances in EBS's <Seo Jang-hoon's Millionaire Next Door>, KBS's <100 People's Emotional Show: The Signature>, Channel A's <Table for Four>, and TV Chosun's <Dad and Me>.

[공연소개]\n\n지난 2023년 9월, 서울 세종문화회관 대극장에서 성.zh:
【性能介绍】

继2023年9月在首尔世宗文化中心隆重举办“King Of Popera - King of Popera”出道25周年纪念演奏会之后，“流行音乐原创明星”林亨柱（40岁，罗马城市艺术大学声乐特聘教授）时隔3年再次在首尔举办付费演奏会！

 
成为第一个获得联合国和平奖章的韩国人，以个人表演彻底征服美国卡内基音乐厅三大礼堂，与世界四大唱片公司之一签订独家专辑发行合同，获得日本NHK“红白歌音乐会”和美国奥巴马和特朗普总统双项奖，是美国格莱美奖的投票成员和评委，与教皇弗朗西斯进行私人观众和表演，被授予称号被英国皇家艺术学会授予终身FRSA称号，并被韩国皇家学会授予FRSA称号，受到大韩民国总统的嘉奖，是历史上最年轻的国家功绩获得者。荣获冬百将勋章的韩国真正的波佩拉传奇人物林亨柱将举办题为“波佩拉轰动！”的新年独奏会。 3月20日晚上7点30分在首尔汝矣岛灵山艺术厅举行。

 
在本次演出中，林亨柱将在他担任过的韩国国家爱乐乐团的精彩伴奏下，为观众呈现优雅、华丽、抒情、宏大的“流行音乐精髓”，包括《成为千风》、《希望你幸福（KBS开朗少女春香OST）》、古典音乐、流行音乐、音乐剧、流行歌曲，甚至特别的7080舞曲。长期担任音乐总监。

 
毫无疑问，他最近出演的EBS《徐长勋的邻家百万富翁》、KBS《百人情感秀：签名》、Channel A《四人桌》、朝鲜电视台《爸爸和我》等，优美而深情的歌曲，更接近他消除了神秘感的友善外表，将受到很多公众的关注。

[공연소개]\n\n지난 2023년 9월, 서울 세종문화회관 대극장에서 성.ja:
【公演紹介】

去る2023年9月、ソウル世宗文化会館大劇場で盛大に繰り広げられた「デビュー25周年記念独創会<King Of Popera - キング・オブ・ポップフェラ>」以後「援助ポップフェラスター」イム・ヒョンジュ(40、ローマ市立芸術大学声楽科席座)

 
韓国人初のUN平和メダル受賞、米国カーネギーホール3大ホールソロ公演で完全征服、世界4大レコード会社独占アルバム流通契約締結、日本NHK「紅白歌合戦」、米国オバマ＆トランプ大統領賞すべて受賞、米国グラミー賞投票人団兼審査委員、イギリス王立芸術学会終身石学会員およびイギリス王室FRSA公称授与、大韓民国大統領表彰および歴代最年少国民勲章椿章勲訓などまさに韓国が生んだポップフェラの伝説イム・ヒョンジュが来る3月20日夕方7時30分センセーション - ポップフェラの感動)!」という副題をつけて新春独創会を持つ。

 
今回の公演でイム・ヒョンジュは自身が長い間音楽監督として在職しているコリアンナショナルフィルハーモニックアンサンブルの幻想的な伴奏で「千の風になって」、「幸せになることを願う（KBS快楽春香OST）」をはじめ、クラシック、ポップ、ミュージカル、歌曲0叙情的でありながらも壮大な「ポップフェラの真髄」を観客に披露する予定だ。

 
最近、EBS <ソ・ジャンフンの近所の百万長者>、KBS <100人の感情ショー：ザ・シグネチャー>、チャンネルA <4人用ダイニングテーブル>、TV朝鮮<パパと私と>などの彼の神秘主義を蹴った親しみやすい姿と一層近づいた美しく静かな歌に多くの大衆の耳。

[공연소개]\n\n지금 우리 시대에 기대하는 환상은 무엇일까요? \n우리.en:
[Performance introduction]

What is the fantasy we look forward to in our times? 
The world of memories and emotions we remember may not fit the current era. 
For those of you who are concerned about reality and ideals rather than expecting a magical coincidence, A TRIP TO THE MOON provides a brief emotional journey and time to reflect on yourself in the process.
[공연소개]\n\n지금 우리 시대에 기대하는 환상은 무엇일까요? \n우리.zh:
【性能介绍】

我们这个时代所期待的幻想是什么？ 
我们记忆中的记忆和情感世界可能不适合当今时代。 
对于那些关心现实和理想而不是期待神奇巧合的人来说，《月球之旅》提供了一段短暂的情感之旅，并让他们有时间在这个过程中反思自己。
[공연소개]\n\n지금 우리 시대에 기대하는 환상은 무엇일까요? \n우리.ja:
【公演紹介】

今、私たちの時代に期待する幻想は何でしょうか？ 
私たちが覚えていた思い出と感性の世界は今の時代には合わないかもしれません。 
魔法のような偶然への期待よりも現実と理想に悩んでいる皆さんに、A TRIP TO THE MOONはしばらく感性の旅をその過程で今に振り返る時間を提供します。

[공연소개]\n청개구리 '꾸리'는 엄마 말씀에 반대로만 한답니다. ㅜㅜ\.en:
[Performance introduction]
The tree frog ‘Kkuri’ only does the opposite of what his mother says. ㅜㅜ

One day, Guri goes to the Dark Cloud Garden, which her mother told her never to go to. 
There is a snake living in the Dark Cloud Garden.

Kkuri was caught by a snake!~!

Mom gets bitten by a snake while trying to find a package.
The collapsed mother asks Kkuri one last favor.

Can Guri do as her mother says?

Spend precious and beautiful time with your friends!!~
[공연소개]\n청개구리 '꾸리'는 엄마 말씀에 반대로만 한답니다. ㅜㅜ\.zh:
【性能介绍】
树蛙“Kkuri”只做与妈妈说的相反的事情。 ㅜㅜ

有一天，古里去了乌云花园，她的母亲告诉她不要去那里。 
乌云花园里住着一条蛇。

Kkuri被蛇咬住了！~！

妈妈在寻找包裹时被蛇咬伤。
昏倒的母亲向库里请求最后一件事。

古里能按照妈妈说的去做吗？

与朋友一起度过珍贵而美好的时光！！~

[프로그램]\n\n1) 청년을 위한 서곡(이정호 작곡)\n2) 대금협주곡.en:
[Program]

1) Overture for Youth (composed by Jeongho Lee)
2) Daegeum Concerto ‘From Within’ (composed by Jeong-ho Lee, performed by Daegeum Concerto, Professor Geun-hwa Ryu of Kyungpook National University)
3) Piri Concerto on the theme of Changbu Taryeong (composed by Beom-Hoon Park, performed by flute collaborator Professor Seong-Jun Kim of Pusan National University)
※ A flute concerto based on Korean folk songs. ‘Arirang’ was listed on the UNESCO Representative List of Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2012.
4) Valley of Fire (composed by Lee Chang-hee, performed by New Folk Music Association Body (6 people))
※ UNESCO’s virtue of emphasizing the modernization of tradition and the next generation (youth) is visualized through original songs and youth collaborations.
5) Pangut and Korean traditional music orchestra ‘Shinmodum’ (composed by Beomhoon Park, performed by Yeonhee Performer Group Cheorat (6 people))
※ UNESCO’s virtue of emphasizing the modernization of tradition and the next generation (youth) is visualized through original songs and youth collaborations.
6) Korean traditional music orchestra ‘Beat-and-Deo-ga’ (collaborating singer Seon-myeong Lee) 
* Program may be subject to change.
[프로그램]\n\n1) 청년을 위한 서곡(이정호 작곡)\n2) 대금협주곡.zh:
[节目内容]

1) 青春序曲（李正浩作曲）
2) 大琴协奏曲《From Within》（李正浩作曲，庆北大学柳根华教授大琴协奏曲演奏）
3) 以Changbu Tarying为主题的Piri协奏曲（由Beom-Hoon Park作曲，由长笛合作者、釜山大学Seong-Jun Kim教授演奏）
※ 以韩国民歌为基础的长笛协奏曲。 2012年，《阿里郎》被列入联合国教科文组织人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录。
4）《火之谷》（李昌熙作曲，新民乐协会演奏（6人））
※ 联合国教科文组织强调传统现代化和下一代（青年）的美德通过原创歌曲和青年合作得以体现。
5) 盘古特与韩国传统管弦乐团“Shinmodum”（由 Beomhoon Park 作曲，由 Yeonhee Performer Group Cheorat 演奏（6 人））
※ 联合国教科文组织强调传统现代化和下一代（青年）的美德通过原创歌曲和青年合作得以体现。
6) 韩国传统乐团“Beat-and-Deo-ga”（合作歌手李宣明） 
* 计划可能会发生变化。
[프로그램]\n\n1) 청년을 위한 서곡(이정호 작곡)\n2) 대금협주곡.ja:
[プログラム]

1) 青年のための西曲（イ・ジョンホ作曲）
2）代金協奏曲「内面から」（イ・ジョンホ作曲、代金協演リュ・グンファ慶北大教授）
3）チャンブタリョン主題による笛協奏曲（パク・ボムフン作曲、笛協演キム・ソンジュン釜山大学教授）
※韓国民謡を素材としたフルート協奏曲。 「アリラン」が2012年ユネスコ人類無形文化遺産代表リストに登載
4)火の渓谷(イ・チャンヒ作曲、共演新民俗楽会ボディ(6人))
※ 伝統の現代化と後続世代（青年）を重視するユネスコの徳を創作曲と青年協演陣に可視化
5) パングッドと国楽観弦楽「新盛り合わせ」
※ 伝統の現代化と後続世代（青年）を重視するユネスコの徳を創作曲と青年協演陣に可視化
6) 国楽館弦楽「麺ダーガ」 
*プログラムは変更されることがあります。

[Program]\n\n*소리의 만남, 하나 되는 기쁨\n\n우리가곡은.en:
[Program]

*The meeting of sounds, the joy of becoming one

Our songs are more than just songs, they are our precious heritage that fully captures the lives and emotions of Koreans. This concert consisted of a variety of stages, including soloists, duets, and quartets, so that the audience could familiarize themselves with the songs of composers from different eras representing Korean music. In addition, this concert ends with a song sung by the audience, and we hope to celebrate and honor our song as one.

Following last year's seasonal theme, the Matinee Concert with Geum Nan-sae meets audiences again this year with a masterpiece series introducing the most beloved concertos in classical history.

[시놉시스]\n\n”길 잃은 청춘을 위한 자장가“\n-슈베르트와 21세기.en:
[Synopsis]

“A lullaby for lost youth”
-Comfort shared between Schubert and the youth of the 21st century

Schubert sang of hope and despair from his sickbed in 1823. The wanderings of the water mill youth he depicts reflect our anxiety and loneliness living in 2026. It's an ironic love song of youth that's okay to fail and beautiful even if it hurts.

Jin Seong-won, a tenor with excellent interpretive skills and a warm vocal voice, trains younger students as a professor at Gachon University. His voice expresses the human agony and youth composed by Schubert with vocal depth!

Eunjoo Choi, a pianist with a distinguished and delicate touch. From the whisper of a stream to the swirling psychological changes of a young man, her accompaniment embodies the essence of Schubert's songs in piano melody!

Announcer Kim Jin-woong, a rising talent at KBS. With his captivating voice and delivery, his trustworthy commentary serves as a bridge to lower the threshold for the beautiful mill girl!

“Every night when I go to bed, I hope not to wake up again… Only works created by sadness can bring people the most joy…”
(From a letter sent by Schubert to his friend Kupelwieser in 1824)

We present to you the song “The Beautiful Mill Girl,” a record of the ‘will to live’ that Schubert left us.

[시놉시스]\n\n”길 잃은 청춘을 위한 자장가“\n-슈베르트와 21세기.zh:
[剧情简介]

“一首逝去青春的摇篮曲”
——舒伯特与21世纪青年的共同安慰

1823年，舒伯特在病床上唱出了希望与绝望。他描绘的水磨坊青年的流浪，反映了我们生活在2026年的焦虑和孤独。这是一首讽刺的青春情歌，失败也没关系，即使受伤也很美丽。

陈成元是一位具有出色诠释能力和温暖嗓音的男高音，在嘉泉大学担任教授，培养年轻学生。他的声音将舒伯特创作的人性的痛苦和青春用声音的深度表达出来！

崔恩珠（Eunjoo Choi），一位钢琴演奏家，有着高贵而细腻的触感。从溪流的呢喃，到少年漩涡般的心理变化，她的伴奏在钢琴旋律中体现了舒伯特歌曲的精髓！

播音员金振雄是 KBS 的后起之秀。迷人的声音和解说，值得信赖的解说，为美丽的磨坊女降低了门槛！

“每天晚上睡觉的时候，我都希望不要再醒来……只有悲伤创作出来的作品，才能给人们带来最大的欢乐……”
（摘自1824年舒伯特写给他的朋友Kupelwieser的一封信）

我们向您呈现歌曲《美丽的磨坊女孩》，这是舒伯特留给我们的“生存意志”的唱片。

[공연소개]\n전쟁 통에 헤어진 옛사랑을 찾아 나선 할아버지와, 멜로드라.en:
[Performance introduction]
A heart-warming true story of a grandfather who sets out to find an old love lost during the war, and a grandson who dreams of becoming a melodrama.
 
Filled with emotion even without fancy stage techniques, this is the power of a ‘real’ story!
The play <Me and Grandpa> is a work based on the real story of Min Jun-ho, the director and CEO of the theater company ‘Ganda Performance Delivery Service’.
This play, which is completed by 'Junhee', a performance script writer who wanted to write a great melodrama, while observing his maternal grandfather, is completed without artificial directing. 
It depicts the simple and honest scenes of our lives. “The people we call grandmother and grandfather were once youths who were passionately in love.”
It reminds us of the truth and provides deep empathy and warm comfort across all generations. 

[Synopsis]
‘Junhee’ is a passionate performance script writer who wants to write a melodrama.
As he sets out to find his grandfather's old love, he discovers true 'life'.
 
Junhee is a passionate performance script writer who wants to write a great melodrama.
His teacher asked him to observe and complete the task of his maternal grandmother and grandfather.
 
However, my grandmother suddenly collapsed before I could start writing.
Eventually, Junhee began to observe only his grandfather.
Record your grandfather's voice and listen to his past stories.
In the end, before my grandmother collapsed, she warned me, “Never help me find something.”
The grandfather's acquaintances also set out to find him.
Listening to my grandfather's story, I somehow thought it was a woman! Was this my grandfather’s first love?
 
Somehow, out of anticipation that a melodrama might be completed, I disobeyed my grandmother's words,
Jun-hee sets out to find grandmother Lim Soo-im together.
 
Will there be an interesting path that Junhee wants to take?
[공연소개]\n전쟁 통에 헤어진 옛사랑을 찾아 나선 할아버지와, 멜로드라.zh:
【性能介绍】
这是一个温暖人心的真实故事，讲述了一位祖父出发寻找在战争中失去的旧爱，和一个梦想成为情节剧的孙子的故事。
 
即使没有华丽的舞台技巧，也充满情感，这就是“真实”故事的力量！
话剧《我和爷爷》是根据剧团“Ganda Performance Delivery Service”的导演兼代表闵俊浩的真实故事改编的作品。
这部剧是由想写出一部伟大的情节剧的表演剧本作家“俊熙”一边观察他的外祖父一边完成的，没有人为导演。 
它描绘了我们生活中朴素、诚实的场景。 “我们所说的祖母和祖父都曾经是热恋的年轻人。”
它提醒我们真相，并为各代人提供深刻的同理心和温暖的安慰。 

[剧情简介]
“俊熙”是一位充满热情的表演剧本作家，想要写一部情节剧。
当他开始寻找祖父的旧爱时，他发现了真正的“生活”。
 
俊熙是一位充满热情的表演剧本作家，他想写出一部伟大的情节剧。
他的老师要求他观察并完成外祖母和祖父的任务。
 
然而，还没等我开始写字，奶奶就突然倒下了。
最终，俊熙开始只观察他的祖父。
录下祖父的声音，聆听他过去的故事。
最后，在我祖母倒下之前，她警告我：“永远不要帮我找东西。”
祖父的熟人也出发寻找他。
听爷爷讲故事，我莫名以为是个女人！这就是我爷爷的初恋吗？
 
不知怎的，出于对一部情节剧可能完成的预期，我违背了祖母的话，
俊熙一起出发寻找祖母林秀林。
 
俊熙会不会想走一条有趣的路呢？

[공연소개]\n\nUNDERCITY의 Soft Opening을 함께 열었.en:
[Performance introduction]

Jeremy Olander, who held the Soft Opening of UNDERCITY, returns to Seongsu after a year. This time, it is not just one set, but Open to Close, which completes the flow of the night from the beginning to the end as a single narrative? The stage is filled with All Night Long Set (6 hours).

Since his debut through Eric Prydz's Pryda Friends, he has established himself as one of the most trusted producers in the melodic house and techno scenes, working on international labels such as Drumcode, Anjunadeep, and Diynamic. Detailed sound design and a set composition that designs both emotion and structure are his biggest signatures. He has also established his identity as an artist and curator through his own label, Vivrant, which he founded in 2014.

This performance is not just a simple performance in Korea, but a Vivrant Showcase and a symbolic night that opens the era of his debut album When The Rain Falls. This album, which will be released on March 13, is his most personal and introspective work, capturing years of artistic evolution and changes in life.

When The Rain Falls aims for electronic music as ‘listening music’ rather than as a functional track for clubs. This album, completed based on his own experiences and emotions, shows the direction of sound newly defined by Jeremy Olander.

The album's world view, starting with the first single 'Apollo', focuses on cinematic sound and clear emotional lines, revealing his expanded musical spectrum through various collaborations. It is a turning point that goes beyond existing progressive house and evolves into a more mature and epic sound.
This Open to Close Set, which will be held at UNDERCITY, is the moment when his career, album narrative, and Vivrant's philosophy are connected as one. This night will remain a special experience that will be remembered for a long time for fans who have grown up with his music.
[공연소개]\n\nUNDERCITY의 Soft Opening을 함께 열었.zh:
【性能介绍】

主持 UNDERCITY 试营业的杰里米·奥兰德 (Jeremy Olander) 时隔一年重返圣水。这一次，不只是一套，而是从Open to Close，将夜晚从开始到结束的流程作为一个单一的叙事完成？舞台充满了All Night Long Set（6小时）。

自从通过 Eric Prydz 的 Pryda Friends 出道以来，他已成为旋律 house 和 techno 领域最值得信赖的制作人之一，为 Drumcode、Anjunadeep 和 Diynamic 等国际唱片公司工作。细致的声音设计和情感与结构并重的布景创作是他最大的标志。他还通过 2014 年创立的自己的品牌 Vivrant 确立了艺术家和策展人的身份。

这场演出不仅仅是一场简单的韩国演出，而是一次Vivrant Showcase，也是一个具有象征意义的夜晚，开启了他的首张专辑《When The Rain Falls》的时代。这张将于3月13日发行的专辑是他最个人化、最内省的作品，捕捉了多年来的艺术演变和生活变化。

《When The Rain Falls》的目标是将电子音乐作为“聆听音乐”，而不是作为俱乐部的功能性曲目。这张根据自己的经历和情感完成的专辑，展现了杰里米·奥兰德(Jeremy Olander)重新定义的声音方向。

这张专辑的世界观从第一首单曲“Apollo”开始，专注于电影声音和清晰的情感线条，揭示了他通过各种合作扩展的音乐谱系。这是一个转折点，超越了现有的渐进式浩室音乐，并演变成一种更加成熟和史诗般的声音。
这场将在 UNDERCITY 举行的 Open to Close Set 是他的职业生涯、专辑叙事和 Vivrant 的哲学融为一体的时刻。对于伴随他的音乐成长的歌迷来说，这个夜晚将是一次特殊的经历，将被铭记很长一段时间。
[공연소개]\n\nUNDERCITY의 Soft Opening을 함께 열었.ja:
【公演紹介】

UNDERCITYのSoft Openingを一緒に開いたJeremy Olanderが1年ぶりに再び聖水を探す。今回はたった一度のSetではなく、夜の始まりから終わりまでの流れを一つの叙事詩に仕上げるOpen to Close ？ All Night Long Set（6時間）でステージを埋める。

Eric PrydzのPryda Friendsを通じてデビューした後、Drumcode、Anjunadeep、Dynanamicなど世界的なラベルを行き来し、彼はメロディックハウスとテクノシンで最も信頼されるプロデューサーとして位置づけてきた。繊細なサウンドデザインと感情と構造を同時に設計する3つの構成は、彼の最大のシグネチャーだ。 2014年に設立した自身のレーベルVivrantを通じてアーティストでありキュレーターとしてのアイデンティティも確立してきた。

今回の公演は単なる来韓公演ではなく、Vivrant Showcaseであり、彼のデビューアルバムWhen The Rain Falls時代を開く象徴的な夜だ。来る3月13日発売されるこのアルバムは、長年の芸術的進化と人生の変化を盛り込んだ彼の最も個人的で省察的な作品だ。

When The Rain Fallsは、クラブのための機能的なトラックではなく、「聴く音楽」としての電子音楽を目指している。自分の経験と感情に基づいて完成したこのアルバムは、Jeremy Olanderが新たに定義したサウンドの方向性を見せる。

初のシングル「Apollo」をはじめとするアルバムの世界観は、シネマティックなサウンドと鮮明な感情線を中心に、様々なコラボレーションを通じて拡張された彼の音楽的スペクトルを現わす。既存のプログレッシブハウスを超えて、より成熟し、叙事詩的なサウンドに進化した転換点だ。
UNDERCITYで繰り広げられる今回のOpen to Close Setは、彼のキャリアとアルバムの叙事詩、そしてVivrantの哲学が一つにつながる瞬間だ。この夜は彼の音楽と共に成長してきたファンたちに、長い間記憶される特別な経験で残るだろう。

[공연소개]\n\n- 현대음악작곡가 최진석의 오케스트라 신작 <Four.en:
[Performance introduction]

- Modern music composer Choi Jin-seok's new orchestral work <Four Pieces for Orchestra>
- Jinseok Choi, a contemporary music composer who won third place at the Basel Composition Competition, presents a new orchestral work consisting of four chapters on the themes of waves, darkness, light, and wind.
Contemporary music composer Choi Jin-seok's new orchestral work <Four Pieces for Orchestra> consists of four pieces (chapters) on the themes of waves, darkness, light, and wind. Each chapter musically explores the different energies and states of nature, forming a continuous flow through the contrast between violence and silence, creation and extinction, and tension and relaxation. Throughout the work, the movements of nature are depicted by applying the structural principles of music that the composer considers most important. This work will be performed for the first time by the Hankyung Arte Philharmonic and conducted by Kim Yu-won.
[공연소개]\n\n- 현대음악작곡가 최진석의 오케스트라 신작 <Four.zh:
【性能介绍】

- 现代音乐作曲家崔振锡的新管弦乐作品《管弦乐队四首曲》
- 在巴塞尔作曲比赛中获得第三名的当代音乐作曲家崔振锡带来了一部新的管弦乐作品，由四个章节组成，主题为波浪、黑暗、光明和风。
当代音乐作曲家崔振锡的新管弦乐作品《管弦乐四首曲》由以波浪、黑暗、光明、风为主题的四首曲子（章节）组成。每一章都以音乐方式探索自然的不同能量和状态，通过暴力与沉默、创造与灭绝、紧张与放松之间的对比形成连续的流动。在整个作品中，自然的运动是通过应用作曲家认为最重要的音乐结构原理来描绘的。该作品由韩国韩国艺术爱乐乐团首次演奏，由金裕元指挥。

- 現代音楽作曲家チェ・ジンソクのオーケストラ新作<Four Pieces for Orchestra>
- バーゼル作曲コンクール3位の現代音楽作曲家チェ・ジンソクが波・闇・光・風をテーマにした4つの章からなる新作オーケストラ作品を披露する。
現代音楽作曲家チェ・ジンソクのオーケストラ新作「Four Pieces for Orchestra」は、波、闇、光、風をテーマにした4つの曲（章）で構成されている。各章は自然の異なるエネルギーと状態を音楽的に探求し、激しさと静けさ、生成と消滅、緊張と弛緩のコントラストを通して一つの連続的な流れを形成する。作品全体の自然の動きは、作曲家が最も重要に思う音楽の構造的原理を適用することによって描かれています。本作品はハンギョンarteフィルハーモニックの演奏とキム・ユウォンの指揮で初演される。

[공연소개]\n\n재즈 피아니스트 케니 배론은 서정성과 스윙, 그리고 정.en:
[Performance introduction]

Jazz pianist Kenny Barron is a master of modern jazz piano who has achieved lyricism, swing, and a sophisticated sense of harmony in perfect balance. He established his musical presence early on through collaboration with the greats at the center of jazz history, such as Dizzy Gillespie, Stan Getz, and Freddie Hubbard, and over the following decades, he has steadily developed his own musical world in a wide range of formats, from trios, solos, and large formations. His performances are always based on understated lyricism and deep swing, conveying the intellectual yet warm charm of jazz.

This performance has special meaning in that it is the first Korean performance of Kenny Barron's trio with bassist Alexis Cuadrado and drummer Jonathan Blake. In particular, April 30th, when the performance will be held, is Jazz Day designated by UNESCO, and will be a special stage to commemorate this special day with the 83-year-old living jazz legend.

Alexis Cuadrado is a Barcelona-born, New York-based bassist who combines the passion of flamenco with the intelligence of modern jazz. Based on her solid classical technique, she collaborated with world-renowned masters such as Angelique Kidjo and Mark Turner. Additionally, as a composer and leader, he will use epic and sophisticated performances, adding depth and dynamism to Kenny Barron's elegant pianism.

On drums is Jonathan Blake, one of the leading players in the modern jazz scene. Jonathan Blake is a drummer with both a traditional swing sense and a modern rhythm interpretation, and has been highly praised for his dynamic yet detailed playing. His drumming goes beyond simple rhythm accompaniment and plays the role of an active conversation between the piano and bass, raising the tension and energy of the entire trio.

The Kenny Barron Trio created by these three is based on the format of a classic piano trio, but will deliver a modern sound that naturally blends the individuality and experience of each player. Elaborately built harmonies, interplay that takes advantage of the blank space, and improvisation that does not miss the inspiration of the moment clearly reveal the most essential charm of trio jazz. In particular, Kenny Barron's musical insight accumulated over a long period of time on stage will shine even more deeply in close collaboration with the two performers.

This performance by the Kenny Barron Trio, held in commemoration of Jazz Day, will be more than a simple performance in Korea, but will be a valuable opportunity to directly see the highest level of perfection that a contemporary jazz trio can achieve. This stage, where you can simultaneously experience the intellectual depth and human warmth of jazz, and the vivid breathing that can only be felt on a live stage, is expected to be a special moment that will be remembered for a long time by domestic jazz fans.
[공연소개]\n\n재즈 피아니스트 케니 배론은 서정성과 스윙, 그리고 정.zh:
【性能介绍】

爵士钢琴家肯尼·巴伦是一位现代爵士钢琴大师，他将抒情性、摇摆性和复杂的和声感达到了完美的平衡。他很早就通过与爵士乐历史中心的伟大人物合作建立了自己的音乐地位，例如迪兹·吉莱斯皮（Dizzy Gillespie）、斯坦·盖茨（Stan Getz）和弗雷迪·哈伯德（Freddie Hubbard），在接下来的几十年里，他以多种形式稳步发展自己的音乐世界，从三重奏、独奏到大型编队。他的演奏始终以低调的抒情和深沉的摇摆为基础，传达出爵士乐知性又温暖的魅力。

此次演出具有特殊意义，因为这是肯尼·巴伦三人组与贝斯手亚历克西斯·夸德拉多和鼓手乔纳森·布莱克的首次韩国演出。特别是演出举办的4月30日，是联合国教科文组织指定的爵士乐日，将成为与83岁的爵士乐传奇人物共同纪念这个特殊日子的特殊舞台。

Alexis Cuadrado 是一位出生于巴塞罗那、现居纽约的贝斯手，他将弗拉门戈的激情与现代爵士乐的智慧融为一体。凭借扎实的古典技巧，她与Angelique Kidjo、Mark Turner等世界知名大师合作。此外，作为作曲家和领导者，他将使用史诗般和复杂的表演，为肯尼·巴伦优雅的钢琴演奏增添深度和活力。

鼓手乔纳森·布莱克（Jonathan Blake）是现代爵士乐界的领军人物之一。乔纳森·布莱克（Jonathan Blake）是一位兼具传统摇摆感和现代节奏诠释的鼓手，以其充满活力且细致的演奏而受到高度赞誉。他的鼓声超越了简单的节奏伴奏，起到了钢琴和贝斯之间积极对话的作用，提升了整个三重奏的张力和能量。

这三人创建的肯尼·巴伦三重奏以经典钢琴三重奏的形式为基础，但将提供现代的声音，自然地融合了每个演奏者的个性和经验。精心打造的和声、利用空白的互动、不放过瞬间灵感的即兴创作，清晰地揭示了三重奏爵士乐最本质的魅力。尤其是肯尼·巴伦在舞台上长期积累的音乐洞察力，将在两位表演者的密切合作中更加闪耀。

肯尼·巴伦三重奏组为纪念爵士日而举行的这场演出将不仅仅是在韩国举行的一场简单的表演，而且将是一个宝贵的机会，可以直接看到当代爵士三重奏组可以达到的最高完美水平。这个可以同时体验爵士乐的知性深度和人性温暖的舞台，以及只有在现场舞台才能感受到的生动呼吸，预计将成为国内爵士乐迷长久铭记的特殊时刻。

[Performance introduction]

Seoul and Sihyang went to see a classical performance with their mother. The two friends fell in love with the wonderful melody as soon as the first song was played! However, a major incident occurs in which the conductor's score is blown away and disappears by a suddenly appearing whirlpool, and they discover that it is the plan of Mr. Crescendo, a villain who wants to keep all the music in the world for himself... Seoul and Sihyang, filled with courage and fueled by a sense of justice, tremble and go on their first adventure to find the missing score.

Shall we embark on an exciting adventure traveling the world and discovering the music of great composers with the Seoul Philharmonic Orchestra?

【性能介绍】

首尔和始香和妈妈一起去看古典表演。第一首歌一响起，两个朋友就爱上了美妙的旋律！然而，一场重大事件发生了，指挥家的乐谱被突然出现的漩涡吹走并消失，他们发现这是恶棍克雷森多先生的计划，他想将世界上所有的音乐据为己有……首尔和始香充满勇气和正义感，战战兢兢地踏上了寻找失踪乐谱的第一次冒险。

我们是否可以与首尔爱乐乐团一起踏上激动人心的冒险之旅，环游世界并发现伟大作曲家的音乐？

[공연소개]\n\n우리 아이에게 주는 최고의 선물! 뮤지컬 <알사탕>과.en:
[Performance introduction]

The best gift to give your child! ‘Happy Day’ with the musical <Al Candy>

On May 5th, Children's Day, the Gongju Literary Center is transformed into a huge dream playground for children.
The Arts Center's Children's Day special project, which started in 2025, welcomes family audiences with even more upgraded fun and emotion this year.
The stage of the main concert hall will feature the family musical “Al Candy,” based on the bestseller by writer Baek Hee-na, loved all over the world. Eat the mysterious candy and make up your mind
Through the story of Dongdong, who heard the sound, the clumsy but sincere love and courage of a family is conveyed, and a touching warmth is felt for both the child and the parents.
It is planned to be presented. The excitement continues off stage as well. Before and after the performance, a variety of side events, <Happy Day>, are held in the lobby and outdoors.
A cute ‘small theater’, exciting ‘outdoor performance’ and an eye-catching ‘magic performance’ add excitement to the festival. Also, ‘Mister Long Legs’ who will welcome children.
There is plenty of experiential events so you will never be bored. We hope that it will become the best children's day outing spot where the whole family can laugh, have fun, and make precious memories.


[Introduction to the work]

A warm story of comfort and growth told by 'Magic Candy', a voice that hears the heart's voice.
Based on the picture book <Al Candy> by world-renowned writer Baek Hee-na, the story has a solid story and beautiful music.
Various stage effects are added to embody the emotion of the picture book.
Since its premiere in 2019, it has ranked first in sales (children's and family categories) for three consecutive years.
It is a luxury family musical that has captured the hearts of not only children but also their parents.


[Synopsis]

“It’s a piece of candy. It’s very sweet.”
 
A bag of candy I bought at a stationery store. Let's put a piece of candy in our mouth
 
I can hear sounds that I couldn't hear before!
 
“Dongdong-ah~ Dong-dong-ah~”
 
The sound of the heart told by magic candy!
 
Whose voice will be heard next?
[공연소개]\n\n우리 아이에게 주는 최고의 선물! 뮤지컬 <알사탕>과.zh:
【性能介绍】

给您孩子最好的礼物！音乐剧《阿尔坎迪》的“快乐的一天”

5月5日儿童节，公州文学馆变身为孩子们的巨大梦想游乐场。
2025年启动的艺术中心儿童节特别项目，今年将以更加升级的趣味性和情感迎接家庭观众。
主音乐厅的舞台将上演家庭音乐剧《Al Candy》，该音乐剧改编自深受全世界喜爱的作家白熙娜的畅销书。吃下神秘糖果，下定决心
通过听到声音的东东的故事，传达了一个家庭笨拙却真挚的爱和勇气，让孩子和父母都感受到了令人感动的温暖。
计划将其呈现。舞台下的兴奋也在继续。演出前后，大厅及户外均举办丰富多彩的周边活动《欢乐日》。
可爱的“小剧场”、激动人心的“户外表演”、引人瞩目的“魔术表演”，为节日增添了精彩。还有迎接孩子们的“长腿先生”。
这里有很多体验活动，所以你永远不会感到无聊。我们希望它能成为全家人欢笑、欢乐、留下珍贵回忆的最佳儿童节郊游场所。


【作品简介】

听到心声的“魔糖”讲述了一个关于安慰和成长的温暖故事。
该故事改编自世界著名作家白熙娜的绘本《阿尔坎迪》，故事情节扎实，音乐优美。
添加了各种舞台效果来体现图画书的情感。
自2019年首发以来，连续三年位居儿童及家庭品类销量第一。
这是一部豪华的家庭音乐剧，不仅俘获了孩子们的心，也俘获了父母的心。


[剧情简介]

“这是一块糖果，非常甜。”
 
我在文具店买的一袋糖果。让我们把一块糖放进嘴里
 
我能听到以前听不到的声音！
 
“咚咚啊~咚咚啊~”
 
魔法糖果诉说的心声！
 
接下来会听到谁的声音？

[공연소개]\n\n<이상한 색깔나라의 무지>\n강아지 무지는 토끼를 따라.en:
[Performance introduction]

<Ignorance in the Land of Strange Colors>
Muji the dog follows a rabbit and accidentally falls into a land of strange colors.
There, Muji begins a special adventure to find the missing colors one by one. Along the way, he meets the Queen of Colors and unique friends, and learns about the meaning and beauty of the various colors red, yellow, and blue. The more colors you find, the more your ignorance grows, and when all the colors finally come together to form a rainbow,
Muji discovers his own color and story.
Ignorance in the land of strange colors
Based on Alice in Wonderland
Children follow the story
This is a performance where you can naturally learn and get to know colors and create your own colors.
[공연소개]\n\n<이상한 색깔나라의 무지>\n강아지 무지는 토끼를 따라.zh:
【性能介绍】

<异色之地的无知>
狗狗穆吉跟随一只兔子，不小心掉进了一片奇异的色彩之地。
在那里，无印良品开始了一场特殊的冒险，逐一寻找缺失的颜色。一路上，他遇到了色彩女王和独特的朋友，并了解了红、黄、蓝各种颜色的含义和美丽。你发现的颜色越多，你的无知就越多，当所有的颜色最终聚集在一起形成彩虹时，
无印良品发现了自己的色彩和故事。
陌生色彩之地的无知
改编自爱丽丝梦游仙境
孩子们跟随故事的脚步
这是一个你可以自然地学习和认识颜色并创造自己的颜色的表演。

[Performance introduction]

`A ‘class’ that never changes over time, the best performance for parents.
 
Joo Hyun-mi, a living legend in the history of Korean popular music, will grace the stage of the Gongju Arts Center. Even amidst the splendor of K-POP
Her voice, which demonstrates an unrivaled presence, is the queen of live music with artistic value that transcends the times.
Joo Hyun-mi, who has already passed the 40th anniversary of her debut, not only sings the nation's favorite songs such as <That Person in Sinsa-dong> and <Sorrow's Little Night Song>, but also <A Tavern Without a Bundle>,

Re-gifting. This concert will be a more dignified and meaningful choice for Parents' Day than any other gift.

[공연소개]\n\n`세월이 흘러도 변치 않는 '클래스', 부모님께 드리는.zh:
【性能介绍】

“一堂永不改变的‘班级’，给家长最好的表演。”
 
韩国流行音乐史上的传奇人物朱贤美将在公州艺术中心的舞台上绽放光彩。即使在 K-POP 的辉煌中
她的声音展现出无与伦比的存在感，是现场音乐女王，具有超越时代的艺术价值。
出道40周年的朱贤美不仅演唱了《新沙洞那个人》、《悲伤的小夜曲》等国民歌曲，还演唱了《没有捆绑的酒馆》，
我们计划用现代感性重新诠释《One Gone Spring Day》等韩国传统歌曲的精髓。这对我父母那一代人来说是令人震惊的。
这将是一个向您的孩子们传达渴望和深刻的音乐共鸣的特殊时刻。在最特别的一天，我父母最灿烂的日子
重新赠送。这场音乐会将是双亲节比任何其他礼物都更有尊严、更有意义的选择。

百年纪念旅馆

百纳纳荆棘
 
南仁秀《悲伤的豆浆》
 
白雪熙、《春天已经过去》等

서울시향 김선욱과 알리스 사라 오트 ②.en: Seoul Philharmonic Orchestra Kim Seon-wook and Alice Sarah Ott ②
서울시향 김선욱과 알리스 사라 오트 ②.zh: 首尔爱乐乐团金善旭、爱丽丝·莎拉·奥特 ②

[공연소개]\n독주자로 서울시향과 각별한 관계를 맺어왔고 지휘자로는 지난.en:
[Performance introduction]
Kim Seon-wook, who has had a special relationship with the Seoul Philharmonic Orchestra as a soloist and debuted on the regular performance stage as a conductor in December 2022, meets the Seoul Philharmonic Orchestra once again. After announcing the start of the performance with Modest Mussorgsky’s ‘One Night on a Bare Mountain’, which leaves an impressive atmosphere with its gritty music, the piece that appears is Maurice Ravel’s Piano Concerto in G major. Alice Sarah Ott, who made her name known as a child prodigy in Germany early on and has firmly established herself on the international stage with her popular moves, participates as the soloist in this concerto, which is bright at every moment. Conductor Kim Seon-wook, who decorated the second part with the work of Richard Strauss in the October 2023 performance with the Seoul Philharmonic Orchestra, prepared this time for Johannes Brahms' Symphony No. 2. We look forward to seeing the Brahms that musician Kim Seon-wook will present with the Seoul Philharmonic Orchestra, who has been evaluated as an outstanding Brahms player throughout his career as a pianist and has shown special affection for the composer even after beginning his full-time career as a conductor.

【性能介绍】
作为独奏家与首尔爱乐乐团有着特殊关系，并于2022年12月作为指挥首次登上常规演出舞台的金善旭再次与首尔爱乐乐团见面。莫杰斯特·穆索尔斯基的《荒山之夜》以其粗犷的音乐营造出令人印象深刻的气氛，宣布演出开始后，登场的是莫里斯·拉威尔的G大调钢琴协奏曲。爱丽丝·莎拉·奥特 (Alice Sarah Ott) 是早年在德国被誉为神童，并以流行动作在国际舞台上站稳脚跟的爱丽丝·莎拉·奥特 (Alice Sarah Ott)，她作为独奏者参与了这部每时每刻都熠熠生辉的协奏曲。在 2023 年 10 月与首尔爱乐乐团的演出中，指挥家金善旭以理查德·施特劳斯的作品装饰了第二部分，这次准备了约翰内斯·勃拉姆斯的《第二交响曲》。我们期待看到音乐家金善旭将与首尔爱乐乐团一起演奏的勃拉姆斯作品。全职指挥生涯。

Daejeon Arts Center’s undisputed steady-seller ‘Classical Music That Opens the Morning’ knocks on your morning with new musicians. [공연소개]\n대전예술의전당의 명실상부한 스테디셀러 ‘아침을 여는 클래식.zh:
【性能介绍】
大田艺术中心无可争议的畅销歌曲《打开早晨的古典音乐》将与新音乐家一起敲响您的早晨。从进入新演出季的年轻表演者到将在享有盛誉的舞台上大展身手的职业中期表演者，都有各种各样的编排和节目可供选择。音乐评论家宋贤民去年每次都以对古典音乐的广泛而深刻的评论和诙谐的主持与表演者产生了良好的化学反应，今年将再次加入我们。我们希望您有时间通过​​《开启2026年早晨的经典》来享受音乐之美和欣赏的乐趣。

[공연소개]\n대전예술의전당의 명실상부한 스테디셀러 ‘아침을 여는 클래식.ja:
【公演紹介】
大田芸術の殿堂の名実共に定番の「朝を開くクラシック」が新しいミュージシャンたちと共に皆様の朝をお披露目します。新緑の季節を迎えた若い演奏者から、観録の舞台で大胆さを見せる中堅演奏者まで、様々な組み合わせとプログラムが用意されています。昨年、クラシックに対する広くて深い解説、ウィットのある進行で毎回演奏者たちと膨大な呼吸を見せてくれた音楽評論家ソン・ヒョンミンが今年も一緒にします。 「2026朝を開くクラシック」と一緒に音楽の美しさ、感想の楽しさを満喫する時間をお過ごしください。

[공연소개]\n동화적 환상을 걷어낸 흑백의 스릴러\n\n고전 발레의 우아.en:
[Performance introduction]
A black-and-white thriller that strips away fairytale fantasy.

The Monaco Monte Carlo Ballet, which has captivated dance fans around the world by exquisitely combining the elegance of classical ballet and the unconventionality of modern dance, will captivate Korean audiences with Jean-Christophe Maillot's masterpiece [Swan Lake]. Maillot removed the fairytale fantasy of the original work and transformed ‘The Swan’ into a detailed psychological drama that delve into the inner self of humans by expressing the contrast between black and white, good and evil, purity and desire with sophisticated mise-en-scène. The newly composed music based on Tchaikovsky's original score will be performed live by the Korea Coop Orchestra, further enriching the tension and emotions of the work.
[공연소개]\n동화적 환상을 걷어낸 흑백의 스릴러\n\n고전 발레의 우아.zh:
【性能介绍】
一部剥离童话幻想的黑白惊悚片。

摩纳哥蒙特卡洛芭蕾舞团将古典芭蕾的优雅与现代舞的标新立异完美结合，吸引了世界各地的舞迷，此次将用让·克里斯托夫·马约的代表作《天鹅湖》吸引韩国观众。马约去掉了原作的童话幻想，将《天鹅》改造成一部细致入微的心理剧，通过复杂的场面调度表达黑与白、善与恶、纯洁与欲望的对比，深入探讨人的内心。根据柴可夫斯基原曲创作的新音乐将由韩国合作乐团现场演奏，进一步丰富了作品的张力和情感。

[공연소개]\n\n방송인 조혜련의 첫 연출 및 출연작!\n1980년대,.en:
[Performance introduction]

Broadcaster Jo Hye-ryun's first directing and starring role!
In the 1980s, a tough mother... This is the story of our mother!
 
Broadcaster Cho Hye-ryun directed and starred in the play “My Lovely Mother,” which garnered attention in the 1980s, when she lost her husband and struggled to get out of the market.
This is the story of 'Ok-hee', who sold fish and lived with only her son in mind.
It depicts the process of 'Cheoldong', a childish son who took his mother's endless sacrifice for granted, and belatedly realizes his mother's love.
The stage is filled with cheerful laughter and heartbreaking emotions that remind us of our mothers back in the day.
May, Family Month, will be a warm time for the whole family to laugh and cry together while reflecting on the love of parents they have forgotten.


[Synopsis]
 
“Oiso boiso Saiso~~”
 
A mother who sold fish alone without a husband and lived a strong life as a mother rather than a woman.
To such a mother, the son is always blunt and immature.
 
...One day, my mother was diagnosed with cancer.
 
“Mom”
 
“Wow”
 
“I’m sick… I feel like I’m going to die.”
 
“It doesn’t hit the line… It will take a little while.”
 
“Is it real?”
 
“Mom”
 
“Wow”
 
“Can I do it on my own?”
 
“Well.. whose son is this.. Mom doesn’t have to worry at all. He can do well.”
 
"......."
 
“Cheoldong... Mom, let’s go...”
[공연소개]\n\n방송인 조혜련의 첫 연출 및 출연작!\n1980년대,.zh:
【性能介绍】

广播员赵惠莲首次自导自演！
20世纪80年代，一位坚强的母亲……这就是我们母亲的故事！
 
广播员曹惠莲自导自演的戏剧《我可爱的母亲》在 20 世纪 80 年代引起关注，当时她失去了丈夫，艰难地退出市场。
这是“玉熙”的故事，她卖鱼，只顾着儿子生活。
讲述了将母亲无休无止的牺牲视为理所当然的幼稚儿子“哲童”，迟迟认识到母亲之爱的过程。
舞台上充满了欢快的笑声和心碎的情绪，让我们想起了当年的母亲。
五月，家庭月，将是全家人一起欢笑、一起哭泣、反思已被遗忘的父母之爱的温暖时刻。


[剧情简介]
 
“Oiso boiso Saiso~~”
 
没有丈夫，独自卖鱼的母亲，过着作为母亲而不是女人的坚强生活。
对于这样的母亲来说，儿子总是生硬、不成熟。
 
......有一天，我的母亲被诊断出患有癌症。
 
“妈妈”
 
“哇”
 
“我病了……我感觉我快要死了。”
 
“还没到线……还需要一点时间。”
 
“这是真的吗？”
 
“妈妈”
 
“哇”
 
“我自己可以做吗？”
 
“嗯……这是谁的儿子……妈妈完全不用担心，他会做得很好的。”
 
“……”
 
“哲童……妈妈，我们走吧……”

[공연소개]\n\n살아 움직이는 책, 인형극으로 펼쳐보는 돈키호테\n인형.en:
[Performance introduction]

A living book, Don Quixote unfolding through a puppet show
The puppet show “Sancho and Don Quixote” was recreated so that even children who cannot read books can experience the message of the book “Don Quixote” in an easy and fun way.
The story begins with Sancho, a 9-year-old child, opening a ‘book’ that leads him into a world of adventure. The production using various types of puppets and pop-up books, such as joints, boards, and shadows, depicts Don Quixote's absurd adventures on stage more convincingly. The actors' humorous performances and music, including medieval dances, add romance to artistic imagination.


[Plot]

The story of Sancho going on an adventure with Don Quixote
A different adventure awaits you every time you open a book in a strange and mysterious old bookstore.
The adventure in the book waiting for you today is the story of the knight Don Quixote. An ordinary child who enters the bookstore is called ‘Sancho’ and is led by Don Quixote on a journey to become an honorable knight. As Sancho sets out on the road with Don Quixote, unimaginable events occur every time, such as a windmill giant and a black-maned lion appearing in front of Sancho... . At this time, a large dragon appeared before our eyes! What will happen to Sancho and Don Quixote in the face of a dragon that they cannot slay or avoid?
[공연소개]\n\n살아 움직이는 책, 인형극으로 펼쳐보는 돈키호테\n인형.zh:
【性能介绍】

一本活生生的书，《堂吉诃德》通过木偶戏展开
重新制作了木偶剧《桑乔与堂吉诃德》，让不会读书的孩子也能轻松有趣地体验《堂吉诃德》这本书的信息。
故事从9岁的桑乔打开一本“书”开始，这本书带领他进入了一个冒险的世界。作品运用关节、木板、皮影等多种木偶和立体书，更加真实地描绘了堂吉诃德在舞台上的荒诞冒险经历。演员们幽默的表演和音乐，包括中世纪的舞蹈，为艺术想象增添了浪漫。


[剧情]

桑丘与堂吉诃德一起冒险的故事
每次在陌生而神秘的老书店打开一本书，一次不同的冒险等待着你。
今天等待你的书中的冒险是骑士堂吉诃德的故事。一个走进书店的普通孩子，名叫“桑丘”，在堂吉诃德的带领下踏上了成为尊贵骑士的旅程。当桑丘与堂吉诃德一起上路时，每一次都会发生难以想象的事件，比如风车巨人和黑鬃狮出现在桑丘面前……。这时，一条巨龙出现在我们眼前！面对无法杀死或躲避的巨龙，桑丘和堂吉诃德会发生什么？

insult her Alfredo, who belatedly found out why Violetta left, goes to see her again.

“有一天，你给了我光明。从那天起，我就生活在伟大的爱之中。”

放弃巴黎的奢华生活后，他与儿子开始了新的生活，儿子却爱上了一位社交名流。
阿尔弗雷多的父亲维奥莱塔认为他在浪费生命，劝他离开。

阿尔弗雷多（Alfredo）在很晚才知道维奥莱塔（Violetta）离开的原因后再次去看望她。
维奥莱塔病重且无法康复，最终去世。

[Performance introduction]
When you were young, you probably all thought about flying in a balloon.

Now that I think about it, it may seem like a stupid idea, but 

When I was young, I imagined this impossible and it seemed like anything was possible.

So are all the dreams we imagined as children impossible? 

I think it was because of that imagination that we created airplanes and electricity.

Today, more things will be accomplished and created than we can imagine. 

< Impossible is possible >
[공연소개]\n여러분들은 어렸을 적에 풍선을 타고 날아간다는 생각은 누구.zh:
【性能介绍】
当你年轻的时候，你可能都想过乘坐气球飞行。

现在想来，这似乎是一个愚蠢的想法，但是 

当我年轻的时候，我想象这是不可能的，似乎一切皆有可能。

那么我们小时候想象的所有梦想都是不可能的吗？ 

我认为正是由于这种想象力，我们创造了飞机和电力。

今天，我们将完成和创造更多的事情，超乎我们的想象。 

< 不可能也是可能 >

[Performance introduction]
Matinee concert with classical evangelist Maestro Geum Nan-sae
 
Following last year's seasonal theme, the Matinee Concert with Geum Nan-sae meets audiences again this year with a masterpiece series introducing the most beloved concertos in classical history.
Based on conductor Geum Nan-sae's witty commentary and in-depth musical knowledge, each episode presents masterpieces by representative composers.
Fill your mornings with a variety of repertoire, from violin, cello, and piano concertos to string music and chamber music.
Warm coffee and sweet cookies provided before the performance, along with conductor Geum Nan-sae's humor and commentary, will provide an even more special matinee stage.

【性能介绍】
与古典传播大师金兰世 (Geum Nan-sae) 合作的日场音乐会
 
继去年的季节性主题之后，金兰世的日场音乐会今年再次与观众见面，带来一系列介绍古典史上最受欢迎的协奏曲的杰作。
以指挥家金兰世的诙谐解说和深厚的音乐知识为基础，每一集都会呈现代表性作曲家的杰作。
让您的早晨充满各种曲目，从小提琴、大提琴、钢琴协奏曲到弦乐和室内乐。
演出前提供的热咖啡和甜饼干，加上指挥金南世的幽默解说，将为日场舞台带来更加特别的气氛。

[시놉시스]\n\n박대출은 평생 돈이 없어 가난에 허덕이다 죽었다.\n\.en:
[Synopsis]

Park Dae-chul had no money throughout his life and died in poverty.

When the memorial service in his honor began, Park Dae-chul couldn't bear the injustice and came back to life.

In my last life, I lived and died in poverty with only loans, but in this life, I will definitely live and die as a rich person.

Park Dae-chul and the villagers come back to life, but honest people are always poor.

Bad people are angry at being rich and summon the money god.

At this time, the god of poverty tries to dissuade Park Dae-chul and the villagers, saying that money is bad.

However, Park Dae-chul and the village people do not agree and defeat the god of poverty and summon the god of money.

But a blind man dressed as a beggar appears in front of them...
[시놉시스]\n\n박대출은 평생 돈이 없어 가난에 허덕이다 죽었다.\n\.zh:
[剧情简介]

朴大哲一生没有钱，死于贫困。

当追悼会开始时，朴大哲无法忍受委屈，又活了过来。

上一世，我是靠着贷款而生、死的，但这一世，我一定会像一个富人一样生、死。

朴大哲和村民们起死回生，但诚实的人总是贫穷的。

坏人因有钱而愤怒，召唤财神。

这时，穷神试图劝阻朴大哲和村民们，说钱不好。

然而，朴大哲和村民们并不同意，并打败了穷神并召唤了财神。

然而，一个打扮成乞丐的盲人出现在他们面前……

[Performance introduction]

A one-time performance to celebrate our 10th anniversary in Korea!
 
Violinist Danny Goo is loved by the entire nation for his 'positive energy' on MBC's <I Live Alone>!
He, who has been the 'busiest classical star' since his debut on the Korean stage in 2016, will hold a recital to commemorate his 10th anniversary in Korea in 2026.
This performance is a meaningful stage that looks back on the journey of the past 10 years and announces the beginning of a new ‘journey’ moving forward.
The stage opened splendidly with his favorite song, Corelli's 'La Folia', and a modern reinterpretation of the masterpiece of classical master 'Bach'.
And ‘Claude Bowling’s’ exciting suite with jazz piano trio and ‘Gershwin’s’ captivating melody!
We want to share with the audience the musical footsteps of the past 10 years and the new beginnings of the future.

[공연소개]\n\n한국 활동 10주년을 기념하는 단 한 번의 무대!\n.zh:
【性能介绍】

庆祝韩国出道10周年的一次性公演！
 
小提琴家具丹尼在MBC《我独自生活》中展现的“正能量”受到全国人民的喜爱！
自2016年在韩国舞台首次亮相以来，他一直是“最忙碌的古典明星”，他将于2026年举办独奏会，纪念他在韩国出道10周年。
这场演出是一个有意义的舞台，回顾了过去10年的历程，宣告了新的“征程”的开始。
舞台在他最喜欢的歌曲科莱利的《La Folia》以及对古典大师杰作《巴赫》的现代重新诠释中华丽拉开帷幕。
还有“克劳德·鲍林”令人兴奋的组曲，包括爵士钢琴三重奏和“格什温”迷人的旋律！
我们想与观众分享过去10年的音乐脚步和未来的新起点。

[공연소개]\n\n살아 움직이는 책, 인형극으로 펼쳐보는 돈키호테\n \.en:
[Performance introduction]

A living book, Don Quixote unfolding through a puppet show
 
The puppet show <Sancho and Don Quixote> is the story of Sancho going on an adventure with Don Quixote. This work was recreated with Sancho as a child as the main character.
Although it is different from the original novel, it still contains the message of the original, 'Tomorrow's Don Quixote is Sancho.' The puppet show <Sancho and Don Quixote> cannot read the book yet.
It was created so that even children could see it as if it were a living book.
 
A strange and mysterious old bookstore. A different adventure awaits you every time you open a book. The adventure in the book waiting for you today is the story of the knight Don Quixote.
An ordinary child who enters the bookstore is called 'Sancho' and is led by Don Quixote to set out on a journey to become an honorable knight.
Unimaginable events occur, such as fighting a windmill giant and a black-maned lion...
 
At this time, a large dragon appeared before my eyes!
What will happen to Sancho and Don Quixote when they encounter a dragon that they cannot avoid or slay?


[Synopsis]
 
Take the lead, Sancho, take out your trumpet and blow! Let's go, it's an adventure!
Now, my friend Sancho, tell me where to find the lion!
 
A different adventure awaits you every time you open a book in a strange and mysterious old bookstore.
 
The adventure in the book waiting for you today is the story of the knight Don Quixote.
 
An ordinary child who enters a bookstore is called ‘Sancho’.
Led by Don Quixote, he sets out on a journey to become an honorable knight.
 
Unimaginable events occur, such as fighting a windmill giant and a black-maned lion...
At this time, a large dragon appeared before our eyes!
 
What will happen to Sancho and Don Quixote when they encounter a dragon that they cannot escape or defeat?
[공연소개]\n\n살아 움직이는 책, 인형극으로 펼쳐보는 돈키호테\n \.zh:
【性能介绍】

一本活生生的书，《堂吉诃德》通过木偶戏展开
 
木偶剧《桑丘与堂吉诃德》讲述了桑丘与堂吉诃德一起冒险的故事。这部作品以小时候的桑乔为主角进行了再现。
虽然与原著有所不同，但依然包含了原著的信息“明天的堂吉诃德是桑乔”。木偶剧《桑丘与堂吉诃德》还不能看书。
它的创建是为了让孩子们也能看到它，就好像它是一本活生生的书一样。
 
一家陌生又神秘的老书店。每次打开一本书，一次不同的冒险等待着你。今天等待你的书中的冒险是骑士堂吉诃德的故事。
一个走进书店的普通孩子，名叫“桑丘”，在堂吉诃德的带领下，踏上了成为尊贵骑士的旅程。
难以想象的事件发生了，比如与风车巨人和黑鬃狮的战斗……
 
这时，一条巨龙出现在我的眼前！
当桑丘和堂吉诃德遇到无法躲避或杀死的巨龙时，他们会发生什么？


[剧情简介]
 
带头，桑乔，拿出你的喇叭吹吧！走吧，这是一次冒险！
现在，我的朋友桑乔，告诉我在哪里可以找到狮子！
 
每次在陌生而神秘的老书店打开一本书，一次不同的冒险等待着你。
 
今天等待你的书中的冒险是骑士堂吉诃德的故事。
 
一个走进书店的普通孩子被称为“桑乔”。
在堂吉诃德的带领下，他踏上了成为一名尊贵骑士的旅程。
 
难以想象的事件发生了，比如与风车巨人和黑鬃狮的战斗……
这时，一条巨龙出现在我们眼前！
 
当桑丘和堂吉诃德遇到无法逃脱或击败的巨龙时，他们会发生什么？

[공연소개]\n\n귀로 듣고 눈으로 즐기는 친절한 발레 <백조의 호수>\.en:
[Performance introduction]

A friendly ballet <Swan Lake> that can be enjoyed with the ears and eyes.
 
<Swan Lake> presented by Seoul City Ballet breaks the prejudice that ballet is difficult by providing friendly commentary on the beautiful movements of the dancers.
It is a ‘tailored to eye level’ performance designed so that anyone, regardless of gender or age, can enjoy it easily and with fun. The story goes that Prince Siegfried is a wizard at a lake in the forest.
It begins with him meeting Princess Odette, the Swan Queen under Rothwald's curse, and swearing fateful love. The wizard brought out the black swan Odile and brought the two together.
It depicts a beautiful ending in which people try to separate each other, but ultimately overcome trials and regain happiness through the power of true love. Trying to understand the mime or the plot
If you follow the exciting story told by the narrator without any need, you will soon become immersed in the work. For children who are new to ballet
It will become a living fairy tale book and the best introductory performance for adult audiences to easily enjoy the depth of the classics.


[Synopsis]
 
Prologue Prince's Coming of Age Ceremony
Prince Siegfried, who had a grand coming-of-age ceremony and received a bow as a gift, saw a swan flying away.
I go hunting by the lakeside with my friends.
 
Act 1 Lakeside view
Prince Siegfried, who came to the forest chasing swans, is attacked by wolves and Rodwald at the lakeside, but overcomes them with the help of the swans.
He discovers Princess Odette, who transforms into human form, falls in love with her at first sight, and proposes to her. For the princess to be freed from the devil's spell
After hearing that he must receive the eternal love of one person, Prince Siegfried promises to swear an oath of love.
 
Act 2 Palace Ballroom
Prince Siegfried welcomes the guests while waiting for Princess Odette to arrive. Friends and ladybugs are enjoying a party together
The demon Rodwald appears with his daughter Odile, who resembles Princess Odette. Odile, brought by the devil Rodwald, becomes Princess Odette.
Prince Siegfried, deluded, announces his marriage to her and promises eternal love at Rodwald's request. At this time, his true colors were revealed.
The demon Rodwald and Odile disappear and Prince Siegfried runs into the forest in sorrow.
 
Act 3 Eternal Love
Princess Odette is forced to live as a swan forever due to Prince Siegfried's betrayal. Prince Siegfried and Odette run to receive forgiveness
Although the princesses mourn each other's fate, they defeat the demon Rodwald with the power of love and promise eternal love.
[공연소개]\n\n귀로 듣고 눈으로 즐기는 친절한 발레 <백조의 호수>\.zh:
【性能介绍】

一部可以用耳朵和眼睛欣赏的友好芭蕾舞剧《天鹅湖》。
 
首尔城市芭蕾舞团的《天鹅湖》打破了人们对芭蕾舞难度的偏见，对舞者优美的动作进行了亲切的解说。
这是一种“根据视线水平量身定制”的表演，旨在让任何人，无论性别或年龄，都可以轻松、有趣地享受它。故事说齐格弗里德王子是森林湖边的一位巫师。
故事开始于他遇见了罗斯瓦尔德诅咒下的天鹅女王奥黛特公主，并宣誓了命中注定的爱情。巫师带出了黑天鹅奥迪尔，将两人带到了一起。
它描绘了一个美好的结局，人们试图分开，但最终通过真爱的力量克服考验，重获幸福。尝试理解哑剧或情节
如果你不需要任何帮助就跟着解说员讲述的激动人心的故事，你很快就会沉浸在作品中。适合刚接触芭蕾舞的孩子
它将成为一本活生生的童话书，成为成年观众轻松领略经典深度的最佳入门演出。


[剧情简介]
 
序幕 王子的成年典礼
齐格弗里德王子在举行盛大的成人仪式并收到弓作为礼物时，看到一只天鹅飞走了。
我和朋友们去湖边打猎。
 
第一幕 湖畔景观
齐格弗里德王子来到森林追逐天鹅，在湖边遭到狼群和罗德瓦尔德的袭击，但在天鹅的帮助下战胜了狼群。
他发现了变身为人类的奥黛特公主，对她一见钟情，并向她求婚。为了让公主摆脱恶魔的咒语
齐格弗里德王子听说自己必须得到一个人永恒的爱后，立下誓言。
 
第二幕 宫殿宴会厅
齐格弗里德王子一边欢迎客人，一边等待奥黛特公主的到来。朋友和瓢虫一起享受聚会
恶魔罗德瓦尔德带着他的女儿奥迪尔出现，她的女儿酷似奥黛特公主。奥迪尔被恶魔罗德瓦尔德带来，成为奥黛特公主。
受迷惑的齐格弗里德王子宣布与她结婚，并在罗德瓦尔德的要求下许诺永恒的爱情。这时候，他的真面目就显露出来了。
恶魔罗德瓦尔德和奥迪尔消失了，齐格弗里德王子悲伤地跑进森林。
 
第三幕 永恒的爱
由于齐格弗里德王子的背叛，奥黛特公主被迫永远像天鹅一样生活。齐格弗里德王子和奥黛特奔跑寻求宽恕
公主们虽然互相哀悼彼此的命运，但她们还是用爱的力量打败了恶魔罗德沃德，并许下了永恒的爱情。

[Performance introduction]
When the rhythm sounds, the stage becomes a festival.
 
The orchestral music <Festival> presented by the National Gugak Center's Creative Orchestra breaks down the boundaries of Korean traditional orchestral music by reinterpreting the deep breath of tradition with a modern sense.
This is a stage where the essence of our dynamic music is displayed. In the sound of magnificent orchestral music, the delicate melodies of the daegeum, piri, and haegeum come to life and broadcast. 
From the familiar 'Frontier' of both dialects to the deep resonance of calligraphy sound, the splendid technique of the mysterious Saenghwang, and the rain rose of 'Beompi Jungryu' from Simcheongga.
In addition, it dramatically depicts the process in which Han's emotions soar powerfully into the energy of excitement. The wave-like sound created by the overlap of different breaths
The essence of Korean music is clearly revealed, and in particular, 'Pannoreum', a combination of samulnori and orchestral music at the peak of the performance, creates an overwhelming performance that unites the stage and the audience.
It will provide excitement. By adding popular trends and colorful compositions to boldly break the stereotype that “tradition is boring,” even audiences unfamiliar with Korean traditional music can enjoy it.
It will be a thrilling festival scene where you will be captivated by the dynamic energy and enjoy the excitement of our sori music with your whole body.

Orchestral Frontier (Composition/Yang Bang-eon)
 
Calligraphy Concerto ‘Poetry of Wind, Trees and Earth’ for calligraphy sound and orchestra
 
Saenghwang Concerto Fantastic (Composer/Lee Jeong-ho)

[공연소개]\n장단이 울리면, 무대는 축제가 된다.\n \n국립국악원 창.zh:
【性能介绍】
当节奏响起，舞台就变成了节日。
 
国立国乐院创意乐团演奏的管弦乐《祭典》打破了韩国传统管弦乐的界限，用现代感重新诠释了传统的深沉气息。
这是一个展示我们动感音乐精髓的舞台。在宏伟的管弦乐声中，大琴、皮里、叼琴的细腻旋律栩栩如生地播放。 
从熟悉的两种方言的“边界”到书法声音的深刻共鸣，神秘生黄的精湛技巧，以及来自深清阁的“凡皮正流”的雨升。
此外，它还戏剧性地描绘了韩的情绪猛烈上升为兴奋能量的过程。不同呼吸重叠产生的波浪般的声音
韩国音乐的精髓被清晰地展现出来，特别是在表演巅峰时将四物音乐与管弦乐相结合的《Pannoreum》，创造了将舞台和观众团结在一起的压倒性表演。
它会带来兴奋。通过加入流行趋势和丰富多彩的作品，大胆打破“传统乏味”的刻板印象，即使不熟悉韩国传统音乐的观众也能享受其中。
这将是一个激动人心的节日场景，您将被充满活力的能量所吸引，并用全身享受我们的索里音乐的兴奋。

[Performance introduction]

Who said classics are boring? Beyond imagination! A comical string quartet that makes you laugh so hard!
 
The string quartet 'Pagagnini', produced by YLLANA Production, a Spanish production company specializing in performance, is a unique comical performance that breaks the mold of classical concerts, which are usually serious and solemn.
It captivates the audience with witty humor and a beautiful musical medley that stimulates emotions. In particular, it tells the story of genius musician Paganini's complex composition methods, reckless personality, and musical interpretation.
reflected in This performance is a new genre called 'classical contemporary music' presented by four outstanding performers with elegant performance skills, and will attract not only the general audience but also the general audience.
It also received praise from demanding audiences who were knowledgeable about music. It can be enjoyed by audiences from all over the world, regardless of age or nationality, and was held at the 2008 Edinburgh Fringe Festival in the UK.
Its quality was recognized by winning awards at numerous international festivals, including the 'Best Picture Award'. It was invited as the opening production of the Busan International Theater Festival and was sold out.
In 2026, we will use even more upgraded humor and irony to allow audiences to interact with the stage through laughter.

【性能介绍】

谁说经典乏味？超乎想象！滑稽的弦乐四重奏，让你开怀大笑！
 
由西班牙专门从事表演的制作公司YLLANA Production制作的弦乐四重奏《帕加尼尼》是一场独特的滑稽表演，打破了古典音乐会通常严肃、庄重的模式。
它以诙谐的幽默和激发情感的优美音乐混合曲吸引着观众。尤其讲述了天才音乐家帕格尼尼复杂的作曲方法、鲁莽的性格以及音乐诠释的故事。
这场演出所体现的是由四位优秀演奏家以优雅的表演技巧呈现的一种名为“古典当代音乐”的新流派，不仅会吸引普通观众，也会吸引广大观众。
它还获得了对音乐有了解的挑剔观众的好评。它可供世界各地的观众欣赏，无论年龄或国籍，并于2008年在英国爱丁堡边缘艺术节上举行。
其质量得到认可，在众多国际电影节上获奖，包括“最佳影片奖”。该剧受邀作为釜山国际戏剧节开幕剧并售空。
2026年，我们将用更加升级的幽默和讽刺，让观众通过笑声与舞台互动。

[Performance introduction]

Time to expand from listening to understanding
 
Lecture concerts are lecture-type concerts that explore various musical genres, from baroque and romantic classics to opera, musicals, Latin classical (tango), and jazz, through expert commentary and demonstrations.
The genre's birth, background, history, and composer's representative songs are explained in an easy and fun way, and it is composed mainly of popular songs so that everyone from beginners to lovers of each genre can enjoy it. 
Provides a three-dimensional experience. Four independent performances are connected organically, helping audiences understand the wide world of music as if traveling naturally, and allowing audiences to enjoy music in their daily lives.
This is a performance designed to make you feel closer. We want to present a special morning to the audience through coffee and cookies provided before the performance, as well as fun and interesting commentary and performances.

【性能介绍】

是时候从倾听扩展到理解了
 
讲座音乐会是讲座型音乐会，通过专家的解说和演示，探索各种音乐流派，从巴洛克和浪漫主义经典到歌剧、音乐剧、拉丁古典（探戈）和爵士乐。
以轻松有趣的方式解释该流派的诞生、背景、历史和作曲家的代表歌曲，并且以流行歌曲为主要内容，以便每个流派的每个人从初学者到爱好者都可以享受。 
提供三维体验。四场独立演出有机衔接，帮助观众如自然旅行般了解广阔的音乐世界，让观众在日常生活中享受音乐。
这是一场旨在让你们感觉更亲近的表演。我们希望通过演出前提供的咖啡和饼干，以及有趣有趣的解说和表演，为观众呈现一个特别的早晨。

[공연소개]\n\n듣는 것에서 이해하는 것으로 확장되는 시간\n \n렉처.ja:
【公演紹介】

聞くことから理解するまで拡大する時間
 
レクチャーコンサートは、バロック、ロマン派の古典からオペラ、ミュージカル、ラテンクラシック（タンゴ）、ジャズまで、さまざまな音楽ジャンルを専門家の解説と実演を通して探求する講義型のコンサートです。
ジャンルの誕生、背景、歴史、作曲家の代表曲などをわかりやすく楽しく解説し、初心者から各ジャンル愛好家まで楽しめるよう人気曲を中心に構成しています。 
3次元の体験を提供します。 4つの独立した演奏が有機的につながり、自然に旅をするように広い音楽の世界を理解し、日常生活の中で音楽を楽しむことができます。
より身近に感じていただくための演出です。開演前のコーヒーやクッキー、楽しくて面白い解説やパフォーマンスを通して、お客様に特別な朝をお届けしたいと思っております。


【プログラム】

＜孤独と情熱の始まり＞
伝統的なタンゴとクラシック音楽の融合を試みたピアソラの音楽遍歴を解説し、タンゴの核心とも言われるバンドネオンの魅力を語る。
オブリビオン

[Performance introduction]

A voice that becomes a poem meets an orchestra.
 
The 'Special Concert' with La Poem and the Gongju City Chungnam Symphony Orchestra is a special stage that encompasses various genres such as pop, pop, and musicals.
La Poem, the world's first crossover group to include a traditional countertenor, presents a poetry-like stage to the audience with resonance and emotional expression based on vocal music.
In this performance, La Poem's representative songs will be presented as well as new interpretations that cross genre boundaries through rich melodies with the orchestra.
The grandeur of classical music, the familiarity of popular music, and La Poem's unique artistic sensibility will combine to provide a special experience to the audience.

[공연소개]\n\n한 편의 시가 되는 목소리, 오케스트라와 만나다.\n.zh:
【性能介绍】

成为一首诗的声音遇见了一支管弦乐队。
 
La Poem与公州市忠南交响乐团合作的“特别音乐会”是涵盖流行音乐、流行音乐、音乐剧等多种流派的特别舞台。
La Poem是全球首个由传统男高音加入的跨界组合，以声乐为基础，为观众呈现出一个充满共鸣和情感表达的诗歌般的舞台。
本次演出将呈现La Poem的代表歌曲，并与乐团一起通过丰富的旋律呈现跨越流派界限的新诠释。
古典音乐的宏伟、流行音乐的熟悉性以及La Poem独特的艺术感受力相结合，将为观众带来特殊的体验。

落叶诗
风之国诗 (霸厨OST)
音乐剧《巴黎圣母院》中的《大教堂时代》等

Following last year's seasonal theme, the Matinee Concert with Geum Nan-sae meets audiences again this year with a masterpiece series introducing the most beloved concertos in classical history.
Based on conductor Geum Nan-sae's witty commentary and in-depth musical knowledge, each episode presents masterpieces by representative composers.

【性能介绍】

与古典传播大师金兰世 (Geum Nan-sae) 合作的日场音乐会
 
继去年的季节性主题之后，金兰世的日场音乐会今年再次与观众见面，带来一系列介绍古典史上最受欢迎的协奏曲的杰作。
以指挥家金兰世的诙谐解说和深厚的音乐知识为基础，每一集都会呈现代表性作曲家的杰作。
让您的早晨充满各种曲目，从小提琴、大提琴、钢琴协奏曲到弦乐和室内乐。
演出前提供的热咖啡和甜饼干，加上指挥金南世的幽默解说，将为日场舞台带来更加特别的气氛。

クラシック伝道師マエストロ今夜とのマティーネコンサート
 
今年の季節のテーマに続き、今年はクラシック史で最も愛される協奏曲を紹介する名作シリーズで再び観客に会う。
今回の指揮者の機知ある解説と深い音楽的知識をもとに、毎回次代表作曲家たちの名曲を披露し、
ヴァイオリン・チェロ・ピアノ協奏曲から弦楽曲、室内楽まで様々なレパートリーで朝時間を盛り上げる。

[공연소개]\n기묘한 문 너머 펼쳐지는 꿈같은 시간,\n상상 그 이상의.en:
[Performance introduction]
A dream-like time unfolding beyond a strange door,
Fantastic magic art beyond imagination
 
The nonverbal performance <SNAP> is a fantastical experience through a mysterious door that three mischievous ‘tricksters’ accidentally discovered.
It is an original art performance depicting a journey around the world. Telling a story without dialogue, only through gestures and facial expressions
This stage exquisitely combines media art, shadow art, and mime with magic to create a moving piece.
It provides visual enjoyment like watching a famous painting. Because there is no language barrier, everyone from illiterate children to adults can enjoy intuitive humor and
You can enjoy wit to your heart’s content. The commotion and magical production of extraordinary characters unfolding in the world beyond the door will keep the audience from falling asleep.
It constantly stimulates my curiosity. This performance will be the most magical gift that the whole family can immerse themselves in, laugh about, and enjoy together.
[공연소개]\n기묘한 문 너머 펼쳐지는 꿈같은 시간,\n상상 그 이상의.zh:
【性能介绍】
陌生的门外展开了梦幻般的时光，
Fantastic magic art beyond imagination
 
无语言表演《SNAP》讲述的是三个淘气的“骗子”无意中发现的神秘之门的奇幻体验。
这是一场描绘环球旅行的原创艺术表演。无需对话，仅通过手势和面部表情讲述故事
这个舞台将媒体艺术、皮影艺术、哑剧与魔术巧妙地结合在一起，创造出动人的作品。
提供如观赏名画般的视觉享受。因为没有语言障碍，从文盲儿童到成人，每个人都可以享受直观的幽默和

[공연소개]\n\n백제의 고도 공주와 정신문화의 수도 안동,\n시대를 넘.en:
[Performance introduction]

The ancient princess of Baekje and Andong, the capital of spiritual culture,
An overwhelming and touching moment that transcends time and becomes one through art.
 
Beyond suffering to joy!
A message of hope from two sister cities! At the threshold of winter, a special performance will be held that will fill the stage with a magnificent sound.
This concert, organized to commemorate the sisterhood relationship between Gongju City and Andong City and to strengthen the friendship between the two cities, is the first concert in the history of classical music.
Beethoven's last symphony, 'The 9th Symphony', which is considered one of his greatest masterpieces, will be presented.
Beethoven's spirit of singing about humanity and hope even in desperate situations is harmonized with the meeting of two cities with a long history.
It conveys a deeper meaning. The elaborate and powerful performance of the Gongju City Chungnam Symphony Orchestra, which represents Gongju, and the Gongju City Choir and
The delicate and rich harmony of the Andong City Choir is expected to create explosive synergy.
The moment the 4th movement ‘Ode to Joy’ rings out, the stage and audience will feel a thrill of excitement as they become one!
The melody of peace and harmony will resonate deeply in your heart.

[공연소개]\n\n백제의 고도 공주와 정신문화의 수도 안동,\n시대를 넘.zh:
【性能介绍】

百济和精神文化之都安东的古代公主，
这是一个超越时间、通过艺术融为一体的压倒性感人时刻。
 
超越痛苦，走向快乐！
来自两座友好城市的希望信息！冬季来临之际，将举行一场特别的演出，让舞台充满壮丽的声音。
此次音乐会是为了纪念公州市与安东市的姐妹关系、加强两市之间的友谊而举办的，是古典音乐史上的第一场音乐会。
贝多芬的最后一部交响曲“第九交响曲”被认为是他最伟大的杰作之一。
贝多芬在绝境中歌颂人性和希望的精神与两座历史悠久的城市的相遇融为一体。
它传达了更深层次的意义。代表公州的公州市忠南交响乐团、公州市合唱团和
安东市合唱团细腻而丰富的和声有望产生爆炸性的协同效应。
当第四乐章《欢乐颂》响起的那一刻，舞台与观众合而为一的激动！
和平与和谐的旋律将在你的内心深处产生共鸣。

계유정난이 조선을 뒤흔들고 어린 왕 이홍위는 왕위에서 쫓겨나 유배길에 오.en: The Gyeyujeong Rebellion shakes Joseon, and the young king Lee Hongwi is kicked out of the throne and sent into exile. Meanwhile, Eom Heung-do, the village chief of Gwangcheongol, a mountain village in Yeongwol, Gangwon-do, strives to make Cheongnyeongpo a place of exile for the villagers who are having a hard time making a living. However, the person the village chief welcomed with exuberant dreams was Lee Hong-wi, who had been kicked out of the throne. As the conservative owner who protects the place of exile, the village chief has to monitor his every day life. He becomes more and more concerned about Lee Hong-wi, who has lost his will to live...
계유정난이 조선을 뒤흔들고 어린 왕 이홍위는 왕위에서 쫓겨나 유배길에 오.zh: 桂裕贞之乱震动了朝鲜，年轻的国王李弘威被赶下王位并流放。与此同时，江原道宁越山村广清谷的村长严兴道努力将清岭浦打造成生活困难的村民的流放地。然而，村长满怀梦想迎接的人却是被赶下王位的李弘伟。作为保护流放地的保守主人，村长必须监视他的日常生活。他越来越担心失去了活下去意志的李弘伟……
계유정난이 조선을 뒤흔들고 어린 왕 이홍위는 왕위에서 쫓겨나 유배길에 오.ja: 渓遊政難が朝鮮を揺さぶり、若い王イ・ホンウィは王位から追い出され、流配道に上がる。一方、江原道ヨンウォル山骨村光天骨の村長オム・フンドは、食べて生きにくい村人のために清霊浦を流刑地にするために努力する。しかし村長が膨らんだ夢で迎えたのは王位から追い出された李洪委だった。流刑地を守る保守主人として彼のすべての日常を監視しなければならない村長は人生の意志を失ったイ・ホンウィがますます気になるのに…。

결혼 후 연기를 안 하게 되었고, 이혼 후 다시 일을 하기 위해 독립영화.en: After getting married, I stopped acting, and after my divorce, I filmed an independent film to get back to work. Today I am being interviewed for the release of the film I shot. It is the day when I become middle-aged and show my face to the world as an actor for the first time in a very long time. Three interviews take place at thirty-minute intervals, and the woman does her best to answer the questions. After the interview, I go to a new acting class. There, the acting teacher asks us to re-enact today's interview. When we get to the most important part of the interview, the woman somehow seems to have no memory of it. I'm tired and want to go home quickly. My daughter is waiting.
결혼 후 연기를 안 하게 되었고, 이혼 후 다시 일을 하기 위해 독립영화.zh: 结婚后，我不再演戏，离婚后，我拍了一部独立电影，重新开始工作。今天我正在接受关于我拍摄的电影上映的采访。这是我人到中年，很长一段时间以来第一次以演员的身份向世界展示自己的脸的日子。三次采访每隔三十分钟进行一次，这位女士尽力回答问题。面试结束后，我去参加一个新的表演班。在那里，表演老师要求我们重演今天的采访。当我们谈到采访中最重要的部分时，这位女士似乎不记得了。我累了，想快点回家。我的女儿正在等待。
