비밀도, 진실도 차가운 얼음 바다에 수장되는 블라디보스토크에서 서로 다른.en: A story of people with different goals clashing in Vladivostok, where both secrets and truth are submerged in the cold icy sea.
비밀도, 진실도 차가운 얼음 바다에 수장되는 블라디보스토크에서 서로 다른.zh: 一个有着不同目标的人们在符拉迪沃斯托克发生冲突的故事，秘密和真相都被淹没在寒冷的冰海中。

자연 속에서 자유롭게 살아온 ‘아녜스’는 마을에 새로 온 교사 ‘윌리엄.en: Agnes, who has lived freely in nature, falls in love with William Shakespeare, a new teacher in town, and starts a family. One day, an unexpected tragedy strikes the two, and in the midst of the terrible pain of losing the most precious thing in life, the two overcome the wounds and tragedy in their own ways...
자연 속에서 자유롭게 살아온 ‘아녜스’는 마을에 새로 온 교사 ‘윌리엄.zh: 在大自然中自由生活的艾格尼丝爱上了镇上新来的老师威廉·莎士比亚，并组建了家庭。有一天，一场意想不到的悲剧降临到两人身上，在失去生命中最珍贵的东西的巨大痛苦中，两人用自己的方式克服了创伤和悲剧……

좀비 랜드 사가: 유메긴가 파라다이스.zh: 僵尸之地传奇：尤梅金加天堂

미친 듯이 사랑했던 그레이스와 잭슨에게 아기가 생긴다. 불처럼 타오르던.en: Grace and Jackson, who were madly in love, have a baby. The love between the two people, which burned like fire, slowly dies out and even sex dries up. As her loneliness deepens, Grace becomes unable to write as a writer and begins to gradually destroy herself. Jackson, who watches all the collapse from the sidelines, is obsessed with the fear that he may not be able to get this love back.
미친 듯이 사랑했던 그레이스와 잭슨에게 아기가 생긴다. 불처럼 타오르던.zh: 疯狂相爱的格蕾丝和杰克逊生下了一个孩子。两个人之间如火般燃烧的爱情慢慢熄灭，甚至连性也干枯了。随着孤独感的加深，格蕾丝变得无法以作家的身份写作，并开始逐渐摧毁自己。杰克逊在场外目睹了所有的崩溃，他担心自己可能无法拿回这份爱。

전설적인 가수, 아벨은 이별로 무너진다. 그런 아벨 앞에 나타난 의문의.en: Legendary singer Abel breaks down after a breakup. A mysterious woman, Annie, appears before Abel. The real story begins behind the scenes!
전설적인 가수, 아벨은 이별로 무너진다. 그런 아벨 앞에 나타난 의문의.zh: 传奇歌手阿贝尔在分手后精神崩溃。一个神秘的女人安妮出现在亚伯面前。真正的故事从幕后开始！

오랜 연구 끝에 개발한 ‘호핑’ 기술로 동물 세계에 가까이 갈 수 있음을.en: The main character, Mabel, discovers that she can get closer to the animal world through the ‘hopping’ technology developed after a long period of research. She is amazed that it is like an ‘Avatar’ and becomes a robot beaver to infiltrate the animal world. Mabel, who understands their words, experiences the animal world as if she were a real animal. She stops a bear from attacking another beaver in the pond, but learns that they have their own order and laws. The doctor who developed the ‘hopping’ technology warns that this technology should not be used to disturb the order of the natural world, but ‘Mabel’ cuts off communication, foreshadowing an unpredictable adventure that will unfold in the future.
오랜 연구 끝에 개발한 ‘호핑’ 기술로 동물 세계에 가까이 갈 수 있음을.zh: 主角梅布尔发现，通过长期研究开发出的“跳跃”技术，她可以更加接近动物世界。她惊讶地发现它就像“阿凡达”一样，变成了机器海狸，渗透到动物世界。梅布尔听懂了他们的话，体验着动物世界，就像她是一只真正的动物一样。她阻止一只熊攻击池塘里的另一只海狸，但得知它们有自己的秩序和法律。开发“跳跃”技术的医生警告说，这项技术不应该被用来扰乱自然世界的秩序，但“梅布尔”却切断了通讯，预示着未来将展开一场不可预知的冒险。

중학교 졸업이 얼마 남지 않은 날, ‘여울’은 소꿉친구 ‘호수’에게 갑작.en: Just days away from graduating from middle school, ‘Yeoul’ received a sudden confessional attack from her childhood friend ‘Hosu’! Since I couldn't think of him as anything more than a friend, I rejected him outright... I never thought I'd meet her again in high school! Every time ‘Yeoul’ sees the ‘lake’, a part of his heart feels uncomfortable. It's also annoying that I can never go back to the way I was before. Meanwhile, ‘Yeoul’ confesses to a senior on the basketball team in a fit of anger, and their first love falls into more and more confusion…
중학교 졸업이 얼마 남지 않은 날, ‘여울’은 소꿉친구 ‘호수’에게 갑작.zh: 距离中学毕业仅剩几天，“Yeoul”突然遭到了青梅竹马“Hosu”的表白攻击！因为我只能把他当作朋友，所以我断然拒绝了他……我没想到我会在高中再次见到她！每当‘烈’看到‘湖’时，他的心里就会有一部分不舒服。同样令人烦恼的是我再也无法回到以前的样子了。与此同时，“烈”一气之下向篮球队的前辈表白，他们的初恋也陷入了越来越混乱……

24시간 빈틈없이 살아온 구청의 갓생 과장 국희. 승진은 코앞이고, 딸의.en: Kuk-hee, a newly-minted manager at the district office, has been living 24 hours a day. Promotion is just around the corner, and my daughter can even get a job! I thought everything would go perfectly according to her plan. But the perfect steps start to go wrong! A stolen promotion, a lost daughter, and an empty heart... A flamenco practice room is the place you go to fix the beat of your messed up life? A project to regain the rhythm of life that doesn't have to be perfect!
24시간 빈틈없이 살아온 구청의 갓생 과장 국희. 승진은 코앞이고, 딸의.zh: 国熙是区政府新上任的经理，每天 24 小时都在生活。升职在即，女儿也能找到工作了！我以为一切都会按照她的计划进行得很顺利。但完美的步骤开始出错！被盗的晋升、失去的女儿、空虚的心……弗拉门戈练习室是你用来调整混乱生活节奏的地方吗？一个恢复生活节奏的项目，但不一定是完美的！

1930년대 미국, 죽음에서 깨어난 ‘브라이드’와 그녀를 사랑하게 된 ‘.en: In 1930s America, ‘Bride’ wakes up from death and ‘Frankenstein’ falls in love with her. One day, he commits a terrible incident and begins a dangerous escape. The unconventional actions of ‘Bride’ and ‘Frankenstein’, who break all the world’s norms, shake the entire United States, and their fate spirals into an uncontrollable direction…
1930년대 미국, 죽음에서 깨어난 ‘브라이드’와 그녀를 사랑하게 된 ‘.zh: 20世纪30年代的美国，“新娘”从死亡中醒来，“弗兰肯斯坦”爱上了她。有一天，他犯下了一件可怕的事件，并开始了一次危险的逃跑。 “新娘”和“弗兰肯斯坦”的非常规行为，打破了世界上所有的规范，震动了整个美国，他们的命运也朝着无法控制的方向发展……

좀비 아이돌 프랑슈슈의 만국박람회 무대로 인류를 위협하는 정체불명의 존재.en: An unidentified being threatening humanity approaches the stage of zombie idol Franchouchou's World Expo, and the unprecedented Galaxy Festival begins.
좀비 아이돌 프랑슈슈의 만국박람회 무대로 인류를 위협하는 정체불명의 존재.zh: 威胁人类的不明生物逼近僵尸偶像 Franchouchou 的世博会舞台，史无前例的银河庆典开始。

2075년, 자연이 너무 위험해져 아이들은 돔 안에서 생활하고, 부모 없.en: In 2075, nature has become so dangerous that children live in domes and are raised by robots without parents. One day, Iris, a ten-year-old girl, discovers a light of hope when she meets Arko, a boy of the same age, who tells her that he is from the future in 2932 and that he can fly in the sky on a rainbow.
2075년, 자연이 너무 위험해져 아이들은 돔 안에서 생활하고, 부모 없.zh: 2075 年，大自然变得如此危险，孩子们住在圆顶屋里，由没有父母陪伴的机器人抚养长大。有一天，十岁的女孩艾里斯遇到了同龄男孩阿尔科，她发现了希望之光，阿尔科告诉她，他来自 2932 年的未来，他可以骑着彩虹在天空中飞翔。

2004년 2월 14일, 하청노동자 박일수의 죽음은 한 인간의 죽음이자.en: The death of subcontractor Park Il-soo on February 14, 2004 was the death of a human being and the death of the vibrant democratic union movement. Now, 20 years after the day of the defeated revolution, there are two people who continue their art while dreaming of the world he desperately wanted. From labor to ecology, women, and every precarious corner of our lives, we are continuing the defeated revolution of the past through poetry and song. Two videos, overlapping sounds, past and present... A new revolution is discovered in the gaps between divided records.
2004년 2월 14일, 하청노동자 박일수의 죽음은 한 인간의 죽음이자.zh: 2004年2月14日，分包商朴一秀的死亡是一个人的死亡，也是充满活力的民主工会运动的死亡。现在，革命失败 20 年后，有两个人继续他们的艺术，同时梦想着他迫切想要的世界。从劳动到生态、女性，以及我们生活中每一个不稳定的角落，我们正在通过诗歌和歌曲继续过去失败的革命。两个视频，重叠的声音，过去和现在……在分割记录之间的间隙中发现了一场新的革命。

베넷 가의 다섯 자매 중 둘째인 엘리자베스는 사랑하는 사람과의 결혼을 믿.en: Elizabeth, the second of the five Bennet sisters, is a proud and smart girl who believes in marrying the person she loves. Bingley, a gentleman from a wealthy and prestigious family, and his friend Darcy come to stay at the mansion for the summer. Elizabeth and Darcy, who first meet at a dance, cannot take their eyes off each other. Darcy gradually falls in love with the beautiful and intelligent woman, and on a windy hill on a rainy day, he confesses to her the passionate love he holds deep in his heart. However, when she learns that Darcy opposed Bingley's marriage to Jane because Jane was not from a prestigious family, she ignores him, considering him an arrogant and prejudiced snob...
베넷 가의 다섯 자매 중 둘째인 엘리자베스는 사랑하는 사람과의 결혼을 믿.zh: 伊丽莎白是班纳特五姐​​妹中的第二个，是一个骄傲而聪明的女孩，她相信嫁给她爱的人。来自富裕名门望族的绅士彬格莱和他的朋友达西来到豪宅避暑。伊丽莎白和达西在一次舞会上初次相遇，两人的目光无法从对方身上移开。达西渐渐爱上了这位美丽聪慧的女子，并在雨天的风山上向她表白了内心深处的炽热爱情。然而，当她得知达西因为简出身于名门望族而反对彬格莱与简结婚时，她忽视了他，认为他是一个傲慢且有偏见的势利小人……

일제강점기, 집단 자살 사건 이후 흔적 없이 사라진 사이비 종교 ‘삼선도.en: During the Japanese colonial period, the pseudo-religion ‘Samseondo’ disappeared without a trace after a mass suicide. Producer Chae Yeon (Cho Yoon-seo) of a social accusation program receives information from Japan's Nagoya TV reporter Matsuda about this religion that disappeared, leaving behind only a "bloody prophecy." In a remote village, 'Samseondo' was still alive, and a sealing ceremony by monks was taking place to prevent prophecy. The reporting team that arrived at the village realized that the ‘bloody prophecy’ had already begun there…
일제강점기, 집단 자살 사건 이후 흔적 없이 사라진 사이비 종교 ‘삼선도.zh: 日本殖民时期，伪宗教“三仙道”在集体自杀后消失得无影无踪。社会指控节目的制作人蔡妍（曹润瑞饰）从日本名古屋电视台记者松田那里收到有关这个宗教消失的信息，只留下了一个“血腥的预言”。在一个偏远的村庄里，“三仙道”还活着，僧侣们正在举行封印仪式，以防止预言的发生。到达村里的报道组发现，‘血腥的预言’已经开始了……

\"목표는 핵심 인물 암살, 특기는 살인, 임무는 댄스 대회 챌린지?!”.en: “The goal is to assassinate key figures, your specialty is murder, and your mission is a dance competition challenge?!” An unprecedented dance action movie featuring five killers with special goals.
\"목표는 핵심 인물 암살, 특기는 살인, 임무는 댄스 대회 챌린지?!”.zh: “目标是刺杀关键人物，你的专长是谋杀，你的任务是舞蹈比赛挑战？！”一部史无前例的舞蹈动作电影，讲述了五个有着特殊目标的杀手的故事。

제주 서귀포시 안덕면 산록남로762번길 69에 위치한 본태박물관은 제주의.en:
The Bontae Museum, located at 69 Sanroknam-ro 762beon-gil, Andeok-myeon, Seogwipo-si, Jeju, is a special space designed to harmonize with the beautiful nature of Jeju.
‘Bontae’ means ‘original form’ and was created in 2012 to explore the natural beauty of humanity through traditional and modern art.
Designed by world-renowned architect Tadao Ando, ​​it boasts a unique and sensuous architectural beauty that combines exposed concrete, light, and water.
The museum operates a variety of exhibitions, experiences, and educational programs based on the major themes of nature and architecture, tradition and modernity, and the encounter between the world and Korea.
The Bonte Museum consists of five exhibition halls.
Hall 1 – Traditional Crafts Hall
A variety of traditional Korean crafts such as small tables, wooden furniture, wrapping cloth, and pillows are on display, allowing you to experience the beauty of our old lifestyle and craftsmanship.
Hall 2 – Museum of Modern Art
Contemporary art works by world-renowned artists such as Picasso, Dali, Andy Warhol, and Nam June Paik are displayed. You can experience the flow of world art with your child.
Hall 3 – Yayoi Kusama Special Hall
Japanese modern art master Yayoi Kusama’s representative works ‘Pumpkin’ and ‘Infinite Mirror Room’ are on display, allowing children to have a fascinating art experience.
Hall 4 – Traditional Funeral Hall
By exhibiting crafts related to the funeral customs of ancient people, such as biers and kkokdu, you can learn about our traditional culture in an easy and interesting way.
Hall 5 – Special Exhibition Hall
Special exhibitions are held on various topics depending on the season, so it is a good idea to check the exhibition information before visiting.
There are various sculptures and beautiful trails not only indoors but also outdoors, so families can walk together and experience art and nature at the same time.
Visiting an art museum itself is an experience where you can see various works of art up close, helping children develop creativity and sensitivity.
There is a corner where you can go inside and experience a unique space, like Yayoi Kusama’s ‘Infinite Mirror Room’, so children can have fun encountering art.
At the Traditional Crafts Museum, you can naturally learn about our culture through familiar objects in everyday life, making it an educational experience.
Operating hours: 10am - 6pm daily
Visiting time: approximately 1 hour 30 minutes to 2 hours
Free admission for infants under 36 months (proof required)
There is ample outdoor space, so we recommend taking a family walk after viewing the exhibition.
It is about 40 minutes by car from Jeju International Airport and about 15 minutes from Jeju International Convention Center.
When using public transportation, it takes about 1 hour to 1 hour and 20 minutes by bus and transfer.
Amenities supported: diaper changing table, stroller rental, parking, reservations
Amenities not supported: baby chair, nursing room
There are many stairs inside the museum, so moving a stroller may be difficult.
It's free for under 36 months.
It would be a good idea to visit the nearby Supungseok Museum and Bangju Church together.

1st floor: Aviation building
It consists of the history and principles of airplanes, various aircraft model exhibitions, and a space where you can experience the cockpit of an actual airplane. There is also a photo zone where you can take pictures wearing various occupational uniforms such as pilots, mechanics, and flight attendants.
2nd floor: Space Hall
In addition to exhibits related to space exploration, there are galaxy-style ceiling decorations, a 4D video theater, a diorama zone, and a model of a future space and aviation city. You can also experience a moving model by pressing a button.
experience space
There are plenty of hands-on activities such as making and flying paper airplanes, VR (virtual reality) simulators, and airplane escape slides.
In the 4D theater, you can indirectly experience real flight or space exploration by adding special effects that stimulate the five senses, such as vibration, wind, and scent, to the video.
You can also experience the T-50 Black Eagles flight simulation.
Energy/Environment Experience
There is an energy experience zone where you can move an airplane using renewable energy, which is also great for developing scientific thinking skills.
The facility has been completely renovated and is comfortable inside, and a variety of experiences and explanations are prepared to suit children's level.
Convenience facilities such as an elevator, nursing room, diaper changing table, stroller rental, and parking are provided for convenient viewing.
Some programs, such as exhibition and experience operating hours and VR and 4D, require on-site application and separate paid experiences, so it is recommended to check the timetable and number of people available before visiting.
Since it is nearby the Sacheon Space and Aviation Museum, you can use a combined admission ticket and enjoy a more enjoyable tour.
At the Aviation Industry Experience Center on the first floor, you can wear costumes for each aviation occupation (pilot, flight attendant, mechanic) and take pictures in the photo zone.
You can experience flying a paper airplane and making an airplane assembly kit (4,000 won).
The 4D theater is open to elementary school students and above, and the running time is 17 minutes. There are a total of 50 seats on a first-come, first-served basis, so it is best to check in advance.
VR experiences include paragliding virtual flight experience VR, fighter pilot VR, and Super Wings VR. On the second floor, you can enjoy a free VR experience and a flight route experience using an air tube.
At the space station, you can try on a spacesuit and coloring pages are also provided.

Soma Museum of Art is located within Olympic Park, 51 Wiryeseong-daero, Songpa-gu, Seoul.
It has a history of sublimating the cultural heritage of the 1988 Seoul Olympics into art. It opened as the Seoul Olympic Museum of Art in 2004 and is now widely known under the name ‘SOMA’.
The museum's main building (Building 1), Building 2, which was expanded in 2018, and a world-class outdoor sculpture park come together.
The sculpture park, which covers a total of 692,367 m2, displays a total of 221 modern sculptures by 155 artists from 66 countries. You can freely walk with your children and admire works of art.
The museum building was designed by famous architect Cho Seong-ryong, and its structure combines natural light and various materials to create a unique atmosphere depending on the time of day and weather.
There are various spaces, including indoor and outdoor exhibition halls, video art halls, studios, education rooms, and seminar rooms, so you can not only appreciate art, but also experience art and engage in educational activities.
The outdoor park, where nature and sculpture are in harmony, has walking paths, corridors, and a water garden, so you can take a walk and play freely with your children.
There is a locker at the entrance so you can leave your luggage and enjoy the tour comfortably, and there is also a place selling souvenirs before the exit.
Hall 1 operating hours: 10:00 ~ 19:00
Building 2 operating hours: 10:00 ~ 18:00
Closed every Monday
Docent: Open from Tuesday to Friday at 11:00, 14:00, and 16:00
Since there are no docents on weekends, it is a good idea to bring earphones and use the **audio guide (paid 3,000 won)**.
Parking is available at the Olympic Park parking lot, and the fee is 600 won per 10 minutes.

There are different exhibitions going on depending on the period, so it is recommended that you check the website before visiting.
Soma Art Museum is located within Songpa Olympic Park, and is a good place to visit together with the Hanseong Baekje Museum and Sculpture Park.

The Hydrogen Safety Museum is located at 360-33 Yeonmi-ro, Maengdong-myeon, Eumseong-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do, and is an experiential and education-oriented exhibition hall operated by Korea Gas Safety Corporation.
This place provides information on the safety of gas and hydrogen in an easy and fun way, and offers a variety of programs and exhibitions so that children can naturally expand their understanding of future energy through hands-on experience.
The first floor has a lobby, information desk, lounge, and experiential education room, and the second floor has spaces where full-scale experience and education take place.
Gas Safety Experience Center
You can learn safety information you need to know in everyday life, such as gas safety classes, basic gas knowledge, and first aid measures in case of gas leaks, with intuitive graphics and experiential content.
At places such as 'Gas Safety Remind' and 'Gas Safety Chamber', you can actually look for risk factors and learn how to prevent accidents.

Hydrogen Safety Promotion Center
Hydrogen's eco-friendliness, safety, and potential as future energy can be approached in an interesting way through videos, exhibitions, and various models by theme.
It is designed so that you can directly examine and indirectly experience safety devices applied in real life, such as the safety of hydrogen storage containers and safety technology of charging stations.
You can imagine what a future hydrogen society will look like in 2050, and also get information about the meaning of the hydrogen economy, international trends, and overcoming climate change.

Siheung Eco Center Chorokbaegot, located at 284 Gyeonggi Science and Technology-daero, Siheung-si, Gyeonggi-do, is a complex educational space filled with exhibitions and experiences on the theme of nature and the environment.
Completed in 2015 and opened in 2016, it has become an eco-friendly space enjoyed by families.
1st floor: Consisting of a permanent exhibition hall, special exhibition hall, and children's experience exhibition hall, you can experience various environmental topics in an easy and fun way.
2nd floor: There are spaces for education and discussion, including an environmental education room, group discussion room, and multipurpose room.
Outdoor: Various ecological experiences and play activities are provided, including an ecological pond, an ecological garden, a natural playground, and an electric train experience center, so you can freely use both indoors and outdoors.
Various environmental exhibitions: Exhibitions and educational programs on topics that change every year, such as resource circulation and climate change, are held so you can learn about various ways to protect nature.
Experience activities: There are activities connected to real life, such as a unique play of listening to the sounds of the forest with a paper tube, an eco-friendly living experience such as a rainwater piggy bank, and an ice pack recycling campaign.
Ecological learning in outdoor and rooftop spaces: You can observe and directly experience plants and insects in ecological ponds and gardens.
Electric train experience center exclusively for children: Open on weekends and depending on the season, you can have fun driving in a space equipped with traffic lights and roads (ages 6 to 10, fee charged).

14 galleries, over 1,000 interactive exhibitions
Each gallery with a variety of themes is full of exhibitions where you can touch, experiment, and experience things yourself. Children can naturally learn the principles of science through various topics such as ‘Optical Illusion of the Eyes’, ‘Mirror Maze’, and ‘Earth and Environment’.
Special exhibitions and unique experiences
There are various special exhibitions such as ‘Phobia – Science of Fear’, emotions, psychology, and the mysteries of nature, and daily events such as experimental demonstrations such as ‘Fire Tornado Show’, ‘Giant Cockroach Observation’, and ‘Star Observation at the Observatory’ are also held.
KidsSTOP
It is a space where children under the age of 8 can learn science and technology through play, and is designed to provide experiences that small children can safely enjoy.
Omni-Theatre
As Singapore's only domed IMAX theater, you can enjoy grand-scale science documentaries and nature videos.
Snow City
This is a space where you can enjoy sub-zero snow indoors, and experience winter activities such as sledding and building a snowman.
If you use the Science Center, you can use the outdoor water park for free. If you plan to use the water park, prepare a swimsuit, a change of clothes, and drinking water.
‘Next to the Science Center’ is the indoor play facility ‘Kids Stop’, suitable for children of a young age. If you want to enjoy the water park, we recommend purchasing the Science Center and Kids Stop package.
Only online reservations are available, and tickets can only be purchased through the website or overseas reservation sites. After purchasing a ticket, you must show your QR to enter, and re-entry is possible.
For meals, we recommend going to a nearby station and enjoying a variety of food rather than the expensive center restaurants.
It has excellent public transportation accessibility and is an 8-minute walk from Jurong East MRT Station. The indoor space is spacious and comfortable, so you can visit regardless of the weather.

It consists of the first and second floors, and each floor and exhibition room covers a variety of topics, including the history of Wando, the sea environment, and marine life.
The first floor has a lobby, special exhibition room, and experience room where you can touch and experience activities.
There is a trick art photo zone in the ecology room on the second floor, making it great for taking pictures.
Inside the exhibition hall, there are colorful cushions, sofas, and various experiential contents to keep children interested.
It is filled with a variety of experiential elements that children can participate in, such as a large digital fish tank, puzzles, rubbing, fishing, and abalone farming.
You can observe and learn up close about the diverse ecosystem and marine life (microalgae, macroalgae, crustaceans, shellfish, fish, etc.) of the Wando sea.
You can naturally learn about the importance of the ocean and seaweed and how to protect the marine ecosystem.
We have prepared an educational exhibition where you can ask questions and think for yourself about environmental issues such as marine pollution and the future under the sea.
There are many hands-on activities and experience corners, such as puzzles and rubbings, so children will never be bored.

In the "Experience Room", you can enjoy a variety of experiences that children enjoy, such as coloring, rubbing, doing puzzles, and fishing.

A place where children can easily and enjoyably learn about ocean ecology and marine environment protection.
There are many programs where you can directly touch and experience, so the learning effect is high.

옥토끼우주센터는 인천 강화도에 위치한 국내 최초의 우주 과학 테마파크입니.en:
Oktokki Space Center is Korea’s first space science theme park located on Ganghwa Island, Incheon. This is a complex cultural space that combines space, science, art, exploration, and play, and is an experiential travel destination that stimulates children's curiosity and creativity.
Indoor exhibitions and experiences are recommended for older or older children who are interested in robots, space, and science.
There are about 500 actual space exhibits on display in an indoor space measuring approximately 2,000 pyeong.
There are exhibition halls with various themes, such as the history of space development, the birth process of rockets and spacecraft, the life of astronauts, and exploration of Mars and the Moon, so you can easily learn about and experience space with your children.
You can watch vivid videos on space and science in the 3D theater.
Activities such as taking commemorative photos as if wearing a space suit and riding space experience devices (6 types) are also popular.
A dinosaur forest with large living dinosaurs has been created on a large outdoor site of approximately 16,000 pyeong. Approximately 40 to 63 large dinosaur models are on display, giving you the experience of time travel to the dinosaur era.
There are a variety of themed play areas, including a robot park, water cannon park, Logos Garden, and a wide observation tower.
The all-season sledding range offers a variety of sledding experiences (snow sledding, rubber sledding) depending on the season, a water park in summer, and a boating range in spring and fall, so you can enjoy a variety of activities all year round.
There is also a mini train, boat rides, and ample landscaped space for playing outside.
Supported amenities: Nursing room, diaper changing table, stroller rental, parking, reservations
Amenities not supported: baby chair

Jungmisan Observatory, located at 1268 Jungmisan-ro, Okcheon-myeon, Yangpyeong-gun, Gyeonggi-do, is located within the Jungmisan Mountain Natural Recreation Forest, approximately 420m to 437m above sea level.
It has excellent accessibility as it can be reached by car in about an hour from Seoul, and with low pollution, it is considered a place where you can see many stars near the metropolitan area.
Astronomical Observation Program: You can directly observe stars, planets, the moon, and seasonal constellations using multiple astronomical telescopes.
Education and video programs: Video education and simulation programs that easily convey basic knowledge of space science are available to stimulate children's curiosity.
Experiential activities: You can experience touching the universe directly through expert explanations and hands-on practice.
Opportunity for re-observation when observation is not possible: If normal observation is difficult due to weather, etc., we provide a free opportunity for re-observation within one year.
I recommend it to children over 6 years old rather than very young children.
Professional instructors: Experts in the fields of astronomy and nature are directly responsible for lectures and observation guidance.
Amenities: Parking, reservations available. At the entrance, a parking attendant will provide parking guidance after confirming the reservation.
Link to natural recreation forests: During the day, you can also connect with various outdoor activities at nearby natural recreation forests.
Since it operates on a reservation system, you must make a reservation through the official website or reservation platform before visiting.
You can enter about 1 hour before the program starts, and it is recommended to arrive at least 10 minutes before your reservation time.
Observation targets vary depending on the season and weather, so check the official website for constellations and planets that can be observed by season.
Driving may be difficult in the dark, so we recommend arriving in advance and traveling safely.
We also provide guidance on how to take pictures of stars for each cell phone model during the constellation observation time.
Observe stars, planets, and the moon directly through an astronomical telescope
Fun video education about constellations and the universe
Flexible re-observation opportunities depending on the weather
Since stargazing takes place in a dark place, please be careful not to let children run around.

Permanent Exhibition Hall: Displays approximately 300 artifacts, including Bronze Age pottery and jade accessories, excavated in Daepyeong-ri, Jinju.
Special Exhibition Hall: Special exhibitions on the lifestyle and culture of the Bronze Age under various themes.
Outdoor exhibition hall: Huts (4 buildings), dolmens, and tombs (about 20) that recreate an actual Bronze Age village are on display, allowing children to experience old life in nature.
Observation rest area, waterside promenade: You can take a walk while appreciating the beautiful scenery harmonized with Jinyang Lake.
Immersive Video Theater: You can experience the festivals and wars of the Bronze Age in vivid three-dimensional images.
AR Drone Observation Room & XR Telescope: Observe a prehistoric village using augmented reality and virtual reality technology and experience farming and funeral culture of the Bronze Age.
VR Jade Workshop: You can make jade jewelry yourself in a virtual reality experience.
Hologram Musical: You can enjoy the old life in a dugout through a vivid hologram performance.
Operating hours: 09:00 ~ 18:00 (winter season 09:00 ~ 17:00)
Closed: Every Monday, January 1st, Lunar New Year’s Day and Chuseok
Admission fee: Children 500 won, Youth/Military 700 won, Adults 1,000 won (50% discount for Jinju citizens, etc.)
Amenities: Nursing room, diaper changing table, stroller rental, parking, reservations
You can see with your own eyes the lives of prehistoric people by looking at actual excavated artifacts.
There are many experiential activities through directly seeing, hearing, and touching old relics such as pottery, dugouts, and dolmens.
There are many experiences using cutting-edge technologies such as AR/VR, so you can enjoy studying and playing at the same time.
A natural environment has been created where you can take a walk alongside the beautiful Jinyang Lake.
Some experience programs may require advance reservations, and "you must have a jade-shaped necklace to experience it," so you must first receive the necklace at the information desk and view it.
It will be very helpful for the tour if you prepare writing utensils, a camera, etc.
When visiting with children, please be careful not to touch the exhibition rooms and artifacts.

As the only municipal astronomy and science museum in northern Gyeonggi Province, it is a special space where you can experience the stars and space up close with your children.
Located inside Pocheon Art Valley, you can experience science in a wonderful landscape where nature and art come together.
Anyone can touch and experience the amazing and interesting exhibits and develop scientific creativity through experiential programs.
1st floor: Lobby, Information Desk, Nursing Room, Exhibition Room 1
2nd floor: Exhibition halls 2 and 3, lounge, restroom
3rd floor: Astronomical projection room (explanation of constellations, viewing of 4D special videos, etc.)
Rooftop: Astronomical observatory (installed with the highest level telescope in Korea, capable of observing the sun, moon, and planets)
The exhibition room is open to free viewing, and the observation and projection room programs are operated with on-site registration on the same day.
If you enter Pocheon Art Valley, you can see it for free.
Just visiting the exhibition hall is enough to see the experience, so I recommend going even if you don't participate in the program.
The planetarium program is popular, so the wait can be long on weekends.
In the astronomical projection room, you can watch constellation stories and special videos every hour, stimulating children's curiosity.
There is vibration when watching the 4D video, so please be aware of this for timid children.
You can observe the sun during the day and observe the moon and planets at night.
When you get off the monorail, it's quick to go to the Astronomical Science Museum, wait for the planetarium, and then look around other places. Monorail operations are temporarily suspended until November 30, 2023.
You can have more fun if you find out about your child's zodiac sign in advance.
A variety of educational programs are offered, including weekend science experience classes and science lectures, making it suitable for family visits.
Anyone can visit the exhibition hall without height or age restrictions, but only children over 5 years old and over 100cm tall can participate in the astronomical observation/projection program.
There is a nursing room on the first floor, so if you need it, you can use it by going to the information desk and telling them.
Admission tickets are distributed free of charge on the day (up to 4 per person) at the information desk on the first floor, and online reservations are not possible.
Adult: 5,000 won

Children: 1,500 won
Seniors, Pocheon citizens, ages 7 and under: Free
Parking: Free

Monday - Thursday: 10:00 - 17:00 (once every 30 minutes)
Friday, Saturday, Sunday, public holidays: 17:30 - 20:00 (once every 30 minutes)
Free viewing during observation hours (reservation not required)
Available for elementary school students and up
Open only on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays: 20:00 - 21:30
The astronomical observation program may be restricted depending on the weather.
When there are many visitors or equipment is being inspected, it may be difficult to experience the desired time slot.
Bringing in food or pets is restricted, and those under the influence of alcohol are not permitted to enter.
You can learn with all five senses by directly seeing and touching the amazing models of the universe, stars, and planets.
A variety of programs and a safe experiential environment are provided to stimulate scientific curiosity.
It is also recommended as a one-day outing in conjunction with Pocheon Art Valley, where nature, art, and science come together.
Astronomical observations are only available in the evening, and you can listen to explanations of individual constellations such as the moon, planets, stars, and clusters.

[공연소개]\n음악의 이유, 여행의 이유\n소설가의 시선으로 걷고, 음악.en:
[Performance introduction]
Reason for music, reason for travel
Europe walked through the eyes of a novelist and remembered through the melody of music

Why do we go on a trip?
Best-selling author and storyteller of our time, Kim Young-ha, will become the host of the 2026 Matinee series and invite audiences to a romantic city in Europe.
This series is a high-quality lecture concert that combines classical music with the unfamiliar landscapes and people that the author encountered while traveling to Italy, Germany, France, and Spain, and the humanistic insights he gained there.
The brilliant sunlight, lonely contemplation, and artistic inspiration felt while traveling are vividly brought to the stage.
In a leisurely time in the morning, <Music by Kim Young-ha>, which combines author Kim Young-ha's charming conversation with a performance full of local flavor, will be a special break that will remind you of the 'reason for travel' for those who are tired of repetitive daily life.

<Germany> Deep in the forest, alone in contemplation
Germany is a great country to think about. It talks about the value of solitude found in dense forests and well-organized cities. Listen to German instrumental music that is logical yet deeply emotional and lyrical songs that touch your heart. Like walking along a forest path in fresh May, it will be a time to sort out your complicated thoughts and provide calm comfort.
[공연소개]\n음악의 이유, 여행의 이유\n소설가의 시선으로 걷고, 음악.zh:
【性能介绍】
音乐的理由，旅行的理由
欧洲通过小说家的眼睛走过，通过音乐的旋律被记住

我们为什么要去旅行？
我们这个时代的畅销书作家和故事讲述者金英河将成为 2026 年 Matinee 系列的主持人，并邀请观众前往欧洲的浪漫城市。
该系列是一场高品质的讲座音乐会，将古典音乐与作者在意大利、德国、法国、西班牙旅行中遇到的陌生风景、陌生人物以及在那里获得的人文感悟相结合。
旅途中的灿烂阳光、孤独的沉思、艺术的灵感被生动地呈现在舞台上。
在清晨的悠闲时光里，作家金英河迷人的谈话与充满乡土气息的表演相结合的《音乐金英河》对于那些厌倦了重复的日常生活的人来说，将是一次特别的休息，让您想起“旅行的理由”。

<德国> 森林深处，独自沉思
德国是一个值得思考的伟大国家。它讲述了在茂密的森林和组织良好的城市中发现的孤独的价值。聆听逻辑性强但情感深厚的德国器乐和触动心灵的抒情歌曲。就像在清新的五月漫步在林间小道一样，这将是一个理清复杂思绪并提供平静舒适的时刻。

There are only two pieces on stage, but it couldn't be more revealing. Markus Stenz, who has been with the Seoul Philharmonic Orchestra as the orchestra's chief guest conductor from 2017 to 2021, returns for the first time in a long time with major works. Part 1 is Johannes Brahms' violin concerto. Although Brahms began composing under the influence of Bruch's Violin Concerto No. 1, which swept through the times, he completed a work that was fully imbued with his unique symphonic spirit. Violinist Vadim Gluzman, who has already performed in Korea several times and met with the Seoul Philharmonic Orchestra in 2019, will be the soloist of this work. William Walton's Symphony No. 1, which follows, is a work that demonstrates the power of symphony experienced in the previous Brahms work. The work, which reflects the influence of Sibelius, who first explored what a symphony can do in the 20th century, pays homage to the traditions of classical music in many places, including the contrapuntal movement seen in the last movement.

* 节目和表演者可能会改变。

舞台上只有两首曲子，但已经不能更揭示了。 2017年至2021年期间担任首尔爱乐乐团首席客座指挥的马库斯·斯坦茨 (Markus Stenz) 长期以来首次带着重要作品回归。第 1 部分是约翰内斯·勃拉姆斯的小提琴协奏曲。勃拉姆斯虽然是在风靡时代的布鲁赫《第一小提琴协奏曲》的影响下开始创作的，但他完成了一部完全充满了他独特的交响精神的作品。曾多次在韩国演出并于2019年与首尔爱乐乐团会面的小提琴家瓦迪姆·格鲁兹曼(Vadim Gluzman)将担任该作品的独奏者。接下来的威廉·沃尔顿的《第一交响曲》是一部展示了勃拉姆斯之前作品中所经历的交响乐力量的作品。这部作品反映了西贝柳斯的影响，西贝柳斯在20世纪首次探索交响曲的作用，向许多地方的古典音乐传统致敬，包括最后乐章中看到的对位运动。

문신에게 삶은 예술이었고, 예술은 곧 삶이었다. 그의 강렬했던 삶의 궤적.en: To Moon Jae-in, life was art, and art was life. By following the trajectory of his intense life, we will try to guess the relationship between life and art and the changes in his work over his life. The era in which Moon Jae-in lived was a turbulent period transitioning from modern times to modern times. Let's take a look at the detailed chronology of the life of Moon Jae-in, who, as fate would have it, entered the path of an artist despite the chaotic historical trends such as the Japanese colonial period and liberation, the Korean War, and rapid industrialization. Moon Mun was born on January 16, 1922, in the small city of Takeo, Saga Prefecture, Kyushu, Japan, as the second son of his father, Moon Chan-i, and his mother, Chiwata Taki. His father, who had a free-spirited and pioneering spirit, took the last name of Ahn Chang-nam, a pilot he admired, and gave him the name Moon An-sin (文安信). In 1927, when he was 5 years old, his family moved to Masan, his father's hometown. Soon after, his parents returned to Japan, and he was raised by his grandmother and uncle. When he turned 11, his father settled in Masan alone. At this time, Tattoo separated from his mother. Moon Jae-in, who was especially loved by his father, recalled that his artistic origins were his childhood with his father. Later, the fact that his works were abstract but reminiscent of the vitality (body) of nature was a manifestation of his subconscious as a child, and not only his memories of the sea in Masan with his father, but also his father's attitude toward life, constitutional sincerity, and passionate obsession, which gave him the courage to overcome trials and tribulations, gave him the spiritual foundation and courage to overcome trials. As a teenager, Moon Jae-soo started working at an art studio that deals with foreign masterpieces, and naturally came into contact with art collections of Picasso, Cézanne, and Van Gogh, and imitated numerous masterpieces. In particular, the more he understood Picasso's work, the more he realized that 'originality' was important. Around the age of 16, while secretly planning a trip to Manchuria, he headed to Japan at the recommendation of a friend who visited him. Although he did not want to go to Japan because he longed for and resented his Japanese mother, his determination to study art guided him. While studying at the Japanese Art School, he worked part-time jobs such as theater work, woodworking, and shoe shine to cover tuition, and sent some of the money to his father in Masan to purchase the current art museum site. Moonshin, who returned to Korea with liberation in 1945, holds exhibitions in Masan, Busan, and Seoul. In works such as <Fisherman> (1946), <Red Pepper> (1946), <Fishing> (1948), and <Mountain and Sky> (1948), he boldly expresses the environment in which he lives and the objects produced in that environment with his own colors and shapes. At the <1st Moon Soo-in's Foreign Paintings Solo Exhibition> at Dongwha Gallery in Seoul (1948), critic Gil Jin-seop said, "There is something to be touched by Moon's works." He displays an honest simplicity that can be achieved, and is also highly praised as ‘a writer who has discarded the pretense of old ideas and styles.’ When the Korean War broke out in 1950, he also worked as a war painter and recorded the scenes of the war through <Field Hospital> (1952). Afterwards, he moved his activities to Seoul and participated in the <Modern Art Association> along with Lee Gyu-sang, Han Muk, Yoo Young-guk, Park Go-seok, and Chun Kyeong-ja. This group was formed by mid-career artists in their 30s and 40s with an avant-garde spirit in the national art exhibition and the Korean art world. They put forward the banner of modern art and advocate the purity and uniqueness of art based on their own creative ideology. During this period, tattoos transitioned to abstraction, and the formative experiments pursued by expressionism and cubism can be seen in <Cow> (1957), <Still Life> (1959), and <On Taepyeong-ro> (1959). In 1961, at the age of 39, Moon Shin headed to France. Paris, France, the center of art in the early 20th century, had a free atmosphere that accepted and recognized diversity, and abstract tendencies such as Engformel, Taschism, and neo-realism were dominant. Moon Shin lived in France from 1961 to 1980 (temporarily returning to Korea in 1965-1967). The 1960s was a time when a new art of tattooing was emerging, and people were immersed in the world of abstraction through various experiments with materials and shapes. Such attempts also appear in <Love> (1962), <Untitled> (1964), and <Sculpture on which humans can live> (1966-1967), which crosses the boundaries between sculpture and space. In 1967, Moon Jae-in participated in the International Sculpture Symposium, with gallerist John Craven serving as commissioner.
문신에게 삶은 예술이었고, 예술은 곧 삶이었다. 그의 강렬했던 삶의 궤적.zh: 对于文在寅来说，生活就是艺术，艺术就是生活。我们将沿着他紧张的人生轨迹，猜测生活与艺术的关系以及他的作品在一生中的变化。文在寅生活的时代是近代向现代过渡的动荡时期。我们来看看文在寅的详细人生年表，他在日本殖民时期和解放、朝鲜战争、快速工业化等混乱的历史潮流中，机缘巧合地走上了艺术家的道路。文文 (Moon Mun) 于 1922 年 1 月 16 日出生于日本九州佐贺县武雄市，是父亲文灿伊 (Moon Chan-i) 和母亲千渡泷 (Chiwata Taki) 的次子。具有自由奔放、开拓进取精神的父亲，继承了自己崇拜的飞行员安昌南的姓氏，并给他取了“文安信”这个名字。 1927年，他5岁时，全家搬到了父亲的家乡马山。不久之后，他的父母回到了日本，他由祖母和叔叔抚养长大。当他11岁时，他的父亲独自在马山定居。这时，纹身与母亲分开了。深受父亲喜爱的文在寅回忆说，他的艺术起源是与父亲一起度过的童年。后来，他的作品抽象却又让人想起自然的生命力（体），这是他小时候潜意识的表现，不仅是他与父亲一起在马山的大海的记忆，还有父亲的生活态度、宪法的真诚和热情的执念，这些给了他战胜磨难的勇气，给了他战胜考验的精神基础和勇气。十几岁的时候，文在洙就开始在一家经营外国名作的艺术工作室工作，自然而然地接触到了毕加索、塞尚、梵高的艺术收藏，并临摹了无数名作。尤其是，他越了解毕加索的作品，就越意识到“原创性”的重要。 16岁左右，他在秘密计划去满洲旅行时，在一位拜访他的朋友的推荐下前往日本。虽然他因为思念和怨恨日本母亲而不想去日本，但学习艺术的决心指引着他。在日本艺术学校学习期间，他通过做戏剧、木工、擦鞋等兼职工作来支付学费，并将一部分钱寄给马山的父亲，以购买现在的美术馆场地。 1945年解放后返回韩国的文信在马山、釜山和首尔举办展览。在《渔夫》（1946）、《红辣椒》（1946）、《钓鱼》（1948）、《山与天》（1948）等作品中，他大胆地用自己的色彩和形状来表现自己所生活的环境以及在该环境中产生的物体。在首尔东和画廊举办的《第一届文秀仁外国画个展》（1948年）上，评论家吉镇燮表示：“文秀仁的作品有令人感动的地方。”他表现出一种可以达到的诚实质朴，也被赞誉为“一位破除旧观念和风格的作家”。1950年朝鲜战争爆发时，他还担任战地画家，通过《野战医院》（1952）记录了战争场面。之后，他的活动转移到首尔，与李奎尚、韩木、柳英国、朴高锡、千庆子一起参加了<现代艺术协会>。这个团体由在全国美展和韩国艺术界具有前卫精神的30多岁和40多岁的职业中期艺术家组成。他们以自己的创作思想为基础，高举现代艺术的旗帜，倡导艺术的纯粹性和独特性。这一时期，纹身向抽象过渡，表现主义和立体主义所追求的造型实验可以在《牛》（1957）、《静物》（1959）和《论太平路》（1959）中看到。 1961年，39岁的文信前往法国。法国巴黎作为20世纪初的艺术中心，有着接受和承认多样性的自由氛围，恩格福梅尔、塔西主义、新现实主义等抽象倾向占主导地位。文信1961年至1980年居住在法国（1965年至1967年暂时返回韩国）。 20世纪60年代是新纹身艺术兴起的时期，人们通过对材料和形状的各种实验沉浸在抽象的世界中。这样的尝试也出现在《爱》（1962）、《无题》（1964）、《人类赖以生存的雕塑》（1966-1967）中，它跨越了雕塑与空间的界限。 1967年，文在寅参加国际雕塑研讨会，画廊主约翰·克雷文担任委员。

양구인문학박물관은 한국 현대문학을 대표하는 시인이자 수녀인 이해인 수녀의.en: Yanggu Humanities Museum presents 'The Beginning of Connection (Haein Geulbang)', a exhibition commemorating the person and literary world of Sister Lee Hae-in, a poet and nun who represents modern Korean literature, in the permanent exhibition room of Hall 1. This exhibition is based on the precious collection donated by Sister Lee Hae-in herself, and is designed to allow visitors to directly experience the warmth of her daily life, thoughts, and writings. Exhibition Composition 1. Sister Lee Hae-in's traces, seen through collections - Sister Lee Hae-in's photographs, handwritten manuscripts, memos, and beloved books, as well as collections filled with personal and historical significance, shed a deep light on the artist's inner self and literary journey. 2. Experience of ‘Haein Geulbang’, a reading and writing space - There is a space where visitors can freely read Sister Lee Hae-in’s poetry collection, and a poetry writing experience space is also operated where visitors can write their own poetry based on their appreciation. The performance/exhibition program may change depending on the circumstances of the organizer, performer, etc. 1688-2220
양구인문학박물관은 한국 현대문학을 대표하는 시인이자 수녀인 이해인 수녀의.zh: 杨口人文博物馆在1号馆常设陈列室中，以韩国现代文学代表诗人、修女李海仁修女的个人及文学世界为纪念，以李海仁修女本人捐赠的珍贵藏品为基础，举办了纪念韩国现代文学代表诗人、修女李海仁修女的个人及文学世界的展览“海印金方”。本次展览以李海仁修女本人捐赠的珍贵藏品为基础，旨在让参观者直接体验她的日常生活、思想和写作的温暖。展览构成一、从藏品中看到李海仁姐妹的踪迹——李海仁姐妹的照片、手稿、备忘录和心爱的书籍，以及充满个人和历史意义的藏品，深刻地揭示了艺术家的内在自我和文学旅程。 2. 阅读写作空间“海印歌房”体验 - 设有可以自由阅读李海仁修女诗集的空间，还设有诗歌写作体验空间，可以根据自己的欣赏来写自己的诗。演出/展览节目可能会根据主办方、表演者等情况而改变。 1688-2220

○ 인천국제공항 제2터미널 한국전통문화센터 기획전시『 The New, T.en: ○ The Korean Traditional Culture Center special exhibition at Incheon International Airport Terminal 2, 『The New, The Crafts』, focuses on the values ​​of harmony and coexistence and introduces works that reinterpret Korean traditional crafts in a modern way. The formative language of traditional crafts, called ‘joining’, ‘weaving’, and ‘containing’, is revived as a symbol that connects the past and present, myself and others. Participating artists explain the values ​​of tradition accumulated over a long period of time from their own perspectives, and contain positive energy and warm messages about life in their author's notes. We hope that many people visiting the airport will respect each other's differences through this exhibition, have the experience of sharing their hearts through works of art, and experience relaxation within it. ○ East Building: (Traditional Crafts) ‘Containing the Heart’ - Composed of works by artists who work on moon jars and utensils, lacquerware and mother-of-pearl lacquerware, which are representative works of art that preserve Korean beauty - Participating artists: Seoul City Intangible Heritage painter Daehyun Son, metal craft Seo Do-sik, metal craft Hyunju Kim ○ West Building: (Contemporary art) ‘Connecting Hearts’ - Leeumgwa A modern reinterpretation of traditional crafts that highlight the beauty of weaving, produced by contemporary artists who unfold their own artist notes - Participating artists: Textile Kang Geum-seong, Textile Lee Hye-min, Installation Hong Seong-cheol ※ This exhibition is held within the duty-free area of Incheon International Airport Passenger Terminal 2 and can be viewed upon departure. The performance/exhibition program may change depending on the circumstances of the organizer, performer, etc. 1688-2220
○ 인천국제공항 제2터미널 한국전통문화센터 기획전시『 The New, T.zh: ○ 仁川国际机场2号航站楼韩国传统文化院特别展览『The New, The Crafts』，重点关注和谐与共存的价值观，介绍以现代方式重新诠释韩国传统工艺的作品。传统工艺的造型语言，称为“连接”、“编织”和“容纳”，作为连接过去与现在、我与他人的符号而得以复兴。参赛艺术家从自己的角度阐释了长期积累的传统价值观，并在作者的笔记中蕴藏着正能量和温暖的生活讯息。我们希望很多来机场的人能够通过这次展览尊重彼此的差异，通过艺术作品获得分享心灵的体验，并在其中体验到放松。 ○ 东馆：（传统工艺品）“包容心” - 由韩国美的代表性艺术作品月坛和器皿、漆器、珍珠母漆器艺术家的作品组成 - 参与艺术家：首尔市非物质遗产画家孙大贤、金属工艺徐道植、金属工艺金贤珠 ○ 西馆：（当代艺术）“连接” Hearts’ - Leeumgwa 以现代方式重新诠释传统工艺，突显编织之美，由当代艺术家展开自己的艺术笔记。 - 参展艺术家：纤维姜金成、纤维李慧敏、装置洪成哲 ※ 本展览在仁川国际机场第 2 航站楼免税区内举办，出发时即可观看。演出/展览节目可能会根据主办方、表演者等情况而改变。 1688-2220

중정 프로젝트 《우주목》 야외 전시는 고대 신화와 종교에 자주 등장하는.en: The courtyard project “Space Tree” outdoor exhibition uses the space tree, a symbol that often appears in ancient mythology and religion, as its motif. The common appearance of this concept in various cultures can be seen as a common expression of the way humans try to understand the structure of nature and the universe. The exhibition theme, “Connection between Heaven and Earth,” symbolically connects the visible and the invisible. It is also an attempt to cross the boundaries between life and death, time and memory, and humans and the universe. This tree standing in space is a visible object and an axis of unique thought. We have been inside the tree and may already be leaning against its roots. The performance/exhibition program may change depending on the circumstances of the organizer, performer, etc. 1688-2220
중정 프로젝트 《우주목》 야외 전시는 고대 신화와 종교에 자주 등장하는.zh: 庭院项目“太空树”户外展览以古代神话和宗教中经常出现的符号太空树为母题。这一概念在不同文化中的共同出现，可以被视为人类试图理解自然和宇宙结构的方式的共同表达。展览主题“天地相连”象征着可见与不可见的连接。这也是一次跨越生与死、时间与记忆、人类与宇宙界限的尝试。这棵矗立在太空中的树是一个可见的物体，也是独特思想的轴心。我们已经进入了树的内部，并且可能已经靠在了树根上。演出/展览节目可能会根据主办方、表演者等情况而改变。 1688-2220

국립민속박물관 파주는 보존과학 전시 《만인산: 보존과 해체의 기록》을 개.en: National Folk Museum Paju is hosting the conservation science exhibition “Maninsan: Records of Preservation and Deconstruction.” Man-in-san (萬人傘) is a type of Il-san (日傘), and can be said to be a souvenir gifted by the people of the village as a token of gratitude to a leader who conducted a benevolent government when he leaves the village. The National Folk Museum of Korea possesses a total of 5 pieces of Maninsan, and starting with conservation treatment for exhibition in 2006, conservation treatment for all 5 pieces has been completed by 2024. This exhibition introduces two pieces of Maninsan, and in particular, Maninsan by Lee Jong-seung (李鍾承, 1828~?), a Gwanseo military commander, is being presented to the public for the first time after conservation treatment. We hope that you will take time to think about the meaning of preserving cultural heritage through the preservation process of Maninsan Mountain. The performance/exhibition program may change depending on the circumstances of the organizer, performer, etc. 1688-2220
국립민속박물관 파주는 보존과학 전시 《만인산: 보존과 해체의 기록》을 개.zh: 坡州国立民俗博物馆正在举办保护科学展览“万仁山：保护与解构的记录”。万人伞是日伞的一种，可以说是村里人为感谢一位施行仁政的领袖出村时赠送的纪念品。国立民俗博物馆共藏有5件万仁山，从2006年开始进行保护处理展出，到2024年已完成所有5件的保护处理。本次展览介绍了两件万仁山，特别是关西武将李钟承（李钟承，1828~？）的万仁山，是经过保护处理后首次向公众展示的。我们希望您能花时间思考通过万仁山的保护过程保护文化遗产的意义。演出/展览节目可能会根据主办方、表演者等情况而改变。 1688-2220

국립해양생물자원관은 개관 10주년을 기념하여「날개 아래 바다 - 서천갯벌.en: To commemorate its 10th anniversary, the National Marine Biological Resources Center is exhibiting “The Sea Under the Wings - Life Story of the Seocheon Tidal Flat” in the special exhibition room on the 3rd floor of the Securium. Seocheon’s mudflats were listed as a UNESCO World Natural Heritage Site on July 26, 2021 as part of ‘Korean Tidal Flasts’. This exhibition was prepared to publicize the outstanding ecological value of the Seocheon Tidal Flat and the importance of mudflat conservation, and in particular, to introduce its role as a major stopping point for endangered migratory birds. Starting with the Yubudo mudflat video, the exhibition is organized into four major themes: ▲Korea's mudflats ▲Biological diversity of the Seocheon mudflats ▲Waterfowl of the Seocheon mudflats ▲Seocheon mudflats and humans. You can view actual specimens of over 50 different species of waterfowl, including endangered species, and also observe enlarged models of small creatures such as midges living in the mudflats. We also created a space where visitors can experience hands-on activities such as taking pictures and putting together puzzles in the mud flat. We hope that this exhibition will provide an opportunity to once again feel that the Seocheon Tidal Flat is a valuable heritage to be passed on to future generations. The performance/exhibition program may change depending on the circumstances of the organizer, performer, etc. 1688-2220
국립해양생물자원관은 개관 10주년을 기념하여「날개 아래 바다 - 서천갯벌.zh: 为纪念成立10周年，国家海洋生物资源中心在Securium 3楼的特别展览室展出“翅膀下的大海——舒川滩涂的生命故事”。舒川滩涂于 2021 年 7 月 26 日作为“韩国潮汐爆发”的一部分被列为联合国教科文组织世界自然遗产。此次展览旨在宣传舒川滩涂的突出生态价值和滩涂保护的重要性，特别是介绍舒川滩涂作为濒危候鸟主要停留地的作用。展览从汤富岛滩涂视频开始，分为四大主题： ▲韩国的滩涂 ▲舒川滩涂的生物多样性 ▲舒川滩涂的水禽 ▲舒川滩涂与人类。您可以观赏 50 多种不同种类的水禽（包括濒危物种）的实际标本，还可以观察生活在泥滩中的蠓等小型生物的放大模型。我们还创造了一个空间，让游客可以体验动手活动，例如在泥滩上拍照和拼拼图。我们希望通过这次展览，让人们再次感受到舒川滩涂是一项值得传承给后代的宝贵遗产。演出/展览节目可能会根据主办方、表演者等情况而改变。 1688-2220

이번전시 「만고상청萬古常靑: 군자의 품격」에서는 고희동의 한국화 뿐 만.en: In this exhibition, “Mango Sangcheong: The Dignity of a Gentleman,” you can see not only Go Hui-dong’s Korean paintings, but also paintings of the Four Gracious Gentlemen, landscape paintings, and joint paintings by various calligraphers with whom he interacted at the time. The Four Gentlemen Paintings and landscape paintings they loved and painted do not just continue the tradition of old literary paintings, but also show internal discipline to get one step closer to the life of an ideal gentleman amidst the ups and downs of the world. Go Hui-dong, who began his career as a member of Sanbyeoksisa and general secretary of the Calligraphy and Painting Association, established himself as the backbone of the modern art world. We hope you will feel the nostalgia of the gentlemanly life that they pursued by contemplating the works of our modern calligraphers, who have meaningful accompaniments again at his house. We hope for your interest and visit. thank you The performance/exhibition program may change depending on the circumstances of the organizer, performer, etc. 1688-2220
이번전시 「만고상청萬古常靑: 군자의 품격」에서는 고희동의 한국화 뿐 만.zh: 在这次展览“芒果尚清：君子的尊严”中，不仅可以看到高惠东的韩国画，还可以看到四仁人画、山水画以及当时与他交往过的多位书法家的联名画。他们所喜爱、所画的四君子画、山水画，不仅延续了古代文人画的传统，更体现了在世事沉浮中向理想君子的生活更近了一步的内在修养。高惠东以山碧社会员、书画协会秘书长出身，奠定了现代艺术界的中坚力量。希望您通过欣赏我们现代书法家的作品，感受到他们所追求的绅士生活的怀旧之情，他们再次在他的家中得到有意义的陪伴。我们希望您的兴趣和访问。谢谢 演出/展览节目可能会根据主办方、表演者等情况而改变。1688-2220

종로구립 박노수미술관 개관 12주년 기념전시 「산수·격물」 종로구립 박노.en: Jongno-gu Park No-soo Museum of Art's 12th Anniversary Commemorative Exhibition 「Landscapes and Paintings」 Jongno-gu Park No-soo Art Museum is holding a commemorative exhibition 「Landscapes and Paintings」 to celebrate its 12th anniversary. This exhibition focuses on artist Park No-soo's artistic way of thinking and attitude toward nature, and highlights his artistic world from the 1970s to the 2000s. In particular, in the ‘Painter’s Time-Dacheonseook’ zone, which recreates the living space where the artist lived during his lifetime, you can experience the artist’s daily life and aesthetic sense through the furniture, ceramics, and stone that he cherished. Additionally, the Live Sketch Media Art Zone, where paintings painted by visitors come to life as if they were moving in the natural scenery on the screen, provides a special art experience where individual participation is expanded into media works. Meanwhile, sculptor Kim Woo-jin's <Deer> (2024) will be on display in the outdoor exhibition hall until March 2026. As time passes, you will encounter another landscape in a space where flowers and birds breathe with nature. We ask for your interest and visit. thank you The performance/exhibition program may change depending on the circumstances of the organizer, performer, etc. 1688-2220
종로구립 박노수미술관 개관 12주년 기념전시 「산수·격물」 종로구립 박노.zh: 钟路区朴鲁秀美术馆成立12周年纪念展“风景与绘画” 钟路区朴鲁秀美术馆为庆祝建馆12周年，正在举办纪念展“风景与绘画”。本次展览聚焦艺术家朴鲁修的艺术思维方式和对自然的态度，重点展示他从1970年代到2000年代的艺术世界。尤其是在再现艺术家生前生活空间的“画家的时光-大川石”区域，可以通过他所珍爱的家具、陶瓷、石材等体验艺术家的日常生活和审美观。此外，在现场写生媒体艺术区，参观者所画的画作栩栩如生，仿佛在屏幕上的自然风景中移动，提供了一种将个人参与扩展到媒体作品的特殊艺术体验。与此同时，雕塑家金宇镇的《鹿》(2024)将在室外展厅展出至2026年3月。随着时间的推移，在花鸟与自然呼吸的空间里，你会遇到另一种风景。我们请求您的兴趣和访问。谢谢 演出/展览节目可能会根据主办方、表演者等情况而改变。1688-2220

오늘날, 한국적인 것이 가장 세계적인 것이라는 사실은 모두가 공감할 것입.en: Today, everyone can agree that what is Korean is most global. In particular, when Korea's unique cultural elements are combined with modern sensibilities, we can feel how powerfully attractive they are through animations such as K-pop Demon Hunters, which have recently attracted global attention. In this rapidly changing world, we describe things that lead trends and attract attention with unique individuality and sensibility as ‘hip.’ And the word ‘hip’ contains the meaning of going beyond simply following trends and radiating deep charm with your own unique color. <HIP, KOREA> is an exhibition that shows how the unique personality and charm of Korean crafts penetrate the times and create a ‘hip’ present. Through this exhibition, we hope that you will fully experience the diverse charm and infinite possibilities of Korean crafts from a new perspective called ‘hip’. We also hope that this exhibition will go beyond a simple craft exhibition and become a door that opens a new chapter in K-heritage and K-culture that will be created by the past, present, and future of Korean cultural heritage. The performance/exhibition program may change depending on the circumstances of the organizer, performer, etc. 1688-2220
오늘날, 한국적인 것이 가장 세계적인 것이라는 사실은 모두가 공감할 것입.zh: 今天，每个人都同意韩国的东西最全球化。尤其是，当韩国独特的文化元素与现代感性相结合时，通过最近引起全球关注的K-pop《恶魔猎手》等动画，我们可以感受到它们有多么强大的吸引力。在这个瞬息万变的世界里，我们把引领潮流、以独特的个性和感性而引人注目的事物形容为“hip”。而“hip”一词则包含着超越简单追随潮流的含义，以自己独特的色彩散发出深沉的魅力。 <HIP, KOREA>是一个展示韩国工艺品的独特个性和魅力如何渗透时代并创造“时尚”礼物的展览。通过本次展览，希望您能从“hip”的新视角充分体验韩国工艺品的多元魅力和无限可能。我们也希望这次展览能够超越一个简单的工艺展览，成为一扇打开韩国文化遗产的过去、现在和未来所创造的韩国遗产和韩国文化新篇章的大门。演出/展览节目可能会根据主办方、表演者等情况而改变。 1688-2220

국립부여박물관은 개관 80주년을 기념하여 특별전 <80년, 함께 걸어온.en: Buyeo National Museum is holding a special exhibition, “80 Years of Memories Walking Together,” to commemorate its 80th anniversary. Buyeo National Museum opened as the Buyeo branch of the National Museum on October 13, 1945, and reopened in 1971 by constructing a new building behind Buyeo Guest House on Busosan Mountain. It was moved to its current location on Geumseongsan Mountain on August 6, 1993. This special exhibition divides the history of the Buyeo National Museum into the Japanese colonial period, Busosan 1st period, Busosan 2nd period, and Geumseongsan period and systematically displays the main contents so that the museum can understand and empathize with the path taken over time. Part 1, Japanese Colonial Period, exhibited materials left by the Buyeo Historic Sites Preservation Society and the Buyeo branch of the Japanese Government General Museum to examine the perception of Buyeo at the time and the nature of the exhibition. Part 2, Busosan 1, contains the story of the first director Hong Sa-jun and his staff's efforts to lay the foundation for the museum in various fields such as securing collections, exhibitions, and academic research. Part 3, Busosan 2nd phase, introduced exhibitions and academic research activities that became more active after the construction of Busosan's new building, and helped understanding with a kiosk video that reproduced the permanent exhibition at the time. Returning to Buyeo after a long time, the traditional bronze sword and bronze ax form excavated from the Songguk-ri ruins in Buyeo welcome visitors. Part 4, Geumseongsan Period, clearly organizes the excavation, preservation, and exhibition records of the Baekje gilt-bronze incense burner, and examines the museum's growth as a Baekje specialty museum by holding various special exhibitions. Part 5, The Museum in My Life, contains the stories of people who have formed a relationship with the museum, and is comprised of a participatory exhibition decorated with ‘Museum and Me’ interview videos and photos submitted to the ‘Looking for Photos’ event, adding to the meaning of the 80th anniversary. We hope you will reminisce about the 80 years of Buyeo National Museum and join us for the next 80 years by viewing this special exhibition prepared to commemorate the 80th anniversary of its opening. The performance/exhibition program may change depending on the circumstances of the organizer, performer, etc. 1688-2220
국립부여박물관은 개관 80주년을 기념하여 특별전 <80년, 함께 걸어온.zh: 扶余国立博物馆为纪念建馆80周年，正在举办“一起行走的80年回忆”特别展览。国立扶余博物馆于 1945 年 10 月 13 日作为国立博物馆扶余分馆开馆，并于 1971 年在釜苏山扶余迎宾馆后面建造了新馆重新开放。 1993年8月6日迁至金城山现址。此次特别展览将扶余国立博物馆的历史分为日本殖民时期、扶余山第一时期、扶余山第二时期、金城山时期，系统地展示主要内容，以便博物馆能够理解和感同身受。第一部分“日本殖民时期”，展出了扶余史迹保护协会和日本政府综合博物馆扶余分馆留下的资料，以考察当时的扶余形象和展览的性质。第二部《釜苏山1》讲述了首任馆长洪思俊及其工作人员在确保藏品、展览和学术研究等各个领域为博物馆奠定基础的努力的故事。第三部分，釜总山二期，介绍了釜总山新大楼建成后变得更加活跃的展览和学术研究活动，并通过再现当时常设展览的信息亭视频来帮助理解。时隔多年再次回到扶余，从扶余松国里遗址出土的传统青铜剑和青铜斧造型迎接着游客。第四部分《锦城山时期》明确整理了百济鎏金香炉的发掘、保存和展览记录，并通过举办各种专题展览来考察博物馆作为百济专业博物馆的成长。第五部分“我生命中的博物馆”讲述了与博物馆结下不解之缘的人们的故事，并由参与式展览组成，其中以“博物馆和我”的采访视频和“寻找照片”活动提交的照片为装饰，增添了80周年的意义。希望您通过观看为纪念国立扶余博物馆开馆80周年而准备的特别展览，回忆国立扶余博物馆的80年，并与我们一起走向下一个80年。演出/展览节目可能会根据主办方、表演者等情况而改变。 1688-2220

<번지고 남아있는: 장욱진 먹그림>은 유화 중심으로 다루어졌던 장욱진 연.en: <Spreading and Remaining: Jang Ucchin's Ink Paintings> was planned to expand the scope of Jang Ucchin's research, which had focused on oil paintings, and to strengthen the research function of the collection. In particular, this exhibition sheds new light on the value of Jang Ucchin's ink paintings based on the research results of <Seeing Jang Ucchin Again>, an academic conference commemorating the 10th anniversary of the museum's opening. Jang Ucchin's ink paintings were produced in large numbers around 1980, and are a genre that represents Jang Ucchin's art world, along with oil paintings and magic paintings. Like ink painting, ink painting uses ink and paper as materials, but it is different in that it reinterprets the symbolic materials that appear in traditional ink painting in terms of content and form. Art historian Choi Gyeong-hyeon commented at an academic conference, “Although the artist used traditional materials such as paper, brush, and ink, he did not want to make a dichotomous distinction between Western and Oriental paintings, so he made it clear that it was a new genre,” which clearly shows the originality of ink paintings. This exhibition examines the influence of Ucchin Jang's ink paintings on his overall artistic world by dividing them into three subjects: folk painting, Buddhism, and daily life. These three materials appear repeatedly in the work and provide important clues to understanding Jang Ucchin's worldview. In this exhibition, which will feature about 40 works, including collections that have not been revealed to the public, the art historical value and unique beauty of ink paintings will be confirmed. The performance/exhibition program may change depending on the circumstances of the organizer, performer, etc. 1688-2220
<번지고 남아있는: 장욱진 먹그림>은 유화 중심으로 다루어졌던 장욱진 연.zh: 《流传与留存：张宇钦的水墨画》旨在扩大张宇钦以往以油画为主的研究范围，并强化馆藏的研究功能。特别是，本次展览以纪念开馆10周年学术会议《又见张宇辰》的研究成果为基础，对张宇辰水墨画的价值有了新的认识。张宇辰的水墨画在1980年左右大量创作，与油画、魔幻画并称为张宇辰艺术世界的代表流派。与水墨画一样，水墨画也以墨和纸为材料，但不同的是，它在内容和形式上重新诠释了传统水墨画中出现的象征材料。艺术史学家崔京贤在一次学术会议上评论道，“艺术家虽然使用了纸、笔、墨等传统材料，但他不想将西方绘画与东方绘画一分为二，所以他明确表示这是一种新的流派”，这清楚地表明了水墨画的独创性。本次展览将张玉珍的水墨画分为民间绘画、佛教和日常生活三个主题来考察张玉珍的水墨画对其整个艺术世界的影响。这三种材料在作品中反复出现，为理解张宇钦的世界观提供了重要线索。此次展览将展出约40件作品，其中包括未公开的藏品，水墨画的艺术史价值和独特之美将得到证实。演出/展览节目可能会根据主办方、表演者等情况而改变。 1688-2220

소장품은 한 시대의 예술과 역사의 흐름을 알 수 있는 미술관의 중요한 자.en: Collections are important assets of an art museum that reveal the flow of art and history of an era. Disclosing and sharing collected objects is an important role of contemporary art museums and is deeply related to their essential function. The ‘Room of Curiosities’ in 16th-century Europe, which is considered to be the origin of the art museum, is a space that provides new experiences and intellectual exploration to viewers by displaying rare and exotic collections. With the formation of modern nation-states, publicness expanded and artworks that had been privately owned were opened to the public and gradually developed into modern museums. Like the Room of Curiosity, this exhibition is a permanent exhibition that introduces about 40 works carefully selected from the international art collection collected by the National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art to encourage new experiences and intellectual exploration. In particular, through the acquisition of the Lee Kun-hee Collection in 2021, you can take a look at not only 19th-century European art housed in the museum, but also various overseas works of art that have expanded the boundaries of modern art. The mutually disparate words ‘Water Lilies and Chandelier’ used as the title of the exhibition are a combination of the titles of “Pond with Water Lilies” (1917-1920), a work by Claude Monet, a light painter representing the 19th century impressionism, and “Black Chandelier” (2017-2021), a work by Ai Weiwei, a world-renowned artist active in the same era. The conjunctive particle ‘-and’ is used between ‘water lily’, which refers to nature, and the artificial object ‘chandelier’, to convey the meaning of creating the possibility of another connection beyond eras and boundaries. If you listen to the various scenes of overseas art in the 100 years between the creation of the two works and imagine their relationships, you will soon reach a time of new experiences full of curiosity. The performance/exhibition program may change depending on the circumstances of the organizer, performer, etc. 1688-2220
소장품은 한 시대의 예술과 역사의 흐름을 알 수 있는 미술관의 중요한 자.zh: 藏品是美术馆的重要资产，揭示了一个时代的艺术流转和历史。公开和分享藏品是当代美术馆的重要作用，与其本质功能密切相关。 16世纪欧洲的“好奇室”被认为是美术馆的起源，是一个通过展示稀有异域藏品为观众提供新体验和智力探索的空间。随着现代民族国家的形成，公共性扩大，私人拥有的艺术品向公众开放，并逐渐发展成为现代博物馆。与“好奇室”一样，本次展览也是常设展览，从国家现当代艺术博物馆收藏的国际艺术藏品中精心挑选的约40件作品，鼓励新的体验和智力探索。特别是，通过2021年收购李健熙收藏，您不仅可以看到博物馆内收藏的19世纪欧洲艺术品，还可以看到各种拓展了现代艺术边界的海外艺术品。展览标题中互不相同的“睡莲与枝形吊灯”一词，是由十九世纪印象派光画家克劳德·莫奈的作品《睡莲池》（1917-1920）和活跃于同一时代的世界知名艺术家艾未未的作品《黑色枝形吊灯》（2017-2021）的标题组合而成。代表自然的“睡莲”与人造物体“吊灯”之间使用连词“-and”，表达了创造超越时代和界限的另一种联系的可能性的含义。如果你聆听两件作品创作之间100年间海外艺术的种种情景，想象它们之间的关系，你很快就会到达一个充满好奇的新体验的时刻。演出/展览节目可能会根据主办方、表演者等情况而改变。 1688-2220
