In particular, Gapyeong-gun plans to quickly renovate the Arts Center in preparation for it being used as a bodybuilding competition venue when Gapyeong hosts the 2025 Gyeonggi-do Sports Festival and the 2026 Gyeonggi-do Sports Festival.
가평 문화 예술 회관은 가평군의 유일한 극장으로서 지역주민의 문화적 욕구.zh: 加平文化艺术中心是加平郡唯一的剧院，致力于满足当地居民的文化需求。于1998年竣工，总面积4801平方米，地下三层至地上二层。主要设施有大型表演厅、多功能展览厅、户外表演厅、放映室、练习室、管理办公室、机电室等。主表演厅可容纳641个座位，室外表演厅可同时容纳250人。必须提前20分钟到达演出大厅，提前10分钟进入观众席。未经同意禁止拍照，观看时请小心。由于对建筑和舞台机械的精确安全诊断结果需要维修，改造项目将于2024年底推进。特别是，加平郡计划迅速翻新艺术中心，为加平举办2025年京畿道体育节和2026年京畿道体育节时将其用作健美比赛场地做准备。

가평문화원은 군민과 함께 전통문화를 발굴하고 육성시키며 문화 예술의 기회.en: The Gapyeong Cultural Center was established to discover and foster traditional culture with residents and to promote preservation of tradition by providing cultural and artistic opportunities. Through this, it is a place where awareness of local culture is renewed and our unique culture is continuously inherited and developed. The Cultural Center not only supports cultural and arts education projects, but also supports cultural activities for multicultural families and supports projects entrusted by the national or local governments to revitalize local culture. The program implemented here incorporates the meaning of lifelong education, utilizes the leisure time of the residents, and seeks to provide an opportunity to lead a high-quality life by developing potential talents and infusing vitality into daily life through enriching hobbies. We are also contributing to promoting Gapyeong and our culture through various cultural events in the Gapyeong area. It is a place that aims for a life that is warm with culture and bright with art.
가평문화원은 군민과 함께 전통문화를 발굴하고 육성시키며 문화 예술의 기회.zh: 加平文化中心的成立是为了与居民一起发现和培育传统文化，并通过提供文化和艺术机会来促进对传统的保护。通过这种方式，我们可以更新当地文化意识，并不断继承和发展我们独特的文化。文化中心不仅支持文化艺术教育项目，还支持多元文化家庭的文化活动，支持国家或地方政府委托的振兴当地文化的项目。这里实施的项目融入了终身教育的意义，充分利用居民的闲暇时间，通过培养潜在人才、丰富兴趣爱好，为日常生活注入活力，为人们提供高质量生活的机会。我们还通过加平地区的各种文化活动为宣传加平和我们的文化做出贡献。这是一个充满文化温暖、艺术璀璨生活的地方。

경기도 가평의 맑은 공기와 자연 속, 베고니아새정원은 약 2만㎡ 규모의.en: In the clean air and nature of Gapyeong, Gyeonggi-do, the Begonia Bird Garden is a complex cultural experience space with indoor and outdoor gardens of approximately 20,000 m2, rare birds, interactive experiences, and flowers in all four seasons. The greenhouse where rare birds and flowers come together has a flower zone, an infinity zone, and a bird zone. Here, there is a begonia hill with beautiful colorful begonia flowers in full bloom, a media room, a space of infinite mirrors through the media facade, and a feast of flowers, the mirror room, the best photo zone where wisteria and hydrangeas welcome you with splendor. In the Bird Zone, you can see rare birds gliding freely, and you can also experience feeding parrots. In addition to the indoor greenhouse, there are three themed outdoor gardens: the front garden where you can see the charm of flowering plants in different seasons, the mystery garden where you can get acquainted with alpacas and Boer goats, and the water garden.
경기도 가평의 맑은 공기와 자연 속, 베고니아새정원은 약 2만㎡ 규모의.zh: 在京畿道加平空气清新、自然的环境中，海棠鸟园是一个拥有约2万平方米的室内外花园、珍稀鸟类、互动体验、四季花卉的复合文化体验空间。珍禽异花齐聚的温室设有花区、无边区、鸟类区。这里有海棠山，五彩缤纷的海棠花盛开，有媒体室，透过媒体立面形成无限镜子的空间，有一场花的盛宴，有镜子室，有紫藤、绣球花绚烂地迎接你的最佳拍照区。在鸟类区，您可以看到珍稀鸟类自由滑翔，还可以体验喂养鹦鹉。除室内温室外，室外还设有三个主题花园：可以观赏不同季节开花植物魅力的前花园、可以认识羊驼和波尔山羊的神秘花园、以及水上花园。

간월암은 부석면 간월도리에 위치한 작은 암자로 조선 초 무학대사가 창건하.en: Ganwolam is a small hermitage located in Ganwol-dori, Buseok-myeon. It is said to have been founded by Master Muhak in the early Joseon Dynasty and rebuilt by Master Song Man-gong. Unlike other hermitages, it is a mystical hermitage that is connected to the land at low tide and becomes an island at high tide. It feels like a hermitage floating on the water at high tide. The combination of the surrounding natural scenery and the ancient temple where you can feel the breath of our ancestors is attracting a number of tourists. In addition, the Gulburugigunwangje, which prays for a good harvest of oysters produced in Ganwol Island, stands in front of the Eori Oyster Monument at Ganwol-dori every year at high tide on the first full moon day. This event is held in front of the Eori Oyster Monument, where clean women who have not committed any unclean behavior wear white clothes and dance at the entrance of the village. When they arrive in front of the oyster tower, they set up offerings and offer oysters collected during the oyster bountiful prayer ceremony for tourists to taste.
간월암은 부석면 간월도리에 위치한 작은 암자로 조선 초 무학대사가 창건하.zh: 甘月庵是位于浮石面甘月路的一座小隐士院。相传是朝鲜初期由无学大师创建，后由宋满功大师重建。与其他隐修院不同的是，它是一座神秘的隐修院，退潮时与陆地相连，涨潮时则成为岛屿。感觉就像是涨潮时漂浮在水面上的隐修院。周围的自然风光与可以感受到祖先气息的古刹相结合，吸引了众多游客。此外，每年正月满潮时，位于江月路的牡蛎纪念碑前都会矗立着祈求元月岛牡蛎丰收的“牡蛎牡蛎纪念碑”。这项活动在英利牡蛎纪念碑前举行，没有犯下任何不洁行为的洁净妇女穿着白色衣服在村口跳舞。到达牡蛎塔前，他们摆上供品，将牡蛎丰收仪式中采集的牡蛎供游客品尝。

갈치저수지는 경기도 군포시 속달동에 위치한 농업용 저수지로, 1984년에.en: Cutlassfish Reservoir is an agricultural reservoir located in Sokdal-dong, Gunpo-si, Gyeonggi-do, and was created in 1984. The area is about 493,000㎡, the water depth is about 8m, and it is located near Beombagol, the valley of Surisan Mountain. There were a lot of reeds in the field around this area, so it was called ‘Galti’ or ‘Galchi’, and the name continued to be the name of the reservoir. There is a rest area and physical fitness equipment at the entrance, and a well-maintained deck path along the reservoir makes it great for a quiet walk.
갈치저수지는 경기도 군포시 속달동에 위치한 농업용 저수지로, 1984년에.zh: 刀鱼水库是位于京畿道军浦市索达洞的农业水库，于1984年建成。面积约493,000平方米，水深约8m，位于苏里山山谷范巴谷附近。这个地区周围的田野里长满了很多芦苇，所以被称为“加尔蒂”或“加尔奇”，这个名字也继续作为水库的名称。入口处设有休息区和健身器材，水库旁有维护良好的甲板步道，非常适合安静散步。

감악산은 경기 오악(五岳) 중 하나로 바위 사이로 검은빛과 푸른빛이 동시.en: Gamaksan Mountain is one of the five peaks of Gyeonggi Province, and is called a dark blue rock mountain because black and blue lights appear simultaneously between the rocks. The suspension bridge, located at the starting point of the Gamaksan Trail, is a bridge that connects the Seolmari Valley, which was cut off by a road. The Suspension Bridge is the nation's longest 150m pillarless mountain suspension bridge and was constructed to harmonize with nature. Ungye Falls, a cute valley with Seolmaceon Stream, is the pride of Gamaksan Mountain. The waterfall, which falls almost vertically, is also used for winter ice training. At the top stands the Gamak Mountain Monument, and just below Janggunbong is the Im Keok-jeong Cave, where Im Keok-jeong hid while avoiding the pursuit of the government forces. Gamaksan Mountain is close to the ceasefire line, so when you climb to the top, you can see the Imjin River and Songaksan Mountain in Gaeseong. The pine-scented hiking trail on the ridge and the refreshing earthy scent are also excellent, so many hikers visit.
감악산은 경기 오악(五岳) 중 하나로 바위 사이로 검은빛과 푸른빛이 동시.zh: 伽玛山是京畿道五峰之一，由于岩石之间同时出现黑色和蓝色的光芒，因此被称为深蓝色岩石山。吊桥位于伽玛山步道的起点，是连接被道路切断的雪玛丽溪谷的桥梁。该吊桥是全国最长的 150m 无柱山地吊桥，其建造目的是与自然和谐相处。云溪瀑布和雪马川溪流一起构成了可爱的溪谷，是伽玛山的骄傲。瀑布几乎垂直落下，也用于冬季冰上训练。山顶矗立着伽玛山纪念碑，将军峰下方是林国正洞窟，林国正为了躲避政府军的追击而藏身于此。伽玛山距离停火线很近，所以登上山顶可以看到开城的临津江和松岳山。山脊上的松香登山步道和清爽的泥土香味也极好，因此吸引了许多徒步旅行者前往。

강릉 경포대는 강릉을 대표하는 명승지 중 하나로, 국가지정문화재 보물 제.en: Gangneung Gyeongpodae is one of Gangneung's representative scenic spots and is designated as National Cultural Heritage Treasure No. 2046. It is one of the Eight Scenic Views of Gwandong that shows the culture of the Goryeo Dynasty, and is a pavilion located on a hill north of Gyeongpo Lake. Since its founding in the 13th year of the reign of King Chungsuk of the Goryeo Dynasty, most detailed records of its restoration and several renovations remain. In particular, records from before its founding remain, making it a pavilion that allows one to see in detail the process of change by era. The name ‘Gyeongpo University’ on the electronic signboard is Yu Han-ji’s handwriting, and the Haeseo font signboard is on Lee Ik-hoi’s handwriting. Inside Gyeongpodae, there are numerous writings by famous people and poets, including ‘Yesterday Poem’ written by King Sukjong, ‘Gyeongpodaebu’ written by Yulgok Yi I at the age of 10, and Sangryangmun by Jo Ha-mang. Pine and oak trees grow thickly around the pavilion, creating an elegant landscape. Gyeongpo 8 Gyeonggi and Gyeongpo Wolsam are said to be the most spectacular of the world. Tourist attractions around Gyeongpodae include Gyeongpo Lake, with its old pine forest and cherry trees, and the coastal sandbar that separates Gyeongpo Lake from the East Sea forms Gyeongpo Beach.
강릉 경포대는 강릉을 대표하는 명승지 중 하나로, 국가지정문화재 보물 제.zh: 江陵镜浦台是江陵的代表性景点之一，被指定为国家文化遗产第2046号。它是展示高丽王朝文化的关东八景之一，是位于镜浦湖北面山丘上的一座亭阁。自高丽忠肃王13年创建以来，至今仍保留着最详细的修复和整修记录。尤其是还保留着创建前的记录，成为可以详细了解各个时代变迁过程的展馆。电子招牌上的“镜浦大学”名字是柳韩智的手写，海西字体招牌是李益会的手写。镜浦台内保存有肃宗的《昨日诗》、栗谷李一10岁时的《镜浦台词》、赵河芒的《上梁门》等众多名人和诗人的著作。亭周围松树、栎树茂密，景观幽雅。镜浦 8 京畿道和镜浦月三号据说是世界上最壮观的。镜浦台周边的旅游景点包括拥有古老松林和樱花树的镜浦湖，以及将镜浦湖与东海分隔开的沿海沙洲形成镜浦海滩。

강릉솔향수목원은 강릉시 구정면 구정리 산 135번지 일원에 2008년부터.en: Gangneung Solhyang Arboretum began construction in 2008 in the area of ​​135 Gujeong-ri, Gujeong-myeon, Gangneung-si, and opened on October 30, 2013. The arboretum is located in Yongsogol, famous for its beautiful scenery in Gangneung, at the foot of Chilseongsan Mountain, where a primeval Geumgang pine forest is preserved. Yongsogol, where the arboretum is located, was named after a dragon that ascended to the sky since ancient times. It is an area where Geumgang pine trees, the representative tree species of Gangneung, have been well maintained under the theme of ‘a meeting place in a thousand-year forest.’ This place preserves the original appearance of a natural forest, making its beauty shine even more. The arboretum, built on a total of 78.5 ha (approximately 240,000 pyeong) of land, is comprised of 220,000 plants of a total of 1,127 species along with 23 various themed spaces. Starting with the sound of water, the scent of flowers, and the scent of pine trees from the entrance, you can enjoy the scenery that changes throughout the four seasons through various exhibition gardens such as the forest ecology observation path with a colony of ginger trees and bamboo trees, the thousand-year breath healing path filled with a thousand years of waiting, the pine forest square surrounded by Geumgang pine trees, and the Bibichu Garden, Daylily Garden, Medicinal Botanical Garden, and Dye Botanical Garden where various wild flowers bloom every season. Among them, the Thousand Year Breath Healing Path, where Geumgang Pine, a native tree species, stretches straight out, is the representative walking course of the arboretum and leaves a deep impression on visitors.
강릉솔향수목원은 강릉시 구정면 구정리 산 135번지 일원에 2008년부터.zh: 江陵松乡植物园于2008年在江陵市九亭面九亭里135号地区开工建设，于2013年10月30日开园。植物园位于江陵风景秀丽的龙小谷，七星山山麓，保存着原始锦江松林。植物园所在的龙首谷因自古以来一条升天的龙而得名。这里以“千年森林的会场”为主题，保存了江陵代表性树种金刚松，保留了天然森林的原貌，更加美丽。植物园占地 78.5 公顷（约 24 万坪），拥有 1,127 个品种、22 万株植物以及 23 个不同的主题空间。从入口处开始，从水声、花香、松香开始，通过姜竹群落的森林生态观察道、充满千年等待的千年呼吸疗愈道、锦江松树环绕的松林广场、以及各种植物园、黄花菜园、药用植物园、染料植物园等各种展园，可以欣赏到四季变幻的景色。野花四季盛开。其中，原生树种锦江松笔直延伸的千年呼吸疗愈道，是树木园的代表性步行路线，给游客留下了深刻的印象。

강릉 중앙시장은 강릉시 성남동 일대에 위치한 대표적인 전통시장으로, 19.en: Gangneung Jungang Market is a representative traditional market located in the Seongnam-dong area of ​​Gangneung City. It was registered and opened on January 18, 1980 and has been actively operated to this day. To the east is the Eastern Market and to the west, the Western Market is located. As the third market to open following these two, it is a core commercial district that faithfully performs the distribution function of Gangneung city center. Seongnam Market, which consists of individual shops, is adjacent to the market, and institutions such as livestock cooperatives, Nonghyup Mart, and Saemaeul Geumgo are concentrated, making it closely connected to the local commercial district. In particular, various stalls are formed along the roadsides and alleys, and local specialties are actively traded throughout the four seasons, allowing you to feel the liveliness of a traditional market. The biggest characteristic of Jungang Market is that it preserves the local character of the Gangneung region. It is a market visited not only by citizens living in downtown Gangneung, but also by residents of farming and fishing villages near the east coast, and has played a central role in the local economy, selling various items such as agricultural and marine products, dried fish, and Gangneung's specialty food ingredients. In particular, during the Gangneung Dano Festival, which is held every year, the Namdaecheon Dano Market area around the market is filled with a festive atmosphere, and it becomes even more lively as a traditional market centered in the Yeongdong area where various products and people from all over the country gather. If you want to experience the life and culture of Gangneung in a space where tradition and modernity come together, Jungang Market is one of the travel destinations that you should not miss.
강릉 중앙시장은 강릉시 성남동 일대에 위치한 대표적인 전통시장으로, 19.zh: 江陵中央市场是位于江陵市城南洞地区的代表性传统市场。它于1980年1月18日注册开业，并一直积极运营至今。东边是东市场，西边是西市场。作为继这两个市场之后开设的第三个市场，它是忠实履行江陵市中心集散功能的核心商圈。由个体店铺组成的城南市场毗邻市场，畜牧合作社、农协超市、新村金库等机构集中，与当地商业区紧密相连。尤其是路边小巷里摆满了各种摊位，四季的特产交易活跃，让你感受到传统市场的热闹。中央市场的最大特点是保留了江陵地区的地方特色。该市场不仅是江陵市中心的居民，也是东海岸附近的农渔村居民都会光顾的市场，销售农水产品、干鱼、江陵特产食材等各种商品，在当地经济中发挥着核心作用。特别是每年举办的江陵端午节期间，市场周边的南大川端午市场一带充满了节日气氛，作为以岭东地区为中心的传统市场，汇集了来自全国各地的各种物产和人群，这里变得更加热闹。如果你想在传统与现代交融的空间里体验江陵的生活和文化，中央市场是你不容错过的旅游目的地之一。

강문해변은 강문동에 자리 잡고 있으며 주변에 작은 포구인 강문항이 있어.en: Gangmun Beach is located in Gangmun-dong, and there is a small port called Gangmun Port nearby, so you can taste fresh raw fish caught at dawn at a nearby raw fish restaurant. Cleanly maintained accommodations and the Gyeongpo district are nearby. At Gangmun Beach, you can anchor at a place that takes 5 to 10 minutes by boat and enjoy the excellent underwater scenery of natural rocks, sea anemones, and large fish spread out in the sea at a depth of 5 to 30 meters. This is a popular destination for scuba diving enthusiasts, and underwater diving is especially for newlyweds who want to make memories. In addition, there is Gangmun Port, so 16 fishing boats regularly catch flounder, yellowtail, octopus, clams, sea urchins, sea squirts, and sea cucumbers, as well as flounder, flatfish, and giant clams in the spring, mackerel in the summer and fall, and rockfish in the winter. Fishing enthusiasts also catch dace and wrasse at the port. ◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave - This is where Seong-jun from the drama “She Was Pretty” came up with the idea for a photoshoot while watching the sea with Hye-jin. The two people revealed their inner feelings to each other here and formed a romantic atmosphere. It is also a popular date course for couples as there are many photo zones where you can take pictures of your life with the East Sea in the background.
강문해변은 강문동에 자리 잡고 있으며 주변에 작은 포구인 강문항이 있어.zh: 江门海滩位于江门洞，附近有一个叫做江门港的小港口，所以你可以在附近的生鱼餐厅品尝黎明捕获的新鲜生鱼。维护干净的住宿和镜浦区就在附近。在江门海水浴场，乘船5至10分钟即可在此处抛锚，欣赏5至30米深处天然岩石、海葵和大鱼散布在海中的绝佳水下风景。这里是水肺潜水爱好者的热门目的地，水下潜水尤其适合想要留下回忆的新婚夫妇。此外，还有江门港，有16艘渔船定期捕捞比目鱼、鰤鱼、章鱼、蛤、海胆、海鞘、海参，春季捕捞比目鱼、比目鱼、砗磲，夏秋季捕鲭鱼，冬季捕捞石斑鱼。钓鱼爱好者还可以在港口捕获鲮鱼和濑鱼。 ◎ 邂逅韩流魅力的旅游信息 - 电视剧《她很漂亮》中的成俊在与慧珍一起看海时萌生了拍摄照片的想法。两个人在这里互相吐露内心的情感，形成了浪漫的氛围。这里也是深受情侣欢迎的约会路线，因为这里有许多拍照区，您可以在那里以东海为背景拍摄自己的生活照片。

경춘선 복선전철 개통으로 쓸모를 다한 옛 경춘선 철로에 이제는 기차 대신.en: With the opening of the Gyeongchun Line double-track railway, the old Gyeongchun Line railway has now run on rail bikes instead of trains. Gangchon Rail Park Kim Yu-jeong Rail Bike departs right next to Gim Yu-jeong Station on the Gyeongchun Line. At the boarding area, there are many small things to enjoy, such as a photo zone such as a large book sculpture and a five-colored umbrella sculpture that take advantage of regional characteristics, as well as a cafe and zip wire. It is an 8.5km course that starts from the Gimyujeong Station boarding area and ends at the old Gangchon Station. The first 6km section is by rail bike, and the remaining 2.5km section is by romantic train. The rail bike section is mainly downhill, so it is not difficult, and offers idyllic scenery with mountains, fields, and rivers, and tunnels decorated with various themes. There is a section where VR (virtual reality) experience is available, and it can be used for an additional fee. The romantic train with an exotic atmosphere runs along the Bukhangang River and offers a panoramic view. After arriving at your destination, take the shuttle bus and return to the boarding area. The Gyeonggang Rail Bike, a 7.2km course departing from Gyeonggang Station, is also operated separately.
경춘선 복선전철 개통으로 쓸모를 다한 옛 경춘선 철로에 이제는 기차 대신.zh: 随着京春线复线铁路的开通，旧京春线铁路现在由轨道自行车代替火车运行。江村铁路公园金裕贞铁路自行车在京春线金裕贞站附近出发。登机区有很多小玩意儿，比如具有地域特色的大型书籍雕塑和五色伞雕塑等拍照区，还有咖啡厅和高空滑索等。路线以金裕贞站乘车处为起点，以旧江村站为终点，全长8.5公里。前6公里路段为铁路自行车，其余2.5公里路段为浪漫火车。轨道自行车路段以下坡为主，难度不高，有山、田、河、隧道等田园风光，还有各种主题的隧道。设有VR（虚拟现实）体验区，需额外付费。充满异域风情的浪漫列车沿着北汉江行驶，视野开阔。到达目的地后，乘坐接驳车返回登机区。从京江站出发的全长7.2公里的京江铁路自行车也是单独运营的。

동막해변은 세계 5대 갯벌 중 하나로 꼽힐 만큼 갯벌 체험을 하기에 좋은.en: Dongmak Beach is a great place to experience the mudflats, as it is considered one of the world's top five mudflats. Surrounded by a white sandy beach and a dense pine forest, it boasts a natural natural scenery. You can enjoy swimming in the sea during high tide, and observe various creatures living in the mudflats during low tide. When the water recedes, the endless mud flats are revealed, allowing you to observe various sea creatures such as black crabs, blackfish, rice-skinned whelks, and lugworms. On one side of the beach, there is a coastal walking path called ‘The Road to See Spoonbills.’ The black-faced spoonbill is a globally endangered species and is protected as a natural monument, and its breeding site has been discovered in the Ganghwa mudflats. Ganghwa mudflats and spoonbill breeding grounds have been designated as natural monuments.
동막해변은 세계 5대 갯벌 중 하나로 꼽힐 만큼 갯벌 체험을 하기에 좋은.zh: 东幕海滩是体验泥滩的好地方，因为它被认为是世界排名前五的泥滩之一。周围环绕着白色的沙滩和茂密的松树林，拥有天然的自然风光。涨潮时可以在海里畅游，退潮时可以观察生活在泥滩上的各种生物。退去后，露出一望无际的泥滩，可以观察到黑蟹、黑鱼、米螺、沙蚕等各种海洋生物。海滩的一侧有一条被称为“琵鹭观赏之路”的沿海步行道。黑脸琵鹭是全球濒临灭绝的物种，被作为天然纪念物受到保护，其繁殖地在江华滩涂中被发现。江华滩涂和琵鹭繁殖地已被指定为天然纪念物。

전등사는 현존하는 한국 사찰 중 가장 오랜 역사를 가졌으며, 부처님의 가.en: Jeondeungsa Temple has the longest history among existing Korean temples, and is a temple that preserves its history and authority as a fundamental Buddhist doctrine that protected the country with the Buddha's covering. As recorded in ‘Sejong Annals of Geography’, Samrangseong was an ancient earthen fortress that Dangun had his three sons build, and during the Three Kingdoms period, a stone fortress was built on the site of the earthen fortress, which continues to this day. It is said that Jeondeungsa Temple was founded in 381 AD (the 11th year of King Sosurim of Goguryeo). The person who first founded Jeondeungsa Temple was Ado, who came from the Jin Dynasty. At that time, Ado is known to have introduced Buddhism to Silla via Ganghwa Island. When Ado was staying in Ganghwa Island, he built a temple at the current location of Jeondeungsa Temple, and the name at that time was ‘Jinjongsa Temple.’ Afterwards, the Goryeo royal family built a palace within Samnangseong Fortress and greatly rebuilt Jinjongsa Temple. 16 years later, during the reign of King Chungnyeol, Queen Jeonghwagungju donated sutras and jade lanterns to Jinjongsa Temple, and the name of the temple was changed to ‘Jeondeungsa Temple.’ Later, in 1614, during the reign of King Gwanghaegun of the Joseon Dynasty, the entire building was destroyed by fire. Reconstruction began under the leadership of Monk Jigyeong, and Jeondeungsa Temple was restored to its original appearance in February 1621. Jeondeungsa Temple contains Korea's treasures such as Daeungjeon, Yaksijeon, and temple bell, and Jeongjoksago, which stored the Annals of the Joseon Dynasty, is located within the precincts. Also, at the east gate, there is a monument to Monk Yangheon, which proves that Jeondeungsa Temple is the epicenter of Buddhism. It was built in 1873, the 10th year of King Gojong's reign, to commemorate the achievement of General Yang Heon-su, who defeated the French army that invaded Jeondeungsa Temple, a strategic point during the Byeonginyangyo period, and saved the country from crisis. Temple stay is available as an experience program and is divided into one-day type, experience type, and relaxation type. The one-day type is designed to allow you to experience Korean Buddhist culture in a short period of time, the experience type offers slightly different programs at each temple depending on the season or the characteristics of the participants, and the rest type is a program that literally helps you stay at the temple and rest your tired body and mind for a while.
전등사는 현존하는 한국 사찰 중 가장 오랜 역사를 가졌으며, 부처님의 가.zh: 传灯寺是韩国现存寺庙中历史最悠久的寺庙，也是以佛法护国的佛教基本教义，保存着历史和权威的寺庙。据《世宗地理志》记载，三浪城是檀君让他的三个儿子建造的古代土城，三国时期在土城遗址上建造了石城，一直延续至今。传灯寺据说创建于公元381年（高句丽昭水林王11年）。传灯寺的始建者是金朝的阿斗。当时，阿多通过江华岛将佛教传入新罗。阿道在江华岛居住时，在现传灯寺所在地修建了一座寺庙，当时的名称为“真宗寺”。之后，高丽王室在三浪城内修建了宫殿，并大力重建了真宗寺。 16年后，忠烈王时期，正化宫主王后向真宗寺捐赠了佛经和玉灯，寺院更名为“传灯寺”。1614年，朝鲜光海君时期，寺院整体被大火烧毁。在志庆和尚的主持下开始重建，传灯寺于1621年2月恢复原貌。传灯寺内珍藏着大雄殿、药膳、寺钟等韩国国宝，寺内还设有存放朝鲜王朝实录的正祖寺。另外，东门还立有养宪和尚的纪念碑，这证明了传灯寺是佛教的中心。它建于1873年，即高宗在位10年，是为了纪念梁宪洙将军在丙仁粮草时期击败了入侵战略要地传灯寺的法军，拯救国家于危难之中的功绩而建造的。寺庙住宿作为体验项目提供，分为一日型、体验型和放松型。一日型是为了让您在短时间内体验韩国佛教文化而设计的，体验型根据季节或参加者的特点，每个寺庙的项目略有不同，而休息型则是真正帮助您留在寺庙里，让疲惫的身心得到暂时休息的项目。

강화루지는 특별한 동력장치 없이 특수 제작된 카트를 타고 땅의 경사와 중.en: Ganghwa Luge is a dynamic experiential leisure sports facility where you ride a specially designed cart without a special power device and go down a track using only the slope of the ground and gravity. It allows direction adjustment and braking, and is characterized by the fact that everyone from children to adults can enjoy it. The track slope is gentle, but the curved course repeats itself, so you can quickly feel the sense of speed and thrill. You can enjoy it safely while wearing protective gear. The track is the largest in Asia with a total of 2 courses (Ocean Course and Valley Course) extending 1.8km/line, and each course has a 360 º rotation course and tunnels and drop sections for each section that double the interest and fun.
강화루지는 특별한 동력장치 없이 특수 제작된 카트를 타고 땅의 경사와 중.zh: 江华斜坡滑车是一种动态的体验式休闲运动设施，您可以乘坐专门设计的车，无需特殊动力装置，仅利用地面的坡度和重力沿着轨道行驶。它可以调整方向和制动，其特点是从儿童到成人都可以享受它。赛道坡度平缓，但弯道不断重复，让你很快感受到速度感和惊险感。您可以穿着防护装备安全地享受它。这条赛道是亚洲最大的赛道，共有2条赛道（海洋赛道和山谷赛道），每条线长1.8公里，每条赛道都有360°旋转赛道，并且每个赛道都有隧道和下降段，趣味性和乐趣倍增。

갤러리박영은 2008년에 개관한 파주출판단지 내의 1호 갤러리이다. 박영.en: Gallery Park Young is the first gallery in the Paju Book Complex, opened in 2008. The meaning of Park Young (博英) is to cultivate talented people and embodies the founder's corporate spirit. Paju Publishing Complex was formed as a special art and culture district where various cultural contents such as book-based art, music, architecture, education, furniture, and entertainment are gathered. The current gathering of more than 300 artists is also the result of the start of Park Young-sa's Gallery Park Young, which was opened to support artists. The artist support project, which was an artist residency program, is currently continuing exhibitions with artists of various genres through an annual contest under the name Park Young The Shift, and the works of Park Young artists are being displayed. Introducing it. Gallery Park Young is a gallery that strives to expand the base of art culture by communicating with the public through meaningful exhibitions such as special exhibitions with representative Korean artists with whom the gallery has been collecting art for over 30 years and exhibitions of Park Young's collection. It is a two-story building with a total floor area of ​​1,000㎡ and is equipped with a total of three exhibition spaces, a space dedicated to digital video, and an outdoor performance hall. It also operates the ''Studio Park Young'' program, which provides studios and various support to promising artists.
갤러리박영은 2008년에 개관한 파주출판단지 내의 1호 갤러리이다. 박영.zh: Gallery Park Young是坡州图书综合体的第一家画廊，于2008年开业。Park Young（博英）的含义是培养人才，体现了创始人的企业精神。坡州出版园区是集书籍艺术、音乐、建筑、教育、家具、娱乐等各种文化内容于一体的特殊艺术文化区。目前聚集了300多名艺术家的同时，也是为了支持艺术家而开设的朴英寺画廊朴英的开办结果。该艺术家支持项目是一个艺术家驻留计划，目前正在通过名为 Park Young The Shift 的年度竞赛继续与各种流派的艺术家一起举办展览，并展示 Park Young 艺术家的作品。介绍一下吧。 Gallery Park Young是一家致力于通过有意义的展览与公众交流，扩大艺术文化基础的画廊，例如与该画廊收藏了30多年艺术品的韩国代表性艺术家的特别展览以及Park Young收藏品的展览。 它是一栋两层建筑，总建筑面积1000平方米，共配备三个展览空间、一个数字视频专用空间和一个室外表演厅。它还运营“Studio Park Young”计划，为有前途的艺术家提供工作室和各种支持。

갤러리아광교는 빛이 건물 전체를 관통하는 첫 번째 백화점으로서 특별하고.en: As the first department store where light penetrates the entire building, Galleria Gwanggyo proposes a shopping space that offers special and new enjoyment. It was designed by world-renowned architect Rem Koolhaas, who won the Pritzker Prize, known as the Nobel Prize of architecture. The façade, reminiscent of a huge rock, and the light streaming inside through the glass roof surrounding it provide a unique spatial experience. Aqua Planet Gwanggyo, where you can see 30,000 marine and land creatures of 210 species, and the Courtyard by Marriott Hotel, which has 288 rooms, are connected. You can enjoy the encounter between nature and the city in one place by taking a walk through Suwon Convention Center and Gwanggyo Lake Park.
갤러리아광교는 빛이 건물 전체를 관통하는 첫 번째 백화점으로서 특별하고.zh: 作为第一家光线穿透整个建筑的百货商店，Galleria Gwanggyo 提出了一个提供特殊和新享受的购物空间。它由被誉为建筑界诺贝尔奖之称的普利兹克奖得主、世界著名建筑师雷姆·库哈斯设计。立面让人想起一块巨大的岩石，光线透过周围的玻璃屋顶流入内部，提供了独特的空间体验。可以观赏 210 种 30,000 种海洋和陆地生物的 Aqua Planet Gwanggyo 与拥有 288 间客房的万怡酒店 (Courtyard by Marriott Hotel) 相连。漫步水原会议中心和光教湖公园，可以享受自然与城市的一处邂逅。

갤러리티(GALLERY:T)는 라이프스타일 속에서 예술 경험을 제안하는.en: GALLERY:T is a brand that proposes art experiences within lifestyle, and provides curating services so that art can naturally permeate daily life. Original paintings by various artists are displayed, and curation is conducted with a focus on the philosophy and messages contained in the works, as well as the emotional connection with the audience. In addition to original works, prints, art posters, interior frames, and mini frames are presented at reasonable prices, and art goods such as postcards and mugs are also displayed and sold.
갤러리티(GALLERY:T)는 라이프스타일 속에서 예술 경험을 제안하는.zh: GALLERY:T是一个在生活方式中提出艺术体验的品牌，并提供策展服务，让艺术自然渗透到日常生活中。展示不同艺术家的原创画作，策展重点关注作品中蕴含的哲学和信息，以及与观众的情感联系。除了原创作品外，还以合理的价格展示版画、艺术海报、室内画框、迷你画框，还展示和出售明信片、马克杯等艺术品。

갯골캠핑장은 경기도 시흥시에 자리 잡고 있다. 시흥시청을 기점으로 장현교.en: Gaetgol Camping Site is located in Siheung-si, Gyeonggi-do. Starting from Siheung City Hall, you can reach it by passing through Janghyeon Intersection and Sanggok Intersection, and it takes about 10 minutes. Although it is located in the city center, when you enter the campsite, you feel like you have entered the forest. It has 2 glamping sites and 40 camping sites. Glamping rooms prepared to accommodate a large number of people are equipped with only air conditioning and heating, so guests must bring their own cooking utensils and other necessary items. If you do not have camping equipment, you can rent it from the management office. Additionally, although electricity is available, the use of a stove is not permitted. The concession stand, open from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m., sells food and drinks. Cash is not accepted, and payment is only possible by card. It also has auxiliary facilities such as a playground for children.
갯골캠핑장은 경기도 시흥시에 자리 잡고 있다. 시흥시청을 기점으로 장현교.zh: Gaetgol露营地位于京畿道始兴市。从始兴市政府出发，经过长岘十字路口和上谷十字路口即可到达，大约需要10分钟。虽然位于市中心，但是当你进入露营地时，你就感觉进入了森林。它拥有2个豪华露营地和40个露营地。准备容纳多人的豪华露营客房仅配备空调和暖气，因此客人必须自备炊具和其他必要物品。如果您没有露营装备，可以向管理处租用。此外，虽然可以使用电力，但不允许使用炉灶。小卖部的营业时间为上午 9 点至晚上 9 点，出售食品和饮料。不接受现金，只能通过卡付款。它还设有儿童游乐场等辅助设施。

갱매폭포는 청계산 매봉(582m)계곡 옥녀봉(376m) 기슭에 있는 폭포.en: Gangmae Falls is a waterfall located at the foot of Oknyebong (376m) in the Maebong (582m) valley of Cheonggyesan Mountain and is also called Sujong Falls. The term Gaengmae is an abbreviation for Gaengmaengi, the largest neighborhood in Makgye-ri, Gwacheon-eup, Siheung-gun, Gyeonggi-do, and was called Gaengmae Village. Gaengmaeng is a dialect of Gwangmyeong, the old name of Makgye 2-ri, and is located above the valley of Gaengmae Village, so it was naturally called Gaengmae Waterfall. Now, with the construction of Seoul Grand Park in Gwacheon, Gaengmae Village has disappeared, and the name has been changed to Makgye-dong, Gwacheon-si, Gyeonggi-do. This waterfall is 13m long and 8m wide. Water flows from Maebong Valley in Cheonggyesan Mountain, through Gaengmae Falls, and through Gwacheon Reservoir (formerly Makgye Reservoir) in Seoul Grand Park to Yangjaecheon, joins Tancheon, and reaches the Han River. It is said that old villagers called Gaengmae Falls Cheonggye Falls, Dongpo Falls, and Gaengmaengi Falls. It takes about 30 minutes on foot from Exit 2 of Grand Park Station on Metropolitan Subway Line 4.
갱매폭포는 청계산 매봉(582m)계곡 옥녀봉(376m) 기슭에 있는 폭포.zh: 江梅瀑布是位于清溪山梅峰(582m)山谷玉女峰(376m)山麓的瀑布，也称为水宗瀑布。甘梅这个词是甘梅基的缩写，是京畿道始兴郡果川邑马溪里最大的街区，被称为甘梅村。甘梅瀑布是光明的方言，即玛溪二里的旧称，位于甘梅村山谷上方，所以自然被称为甘梅瀑布。现在，随着果川首尔大公园的建设，甘梅村消失了，更名为京畿道果川市麻溪洞。这个瀑布长13m，宽8m。水从清溪山的梅峰溪谷流经甘美瀑布，再经首尔大公园的果川水库（原麻溪水库）到达良才川，与炭川汇合，最后流入汉江。据说老村民把甘梅瀑布称为清溪瀑布、东坡瀑布、甘梅瀑布。从都营地铁4号线大公园站2号出口步行约30分钟。

하남시청 동쪽에 위치한 높이 657m로 하남시의 대표적인 명산으로 유명하.en: Located east of Hanam City Hall, it is 657m high and is famous as a representative mountain of Hanam City. It is said to be Seongsan (崇山) and Jinsan (鎭山) in Wiryeseong, Hanam during the Hanseong period of Baekje, and is a sacred mountain where the king performed ancestral rites to heaven. From the summit of Geomdansan Mountain, you can enjoy the scenery of Yangsu-ri and Hanam, where the Namhan River and Bukhangang River meet, as well as Seoul, the Yangpyeong area, and the surroundings of Paldang Lake, making it a popular one-day climbing course near Seoul. It is located near Seoul, has convenient transportation, has well-maintained hiking trails, and the course is not that difficult, making it a good place for a family outing as a day hike. For hiking, you can use the hiking trail toward Sangok Elementary School in Hasangok-dong and toward Aebaealmi across Paldang Dam, with the former being more convenient for transportation. In addition, there is a memorial tower hiking trail that starts from the direction of Korea Animation High School in Changwoo-dong. The hike starting from Hasangok-dong is initially very steep, but the middle of the mountain is covered with old pine trees, making it a good place to take a break. When you stand on the wide, flat summit, you can see the mountains of Bukhansan Mountain and Dobongsan Mountain in the distance. Paldang Dam is visible to the east, Yongmasan Mountain rises on the ridge extending to the south, and the Jungbu Expressway runs powerfully to the west. Originally, King Sejong's tomb was intended to be built here, but it was moved to Yeoju, and the tomb site that was cleaned up still remains, telling the history, and there is the tomb of Yu Gil-jun, who wrote 《Seoyugyeonmun》.* Origin of Geomdansan *It was called Geomdansan Mountain because the Zen master Geomdan lived in seclusion here during the Baekje period. The height is similar to Gwanaksan Mountain (629m), but the mountain's shape is so unique that it is called the true mountain of Gwangjumok in Dongguk Yeoji Seungnam (東國與地勝覽). When you pass the steep slope and climb up to the ridge, the panoramic view in all directions opens up, and the path gradually leading to the top is very diverse.
하남시청 동쪽에 위치한 높이 657m로 하남시의 대표적인 명산으로 유명하.zh: 位于河南市厅东侧，海拔657m，作为河南市的代表山而闻名。相传是百济汉城时期河南卫礼城的崇山和鎭山，是国王祭天的圣山。从黔丹山山顶可以眺望南汉江和北汉江交汇处的阳水里和河南，以及首尔、杨平地区和八堂湖周边的景色，是首尔附近人气的一日登山路线。它位于首尔附近，交通便利，徒步路线维护良好，路线难度不大，是家庭郊游一日徒步的好去处。想要徒步的话，可以沿着下山谷洞山谷小学方向和越过八堂水库往埃巴米方向的登山路线，前者交通更方便。另外，还有一条以昌宇洞韩国动画高中方向为起点的纪念塔登山步道。从下山谷洞出发的徒步路线一开始很陡，但山腰上长满了老松树，是休息的好地方。站在宽阔平坦的山顶，可以看到远处的北汉山和道峰山。东边可见八堂水坝，南边山脊上耸立着龙马山，西边是中部高速公路，气势雄伟。本来，世宗王的陵墓打算建在这里，但后来迁到了骊州，清理后的坟墓还留存着，讲述着历史，还有写《西游传文》的柳吉俊的坟墓。 * 黔丹山的由来 * 因百济时期黔丹禅师隐居于此，所以被称为黔丹山。高度与冠岳山（629m）相近，但山形独特，被称为东国与地胜览的光州木真山。过了陡坡，爬上山脊，四面八方的景色尽收眼底，逐渐通向山顶的路径十分多样。

‘새가 편안히 깃든다’ 하여 이름 붙여진 조안은 2010년 11월 수도권.en: Joan, named for ‘birds nesting comfortably,’ is the first slow city in the metropolitan area to be designated in November 2010. There is a bicycle path along the Namhangang River that runs from Paldang to Yangpyeong and Daeseong-ri. Additionally, there is a Slow City road that starts from Ungilsan Station, passes through Majin Fortress, Sujongsa Temple, and Songchon Independence Park, and tours the Slow City Cultural Center. This road was selected among about 40 target sites across the country through a public contest by the Ministry of Public Administration and Security for the project to create an eco-friendly living space green road. It is made up of 12 villages with simple and beautiful names such as Jeonwon Village, Jangsu Village, Lotus Village, and Ilgigi Village. Specialties of Joan-myeon include pear pear, organic ssamchae grown through organic farming, strawberries, and crafts made with rice straw and ssari.
‘새가 편안히 깃든다’ 하여 이름 붙여진 조안은 2010년 11월 수도권.zh: 贞安以“鸟儿舒适地筑巢”而得名，是2010年11月被指定的首都圈首个慢城市。沿着南汉江有一条自行车道，从八堂一直延伸到杨平和大城里。另外，还有一条慢城道路，从云吉山站出发，经过马津城、水宗寺、松村独立公园，游览慢城文化馆。这条道路是通过公共管理和安全部创建生态友好型居住空间绿色道路项目的公开竞赛，从全国约40个目标地点中选出的。它由传院村、长寿村、莲花村、一吉吉村等12个村庄组成，名字朴素又美丽。琼面的特产有梨梨、通过有机农业种植的有机samchae、草莓以及用稻草和ssari制作的工艺品。

한국민속촌 부근에 있는 경기도국악당은 한국 전통예술을 널리 보급하여 국악.en: Gyeonggi-do Gugakdang, located near the Korean Folk Village, opened in July 2004 to widely disseminate Korean traditional arts, expand the base of Korean traditional music, realize the globalization of traditional culture, and disseminate various traditional cultures to local residents and foreign tourists. Starting with the founding of the Gyeonggi Provincial Theater Company in 1990, it was launched as the Gyeonggi Arts Center in 2004 and is an affiliated organization of the Gyeonggi Arts Center, which changed its name in 2020. Gyeonggi-do Gugakdang was built with two floors above ground and three floors above ground. The performance hall has 470 seats (including 6 disabled seats), and auxiliary facilities include a dressing room, ensemble room, classroom, instrument storage room, costume storage room, lounge, snack bar, and children's playroom. It takes about 7 minutes by car from Suwon Singal IC and about 6 minutes from Sanggal Station on the Suin Bundang Line, and there is a bus that goes there from the station. Nearby are Everland, Korean Folk Village, Korea Job World, World Cultural Heritage Yunggeonreung Royal Tomb, Mulhyanggi Arboretum, Yongin Rural Theme Park, and Deokpyeong Dinosaur Arboretum.
한국민속촌 부근에 있는 경기도국악당은 한국 전통예술을 널리 보급하여 국악.zh: 位于韩国民俗村附近的京畿道国乐堂于2004年7月开业，旨在广泛传播韩国传统艺术，扩大韩国传统音乐的基础，实现传统文化的全球化，向当地居民和外国游客传播各种传统文化。 1990年京畿道剧团成立，2004年作为京畿道艺术中心成立，是京畿道艺术中心的附属机构，2020年更名。京畿道国乐堂建有地上两层、地上三层。演出厅设有座位470个（其中残疾人座位6个），附属设施有化妆室、演出室、教室、乐器储藏室、服装储藏室、休息室、小吃店、儿童游乐室等。从水原新葛IC开车约7分钟，距离水仁盆唐线上葛站约6分钟，有公交车前往。附近有爱宝乐园、韩国民俗村、韩国就业世界、世界文化遗产龙庆陵、水香树木园、龙仁乡村主题公园、德坪恐龙树木园等。

경기도미술관은 국내외 작가의 전시, 미술품 수집을 비롯해 연구, 교육,.en: The Gyeonggi Museum of Modern Art provides a variety of cultural services by operating programs such as exhibitions by domestic and foreign artists, collection of art works, research, education, and promotional projects. In particular, it has established itself as a famous place for art and culture through various special exhibitions that harmonize professionalism, artistry, locality and globality. The museum building, with the park's ecological lake in the background, is made of glass on the front, giving it a clear and pleasant feel, while also fulfilling the role of a modern art museum centered on a high-floor exhibition hall where various special exhibitions are held. The Gyeonggi Museum of Art runs [Culture Day] on the last week of every month so that anyone can easily access culture and arts in their daily lives. Curators from the Museum of Art tell stories on new and diverse topics every month, including exhibitions, works, archives, and architecture. Through this, you can enjoy art more comfortably and happily, and it is well-received as an art museum where anyone, including the general public and children, not just art experts, can appreciate and enjoy works of art.
경기도미술관은 국내외 작가의 전시, 미술품 수집을 비롯해 연구, 교육,.zh: 京畿道现代美术馆通过运营国内外艺术家的展览、艺术品收藏、研究、教育和宣传项目等项目，提供各种文化服务。特别是通过各种集专业性、艺术性、本土性和全球性为一体的专题展览，将其打造成艺术文化名城。博物馆建筑以公园生态湖为背景，正面采用玻璃材质，给人一种清澈宜人的感觉，同时也履行了以高层展厅为中心、举办各种专题展览的现代美术馆的作用。京畿道美术馆在每个月的最后一周举办“文化日”，以便任何人都可以在日常生活中轻松接触文化和艺术。艺术博物馆的策展人每月都会讲述新的、多样化的主题的故事，包括展览、作品、档案和建筑。通过这样，您可以更舒适、更快乐地享受艺术，它作为一个不只是艺术专家，包括普通公众和儿童在内的任何人都可以欣赏和欣赏艺术作品的美术馆而受到好评。

* 조선 도자 전문 박물관, 경기도자박물관 * 광주 조선관요박물관은 조선.en: * Gyeonggi Ceramic Museum, a museum specializing in Joseon ceramics * Gwangju Joseon Royal Court Museum is located in Gwangju, Gyeonggi-do, where the royal palaces of the Joseon Dynasty were installed and operated for over 400 years. It is a specialized ceramic museum that studies traditional Korean ceramics, including research on Joseon white porcelain, excavation of Joseon official relics, academic research projects, and education on traditional ceramic culture. In order to foster and develop traditional Korean ceramics, a traditional ceramics contest called ''Beautiful Korean Pottery Exhibition'' is held every two years, through which beautiful Korean ceramics that match today's Korean characteristics will be showcased. It consists of two large exhibition halls, a special exhibition room, and a multi-purpose room, and is equipped with auxiliary facilities such as a large-scale outdoor sculpture park, a firewood kiln, a Korean garden, a tea ceremony extension, and a ceramics shopping mall selling ceramics produced in the Gwangju area. Gwangju Joseon Official Art Museum permanently exhibits traditional ceramics produced in Joseon Dynasty official ceramics, such as pure white porcelain, blue and white porcelain, iron and white porcelain, and Buncheong porcelain, which have continued the Joseon Dynasty's 500-year history, as well as works by modern artists who have inherited that tradition. It will allow you to feel our living, breathing ceramic tradition through special exhibitions and special exhibitions that illuminate our traditional ceramic culture and history. * Discover various information about ceramics * The Gyeonggi Ceramic Museum has two floors of exhibition rooms, with a ceramic culture room and special exhibition room on the first floor and a permanent exhibition room on the second floor. The Ceramic Culture Room provides visitors with knowledge and information on ceramic concepts, history, and techniques, and the Gyeonggi Ceramic Museum holds special exhibitions that highlight the history and traditions of domestic and foreign ceramics by theme at least twice a year. Special exhibitions held in various spaces, including the first floor special exhibition room as well as the second floor exhibition room, provide new attractions and learning materials that cannot be seen in the permanent exhibition. The permanent exhibition room is divided into rooms 1 and 2. In room 1, you can see at a glance the development process of ceramic culture on the Korean Peninsula, and in room 2, you can admire ceramic works that suggest the future development direction of Korean ceramics.
* 조선 도자 전문 박물관, 경기도자박물관 * 광주 조선관요박물관은 조선.zh: * 京畿陶瓷博物馆，专门展示朝鲜陶瓷的博物馆 * 光州朝鲜宫廷博物馆位于京畿道光州，朝鲜王朝的王宫在这里设置和运营了 400 多年。是一家研究韩国传统陶瓷的专业陶瓷博物馆，包括朝鲜白瓷研究、朝鲜官方文物发掘、学术研究项目、传统陶瓷文化教育等。为了培育和发展韩国传统陶瓷，每两年举办一次名为“美丽韩国陶瓷展”的传统陶瓷大赛，通过该大赛展示符合当今韩国特色的美丽韩国陶瓷。它由两个大型展厅、一个专题展览室和一个多功能室组成，并配有大型户外雕塑公园、柴窑、韩国花园、茶道扩建以及销售光州地区生产的陶瓷的陶瓷购物中心等辅助设施。光州朝鲜官方美术馆永久展示着朝鲜王朝官方陶瓷生产的传统陶瓷，如延续朝鲜王朝500年历史的纯白瓷、青花瓷、铁白瓷和文青瓷，以及继承这一传统的现代艺术家的作品。它将通过专题展览和阐释我们传统陶瓷文化和历史的专题展览，让您感受到我们生机勃勃的陶瓷传统。 * 发现有关陶瓷的各种信息 * 京畿道陶瓷博物馆有两层展览室，一楼设有陶瓷文化室和特别展览室，二楼设有常设展览室。陶瓷文化室为游客提供有关陶瓷概念、历史和技术的知识和信息，京畿道陶瓷博物馆每年至少举办两次以主题突出国内外陶瓷历史和传统的特别展览。一楼特别展览室和二楼展览室等各个空间举办的特别展览，提供了常设展览中看不到的新景点和学习资料。常设展览室分为1室和2室。在1室可以一览朝鲜半岛陶瓷文化的发展历程，在2室可以欣赏暗示韩国陶瓷未来发展方向的陶瓷作品。

소요산 자락에 자리 잡은 경기북부어린이박물관은 ‘숲에서 꿈꾸는 어린이’를.en: The Gyeonggi Northern Children’s Museum, located at the foot of Soyosan Mountain, has an exhibition hall under the theme of ‘Children dreaming in the forest.’ This contains the idea that children should develop their dreams by physically experiencing life with various living things in nature. Among the exhibition spaces with the forest theme of the forest of the past, forest of the present, and forest of the future, the ‘Forest of the Past’ on the first floor includes the Dinosaur Forest, Oreum Forest, and Sea Forest (children’s playground). The Dinosaur Forest is a space where you can explore the dinosaur forests of the past along with little Brachio while asking the question, “Did dinosaurs live in Dongducheon?” The Oreum Forest is a large physical development playground where you climb up and down the body of the giant herbivorous dinosaur Brachiosaurus, and the Sea Forest is an experiential exhibition room designed for infants under 36 months old with the theme of underwater marine life and adventure. When you go up to the second floor, the Natural Forest, the Five Senses Forest, the Imagination Forest, and the Learning Center are the ‘present day forest.’ It forms a ‘forest’ and a ‘forest of the future.’ The natural forest is a space where we, who have become as small as a blade of grass, meet and interact with the life in the forest up close and with our whole bodies, under the theme of ‘a world that can only be seen when it is small.’ The Five Senses Forest is an experiential exhibition hall that awakens the senses of the forest with museum characters based on the five senses. Imagination Forest periodically presents special exhibitions that colorfully explain the coexistence of various life forms for visitors of various generations to help children and all of them develop their dreams and imaginations. And at the learning center, we are creating a ‘forest of the future’ through education and practice that embodies the values ​​of nature, ecosystem, environment, and peace. In addition, the Gyeonggi Northern Children’s Museum is planning various exhibitions, education, publications, research, and exchange programs with children as the main characters to understand me and you and us and spread the value of respect for each other. In addition, school education programs in connection with education support offices in northern Gyeonggi Province, and collaboration with children's culture and arts education groups, local organizations, and activists are also underway. Based on this, we aim to establish ourselves as a representative cultural and artistic space in northern Gyeonggi Province where children and families can experience the ‘natural play forest’ and develop their dreams.
소요산 자락에 자리 잡은 경기북부어린이박물관은 ‘숲에서 꿈꾸는 어린이’를.zh: 京畿道北方儿童博物馆位于昭阳山山麓，设有以“森林里的梦想的儿童”为主题的展示厅。这蕴含着孩子们应该通过与大自然中的各种生物体接触生活来实现梦想的理念。以过去的森林、现在的森林、未来的森林为森林主题的展览空间中，一楼的“过去的森林”包括恐龙森林、火山森林和海洋森林（儿童游乐场）。恐龙森林是一个可以和小布拉奇奥一起探索过去的恐龙森林的空间，同时提出“恐龙生活在东豆川吗？”的问题。奥勒姆森林是一个大型体能拓展游乐场，您可以在巨型食草恐龙腕龙的身体上爬上爬下；海洋森林是一个为36个月以下婴儿设计的体验式展览室，以水下海洋生物和冒险为主题。上到二楼，天然森林、五感森林、想象森林、学习中心就是“现在的森林”。它构成了“森林”和“未来的森林”。天然森林是我们小小如一片草叶，全身心地与森林里的生命近距离接触和互动的空间，主题是“小世界才能看到”。五感森林是一个以五种感官为基础的博物馆人物唤醒森林感官的体验式展厅。想象森林定期举办专题展览，为各年龄段的参观者丰富多彩地解释各种生命形式的共存，帮助孩子们和所有人发展他们的梦想和想象力。在学习中心，我们正在通过教育和实践创造一个体现自然、生态系统、环境与和平价值观的“未来森林”。此外，京畿道北方儿童博物馆正在策划以儿童为主角的各种展览、教育、出版、研究和交流项目，以了解我、你和我们，传播相互尊重的价值观。此外，与京畿道北部教育支援办公室相关的学校教育项目以及与儿童文化艺术教育团体、地方组织和活动家的合作也在进行中。基于此，我们的目标是将自己打造成京畿道北部具有代表性的文化艺术空间，让儿童和家庭可以体验“自然游乐森林”并实现他们的梦想。

경기아트센터는 경기도 수원시 팔달구에 있는 종합 공연장이다. 1984년.en: Gyeonggi Arts Center is a comprehensive performance hall located in Paldal-gu, Suwon-si, Gyeonggi-do. The establishment of a basic plan and a design competition began in 1984, and it opened as the Gyeonggi Arts Center in 1991. In 2020, the name was changed to Gyeonggi Arts Center and Gyeonggi Arts Troupe, and at the same time, it is transforming into a de-authorized open space. Gyeonggi Art Center was established to revitalize local culture and arts and provide various cultural benefits to residents of the province as a place where art is vibrant, interacts with society, and daily life becomes art. There are the Happy Grand Theater, Cozy Small Theater, Dreaming Convention Center, Exciting Outdoor Performance Hall, Shining Gallery, and Small Gallery. In addition to production performances, Gyeonggi Arts Center operates a variety of cultural and artistic contents such as cultural welfare, education, provincial projects, exhibitions, and rentals. It provides the best culture to the audience by leading the way in advanced and professional culture through continuous efforts to build cutting-edge facilities.
경기아트센터는 경기도 수원시 팔달구에 있는 종합 공연장이다. 1984년.zh: 京畿道艺术中心是位于京畿道水原市八达区的综合表演场。 1984年开始制定基本规划和设计竞赛，1991年作为京畿艺术中心开业。2020年更名为京畿艺术中心和京畿艺术团，同时转变为非授权开放空间。京畿道艺术中心的成立是为了振兴当地文化艺术，并为该道居民提供各种文化福利，让艺术充满活力，与社会互动，让日常生活成为艺术。有欢乐大剧院、温馨小剧场、梦想会议中心、精彩户外表演厅、闪亮画廊、小画廊。除了制作演出外，京畿道艺术中心还运营文化福利、教育、省级项目、展览、租赁等多种文化艺术内容。通过不断打造尖端设施，引领先进、专业文化，为观众提供最好的文化。

경기아트센터 갤러리는 경기도 수원시 팔달구에 있는 종합 공연장인 경기아트.en: Gyeonggi Art Center Gallery is an exhibition space located inside Gyeonggi Art Center, a general performance hall located in Paldal-gu, Suwon-si, Gyeonggi-do, and operates short-term art and experiential exhibitions. Meanwhile, the Gyeonggi Art Center was built with the goal of becoming ‘a place where everyday life becomes art’, revitalizing local culture and arts, and allowing residents to enjoy culture. In addition to the gallery, it has facilities such as a large theater, a small theater, and an outdoor performance hall. Hyowon Park and Ingye Art Park are nearby, making it a good place to take a walk after viewing the exhibition.
경기아트센터 갤러리는 경기도 수원시 팔달구에 있는 종합 공연장인 경기아트.zh: 京畿艺术中心画廊是位于京畿道水原市八达区综合表演厅京畿艺术中心内的展览空间，运营短期艺术和体验展览。与此同时，京畿道艺术中心的建设目标是成为“日常生活变成艺术的地方”，振兴当地文化和艺术，让居民享受文化。除画廊外，还设有大剧场、小剧场、露天表演厅等设施。孝园公园和仁溪艺术公园就在附近，是看完展览后散步的好地方。

수도권 최대의 인공생태습지\"01. 수도권 최대의 인공생태습지레일파크가.en: "The largest artificial ecological wetland in the metropolitan area" 01. Wangsong Lake, where the metropolitan area's largest artificial ecological wetland rail park is located, is a reservoir with an embankment length of 640m and a total storage capacity of 2.07 million tons. It is a habitat for migratory birds in all seasons and a place where various fish species, wetland plants, and aquatic plants are distributed. In addition, there are facilities such as an avian ecology science museum, a nature learning park, and a clear water treatment plant in the vicinity, making it a natural and ecological learning education center. 02. Wangsong Lake, the best sunset view in the metropolitan area, is located in the center of the metropolitan area and is adjacent to six cities, including Anyang, Gunpo, Gwacheon, Suwon, and Seongnam. It can be accessed quickly and easily from Seoul and other nearby areas. In particular, the sunset view of Wangsong Lake is known as a spectacle rarely seen in the metropolitan area. It has world-class integrated railway facilities covering an area of 2,525,915㎡, including the Railway Museum and KORAIL Human Resources Development Center.
수도권 최대의 인공생태습지\"01. 수도권 최대의 인공생태습지레일파크가.zh: 《都市圈最大的人工生态湿地》01、都市圈最大的人工生态湿地轨道公园所在的望松湖，是一座堤长640m、总库容207万吨的水库。这里是四季候鸟的栖息地，也是多种鱼类、湿地植物、水生植物的分布地。此外，附近还有鸟类生态科普馆、自然学习园、清水处理厂等设施，使其成为自然生态学习教育中心。 02. 首都圈最佳日落景观望松湖位于首都圈中心，毗邻安阳、军浦、果川、水原、城南等6个城市。从首尔和其他附近地区可以快速轻松地到达这里。尤其是望松湖的日落景观，被誉为大都市地区难得一见的奇观。拥有世界一流的铁路综合设施，占地2,525,915平方米，包括铁路博物馆和KORAIL人力资源开发中心。

경복궁은 1392년 조선 건국 후 1395년(태조 4)에 창건한 조선왕조.en: Gyeongbokgung Palace is the first royal palace of the Joseon Dynasty, founded in 1395 (the 4th year of King Taejo's reign) after the founding of the Joseon Dynasty in 1392. Gyeongbokgung Palace was the center of Hanyang, with buildings placed on a wide terrain with Baekaksan Mountain (Bukaksan Mountain) as the main mountain, and a wide Yukjo Street spread out in front of Gwanghwamun, the main gate. The name of ‘Gyeongbok’ contains the meaning that ‘the new dynasty will enjoy great fortune and prosper,’ and it was here that Hunminjeongeum was created and promulgated during the reign of King Sejong. In addition, it was also called ‘Bukgul’ because it was located in the north compared to the eastern palace (Changdeokgung Palace) or the western palace (Gyeonghuigung Palace). If you look at the kings who held coronation ceremonies at Geunjeongjeon in Gyeongbokgung Palace, they include the 2nd King Jeongjong, the 4th King Sejong, the 6th King Danjong, the 7th King Sejo, the 9th King Seongjong, the 11th King Jungjong, and the 13th King Myeongjong. Gyeongbokgung Palace was destroyed by fire during the Japanese Invasion of Korea in 1592 (the 25th year of King Seonjo's reign), and was unable to be restored after that. It was rebuilt about 270 years later in 1867 (4th year of King Gojong's reign). During the reign of King Gojong, Geoncheong Palace, Taewonjeon, and Jipokjae were built, and in particular, Okhoru of Geoncheong Palace was also the tragic location where Empress Myeongseong was assassinated in the Eulmi Incident in 1895. After the Gyeongsul National Rule in 1910, Gyeongbokgung Palace began to be deliberately damaged, and most of the pavilions were demolished in 1915 under the pretext of holding the Joseon Industrial Exhibition, and in 1926, the Japanese Government-General of Korea was rebuilt. The scenery of Gyeongbokgung Palace was damaged by the construction of the government building. Afterwards, Gyeongbokgung Palace restoration work was carried out in earnest from the 1990s, and the Joseon Government-General building was demolished from 1995 to 1997, and the Heungnyemun Gate area, the Chimjeon area, Geoncheong Palace, Taewonjeon, and Gwanghwamun were restored to the present. In Gyeongbokgung Palace, the ponds of Gyeonghoeru and Hyangwonjeong, representative buildings of the Joseon Dynasty, remain in their original form, and the moonstone and statues of Geunjeongjeon are the same as those of the time. It represents sculpture art. Currently, the National Palace Museum is located on the west side outside Heungnyemun Gate, and the National Folk Museum is located on the east side of Hyangwonjeong in Gyeongbokgung Palace. The main cultural assets of Gyeongbokgung Palace include the historical site Gyeongbokgung Palace, national treasure Gyeongbokgung Palace Geunjeongjeon, national treasure Gyeonghoeru Gyeongbokgung Palace, treasure Gyeongbokgung Jagyeongjeon, treasure Gyeongbokgung Palace Jagyeongjeon Chimney of the Ten Jangsangsaeng, treasure Gyeongbokgung Palace Amisan Chimney, treasure Gyeongbokgung Geunjeongmun and Haenggak, treasure There is Gyeongbokgung Palace Punggidae, etc. ◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave The American national TV show ‘The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon’ held a special BTS broadcast for five days under the name ‘BTS Week’, and the place where BTS sang ‘Microcosm’ and ‘IDOL’ from the ‘Map of the Soul: Persona’ mini album became a hot topic. The place is Gyeonghoeru and Geunjeongjeon of ‘Gyeongbokgung Palace’, one of the palaces of the Joseon Dynasty. We recommend experiencing Korea’s past at Gyeongbokgung Palace, which shines beautifully in purple lights.
경복궁은 1392년 조선 건국 후 1395년(태조 4)에 창건한 조선왕조.zh: 景福宫是朝鲜王朝的第一座王宫，于1392年朝鲜王朝建立后，于1395年（太祖4年）建立。景福宫是汉阳的中心，建筑群分布在以白岳山（北岳山）为主山的广阔地形上，正门光化门前有一条宽阔的六朝街。 “景福”之名含有“新王朝将大吉大利、繁荣昌盛”之意，世宗时期制定并颁布了训民正音。此外，由于与东宫（昌德宫）或西宫（庆熙宫）相比，它位于北方，因此也被称为“北宫”。如果你看看在景福宫勤政殿举行加冕典礼的国王，有第二代正宗、第四代世宗、第六代端宗、第七代世祖、第九代成宗、第十一代中宗、第十三代明宗。景福宫在1592年（宣祖25年）日本侵略朝鲜期间被大火烧毁，此后未能修复。大约270年后的1867年（高宗4年）重建。高宗统治时期修建了建清宫、太院殿、池福斋，特别是建清宫的玉鹤楼，也是1895年乙尾事件中明成皇后被刺杀的悲惨地点。1910年庆州国统后，景福宫开始遭到故意破坏，1915年大部分楼阁被拆除以举办朝鲜工业展览会为借口，于1926年重建日本驻朝鲜总督府。政府大楼的建设破坏了景福宫的景观。此后，从20世纪90年代开始认真进行景福宫修复工作，1995年至1997年朝鲜总督府被拆除，兴礼门地区、廉殿地区、建清宫、大院殿、光化门等恢复到现在的样子。景福宫内，朝鲜王朝的代表性建筑庆会楼和香远亭的池塘仍保持着原貌，月光石和勤政殿的雕像也与当时相同。它代表了雕塑艺术。目前，国立故宫博物院位于兴礼门外西侧，国立民俗博物馆位于景福宫香远亭东侧。景福宫的主要文化遗产有历史遗址景福宫、国宝景福宫勤政殿、国宝景会楼景福宫、宝物景福宫紫庆殿、宝物景福宫紫庆殿十长生烟囱、宝物景福宫峨眉山烟囱、宝物景福宫勤政门和行阁、宝藏 有景福宫丰吉台等 ◎ 遇见韩流魅力的旅游信息 美国国民电视节目《吉米·法伦今夜秀》以“BTS Week”为名举办了为期五天的 BTS 特别广播，BTS 演唱《Map of the Soul: Persona》迷你专辑中的《Microcosm》和《IDOL》的地方成为热门话题。这个地方是朝鲜王朝宫殿之一“景福宫”的庆会楼和勤政殿。我们建议您在景福宫体验韩国的过去，它在紫色的灯光下熠熠生辉。

광주 경안시장은 조선시대부터 명맥을 이어온 유서 깊은 전통시장으로, 광주.en: Gwangju Gyeongan Market is a historic traditional market that has existed since the Joseon Dynasty and is located in the center of Gwangju City. Through the facility modernization project in 2010, environmental improvements such as arcade installation, water supply, gas, and electricity construction, and central passage maintenance were completed. In 2014, a parking lot was also created to improve user convenience. A regular market and a permanent market are operated in parallel, and the regular market sells a variety of products, including local agricultural products, miscellaneous goods, and clothing. In particular, there is a gallery window depicting Namhansanseong Fortress and ceramics, providing a unique attraction.
광주 경안시장은 조선시대부터 명맥을 이어온 유서 깊은 전통시장으로, 광주.zh: 光州庆安市场是自朝鲜王朝以来就存在的历史悠久的传统市场，位于光州市中心。通过2010年的设施现代化改造工程，完成了游乐设施安装、供水、燃气、电力建设、中央通道维护等环境整治工作。 2014年，还设立了停车场，以提高用户便利性。常规市场和常设市场并行运营，常规市场出售各种产品，包括当地农产品、杂货、服装等。特别是展示南汉山城和陶瓷的画廊橱窗，具有独特的吸引力。

경주 대릉원은 경주시 노동동과 황남동에 있는 신라 시대의 고분군을 말하며.en: Gyeongju Daereungwon refers to a group of ancient tombs from the Silla period located in Nodong-dong and Hwangnam-dong, Gyeongju-si. It consists of Nodong-dong tombs, Noseo-ri tombs, Hwangnam-dong tombs, Hwango-dong tombs, and Inwang-dong tombs. The Nodong-dong tombs are tombs from the Go Silla period and include Bonghwangdae, Sikri Tomb, and Geumnyeong Tomb. Bonghwangdae is the second largest tomb after Hwangnamdaechong with a base circumference of 230m, a diameter of 82m, and a height of 22m. It is a stone mound tomb with an overlay installed. The Noseo-ri tomb group consists of 14 large and small tombs on a large flat area. In addition to the Bonghwangdae Tomb in Nodong-ri, there is Tomb No. 130, which is large in size and forms a double wall, as well as Geumgwanchong Tomb, where a gold crown was excavated in 1921, and Seobongchong Tomb, where Sweden's crown prince and archaeologist Gustav VI Adolf stopped by during his visit to Japan in 1926 to investigate and observe excavations. In 1946, a bronze vessel engraved with the name of King Gwanggaeto of Goguryeo was discovered, and there are also Houchong, Eunpyeongchong, Ssangsangchong, and Machong that helped estimate the age of the Silla tomb. Pieces of pottery were excavated from Ssangsangchong, and fragments of horse bones and saddles were unearthed from Mamchong. The Hwangnam-dong Ancient Tombs are tombs from the early Silla Dynasty, some of which are located within the Daereungwon area. There are 30 tombs piled up in a circular shape. The large tomb is a stone mound tomb, and nearby there is a small tomb with no seal gate. Inside Daereungwon, there are the former tomb of King Michu, Cheonmachong Tomb, and Hwangnamdaechong Tomb. Cheonmachong Tomb was excavated from April 6 to December 4, 1973. Cheonmachong Tomb has a diameter of 47m and a height of 12.7m, and many relics, including a gold crown, were found there. Since a horse saddle draper with a drawing of Cheonmado was excavated at the time, it was named Cheonmachong and its interior is open to the public. The Hwango-dong Ancient Tombs are densely packed with large and small Silla period tombs. Although the burial mounds have been greatly damaged due to lack of maintenance over a long period of time, there are about 10 burial mounds that can be assumed to be ancient tombs. Judging from the structure of the tombs excavated in the adjacent area, these tombs are presumed to be stone mound tombs that mainly buried royalty or nobles from around the 4th to 5th centuries. The Inwang-dong tomb group is located in the easternmost part of the tomb group remaining in the central plain of Gyeongju. During the Japanese colonial period, 13 burial mounds were identified, and 10 new tombs were found to be in distribution. Some of the tombs were excavated, and the tomb styles of the Three Han and Three Kingdoms periods were confirmed. It can be seen that tombs began to be built from an early period. Most of the tombs from the Three Kingdoms period that still have fiefs are stone mound tombs, and judging from the excavated artifacts and the size of the remains, they are presumed to be the tombs of Silla nobles. ◎ Travel information to experience the charm of the Korean Wave - This is a park dense with ancient tombs where Bora spent her free time on a school trip in the drama <20th Century Girl>. About 20 large tombs create a dreamlike atmosphere as if they are drawing a ridge. The place where a magnolia tree stands between the burial mounds is a famous photo spot. It is recommended that you also tour Cheonmachong Tomb, the only one whose interior is open to the public.
경주 대릉원은 경주시 노동동과 황남동에 있는 신라 시대의 고분군을 말하며.zh: 庆州大陵苑是指位于庆州市鲁洞洞和皇南洞的新罗时期古墓群。由鲁洞洞古墓、路西里古墓、皇南洞古坟、皇古洞古坟、仁王洞古坟组成。鲁洞洞古坟群是高新罗时期的古坟群，包括凤凰台、西里古坟、金宁古坟等。凤凰台是继皇南大冢之后的第二大坟墓，基周长230m，直径82m，高22m。这是一座石丘墓，上面安装了覆盖物。路西里古墓群由大小14座古坟组成，地势平坦，面积广阔。除了鲁洞里的凤凰台古坟外，还有规模较大、双层墙体的第130号古坟、1921年出土金冠的金冠冢、1926年瑞典王储兼考古学家古斯塔夫六世·阿道夫在访问日本期间考察和观摩发掘时曾到访的西峰冢。 1946年，发现了刻有高句丽广开土王名字的青铜器，此外还发现了后坟、恩坪坟、双相坟、麻坟等，有助于推测新罗坟墓的年代。双桑冲出土了陶器碎片，马冲出土了马骨和马鞍的碎片。皇南洞古坟群是新罗初期的坟墓，其中一些位于大陵苑地区。共有30座坟墓，堆积成圆形。大墓为石丘墓，附近有一座没有封门的小墓。大陵苑内有旧弥丘王陵、天马冢、皇南大冢等。天马冲墓于1973年4月6日至12月4日期间发掘。天马冲墓直径为47m，高12.7m，出土了金王冠等许多遗物。由于当时出土了绘有天马岛图案的马鞍布，因此被命名为“天马冢”，其内部也对外开放。皇吾洞古坟群里密布着大大小小的新罗时期的坟墓。虽然由于长期无人维护，古坟遭到严重破坏，但可认定为古墓的古坟约有10座。从周边发掘的墓葬结构来看，这些墓葬推测为石丘墓，主要埋葬4世纪至5世纪左右的皇室或贵族。仁王洞古墓群位于庆州中部平原残存古墓群的最东端。日本殖民时期已发现古坟13座，并发现新坟墓10座。部分墓葬被发掘，确认了三汉三国时期的墓葬样式。可见，墓葬很早就开始修建。尚存封地的三国时期墓葬大多为石丘墓，从出土文物和遗骸规模来看，推测为新罗贵族的墓葬。 ◎ 体验韩流魅力的旅游信息 - 这是一座古墓密布的公园，电视剧《20世纪少女》中宝拉修学旅行时曾在这里度过闲暇时光。大约20座大坟墓营造出一种梦幻般的气氛，仿佛它们正在绘制一道脊线。古坟之间矗立着一棵玉兰树的地方是著名的拍照景点。建议您还参观天马冢，这是唯一一座内部向公众开放的古墓。

신라 제30대 문무왕(재위 661~681)의 수중 왕릉으로 신라인들의 창.en: This is the underwater royal tomb of King Munmu, the 30th king of Silla (reigned 661-681), and is a place where you can get a glimpse of the creative thinking of the Silla people. It is located 200m off the coast of Bonggil-ri in the East Sea, and is exposed 35m east-west, 36m north-south, and 5.3m above sea level. King Munmu inherited the achievements of his father, King Taejong Muyeol, and destroyed Goguryeo and prevented the Tang invasion, unifying the three kingdoms. In addition, it provided the basis for completing the national system by creating central government offices such as the Ministry of Military Affairs and the Ministry of Court, and laying the foundation for a military system of 5 small economic provinces, 9 Seodang, and 10 administrative districts for local governance. King Munmu, who achieved the unification of the three kingdoms, said that he would become a dragon to stop the invading Japanese pirates, and buried his body according to his will, which asked him to cremate his body in Buddhist style and bury his ashes in the East Sea. This rock is called Daewangam or Daewangbawi Rock, and the royal tombs under the sea are unprecedented in the world. Daewangam was made using natural rocks. A cross-shaped artificial waterway was created from east to west and north to south on a rocky island, and then dug out like a small pond in the middle to form a port. It is presumed that a wide turtle-shaped stone measuring 3.7m, 2.06m in width, and 0.9m in thickness was placed here at a depth of 2m under water to enshrine the remains. His son, King Sinmun, built Gameunsa Temple near the East Sea and built a drainage channel toward the East Sea under the shrine so that King Munmu, who became a dragon, could come and go.
신라 제30대 문무왕(재위 661~681)의 수중 왕릉으로 신라인들의 창.zh: 这是新罗第30代国王文武王（661-681年在位）的水下王陵，是可以一睹新罗人民创造性思维的地方。位于东海凤吉里海岸200m处，东西高35m，南北高36m，海拔5.3m。文武王继承了其父太宗武烈的功绩，灭掉了高句丽，阻止了唐朝的入侵，统一了三国。此外，它还为完善国家体制奠定了基础，设立了军事部和法院部等中央政府机构，并为由5个经济小道、9个西堂和10个地方治理行政区组成的军事体制奠定了基础。实现三国统一的文武王表示，自己要化身为龙，阻止倭寇的入侵，并按照遗嘱埋葬了自己的遗体，遗嘱要求他以佛教方式火化遗体，将骨灰埋入东海。这块岩石被称为大王岩或大王岩，海底的皇家陵墓在世界上是前所未有的。大王岩是用天然岩石制成的。在一座岩石岛上从东向西、从北向南开辟出一条十字形的人工水道，然后在中间挖出一个小池塘一样的形状，形成港口。据推测，这里水下2m深处放置了一块长3.7m、宽2.06m、厚0.9m的宽龟形石来供奉遗骸。他的儿子神文王在东海附近建造了伽云寺，并在神社下方修建了通向东海的排水道，以便化身为龙的文武王能够出入。

석굴암(국보)은 신라 경덕왕 10년에 당시의 재상인 김대성에 의해 창건되.en: It is said that Seokguram Grotto (National Treasure) was founded in the 10th year of King Gyeongdeok of Silla by Kim Dae-seong, the prime minister at the time. The structure of Seokguram Grotto, located 3 km away from Bulguksa Temple by climbing the ridge and 9 km away by the new road, is a harmony of squares and circles, straight lines and curves, and planes and spheres. In particular, none of the 38 figures carved around the wall are masterpieces, and their overall harmony shows a high degree of philosophy and scientific aspects. In the center, the original seated Buddha made of white granite overlooks the East Sea, and the gaze of the seated Buddha is towards Daewangam in front of Bonggil-ri, the tomb of the underwater king of King Munmu. The site of Gameunsa Temple, which protects the underwater king, and Igyeondae, where it is said that King Munmu was seen as a dragon, are located on the coast near Daewangam, and Bulguksa Temple and Seokguram Grotto were opened on December 6, 1995, along with the Tripitaka Koreana and Jongmyo Shrine of Haeinsa Temple. It is officially designated and protected as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The sky and sea, with the red sun over the horizon seen from Seokguram Grotto, are spectacular. After watching the sunrise at Seokguram Grotto, Seokjang-ro, which goes directly from Tohamsan Mountain to the east coast, was opened in 1998, allowing you to easily go to the sea off Gampo and Yangbuk. Enjoy raw fish that boasts the taste of the cleanest sea in the country, and tour Gameunsa Temple Site and King Munmu's Tomb to make an even more wonderful trip.
석굴암(국보)은 신라 경덕왕 10년에 당시의 재상인 김대성에 의해 창건되.zh: 石窟庵据说是新罗庆德王10年由当时的国相金大成创建的。石窟庵距佛国寺爬山脊3公里，新路9公里，其结构是方形与圆形、直线与曲线、平面与球体的和谐统一。尤其是四周墙壁上雕刻的38尊人物，无一不是杰作，其整体和谐表现出高度的哲学性和科学性。中央是白色花岗岩制成的原始坐佛，俯瞰着东海，其目光投向文武王水下王陵奉吉里前的大王岩。保护水下王的歌云寺遗址和据说文武王被视为龙的二敬台位于大王岩附近的海岸，佛国寺和石窟庵于1995年12月6日与海印寺的高藏经和宗庙一起开放。它被正式指定为联合国教科文组织世界遗产并受到保护。从石窟庵看到的天空和大海，以及地平线上的红日，非常壮观。在石窟庵观赏日出后，从吐含山直达东海岸的石藏路于1998年开通，可以轻松前往甘浦、羊北海域。品尝拥有全国最干净的海水味道的生鱼，游览甘云寺遗址和文武王陵，让旅途更加精彩。

첨성대는 신라 제27대 선덕여왕 때 건립된 것으로 추정되며 경주를 상징하.en: Cheomseongdae is believed to have been built during the reign of Queen Seondeok, the 27th queen of Silla, and is one of the landmarks that symbolize Gyeongju. It has a cylindrical part in the shape of a liquor bottle on top of the stylobate that serves as a pedestal, and the top part in the shape of the letter Jeong (井) is placed on top, and the height is about 9m. The cylindrical part is made of 27 layers of fan-shaped stones. The lower part, centered around the southeast-facing window, is filled with stone, and the upper part is open to the top and is hollow. The eastern half of the summit is blocked by Pandora, and the ends of long stones interlocked in the shape of the letter 井 protrude to the outside. This type of appearance is also found in the 19th~20th and 25th~26th levels, and it seems to have been suitable for hanging a ladder inside. According to an old record, “people are supposed to go up in the middle,” and it appears that they placed a ladder outside, went inside through the window, and then used the ladder to climb to the top and observe the sky. The stones that make up Cheomseongdae each have their own meaning. The shape of Cheomseongdae, which is round at the top and square at the bottom, symbolizes heaven and earth. The 365 stones that made Cheomseongdae symbolize the number of days in a year, the 27-tiered stone platform symbolizes the 27th Queen Seondeok, who built Cheomseongdae, and the 29-tiered and 30-tiered stones, including the pavilion stone at the top, represent the number of days in a lunar month. It is assumed that observers came and went, and the 12 upper and 12 lower tiers based on the window indicate the 12 months and 24 seasons of the year. This part suggests that Cheomseongdae was used to determine the timing of farming by calculating the movement of the sky and to predict good or bad fortune for the country. ◎ Travel information to experience the charm of the Korean Wave - Cheomseongdae, where Bogyeom and Jia passed each other in the drama <I Love You Today Too>, is a landmark representing Gyeongju and the oldest astronomical observatory in the world. Not only does it have great viewing value as a historic site, but it is also visited by many tourists who want to enjoy an outing as various flowers and plants bloom every season.
첨성대는 신라 제27대 선덕여왕 때 건립된 것으로 추정되며 경주를 상징하.zh: 瞻星台据信建于新罗第27代女王善德女王统治时期，是庆州的象征之一。台座上有酒瓶状的圆筒部分，其上置有井字形的顶部，高约9m。圆筒部分由27层扇形石块砌成。下部以朝东南的窗户为中心，用石头填满，上部敞口，中空。山顶的东半部被潘多拉封锁，呈字母井形状的长石的末端伸出到外面。这种外观也出现在第19~20层和第25~26层，似乎很适合在里面挂梯子。据古籍记载，“人应从中间上去”，看来他们是在外面架起梯子，从窗户进去，然后利用梯子爬到顶部观察天空。构成瞻星台的石头各有其各自的含义。瞻星台的形状上圆下方，象征着天地。构成瞻星台的365块石头象征着一年中的天数，27层石台象征着建造瞻星台的第27代善德王后，包括顶部的亭石在内的29层和30层石头代表农历月份的天数。假定观察者来来去去，基于窗口的上 12 层和下 12 层表示一年中的 12 个月和 24 个季节。这部分表明瞻星台是通过计算天象来确定农耕时间并预测国家吉凶的。 ◎ 体验韩流魅力的旅游信息 - 瞻星台是电视剧《今天我也爱你》中宝剑和贾母擦肩而过的地方，是代表庆州的地标建筑，也是世界上最古老的天文台。它不仅作为古迹具有很高的观赏价值，而且每个季节都有各种各样的花卉和植物盛开，吸引了许多想要郊游的游客。

황리단길은 경주에서 가장 젊은 길로 황남동과 이태원의 경리단길을 합쳐진.en: Hwangridan-gil is the youngest road in Gyeongju and is a combination of Hwangnam-dong and Itaewon’s Gyeongnidan-gil, meaning ‘Hwangnam-dong’s Gyeongnidan-gil.’ It refers to the area around Hwangnam-dong and Sajeong-dong on both sides of the road starting from Naenam Intersection to Hwangnam Elementary School Intersection. It is a street where you can fully feel the atmosphere of the past as old buildings from the 1960s and 1970s have been preserved as is. A few years ago, young people began to gather here, and cafes with a nice atmosphere, cute props, souvenir shops, and unique restaurants opened. In the beginning, shops were built mainly along the roadside, but as the outer edge of Hwangridan-gil expanded, unique shops began popping up in every alley. It has become an essential course when traveling to Gyeongju, and it is in the spotlight as a famous tourist attraction in Gyeongju as it allows you to visit the nearby tourist attractions of Cheomseongdae and Daereungwon.
황리단길은 경주에서 가장 젊은 길로 황남동과 이태원의 경리단길을 합쳐진.zh: 皇里团路是庆州最年轻的道路，由皇南洞和梨泰院经理团路组合而成，意思是“皇南洞的经理团路”。是指从内南十字路口到皇南小学十字路口的道路两侧的皇南洞和沙井洞周边地区。这是一条可以充分感受到过去气氛的街道，1960年代和1970年代的老建筑都被原样保存下来。几年前，年轻人开始聚集在这里，气氛美好、道具可爱的咖啡馆、纪念品商店、特色餐厅纷纷开业。最初，商店主要建在路边，但随着黄里坛路外围的扩大，每条小巷都开始出现独特的商店。它已成为庆州旅游的必修路线，作为庆州著名的旅游景点而备受瞩目，因为它可以让您游览附近的瞻星台和大陵苑等旅游景点。

경주엑스포대공원은 1998년 세계 최초로 문화예술을 주제로 한 문화박람회.en: Gyeongju Expo Grand Park is where the world's first culture and arts-themed cultural expo, 'Gyeongju World Expo', was held in 1998. Since then, it has hosted the Gyeongju World Expo 10 times over the past 20 years, raising Koreans' cultural pride and contributing to the development of human culture. Currently, it is a famous place in Gyeongju that lovers, friends, and families can visit and enjoy together based on various exhibitions, videos, performances, and experiential cultural contents. Major facilities include Gyeongju Tower, Gyeongju Solgeo Art Museum, Bium Meditation Trail, and Luminite. In addition, there are various facilities such as Timeless Media Art, Natural History Museum, and Gyeongju World Culture Expo Memorial Hall.
경주엑스포대공원은 1998년 세계 최초로 문화예술을 주제로 한 문화박람회.zh: 庆州世博大公园是1998年举办世界首个以文化艺术为主题的文化博览会“庆州世博会”的举办地。此后，20年来共举办了10届庆州世博会，提高了韩国人的文化自豪感，为人类文化的发展做出了贡献。目前，这里通过各种展览、视频、表演和体验式文化内容，成为庆州情侣、朋友和家人可以一起参观和享受的著名场所。主要设施有庆州塔、庆州松巨美术馆、Bium冥想步道、Luminite等。此外，还有永恒媒体艺术、自然历史博物馆、庆州世界文化博览会纪念馆等各种设施。

경주월드는 어뮤즈먼트와 워터파크인 캘리포니아비치를 운영하고 있다. 그 중.en: Gyeongju World operates California Beach, an amusement and water park. Among them, Gyeongju World Amusement, a theme park that operates about 30 rides, is a theme park with comprehensive recreational facilities such as a snow park and Draken Valley. There are life-changing attractions such as Time Rider, Valkyrie, Krak, and Dragon Race, and various performances and events are also in progress. There are also stores where you can eat, such as Draken Snacks, a stage concession stand, and a deli house, and you can eat your own packed lunch at the picnic ground.
경주월드는 어뮤즈먼트와 워터파크인 캘리포니아비치를 운영하고 있다. 그 중.zh: 庆州世界经营加州海滩游乐园和水上乐园。其中，经营约30个游乐设施的主题公园庆州世界游乐园，是一座拥有冰雪公园、德拉肯谷等综合游乐设施的主题公园。这里有时光骑士、女武神、克拉克、龙族赛跑等改变生活的景点，各种表演和活动也在进行中。这里还有 Draken Snacks、舞台小摊、熟食店等可以吃饭的商店，您还可以在野餐场吃自己的盒装午餐。

동해안 최대 해변으로 유명하며 강문동, 안현동에 있고 시내에서 북으로 6.en: Famous as the largest beach on the East Coast, it is located in Gangmun-dong and Anhyeon-dong, 6km north of the city and 1km from Gyeongpodae, and is filled with waves of waves from the East Sea. The combination of the waves crashing in as if trying to swallow everyone, the 1.8 km long, 1.44 km2 white sandy beach that embraces them, and the lush pine folding screens that quietly block out the noisy daily life creates a unique beauty of the beach. Gyeongpodae Beach is a 1.8km white sand beach with an average water depth of 1~2m. It is a place where many people visit every year due to its moderate depth and gentle slope. There is a thick pine forest around the beach, making it a perfect summer resort as you can enjoy sea and forest bathing at the same time. Every summer, the Summer Night Arts Festival is held at the permanent stage on Gyeongpo Beach, offering a variety of cultural attractions. Hiking by renting a bicycle around Gyeongpo Lake is also a specialty. In addition, there are Seoraksan Mountain and Odaesan National Park nearby, so you can explore mountains, the sea, and valleys.
동해안 최대 해변으로 유명하며 강문동, 안현동에 있고 시내에서 북으로 6.zh: 位于市区以北 6 公里、距镜浦台 1 公里的江门洞和安岘洞，被誉为东海岸最大的海滩，充满了来自东海的海浪。仿佛要将所有人吞没的海浪，与拥抱海浪的1.8公里长、1.44平方公里的白色沙滩，与静静遮挡日常生活喧嚣的茂密松木屏风，共同营造出海滩独特的美感。镜浦台海水浴场是长1.8公里的白色沙滩，平均水深1~2m。由于深度适中、坡度平缓，每年都有不少游客前来参观。海滩周围有茂密的松树林，可以同时享受海水浴和森林浴，是绝佳的避暑胜地。每年夏天，镜浦海滩的永久舞台都会举办夏夜艺术节，提供各种文化景点。租借自行车环镜浦湖徒步也是一大特色。此外，附近还有雪岳山和五台山国立公园，可以探索山、海、谷。

고고다이노 키즈카페는 어린이 애니메이션 ‘고고다이노’를 주제로 만든 20.en: Gogo Dino Kids Cafe is an indoor playground measuring 200 to 300 pyeong with the theme of the children’s animation ‘Gogo Dino’. Dasan Hyundai Campus Mall branch is equipped with a variety of play facilities such as a dance trampoline, tube slide, and children's ball pool, so children can have fun all day long. Convenience facilities such as a cafeteria and a lounge are provided so you can eat and rest. You can make your child’s birthday special in the reservation-only party room.
고고다이노 키즈카페는 어린이 애니메이션 ‘고고다이노’를 주제로 만든 20.zh: Gogo恐龙儿童咖啡厅是一个占地200至300坪的室内游乐场，以儿童动画“Gogo恐龙”为主题。茶山现代Campus Mall店配备了舞蹈蹦床、管道滑梯、儿童球池等各种游乐设施，让孩子们可以玩上一整天。设有自助餐厅、休息室等便利设施，方便您就餐、休息。您可以在仅限预订的派对室让您孩子的生日变得特别。

고대산은 해발 832m로 연천군의 신서면과 강원도 철원군 철원읍의 경계를.en: Godae Mountain is 832 meters above sea level and forms the border between Sinseo-myeon, Yeoncheon-gun and Cheorwon-eup, Cheorwon-gun, Gangwon-do. It is the closest mountain to North Korea among the mountains permitted for climbing. The origin of Godae Mountain appears to be related to the Shintan name, [Big Whale]. It refers to Bangorae (the furrow through which flame and smoke flows under the floor of an ondol room using firewood), and is called Godae Mountain because the valley is deep and high. Godasan Mountain has a total of three hiking trails that use Godasan Natural Recreation Forest as the starting and ending points. Course 1 is about 4.2km, and includes the Godasan parking lot - 1st hiking trail entrance - Keungol - Munbawi - Daegwangbong - Samgakbong - and climbs to the top of Godesan Mountain. Course 2 is about 4.3km, and goes from Godaesan Parking lot - 2nd hiking trail entrance - Maldeungbawi Rock - Kalbawi - Daegwangbong - Samgakbong - to the top of Godesan Mountain. Course 3 is about 4.0km long and goes from Godae Mountain parking lot to the 3rd hiking trail entrance to Leopard Falls to the summit of Godae Mountain. All three hiking trails take about 2 hours to 2 hours and 10 minutes. Course 3 is steeper than Courses 1 and 2, so hiking in a circle from Courses 1 and 2 to Course 3 is usually preferred. In particular, the secret scenery of Kalbawi Ridge, the highlight of course 2, and Leopard Falls, course 3, steal the hearts of many hikers. There is a pavilion and a large heliport near the top of the mountain, making it a great place to rest or enjoy the view. From the summit, you can see at a glance the Cheorwon Plain in the North, the Iron Triangle, the site of the greatest battle of the Korean War, the Taebongguk City Wall built around the new capital by Gungye, as well as Geumhaksan Mountain, Jijangbong Peak, Bukdaesan Mountain, and Hyangnobong Mountain, as well as Jongjasan Mountain on the banks of the Hantangang River. It is also a popular winter hiking destination, and people can hike to nearby Bogaesan Mountain and Geumhaksan Mountain. Nearby are Baekmagoji, Yeoncheon Station Icicle, Labor Party Headquarters, Key Observatory, Dongmakgol Recreation Area, Crane Theme Park, Herb Village, Jaein Falls (Hantangang River National Geopark), Hantangang and Imjin River columnar joints, Yeoncheon Jeongok-ri Ruins, Yeoncheon Horogoru, and Yeoncheon Gorangpogu Historical Park.
고대산은 해발 832m로 연천군의 신서면과 강원도 철원군 철원읍의 경계를.zh: 高台山海拔832米，是涟川郡新西面和江原道铁原郡铁原邑的边界。它是允许攀登的山峰中距离朝鲜最近的山峰。五台山的起源似乎与神滩的名字“大鲸”有关。指的是班戈雷（用柴火在火炕室的地板下流淌火焰和烟雾的沟渠），因山谷深而高而被称为高台山。五田山共有3条登山路线，以五田山自然休养林为起点和终点。第1路线全长约4.2公里，包括高台山停车场-第1登山道入口-强谷-文波威-大光峰-三角峰-登上高台山山顶。第2路线全长约4.3公里，从高台山停车场-登山道第二入口-魔灯岩-甲骨峰-大光峰-三角峰-高台山山顶。第3路线全长约4.0公里，从高台山停车场至豹子瀑布登山步道第3入口至高台山山顶。 3条徒步路线均需时约2小时至2小时10分钟。路线 3 比路线 1 和 2 陡峭，因此通常首选从路线 1 和 2 绕一圈徒步到路线 3。尤其是第2路线的亮点卡尔巴维山脊的秘境和第3路线的豹子瀑布，俘获了众多徒步旅行者的心。山顶附近有凉亭和大型直升机场，是休息或赏景的好地方。从山顶可以一览北方的铁原平原、朝鲜战争最伟大战役的铁三角、军溪在新都周围修建的大峰国城墙、金鹤山、地藏峰、北大山、香炉峰以及汉滩江畔的钟子山。这里也是冬季徒步旅行的热门目的地，人们可以徒步前往附近的宝开山和金鹤山。附近有百马高地、涟川站冰柱、劳动党本部、重点展望台、东莫谷游憩区、仙鹤主题公园、香草村、才人瀑布（汉滩江国家地质公园）、汉滩江、临津江柱状节理、涟川全谷里遗迹、涟川Horogoru、涟川五郎浦古历史公园等。

경기도 연천군 신서면 대광리에 소재한 고대산산자연휴양림은 2017년에 개.en: Godae Mountain Natural Recreation Forest, located in Daegwang-ri, Sinseo-myeon, Yeoncheon-gun, Gyeonggi-do, opened in 2017 and is close to National Road 3 and Shintan-ri Station on the Gyeongwon Line, so it is easily accessible and is a place where you can enjoy the clear and quiet natural environment unique to the border area. The main facilities include 14 forest houses, 1 forest recreation center, 6 rooms, 1 forest training center, 20 campsites, 1 public restroom and kitchen. It is a place where you can breathe with nature, wash away stress and tired mind and body, and add joy and comfort through various hiking and exploring trails leading to Godaesan Mountain (832m) and Bogaesan Mountain (877m). It takes about 2 minutes by car or 15 minutes on foot from Shintanri Station on the Gyeongwon Line. Nearby are Baekmagoji, Yeoncheon Station Icicle, Labor Party Headquarters, Key Observatory, Dongmakgol Recreation Area, Crane Theme Park, Herb Village, Jaein Falls (Hantangang River National Geopark), Hantangang River and Imjingang River Columnar Joints, Yeoncheon Jeongok-ri Ruins, Yeoncheon Horogoru, and Yeoncheon Gorangpo Historical Park. (Source: Godae Mountain Natural Recreation Forest website)
경기도 연천군 신서면 대광리에 소재한 고대산산자연휴양림은 2017년에 개.zh: 高大山自然休养林位于京畿道涟川郡新西面大光里，于2017年开业，靠近3号国道和京原线新炭里站，交通便利，是可以享受边境地区特有的清澈、安静的自然环境的地方。主要设施包括14栋森林房屋、1个森林游乐中心、6个房间、1个森林培训中心、20个露营地、1个公共卫生间和厨房。在这里，您可以通过通往高台山（832m）和宝盖山（877m）的各种徒步旅行和探索路线，与大自然一起呼吸，洗去压力和疲惫的身心，增添欢乐和舒适。从京原线新谷里站乘车约2分钟，步行约15分钟。附近有百马高地、涟川站冰柱、劳动党本部、重点展望台、东莫谷游憩区、仙鹤主题公园、药草村、才人瀑布（汉滩江国家地质公园）、汉滩江、临津江柱状节理、涟川全谷里遗迹、涟川Horogoru、涟川五郎浦历史公园等。 （来源：五台山自然休养林网站）

고모리는 어떤 사람이 늙은 고모님을 모시고 그 산 밑에 살았다 하여 붙여.en: Gomori is a name given to a person who lived under the mountain with his old aunt. This grandmother passed away alone, and the village was opened in front of her grave. This place was called Gomoe-ap, Gomyo, or Gomo. For this reason, the name of the village became Gomori. Gomo Reservoir is a reservoir with a storage capacity of 1,300,000 tons and an area of ​​​​about 55,000 pyeong, located in the center of Jukyeop Mountain, 600m above sea level, east of Soheul-eup. It has a beautiful trail, fountain, and rest area, so it is convenient for nearby cafes, galleries, restaurants, walking trails, and hiking courses. It is also a pleasant place to explore or resort, and you can enjoy water leisure activities, making it a suitable day trip destination. The Gomo Reservoir fountain operates every 30 minutes from 12:00 to 17:30 from mid-April to mid-November. Every Saturday and Sunday, a flea market is held at the lake square, where Komori residents, artists, and skilled handmade sellers come out to show off their skills and sell them. Additionally, there are many restaurants and cafes that allow dogs, so there are many people outing with their dogs.
고모리는 어떤 사람이 늙은 고모님을 모시고 그 산 밑에 살았다 하여 붙여.zh: 后森是一个与他的老姑妈住在山下的人的名字。这位祖母孤独地去世了，村子在她的坟前被开辟了。这个地方被称为“Gomoe-ap”、“Gomyo”或“Gomo”。因此，村名就变成了“五森”。戈莫水库是一座库容130万吨、面积约55000坪的水库，位于秀乙邑以东、海拔600m的竹结山中央。它有美丽的步道、喷泉和休息区，因此前往附近的咖啡馆、画廊、餐馆、步行道和徒步旅行路线都很方便。这里还是一处宜人的探险或度假胜地，可以享受水上休闲活动，是适合一日游的目的地。戈莫水库喷泉于4月中旬至11月中旬的12:00至17:30每30分钟运行一次。每周六、周日，湖边广场都会举办跳蚤市场，小森居民、艺术家、手艺精湛的卖家都会出来展示自己的手艺并出售。此外，有很多餐厅和咖啡馆允许携带狗，因此有很多人带着狗出去郊游。

고봉산은 고양시 일산구에서 가장 높은 산이다. 이 산의 이름은 ‘높은 산.en: Gobongsan Mountain is the highest mountain in Ilsan-gu, Goyang-si. The name of this mountain comes from the meaning of ‘high mountain peak’ or ‘raising a signal fire.’ When viewed from a distance, the north side is high and the south side is low. It is a famous mountain that appears in 'Samguk Sagi', a record of the Three Kingdoms period, and was a key military, transportation, and strategic point where Goguryeo, Baekje, and Silla fought fierce battles over the Han River basin. As proof of this, pottery pieces from the Three Kingdoms period are found here and there on this mountain. Gobongsan Mountain is home to pine trees, zelkova trees, oak trees, and chestnut trees, which always provide cool shade. At the foot of the mountain, there are small temples of Mangyeongsa Temple and Yeongcheonsa Temple, as well as cultural assets such as Jeong Ji-un's tomb and Hong I-sang's tomb. There are also many small rocks on the mountain, and the representative rocks include Madangbawi Rock, Jangsabawi Rock, Toad Rock, Cheukimbawi Rock, Imugi Rock, and Thunder Rock. Gobongsan Beacon Mound is located at the top. Old literature records that Gobongsanseong Fortress was located here and a beacon fire station was installed there. The current beacon mound remains as a rectangular stone mound centered on the peak of the mountain. The total circumference of the stone wall is approximately 120m, and the height is approximately 5m. Gobong Beacon Mound is a beacon mound made by piling up surrounding natural stones and is in a relatively good state of preservation with no special collapsed areas.
고봉산은 고양시 일산구에서 가장 높은 산이다. 이 산의 이름은 ‘높은 산.zh: 高峰山是高阳市一山区的最高峰。这座山的名字来源于“高山峰”或“燃起信号火”的意思。从远处看，北边高，南边低。是三国史记《三国史记》中记载的名山，是高句丽、百济、新罗争夺汉江流域的军事、交通、战略要地。这座山上到处都发现了三国时期的陶器，足以证明这一点。高峰山上有松树、榉树、橡树、栗树等，常年乘凉。山脚下有万庆寺、永天寺等小寺院，还有郑智云墓、洪伊尚墓等文化遗产。山上还有很多小岩石，代表性的岩石有马当巴威岩、长沙巴威岩、蟾蜍岩、Cheukimbawi 岩、Imugi 岩、雷霆岩等。高峰山烽火台位于山顶。据古文献记载，这里有高峰山城，并设有烽火台。现在的烽火台仍是一个以山顶为中心的长方形石丘。石墙总周长约120m，高约5m。高峰烽火台是由周围的天然石料堆砌而成的烽火台，保存状况较好，没有特别塌陷的地方。

경기도 안성에 자리한 고삼호수는 60년에 준공한 94만 평 규모로, 몽환.en: Gosam Lake, located in Anseong, Gyeonggi-do, is a 940,000 pyeong (940,000 pyeong) lake built in 1960 and is a place of natural beauty with a dreamy and lyrical sense of mystery. Gosam Lake, the main setting of director Kim Ki-duk's movie Island, is impressive with its blue water and pedestal floating on it. Gosam Lake is famous as a fishing spot, but after the movie was released, it also became known as a tourist destination. It is located relatively close to downtown Seoul, so it is possible as a day course. In the movie, the entire lake is set as an open set, so you can enjoy the tranquil atmosphere as it was in its original form. This place has clean water, shallow depth, and well-formed aquatic plants along the coast, so carp and carp are especially abundant. There are shops nearby that sell whole carp, native chicken, grilled eel, and spicy spicy stew restaurants. Nearby scenic spots include Mirinae, a sacred place for Korean Catholics who were so religious that they were reputed to be the only ones in the world who spontaneously accepted a new religion; there is also a temple of the 103rd Catholic saint who was sealed as a Catholic saint by the Vatican in 1984, the tomb and chapel of the first priest, Father Kim Dae-geon, a rectory, and a monastery. In addition, there are many fishing spots nearby, such as Misan Lake, so it is a place where Kang Tae-gong constantly visits.
