경기도 안성에 자리한 고삼호수는 60년에 준공한 94만 평 규모로, 몽환.zh: 高三湖位于京畿道安城市，是一个建于1960年的940,000坪（940,000坪）湖泊，是一个充满梦幻和抒情神秘感的自然美景之地。高三湖是金基德导演的电影《岛》的主要场景，碧蓝的湖水和漂浮在湖面上的基座令人印象深刻。高三湖原本是著名的钓鱼胜地，但电影上映后，它也成为了著名的旅游胜地。它距离首尔市中心较近，因此可以作为日间课程。电影中整个湖被设置为开放式场景，因此您可以享受到原汁原味的宁静氛围。这里水清，水深浅，沿岸水草茂盛，所以鲤鱼、鲤鱼特别丰富。附近有卖整条鲤鱼、土鸡、烤鳗鱼、麻辣烫的炖菜店。附近的景点包括米里那 (Mirinae)，这是韩国天主教徒的圣地，他们非常虔诚，据说他们是世界上唯一自发接受新宗教的人；还有1984年被梵蒂冈封为天主教圣人的第103位天主教圣人的圣殿、第一任神父金大建神父的坟墓和礼拜堂、教区长和修道院。此外，附近还有美山湖等许多钓鱼点，因此这里也是姜泰功经常光顾的地方。

휴전선과 남방한계선이 만나는 해발 70m 고지의 통일전망대에 서면 금강산.en: If you stand at the Unification Observatory, located 70 meters above sea level where the Armistice Line and the Southern Limit Line meet, you can see Guseonbong Peak and Haegeumgang River in close proximity, and on clear days, you can see Oknyebong Peak, Chaehabong Peak, and Ilchulbong Peak. The front-line guard posts facing each other across the barbed wire fence of the ceasefire line below give a sense of the tension between North and South Korea. As a representative tourist attraction in Goseong, visited by more than 1.5 million tourists annually, there are religious facilities such as the Virgin Mary, Maitreya Buddha, and Jeonjeon Iron Tower for the displaced people who remember their descendants and families left behind in North Korea and those who wish for unification, as well as security education exhibits such as armored vehicles, tanks, and airplanes. Geumgangsan overland tourism can be seen taking place on the Donghae Line, a north-south connecting road that opened in December 2004.
휴전선과 남방한계선이 만나는 해발 70m 고지의 통일전망대에 서면 금강산.zh: 站在位于停战线和南方界线交汇处海拔70米处的统一展望台，可以近距离看到九仙峰和海金刚，天气晴朗时还可以看到玉女峰、彩霞峰、日出峰。前线哨所隔着停火线的铁丝网面对面，让人感受到朝鲜和韩国之间的紧张局势。作为高城的代表性旅游景点，每年接待游客超过150万人次，这里有圣母玛利亚、弥勒佛、全殿铁塔等宗教设施，供缅怀在北朝鲜的子孙和家人以及希望统一的人们使用，还有装甲车、坦克、飞机等安全教育展览。金刚山陆路旅游可以在 2004 年 12 月开通的南北连接公路东海线上看到。

높이 298m인 고성산은 만세고개에서 운수암에 이르는 등산코스가 제법 운.en: Goseongsan Mountain, which is 298m high, has a quite picturesque hiking course from Manse Pass to Unsuam. If you climb from Bangsin-ri, Yangseong-myeon, Anseong-si, you can first see Unsuam Hermitage. If you head northwest from the entrance to Bangsin-ri, you can see the atmosphere of Unsuam among the larch and pine forests. Unsuam Hermitage, where the clear sound of moktak greets you on the forest path, is designated as Gyeonggi-do Cultural Asset No. 25 and contains a Vairocana Buddha statue created during the Goryeo Dynasty. Unsuam Temple is a temple founded in the 26th year of King Yeongjo’s reign in the Joseon Dynasty. According to legend, a Bodhisattva decided to live with Buddha for the rest of his life and was initially laying a foundation under Musanseong Fortress. One day, in a dream, he received a revelation from the Buddha telling him to build a temple within the fortress. He entered the fortress, visited the place shown in his dream, discovered an old temple site, and built a temple there. Later, when this Bodhisattva died, Daewongun rebuilt this temple, which was overgrown with weeds, and put up a handwritten plaque praying for the peace of the nation and the name Unsuam. This temple became famous. However, because there was no one to take care of it, it was on the verge of collapse, so monk Hyeonam repaired it and rebuilt the main hall, which still stands today. If you have carefully looked around Unsuam, you can find a mineral spring by walking a short distance along the well-maintained hiking trail. If you cool off your sweat here for a moment and take a few steps, you will reach the summit of Goseongsan Mountain. When you climb to the top of Goseongsan Mountain, you can see the vast fields of Anseong Yangseong area and the plains extending to Pyeongtaek. After enjoying the surrounding scenery from the top, let’s walk towards Hill 216. When you come down from the summit, you will come across a small hiking trail that goes down towards Bibeopsa Temple. Instead of taking this route, you can also go over Hill 216 and descend behind the mountain lodge rest area. In particular, the March 1st Movement Memorial Hall has been newly built across from the mountain lodge rest area, so you can tour historical sites.
높이 298m인 고성산은 만세고개에서 운수암에 이르는 등산코스가 제법 운.zh: 高城山海拔298m，从万岁岭到云水岩有风景如画的徒步路线。从安城市阳城面芳心里爬上去，首先就能看到云水岩寺。从芳心里入口向西北方向走，可以在落叶松和松树林中感受到云水岩的风情。林间小道上清脆的木打声迎接您的云水庵被指定为京畿道文化遗产第25号，内有高丽时期制作的毗卢遮那佛像。云水岩寺是朝鲜英祖26年创建的寺庙。相传，一位菩萨决定与佛陀共度余生，最初在茂山城下奠基。有一天，他在梦中得到佛陀的启示，告诉他要在堡垒内建造一座寺庙。他进入了要塞，参观了梦中所示的地方，发现了一座古老的寺庙遗址，并在那里建造了一座寺庙。后来这位菩萨圆寂后，大院君重建了这座杂草丛生的寺庙，并挂了祈求国家和平的手书匾额，并取名云水岩。这座寺庙因此而闻名。但因无人照管，濒临倒塌，贤庵和尚对其进行了修复，并重建了大雄宝殿，至今仍屹立不倒。如果您仔细观察了 Unsuam 的周围，沿着维护良好的远足小径步行一小段距离即可发现矿泉。在这里稍稍消一下汗，再走几步，就到了高城山的山顶。登上高城山山顶，可以看到安城阳城地区的广阔田野以及一直延伸到平泽的平原。从山顶欣赏完周围的景色后，我们向216山走去。从山顶下来后，您会看到一条小登山道，一直向下通往飞法寺。除了走这条路，你也可以翻过216山，在山间小屋休息区后面下山。特别是山间小屋休息区对面新建了三一运动纪念馆，可以游览古迹。

단종 복위운동에 가담했다가 참화를 당한 김문기(金文起)의 손(孫)인 김충.en: This is the place where Kim Chung-ju, the grandson of Kim Mun-gi, who participated in the movement to restore King Danjong and suffered disaster, lived. It is said that Kim Chung-ju escaped from the capital during the night and moved around various places until he hid in Hwajeong-dong and made it his business to weave grass to build a house and bake and sell charcoal. He called himself Tanong (炭翁) and did not eat meat or alcohol all his life, and wore sackcloth and a hat. It is said that whenever his mind about King Danjong changed, he cried while looking at Yeongwol, where King Danjong's grave is located, and that the pine tree withered and died due to the tears he shed as he mourned the death of his grandfather and father. In the 27th year of King Sunjo's reign (1827), his 9th generation grandson, Jinsa Kim Cheo-il, built a pavilion called Gosongjeong (枯松亭) on the spot. Gosongjeong site is also called Tanong Goteo because he made a living by weaving grass to build houses, grilled and sold charcoal, and called himself an old man who burns charcoal. The pavilion measures 2 kan at the front and 2 kan at the sides, and has a gable roof that is shaped like an eight-pointed gable when viewed from the side. To the left of the pavilion, there is a rock with the inscription [Tanonggoji], and if you go up to the right of Gosongjeong, there is a rock called Mangwolam where he cried while drawing Danjong. The surrounding area has zelkova and juniper trees that are over 500 years old, creating an outstanding natural scenery.
단종 복위운동에 가담했다가 참화를 당한 김문기(金文起)의 손(孫)인 김충.zh: 这里是参加端宗复辟运动而遭受灾难的金文基的孙子金正柱居住的地方。据说，金正柱连夜逃出京城，辗转各地，直到躲进花井洞，以织草盖房、烧炭卖炭为业。他自号炭翁，一生不食肉，不饮酒，穿麻衣，戴帽子。据说，每当他对端宗的想法发生变化时，他都会看着端宗坟墓所在的宁越哭泣，而松树因他为悼念祖父和父亲而流下的眼泪而枯萎而死。纯祖27年（1827年），其九代孙金处日在原址修建了一座名为“枯松亭”的亭子。高松亭遗址因以编草造屋、烧烤卖炭为生，自称烧炭老人，故又称“塔农古太”。亭面宽二间，侧面二间，山墙式屋顶，从侧面看呈八角形。亭子的左边有一块岩石，上面刻有“Tanonggoji”字样，如果你登上高松亭的右边，有一块叫做“望月岩”的岩石，他在那里画坛宗时哭泣。周边有树龄超过500年的榉树、桧树，自然风光优美。

일산호수공원 가로수길은 지하 1층부터 지상 3층까지 5개 동, 약 270.en: Ilsan Lake Park Garosu-gil is a street mall with 5 buildings from the 1st basement level to the 3rd floor above ground and is approximately 270m long. There are prop shops, cafes, and dessert stores on the first floor, and various food and beverage stores, including Korean food, Western food, and snacks, on the second floor. It is adjacent to the lake park, making it ideal for walking trails, and the dome-shaped building creates an exotic atmosphere reminiscent of Santorini. Terrace-type open-air cafes are popular as photo zones where you can enjoy European sensibility regardless of the season.
일산호수공원 가로수길은 지하 1층부터 지상 3층까지 5개 동, 약 270.zh: 一山湖公园林荫树路是一座街道商业街，从地下1层到地上3层共有5栋建筑，全长约270m。一楼有道具店、咖啡厅、甜品店，二楼有韩餐、西餐、小吃等各种餐饮店。它毗邻湖滨公园，非常适合步行步道，圆顶形状的建筑营造出一种让人想起圣托里尼岛的异国情调。露台式的露天咖啡厅作为拍照区很受欢迎，无论什么季节都可以享受欧洲风情。

고양꽃전시관은 2000 고양 세계꽃박람회의 성공적 개최를 기념하고 정기적.en: Goyang Flower Exhibition Hall is an exhibition hall built in Ilsan Lake Park by Goyang City with a budget of KRW 9.8 billion to commemorate the successful hosting of the 2000 Goyang World Flower Expo and to hold regular flower fairs and flower-related exhibitions. There are three exhibition halls indoors and two exhibition areas outdoors. The first floor of the exhibition hall includes a flower book cafe, flower shop, and main exhibition hall, and the second floor consists of a flower academy and cafeteria. There is also a seminar room and press center for academic conferences. It is affiliated with the Goyang Flower Culture and Arts Center, which offers various flower culture classes, and is located within Ilsan Lake Park in Goyang-si, so you can tour the lake park after viewing the exhibition hall event.
고양꽃전시관은 2000 고양 세계꽃박람회의 성공적 개최를 기념하고 정기적.zh: 高阳市花卉展览馆是高阳市为纪念2000年高阳世界花卉博览会的成功举办，并定期举办花卉博览会和花卉相关展览，斥资98亿韩元在一山湖公园修建的展览馆。室内设有三个展厅，室外有两个展区。展厅一层包括花书咖啡厅、花店、主展厅，二层由花书院和自助餐厅组成。还有一个用于学术会议的研讨室和新闻中心。它隶属于高阳市花卉文化艺术中心，提供各种花卉文化课程，位于高阳市一山湖公园内，因此可以在观看展览馆活动后游览湖公园。

고양문화원은 1984년 개원하여 고양의 역사 문화 보존, 발굴, 육성,.en: Goyang Cultural Center opened in 1984 and has been leading the development of Goyang City's traditional culture through preservation, discovery, cultivation, and dissemination of Goyang's history and culture. Goyang Cultural Center plays the role of cultural guardian of Goyang City by conducting permanent traditional cultural performances and cultural arts forums (classes). Additionally, a digital library is in operation and traditional wedding ceremonies can also be held.
고양문화원은 1984년 개원하여 고양의 역사 문화 보존, 발굴, 육성,.zh: 高阳市文化馆于1984年开业，通过保存、发现、培育和传播高阳市的历史文化，引领高阳市传统文化的发展。高阳市文化馆通过常设传统文化演出和文化艺术论坛（班），发挥高阳市文化守护者的作用。此外，数字图书馆正在运营，还可以举行传统的婚礼。

주엽어린이도서관은 지하1층, 지상 3층 총면적 2,049㎡로 10만 권이.en: Jooyeop Children's Library has a total area of ​​2,049㎡, one underground floor and three above-ground floors, and consists of a children's book resource room (Book Love and Treasure Complex) filled with over 100,000 books, a multi-story room with computer access, and a social gathering place where performances and events can be held. As a library that emphasizes the concept of global culture, it presents a future vision to children through foreign fairy tales that express images of various lifestyles and cultures around the world, a story room where you can feel the old Korean emotions, a multi-story room, and a Bitgeum fairy tale room. It is inspired by the Mandaeru Pavilion of Byeongsan Seowon and has an architectural meaning that is similar to the structure of a hanok with a yard and bare feet. It is a pretty library that boasts wide windows, an interesting two-story structure, and a cute palace-like architecture. It is operated as a space that provides happiness to children, serving as a book playground.* Opening date: June 28, 2007
주엽어린이도서관은 지하1층, 지상 3층 총면적 2,049㎡로 10만 권이.zh: 居野儿童图书馆总面积2049平方米，地下一层，地上三层，由藏书10万余册的儿童图书资源室（书爱宝藏综合体）、配有电脑的多层房间以及可举办表演和活动的社交聚会场所组成。作为强调全球文化概念的图书馆，这里通过表达世界各地各种生活方式和文化形象的外国童话故事、可以感受到古老韩国情感的故事室、多层房间和Bitgeum童话室，向孩子们展示了未来的愿景。它的灵感来自屏山书院的满大楼，其建筑意义类似于带院子和赤脚的韩屋结构。这是一个漂亮的图书馆，拥有宽大的窗户、有趣的两层结构和可爱的宫殿式建筑。它是一个为孩子们提供快乐的空间，也是一个读书游乐场。*开业日期：2007年6月28日

고양시 문예회관은 고양 시청 및 고양시 의회와 같은 곳에 위치해 있으며,.en: Goyang City Arts Center is located in the same place as Goyang City Hall and Goyang City Council, and is a complex cultural space with a total of 334 seats that opened in 1989. It is equipped with improved convenience facilities and a stage system through remodeling in 2020, and is a cultural and artistic space where citizens take the lead by serving as a medium through which art can fill the daily lives of citizens. You can apply for rental at a time determined by the Goyang Cultural Foundation, and you must apply through the Goyang Cultural Foundation website (you can apply after registering as a member of the Goyang City Cultural Center). You must attach and submit a rental application form, performance plan, and a copy of your ID card, and approval notification will be individually notified in writing (via fax or email). The rental fee is relatively cheap. This place is not normally open and is only used when there are performances or events. It is mainly used for events such as various contests, training and education, and lectures.
고양시 문예회관은 고양 시청 및 고양시 의회와 같은 곳에 위치해 있으며,.zh: 高阳市艺术中心与高阳市政府和高阳市议会位于同一地点，是1989年开放的共有334个座位的复合文化空间。通过2020年的改造，配备了完善的便利设施和舞台系统，是一个以艺术为媒介，让艺术充满市民日常生活的以市民为主体的文化艺术空间。您可以在高阳市文化财团规定的时间申请租赁，并且必须通过高阳市文化财团网站申请（注册为高阳市文化中心会员后即可申请）。您必须附上并提交租赁申请表、演出计划和身份证复印件，批准通知将单独书面通知（通过传真或电子邮件）。租金相对便宜。这个地方平时不开放，只有在有表演或者活动的时候才使用。主要用于各类竞赛、培训教育、讲座等活动。

고양한강공원은 한강을 배경으로 산책로와 넓은 잔디광장이 조성된 휴식 공간.en: Goyang Hangang Park is a relaxation space with a walking path and a large lawn plaza with the Han River in the background. The walking trail connected to the DMZ Peace Road is good for a light walk while feeling the cool river breeze and fresh greenery, and the wide lawn along the Han River is good for enjoying a leisurely picnic with lovers, family, children, or alone. There are historical sites and tourist attractions nearby, such as Haengjusanseong Fortress, so exploring them together makes for a more enriching outing.
고양한강공원은 한강을 배경으로 산책로와 넓은 잔디광장이 조성된 휴식 공간.zh: 高阳汉江公园是以汉江为背景，设有步行道和大型草坪广场的休闲空间。连接DMZ和平路的步道适合散步，感受凉爽的河风和新鲜的绿色，汉江沿岸宽阔的草坪适合与爱人、家人、孩子或独自享受悠闲的野餐。附近还有幸州山城等历史古迹和旅游景点，一起探索可以让郊游更加丰富。

&nbsp;고양향교는 경기도 고양시 덕양구 고양동에 있는 조선 후기 숙종.en: Goyang Hyanggyo is a Hyanggyo that was founded during the reign of King Sukjong in the late Joseon Dynasty in Goyang-dong, Deogyang-gu, Goyang-si, Gyeonggi-do. Hyanggyo is a national educational institution during the Goryeo and Joseon Dynasties that was established for the education and enlightenment of local residents by holding memorial tablets of great Confucian scholars and holding ancestral rites. It is located on the eastern foot of Daejasan Mountain, and is a cultural heritage site that retains the traditional architectural beauty, starting with Hongsalmun Gate, Hanok buildings such as Myeongryundang, and walls, chimneys, and tiles. Although the detailed history after its founding is not told, it has been repaired several times, and the fence was repaired in 1970. The existing building is centered around the five-room Daeseongjeon Hall and includes the East House, Study Room, and Naesammun Gate, but there is no Myeongnyundang Hall. In Daeseongjeon, there are memorial tablets of five saints, and in Dongmu Seomu, memorial tablets of the 2 prefectures of the Song Dynasty and the 18 prefectures of Korea are enshrined. During the Joseon Dynasty, instructors were provided with fields, slaves, and Jeokjeok by the government to teach students, but now the educational function has disappeared. A memorial service is held in the spring and fall, and incense is burned on the first day and the first full moon. One Jeongyo (典校) and a funeral director are in charge of the operation. This Hyanggyo is designated as a Gyeonggi-do cultural property. Major experience programs include the Goyang Confucian Etiquette School, where you can learn proper manners and the spirit of a scholar through a scholar experience at a local school, and the Little Scholar Pungryu Playground, where you can have fun and enjoy a variety of traditional games.
&nbsp;고양향교는 경기도 고양시 덕양구 고양동에 있는 조선 후기 숙종.zh: 高阳乡校是朝鲜后期肃宗时期在京畿道高阳市德阳区高阳洞创建的乡校。乡校是高丽、朝鲜时期为了教育和启蒙当地居民而设立的国家教育机构，供奉儒家大儒的牌位和举行祭祀活动。位于大子山东麓，以红萨尔门、明轮堂等韩屋建筑、墙壁、烟囱、瓦片等为代表，保留着传统建筑美感的文化遗产。虽然创建后的详细历史不详，但曾多次修缮，1970年修葺栅栏。现存建筑以五间大成殿为中心，包括东屋、书房、内三门，但没有明伦堂。大成殿内供奉着五位圣人的牌位，东武西武内供奉着宋朝二郡和朝鲜十八郡的牌位。朝鲜时期，政府为教师提供田地、奴隶、赤积来教导学生，但现在教育功能已经消失。春秋两季举行祭祀，初一、初月烧香。一名典校和一名丧葬承办人负责运营。该乡校被指定为京畿道文化财产。主要体验项目包括高阳儒礼学校和小学者风流游乐场，前者可以通过当地学校的学者体验学习礼仪和学者精神，后者可以享受各种传统游戏的乐趣。

곤지암스키장 인근에 위치한 곤지암렌탈샵 아이원입니다. 저희는 무작정 저렴.en: This is I-One, a Gonjiam rental shop located near Gonjiam Ski Resort. We aim to rent good quality products at reasonable prices, not just blindly low prices.  You can rent not only skis/boards and clothing, but also gloves, helmets, protectors, and goggles. The space has been configured for maximum efficiency so that you can quickly rent equipment and clothing in a space of approximately 80 pyeong. The changing room has been expanded and remodeled to allow for neater use, and parking is available for more than 20 cars in front of the store.  We also have a variety of equipment including button step-on boards, inline skis, hammer decks, short skis, and advanced skis.
곤지암스키장 인근에 위치한 곤지암렌탈샵 아이원입니다. 저희는 무작정 저렴.zh: 这是位于昆池岩滑雪场附近的昆池岩租赁店I-One。我们的目标是以合理的价格租用优质的产品，而不是一味的低价。  您不仅可以租用滑雪板/滑雪板和服装，还可以租用手套、头盔、护具和护目镜。 该空间经过精心配置，可实现最大效率，因此您可以在约 80 坪的空间内快速租用设备和衣物。更衣室经过扩建和改建，使用更加整洁，店前设有可停放20多辆汽车的停车场。  我们还拥有各种设备，包括按钮踩板、直排滑雪板、锤板、短滑雪板和高级滑雪板。

곤지암렌탈샵 장비좋은집은 곤지암리조트 스키장과 가장 가까운 거리에 위치해.en: Konjiam Rental Shop Equipment Good House is located closest to the Konjiam Resort Ski Resort, making it convenient to use from rental to return. It is updated every year with the latest clothing and equipment, and is fully equipped with equipment suitable for all levels, from beginners to advanced. Thanks to the spacious and comfortable store environment, a big advantage is that even if you visit without a reservation, you can rent right away without waiting. In particular, we provide thorough assistance in setting up equipment so that beginners can enjoy skiing safely and happily.
곤지암렌탈샵 장비좋은집은 곤지암리조트 스키장과 가장 가까운 거리에 위치해.zh: 昆池岩租赁店设备 Good House 距离昆池岩度假村滑雪场最近，从租赁到归还都很方便。它每年都会更新最新的服装和装备，并且配备了适合从初学者到高级的各个级别的装备。得益于宽敞舒适的店内环境，一大优点是即使没有预约来访，也可以立即租用，无需等待。特别是我们为初学者提供全面的装备设置帮助，让他们能够安全、快乐地享受滑雪的乐趣。

곤지암리조트 스키장은 서울에서 40분 거리에 있는 수도권 최대 규모의 프.en: Konjiam Resort Ski Resort is the largest premium ski resort in the metropolitan area, located 40 minutes from Seoul. It is equipped with top-level facilities such as a total of 8 wide slopes, high-speed lifts, and cutting-edge snow removal systems, and provides differentiated ski services such as Korea's first 'part-time lift ticket', 'slope quota system', and 'ski mobile quick pass' to provide a more comfortable and premium ski life. In addition, there is a ‘panoramic slope’ that beginners and intermediate skiers can use from the top, so they can experience longer and more thrilling skiing. In addition, it brings joy by introducing content that allows people of all ages and genders to enjoy representative winter leisure sports in a more diverse way, such as premium ski lessons, the ‘fun slope’ loved by many skiers, the ‘large photo zone’ in the clock tower plaza, and the ‘snow sledding slope’.
곤지암리조트 스키장은 서울에서 40분 거리에 있는 수도권 최대 규모의 프.zh: 昆池岩度假村滑雪场是首都圈最大的高级滑雪场，距首尔 40 分钟路程。配备共8条宽阔雪道、高速缆车、尖端除雪系统等顶级设施，并提供韩国首创的“兼职缆车票”、“滑雪道配额制”、“滑雪移动快速通行证”等差异化滑雪服务，提供更舒适、更优质的滑雪生活。此外，这里还设有“全景坡道”，初级和中级滑雪者可以从上面使用，这样他们就可以体验更长、更惊险的滑雪体验。此外，还引入了优质滑雪课程、深受滑雪爱好者喜爱的“欢乐坡”、钟楼广场的“大片拍照区”、“雪橇坡”等让各个年龄段、不同性别的人们以更多样化的方式享受代表性冬季休闲运动的内容，带来欢乐。

공릉천이 시작되는 곳은 덕양구 고양동, 신도동과 양주시 장흥면의 경계선이.en: The place where Gongneungcheon begins is the boundary between Goyang-dong and Sindo-dong in Deokyang-gu and Jangheung-myeon in Yangju-si, and passes through Gwansan-dong, Sarihyeon-dong, and Jiyeong-dong before meeting the Han River at Gyoha-myeon in Paju-si. (Total length 30.5km). It is called Gongneungcheon, named after Gongneung, located in Samneung, Paju. The surrounding sedimentary plains are used as flower complexes and rice fields. It is a river that flows through Yangju-si, Goyang-si, and Paju-si, Gyeonggi-do and is the first tributary of the Han River. If you walk along the sound of the powerful running water of Gongneungcheon, you can easily encounter winter migratory birds such as egrets and flocks of geese, as well as natural monuments such as mandarin ducks and ducks.
공릉천이 시작되는 곳은 덕양구 고양동, 신도동과 양주시 장흥면의 경계선이.zh: 孔陵川的起点是德阳区高阳洞、新岛洞和杨州市长兴面的交界处，经过冠山洞、沙里县洞、知营洞，在坡州市交河面与汉江汇合。 （全长30.5公里）。位于坡州三陵的孔陵川因孔陵而得名。周围的沉积平原被用作花卉园和稻田。流经京畿道杨州市、高阳市、坡州市的河流，是汉江的第一支流。沿着孔陵川强劲的流水声漫步，很容易会遇到白鹭、大雁等冬季候鸟，以及鸳鸯、野鸭等天然纪念物。

가평에서 생산되는 쌀, 포도 등 지역 농산물을 활용하여 맥주, 탁주, 증.en: It is the first alcohol culture complex in the country to manufacture a variety of alcoholic beverages such as beer, rice wine, distilled liquor, and fruit wine using local agricultural products such as rice and grapes produced in Gapyeong, and to provide education, exhibition, and tasting spaces. We operate a variety of one-day experience programs such as makgeolli, distilled liquor, bangsho, mother liquor, and making alcohol bread, and when touring the brewery, you can sample alcoholic beverages produced directly at Suljium.
가평에서 생산되는 쌀, 포도 등 지역 농산물을 활용하여 맥주, 탁주, 증.zh: 它是韩国第一个酒精文化综合体，使用加平生产的大米和葡萄等当地农产品生产啤酒、米酒、蒸馏酒和果酒等多种酒精饮料，并提供教育、展览和品尝空间。 我们运营马格利酒、蒸馏酒、房酒、母酒、酒精面包制作等各种一日体验项目，在参观啤酒厂时，您可以品尝直接在Suljium生产的酒精饮料。

공산성은 백제시대의 대표적인 성곽으로 백제의 수도가 공주였을 때 공주를.en: Gongsanseong Fortress is a representative castle of the Baekje period and is a fortress of Baekje that protected Gongju when the capital of Baekje was Gongju. It was the capital of Baekje until the capital was moved to Buyeo in the 16th year of King Seong's reign (538), and was the center of local administration until the Joseon Dynasty, making it an important relic of great historical value. It is a valley-shaped mountain fortress surrounding the valley of a hillside along the Geumgang River. It was originally an earthen fortress, but was remodeled into a stone fortress during the Joseon Dynasty. The date of its construction is not exact, and it was called Ungjinseong Fortress during the Baekje period, Gongjusanseong Fortress or Gongsanseong Fortress during the Goryeo Dynasty, and Ssangsusanseong Fortress after King Injo took refuge during the Yi Gwal Rebellion (1623) during the Joseon Dynasty. Immediately after the fall of Baekje, King Uija stayed here for a while, and it was also a base for the Baekje revival movement. During the Unified Silla period, Kim Heon-chang's Rebellion (822) occurred. It is rectangular in shape, about 800m from east to west and 400m from north to south. Gate sites can be found in four rooms, with Jinnamru, the south gate, and Gongbukru, the north gate, remaining. Only the ruins of the east and west gates remained, and in 993, Yeongdongru was restored on the east gate site, and Geumseoru was restored on the west gate site. Defense facilities such as Ammun, Chiseong, Godae, Jangdae, and Sugumun remain, and within the fortress are Ssangsujeong, Yeongeunsa, Yeonji, Imryugakji, and Manharuji. In addition, many relics, including lotus-patterned roof tiles, Baekje tiles, and pottery, as well as relics from the Goryeo and Joseon periods, were excavated. If you walk along the fortress wall, you can see the city of Gongju at a glance. During the Baekje Cultural Festival, you can cross the bridge from in front of Gongsanseong Fortress to Geumgang New Government Park. At Geumseoru, you can see the majesty of the Baekje Kingdom through the ‘Woongjinseong Guard Changing Ceremony’, and at Geumgang New Building Park, you can enjoy the beautiful night scenery of Gongsanseong Fortress.
공산성은 백제시대의 대표적인 성곽으로 백제의 수도가 공주였을 때 공주를.zh: 公山城是百济时代的代表性城堡，是百济定都公州时守护公州的百济城池。成王十六年（538年）迁都扶余之前一直是百济的都城，到朝鲜王朝为止一直是地方行政中心，是具有重要历史价值的重要遗迹。它是一个山谷形状的山城，环绕着锦江沿岸的山坡山谷。它原本是一座土城，但在朝鲜时代被改建为石城。建造年代不详，百济时期称为熊津城，高丽时期称为公州山城或公山城，朝鲜李果之乱（1623年）仁祖避难后称为双水山城。百济灭亡后，义子王曾在此短暂停留，这里也是百济复兴运动的根据地。统一新罗时期，发生了金宪昌之乱（822年）。呈长方形，东西长约800m，南北长约400m。门址共四室，仅存南门、北门工北楼。仅存东西门遗址，993年在东门址恢复永同楼，在西门址恢复金西楼。城内保留有岩门、漆城、古台、将台、水谷门等防御设施，城内有双水亭、灵恩寺、莲池、林柳岳支、万春寺等。此外，还出土了莲花瓦、百济瓦、陶器等高丽、朝鲜时期的文物。沿着城墙行走，公州城尽收眼底。百济文化节期间，可以从公山城前过桥前往锦江新政府公园。在金西楼可以通过“熊津城卫换岗仪式”一睹百济王国的威严，在锦江新城公园可以欣赏公山城美丽的夜景。

사적 공주 무령왕릉과 왕릉원은 백제 웅진시기(475~538년) 왕들의 무.en: The Royal Tomb of King Muryeong and Wangneungwon, a historic site, are a collection of tombs of kings from the Ungjin period (475-538) of Baekje. There are a total of seven tombs in this area, including the tomb of King Muryeong, and they are located on the southern hillside of the Geumgang River. Across the valley, to the west are King Muryeong's tomb and tombs No. 5 and No. 6, and to the northeast are tombs No. 1 to 4. Tombs 1 to 6 were investigated during the Japanese colonial period, revealing the structure and form of the tombs, and King Muryeong's tomb was discovered during the repair work of tombs 5 and 6 in 1971. Tombs 1 to 5 are cave-type tombs made of stone, a representative tomb style of Baekje, while Tomb 6 and the tomb of King Muryeong are brick tombs, a tomb style that was widely popular in China at the time. The brick tomb is a new type of tomb that has never been seen before in Baekje, and is evidence of Baekje's active exchanges with the Southern Liang Dynasty of China. In particular, stone masonry and ceramics influenced by China, wooden coffins made of Japanese gold pine, and accessories symbolizing exchanges with Thailand and India were discovered in King Muryeong's tomb, providing a glimpse into Baekje's high-level international cultural exchange capabilities.
사적 공주 무령왕릉과 왕릉원은 백제 웅진시기(475~538년) 왕들의 무.zh: 武宁王陵和古迹王陵苑是百济熊津时代（475-538）王陵的集合体。包括武宁王陵在内，这一地区共有七座古墓，位于锦江南侧的山坡上。穿过山谷，西面是武宁王陵及5号、6号陵墓，东北面是1号至4号陵墓。1号至6号陵墓是日本殖民时期调查的，揭示了陵墓的结构和形态，1971年在修复5号和6号陵墓时发现了武宁王陵。1号至5号陵墓是百济的代表性墓葬形式为石穴式墓葬，六号墓和武宁王墓为砖墓，是当时在中国广泛流行的墓葬形式。砖墓是百济从未见过的新型墓葬，是百济与中国南梁积极交往的证据。特别是在武宁王墓中发现了受中国影响的石砖和陶瓷、日本金松制成的木棺以及象征着与泰国、印度交流的装饰品，展示了百济高水平的国际文化交流能力。

과천문화원은 과천지역의 향토문화 창달과 전통문화를 발굴하고 전승, 보존해.en: The Gwacheon Cultural Center is a place that discovers, transmits, and preserves the local culture and traditional culture of the Gwacheon region, and conducts various cultural events and social education programs for Gwacheon residents. In addition, it manages cultural assets in the Gwacheon area, studies local history, opens a cultural school, a history and culture academy, and an experience sharing school to run various programs and hold cultural events. In the cultural school, there are gayageum classes, knot classes, literary painting classes, and samulnori classes, and in the experience schools, there are village miscellaneous activities, imaginative design activities, and walks. In addition, the Gwacheon Cultural Center hosts the Korean Chusa Calligraphy Exhibition and the Invitational Calligraphy Artist Exhibition. The cultural center has a reference room on the first basement floor, a part-time child care facility and an outdoor performance hall on the first floor, a local history center, a library, an open rest area, and a storage room on the second floor, and a garden and rooftop hall on the rooftop. Gwacheon Cultural Center's living culture center has an open space, a wind music hall, a soundproof practice room, a dance practice room, an audiovisual learning room, a meeting space, and a face-to-face space.
과천문화원은 과천지역의 향토문화 창달과 전통문화를 발굴하고 전승, 보존해.zh: 果川文化馆是发现、传播、保存果川地区的乡土文化和传统文化，为果川居民开展各种文化活动和社会教育活动的场所。此外，还管理果川地区的文化资产，研究当地历史，开设文化学校、历史文化学院和经验分享学校，运营各种项目和举办文化活动。文化学校有伽倻琴班、结语班、文学绘画班、四物游戏班，体验学校有村杂活动、想象设计活动、散步等。此外，果川文化中心还举办韩国秋史书法展和书法艺术家邀请展。文化中心地下一层设有资料室，一层设有兼职托儿设施和户外表演厅，二层设有当地历史中心、图书馆、开放式休息区和储藏室，屋顶设有花园和屋顶大厅。果川文化中心的生活文化中心设有开放空间、管乐厅、隔音练习室、舞蹈练习室、视听学习室、会议空间、面对面空间。

과천시민회관은 수도권 지하철 4호선 정부과천청사역 10번 출구에서 135.en: Gwacheon Citizens' Center is a cultural and artistic performance hall located 135 meters away from Exit 10 of Gwacheon Government Complex Station on Seoul Metropolitan Subway Line 4. Befitting its reputation as the most livable city in the country, it boasts a beautiful and magnificent appearance in harmony with the natural scenery. It is a cultural, artistic, and sports complex cultural facility that opened on October 7, 1995. It is equipped with major facilities such as a large theater (929 seats), a small theater (380 seats), an outdoor performance hall, a gym, a bowling alley, a swimming pool, an ice rink, an indoor golf course, and a gymnasium, as well as auxiliary facilities such as a green shop, seminar room, conference room, and ice equipment store. In addition to cultural and artistic performances, there are various programs such as Taekwondo, yoga, aerobics, and ballet that help citizens enjoy leisure activities and improve the quality of life.
과천시민회관은 수도권 지하철 4호선 정부과천청사역 10번 출구에서 135.zh: 果川市民中心是位于首尔地铁4号线果川政府大楼站10号出口135米处的文化艺术表演厅。果川市民中心拥有韩国最宜居城市的美誉，拥有与自然风光融为一体的美丽而宏伟的外观。它是一座文化、艺术、体育综合性文化设施，于1995年10月7日开业。设有大剧场（929座）、小剧场（380座）、室外表演厅、健身房、保龄球馆、游泳池、溜冰场、室内高尔夫球场、体育馆等主要设施，以及绿地店、研讨室、会议室、冰上器材店等辅助设施。除文化艺术表演外，还有跆拳道、瑜伽、健美操、芭蕾舞等丰富多彩的节目，帮助市民享受休闲活动，提高生活质量。

광교산은 수원의 북쪽에서 오는 찬바람을 막아주며 시가지를 품에 안고 있는.en: Gwanggyosan Mountain is the main mountain of Suwon, protecting the city from the cold winds coming from the north of Suwon. Its original name was Gwangaksan Mountain, but it is said that it was renamed Gwanggyosan Mountain by King Taejo of the Goryeo Dynasty. Gwanggyosan Mountain is a mountain that stretches approximately 2km north to south between the Gyeongbu Expressway and the Seoul-Suwon road and is located in Sanggwanggyo-dong, Suwon-si. The ridge of the mountain is very quiet and gentle, and there are thick trees in between, making it a place where you can enjoy forest bathing or a day hike in peace. Since ancient times, Gwanggyosan Mountain has been called one of the eight scenic views of Suwon, and the beauty of the scenery of snow falling on Gwanggyosan Mountain and piled up on the trees, called Gwanggyojeokseol (光敎積雪), was selected as the first among the eight scenic spots. Until 1994, entry to the mountain was completely restricted in the fall (1 month) and spring (3 months) due to concerns about forest fires, but since the fall of 1995, it has been open year-round to provide residents with a rest area and expand opportunities for leisure use. In order to allow the forest environment to recover damaged hiking trails and natural scenery, the Gwanggyosan Mountain Rest Year System has been implemented in stages every three years since February 1, 2003.* Area 847ha, 582m above sea level (Sirubong)
광교산은 수원의 북쪽에서 오는 찬바람을 막아주며 시가지를 품에 안고 있는.zh: 光教山是水原市的主山，保护城市免受来自水原市北部的寒风的侵袭。原名光岳山，据说高丽太祖将其改名为光教山。光教山是位于京釜高速公路和首尔水原公路之间南北长约2公里的山，位于水原市上光教洞。山脊十分幽静平缓，山间树木茂密，是您可以安心享受森林浴或一日徒步的地方。光教山自古以来被称为水原八景之一，而光教山上的雪花落在树上的美丽景色，被称为光敎积雪，被选为水原八景之首。直到1994年，由于担心森林火灾，秋季（1个月）和春季（3个月）完全限制进山，但自1995年秋季起，全年开放，为居民提供休息场所，扩大休闲利用机会。为了让森林环境恢复受损的登山步道和自然景观，自2003年2月1日起，每三年分阶段实施光教山休养年制度。 * 面积847ha，海拔582m（诗鲁峰）

1912년 일제가 자원수탈을 목적으로 개발을 시작한 광명동굴(구. 시흥광.en: Gwangmyeong Cave (formerly Siheung Mine), which the Japanese began developing in 1912 for the purpose of resource exploitation, was the site of conscription and exploitation during the Japanese colonial period and is an industrial heritage that retains traces of modernization and industrialization after liberation. Gwangmyeong Cave, which was used as a salted shrimp warehouse for 40 years after the mine was closed in 1972, was purchased by Gwangmyeong City in 2011 and transformed into a historical and cultural tourist attraction. Gwangmyeong Cave is evaluated as the best cave theme park in Korea that combines industrial heritage value and cultural value, and has achieved the miracle of an abandoned mine that surprised the world with more than 1 million tourists visiting each year. (Source: Gwangmyeong Cave website) ◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave - In the entertainment show <2 Days of Stone> and <Le Seraphim>, Le Seraphim members Chaewon, Yunjin, and Eunchae set out to complete a mission. This is the place I found. Gwangmyeong Cave, known as the best cave theme park in Korea, began development in 1912, and in 1972, Gwangmyeong City purchased the abandoned mine and transformed it into a tourist attraction.
1912년 일제가 자원수탈을 목적으로 개발을 시작한 광명동굴(구. 시흥광.zh: 光明洞窟（原始兴矿山）是日本人以资源开发为目的于1912年开始开发的，是日本殖民时期的征兵和剥削场所，也是解放后保留着现代化和工业化痕迹的工业遗产。光明洞窟在1972年矿山关闭后，曾作为盐虾仓库使用了40年，2011年被光明市收购，改造成历史文化旅游景点。光明洞窟被评价为韩国最优秀的兼具工业遗产价值和文化价值的洞穴主题公园，实现了每年超过100万游客参观的废弃矿山奇迹，令世界惊叹不已。 （出处：光明洞窟网站） ◎ 遇见韩流魅力的旅行信息 - 在综艺节目《石头的2天》和《六翼天使》中，六翼天使成员彩元、云珍、恩彩出发去完成任务。这是我找到的地方。被誉为韩国最好的洞穴主题公园的光明洞窟于1912年开始开发，1972年光明市购买了废弃矿山并将其改造成旅游景点。

광명문화원은 1992년 전통문화계승 보존과 지역문화 개발을 목적으로 설립.en: Gwangmyeong Cultural Center was established in 1992 for the purpose of preserving traditional culture and developing local culture. We are contributing to cultivating citizens' cultural sensitivity and developing local culture by researching and disseminating local history, holding local cultural events, and researching and disseminating cultural and artistic programs. Children's culture school and adult culture school run programs such as violin, ballet class, pungmul class, calligraphy, Four Gentlemen, Gyeonggi folk songs, adult pansori, and Korean painting. The field trip program, conducted in connection with our hometown Gwangmyeong, is a cultural education program for young students who are starting to learn about the local community for the first time by directly visiting Gwangmyeong's local historical sites and cultural facilities to properly know and learn about the local history and culture, thereby fostering pride and local awareness as Gwangmyeong citizens. The Ori Cultural Festival has been held every year since 1992 to honor the local great man, Ori Lee Won-ik, and to foster pride in the hometown and local culture.
광명문화원은 1992년 전통문화계승 보존과 지역문화 개발을 목적으로 설립.zh: 光明文化院成立于1992年，旨在保护传统文化和发展地方文化。我们通过研究和传播当地历史、举办当地文化活动、研究和传播文化艺术项目，为培养公民的文化敏感性和发展当地文化做出贡献。儿童文化学校和成人文化学校开设有小提琴、芭蕾舞班、风物班、书法、四君子、京畿民歌、成人板索里、韩国画等项目。这次针对家乡光明开展的实地考察活动，是针对初次接触当地社会的年轻学生的文化教育项目，通过直接参观光明当地的历史遗迹和文化设施，正确认识和了解当地的历史和文化，从而培养作为光明市民的自豪感和地方意识。自1992年以来，每年都会举办乌里文化节，以纪念当地伟人乌里李元益，并培养对家乡和当地文化的自豪感。

광명 업사이클 아트센터는 업사이클 (버려진 물건에 예술적 가치를 더해 새.en: Gwangmyeong Upcycle Art Center is a complex art space where exhibitions, design education, and events are held under the theme of upcycling (adding artistic value to discarded items to create new works or products). Gwangmyeong Upcycle Art Center is the first upcycling hub in Korea, and is continuously conducting support projects, exhibitions, experiential education programs, contests, and performances to spread good art that does not end with one-time consumption but is practiced by creating other uses and values.
광명 업사이클 아트센터는 업사이클 (버려진 물건에 예술적 가치를 더해 새.zh: 光明升级再造艺术中心是一个以升级再造（为废弃物品添加艺术价值以创造新作品或产品）为主题举办展览、设计教育和活动的综合艺术空间。光明升级再造艺术中心是韩国第一个升级再造中心，不断开展支持项目、展览、体验式教育计划、竞赛和表演，以传播良好的艺术，这些艺术不只是一次性消费，而是通过创造其他用途和价值来实践。

광안리해수욕장은 부산 수영구에 위치한 아름다운 해변이다. 맑고 푸른 바다.en: Gwangalli Beach is a beautiful beach located in Suyeong-gu, Busan. Featuring clear blue sea and fine sand, it is a popular attraction visited by many tourists during the summer. In particular, the scenery of Gwangan Bridge and the sea is beautiful, making it a famous night view spot. In addition to swimming in the sea, you can enjoy a variety of marine sports, and there are cafes and restaurants nearby, so you can spend a leisurely time enjoying delicious food. In addition, it is close to the city center and has excellent accessibility, making it a highly recommended place for travelers visiting Busan. Thanks to its variety of things to enjoy and convenient transportation, it is a tourist destination suitable for families, friends, and lovers alike.
광안리해수욕장은 부산 수영구에 위치한 아름다운 해변이다. 맑고 푸른 바다.zh: 广安里海水浴场是位于釜山水营区的美丽海水浴场。这里拥有清澈碧蓝的海水和细腻的沙滩，是夏季游客众多的热门景点。尤其是广安大桥和大海的景色非常美丽，是著名的夜景景点。除了在海里游泳之外，还可以享受各种海上运动，附近还有咖啡馆和餐馆，可以享受美味佳肴，度过悠闲的时光。此外，它靠近市中心，交通便利，是到访釜山的旅客强烈推荐的地方。丰富多彩的旅游项目和便捷的交通，是适合家庭、朋友、情侣的旅游胜地。

양동시장은 광주 서구에 위치한 전통재래시장으로 전남에서 규모가 가장 크다.en: Yangdong Market is a traditional market located in the western part of Gwangju and is the largest in Jeonnam. The origin of Yangdong Market is said to be a market held on the 2nd and 7th of every month on the white sandy beach under Gwangju Bridge in the 1910s. Yangdong Market is known as ‘the kitchen of Gwangju, the market with big hands’ to the citizens of Gwangju as it is filled with a wide variety of products and has an abundance of food, so much so that it is called ‘a symbol of generous people.’ People still say that you have to go to Yangdong Market to buy skates as it is the birthplace of holiday preparations, and Yangdong Market’s specialty, 『Yangdong Chicken』, which has often appeared in the media, can only be tasted here at Yangdong Market. It is a delicacy. In addition, during the May 18 Democratization Movement, Yangdong Market and Daein Market were places where Gwangju citizens demonstrated the spirit of unity and unity. At that time, merchants supported and encouraged the militia by providing them with rice balls, drinks, and medicine. As traditional markets began to decline due to the development of the distribution industry, Yangdong Market also began modernizing its facilities. We successfully carried out management modernization projects such as an integrated logo project, building an online shopping mall, and opening a merchant college, and it was clean and clear enough to win the grand prize for traditional market remodeling at the 『National Excellent Market Fair』, making it a space where you can shop without any problems wherever you go. In addition, Yangdong Traditional Market’s love for the region continues to this day. Yangdong Cheonwon Guksi, which provides lunch for the elderly at an affordable price, and Cafe ‘Moreless’ in River Market 276, which will be a dream creative center for disabled barista trainees, run experience programs such as cooking, crafts, and zero waste. The top 3 foods at Yangdong Market are Yangdong Chicken vs. Sunil Chicken, Yangdong Cheonwon Chicken, and lettuce fries. Nearby are the Yangnim History and Culture Village, the National Asia Culture Center, and the May 18 Memorial Park.
양동시장은 광주 서구에 위치한 전통재래시장으로 전남에서 규모가 가장 크다.zh: 良东市场是位于光州西部的传统市场，也是全罗南道最大的市场。良东市场的起源据说是1910年代在光州大桥下的白色沙滩上每月2号和7号举行的市场。良东市场被光州市民称为“光州的厨房、大手市场”，物产丰富，食物丰富，被称为“大方的象征”。至今人们还说，买溜冰鞋一定要去良东市场，因为这里是节日准备的发源地，而经常出现在媒体上的良东市场特产“良东鸡”，也只有在这里才能品尝到。阳东市场。这是一道美味佳肴。此外，5月18日民主化运动期间，良东市场和大仁市场是光州市民展现团结团结精神的场所。当时，商人为民兵提供饭团、饮料和药品来支持和鼓励他们。随着流通业的发展，传统市场开始衰落，阳东市场也开始对其设施进行现代化改造。成功实施了综合标识工程、建设网上商城、开办商学院等管理现代化项目，干净整洁，荣获『全国优秀市场博览会』传统市场改造大奖，成为了走到哪里都可以放心购物的空间。此外，阳东传统市场对该地区的热爱至今仍在延续。以实惠的价格为老年人提供午餐的阳东天元国际餐厅，以及将成为残疾咖啡师实习生的梦想创意中心的 River Market 276 咖啡馆“Moreless”，举办烹饪、手工和零浪费等体验项目。良东市场排名前三的美食是良东鸡VS苏尼尔鸡、良东千元鸡和生菜薯条。附近有阳林历史文化村、亚洲国家文化中心、5 月 18 日纪念公园。

광한루원은 전라북도 남원시에 있는 조선 전기에 조성된 광한루의 정원이다..en: Gwanghalluwon is the garden of Gwanghallu Pavilion, which was created in the early Joseon Dynasty in Namwon-si, Jeollabuk-do. In the city near Namwon Station, there is Gwanghallu Pavilion, where Chunhyang and Lee Doryeong met, and the garden where Gwanghallu Pavilion is located is collectively called Gwanghalluwon. To the north of Nuwon, Gyoryongsan Mountain stands tall, to the south is Geumambong Peak, which is said to be as precious as a gold bar, and Jiri Mountain can be seen in the distance. Gwanghalluwon is the best pavilion in Korea that expresses a distant view of the universe, with Gwanghallu, symbolizing the Moon Palace, and Samsinsan Mountain, paradise on earth, on the edge of a pond symbolizing the Milky Way. It is one of the four major pavilions in Korea, along with Gyeonghoeru, Chokseokru, and Bubyeokru. Inside Gwanghalluwon, there are Gwanghallu, Ojakgyo, Wanwoljeong, Yeongjugak, Chunhyanggwan, Chunhyang Shrine, and Wolmae House. In addition, there are craft shops, There are auxiliary facilities such as a cafe. Lotus flowers, symbolizing paradise on earth, were planted in the lotus pond, and Ojakgyo Bridge, the bridge of love, where Gyeonwoo and Jiknyeo were unable to meet because they were blocked by the Milky Way, met once on July 7th, was installed over the pond. This stone bridge has four rainbow-shaped holes that allow water to flow on both sides, and is the most representative bridge in Korean gardens. At Chunhyang Shrine, a portrait of Chunhyang painted by artist Kim Eun-ho is enshrined. Every year, the Chunhyang Festival is held on Dano Day, May 5th of the lunar calendar.◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave This is a place where the palace where the Jade Emperor of Heaven lives in the legend is recreated on earth, and is a representative traditional pavilion in Korea. It is the filming location of various dramas such as <Woldam of Youth>, <Shurup>, and <The Joseon Lawyer>, and is the setting of <Chunhyangjeon>, a classic novel known to all Koreans, so Gwanghalluwon has long been the setting for a story that has dominated an era. I highly recommend taking a stroll around Gwanghallu Pavilion, one of the four major pavilions in Korea, and Ojakgyo Bridge of Love.
광한루원은 전라북도 남원시에 있는 조선 전기에 조성된 광한루의 정원이다..zh: 光汉楼院是朝鲜初期创建于全罗北道南原市的光汉楼的庭园。在南原站附近的城市里，有春香和李道宁相遇的光汉楼，光汉楼所在的花园统称为光汉楼院。牛原的北边是高耸的校龙山，南边是据说金条般珍贵的金万峰，远处可以看到智异山。广寒楼是韩国最能表达宇宙远景的凉亭，广寒楼象征着月宫，三信山位于象征银河的池塘边，是人间天堂。与庆会楼、竹石楼、佛碧楼并称韩国四大展馆之一。光汉楼院内有光汉楼、乌雀桥、月月亭、灵州阁、春香馆、春香神社、月梅屋等。此外，还有工艺品店、咖啡厅等辅助设施。荷花池中种植了象征人间天堂的莲花，荷花池上方还架设了因被银河阻挡而未能相见的贤宇和直女于7月7日相遇的爱情桥“乌雀桥”。这座石桥有四个彩虹形的孔，可以让水从两边流过，是韩国园林中最具代表性的桥。春香神社供奉着画家金恩浩绘制的春香肖像。每年农历5月5日端午节都会举办春香节。◎ 邂逅韩流魅力的旅游信息 这里是在人间重现传说中玉皇大帝居住的宫殿的地方，是韩国具有代表性的传统亭阁。这里是《青春月潭》、《书鲁》、《朝鲜律师》等多部电视剧的拍摄地，也是韩国人都知道的经典小说《春香传》的拍摄地，所以光汉路院自古以来就是一个统治一个时代的故事的发生地。强烈推荐去韩国四大展馆之一的光汉楼和乌雀桥逛逛。

대룡시장은 6·25 때 황해도 연백군에서 교동도로 잠시 피난 온 주민들이.en: Daeryong Market is an alley market that recreates the appearance of Yeonbaek Market in their hometown to make a living for residents who temporarily fled from Yeonbaek-gun, Hwanghae-do to Gyodong-do during the Korean War, to make a living as the Han River Estuary became a dividing line and they were unable to return to their hometown. Gyodong-do was the center of economic development for about 50 years, but now most of the displaced elders who created the market have passed away and the population has rapidly decreased, leading to a significant decrease in the size of the market. However, with the opening of Gyodong Bridge in July 2014, Daeryong Market, which looks like a 1960s movie set, has become a must-see for tourists to take pictures. Gyodong Giga Island (aka ‘Gyodong Bird’s Nest’) has been in operation since the end of March. Gyodong Bird’s Nest provides tourists with IT-based tourist information as well as bicycle and smartwatch rental services and various experience programs such as ‘VR video experience’ and ‘creating a Gyodong newspaper’.
대룡시장은 6·25 때 황해도 연백군에서 교동도로 잠시 피난 온 주민들이.zh: 大龙市场是朝鲜战争期间，因汉江口成为分界线而无法返回家乡而暂时从黄海道延白郡逃往桥洞岛的居民们为了谋生而建造的，再现故乡延白市场面貌的胡同市场。校洞岛在大约50年的时间里一直是经济发展的中心，但现在创建市场的流离失所的老人大部分已经去世，人口迅速减少，导致市场规模大幅缩小。然而，随着2014年7月桥洞大桥的通车，看起来像1960年代电影外景地的大龙市场成为了游客拍照的必去之地。校洞千兆岛（又名“校洞鸟巢”）自三月底开始运营。校洞鸟巢为游客提供基于IT的旅游信息、自行车和智能手表租赁服务以及“VR视频体验”和“制作校洞报纸”等各种体验项目。

이른 봄 노란 산수유 꽃이 시들어지는 무렵 청정 하천인 섬진강변과 어울리.en: In early spring, when the yellow Cornus officinalis flowers are withering, white cherry blossoms, matching the clean riverside of the Seomjingang River, are in full bloom. This place, where the Seomjingang Riverside Cherry Blossom Festival is held, has been established since 1992, and white cherry blossoms are in full bloom along the riverside along National Highways 17 and 19, which connect Gokseong to Hadong. You can experience a wonderful drive while feeling the scent of spring, and it is also in the spotlight as an optimal marathon course. It is also a famous flower spot where the Gurye 300-ri Cherry Blossom Festival is held every March.
이른 봄 노란 산수유 꽃이 시들어지는 무렵 청정 하천인 섬진강변과 어울리.zh: 初春时节，黄色的山茱萸花谢了，白色的樱花盛开，与干净的蟾津江河岸相映成趣。这里是1992年举办蟾津江樱花节的地方，连接谷城和河东的17号国道和19号国道沿线的河边，白色的樱花盛开。您可以一边感受春天的气息，一边体验美妙的驾驶体验，这里也作为最佳马拉松赛道而备受瞩目。这里还是著名的赏花胜地，每年 3 月都会举办求礼三百里樱花节。

신라 문무왕 8년(668년)에 의상대사가 창건한 사찰로 대웅전 자리에 9.en: This temple was founded by Master Uisang in the 8th year of King Munmu of Silla (668). The pond where nine dragons lived was filled in at the site of the main hall and the temple was founded and called Guryongsa Temple. However, it is said that it was renamed to its current name, Guryongsa Temple, in connection with the turtle rock legend in the mid-Joseon Dynasty. Also, according to the 'Chiaksan Guryongsa Historic Site', it is recorded that it was founded by Doseonguksa, a high monk of the late Silla Dynasty. Currently, a roof tile engraved with letters from the 45th year of Kangxi's reign has been excavated, showing that Guryongsa Temple was rebuilt in the 32nd year of King Sukjong's reign (1706). To the left and right in front of the main hall are Seosangwon, Bogwangnu, Jeokmukdang, and Simgeomdang's temples, as well as Wontongmun, Guksadan, Four Heavenly Kings' Gate, Beomjonggak, and Eungjinjeon. At the entrance to the temple, there is a stupa built during the Joseon Dynasty, and there is also a turtle rock that tells the legend of Guryongsa Temple and a Yongso under the waterfall. There is also a Hwangjanggeum sign made during the Joseon Dynasty, which prohibits unauthorized logging of pine forests around Chiaksan Mountain.
신라 문무왕 8년(668년)에 의상대사가 창건한 사찰로 대웅전 자리에 9.zh: 该寺是新罗文武王8年（668年）由义相大师创建的。九龙居住的池塘被填平在正殿遗址上，并建立了寺庙，称为九龙寺。不过，据说是因朝鲜中期的龟岩传说而更名为现在的龟龙寺。另外，据《雉岳山九龙寺史迹》记载，该寺是新罗末期高僧道圣国寺创建的。目前，还出土了刻有康熙45年文字的瓦片，表明九龙寺是在肃宗32年（1706年）重建的。正殿前左右两侧有西上院、普光楼、极目堂、深鉴堂，还有圆通门、国师坛、四大天王门、凡宗阁、应真殿。寺庙入口处有一座朝鲜时期建造的佛塔，还有讲述九龙寺传说的龟岩和瀑布下的龙沼。朝鲜时代还立有黄章琴，禁止擅自砍伐雉岳山周围的松林。

구름산 내에 위치한 산림욕장은 높이 20m가량의 나무숲으로 울창하게 조성.en: The forest bathing area located within Cloud Mountain is densely formed with a forest of trees about 20 meters high. The main facilities include a comprehensive play facility, a stream crossing, a flat bench, and benches, and it has the highest phytoncide concentration among the 13 forest bathing areas in Gyeonggi-do. With 356 fir trees planted and a 184m red clay trail created, it is gaining attention as a healing space that helps citizens and tourists relax, as they can experience the hiking trail barefoot. In particular, most of the forest paths connecting every corner of the forest bathing area are covered with wood chips, making it easy to walk.
구름산 내에 위치한 산림욕장은 높이 20m가량의 나무숲으로 울창하게 조성.zh: 云山森林浴区树木茂密，高约20米。主要设施有综合游乐设施、溪流渡口、平凳、长椅等，是京畿道13个森林浴场中芬多精浓度最高的。种植了356棵杉树，修建了184m的红土步道，作为可以赤脚体验登山步道、帮助市民和游客放松身心的治愈空间而受到关注。尤其是连接森林浴区各个角落的林间小道大多铺满了木片，行走起来十分方便。

구리 왕숙체육공원은 시민의 휴식과 체력 증진을 위하여 조성된 공원으로,.en: Guri Wangsuk Sports Park is a park created for citizens to rest and improve their physical strength. It is a complex sports and cultural space equipped with various exercise equipment and facilities such as soccer fields, tennis courts, and futsal courts. Originally a landfill, the site was stabilized for about 10 years. After 10 years of stabilization, 11.5 billion won was invested on a 57,479㎡ site to create sports park facilities and various auxiliary facilities to promote daily sports and utilize citizen leisure. In order to improve the basic physical strength of local residents, a sports park equipped with outdoor exercise equipment such as one artificial turf soccer field [6,262㎡], 17 tennis courts [11,027㎡], and one futsal field [800㎡], as well as convenience facilities such as walking trails, lighting fountains, sculptures, large green spaces, and concession stands, and rest areas have been created.
구리 왕숙체육공원은 시민의 휴식과 체력 증진을 위하여 조성된 공원으로,.zh: 九里王石体育公园是为了市民休息、增强体力而建的公园。是一个综合性的体育文化空间，配备有足球场、网球场、五人制足球场等各种健身器材和设施。该场地最初是一个垃圾填埋场，稳定了大约 10 年。经过10年的稳定，在57,479平方米的场地上投资了115亿韩元，建造了体育公园设施和各种辅助设施，以促进日常体育运动和利用公民休闲。为提高当地居民的基本体力，建设了体育公园，配备人造草坪足球场1个[6,262平方米]、网球场17个[11,027平方米]、五人制足球场[800平方米]等户外运动器材，以及步道、灯光喷泉、雕塑、大型绿地、小卖部、休息区等便民设施。

1991년 설립된 구리문화원은 지역의 문화와 예술을 증진하고, 지역 주민.en: Established in 1991, Guri Cultural Center promotes local culture and arts and provides a space where local residents can enjoy cultural life. Main facilities include an exhibition room, multiple classrooms for culture school classes, a main auditorium, a library, and a rooftop sky garden. The cultural school operated by the Guri Cultural Center was opened in September 1995 and is composed of programs centered on pure culture and arts rather than entertainment-oriented courses with the purpose of realizing the cultural welfare of Guri citizens. Cultural school programs include traditional classes such as Korean dance, daegeum, pungmul, gayageum, and calligraphy, as well as general classes in acoustic guitar, saxophone, essay, and drum. You can apply for classes through the cultural center website. In addition, local cultural events such as the Donggureung Cultural Festival, Guri Beolmaldari Stepping, and Galmae-dong Dodang Gut are held, and Guri Cultural Magazine is published every month, and local history excavations, surveys, and research, and historical materials are collected and preserved.
1991년 설립된 구리문화원은 지역의 문화와 예술을 증진하고, 지역 주민.zh: 九里文化馆成立于1991年，致力于弘扬当地文化艺术，为当地居民提供享受文化生活的空间。主要设施包括展览室、文化学校多间教室、主礼堂、图书馆和屋顶空中花园。九里文化中心运营的文化学校于1995年9月开办，以实现九里市民的文化福利为目的，以纯粹的文化艺术为中心，而非以娱乐为中心的课程。文化学校课程包括韩国舞蹈、大琴、风物、伽倻琴和书法等传统课程，以及原声吉他、萨克斯管、散文和鼓等普通课程。您可以通过文化中心网站申请课程。此外，还举办东九陵文化节、九里法马达里踏步、甲梅洞道堂祭等地方文化活动，每月出版九里文化杂志，收集、保存地方历史的发掘、调查、研究和史料。

구봉도는 안산시 단원구 대부북동에 있는 간척지로 연륙화된 섬으로 아름다운.en: Gubongdo Island is an island connected by reclaimed land in Daebubuk-dong, Danwon-gu, Ansan-si, and was named so because it has nine beautiful peaks. As the name Daebudo Haesol-gil suggests, it is an island composed mostly of pine forests. If you walk about 1km northwest along the coastline of Gubong Island, you will come across two large rocks, which are called Gubong Seondol. The small rock looks like a grandmother and the large rock looks like a grandfather, so it is also called grandmother's rock or grandfather's rock, and although it is small, it is a photo point here. If you walk along the coastal road past the Gubonggi Seondol, you will arrive at the Ant Waist Arch Bridge. It is an arch bridge built on a narrow section like an ant's waist, and the sunset scenery here is so famous that it often appears in promotional photos of Daebu Haesol-gil, and Gubongdo is a representative sunset spot in the West Sea, as three of the nine scenic views of Ansan were selected as Gubongdo sunset spots.
구봉도는 안산시 단원구 대부북동에 있는 간척지로 연륙화된 섬으로 아름다운.zh: 九峰岛是位于安山市檀园区大北洞的填海造地连接而成的岛屿，因拥有九座美丽的山峰而得名。正如大扶岛解松路这个名字所暗示的那样，它是一个主要由松树林组成的岛屿。沿着九峰岛海岸线向西北方向行走约1公里，就会看到两块大岩石，称为九峰仙石。小石头像奶奶，大石头像爷爷，所以也被称为奶奶岩或爷爷岩，虽然很小，但却是这里的拍照点。沿着滨海路步行，经过古峰基仙石，就到了蚂蚁腰拱桥。是一座建在像蚂蚁腰一样狭窄的拱桥上，这里的日落景色非常有名，经常出现在大釜解松路的宣传照片中，而九峰岛是西海代表性的日落景点，安山九景中的三处被选为九峰岛日落景点。

국립과천과학관은 과학기술을 놀이처럼 즐길 수 있는 매력적인 과학문화 체험.en: Gwacheon National Science Museum is an attractive science and culture experience facility where you can enjoy science and technology like play. It is the largest science museum in Korea and a landmark in the metropolitan area, making it easy to access as it is connected to a subway station near Seoul. Anyone can experience science in an easy and enjoyable way through various exhibitions ranging from basic science to cutting-edge technology in six permanent exhibition halls, special exhibition rooms, planetarium, and outdoor exhibition facilities. In addition, we are taking the lead in narrowing the gap between science and technology, which can be perceived as difficult and rigid, and the public, through science and culture events and experience programs that the whole family can enjoy.
국립과천과학관은 과학기술을 놀이처럼 즐길 수 있는 매력적인 과학문화 체험.zh: 国立果川科学馆是一个可以像游戏一样享受科学技术的极具魅力的科学文化体验设施。它是韩国最大的科学博物馆，也是大都市地区的地标，与首尔附近的地铁站相连，交通十分便利。六个常设展厅、特别展览室、天文馆和室外展览设施，从基础科学到尖端技术，各种展览让任何人都能轻松愉快地体验科学。此外，我们还通过全家人都可以享受的科学文化活动和体验项目，带头缩小被视为困难和僵化的科学技术与公众之间的差距。

국립광주과학관은 광주광역시 북구에 위치한 호남권 과학문화 확산 중심기관이.en: The Gwangju National Science Museum is a central institution for the spread of science culture in the Honam region, located in Buk-gu, Gwangju. The main building's permanent exhibition hall, children's science hall, and artificial intelligence hall with the theme of light, sound, space, and the convergence of science and art are always in operation. In addition, special exhibitions on various science-related topics are held throughout the year, and scientific cultural events that allow people to enjoy science as a play in their daily lives are also held on a regular basis. The Gwangju National Science Museum also operates an educational program where students can naturally learn scientific principles through various experiments and experiential activities based on the scientific principles they learned at school. It is a place of learning and a place of relaxation for leisure where anyone, regardless of gender or age, can enjoy science through various programs for adults.
국립광주과학관은 광주광역시 북구에 위치한 호남권 과학문화 확산 중심기관이.zh: 国立光州科学博物馆位于光州北区，是湖南地区科学文化传播的中心机构。主楼以光、声、空间、科学与艺术融合为主题的常设展厅、儿童科学馆、人工智能馆常年营业。此外，全年举办各类科学专题专题展览，定期举办让人们在日常生活中享受科学乐趣的科学文化活动。国立光州科学博物馆还开展教育项目，学生可以根据在学校学到的科学原理，通过各种实验和体验活动自然地学习科学原理。它是一个学习的地方和休闲放松的地方，任何人，无论性别或年龄，都可以通过各种成人项目享受科学的乐趣。

부여 시내 남동쪽 금성산 기슭에 위치한 국립부여박물관은 1929년 재단법.en: The Buyeo National Museum, located at the foot of Geumseongsan Mountain in the southeast of Buyeo city, was established in 1929 by the ‘Buyeo Historic Sites Preservation Society’ and is a cultural property of Baekje. The Buyeo National Museum began by collecting relics and displaying them in the guest quarters of the Joseon Dynasty government office located south of Busosan Mountain. From 1939, it was called the ‘Buyeo Branch of the Museum of the Government-General of Korea’ and finally received the name ‘Buyeo Museum.’ In 1970, a new museum was built at the southern foot of Busosan Mountain to display Baekje cultural relics scattered throughout the Baekje region, including the Buyeo region. On August 6, 1993, it moved to its current location and opened with a new look. Buyeo National Museum has four exhibition halls and an outdoor relic exhibition hall in an area of ​​61,429㎡ and displays about 1,000 relics. At the time of designing the building, the traditional Korean style was introduced and the permanent exhibition halls (prehistoric room, history room, Buddhist art room, and outdoor exhibition room) were placed with an octagonal courtyard at the center. In the prehistory room, relics from the Bronze Age and Iron Age excavated in the Chungcheongnam-do region, mainly in the Buyeo region, were displayed, and in the history room, relics from Baekje from the Sabi period and from the Three Kingdoms period were displayed. In the Buddhist art room, Buddhist artworks from Baekje during the Sabi period are displayed, and in the outdoor exhibition room, sculptures such as Buddha statues and stone pagodas are displayed.
부여 시내 남동쪽 금성산 기슭에 위치한 국립부여박물관은 1929년 재단법.zh: 国立扶余博物馆位于扶余市东南部金城山山麓，由“扶余史迹保护协会”于 1929 年建立，是百济的文化财产。扶余国立博物馆最初收集了文物，并将其展示在位于扶苏山以南的朝鲜王朝政府办公室的客房内。从1939年开始，它被称为“韩国总督博物馆扶余分馆”，最后被命名为“扶余博物馆”。1970年，在扶余山南麓修建了一座新博物馆，展示散布在包括扶余地区在内的百济地区的百济文物。 1993年8月6日迁至现址，并以全新面貌开业。扶余国立博物馆拥有四个展厅和一个室外文物展厅，面积61,429平方米，展示约1,000件文物。建筑设计时引入韩国传统风格，以八角形庭院为中心设置常设展厅（史前室、历史室、佛教艺术室、室外展览室）。史前室陈列着以扶余地区为中心的忠清南道出土的青铜器时代和铁器时代的文物，历史室则陈列着泗泗时代、三国时代的百济遗物。佛教美术室陈列着泗毗时期百济的佛教艺术品，室外陈列室则陈列着佛像、石塔等雕塑。

2007년 10월 개관한 국립생물자원관은 동양 최대 규모의 시설을 갖추고.en: The National Institute of Biological Resources, which opened in October 2007, is equipped with the largest facilities in Asia and is an institution that conducts basic research, including excavation and sampling of national biological resources. It oversees exhibitions and promotes the importance of preserving native organisms and biological resources on the Korean Peninsula. It is adjacent to the metropolitan area landfill in Gyeongseo-dong, Seo-gu, and has unique buildings that symbolize the institution, such as a water pipe modeled after the shape of a spine, a research building, an exhibition hall modeled after a leaf, and an education center. Korea's unique and native organisms are on display, and you can experience the real environment by reproducing forests, rivers, lakes, mud flats, and marine ecosystems. The outdoor green space is large and the walking trails are well-maintained.
2007년 10월 개관한 국립생물자원관은 동양 최대 규모의 시설을 갖추고.zh: 国家生物资源研究所于2007年10月成立，拥有亚洲最大的设施，是进行国家生物资源挖掘和采样等基础研究的机构。它负责监督展览并宣传保护朝鲜半岛本土生物和生物资源的重要性。它毗邻西区庆西洞首都圈垃圾填埋场，拥有脊柱形状的水管、研究大楼、树叶形状的展览馆、教育中心等象征该机构的独特建筑。展示韩国独特的本土生物，通过再现森林、河流、湖泊、泥滩和海洋生态系统，您可以体验真实的环境。室外绿地很大，步行道维护得很好。

국립생태원 에코리움은 세계 5대 기후를 재현한 열대관, 사막관, 지중해관.en: The Ecorium of the National Institute of Ecology displays over 1,600 species of plants and animals representing each climate, including the Tropical Hall, Desert Hall, Mediterranean Hall, Temperate Hall, and Polar Hall, which reproduce the world's five major climates, allowing visitors to vividly experience a living ecosystem. In addition, there are permanent thematic exhibition halls 1 and 2 where you can learn the basic concepts of the ecosystem, a special exhibition hall where ecosystem topics are held, an eco lab where ecological education is provided at each level, a children's ecology writing room, and a 4D video theater. The outdoor exhibition areas include the Geumguri Area, where you can observe the characteristics of the wetland ecosystem, the Hadaram Area, which reproduces forest vegetation for each climate zone in Korea, the Ancient Continent Area, which reproduces the habitat of Korea's representative deer, the Native Fish Area, where you can enjoy various types of egrets and ducks flying in the wild, the Eco Care Center, which is a quarantine facility to prevent highly pathogenic avian influenza and the protection of internationally endangered animals, and the CITES Animal Protection Facility to protect internationally endangered animals that are smuggled and trafficked. etc.
국립생태원 에코리움은 세계 5대 기후를 재현한 열대관, 사막관, 지중해관.zh: 国立生态研究所生态馆展示了代表各气候的1600多种动植物，包括热带馆、沙漠馆、地中海馆、温带馆、极地馆，再现了世界五大气候，让游客生动地体验活生生的生态系统。此外，还设有学习生态系统基本概念的常设专题展厅1、2、举办生态系统专题的专题展厅、进行各级生态教育的生态实验室、儿童生态书写室、4D视频影院等。室外展区包括可观察湿地生态系统特征的金九里区、再现韩国各气候区森林植被的哈达兰区、再现韩国代表性鹿的栖息地的古代大陆区、可观赏各种白鹭和鸭子在野外飞翔的原生鱼区、预防高致病性禽流感和保护国际濒危动物的检疫设施生态保育中心、 CITES 动物保护机构旨在保护走私和贩运的国际濒危动物。 ETC。

국립수목원은 1997년 정부 대책으로 수립된 광릉숲 보전대책의 성과 있는.en: The National Arboretum is Korea's leading forest species research institute, established independently from the Forestry Research Institute's Central Forestry Experiment Station on May 24, 1999, to successfully promote the Gwangneung Forest conservation plan established as a government measure in 1997. It is responsible for various roles in plants and ecosystems. The National Arboretum conducts research, collection, propagation, and preservation of forest plants, and collection, classification, production, and storage of forest biological specimens. It also conducts exchanges and cooperation between domestic and foreign arboretums, exploration and securing of useful plants, and information registration and import and export management of forest plant resources. In addition, its mission is to educate and promote the public about forests and preserve Gwangneung Forest. To this end, we are focusing on establishing a national plant resources management system, installing and operating a plant conservation center, supplementing and expanding the functions of specialized arboretums, exploring and securing useful plants at home and abroad, establishing a forest biological herbarium, expanding public education and promotion, installing a specialized arboretum library, and ecosystem conservation management of Gwangneung Forest.
국립수목원은 1997년 정부 대책으로 수립된 광릉숲 보전대책의 성과 있는.zh: 国立树木园是韩国领先的森林物种研究所，于1999年5月24日独立于林业研究所中央林业实验站而成立，以成功推进1997年作为政府措施制定的光陵森林保护计划。它负责植物和生态系统中的各种作用。国家植物园承担森林植物的研究、采集、繁殖、保存和森林生物标本的采集、分类、制作、保存等工作。开展国内外植物园交流与合作、有用植物勘探与获取、森林植物资源信息登记和进出口管理等工作。此外，其使命是教育和宣传公众有关森林的知识并保护光陵森林。为此，我们重点致力于建立国家植物资源管理体系、建立和运营植物保护中心、补充和扩大专业植物园的功能、发掘和确保国内外有用植物、建立森林生物标本馆、扩大公共教育和宣传、建立专业植物园图书馆以及光陵森林的生态系统保护管理。

산림박물관은 국립수목원의 일부로서, 산림과 임업에 관한 자료의 수집과 국.en: The Forest Museum, as part of the National Arboretum, was built over a period of 1 year and 6 months from October 25, 1985 to April 5, 1987 for the purpose of collecting data on forests and forestry, conducting national guidance and field trips, classifying and identifying specimens, storing, exhibiting, and researching. The building is 4,617㎡ (1,400 pyeong) made of reinforced concrete with one underground floor and two above-ground floors. The exterior was built using modern new materials such as granite, a domestic stone, based on the traditional ideas of Korean architecture that adapts to nature. The interior was constructed using domestic materials from Gwangneung, such as pine tree and larch, and the front wall of the museum is a stone mural engraved with a modern sense of the Baekje era mural Sansumunjeon, expressing nature such as mountains, trees, water, rocks, and clouds in a harmonious arrangement. Exhibition Room 1 (Living Forest) presented a beautiful forest by introducing a living forest video system using video art techniques using multiple monitors. Eight monitors are installed on the symbolic zelkova tree. Five monitors installed in the lower part show images of plants, insects, amphibians, and mammals living on the forest floor, and three monitors in the middle part show leaves, fruits, flowers, and birds and butterflies. For 8 minutes, visitors can enjoy the entire forest that changes depending on the season along with sweet music. The second exhibition room (Forest Culture Center) is an exhibition space with two themes: history and wood use. In the introduction, various seeds were displayed based on the concept of seeds being the source of forests and human life. The history section displays various contents related to forests from ancient times to modern times, and the wood use section displays information about our ancestors' wood processing and use. In the third exhibition hall (multi-faceted video theater), there are videos containing the importance of forests and the importance of biological conservation, and the structural features inside the video theater more effectively convey the content contained in the video. Exhibition Room 4 (Forest Life Hall) consists of the following corners: [Evolution of Animals and Plants], [Ecological Forest Diorama], [Humans and Plants], [Humans and Insects], [Humans and Mushrooms], [Earth Threatened], [Efforts to Prevent Various Threats through International Cooperation], and [Gwangneung Forest]. Exhibition Room 5 (Korea's Nature) is a laminated lumber made from larch and pine trees and using urethane resin adhesive parallel to the direction of the fibers, and presented a method of utilizing thinning small economy. It is a meeting place and a resting place, and anyone can play fun computer games, such as guessing the difference between pictures of beautiful plants, and more. The special exhibition room is used as a place for forest environment education for the public and youth education by planning and exhibiting environmental and ecological photography exhibitions, Korean bird and water species exhibitions, insect exhibitions, miniature painting exhibitions, and wooden furniture and woodcraft exhibitions.
산림박물관은 국립수목원의 일부로서, 산림과 임업에 관한 자료의 수집과 국.zh: 森林博物馆是国家植物园的一部分，于1985年10月25日至1987年4月5日历时一年零六个月建成，旨在收集森林和林业资料，进行国家指导和实地考察，标本分类鉴定、保存、展览和研究。该建筑面积为4,617平方米（1,400坪），由钢筋混凝土建成，地下一层、地上两层。外观采用国产石材花岗岩等现代新材料，基于韩国建筑顺应自然的传统理念。内部采用松树、落叶松等光陵国产材料建造，正面墙壁上雕刻着具有现代感的百济时代壁画《山水文殿》，将山、树、水、石、云等自然景观和谐地表现出来。展览室1（生命森林）通过使用多台显示器的视频艺术技术介绍生命森林视频系统，呈现出美丽的森林。象征性的榉树上安装了八台显示器。安装在下部的五台显示器显示生活在森林地面上的植物、昆虫、两栖动物和哺乳动物的图像，中部的三台显示器显示树叶、水果、花朵、鸟类和蝴蝶。在8分钟的时间里，游客可以伴随着悦耳的音乐欣赏随季节变化的整个森林。第二展厅（森林文化中心）是一个具有历史和木材使用两个主题的展览空间。介绍中展示了各种种子，以种子为森林之源、人类生命之源为理念。历史部分展示了从古至今与森林有关的各种内容，木材利用部分展示了我们祖先对木材加工和使用的信息。在第三展厅（多面影厅），播放着包含森林重要性和生物保护重要性的视频，而影厅内部的结构特征更有效地传达了视频所包含的内容。第四展厅（森林生命馆）由以下区域组成：【动植物的进化】、【生态森林立体模型】、【人类与植物】、【人类与昆虫】、【人类与蘑菇】、【地球面临的威胁】、【通过国际合作预防各种威胁】、【光陵森林】。展览室5（韩国的自然）是由落叶松和松树制成的层积材，并使用平行于纤维方向的聚氨酯树脂粘合剂，并提出了一种利用间伐小经济的方法。它是一个聚会场所和休息场所，任何人都可以玩有趣的电脑游戏，例如猜测美丽植物图片之间的差异等等。特设展览室作为公众森林环境教育和青少年教育的场所，规划和展出环境生态摄影展、韩国鸟类和水生物种展、昆虫展、微型绘画展、木制家具和木工艺展等。

장흥유원지의 인근에 위치하고 있는 아세안자연휴양림은 서울을 비롯한 인천.en: ASEAN Natural Recreation Forest, located near Jangheung Recreation Area, is less than an hour away from Seoul, Incheon, Ilsan, and Uijeongbu, making it the most accessible natural recreation forest in the metropolitan area. In addition, in order to promote friendship between Korea and ASEAN and to encourage social harmony among foreign workers and multicultural families, ASEAN traditional houses were built under the theme and used as lodging facilities, allowing people to experience various overseas cultural experiences and forest experiences at the same time. The area around the recreation forest is dominated by oak trees such as Quercus Quercus, Quercus Quercus, and Oak Tree. There are large and small strangely shaped rocks along the valleys and ridges, and the valley leading to Angoryeong Recreation Area is dotted with small waterfalls and cows, creating a beautiful natural scenery.
장흥유원지의 인근에 위치하고 있는 아세안자연휴양림은 서울을 비롯한 인천.zh: 东盟自然休养林位于长兴游憩区附近，距首尔、仁川、一山、议政府市不到一小时车程，是首都圈最方便的自然休养林。此外，为了促进韩国与东盟的友谊，鼓励外籍劳工和多元文化家庭之间的社会和谐，以东盟传统民居为主题建造并用作住宿设施，让人们同时体验各种海外文化体验和森林体验。休闲林周边以栎树为主，有栎树、栎树、栎树等。山谷和山脊上有大大小小的奇岩怪石，通往安高岭游憩区的山谷中点缀着小瀑布和牛群，构成了美丽的自然风光。

국립양평치유의숲은 경기도 양평군 양동면 황거길 262-10 삼각산(538.en: National Yangpyeong Healing Forest is located at 262-10 Hwanggeo-gil, Yangdong-myeon, Yangpyeong-gun, Gyeonggi-do, at the southern foot of Samgaksan Mountain (538m), and has excellent accessibility within an hour from the metropolitan area. It offers a variety of healing facilities and specialized healing programs for each target, such as Sabak Road (1.1km barrier-free deck road), hammock zone, cypress pool, thermal healing room, meditation hut, and unmanned health management system.
국립양평치유의숲은 경기도 양평군 양동면 황거길 262-10 삼각산(538.zh: 国立杨平治愈林位于京畿道杨平郡良洞面黄居路262-10，三岳山南麓(538m)，距离首都圈1小时以内，交通便利。它为每个目标提供各种治疗设施和专门的治疗项目，如沙巴克路（1.1公里无障碍甲板路）、吊床区、柏树池、热疗室、冥想小屋和无人健康管理系统。

2002년 12월 9일 국내 최초 여성사전시관이 서울시 대방동 여성플라자.en: On December 9, 2002, Korea's first women's dictionary exhibition hall was installed at the Women's Plaza in Daebang-dong, Seoul. It was registered as a national museum in 2012, and was relocated and opened at the Goyang City Government Joint Building on September 1, 2014. It functions as a complex educational and cultural space to highlight the role of women in history and people who contributed to the development of history and to raise public awareness of gender equality. It consists of a special exhibition room on the first floor, a permanent exhibition room on the second floor, a storage room, and a research room. It illuminates the history of women from ancient times to modern times. Using digital media, physical materials, and media art, it reproduces the flow of Korean women's history from Queen Seondeok, the first queen of the Silla Dynasty in 632, to modern times. In primitive ancient society, women exerted political influence through their roles as goddesses, priestesses, ancestors, and queens. During the Goryeo Dynasty, women not only served as household managers and managers, but also accumulated wealth by engaging in commerce and trade activities. In addition to the lives of women who were active in artistic activities such as literature and painting despite Confucian control during the Joseon Dynasty, we can also get a glimpse of the efforts of women in modern and contemporary times to secure women's suffrage, education rights, and job rights. Starting with a special exhibition on the theme of women's power and creativity in commemoration of the first anniversary of its opening in 2003, special exhibitions are held every year, and gender equality education for children and youth and women's history lectures for adults are also held. Residents of local communities such as Goyang City are volunteering, and applications are accepted and operated through the volunteer portal.
2002년 12월 9일 국내 최초 여성사전시관이 서울시 대방동 여성플라자.zh: 2002年12月9日，韩国第一家女性词典展厅在首尔大方洞女性广场设立。 2012年注册为国家博物馆，并于2014年9月1日搬迁至高阳市政府联合大楼并开放。它作为一个综合教育和文化空间，旨在突出女性在历史中的作用和为历史发展做出贡献的人们，并提高公众对性别平等的认识。由一层特设陈列室、二层常设陈列室、储藏室、研究室组成。它阐明了从古代到现代的女性历史。它利用数字媒体、实体材料和媒体艺术，再现了从632年新罗王朝第一位女王善德女王到现代的韩国女性历史的流程。在原始古代社会，女性通过女神、女祭司、祖先和女王等角色发挥政治影响力。高丽王朝时期，女性不仅担任家主、管理者，还通过从事商贸活动积累财富。除了朝鲜王朝时期在儒家统治下活跃于文学、绘画等艺术活动的女性的生活之外，我们还可以一睹近现代女性为保障女性的选举权、教育权、就业权而做出的努力。从2003年纪念开馆一周年举办以女性力量和创造力为主题的专题展览开始，每年举办专题展览，还举办针对儿童和青少年的性别平等教育和针对成人的妇女历史讲座。高阳市等当地社区的居民正在开展志愿服务，通过志愿者门户接受申请并进行操作。

국립중앙과학관은 ‘자연과 인간과 과학의 조화’를 주제로 건립된 과학기술.en: The National Science Museum is a center of science and technology culture built under the theme of ‘harmony between nature, humans, and science.’ It was established to promote the scientificization of people’s lives and to contribute to the development of young people’s interest in science and technology and their creativity. This is a space where you can easily and enjoyably access science in your daily life, and a comprehensive scientific and cultural space where you can accumulate, inherit, and utilize scientific knowledge of the past, present, and future. It also plays a role in fostering creativity and serving as the foundation for creating a rational society. We provide the public with opportunities to experience science, technology, and culture through exhibitions, education, and various science events. Excavation and preservation of science and technology cultural heritage, exhibition and educational research activities, and exchanges and cooperation with science museums across the country are also actively carried out.
국립중앙과학관은 ‘자연과 인간과 과학의 조화’를 주제로 건립된 과학기술.zh: 国立科学博物馆是以“自然、人类与科学和谐相处”为主题而建设的科技文化中心，旨在促进人们生活的科学化，为培养青少年的科技兴趣和创造力做出贡献。这是一个让你在日常生活中轻松愉快地接触科学的空间，是一个让你积累、传承、运用过去、现在和未来科学知识的综合性科学文化空间。它还发挥着培养创造力和创建理性社会的基础的作用。我们通过展览、教育和各种科学活动为公众提供体验科学、技术和文化的机会。科技文化遗产发掘保存、展览和教育研究活动以及与全国科学博物馆的交流与合作也积极开展。

국립중앙박물관은 용산으로 이전하여 2005년 개관한 이래 사람들에게 많은.en: The National Museum of Korea has received a lot of attention and love from people since it moved to Yongsan and opened in 2005. You can fully enjoy and enjoy seven permanent exhibition halls presented by era and theme, special exhibition halls showing a variety of contents, an exhibition commentary program that helps visitors understand, a children's museum where you can enjoy and learn with all five senses, various educational programs, and realistic content using cutting-edge technology. The permanent exhibition hall displays and provides 9,884 artifacts, and exhibits are changed periodically to accommodate external exhibition schedules and the preservation status of artifacts. In addition, efforts are being made to improve completeness in various fields such as collection and preservation of collections, which are the basis of exhibitions, and academic research. The National Museum of Korea is also a healing space in the city where you can have a leisurely and enjoyable time while strolling through the garden where beautiful flowers bloom depending on the season. In modern society, where everything changes rapidly, museums are a place where you can take a break and look back. You can enjoy the value of culture and daily life while enjoying leisure time with family, friends, lovers, or by yourself.
국립중앙박물관은 용산으로 이전하여 2005년 개관한 이래 사람들에게 많은.zh: 韩国国立中央博物馆自2005年迁至龙山开馆以来，受到了人们的广泛关注和喜爱。您可以充分享受和享受按时代和主题呈现的七个常设展厅、展示多种内容的特别展厅、帮助参观者理解的展览解说节目、可以用五种感官享受和学习的儿童博物馆、各种教育项目以及使用尖端技术的现实内容。常设展厅展示并提供9,884件文物，展品定期更换，以适应外部展览日程和文物保存状况。此外，作为展览基础的藏品的收藏、保存、学术研究等各领域的完整性也正在努力提高。国立中央博物馆也是都市中的疗愈空间，您可以在随季节绽放美丽花朵的庭园中漫步，度过悠闲愉快的时光。在一切都瞬息万变的现代社会，博物馆是一个可以休息、回顾过去的地方。您可以在与家人、朋友、爱人或自己享受休闲时光的同时，享受文化和日常生活的价值。

국립현대미술관은 한국 근·현대 미술의 흐름과 세계 미술의 시대적 경향을.en: The National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art is the only national art museum in Korea that simultaneously accommodates the trends of Korean modern and contemporary art and the trends of world art. It opened in the Small Exhibition Hall at Gyeongbokgung Palace in 1969 and was moved to the Seokjojeon Hall at Deoksugung Palace in 1973. In 1986, it was newly built and relocated to Gwacheon, which has international-scale facilities and an outdoor sculpture hall. The National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art (Gwacheon) has a unique building exterior with traditional styles, including an old fortress wall and beacon tower that go well with the beautiful scenery of Cheonggyesan Mountain, and the walls and stairs of a traditional village. It fulfills its role as a national art institution both in name and reality, including collection and preservation of art works and materials, exhibitions, research and research, and related international exchanges and dissemination of art activities and improvement of art culture awareness through education. You can also appreciate the works of domestic masters such as Nam June Paik, Lee Jung-seop, and Chun Kyung-ja, and there are various educational programs. There is a shuttle bus from exit 4 of Grand Park Station on the metropolitan subway to the museum, and you can also take the elephant train to the museum, and Seoul Grand Park is nearby.
국립현대미술관은 한국 근·현대 미술의 흐름과 세계 미술의 시대적 경향을.zh: 国立现代美术馆是韩国唯一同时容纳韩国现当代艺术潮流和世界艺术潮流的国立美术馆。 1969年在景福宫小展览馆开馆，1973年迁至德寿宫石造殿。1986年新建并迁至拥有国际规模设施和室外雕塑馆的果川。国立现代美术馆（果川）的建筑外观独特，具有传统风格，包括与清溪山美景相得益彰的古老城墙和烽火台，以及传统村庄的墙壁和楼梯。它在名义上和现实上履行着国家艺术机构的职责，包括艺术作品和资料的收藏和保存、展览、研究和研究，以及相关的艺术活动的国际交流和传播以及通过教育提高艺术文化意识。还可以欣赏白南准、李正燮、全庆子等国内大师的作品，还有丰富多彩的教育项目。都营地铁大公园站4号出口有班车到博物馆，也可以乘坐大象火车到博物馆，首尔大公园就在附近。

국립현대미술관(서울관)은 동시대 현대미술을 중점적으로 다루는 미술관이다..en: The National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art (Seoul branch) is an art museum that focuses on contemporary contemporary art. Following the Gwacheon Pavilion, which opened in 1986, and the Deoksugung Pavilion, which opened in 1998, the Seoul Pavilion, which opened in 2013, is located on the site of Sogyeokseo, Jongchinbu, Gyujanggak, and Saganwon during the Joseon Dynasty. The National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art (Seoul Branch), which was built using the [Yard] concept, is designed as a space where anyone can enjoy and relax. The inside and outside of the building are organically connected and designed to harmonize with the surrounding attractions. The National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art (Seoul Branch) is a complex art and culture center equipped with various facilities, including an exhibition room, digital information room, multimedia hall, and movie theater, and hosts exhibitions of Korean contemporary art and new media convergence exhibitions.
국립현대미술관(서울관)은 동시대 현대미술을 중점적으로 다루는 미술관이다..zh: 国立现代美术馆（首尔分馆）是一家专注于当代当代艺术的美术馆。继1986年开馆的果川馆、1998年开馆的德寿宫之后，2013年开馆的首尔馆位于朝鲜时期的小溪西、钟镇府、奎章阁、寺官院等地。以“庭院”为概念建造的国立现代美术馆（首尔分馆）被设计为任何人都可以享受和放松的空间。建筑内外有机相连，设计与周围景点相协调。国立现代美术馆（首尔分馆）是一座综合性艺术文化中心，配备展览室、数字信息室、多媒体厅、电影院等多种设施，举办韩国当代艺术展览和新媒体融合展览。

국립현대미술관은 1969년 경복궁에서 개관한 이래로 2018년에는 충청북.en: Since its opening at Gyeongbokgung Palace in 1969, the National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art has been making efforts to foster it as a famous place for art and culture in the central region by opening the National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art Cheongju, which was a reconstruction of an old tobacco manufacturing plant in Cheongju, Chungcheongbuk-do, in 2018. In 2019, it held a commemorative ceremony to celebrate its 50th anniversary and is growing into an open art museum in the world that shares art culture. The National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art Cheongju unveils Korea's first open storage facility built on the collections of art museums, government agencies, and art banks. An open storage facility can be said to be an expanded concept of an art museum where collections, which are the basic components of an art museum, are stored and opened to the viewer, allowing not only the public to appreciate a vast amount of works, but also to learn about the invisible functions of the art museum. (Source: National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art website)
국립현대미술관은 1969년 경복궁에서 개관한 이래로 2018년에는 충청북.zh: 国立现当代美术馆自 1969 年在景福宫开馆以来，一直致力于将其打造成中部地区的艺术文化名胜，2018 年在忠清北道清州旧烟草制造厂改建的基础上开设了清州国立现当代美术馆。2019 年举办了建馆 50 周年纪念仪式，目前正在发展成为国立现代美术馆。世界开放的艺术博物馆，共享艺术文化。清州国立现代美术馆推出了韩国首个以美术馆、政府机构和艺术银行藏品为基础的开放式存储设施。开放式储藏设施可以说是美术馆概念的延伸，将作为美术馆基本组成部分的藏品进行储藏并向观众开放，不仅让公众欣赏到大量的作品，还让公众了解美术馆的隐形功能。 （来源：国立现当代美术馆网站）

국화도는 경기도 화성시 우정읍 소재지에서 남서부 28㎞ 지점에 위치함..en: Gukhwado Island is located 28km southwest of Ujeong-eup, Hwaseong-si, Gyeonggi-do. The eastern part of the island is Seongmun-myeon, Dangjin-gun, and the north is an inhabited island adjacent to Ippado Island. It is an island fishing village whose main business is collecting clams and oysters and other seafood. Because the flowers bloom late and fall late, it was called Manhwado Island using the character 'man (晩)' for late, but it was changed to Gukhwado Island because it was an island where many chrysanthemums bloomed during the Japanese colonial period. In fact, wild chrysanthemums are in full bloom all over the island. Gukhwado Island is located 10 minutes away from Janggo Port by boat and 1 hour away from Gungpyeong Port, and is a small island that can be explored on foot in 2 hours. Although it is about 10 minutes away by ferry from Janggo Port, it is a little-known island. Gukhwado Island seen from Janggo Port looks like an uninhabited island due to the pine forest that covers the island. Gukhwado Island, which boasts scenery that is worthy of an outing, is good for a day trip, but you can also stay on the island for a day or two and enjoy the atmosphere of a quiet and simple fishing village and spend some time relaxing. A place where you can safely enjoy water play at a beach with a gentle slope and clear water, go out with your child with a hoe and catch a variety of seafood such as conchs and clams, or enjoy fishing on a fishing boat is Gukhwado Island, an isolated island of wild chrysanthemums that are breathtakingly beautiful.
국화도는 경기도 화성시 우정읍 소재지에서 남서부 28㎞ 지점에 위치함..zh: 国花岛位于京畿道华城市雨井邑西南28公里处。岛的东部是唐津郡城门面，北部是与一波岛相邻的有人居住的岛屿。这是一个海岛渔村，主要业务是采集蛤蜊和牡蛎等海产品。由于花开晚、秋晚，所以用“晚”字被称为“蔓花岛”，但由于日本殖民时期是菊花盛开的岛屿，所以改名为“国花岛”。事实上，岛上到处都盛开着野菊花。国花岛距离长古港乘船10分钟，距离宫坪港1小时，是一个步行2小时即可游览完毕的小岛。虽然距离长戈港乘渡轮约10分钟，但它是一个鲜为人知的岛屿。从长古港看去的国华岛，由于松树林覆盖，看起来就像一座无人岛。 Gukhwado岛拥有值得郊游的风景，适合一日游，但也可以在岛上停留一两天，享受宁静而淳朴的渔村氛围，度过一段轻松的时光。可以在坡度平缓、海水清澈的海滩安全地玩水，也可以带着孩子拿着锄头出去捕捉海螺、蛤蜊等各种海鲜，还可以在渔船上享受钓鱼的乐趣，这就是国花岛，这是一座野菊花孤岛，景色美得令人窒息。

근대역사의 중심도시, 군산에 자리한 군산근대역사박물관은 군산의 근대문화.en: Gunsan Modern History Museum, located in Gunsan, the central city of modern history, is a specialized museum and local museum with the theme of Gunsan's modern and maritime culture, and is a space where visitors can experience the history and culture of Gunsan. Gunsan Modern History Museum is a museum that exhibits the old Gunsan, which was the center of maritime logistics distribution as a trading port in the past under the motto that ‘history becomes the future,’ and the nation’s largest modern cultural resources, showing the thousand years of West Sea logistics distribution and Gunsan, an international trade port reaching out to the world. The first floor is home to the Marine Logistics History Museum, Children's Experience Center, and Donation Exhibition Room, the second floor is the Modern Data Center and Citizens' Open Gallery, and the third floor is the Modern Life Center and Special Exhibition Room.
근대역사의 중심도시, 군산에 자리한 군산근대역사박물관은 군산의 근대문화.zh: 群山近代历史博物馆位于近代历史中心城市群山，是以群山近代文化和海洋文化为主题的专业博物馆和地方博物馆，是游客体验群山历史和文化的空间。群山近代历史博物馆是以“历史成就未来”为座右铭，展示过去作为贸易港口的海上物流集散中心的旧群山和韩国最大的近代文化资源的博物馆，展示了千年的西海物流集散和群山这个走向世界的国际贸易港口。一层为海洋物流历史馆、儿童体验中心、捐赠陈列室，二层为现代数据中心和市民开放画廊，三层为现代生活中心和专题展览室。

군포문화원은 군포의 전통문화 및 향토사 자료의 수집, 보존, 보급에 앞장.en: The Gunpo Cultural Center is a research center that takes the lead in the collection, preservation, and dissemination of Gunpo's traditional culture and local history materials. We strive to preserve traditional culture and arts, promote the development and promotion of culture and arts through local love and local cultural activities that are factors of the local community, and strive to create an atmosphere of civic harmony by promoting the emotional life of citizens and their pride as citizens of traditional culture through the establishment of a sound culture.
군포문화원은 군포의 전통문화 및 향토사 자료의 수집, 보존, 보급에 앞장.zh: 军浦文化馆是牵头收集、保存、传播军浦传统文化和地方历史资料的研究中心。我们努力保护传统文化艺术，通过作为当地社区因素的乡情和地方文化活动，促进文化艺术的发展和弘扬，并通过建立良好的文化，促进公民的情感生活和作为传统文化公民的自豪感，努力营造公民和谐的氛围。

궁평관광지는 솔향과 서해안 정취가 어우러지는 공간으로, ‘궁평유원지’라는.en: Gungpyeong Tourist Site is a space where pine trees and the atmosphere of the West Coast come together, and is widely known as ‘Gungpyeong Recreation Area’. On the Gungpyeong Marine Pine Colony Trail, you can walk while feeling the scent of a pine forest full of phytoncide, and at Gungpyeong Beach, you can enjoy the beautiful sunset along with the open sea. The promenade and beach area are always bustling with visitors who spread out tents or mats and enjoy picnics. During the summer, a mudflat experience program is operated and is even more popular with families.
궁평관광지는 솔향과 서해안 정취가 어우러지는 공간으로, ‘궁평유원지’라는.zh: 宫坪旅游区是松树与西海岸风情融为一体的空间，被称为“宫坪休闲区”。在宫坪海松群落步道上，您可以一边散步，一边感受充满芬多精的松树林的香气；在宫坪海水浴场，您可以欣赏到美丽的夕阳和大海。海滨长廊和海滩区总是挤满了摊开帐篷或垫子享受野餐的游客。夏季还开设泥滩体验项目，更受家庭欢迎。

궁평리 해수욕장은 궁평항 앞에 있는 백사장 길이 2km, 폭 50m의 아.en: Gungpyeong-ri Beach is a small white sand beach in front of Gungpyeong Port with a length of 2km and a width of 50m. Located at the tip of the Namyang Peninsula, a dense bear pine forest that is over 100 years old is located right in front.
