At low tide, you can enjoy a variety of experiences, including tidal flat experience and sea fishing, on a 2km mudbed. At high tide, you can enjoy swimming in the sea for more than two hours a day. In addition to this, you can enjoy the walking path along the beach in both directions, including Gungpyeong Port and the sea pine colony. At Gungpyeong-ri Beach, you can set up shade tents and parasols on the beach, and car camping is also possible. Chabak and chaknik can be used at designated locations (private land) for a fee, and cooking is also possible.
궁평리 해수욕장은 궁평항 앞에 있는 백사장 길이 2km, 폭 50m의 아.zh: 宫坪里海水浴场是宫坪港前的一片白色小沙滩，长2km，宽50m。位于南阳半岛的顶端，眼前是一片树龄超过100年的茂密熊松林。退潮时，您可以在2公里的泥滩上享受滩涂体验、海钓等多种体验。涨潮时，每天可以在海里畅游两个多小时。除此之外，您还可以沿着海岸线的两个方向散步，包括宫坪港和海松群落。在宫坪里海水浴场，可以在沙滩上搭起遮阳帐篷和遮阳伞，还可以进行汽车露营。客人可以在指定地点（私人土地）付费使用Chabak和chaknik，还可以做饭。

수원시 권선동에 위치한 권선종합시장은 약 110개 점포로 구성된 상가 건.en: Gwonseon General Market, located in Gwonseon-dong, Suwon, is a traditional market in the form of a commercial building consisting of about 110 stores. It has served as a daily marketplace for local residents, stocking a variety of items such as agricultural products, livestock products, marine products, and industrial products, and there are a variety of food stores such as sundae and pig's feet concentrated there. Well-equipped parking facilities make it convenient to visit by car, and arcades are installed throughout the market, allowing you to shop comfortably even in inclement weather such as rain or snow. Thanks to the shaded interior environment, it is relatively cool even in the summer, and user satisfaction is high.
수원시 권선동에 위치한 권선종합시장은 약 110개 점포로 구성된 상가 건.zh: 权善综合市场位于水原市权善洞，是一个由约110家店铺组成的商业建筑形式的传统市场。这里曾是当地居民的日常集市，出售农产品、畜产品、海产品、工业品等多种商品，圣代、猪蹄等各类食品店也集中于此。停车设施齐全，驾车游览也很方便，市场各处均设有拱廊，即使在雨雪等恶劣天气下也能舒适购物。由于室内环境有遮荫，即使在夏天也比较凉爽，用户满意度较高。

청계산과 명지산의 중간에 있는 귀목봉(높이 1,036m)은 이름 없는 고.en: Gwimokbong (height 1,036m), located in the middle of Cheonggyesan Mountain and Myeongjisan Mountain, is an unnamed hill. Climbers call it Gwimokbong because it is located on top of Gwimok Pass. It is adjacent to Myeongjisan Mountain to the east, Cheonggyesan Mountain to the west, and Gangsibong Peak to the north. Compared to the height of the mountain, the overall slope of Gwimokbong is gentle and not rugged, so you can enjoy easy hiking. There are large and small waterfalls and waterholes on the halfway side of the hiking trail, and the surrounding area is surrounded by strangely shaped rocks and dense forests. It takes at least 3 hours to reach the top of Myeongji Mountain. If you climb to the top of Gwimokbong Peak, you can view Hwaaksan Mountain and Myeongjisan Mountain, the highest peaks in Gyeonggi-do.
청계산과 명지산의 중간에 있는 귀목봉(높이 1,036m)은 이름 없는 고.zh: 鬼木峰（高度1,036m）位于清溪山和明池山的中间，是一座无名山丘。登山者称其为“Gwimokbong”，因为它位于“Gwimok Pass”的顶部。东邻明池山，西邻清溪山，北邻江司峰。与山的高度相比，龟木峰的整体坡度较为平缓，并不崎岖，因此可以轻松享受徒步旅行。徒步步道的半途有大大小小的瀑布和水潭，周围奇石林立。到达明知山顶至少需要3个小时。登上桂木峰山顶，可以眺望京畿道最高峰华岳山和明池山。

조선호텔이 지난 100여 년간 고객과 함께 해온 역량과 경험을 집대성하여.en: Grand Chosun Busan, developed by a culmination of the capabilities and experiences that Chosun Hotel has shared with customers over the past 100 years, provides a hotel experience through exploration and innovation of the essence of the hospitality industry. In the magnificent atrium, a space that embodies the sea, nature, and colors of the city of Haeundae, you can feel optimal comfort and enjoyment during your stay even if you come without any preparation. The unique dining options of Aria, Palais de Sin, Lounge & Bar, and Chosun Deli add to the pleasure of gourmet cuisine, and the three banquet halls located on the 5th floor can be used for various purposes, such as invitation events and weddings. Premium bedding is provided in all rooms to ensure a good night's sleep, and guests can enjoy relaxation in various relaxation areas such as the swimming pool and sauna. Chosun Junior is Grand Chosun's kids-specialized brand that provides memories for children and parents a comfortable rest and relaxation during their trip throughout the entire hotel journey, from check-in to check-out and beyond. The Kids Room, which offers a differentiated sense of luxury in a design that takes children into consideration, is designed with the theme of the sea, forest, and sky to stimulate the imagination and curiosity of young customers.
조선호텔이 지난 100여 년간 고객과 함께 해온 역량과 경험을 집대성하여.zh: 釜山大朝鲜酒店汇集了朝鲜酒店过去 100 年来与顾客分享的能力和经验，通过对酒店业精髓的探索和创新，提供酒店体验。在宏伟的中庭，这个体现了海云台市的大海、自然和色彩的空间，即使您没有任何准备，也能在住宿期间感受到最佳的舒适和享受。 Aria、Palais de Sin、Lounge & Bar 和 Chosun Deli 等独特的餐饮选择增添了美食的乐趣，位于 5 楼的三个宴会厅可用于举办邀请活动和婚礼等多种用途。所有客房均提供高档床上用品，确保您睡个好觉，客人可以在游泳池和桑拿浴室等各种休闲区放松身心。 Chosun Junior 是 Grand Chosun 旗下的儿童专业品牌，旨在为孩子和家长在整个酒店旅程（从入住到退房等）的旅途中提供舒适的休息和放松的回忆。儿童房以海洋、森林、天空为主题，以儿童为主题，营造差异化的奢华感，激发年轻顾客的想象力和好奇心。

스타필드 안성 내에 위치한 글로우사파리는 동물 없는 사파리를 콘셉트로 한.en: Glow Safari, located within Starfield Anseong, is an indoor theme park with the concept of an animal-free safari. The exhibition space was created under the setting of communicating with ‘Glow Animals’, mysterious animals that bring light to the human world. Although there are no actual animals, it provides a unique experience of interacting with animals by utilizing realistic media technologies such as holograms, interactive systems, and projection mapping. Depending on the theme that changes depending on the season, cute animal characters such as pandas, polar bears, and red pandas appear, and there are photo zones for taking pictures throughout the space.
스타필드 안성 내에 위치한 글로우사파리는 동물 없는 사파리를 콘셉트로 한.zh: Glow Safari 位于安城 Starfield 内，是一个以无动物野生动物园为概念的室内主题公园。展览空间是在与给人类世界带来光明的神秘动物“发光动物”沟通的背景下创建的。虽然没有真实的动物，但它利用全息图、交互系统和投影映射等现实媒体技术，提供了与动物互动的独特体验。根据季节变化的主题，会出现熊猫、北极熊、小熊猫等可爱的动物角色，整个空间还设有可供拍照的拍照区。

금광호수공원은 금광호수 서쪽 금광교 인근에 위치한 근린공원이다. 금광호수.en: Geumgwang Lake Park is a neighborhood park located near Geumgwang Bridge on the west side of Geumgwang Lake. Geumgwang Lake is a landmark in Anseong that boasts beautiful and tranquil scenery in all directions, north, south, east, west, and north. It is a V-shaped valley-shaped lake with good fishing conditions, making it a famous spot for smelt fishing in winter. In particular, the direction of Geumgwang Lake Park and Water Fog Park, located on the west side of Geumgwang Lake, has a well-developed waterside deck for taking a walk around the lake, and is close to nearby commercial areas such as restaurants and cafes, making it a good place to explore. By car, it is about 10 minutes from downtown Anseong and 30 minutes from Pyeongtaek, so you can visit without burden even on holidays.
금광호수공원은 금광호수 서쪽 금광교 인근에 위치한 근린공원이다. 금광호수.zh: 金光湖公园是位于金光湖西侧金光大桥附近的邻里公园。金光湖是安城的地标，东西南北四面八方，风景秀丽，景色清幽。为V型谷状湖泊，垂钓条件良好，是冬季钓西太公鱼的著名地点。尤其是位于金光湖西侧的金光湖公园和水雾公园方向，拥有发达的环湖散步水边平台，且靠近附近餐厅、咖啡馆等商业区，是游览的好去处。距离安城市中心约10分钟车程，距离平泽约30分钟车程，节假日也可轻松游览。

제주시 한림읍에 위치한 금능해수욕장은 서쪽의 인기 명소인 협재해수욕장과.en: Geumneung Beach, located in Hallim-eup, Jeju City, is directly connected to Hyeopjae Beach, a popular attraction in the west. It has a similar scenery to neighboring beaches, from the blue-painted sea to the cute-looking Biyangdo Island and soft-touch sandy beaches, but its charm is that it is less crowded and more relaxed. The parking lot is directly connected to the beach, so there is no need to worry about moving your luggage. The newly built shower room is convenient as it offers hot water showers. When visiting this place, it is recommended to go during low tide when the water recedes. When the sea water recedes far away, a wide, fine sandy beach is revealed. There are natural pools here and there with shallow water that are great for children to play in. Seaweed and small seaweed left behind by the seawater naturally become toys for children. Thanks to this, you can enjoy it even without any preparation. However, at the entrance to the beach, small broken shells are mixed with the sand, so it is recommended to wear water shoes if possible.
제주시 한림읍에 위치한 금능해수욕장은 서쪽의 인기 명소인 협재해수욕장과.zh: 金陵海水浴场位于济州市翰林邑，与西部热门景点挟才海水浴场直接相连。这里的景色与邻近的海滩相似，从蓝色的大海到可爱的飞扬岛和触感柔软的沙滩，但它的魅力在于人少，更轻松。停车场与海滩直接相连，不用担心搬行李的问题。新建的淋浴房有热水淋浴，很方便。游览此地时，建议在退潮时，退潮时前往。当海水退去远处，露出宽阔细腻的沙滩。到处都是天然的水池，水很浅，很适合孩子们玩耍。海水留下的海藻、小海藻自然就成了孩子们的玩具。因此，即使没有任何准备，您也可以享受它。不过在海滩入口处，沙子里混有小碎贝壳，所以建议尽可能穿水鞋。

683년 원효대사가 이곳에서 초당을 짓고 수도하면서 관세음보살을 친견한.en: In 683, Master Wonhyo built a chodang here and met Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva while practicing meditation. After that, the mountain was named Bogwangsan and the chodang was named Bogwangsa. Later, Lee Seong-gye is said to have prayed for 100 days here and founded the Joseon Dynasty. In gratitude, in 1660, King Hyeonjong made this temple the royal temple and changed the name of the mountain to Geumsan and the name of the temple to Boriam. Boriam, located at the top of Geumsan Mountain, is a beautiful temple where you can see all the strange rocks of Geumsan Mountain and the scenery of the blue South Sea at a glance. Within the precincts, the Jwasundae Rock, where Master Wonhyo is said to have meditated, attracts attention, and the nearby rock cave called Ssanghongmun is known to be the best among the 38 scenic views of Geumsan Mountain. It is one of the three major places of prayer in Korea, along with Hongyeonam Hermitage at Naksansa Temple in Yangyang-gun, Gangwon-do, and Bomunsa Temple in Ganghwa-do, Gyeonggi-do. Believers flock to it every day. Geumsan Mountain is called the Rock Zoo for its outstanding scenery, Geumgang River in the South Sea, and many animal-shaped rocks. It is a mountain overlooking the harmony of the indigo sea and green fields. At the top of Geumsan Mountain, where you can enjoy the beauty of Hallyeohaesang National Park, is Boriam Rock, the most famous of Korea's three major prayer sites, which is said to have been founded by Master Wonhyo. In addition, each rock in Geumsan Mountain preserves legends related to Buddhism, and Boriam Rock is surrounded by strangely shaped rocks such as Daejangbong Peak, Hyeongriam Rock, Hwaeombong Peak, Ilwolbong Peak, and Sambulam Rock. The course that goes up to Boriam from the entrance to Geumsan in Sangju Village is the best hiking course that harmonizes the dense forest and the South Sea. When you stay overnight and watch the sunrise in Geumsan, the view is so spectacular that you can't help but feel the harmony of heaven and earth. By car, there is a road that goes over Angang Pass, from Beoksigol in Idong-myeon, past Bokgok Reservoir, to the 8th ridge of Geumsan. (Source: Namhae Culture and Tourism)
683년 원효대사가 이곳에서 초당을 짓고 수도하면서 관세음보살을 친견한.zh: 683年，元晓法师在此建草堂，修行时遇见观世音菩萨。此后，这座山被命名为普光山，草堂被命名为普光寺。据说后来李成桂在这里祈祷了100天，建立了朝鲜王朝。为报恩，显宗于1660年将这座寺庙设为皇家寺庙，并将山名改为锦山，寺名改为宝莲岩。宝莲庵位于锦山山顶，是一座美丽的寺庙，一眼望去，锦山的奇岩怪石和蓝色南海的景色尽收眼底。境内以元晓法师禅修的左旋台最为引人注目，附近的双红门岩洞被誉为锦山三十八景中的第一。与江原道襄阳郡洛山寺的红莲庵、京畿道江华道的普文寺并列为韩国三大祈祷场所之一。每天都有信徒蜂拥而至。锦山以其出色的风景和南海的锦江以及许多动物形状的岩石而被称为岩石动物园。这座山俯瞰着蔚蓝的大海和绿色的田野的和谐。在锦山山顶，可以欣赏闲丽海上国立公园的美景，有韩国三大祈福场中最著名的宝莲岩，据说是元晓法师创建的。此外，锦山的每块岩石都保存着与佛教有关的传说，宝莲岩周围有大长峰、玄岩岩、华严峰、日月峰、三佛岩等奇岩怪石。从尚州村锦山入口到宝莲岩的路线是密林与南海融为一体的最佳徒步路线。当你在锦山过夜观看日出时，景色是如此的壮观，让人不禁感受到天地的和谐。开车的话，有一条路从二洞面的北西谷翻过安江关，经过福谷水库，到达锦山八岭。 （来源：南海文化观光）

경기도 양주시 백석읍 기산리에 조성된 저수지이곳은 14만 8,760㎡의.en: A reservoir built in Gisan-ri, Baekseok-eup, Yangju-si, Gyeonggi-do. This reservoir is built on an area of ​​148,760㎡ and has a storage capacity of about 878 tons. It is a reservoir surrounded by high mountains, boasting beautiful scenery, and is famous as a fishing spot where carp are easily caught, making it a place visited by many anglers. Additionally, a walking trail has been built around the reservoir, making it great for taking a walk while enjoying the natural scenery.
경기도 양주시 백석읍 기산리에 조성된 저수지이곳은 14만 8,760㎡의.zh: 建于京畿道杨州市白石邑岐山里的水库。该水库建面积148760平方米，库容约878吨。水库群山环抱，风景秀丽，是著名的钓鱼胜地，容易钓到鲤鱼，是许多钓鱼者到访的地方。此外，水库周围还修建了步行道，非常适合散步、欣赏自然风光。

강하예술공원 근처에 있는 기흥성뮤지엄은 설립자 기흥성 선생께서 50년간.en: The Giheungseong Museum, located near Gangha Art Park, is a museum that displays 1,000 model works created by its founder, Kiheungseong, over 50 years. It is the only museum specializing in models in Korea. Professor Ki Heung-seong is a master of architectural models and is an expert in the production of model buildings such as modern architecture and industrial models, as well as exhibition planning for museums and exhibition halls. A variety of models, including architecture, civil engineering, automobiles, factory facilities, aircraft, and ships, are on display on the first basement and second floors. In the first exhibition hall on the first basement floor, you can see model works of traditional Korean architecture from the Three Kingdoms period to the Joseon Dynasty. Teacher Ki Heung-seong collaborated with experts and conducted thorough historical research to reproduce the scale based on facts. The second exhibition hall on the second floor displays modern and contemporary architectural models from the 1960s to the present, including construction, architecture, and urban development, in which Ki Heung-seong personally participated, as well as famous overseas architectural models such as the White House and Bruj Khalifa. Admission is free, and you can have a drink at the cafe on the first floor. The outdoor waterside park behind the museum has walking trails, sculptures, and an observation deck so you can enjoy the beautiful scenery of the Namhan River.
강하예술공원 근처에 있는 기흥성뮤지엄은 설립자 기흥성 선생께서 50년간.zh: 器兴城博物馆位于江河艺术公园附近，是一个博物馆，展示了其创始人基兴城50多年来创作的1000件模型作品。是韩国唯一一家专门展示模型的博物馆。奇香成教授是建筑模型大师，是现代建筑、工业模型等建筑模型制作以及博物馆、展览馆的展览策划方面的专家。地下一层和二层展示了建筑、土木、汽车、工厂设备、飞机、船舶等多种模型。在地下一层第一展厅，可以看到从三国时代到朝鲜王朝的韩国传统建筑模型作品。奇香成老师与专家合作，进行了深入的历史研究，以事实为基础再现了规模。二楼第二展厅展示了奇香城亲自参与的从1960年代至今的现当代建筑模型，包括建造、建筑、城市发展等，以及白宫、哈利法塔等海外著名建筑模型。免费入场，可以在一楼咖啡厅喝一杯。博物馆后面的户外水边公园设有步道、雕塑和观景台，您可以欣赏南汉江的美丽景色。

하늘에서 바라본 모습이 한문 평(平) 자를 이룬 모양을 하고 있어 김녕이.en: This beach is located in Gimnyeong village, and is called Gimnyeong because its appearance from the sky is shaped like the Chinese character for pyeong (平). It was built with sand piled on top of a huge rock rock, and Seongsegi means a small castle to prevent invasion by foreign powers. The waves crashing on the white sand make a cool sound, and the cobalt-colored seascape makes you feel the beauty of Jeju's nature. While walking along the beach, you can observe the Gimnyeong wind power generators that are powered by the wind of Jeju. Nearby, the seaside rock fishing spot where you can easily catch sea bream and sea bream is a popular spot for anglers, and various caves such as Yongcheon Cave, Dangcheomul Cave, and Manjanggul are located nearby, allowing you to enjoy a cool summer getaway. Due to the unique topography of Gimnyeong Beach, a geotrail has also been created, and the geotrail is a walking path that combines the geological resources of each region and the history and culture of the village by utilizing the UNESCO Global Geopark.
하늘에서 바라본 모습이 한문 평(平) 자를 이룬 모양을 하고 있어 김녕이.zh: 这个海滩位于金宁村，因从空中俯瞰其形状像汉字“平”而被称为“金宁”。它是用沙子堆在一块巨大的岩石上建造的，“Seongsegi”的意思是防止外国列强入侵的小城堡。海浪拍打着白色的沙滩发出清凉的声音，钴色的海景让你感受到济州大自然的美丽。沿着海滩散步时，您可以观察到利用济州风提供动力的金宁风力发电机。附近有可以轻松钓到鲷鱼和鲷鱼的海边岩钓点，是垂钓者的热门场所，附近还有龙泉洞、堂处物洞、万丈窟等各种洞窟，可以享受凉爽的夏日度假。由于金宁海水浴场独特的地形，还创建了地质步道，地质步道是利用联合国教科文组织世界地质公园，结合各地区的地质资源和村庄的历史文化的步行道。

코끝을 파고드는 소금기, 갓 잡아올려 펄펄 뛰는 물고기, 물때에 맞춰 먼.en: The salty air penetrating the tip of your nose, freshly caught fish jumping around, fishing boats returning from the sea in time for the tide, and people snooping around the fish market and raw fish restaurant. This is Daemyeong Port, Daegot-myeon, Gimpo-si, where the fresh vitality of life is alive and breathing. It is located 30 minutes away by car from Gimpo Airport, so it is close to Seoul, and ship owners and fishermen directly run raw fish restaurants, so the price of raw fish is about 20% cheaper than in other ports, according to people in the port. The raw fish restaurants that lead from the entrance to Daemyeong Port are filled with fresh raw fish just caught in each aquarium, and the sight of nets being spread out and cleaned in various places allows you to realistically feel the characteristics of the port. Daemyung Port is the only port facing the coast of Ganghwa Island, where you can enjoy the beautiful seascape. It is in the spotlight both at home and abroad due to the Daemyung Type 2 Fishing Port project and the holding of the Big Catch Festival. Daemyeong Port is a place where you can enjoy the beautiful seascape and the atmosphere of a traditional port, so much so that it was selected as one of the ‘7 best winter seas recommended by the Korea Tourism Organization’ in 2001. Daemyeong Port, which faces Ganghwa Island across the Ganghwa Strait, is not crowded with tourists like Sorae Port or Yeonan Pier, and boasts a friendly atmosphere where you can enjoy the quiet atmosphere of a fishing village. In particular, Deokpojin, the historical site of the fight against foreign powers in the late Joseon Dynasty, is located nearby.
코끝을 파고드는 소금기, 갓 잡아올려 펄펄 뛰는 물고기, 물때에 맞춰 먼.zh: 咸咸的空气直冲鼻尖，新鲜捕获的鱼在跳跃，渔船赶着涨潮从海上归来，人们在鱼市和生鱼餐厅里窥探。这里是金浦市大串面大明港，这里充满了生机。据港口人士介绍，这里距金浦机场约30分钟车程，距离首尔较近，而且船主和渔民直接经营生鱼餐厅，因此生鱼价格比其他港口便宜20%左右。从大明港入口处延伸出来的生鱼餐厅里摆满了各水族馆刚捕获的新鲜生鱼，各处撒网、清洗的景象，可以真实地感受到港口的特色。大明港是唯一面向江华岛海岸的港口，在这里可以欣赏到美丽的海景。因大明二型渔港项目和Big Catch Festival的举办而受到国内外关注。大明港是一个可以欣赏美丽海景和传统港口氛围的地方，2001年被选为韩国旅游发展局推荐的“冬季7大最佳海域”之一。大明港隔着江华海峡与江华岛相望，不像苏来港或延安码头那样挤满了游客，气氛友好，可以享受渔村的宁静氛围。特别是朝鲜后期抗击列强的历史遗址德浦津就位于附近。

김포시 독립운동기념관은 2013년 양촌읍에 개관하였다. 김포 지역에서 일.en: Gimpo City Independence Movement Memorial Hall opened in Yangchon-eup in 2013. It was built to inherit the spirit of the independence movement that took place in the Gimpo area and to honor our ancestors. The place where the memorial hall was created is where the Orani Market Movement took place in 1919, and it is a space where you can see at a glance materials related to the anti-Japanese movement in the Gimpo area. The permanent exhibition hall on the first floor displays a video reproducing the independence movement that took place in the Gimpo area and the history of the independence movement across the country, including Gimpo. The last letter sent by Ahn Jung-geun's mother, Mrs. Jo Maria, to Dr. Ahn Jung-geun and items donated by Dr. Ahn Jung-geun to the National Security Foundation are on display. In the special exhibition room, special exhibitions on March 1st Independence Movement Day and August 15th Liberation Day, as well as exhibitions on various other topics are held. In particular, in 2023, the Metaverse Virtual Exhibition Hall was opened, which reproduces the interior of the permanent and special exhibition halls of the Gimpo City Independence Movement Memorial Hall in virtual space after 3D modeling, and you can learn about the history of the Gimpo Independence Movement in a fun way by solving various missions.
김포시 독립운동기념관은 2013년 양촌읍에 개관하였다. 김포 지역에서 일.zh: 金浦市独立运动纪念馆于2013年在阳村邑开馆。该纪念馆是为了继承金浦地区独立运动的精神并纪念我们的祖先而建造的。纪念馆创建的地方是1919年奥拉尼市场运动的发生地，是一个可以一目了然地看到金浦地区抗日运动相关资料的空间。一楼的常设展厅展示了再现金浦地区独立运动以及包括金浦在内的全国独立运动历史的视频。展示着安重根的母亲乔玛丽亚夫人写给安重根博士的最后一封信以及安重根博士向国家安全保障财团捐赠的物品。特别展览室举办3月1日独立运动日和8月15日解放日特别展览以及其他各种主题的展览。特别是2023年开设了元界虚拟展厅，通过3D建模在虚拟空间中再现了金浦市独立运动纪念馆常设展厅和特别展厅的内部，通过解决各种任务，可以有趣地了解金浦独立运动的历史。

경기도 김포 운양동에 위치한 김포문화원은 1964년 개원하였으며 김포의.en: Gimpo Cultural Center, located in Unyang-dong, Gimpo, Gyeonggi-do, opened in 1964 and is actively promoting cultural projects such as preservation, transmission, and excavation of Gimpo's history and local culture, cultural events, and traditional culture education. Main facilities include classrooms for cultural school classes, a data room, and storage, and affiliated organizations include the Gimpo Studies Research Institute and the Gimpo City Folk Art Preservation Society, which conduct research and research on local history and local culture. As a cultural program, Gimpo Culture College runs cultural classes where you can learn about traditional culture and scholar culture.
경기도 김포 운양동에 위치한 김포문화원은 1964년 개원하였으며 김포의.zh: 金浦文化馆位于京畿道金浦市云阳洞，于1964年开业，积极推进金浦历史和地方文化的保存、传播、挖掘、文化活动、传统文化教育等文化事业。主要设施有文化学校教室、资料室、保管库等，附属机构有金浦研究所、金浦市民俗艺术保存会等，对地方历史和地方文化进行调查研究。作为文化项目，金浦文化学院开设文化课程，可以学习传统文化和学者文化。

김포아트빌리지는 전통과 현대의 아름다움이 공존하는 문화관광복합공간이다..en: Gimpo Art Village is a cultural and tourism complex where traditional and modern beauty coexist. Located at the foot of Modam Mountain, you can enjoy the quiet charm of a Hanok village and beautiful natural scenery at the same time. It consists of 17 hanoks, 5 creative studios, an art center, an outdoor performance hall, and a traditional playground, and various cultural and artistic activities take place. For citizens, it is a friendly place where they can experience culture in their daily lives, and for tourists, it is a special travel destination that they want to visit again.
김포아트빌리지는 전통과 현대의 아름다움이 공존하는 문화관광복합공간이다..zh: 金浦艺术村是一个传统与现代之美并存的文化旅游综合体。位于Modam山脚下，您可以同时享受韩屋村的宁静魅力和美丽的自然风光。它由17间韩屋、5个创意工作室、一个艺术中心、一个户外表演厅和一个传统游乐场组成，举办各种文化艺术活动。对于市民来说，这是一个可以在日常生活中体验文化的友好场所，对于游客来说，这是一个他们想再次访问的特殊旅行目的地。

김포아트홀은 김포시민의 삶의 질 향상과 문화예술 진흥을 위해 건립된 김포.en: Gimpo Art Hall is a public art center in Gimpo City built to improve the quality of life of Gimpo citizens and promote culture and arts. It consists of a 503-seat performance hall, gallery, and seminar room, and operates a variety of citizen participation contents such as high-quality planned performances and exhibitions, cultural arts education, and ‘Culture Day’ programs. The performance hall is designed to be suitable for plays, chamber music, recitals, etc., and the exhibition hall can display works of various genres such as paintings, calligraphy, and sculpture, serving as a center for local artistic activities.
김포아트홀은 김포시민의 삶의 질 향상과 문화예술 진흥을 위해 건립된 김포.zh: 金浦艺术馆是金浦市为提高金浦市民生活质量、弘扬文化艺术而建的公共艺术中心。它由503个座位的表演厅、画廊和研讨室组成，运营高品质策划的演出和展览、文化艺术教育、“文化日”活动等多种公民参与内容。表演厅设计适合戏剧、室内乐、独奏会等演出，展览厅可展示绘画、书法、雕塑等多种流派的作品，是当地艺术活动的中心。

김포의 특산물인 김포인삼과 금쌀을 이용하여 개발한 인삼쌀맥주를 즐길 수.en: It is a famous place where you can enjoy ginseng rice beer developed using Gimpo ginseng and golden rice, which are special products of Gimpo. It also has restaurant facilities where you can enjoy a variety of dishes along with ginseng rice beer. You can also tour the Ginseng Theme Hall, where you can see the growth, growth process, and efficacy of ginseng, and the Promotion Hall, where you can see the beer manufacturing process. Gimpo Ginseng Rice Beer Gallery is located at the entrance to Ganghwa Island, making it ideal for sightseeing in conjunction with nearby Daemyeong Port, Deokpojin, and Hamsang Park.
김포의 특산물인 김포인삼과 금쌀을 이용하여 개발한 인삼쌀맥주를 즐길 수.zh: 是可以品尝到使用金浦特产金浦人参和黄金大米酿造的人参米啤酒的著名场所。还设有餐厅设施，您可以一边享用各种菜肴，一边品尝人参米啤酒。还可以参观人参主题馆，在这里可以看到人参的生长、生长过程和功效，以及推广馆，在这里可以看到啤酒的制造过程。金浦人参米啤酒画廊位于江华岛的入口处，与附近的大明港、德浦津、咸相公园等一起观光非常适合。

김해시 서상동에 있는 금관가야의 시조 수로왕의 무덤으로 사적으로 지정됐다.en: It is the tomb of King Suro, the founder of Geumgwan Gaya, located in Seosang-dong, Gimhae-si, and has been designated as a historic site. It is a circular mound with a height of about 5m, and there are buildings such as Sungseonjeon, Anhyanggak, Jeonsacheong, and Jegigo, which enshrine a deity, as well as stone monuments such as shrines and public monuments. The major historic sites of King Suro's tomb include Sungseonjeon, which houses the shrine, Anhyanggak, where incense and axes for use in the Spring and Autumn rites are stored, Napleung Main Gate, the main gate of the royal tomb, and Gujibong Peak, which is shaped like a group of 10 turtles. King Suro ascended to the throne as the founder of the Garak Kingdom in 42 AD, took Heo Hwang-ok, princess of the Yayuta Kingdom of India, as queen in 48 AD, and is the progenitor of the Kim clan of Gimhae. It is said that in the 13th year of King Seonjo's reign (1580), Heo Yeop, the governor of Yeongnam, renovated the tomb into its current appearance. Inside the royal tomb, there is a memorial tablet for King Suro and Queen Suro, which is a place for the soul of the deceased and refers to a picture or fat of the deceased. The tombstone in front of the tomb was erected in the 25th year of King Injo's reign (1647) in the Joseon Dynasty, and Sungseonjeon is the name given by the king in the 21st year of King Gojong's reign (1884).
김해시 서상동에 있는 금관가야의 시조 수로왕의 무덤으로 사적으로 지정됐다.zh: 位于金海市西上洞的金冠伽倻创始人首露王的陵墓，已被指定为史迹。是一个高约5m的圆形土丘，有崇善殿、安乡阁、传殿、祭祀阁等祭祀神明的建筑物以及神社、公碑等石碑。首露王陵的主要古迹有神殿所在的崇善殿、存放春秋祭祀用的香火和斧头的安香阁、王陵正门那不伦正门以及形状像10只乌龟的龟芝峰。首露王于公元42年即位，成为可乐王国的创始人，于公元48年立印度雅由多王国公主许璜玉为王后，是金海金氏的始祖。据说宣祖13年（1580年），岭南太守许冶将坟墓整修成现在的样子。王陵内有首罗王和首罗王后的牌位，是死者灵魂的安放处，指的是死者的画像或脂肪。墓前的墓碑建于朝鲜仁祖25年（1647年），崇善殿是高宗21年（1884年）国王赐名。

양주시에서 운영하는 나리농원은 전국 최대 규모의 천일홍꽃 군락지가 조성되.en: Nari Farm, operated by Yangju City, is a nature-friendly healing space with the largest bay myrtle flower colony in the country. Every year around September, the ‘10 Million Flowers Festival’ is held and many tourists flock to the area. During the two months from September to October when the festival is held, entry times to the farm are set, but after the festival ends, you can walk and pass as usual. On the deepening cool fall days, you can enjoy happy times with your family and lover.
양주시에서 운영하는 나리농원은 전국 최대 규모의 천일홍꽃 군락지가 조성되.zh: 杨州市经营的纳里农场是一个自然友好的疗愈空间，拥有全国最大的香桃木花群。每年9月左右，这里都会举办“千万花节”，吸引众多游客前来。祭典举办期间的9月至10月的两个月内，规定了农场的入场时间，但祭典结束后，就可以照常步行通行了。在秋高气爽的日子里，您可以与家人、爱人一起享受幸福时光。

안동댐 수력발전소 입구 좌측에 위치한 낙강물길공원은 주변 수자원 환경과.en: Nakgang Waterway Park, located to the left of the entrance to the Andong Dam Hydroelectric Power Plant, was created with the purpose of providing a comfortable resting and healing space for visitors by creating forest paths and gardens that match the surrounding water environment. Metasequoia and fir trees grow around a small pond, and the stone bridge and path over the pond create an exotic scenery, so it is called Korea's Giverny. There are benches here and there under the trees, so it is a resting place loved by Andong citizens as well as tourists. Taking pictures at the photo zones hidden here and there will make you feel like you are Monet. In addition, there is a walking path around Andong Dam and a waterside deck leading to Wolyeong Park, making it a perfect walking course for everyday use.
안동댐 수력발전소 입구 좌측에 위치한 낙강물길공원은 주변 수자원 환경과.zh: 洛江水道公园位于安东水坝水力发电厂入口左侧，旨在通过营造与周围水环境相匹配的森林小道和花园，为游客提供舒适的休息和疗愈空间。小池塘周围生长着水杉和冷杉，池塘上的石桥和小路营造出异域风情，因此被称为韩国的吉维尼。树下到处都有长椅，是安东市民和游客喜爱的休息场所。在隐藏的拍照区拍照，让你感觉自己就是莫奈。此外，安东水库周围还有步行道和通往月岭公园的水边平台，是适合日常使用的完美步行路线。

낙산공원은 대학로와 동대문으로부터 이어지며 역사와 문화를 함께 즐길 수.en: Naksan Park is connected to Daehakro and Dongdaemun and is a park where you can enjoy history and culture. Naksan was also called Camel Mountain because its terrain resembles a camel's back, and it was also called Taraksan Mountain because there was a royal ranch that supplied milk to the palace. After the 1960s, the original appearance of Naksan disappeared due to citizen apartments and crowded housing, and the Seoul Metropolitan Government established a plan to restore Naksan. As part of this plan, a park conversion project was carried out and it opened as Naksan Park in July 2002. Naksan Park's central plaza has the Naksan Exhibition Hall, a central stage, and a concession stand, so it's great for taking a break, and there's a parking lot right below the plaza, so it's easy to get to the central plaza. Naksan Exhibition Hall is a facility located at the entrance to Naksan Park. It displays the origins of Naksan, historical figures, photos and models of Hanyangdoseong, and provides various information to citizens visiting Naksan Park. Park use programs related to Naksan and Seoul Hanyangdoseong are operated on weekends, and anyone can use them for free. On one side of the square is Naksanjeong Pavilion. Naksanjeong is a pavilion created during the restoration of Naksan Mountain and is a place with a great view of Seoul. It has established itself as a resting place for citizens where they can feel the beautiful atmosphere of Seoul Hanyangdoseong and green forests, and is in the spotlight as a place where you can see the most beautiful night view in Seoul. There are various courses, including the Ihwa-dong Mural Village with houses and murals from the top of the hill, the Dongdaemun course to Heunginjimun and Hanyangdoseong-gil, and the Hansung University entrance course where you can walk while looking at the entire exterior wall. ◎ Travel information to experience the charm of the Korean Wave - Animation <K-Pop Demon Hunters> This is one of the places where Rumi and Jin-Woo walk while talking in the Netflix animation ‘K-Pop Demon Hunters’. The cityscape of Seoul unfolding beyond the castle walls is impressively captured, conveying the emotions in the animation more deeply. If you actually visit, you will be able to see the panoramic view of Seoul at a glance along with the quiet castle road, providing a special experience.
낙산공원은 대학로와 동대문으로부터 이어지며 역사와 문화를 함께 즐길 수.zh: 洛山公园与大学路和东大门相连，是可以感受历史和文化的公园。洛山因其地形酷似骆驼背而被称为骆驼山，又因这里有向皇宫供应牛奶的皇家牧场而被称为塔拉克山。 20世纪60年代后，由于市民公寓和住房拥挤，骆山的原貌消失了，首尔市政府制定了恢复骆山的计划。作为该计划的一部分，进行了公园改建工程，并于2002年7月作为洛山公园开放。洛山公园的中央广场设有洛山展览馆、中央舞台和小卖部，非常适合休息，广场下方有停车场，因此前往中央广场也很方便。骆山展览馆是位于骆山公园入口处的设施。展示了骆山的起源、汉阳都城的历史人物、照片和模型，为游览骆山公园的市民提供各种信息。骆山和首尔汉阳都城相关的公园利用项目在周末运营，任何人都可以免费使用。广场的一侧是洛山亭。洛山亭是洛山修复时修建的亭子，是可以眺望首尔景色的地方。它已成为市民休息的地方，可以感受到首尔汉阳都城和绿色森林的美丽氛围，并且作为可以看到首尔最美丽夜景的地方而受到关注。有从山顶看有房屋和壁画的梨花洞壁画村、到兴仁之门、汉阳都城路的东大门路线、可以边走边眺望整个外墙的汉城大学入口路线等各种路线。 ◎ 体验韩流魅力的旅游信息 - 动画<K-Pop恶魔猎手> 这里是Netflix动画《K-Pop恶魔猎手》中Rumi和Jin-Woo边走边说话的地方之一。城堡墙外展现的首尔城市景观令人印象深刻，更深刻地传达了动画中的情感。如果你真的去参观的话，沿着幽静的城堡道路，一眼就能看到首尔的全景，别有一番体验。

낙산사는 강원특별자치도 양양군을 대표하는 관광명소이자 역사적 가치가 큰.en: Naksansa Temple is a representative tourist attraction in Yangyang-gun, Gangwon-do and a scenic spot with great historical value. It is an ancient temple founded by Master Uisang in the 11th year of King Munmu of Silla (671) and is considered one of the three major Avalokitesvara shrines in Korea, along with Bomunsa Temple in Ganghwa and Boriam Temple in Namhae. The temple, with its natural beauty overlooking the East Sea, is one of the Eight Scenic Scenic Spots of Gwandong (eight scenic spots in Yeongdong, Gangwon-do), and its beauty has been passed down in numerous classics and poems since ancient times. Naksansa Temple is a historical temple that has been rebuilt and restored several times and possesses several cultural assets. Well-known examples include the 16m high Seawater Avalokitesvara Statue, Uisangdae, a pavilion built on a coastal cliff and a famous sunrise spot on the East Coast, Hongnyeonam Hermitage overlooking the sea, the Yangyang Naksansa Seven-story Stone Pagoda (treasure), which was built during the Joseon Dynasty but inherited the Goryeo Dynasty style, and the Yangyang Naksansa Temple Seawater Avalokitesvara Avalokitesvara, a monument and a collection of reliquaries (treasures), where Buddha's relics and other reliquaries were discovered. In 2005, a large forest fire occurred, destroying about 20 buildings, including the bronze bell, which had been designated as a treasure. You can apply for a temple stay through the Naksansa Temple website. ◎ Travel information to experience the charm of the Korean Wave - <Rino Log> We recommend walking along the ‘road where dreams come true’ that Rino walked, placing a small stone on top of the numerous stone pagodas and making a wish.
낙산사는 강원특별자치도 양양군을 대표하는 관광명소이자 역사적 가치가 큰.zh: 洛山寺是江原道襄阳郡的代表性旅游景点，也是一处极具历史价值的风景名胜区。是由义相大师于新罗文武王11年（671年）创建的古刹，与江华普文寺、南海宝莲寺并称为韩国三大观音寺之一。该寺俯瞰东海，自然风光秀丽，是关东八景（江原道岭东八景）之一，其美景自古以来就在无数经典和诗词中流传。洛山寺是一座历史悠久的寺庙，经过多次重建和修复，拥有多项文化遗产。著名的例子包括高16m的海水观音像、建在海岸悬崖上的凉亭、东海岸著名的日出景点义象台、俯瞰大海的弘莲庵、建于朝鲜时期但继承高丽王朝风格的襄阳洛山寺七层石塔（宝物）、襄阳洛山寺海水观世音菩萨观世音菩萨，一座纪念碑和舍利盒（宝物）收藏地，这里发现了佛陀的舍利和其他舍利盒。 2005年，发生了一场特大森林火灾，烧毁了约20座建筑物，其中包括被定为国宝的铜钟。您可以通过洛山寺网站申请寺庙住宿。 ◎ 体验韩流魅力的旅游信息 - <Rino Log> 推荐沿着Rino走过的“梦想成真之路”行走，在众多的石塔上放置一块小石头，许愿。

난지천공원은 월드컵공원의 5대 테마공원 중 하나이다. 난지천공원에선 연못.en: Nanjicheon Park is one of the five theme parks of World Cup Park. At Nanjicheon Park, you can enjoy a wonderful view of ponds and streams in harmony with the fields. A variety of aquatic plants and flowers are well preserved, so flora that is not easily seen in the city can often be seen. It is a perfect place for a family outing as children can have fun running around with the beautiful nature in the background. In spring, you can also see a variety of flowers, such as rape blossoms and colorful tulips, filled with the scent of spring. Double cherry blossoms, boasting lovely flower clusters, are also in bloom, adding to the fun of walking.
난지천공원은 월드컵공원의 5대 테마공원 중 하나이다. 난지천공원에선 연못.zh: 兰芝川公园是世界杯公园五个主题公园之一。在兰芝川公园，可以欣赏到池塘、溪流与田野和谐相处的美景。各种水生植物、花卉保存完好，经常能看到城市里不易见到的植物群。这里是家庭出游的理想场所，孩子们可以在美丽的大自然背景下尽情奔跑。春天还可以看到各种花卉，如油菜花、色彩缤纷的郁金香等，充满了春天的气息。重瓣樱花也盛开，花簇可爱，增添了散步的乐趣。

남부수자원생태공원은 역곡 배수구역과 오류3 배수분구에서 유입되는 하수를.en: Southern Water Resources Ecological Park is an ecological park created by eco-friendly purification of sewage flowing in from the Yeokgok drainage area and Oryu 3 drainage basin. The pyramid waterway, Silgaecheon, and garden are centered around a large lawn, making it a great place to take a walk. There are a variety of sports facilities such as futsal courts, basketball courts, and inline skating rinks, which are used as exercise spaces for residents. In the summer, there is a water park that children can enjoy, and in the fall, the leaves change color, making it perfect for families to enjoy a picnic.
남부수자원생태공원은 역곡 배수구역과 오류3 배수분구에서 유입되는 하수를.zh: 南部水资源生态公园是对驿谷流域和五流3流域流入的污水进行环保净化而创建的生态公园。金字塔水道、实盖川、庭园以大草坪为中心，是散步的好去处。拥有五人制足球场、篮球场、直排轮溜冰场等多种体育设施，作为居民的锻炼空间。夏天，这里有适合孩子们玩耍的水上乐园，秋天，树叶变色，非常适合家庭野餐。

남산서울타워는 효율적인 방송전파 송수신과 한국의 전통미를 살린 관광 전망.en: Namsan Seoul Tower was built for the future of broadcasting culture and the tourism industry as Korea's first comprehensive radio tower that combines the functions of efficient transmission and reception of broadcast waves and a tourist observation facility that takes advantage of Korea's traditional beauty. Just as world-famous towers have become symbolic entities of a country or city, Namsan Seoul Tower has also served as a representative tourist destination in Korea and a symbol of Seoul for the past 40 years. Namsan Seoul Tower has become an object of interest and love among citizens due to its height, unique structure, and shape, which can be seen from all over downtown Seoul, and is solidifying its position as the number one tourist attraction enjoyed by domestic and foreign tourists. Recently, as the name has increased as a filming location for various entertainment shows and dramas that have driven the Korean Wave, it is a place where domestic and foreign tourists constantly visit.
남산서울타워는 효율적인 방송전파 송수신과 한국의 전통미를 살린 관광 전망.zh: 南山首尔塔是为广播文化和旅游业的未来而建造的，是韩国第一座综合广播塔，结合了有效传输和接收广播电波的功能以及利用韩国传统美的旅游观察设施。正如世界著名的塔楼已成为一个国家或城市的象征一样，南山首尔塔在过去的40年里也一直是韩国的代表性旅游目的地和首尔的象征。南山首尔塔因其高度、独特的结构和形状而成为市民感兴趣和喜爱的对象，从首尔市中心的各个地方都可以看到，并正在巩固其作为国内外游客最喜爱的第一旅游景点的地位。近年来，作为带动韩流的各种综艺节目和电视剧的拍摄地，其名气越来越大，成为国内外游客络绎不绝的地方。

남송미술관은 가평 명지산과 연인산 청정 계곡 자락에 위치하여 전원의 아름.en: Namsong Art Museum is located at the foot of the clean valley of Myeongji Mountain and Yeonin Mountain in Gapyeong and is a comprehensive cultural and art exhibition space where you can enjoy the beautiful scenery of the countryside and art using various cultural materials. Starting with the opening exhibition in 2006, this place has consistently held exhibitions of works of various art genres. In addition to the rich artistic activities of director Namgung-won, a master painter, the museum has planned and exhibited works of art with aesthetic value based on the domestic and foreign works of art it has collected and managed. It has the appearance of a traditional Korean hanok building and is a four-story building with a total land area of ​​2,210 m2 and a total floor area of ​​1,498 m2. It has exhibition spaces on the first and second floors, an experiential learning space on the third floor, and an open exhibition room on the fourth floor. There is also an outdoor parking lot for the convenience of visitors, and nearby auxiliary facilities are the Scarecrow Village, a cultural experiential learning and artist rest area. Scarecrow Village is located in the valley of Myeongjisan Mountain in Gapyeong. It is a resort area where busy city dwellers can breathe in nature, which is like a mother's arms. It is a beautiful village built on 10,000 m2 of land to allow people to enjoy the scent of culture and art in abundance.
남송미술관은 가평 명지산과 연인산 청정 계곡 자락에 위치하여 전원의 아름.zh: 南松美术馆位于加平明知山和莲仁山洁净的山谷脚下，是一个可以欣赏乡村美景和使用各种文化材料的艺术的综合文化艺术展览空间。自2006年开幕以来，这里一直举办各种艺术流派的作品展览。除了画家大师南宫元馆长丰富的艺术活动外，博物馆还根据收藏和管理的国内外艺术品策划和展示具有审美价值的艺术品。它具有韩国传统韩屋建筑的外观，为四层建筑，总用地面积2,210平方米，总建筑面积1,498平方米。一楼、二楼设有展览空间，三楼设有体验式学习空间，四楼设有开放式展览室。还设有室外停车场，方便游客，附近的辅助设施有稻草人村、文化体验式学习和艺术家休息区。稻草人村位于加平明芝山山谷中。这里是忙碌的都市人可以呼吸大自然的度假区，大自然就像母亲的怀抱。这是一座建在万平方米土地上的美丽村庄，让人们充分享受文化艺术的气息。

* 한국 고유의 문화를 살리는 곳, 남양주문화원 * 남양주문화원은 지역의.en: * Namyangju Cultural Center, a place that preserves Korea's unique culture * Namyangju Cultural Center was opened in 1982 and has been active in promoting culture in the local community by conducting research and research on local materials and holding local cultural events in order to develop, preserve, and transmit the unique culture of the region. Namyangju City has been at the center of the history of the Korean Peninsula for a long time, so it preserves numerous cultural heritages. It is located in the northeastern part of the metropolitan area and the central part of Gyeonggi-do. It is surrounded by Cheonmasan Mountain, Chuknyeongsan Mountain, Bulamsan Mountain, and Ungilsan Mountain, and is a naturally blessed area along the beautiful Han River. * Namyangju Cultural Center’s Dasan Cultural Festival * Among the cultural projects conducted by Namyangju Cultural Center, the most important cultural project is the Dasan Cultural Festival. Dasan Cultural Festival is a local festival that commemorates the achievements and Silhak ideas of Dasan Jeong Yak-yong, a great Silhak scholar in the late Joseon Dynasty. The contents include holding art, writing, calligraphy, and photography contests for kindergarten, elementary, middle, and high school students in the district, and the general public, thereby contributing to discovering talent and turning the arts and culture around. It also honors the spirit of Dasan by selecting and awarding the Dasan Mokmin Award to civil servants from related organizations in the district for serving citizens. In addition, the Dasan Thought Lecture is held to disseminate Dasan's ideology to local residents and transform it into a civic festival, providing an opportunity to experience various genres of culture and arts such as traditional art performances and various exhibitions.
* 한국 고유의 문화를 살리는 곳, 남양주문화원 * 남양주문화원은 지역의.zh: * 保存韩国独特文化的地方南杨州文化中心 * 南杨州文化中心于 1982 年开业，通过对当地材料进行研究和研究并举办当地文化活动，积极促进当地文化的发展，以发展、保存和传播该地区的独特文化。南杨州市长期以来一直处于朝鲜半岛历史的中心，因此保存着众多的文化遗产。位于首都圈东北部、京畿道中部。周围有天马山、竹岭山、富兰山、云吉山等，是美丽的汉江沿岸的自然福地。 * 南杨州文化院茶山文化节 * 南杨州文化院开展的文化项目中，最重要的文化项目是茶山文化节。茶山文化节是纪念朝鲜末期实学大师茶山郑若镛的功绩和实学思想的地方节日。内容包括面向全区幼儿园、小学生、初高中生和社会公众举办美术、写作、书法、摄影比赛，为发现人才、扭转文化艺术贡献力量。为弘扬茶山精神，还向区内相关团体的公务人员评选并授予为市民服务的茶山木民奖。此外，还举办茶山思想讲座，向当地居民传播茶山思想，并将茶山思想转化为市民节日，提供体验传统艺术表演、各类展览等多种文化艺术的机会。

남양주시 와부읍에 있는 남양주시립박물관은 남양주의 역사와 문화를 보존하기.en: Namyangju City Museum, located in Wabu-eup, Namyangju, was established to preserve the history and culture of Namyangju and opened in April 2010. It is equipped with a permanent exhibition room, special exhibition room, and education room, and outside, you can see an outdoor performance hall and stone artifacts. The permanent exhibition room displays everything from Paleolithic relics excavated in Namyangju to various folk relics from the Joseon Dynasty and modern times, while the special exhibition room presents various exhibitions with new themes every year. (Source: Namyangju City Museum website)
남양주시 와부읍에 있는 남양주시립박물관은 남양주의 역사와 문화를 보존하기.zh: 南杨州市博物馆位于南杨州市洼府邑，是为了保存南杨州市的历史和文化而设立的，于2010年4月开馆。博物馆设有常设展览室、特别展览室、教育室，室外还有露天表演厅和石制品。常设展览室展示了从南杨州出土的旧石器时代文物到朝鲜王朝和现代的各种民间文物，特别展览室每年都会推出新主题的各种展览。 （来源：南杨州市博物馆网站）

남양주시 삼패동 630번지 일원에 위치한 삼패한강공원은 시민들에게 계절별.en: Sampae Hangang Park, located around 630 Sampae-dong, Namyangju-si, is a beautiful waterside park that people from all walks of life can visit and enjoy throughout the four seasons by providing seasonal flower and flower complexes, a children's garden, a musical fountain, and a water park to citizens. A flea market is also held every Saturday from spring to fall where citizens can participate and sell or exchange recyclable items. Sampae Hangang Park also has a bicycle path, so you can not only enjoy bicycle riding while enjoying the atmosphere of the Han River and Bukhangang River, but it is also a great walking course. (Source: Namyangju City Culture and Tourism website)
남양주시 삼패동 630번지 일원에 위치한 삼패한강공원은 시민들에게 계절별.zh: 三台汉江公园位于南杨州市三台洞630号附近，为市民提供四季花卉、花卉综合体、儿童花园、音乐喷泉、水上乐园等，是四季皆宜的美丽水边公园。从春季到秋季，每周六还会举办跳蚤市场，市民可以参与其中，出售或交换可回收物品。三佩汉江公园还设有自行车道，不仅可以一边骑自行车，一边感受汉江和北汉江的氛围，同时也是一个很棒的散步路线。 （来源：南杨州市文化观光网站）

남양황라는 1973년 12월 20일 2,065m의 남양방조제가 완공되면서.en: Namyang Hwangra is a place where 1,211ha of reclaimed farmland was created with the completion of the 2,065m Namyang Seawall on December 20, 1973. Namyangho, an artificial lake, is a tourist attraction created with an area of ​​967ha along with the construction of an embankment and is one of the eight scenic views of Hwaseong. Rice produced in the Namyang reclaimed land contains a lot of alkaline components and boasts the highest quality among Gyeonggi rice. The vast fields provide different richness depending on the season, but in particular, the golden fields of autumn combine with Namyang Lake to add abundance and fullness. In winter, it becomes a very good habitat for black geese, which search for plant-based food. On a fall day, a flock of white-fronted geese settle down in a golden field, and mallard ducks settle near Jangan Bridge. Just by parking your car on the side of the road and opening the window, you can observe migratory birds in winter without any special equipment. It is also famous as an ice fishing spot in winter. And to the left of the entrance to the Namyang Seawall is Namyang Lake, and to the right is the sea. It is a unique place where you can see the sea and the lake at the same time.
남양황라는 1973년 12월 20일 2,065m의 남양방조제가 완공되면서.zh: 南阳黄罗是1973年12月20日随着全长2,065m的南阳海堤竣工而形成的1,211ha开垦农田的地方。南阳湖是人工湖，是随着堤坝建设而形成的面积967ha的旅游胜地，是华城八景之一。南阳开垦地生产的大米含有大量碱性成分，是京畿道大米中品质最高的。广阔的田野随着季节的不同而呈现出不同的丰饶感，尤其是秋天的金色田野与南阳湖的结合，增添了丰沛的气息。在冬季，这里成为寻找植物性食物的黑雁的良好栖息地。秋天的一天，一群白额雁在金色的田野里栖息，绿头鸭在长安桥附近栖息。只需将车停在路边，打开窗户，无需任何特殊设备，即可观察冬季候鸟。这里也是冬季著名的冰钓胜地。南阳海堤入口左侧是南阳湖，右侧是大海。这是一个可以同时看到大海和湖泊的独特地方。

남이섬은 북한강 한가운데 위치한 작은 섬으로, 행정구역은 춘천시에 속하지.en: Nami Island is a small island located in the middle of the Bukhangang River. Its administrative district belongs to Chuncheon-si, but the docks to enter the island are mainly located in Gapyeong, Gyeonggi-do. The unique entry method using a boat or zip line is attractive. The entire island is decorated like an arboretum, showing off different charms each season, including the metasequoia road, birch road, and ginkgo tree road. Equipped with various sculptures, exhibitions, cafes, and restaurants, it is an international tourist attraction visited by millions of domestic and foreign tourists every year to enjoy walking and relaxation.
남이섬은 북한강 한가운데 위치한 작은 섬으로, 행정구역은 춘천시에 속하지.zh: 南怡岛是位于北汉江中部的一个小岛。其行政区属春川市，但进岛码头主要位于京畿道加平。使用船或滑索的独特进入方法很有吸引力。整个岛屿被装饰得像一个植物园，每个季节都展现出不同的魅力，有水杉路、白桦路、银杏树路。这里设有各种雕塑、展览、咖啡馆、餐厅，是每年数以百万计的国内外游客前来散步、休闲的国际旅游胜地。

과거 한양을 지키던 4대 요새 중 하나인 남한산성을 품은, 남한산성도립공.en: There is Namhansanseong Provincial Park, which houses Namhansanseong Fortress, one of the four fortresses that once protected Hanyang. These were Gaeseong in the north, Suwon in the south, Ganghwa in the west, and Gwangju in the east. In Gwangju to the east, there was Namhansanseong Fortress. It is located on Namhansan Mountain, 24km southeast of Seoul and 6km northeast of Seongnam City, with a total length of 12.4km (8.9km for the main castle, 3.2km for the outer castle, 0.2km for the Sinnam Fortress) and a height of 7.3m. There is a record that it was originally the royal castle of Onjo, the founder of Baekje, the son of King Dongmyeong of Goguryeo, about 2,000 years ago, and there is also a record that it was Jujangseong Fortress built in Hansanju in the 13th year of King Munmu of Silla (673) when the Silla-Tang War was in full swing. It is said that it was rebuilt several times in later generations using the old site, and was built in earnest during the reign of Gwanghaegun of the Joseon Dynasty (1621). Namhansanseong Fortress, built with stone walls, has a circumference of about 12km. Natural stones were used to stack the large stones on the bottom and the small stones on the top. There were 4 gates, a gate tower, and 16 secret gates in each of the east, west, south, and north, and there were poles in 4 places in the east, west, south, and north. Inside the castle, a fishery office was established, a government office, warehouse, and temporary palace were built. The temporary palace to accommodate in times of emergency consisted of 73 rooms for the upper palace, 154 rooms for the lower palace, and 26 rooms for the left palace, with a total of 252 rooms. 80 wells and 45 springs were built, and the administrative office of Gwangju-eup was also moved into the fortress. At this point, you can guess the importance of Namhansanseong Fortress and the population it can attract. The number of people who participated in the mobile training that was first conducted after the fortress was built (1639, 17th year of King Injo’s reign) was 12,700. However, only a few buildings remain in the castle now. The eastern and southern gates, Seojangdae, Hyeonjeolsa Temple, Yeonmugwan, Janggyeongsa Temple, Jisudang, Yeongwoljeong, Chimgwaejeong, Sungnyeoljeon General Iseo General Shrine, Bo, Ru, and Dondae remain. Among them, the four main gates, Sueojangdae, and some castle walls in the middle of the west gate are well preserved in their original form. Namhansanseong Fortress is designated as a historic site and provincial park.
과거 한양을 지키던 4대 요새 중 하나인 남한산성을 품은, 남한산성도립공.zh: 南汉山城道立公园内有曾经守护汉阳的四大城池之一的南汉山城。这些是北部的开城，南部的水原，西部的江华，东部的光州。光州东部有南汉山城。位于首尔东南24公里、城南市东北6公里的南汉山上，全长12.4公里（主城8.9公里，外城3.2公里，新南城0.2公里），高7.3m。据记载，它原本是距今约2000年前高句丽东明王的儿子、百济创始人温祖的王城，也有记载是新罗文武王13年(673年)新罗唐战争如火如荼时在汉山州修建的朱将城。据说后世曾在旧址上多次重建，并于朝鲜光海君时期（1621年）正式建成。南汉山城由石墙建成，周长约12公里。采用天然石材，将大石堆放在底部，将小石堆放在顶部。东、西、南、北各有城门4座，门楼各1座，暗门16座，东西南北4处立有柱子。城堡内设立了渔业办公室，并修建了衙门、仓库和行宫。临时行宫有上宫73间、下宫154间、左宫26间，共计252间。修建了80口水井和45处泉水，光州邑的行政办公室也迁入了城内。至此，你就可以猜到南汉山城的重要性以及它能吸引的人口了。筑城后（仁祖17年1639年）首次进行的流动训练参加人数为12,700人。不过，现在城堡内只剩下一些建筑物了。东门、南门、西将台、贤节寺、演武馆、长庆寺、池水堂、宁月亭、清桂亭、崇烈殿、二西将军祠、宝殿、祇殿、东台尚存。其中，四个正门、修御将台以及西门中部的一些城墙都保存完好。南汉山城被指定为史迹和道立公园。

남해 독일마을은 파독 광부 간호사들이 은퇴 후 귀국하여 정착한 마을이다..en: Namhae German Village is a village where miners and nurses stationed in Germany settled after returning home after retirement. You can see traditional German-style houses and Korean-Germans living here. Of these, about 30 are running guesthouses as a side business. It is said that many tourists visit each house for its unique interior design and service. Right in front of you is the cool sea of ​​the seawall and the Mulmi Coastal Road, the most beautiful coastal drive course on the southern coast.
남해 독일마을은 파독 광부 간호사들이 은퇴 후 귀국하여 정착한 마을이다..zh: 南海德国村是驻德矿工和护士退休后回国定居的村庄。你可以看到传统的德式房屋和居住在这里的韩裔德国人。其中，约有 30 家以经营宾馆为副业。据说每栋房子都因其独特的室内设计和服务而吸引了许多游客。眼前就是凉爽的海堤和木尔米滨海公路，这是南部海岸最美的滨海自驾路线。

내리문화공원은 지역 주민들에게 문화와 자연을 동시에 즐길 수 있는 공간이.en: Naeri Cultural Park is a space where local residents can enjoy culture and nature at the same time. It is located in a place where you can see Anseongcheon Stream. It is popular with families as it has a large lawn and bicycle path. Various performances and events are held in the lawn yard. You can go up to the observatory and relax while looking at the water of Anseongcheon Stream. In fall, flowers bloom in the pink muli garden, making it a great place to take pictures. The Naeri camping site is located right next to it.
내리문화공원은 지역 주민들에게 문화와 자연을 동시에 즐길 수 있는 공간이.zh: 内里文化公园是当地居民可以同时享受文化和自然的空间。位于可以看到安城川的地方。由于拥有大草坪和自行车道，深受家庭欢迎。草坪上举办各种表演和活动。可以登上展望台，一边眺望安城川的水一边放松身心。秋天，粉色的木里花园里鲜花盛开，是拍照的好地方。 Naeri 露营地就位于其旁边。

내소사는 백제 무왕 34년(633)에 혜구두타(惠丘頭陀)가 세운 절로 원.en: Naesosa Temple was built by Hyegu Duta in 633 (the 34th year of King Mu of Baekje), and its original name was Sorae Temple. Daeungbojeon is a Buddhist temple that enshrines Bodhisattva Bodhisattva and Bodhisattva Bodhisattva on the left and right with Sakyamuni at the center. It is said to have been built by the Great Master Cheongmin in the 11th year of King Injo of the Joseon Dynasty (1633) when he was renovating the temple. The size is 3 rooms in the front and 3 rooms on the sides, and the roof is a gable roof in the shape of the characters 8 (八). The decorative structure to support the eaves of the roof is not only on the pillars but also between pillars in the multi-layer style, and the overlapping appearance of the members extending outward clearly shows the characteristics of architecture in the mid-Joseon Dynasty. In addition, you can get a glimpse of the excellent carving skills of the time in the flower gates of Daeungbojeon, and on the rear wall behind the Buddha statue, there is a seated white-robed Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva, the largest one left in Korea.◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave - Drama <Daejanggeum> In the drama 'Daejanggeum', the impressive scene where Janggeum throws a stone while looking at the pond, and Min Jeong-ho watches it, was filmed in the pond on the grounds of Naesosa Temple. The beautiful scenery around the pond along with the quiet temple atmosphere captures the emotions of the drama more deeply.
내소사는 백제 무왕 34년(633)에 혜구두타(惠丘頭陀)가 세운 절로 원.zh: 那索萨寺是惠久杜塔于633年（百济武王34年）所建，原名苏来寺。大雄宝殿是以释迦牟尼为中心，左右供奉菩萨菩萨和菩萨的佛教寺庙。相传是朝鲜仁祖11年（1633年）清珉大师重修寺庙时所建。规模为正面3间，侧面3间，屋顶为山形屋顶，呈“八”字形。支撑屋顶檐口的装饰结构不仅在柱子上，而且在多层式的柱子之间，向外延伸的构件的重叠外观清楚地显示了朝鲜中期建筑的特征。另外，在大雄宝殿的花门上可以一睹当时精湛的雕刻技艺，佛像背后的后墙上还供奉着韩国现存最大的白衣观世音菩萨坐像。 ◎ 邂逅韩流魅力的旅行信息 - 电视剧《大长今》 电视剧《大长今》中，长今投石观景的场景令人印象深刻闵正浩在观看的池塘，是在内索寺院内的池塘里拍摄的。池塘周围的美丽景色和安静的寺庙气氛更加深刻地捕捉到了戏剧的情感。

가평 노랑다리미술관은 숲속에 꾸며진 개인 미술관으로 다양한 소재로 만든.en: Gapyeong Yellow Bridge Museum is a private art museum set in the forest, where works made of various materials are naturally displayed, and the works can also be viewed in the museum's indoor garden. There is a cafe inside the museum, and the admission fee includes one drink and a cookie snack, and you can enjoy tea while relaxing among the artwork. This place is also known as ‘Gapyeong Travel Destination with Children’, which means that children will also like it. As the name of the museum suggests, the entrance is across the yellow bridge and is decorated so cutely and stylishly that it becomes a popular photo spot. The indoor garden is worth seeing as the works are naturally mixed in with well-trimmed trees. It is quite large and has a space where children can draw and display pictures. In the museum, you can feel nature such as trees, flowers, and birds, so the museum itself is like a forest and a work of art. There is also a valley at the entrance of the museum, where you can relax and feel nature.
가평 노랑다리미술관은 숲속에 꾸며진 개인 미술관으로 다양한 소재로 만든.zh: 加平黄桥博物馆是一座坐落在森林中的私人艺术博物馆，自然地展示着各种材料制成的作品，在博物馆的室内花园中也可以欣赏到这些作品。博物馆内设有咖啡厅，入场费包含一杯饮料和一份饼干小吃，您可以在艺术品中一边喝茶一边放松。这个地方也被称为“加平带孩子的旅行目的地”，这意味着孩子们也会喜欢这里。正如博物馆的名字所暗示的那样，入口处是穿过黄色的桥，装饰得可爱又时尚，成为了一个受欢迎的拍照景点。室内花园值得一看，因为作品与修剪整齐的树木自然地融为一体。它相当大，有一个供孩子们绘画和展示图画的空间。在博物馆里，你可以感受到树木、花、鸟等自然，所以博物馆本身就像一片森林，也是一件艺术品。博物馆门口还有一个山谷，可以在这里放松心情，感受大自然。

이 산은 경기도 이천시 설성면과 안성시 일죽면의 경계를 이루는 해발 31.en: This mountain is a low mountain 310 meters above sea level that forms the border between Seolseong-myeon, Icheon-si, Gyeonggi-do, and Iljuk-myeon, Anseong-si. When you exit Iljuk IC on the Jungbu Expressway and head toward Janghowon, the low mountain you see on the left is Noseongsan Mountain. It is a mountain behind the neighborhood where one can assume that there are no beautiful rocks or rock ridges at all, but there are various strangely shaped rocks such as Oyster Rock, Folding Screen Rock, Horsehead Rock, and Lonely Rock, and there is also a citizen's park under the mountain. The starting point of the hike is the parking lot of Citizens' Park in Geumdang-ri, Seolseong-myeon, Icheon-si, in the north. It only takes 2 hours, including breaks, to go around the mountain and come back down. This mountain has three names, including Nosongsan, Noseungsan, and Noseongsan, but the official administrative name is Noseongsan. It was marked as 310m by referring to the summit marker and information board installed locally. As the first name suggests, Isan has an unusually large number of pine trees. Citizen's Park is the starting point for hiking, and the hiking trail is well-maintained using trees and railway timbers. Not only are there many strangely shaped rocks here and there, but the evening water flows between the cracks in the rocks of Byeongpungbawi Rock and Byeongmokan, providing drinking water. The view from the summit is unobstructed in all directions, and if you climb up on the observatory rock just below the summit, the view of Wongyeongsa Temple and Geumdang Reservoir is even more beautiful. It truly deserves to be called Icheon's Little Salt River, and is suitable for a family-friendly recreational hiking destination.
이 산은 경기도 이천시 설성면과 안성시 일죽면의 경계를 이루는 해발 31.zh: 这座山是京畿道利川市雪城面和安城市一竹面的边界处的一座海拔310米的低山。从中部高速公路一竹IC出来，向长湖园方向行驶，左边看到的低山就是牛城山。这是小区后面的一座山，根本看不到什么美丽的岩石和岩脊，但有牡蛎岩、屏风岩、马头岩、孤独岩等各种奇形怪状的岩石，山下还有一个市民公园。徒步旅行的起点是北部利川市雪城面金堂里市民公园的停车场。绕山一圈再下山只需要2个小时，包括休息时间。这座山有三个名字，包括Nosongsan、Noseungsan和Noseongsan，但官方行政名称是Noseongsan。参考当地安装的山顶标记和信息牌，将其标记为310m。顾名思义，伊桑拥有数量异常多的松树。市民公园是远足的起点，远足步道使用树木和铁路木材维护得很好。不仅到处都有许多奇形怪状的岩石，而且傍晚时分，屏风岩和屏毛坎的岩石缝隙间流淌着水，提供了饮用水。从山顶看去，四面八方的景色都一览无余，如果登上山顶正下方的展望岩，圆庆寺和金堂水库的景色更加美丽。名副其实的利川小盐河，适合家庭休闲徒步的目的地。

경기 가평군 상면 덕현리에 위치한 녹수계곡은 아름다운 청우산(619m)과.en: Noksu Valley, located in Deokhyeon-ri, Sang-myeon, Gapyeong-gun, Gyeonggi-do, is a valley composed of clear, clean water and tall dense forests that flows along the beautiful Cheongwu Mountain (619m) and the clear and clean Jojongcheon Stream. Water flows along the flat land, and the river is wide, deep, and has an abundance of water, making it feel like a riverside rather than a valley in the forest. You can climb to the small Noksubong Peak (370m) along the valley, and the nearby Gitdaebong Peak, Cheongwusan Mountain, Bulgisan Mountain, and Daegeumsan Mountain are connected by a ridge, so you can also hike along the ridge. Low banks are built in the middle of the valley to occasionally stop the flow of water, dividing it into areas where the flow is fast and areas where the water stagnates and is suitable for swimming. There are people who manage safety for each section and lend life jackets. As you go upstream, the width of the valley becomes narrower and the water is deeper, so you must be careful when playing in the water. There is no separate parking lot, so you may park your car on the side of the road upstream. There are some people who cook around the river, but this is a no-cooking area, so cooking is not allowed. Playing in the water in Noksu Valley is good any time of the year: spring, summer, or fall.
경기 가평군 상면 덕현리에 위치한 녹수계곡은 아름다운 청우산(619m)과.zh: 绿水溪谷位于京畿道加平郡上面德贤里，是沿着美丽的青梧山（619m）和清澈洁净的朝宗川流淌的溪谷，清澈见底的水和高大茂密的森林组成。水沿着平坦的土地流淌，河水又宽又深，而且水量充足，让人感觉不像是森林中的山谷，而是河边。沿着山谷可以爬到小绿首峰（370m），附近的吉大峰、青梧山、佛基山、大金山有山脊相连，也可以沿着山脊徒步。山谷中部建有低堤，偶尔阻挡水流，将其分为水流较快的区域和水流停滞、适合游泳的区域。各区域都有专人负责安全管理，并提供救生衣借用。越往上游走，山谷的宽度就越窄，水也就越深，玩水的时候一定要小心。没有单独的停车场，所以你可以把车停在上游的路边。河边也有人做饭，但这里是禁煮区，所以不可以做饭。一年中的任何时间都可以在诺克苏山谷 (Noksu Valley) 戏水：春季、夏季或秋季。

파주 농업기술센터 앞에 있는 농경유물전시관은 사라져 가는 전통 농경 문화.en: The Agricultural Relics Exhibition Hall in front of the Paju Agricultural Technology Center was established with the purpose of raising pride in our culture and promoting a proper understanding of agriculture in future generations through tours of our disappearing traditional agricultural cultural heritage. The exhibition hall is 1 floor underground and 3 floors above ground, and displays about 500 agricultural relics and 200 straw crafts along with related photos and sculptures. The relics come from various eras and regions, from prehistoric times to the Joseon Dynasty, and you can see a variety of farming-related tools and equipment, farming equipment, agricultural products, and straw crafts in one place. The main artifacts on display in this exhibition hall include plowing tools, boiling tools, seeding tools, weeding tools, fertilizing tools, watering tools, harvesting tools, threshing tools, drying tools, mill tools, carrying tools, harvesting tools, livestock farming tools, straw and grass processing tools, food processing tools, weaving tools, and weighing tools.
파주 농업기술센터 앞에 있는 농경유물전시관은 사라져 가는 전통 농경 문화.zh: 坡州农业技术中心前的农业文物陈列馆的设立目的是通过参观我们正在消失的传统农业文化遗产，提高我们的文化自豪感，并促进子孙后代对农业的正确认识。展厅地下1层、地上3层，展出约500件农业文物、200件草编工艺品以及相关照片和雕塑。文物来自各个时代、各个地区，从史前时期到朝鲜王朝，各种与农耕有关的农具设备、农具、农产品、草编工艺品等都集中在一处。本馆展出的主要文物有犁具、煮具、播种工具、除草工具、施肥工具、浇水工具、收割工具、脱粒工具、烘干工具、碾磨工具、搬运工具、收割工具、畜牧业工具、秸秆草加工工具、粮食加工工具、编织工具、衡器等。

뉴코아아울렛 일산점은 마두동에 자리한 패션·잡화 중심의 복합 쇼핑공간이다.en: New Core Outlet Ilsan Branch is a shopping complex centered on fashion and miscellaneous goods located in Madu-dong. There are many E-Land retail brands such as Kim's Club, Modern House, and Luxury Gallery, and it also has a wide range of clothing and household goods for each age group. The 9th floor cultural center is used as a space for local residents’ hobbies and educational programs. It is also comprised of family restaurants, specialty restaurants, and a food mall, making it a great place to enjoy shopping and dining out in one place.
뉴코아아울렛 일산점은 마두동에 자리한 패션·잡화 중심의 복합 쇼핑공간이다.zh: 新核心奥特莱斯一山店是位于马头洞的以时尚杂货为中心的购物中心。衣恋零售品牌众多，如Kim's Club、Modern House、Luxury Gallery等，还拥有适合各个年龄段的各类服装和家居用品。 9楼的文化中心被用作当地居民的兴趣爱好和教育活动的空间。还设有家庭餐厅、特色餐厅、美食城等，是集购物、餐饮为一体的好去处。

뉴코아아울렛 평촌점은 1997년 ‘킴스아울렛’으로 개점한 이후 같은 위치.en: New Core Outlet Pyeongchon Branch is an urban outlet that has been operating in the same location since opening as ‘Kim’s Outlet’ in 1997. It has excellent accessibility as it is directly connected to Beomgye Station on Subway Line 4, and the store structure and circulation were completely reorganized through a major renewal in May 2025. Approximately 260 fashion and miscellaneous goods brands, specialty restaurants, Shupen, Kim's Club, etc. are operated, allowing a variety of products and services to be used in one place. A CGV movie theater and cultural center are also included, so you can enjoy both shopping and leisure. It has a large parking space and efficient circulation, making it highly convenient for visitors.
뉴코아아울렛 평촌점은 1997년 ‘킴스아울렛’으로 개점한 이후 같은 위치.zh: New Core Outlet 坪村店是自 1997 年开业以来一直在同一地点运营的城市奥特莱斯。与地铁 4 号线凡溪站直接相连，交通便利，2025 年 5 月进行了重大更新，彻底重组了店铺结构和动线。运营着约 260 个时尚杂货品牌、特色餐厅、Shupen、Kim's Club 等，可开展多种活动。在一个地方使用的产品和服务。还设有CGV电影院、文化中心，购物休闲两相宜。停车位宽敞，流线高效，为游客提供极大便利。

니지모리스튜디오는 일본의 고전적인 거리 풍경과 다이쇼시대 특유의 감성을.en: Nijimori Studio is a themed cultural complex that reproduces classic Japanese street scenes and the unique sensibility of the Taisho era. It is located in a location that is easily accessible from Seoul and the metropolitan area, and its exterior and interior design with a Japanese street motif embodies a unique concept that is rare in Korea. All elements of the space, including signs, shops, street lighting, and vending machines, faithfully reflect the Japanese retro atmosphere, allowing visitors to have an immersive experience as if they were actually in Japan. This space goes beyond a simple theme park and offers a variety of content such as YouTube videos, advertisements, music videos, SNS content, fashion pictorials, and wedding photography. It is also actively used as a location for production. It is operated not only for filming rentals but also as an experiential space for general visitors, so it is attracting attention as a famous place for the MZ generation and creators to take the best shot of their lives, and as an optimal place for branded content production for brands and planners. Combining differentiated spatiality and content utilization, Nijimori Studio is a place with a strong competitive edge for projects that require emotional and original visuals.
니지모리스튜디오는 일본의 고전적인 거리 풍경과 다이쇼시대 특유의 감성을.zh: 虹森工作室是再现日本经典街景和大正时代独特感性的主题文化综合体。它位于从首尔和首都圈很容易到达的位置，其外部和内部设计以日本街头为主题，体现了韩国罕见的独特概念。空间中的所有元素，包括招牌、商店、路灯、自动售货机，都忠实地体现了日本的复古氛围，让游客有身临其境的身临其境的体验。这个空间不仅仅是一个简单的主题公园，还提供YouTube视频、广告、音乐视频、SNS内容、时尚画报、婚纱摄影等多种内容。它也被积极用作生产地点。它不仅以出租影片的方式运营，还作为普通游客的体验空间而运营，因此作为MZ一代和创作者拍摄生活中最美好的镜头的著名场所，以及作为品牌和策划者的品牌内容制作的最佳场所而受到关注。 Nijimori Studio 结合了差异化的空间性和内容利用，对于需要情感和原创视觉效果的项目来说是一个具有强大竞争优势的地方。

김포다도박물관은 한국 차[茶] 문화역사를 재조명할 수 있도록 개관한 전통.en: Gimpo Tea Ceremony Museum is a private museum specializing in traditional tea ceremony that was opened to shed new light on the cultural history of Korean tea. It is equipped with auxiliary facilities such as a sculpture park, Paldojangdok exhibition, and a gallery on a site of approximately 10,000 pyeong. Behind the museum, a dense forest surrounds it like a folding screen, making it feel like a painting. It is a complex cultural and artistic space that satisfies cultural needs by holding various cultural events and performances, including planning and exhibiting various special exhibitions two to three times a year to reproduce the living, breathing scenes of etiquette and tea culture history and to satisfy the cultural desires of the general public. Children, teenagers, general citizens, and foreigners can receive education on tea ceremonies and traditional etiquette experiences that can help with character education. A pavilion, an ecological pond, and a lawn garden have been created where they can relax in nature, and they can also experience folk games (Tuhorye, Jegichagi, Yutnori, etc.).
김포다도박물관은 한국 차[茶] 문화역사를 재조명할 수 있도록 개관한 전통.zh: 金浦茶道博物馆是一家专门展示传统茶道的私人博物馆，其开馆目的是为了解韩国茶文化历史提供新的视角。占地约1万坪，配有雕塑公园、八道藏德展览、画廊等辅助设施。博物馆后面，茂密的森林像屏风一样包围着它，让人感觉像一幅画。它是通过举办各种文化活动和演出来满足文化需求的复合型文化艺术空间，包括每年策划和举办2至3次各种专题展览，再现礼仪和茶文化历史的鲜活场景，满足广大民众的文化欲望。儿童、青少年、普通民众和外国人都可以接受有助于品格教育的茶道教育和传统礼仪体验。还建有凉亭、生态池塘和草坪花园，让人们在大自然中放松身心，还可以体验民间游戏（Tuhorye、Jegichagi、Yutnori 等）。

다산체육공원 축구장은 남양주시 다산동에 위치한 생활체육시설이다. 축구장의.en: Dasan Sports Park Soccer Field is a recreational sports facility located in Dasan-dong, Namyangju-si. All elements, including the size of the soccer field and goalposts, are of the regular size, and the turf is always maintained in optimal condition. In addition to the soccer field, the park has several sports facilities, including tennis courts and foot volleyball courts, which citizens can conveniently use by making reservations. The large site also has a park-like space, making it ideal for taking a walk after exercising or resting in nature.
다산체육공원 축구장은 남양주시 다산동에 위치한 생활체육시설이다. 축구장의.zh: 茶山体育公园足球场是位于南杨州市茶山洞的休闲体育设施。所有元素，包括足球场和球门柱的尺寸，均为常规尺寸，并且草坪始终保持最佳状态。除足球场外，公园内还设有网球场、足排球场等多项体育设施，市民通过预约即可方便使用。广阔的场地还拥有公园般的空间，非常适合在大自然中锻炼或休息后散步。

&nbsp;단국대학교 죽전캠퍼스에 있는 난사 석주선(1911~1996).en: This is a museum commemorating the achievements of Dr. Seok Ju-seon (1911-1996) of Nansa, located on the Jukjeon Campus of Dankook University. The Department of History, which was established with the opening of the school in 1947, conducted regular or frequent field trips every year from the beginning and collected many relics, and based on this, an archeology room was established on September 1, 1961. Afterwards, it was launched as the university-affiliated central museum on November 3, 1967, immediately after the university was promoted to a comprehensive university. On May 2, 1981, Dr. Seok Ju-seon, an authority in the field of Korean clothing history, donated 3,365 pieces of folk relics (costumes) collected throughout his life, and the school opened the Seok Ju-seon Memorial Folk Museum to commemorate his noble spirit and contributions, and to educate the future and develop and preserve national cultural assets through research and preservation of folk relics. On March 26, 1999, ''Central Museum'' and ''Seok Juseon Memorial Folk Museum'' were merged and the name was renamed to ''Seok Juseon Memorial Museum'', which continues to this day. Dr. Seok Ju-seon, a pioneer in the field of Korean clothing history and an authority in folklore studies, donated 3,365 pieces of traditional clothing and folk relics collected throughout his life. The museum is largely divided into an archaeological museum and a folk costume museum. The first floor has a total of five exhibition halls, and the second floor is a research and data room with facilities such as an artifact restoration and conservation science laboratory and a convention hall. It houses a total of 40,000 artifacts, of which about 1,500 are on display. In particular, 11 items and 100 pieces of relics, including An Jung-geun's ink (treasure) and Princess Deokon's dangui, have been designated as important folk cultural properties, and diplomat Lee Beom-jin's [Missage Log], which records his activities as an envoy to the United States, has been designated as a nationally registered cultural property. It takes about 8 minutes by car from Jukjeon Station on the Suin Bundang Line, and there is a bus that goes from the station to the campus. Nearby are the Gyeonggi Provincial Museum, Gyeonggi Provincial Children's Museum, and Korean Folk Village.
&nbsp;단국대학교 죽전캠퍼스에 있는 난사 석주선(1911~1996).zh: 位于檀国大学竹田校区内，是纪念南沙大学石周善博士（1911-1996）功绩的博物馆。 1947年建校时设立的历史系，从建校之初每年都会进行定期或频繁的实地考察，收集了许多文物，并在此基础上于1961年9月1日成立了考古室。1967年11月3日升格为综合性大学后，作为校属中央博物馆启用。 1981年5月2日，韩国服装史领域的权威石周善博士捐赠了其一生收藏的3365件民间文物（服饰），学校开设了石周善纪念民俗博物馆，以纪念他的崇高精神和贡献，通过民间文物的研究和保存，教育未来，发展和保存国家文化遗产。 1999年3月26日，“中央博物馆”与“石周善纪念民俗博物馆”合并，更名为“石周善纪念馆”，并延续至今。韩国服装史领域的先驱、民俗研究的权威石柱善博士捐赠了他一生收集的3,365件传统服装和民间文物。博物馆主要分为考古博物馆和民族服饰博物馆。一楼共有五个展厅，二楼是研究和资料室，设有文物修复和保护科学实验室和会议厅等设施。馆内共藏有 40,000 件文物，其中展出约 1,500 件。特别是，安重根的墨汁、德建公主的丹桂等11件、100件文物被指定为重要民间文化遗产，记录其出使美国活动的外交官李范镇的《信函日志》被指定为国家注册文化财产。从水仁盆唐线竹田站乘车约8分钟，有公交车前往校园。附近有京畿道博物馆、京畿道儿童博物馆、韩国民俗村。

충북 단양군 단양읍 고수동굴길 8에 자리한 단양 고수동굴(천연기념물)은.en: Danyang Gosu Cave (Natural Monument), located at 8 Gosu Cave-gil, Danyang-eup, Danyang-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do, is one of the mysterious and beautiful natural caves. Inside the 1,700m long cave, there are many things to see, including stalactites, stalagmites, cave corals, cave pearls, natural bridges, and aragonite, a rare stalactite. It is no exaggeration to say that you can see almost anything that is created in a limestone cave. The highlight of Gosu Cave is the amazing scenery created by nature and time, including Lion Rock, Dodamsambong Rock, Mary Statue, and Love Rock. In particular, Course B, which had been restricted from viewing, has been opened to the public since April 2013, adding to the attractions. It is a good educational place for children as they can get a glimpse of ancient nature and prehistoric life.
충북 단양군 단양읍 고수동굴길 8에 자리한 단양 고수동굴(천연기념물)은.zh: 丹阳古水洞（天然纪念物）位于忠清北道丹阳郡丹阳邑古水洞街8号，是神秘而美丽的天然洞穴之一。洞内长1700米，钟乳石、石笋、洞珊瑚、洞珍珠、天生桥、文石等珍稀钟乳石等，可观赏性极强。毫不夸张地说，您几乎可以看到石灰岩洞穴中创造的任何东西。古水洞的亮点是自然和时间创造的令人惊叹的风景，包括狮子岩、岛潭三峰、玛丽雕像和爱情岩。尤其是原本禁止参观的B路线，自2013年4月开始向公众开放，增添了更多的魅力。对于孩子们来说，这是一个很好的教育场所，因为他们可以一睹古老的自然和史前生活。

굽이치는 남한강가에 우뚝 서있는 다누리센터는 단양의 랜드마크이다. 국·내.en: Danuri Center, which stands tall on the winding Namhan River, is a landmark of Danyang. It is the largest freshwater ecological aquarium in Korea, where 23,000 domestic and foreign freshwater fish of 234 species swim leisurely in various tanks, including a large aquarium with a height of 8 meters. You can enjoy a fantastic underwater trip by encountering various domestic freshwater fish, including yellow mantis, silverfish, and leadfish, which are native fish of the Namhan River, as well as rare foreign freshwater fish, such as the Hongryong, the most protected species in China, and the Amazon giant piraruq, which are said to bring health and good luck. In addition, Danuri Aquarium's aquarium is decorated with the theme of the Eight Scenic Views of Danyang, providing another attraction. For children, it is a fountain of learning and an optimal ecological learning place, and for adults, it is a hall of memories and happiness where they can look back on their childhood days. Above all, since it is next to Danyang Intercity Bus Terminal, it is easy to find and has good accessibility, so many people come here.
굽이치는 남한강가에 우뚝 서있는 다누리센터는 단양의 랜드마크이다. 국·내.zh: 丹努里中心高耸于蜿蜒的南汉江畔，是丹阳的地标性建筑。这里是韩国最大的淡水生态水族馆，拥有234种23000条国内外淡水鱼在各种水槽中悠闲地游动，其中包括一个高度8米的大型水族馆。您可以邂逅南汉江原生鱼类黄螳螂、蠹鱼、铅鱼等多种国产淡水鱼，以及中国最受保护的红龙鱼、据说能带来健康和好运的亚马逊巨皮拉鲁克等稀有外国淡水鱼，享受梦幻般的水下之旅。此外，丹努里水族馆的水族馆以丹阳八景为主题进行装饰，又增添了一大看点。对于孩子来说，这里是学习的源泉，是最佳的生态学习场所；对于成年人来说，这里是回忆童年的快乐殿堂。最重要的是，由于紧邻丹阳城际客运站，很好找，交通也很好，所以来这里的人很多。

* 기암과 계곡의 만남이 장관을 이루는 사인암 *사인암은 단양 8경 중.en: *Sainam Hermitage is a spectacular combination of strangely shaped rocks and a valley. *Sainam Rock is one of the eight scenic views of Danyang. It is a 70m high strangely shaped rock cliff along the deep blue stream along the Namjo Stream in the south of Danyang. Sainam is located on the side of Namjocheon (aka Ungyecheon), where a wide rock like a folding screen forms a straight wall and boasts majesty. Sainam is a biotite granite from the Cretaceous period of the Mesozoic Era. The plate-shaped joints and vertical joints are well developed, making the granite body look like a square pillar. The granite body in this area has well-developed joints, including tors, on the upper part, forming a unique landscape, and is located near a river, where eroded landforms such as potholes and barrels are distributed. In addition, there is Cheongnyeonam Hermitage, a hermitage from the Goryeo Dynasty, and you can go trekking using the Seonamgol Ecological Trail, making it a place where many scenic values, culture, history, ecology, and geological values ​​are combined. * Origin of the name Sain-am * It is said that Jae-gwang Lim, who served as the governor of Danyang-gun during the reign of King Seongjong of the Joseon Dynasty, named it Sain-am because Woo-tak, a scholar from Danyang in the late Goryeo Dynasty and well-versed in epidemiology, stayed here while he was serving as an official of the fourth rank, ‘Sain,’ a position that assists the king.
* 기암과 계곡의 만남이 장관을 이루는 사인암 *사인암은 단양 8경 중.zh: * Sainam Hermitage 是形状奇特的岩石和山谷的壮观组合。 *塞南岩是丹阳八景之一。它是丹阳南部南乔溪沿岸深蓝色溪流上的一处70m高的奇形岩崖。西南位于南朝川（又名云溪川）一侧，屏风般的宽阔岩石形成直墙，气势磅礴。 Sainam是中生代白垩纪时期的黑云母花岗岩。板状节理和垂直节理十分发达，使花岗岩体呈方柱状。该区花岗岩体上部节理发育，有突起，形成独特的景观，且靠近河流，分布着坑洼、桶状等侵蚀地貌。此外，还有高丽时代的清莲庵，还可以利用仙岩谷生态步道进行徒步旅行，这里是风景名胜、文化、历史、生态、地质等多种价值融为一体的地方。 * 新岩名称的由来 * 据说，朝鲜成宗时期担任丹阳郡知事的林在光因高丽末期丹阳学者、精通流行病学的佑德曾在此担任辅佐国王的四品“新岩”而在此居住，因此将这里命名为“新岩”。

총길이 1.2km의 단양강 잔도길에는 그동안 접근하기 어려웠던 남한강 암.en: The Danyang River Trail, which is 1.2km long, has a trail along the rock wall of the Namhan River that has been difficult to access, allowing you to experience the romance and thrill of trekking with your whole body. By installing night lighting, it was selected as one of the top 100 night tours in 2020 and is leading Danyang-gun as a residential tourist city. Nearby attractions such as the Moss Tunnel, Mancheonha Skywalk, Suyang Gaeseon Relics Exhibition Hall, and Suyanggae Light Tunnel have also been created to provide experiences encompassing tourism, geology, and history.
총길이 1.2km의 단양강 잔도길에는 그동안 접근하기 어려웠던 남한강 암.zh: 丹阳江步道全长1.2公里，沿着一直难以进入的南汉江岩壁有一条步道，让您全身心体验徒步的浪漫与惊险。通过安装夜间照明，被选为2020年夜间旅游百强之一，在住宅型旅游城市中领先于丹阳郡。附近还修建了苔藓隧道、万千花天空步道、水阳开善遗址展示馆、水阳开光隧道等景点，提供旅游、地质和历史等体验。

단양군에는 단양장, 영춘장, 매포장 등의 5일장이 서는데 그중 가장 큰.en: In Danyang-gun, there are five-day markets such as Danyang Market, Yeongchun Market, and Maepo Market, the largest of which is Danyang Market. Danyang Market is the largest traditional market in Danyang-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do, and opens a five-day market on the 1st and 6th of every month. At any market, there are long lines of various agricultural and marine products, daily necessities, industrial products, etc., but vegetables and beans grown by rural seniors, and wild greens collected from Sobaeksan Mountain make you feel nostalgic for your hometown, and you can see old daily necessities (e.g., brooms, brooms, etc.) that cannot be found in large department stores or marts. In particular, garlic dumplings made with fillings kneaded with directly boiled garlic oil are popular. ◎ Travel information to discover the charms of the Korean Wave Enhyphen’s own content is the first market we visited upon arriving in Danyang. There are plenty of foods to taste in Danyang, including black garlic chicken gangjeong, which Seonwoo was looking forward to from the taxi, as well as bugak, pancakes, makgeolli, and boiled Neungi duck.
단양군에는 단양장, 영춘장, 매포장 등의 5일장이 서는데 그중 가장 큰.zh: 丹阳郡有丹阳市场、永春市场、梅浦市场等五日市场，其中最大的是丹阳市场。丹阳市场是忠清北道丹阳郡最大的传统市场，每月1日和6日开放为期5天的市场。任何一个市场，各种农水产品、日用品、工业品等都排着长队，但农村老人种植的蔬菜、豆类、小白山采摘的野菜等都让人怀念故乡，还可以看到大型百货商店或市场里找不到的古老生活用品（扫把、扫帚等）。尤其是用直接煮沸的蒜油揉成的馅料制成的蒜蓉饺子很受欢迎。 ◎ 探寻韩流魅力的旅游资讯 Enhyphen自有内容是我们到达丹阳后第一个去的市场。丹阳的美食有很多，包括善宇在出租车上期待的黑蒜鸡姜丁，还有臭豆腐、煎饼、马格利酒和煮鸭子。

대구에서 가장 오래된 도심 공원인 달성공원은 역사의 흔적을 품고 있다..en: Dalseong Park, the oldest urban park in Daegu, contains traces of history. Dalgubeol's earthen fortress, originally an old tribal nation in Daegu, is a fortress built in the earliest period in the history of castle development in Korea, and the name Dalseong Park also comes from the earthen fortress. Dalseong Park is located in the center of the city, so transportation is convenient, and there are historical sites within the park, so it is used as an educational center for children and youth. In addition, it is popular with families as it has a harmony of rare large trees and landscaping trees, and a zoo where you can see deer, ostriches, seals, tigers, etc. There are many benches and rest areas here and there, and there is a path that goes around the park, making it great for taking a leisurely stroll.
대구에서 가장 오래된 도심 공원인 달성공원은 역사의 흔적을 품고 있다..zh: 达城公园是大邱最古老的城市公园，蕴藏着历史的痕迹。达古伐土城原本是大邱的一个古老的部落国家，是韩国城堡发展史上最早建造的一座城池，达城公园的名字也来源于土城。达城公园位于市中心，交通便利，公园内有历史遗迹，因此被用作儿童和青少年的教育中心。此外，这里珍稀大树和园林树木和谐相处，还有动物园，可以看到鹿、鸵鸟、海豹、老虎等，很受家庭欢迎。到处都有很多长椅和休息区，还有一条环绕公园的小路，非常适合悠闲漫步。

닭머루 입구에서 신촌포구까지의 구간으로 나무데크로 이어진 전망대와 산책로.en: The section from the entrance to Dakmeoru to Sinchon Port has an observatory and walking path connected to a wooden deck, and fall to early winter is a good time to visit the Dakmeoru coastal road. Dakmeor Rock was named so because it resembles a chicken digging up the soil and sitting in it. This place, which boasts a beautiful sea view, is already well known to local residents, but is not yet well-known to travelers. Therefore, it is the perfect place to enjoy a quiet walk and take pictures. In the area where the Dakmeor Rock is located, there is a road made of wooden decks, and there is a coastal pavilion at the end of the road. The path leading to the coastal pavilion is filled with silver grass that has become abundant in the fall, creating a great backdrop for taking pictures. In particular, this is a popular sunset spot, so it is recommended to take pictures just before the sun sets. Silver grass and the setting autumn sun will create a beautiful background and lighting. (Source: Jeju Culture and Tourism website)
닭머루 입구에서 신촌포구까지의 구간으로 나무데크로 이어진 전망대와 산책로.zh: 从 Dakmeeru 入口到新村港的路段设有展望台和与木甲板相连的步行道，秋季到初冬是游览 Dakmeeru 沿海道路的好时机。达克美岩因形似一只掘土并坐在其中的鸡而得名。这个拥有美丽海景的地方已经为当地居民所熟知，但尚未为游客所熟知。因此，这里是享受安静散步和拍照的绝佳场所。在达克美岩所在的地区，有一条木板铺成的路，路的尽头有一座滨海亭。通往滨海阁的小路上长满了秋天茂密的紫芒，非常适合拍照。特别是这里是著名的日落景点，因此建议在日落之前拍照。芒草和秋日的夕阳将营造出美丽的背景和灯光。 （来源：济州文化观光网）

메타 프로방스는 연간 약 500만 명의 관광객이 방문하는 전라남도 담양에.en: Meta Provence is a tourist complex built in Damyang, Jeollanam-do, visited by about 5 million tourists annually. It is located right next to Damyang Metasequoia Road, which has been selected as the most beautiful tree-lined road in Korea. It has the feel of a replica of Provence, a French city famous as a resort. Meta Provence is comprised of an open space where culture, art, and business coexist, including a fashion street, design workshops and experience centers, commercial spaces, and banquet halls for individual tourists as well as families and club tourists. We strive to provide special memories and new experiences to everyone who visits us through diverse and differentiated high-quality services.
메타 프로방스는 연간 약 500만 명의 관광객이 방문하는 전라남도 담양에.zh: 梅塔普罗旺斯是位于全罗南道潭阳市的旅游综合体，每年接待游客约 500 万人次。紧邻被选为韩国最美绿树大道的潭阳水杉路。它具有复制普罗旺斯的感觉，普罗旺斯是一座以度假胜地而闻名的法国城市。梅塔普罗旺斯由一个文化、艺术和商业共存的开放空间组成，包括时尚街、设计工作室和体验中心、商业空间以及适合散客、家庭和俱乐部游客的宴会厅。我们力求通过多元化、差异化的高品质服务，为每一位来访的客人提供特殊的回忆和新的体验。

경기도 여주시 대신면에 위치한 당남리섬은 수도권의 대표적인 경관농업단지로.en: Dangnam-ri Island, located in Daeshin-myeon, Yeoju-si, Gyeonggi-do, is a representative landscape agricultural complex in the metropolitan area and is famous for a variety of flowers blooming seasonally, such as rape flowers, lavender, buckwheat flowers, cosmos, and pink muhly. Yeoju City also planted rapeseed flowers, pink muhly, and kenaf on an area of ​​approximately 14,700 m2 this spring. The largest Kenyan forest in the country, an environmentally purifying plant that absorbs more than five times more carbon dioxide, is being created.
경기도 여주시 대신면에 위치한 당남리섬은 수도권의 대표적인 경관농업단지로.zh: 堂南里岛位于京畿道骊州市大新面，是首都圈代表性的景观农业园区，以油菜花、薰衣草、荞麦花、波斯菊、粉花等各种季节性花卉而闻名。今年春天，骊州市还种植了油菜花、红麻、红麻等，面积约14,700平方米。肯尼亚正在建造该国最大的森林，这是一种环境净化植物，可吸收五倍以上的二氧化碳。

닻미술관은 사진과 책을 중심으로 예술을 통한 나눔을 실천하고자 2010년.en: The Anchor Art Museum opened in October 2010 to practice sharing through art, focusing on photography and books. It is an organic space where inner reflection takes place through creative experiences outside the time and space of the modern city. Utilizing a large site surrounded by forests, we introduce exhibitions that resonate with nature and art, and operate a frame wild garden, woodworking shop, photography studio, residency, and greenhouse. In addition, the Anchor Art Museum, a small art museum in the forest, is a place where you can escape from your busy daily life and relax while looking at the works on display.
닻미술관은 사진과 책을 중심으로 예술을 통한 나눔을 실천하고자 2010년.zh: 安佳美术馆于2010年10月开业，以艺术实践分享，以摄影和书籍为主。这是一个有机空间，通过现代城市时空之外的创意体验进行内心反思。利用被森林包围的广阔场地，引进与自然和艺术产生共鸣的展览，并运营框架野生花园、木工店、摄影工作室、住宅和温室。此外，安佳艺术博物馆是一座位于森林中的小型艺术博物馆，是您逃离繁忙日常生活，一边欣赏展出作品一边放松身心的地方。

한국 농림부에서 지정한 동물복지와 산림보존에 특화된 목장이다. 넓은 초지.en: It is a ranch specializing in animal welfare and forest conservation designated by the Korean Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry. Sheep graze freely on large pastures. The ranch, which completed its first barn in 1989 and introduced sheep in 1991, has grown into a ranch with the highest level of sheep breeding system in Korea. There are two main things to enjoy at Daegwallyeong Sheep Farm: walking on a trail and feeding. You can walk along trails where wild plants grow and meet flocks of sheep grazing in the grasslands. For reference, sheep are grazed from mid-May to late October when grass grows in the pasture, and live in barns in the winter. There is a wooden hut at the beginning of the trail, and the Baekdudaegan Mountain Range seen from 920m above sea level, the midpoint of the trail and the top of the ranch, refreshes the congested heart.
한국 농림부에서 지정한 동물복지와 산림보존에 특화된 목장이다. 넓은 초지.zh: 是韩国农林部指定的专门从事动物福利和森林保护的牧场。羊群在宽阔的牧场上自由自在地吃草。该牧场于1989年建成了第一个谷仓，并于1991年引进了羊，现已发展成为韩国羊饲养系统水平最高的牧场。在大关岭羊牧场主要有两件事：散步和喂食。您可以沿着野生植物生长的小径漫步，遇见在草原上吃草的羊群。作为参考，羊在5月中旬至10月下旬牧场长草时放牧，冬季住在谷仓里。步道的起点有一间木屋，从海拔920m、步道的中点和牧场的山顶看到的白头大干山脉，让充血的心感到清爽。

1920년대에 천황당지를 매립하여 지금의 장소로 이전한 대구 큰 장이라고.en: Seomun Market, said to be Daegu's largest market, was relocated to its current location in the 1920s by reclaiming the Emperor's Hall site and has a long history. The three major markets of the Joseon Dynasty were Daegu, Pyongyang, and Ganggyeong. Because it was located on the west side of Daegu Fortress, it was called Seomun Market. At first, the motorcycle alley around Bonjeon Coffee Shop in Marketbuk-ro, about 300 meters away from the fortress, was the market, and it is said to be open on the 2nd and 7th of every month. The alley names of Hongdukkaejeon and Chicken Jeon remain to this day. Textile-related items are the main products, and the scale is so large that there is everything including castings and fabrics, fabrics, fabrics, crafts, men's and women's clothing, dishes, and dried seafood. It has a warm atmosphere and is conveniently equipped with heating and cooling facilities and a large parking lot.
1920년대에 천황당지를 매립하여 지금의 장소로 이전한 대구 큰 장이라고.zh: 西门市场据说是大邱最大的市场，1920年代通过填海天皇殿遗址迁至现址，历史悠久。朝鲜王朝的三大市场是大邱、平壤、江京。因为位于大邱城西侧，所以被称为西门市场。最初，距城墙约300米的市场北路本田咖啡店周围的摩托车胡同是市场，据说每月2号和7号开放。红豆花田和鸡田的巷名至今仍保留着。以纺织相关物品为主，规模之大，铸件、布料、布艺、布艺、工艺品、男女服装、菜肴、海味干货等一应俱全。气氛温馨，交通便利，配备冷暖设施和大型停车场。
