강원도 삼척시 대이리 동굴 지대에 위치한 대금굴은 인근에 있는 환선굴,.en: Daegeum Cave, located in the Daeiri Cave area in Samcheok-si, Gangwon-do, was formed at a similar time as the nearby Hwanseon Cave and Gwaneum Cave. It was opened to the public after a total of 7 years of preparation, including 4 years for the cave's discovery and 3 years for the installation of facilities. Inside the cave, cave formations such as stalactites, stalagmites, and stone columns are well developed. In particular, a large amount of cave water of unknown origin flows underground, forming several large and small waterfalls and cave lakes. The topography of this place is an area where the Pungchon Formation and Atmospheric Rocks of the Joseon Supergroup, a sedimentary rock class of the Lower Paleozoic Era from the Camburian to the Ordovician Period, are distributed about 530 million years ago. The topography, including coral reefs deposited in the deep tropical sea, reached its current location due to tectonic changes and eroded over a long period of time to form caves. Currently, Daegeum Cave is only accessible by monorail, and you must make an online reservation at least one day before your visit to enter.
강원도 삼척시 대이리 동굴 지대에 위치한 대금굴은 인근에 있는 환선굴,.zh: 大金洞窟位于江原道三陟市大梨洞窟地区，与附近的幻仙洞窟和观音洞窟形成于同一时期。经过7年的筹备，其中发现洞穴4年、设施安装3年，洞窟正式向公众开放。洞内钟乳石、石笋、石柱等溶洞十分发育。尤其是大量不明来源的洞水流淌在地下，形成了数个大大小小的瀑布和洞湖。该地的地形是大约5.3亿年前寒武纪至奥陶纪下古生代沉积岩类朝鲜超群的丰村组和大气岩的分布区域。地形，包括热带深海沉积的珊瑚礁，由于构造变化而达到现在的位置，并经过长时间的侵蚀形成洞穴。目前，大金洞只能乘坐单轨电车前往，并且必须至少在参观前一天在线预约才能进入。

창원시에 위치한 대동백화점은 1990년 9월에 설립하였으며, 지역주민들을.en: Daedong Department Store, located in Changwon City, was established in September 1990, and has become a shopping space for local residents, and at times a place for residents as a various cultural space, and a new resting place for local residents. There are about 300 brands, selling a variety of products that meet customer needs. In addition, we run a program called the Moon Knight Festival four times a year that provides discounts, attractions, and memories to become more friendly and strengthen bonds with local residents.
창원시에 위치한 대동백화점은 1990년 9월에 설립하였으며, 지역주민들을.zh: 位于昌原市的大同百货商店于1990年9月成立，已成为当地居民的购物空间，有时也成为居民的各种文化空间和新的休息场所。约有300个品牌，销售各种满足客户需求的产品。此外，我们每年举办四次“月光骑士节”活动，提供折扣、景点和回忆，以增强与当地居民的友好度并加强联系。

대둔산 케이블카는 1990년 11월에 운행을 개시했다. 선로길이 927m.en: Daedunsan Cable Car began operation in November 1990. It is a two-way cable car with a track length of 927m and an incline of 23 degrees, with two cars crossing each other. It is a comfortable and safe cable car that can allow up to 50 people to reach the upper station in about 5 minutes. Daedun Mountain's majestic mountain range and strangely shaped rocks, seen from the cable car, spread out like a folding screen, creating a spectacular view. The mountain view seen from the top of the cable car is an unexplored area comparable to Mt. Geumgangsan, and the Geumgang Cloud Bridge and Samseon Cloud Bridge above are considered famous attractions. Cable car boarding passes can be issued sequentially on the day of boarding, and advance reservations are not possible.
대둔산 케이블카는 1990년 11월에 운행을 개시했다. 선로길이 927m.zh: 大顿山缆车于1990年11月开始运营，是双向缆车，轨道长927m，倾斜度23度，两节车厢交叉。这是一种舒适安全的缆车，最多可承载50人，约5分钟即可到达上站。从缆车上看大顿山雄伟的山脉和奇形怪状的岩石像屏风一样展开，蔚为壮观。从缆车顶部看到的山景是可与金刚山媲美的秘境，上面的金刚云桥和三仙云桥也算是著名景点。缆车登机牌可在乘车当天依次发放，且不可提前预订。

안산의 하와이로 불리는 대부도는 시화방조제로 연결이 되어 육지가 된 섬이.en: Daebudo Island, called the Hawaii of Ansan, is an island connected to the mainland by the Sihwa seawall, but the romance and lyricism of the island still remain in many places. Above all, on the way to Daebudo Island, you can enjoy a unique drive that connects islands. If you cross Seonjae Bridge from Daebudo Island, you will enter Seonjae Island, and if you cross Yeongheung Bridge from Seonjae Island again, you will enter Yeongheung Island. Tando Island, said to have black stones, Buddha Island, where Buddha appeared, Seongamdo Island, where immortals roamed, Yukdo Island, so-called because six islands stand shoulder to shoulder like brothers in the West Sea, and Pungdo Island, which has a unique lifestyle of moving to nearby Dorido Island to collect oysters and clams in winter and returning before the Lunar New Year the following year, is a place that retains its unique charm. Daebudo Island is a place where you can enjoy the mud flat experience on the wide mud flat, and the sunset. The scenery at dusk is beautiful, and the clam kalguksu and clam grill restaurants lined up along the coast are also famous, making it a popular day outing course for citizens of the metropolitan area.
안산의 하와이로 불리는 대부도는 시화방조제로 연결이 되어 육지가 된 섬이.zh: 大扶岛被称为安山的夏威夷，是一座通过始华海堤与大陆相连的岛屿，但岛上的浪漫和抒情在许多地方仍然保留着。最重要的是，在前往大阜岛的途中，您可以享受连接岛屿的独特驾驶体验。从大扶岛过仙才桥就进入仙才岛，再从仙才岛过灵兴桥就进入灵兴岛。据说有黑色石头的炭岛、佛陀出现的佛岛、神仙漫游的仙岩岛、西海六岛并肩而立而得名的六岛、以及冬天到附近的多利岛采集牡蛎和蛤蜊并在第二年农历新年之前返回的独特生活方式的丰岛，是一个保留着独特魅力的地方。大扶岛是一个可以在宽阔的泥滩上享受泥滩体验和日落的地方。黄昏时的景色很美，沿岸排列的蛤蜊刀切菜店和蛤蜊烧烤店也很有名，是首都圈市民一日游的热门路线。

대부산은 경기도 가평군 설악면과 양평군 옥천면 경계에 있는 산으로 높이는.en: Daebusan Mountain is a mountain located on the border of Seorak-myeon, Gapyeong-gun, Gyeonggi-do and Okcheon-myeon, Yangpyeong-gun, and is 743m high. It is a peak rising to the south of Yumyeongsan Mountain and is called Daebusan Mountain because it is a mountain that separates Seorak-myeon and Okcheon-myeon along with Yumyeongsan Mountain opposite it. The mountain group consisting of Daebusan Mountain, Yumyeongsan Mountain, Eobisan Mountain, Sogunisan Mountain, and Yongmunsan Mountain boasts rare scenery in Gyeonggi-do. Daebusan has another name, Eobisan. A long time ago, it was said that fish would swim over the mountain during floods, so it became Eobisan Mountain. That's why this mountain has the name Bannermijae. Bannermijae has the meaning of ''the hill that ships used to cross''. Daebusan Mountain is also famous for its silver grass. Before silver grass took over this mountain, this was a place where slash-and-burn farmers set fires to cultivate their fields. Then, in the 1960s, after the slash-and-burn farmers left, it was occupied by highland vegetables, and about 20 years ago, it became a silver grass field. Below the eastern summit of Daebusan Mountain is an open silver grass plain. Daebusan Mountain was also the filming location for the movie 'Counseling', and the set of Neowajip remains. To get to Daebusan, take National Highway No. 6 toward Yangpyeong-eup, turn left at the Goeup intersection in Okcheon-myeon, go straight past Okcheon Naengmyeon Village, and pass Seolmaejae Natural Recreation Forest to reach the summit of Bannermijae.
대부산은 경기도 가평군 설악면과 양평군 옥천면 경계에 있는 산으로 높이는.zh: 大釜山是位于京畿道加平郡雪岳面和杨平郡沃川面交界处的一座山，海拔743m。是耸立在有明山南面的山峰，与对面的有明山隔开雪岳面和沃川面，因此被称为大扶山。由大釜山、有明山、御飞山、小国山、龙门山组成的山群，拥有京畿道罕见的风景。大釜山还有另一个名字，Eobisan。很久以前，据说洪水泛滥时鱼会游过山，所以这里就成了御飞山。这就是为什么这座山被称为Bannermijae。 Bannermijae 的意思是“船只曾经经过的山丘”。大釜山还因紫芒而闻名。在芒草占领这座山之前，这里是农民刀耕火种耕田的地方。然后到了1960年代，刀耕火种的农民离开后，这里被高原蔬菜占据，大约20年前，这里变成了芒草田。大釜山东山顶下是一片开阔的芒草平原。大釜山还是电影《辅导》的拍摄地，现在还保留着《Neowajip》的拍摄地。前往大釜山时，沿国道6号线向杨平邑方向行驶，在沃川面古邑十字路口左转，直行经过沃川冷面村，经过雪梅斋自然休养林，即可到达斑马美斋山顶。

대유평공원은 경기도 수원시 장안구에 위치한 대규모 공원으로, 시민들의 여.en: Daeyupyeong Park is a large park located in Jangan-gu, Suwon-si, Gyeonggi-do, and is a green space created for citizens' leisure and relaxation. It has a large lawn and a walking path, and is in harmony with the surrounding natural environment, allowing you to enjoy a pleasant rest in the city. Because of its good accessibility, it is suitable for various activities such as family outings, walks, and exercise.
대유평공원은 경기도 수원시 장안구에 위치한 대규모 공원으로, 시민들의 여.zh: 大裕坪公园是位于京畿道水原市长安区的大型公园，是为市民休闲、放松而打造的绿地。拥有大片草坪和步行道，与周边自然环境融为一体，让您在城市中享受愉快的休息。由于其通达性好，适合家庭出游、散步、锻炼身体等各种活动。

대전역 동광장은 대전시 동구 소제동에 자리 잡고 있다. 음식점과 술집 등.en: Daejeon Station East Plaza is located in Soje-dong, Dong-gu, Daejeon. It is a square with a different atmosphere from West Square, which is lined with restaurants, bars, and other food establishments. This is a meeting plaza for people going to and from Daejeon Station. It is the gateway you must pass through when getting on or off the train, and there are many parking facilities nearby. In addition, the Hoguk Railroad Plaza, a neighborhood park with sculptures, has been created, so the west plaza is called Daejeon Station Square and the east plaza is called the Hoguk Railroad Plaza. It is also good to enjoy other courses starting from Daejeon Dong Square.
대전역 동광장은 대전시 동구 소제동에 자리 잡고 있다. 음식점과 술집 등.zh: 大田站东广场位于大田广域市东区小济洞。这是一个与西广场不同氛围的广场，西广场两旁都是餐馆、酒吧和其他美食场所。这是往返大田站的人们的集合广场。是上下火车必须经过的关口，附近有很多停车设施。另外，还修建了有雕塑的邻里公园“护国铁道广场”，因此西侧广场被称为大田车站广场，东侧广场被称为“护国铁道广场”。从大田东广场出发享受其他路线也不错。

대전오월드는 주랜드, 플라워랜드, 조이랜드, 버드랜드, 나이트 유니버스로.en: Daejeon O-World is the largest complex theme park in the central region, consisting of Zoo Land, Flower Land, Joy Land, Bird Land, and Night Universe. Zoo Land has a space where you can see various animals, including the Korean Wolf Safari and African Safari. At Joyland, you can enjoy thrilling rides such as Giant Drop, Flume Ride, and Super Viking. Flower Land is a garden-type space where flowers, water, and light are in harmony, and at Bird Land, you can experience rare birds and a tropical garden. Night Universe provides nighttime content based on digital media, such as hologram shows and musical fountain water shows.
대전오월드는 주랜드, 플라워랜드, 조이랜드, 버드랜드, 나이트 유니버스로.zh: 大田O世界是中部地区最大的复合型主题公园，由动物园乐园、花乐园、欢乐乐园、鸟乐园和夜宇宙组成。动物园乐园有韩国狼野生动物园和非洲野生动物园等可以观赏各种动物的空间。在Joyland，您可以享受Giant Drop、Flume Ride、Super Viking等惊险刺激的游乐设施。花乐园是花、水、光和谐相处的花园式空间，而鸟乐园则可以体验珍稀鸟类和热带花园。 Night Universe提供基于数字媒体的夜间内容，例如全息表演和音乐喷泉水秀。

충남 보령시 해수욕장 4길 일원은 대천해수욕장이다. 이미 1930년대부터.en: Daecheon Beach is located in the area of ​​Beach 4-gil, Boryeong-si, Chungcheongnam-do. It is the largest beach on the west coast and has been established as a resort complex for foreigners since the 1930s. The white sand beach is 3.5km long and 100m wide. The slope is gentle and the sand is clean. The sunset that matches Dabodo Island is especially beautiful. Daecheon Beach is largely divided into the Sunset Square and Mud Square areas, and each offers different things to enjoy during the summer vacation season. The Boryeong Mud Festival, held every year, attracts the attention of people not only domestically but also around the world. A variety of events will be held with the theme of Boryeong’s mud, including the Mud Checkpoint and Mud Discotheque. At the end of the beach is the Boryeong Mud Experience Center. Mud sauna, mud ondol room, mud self-pack, and mud massage are available. There are many things to enjoy at Daecheon Beach other than swimming. Daecheon Ziptrek gives you the thrill of rushing into the sea. Sky Bike is the nation's first maritime rail bike that travels between Daecheon Beach and Daecheon Port. A track was installed at a height of 8 to 15 meters above the water to run along the sea road. It is a 2.3km round trip in 40 minutes, and if possible, it is recommended to ride during high tide when the sea is full.
충남 보령시 해수욕장 4길 일원은 대천해수욕장이다. 이미 1930년대부터.zh: 大川海水浴场位于忠清南道保宁市海水浴场4街一带。它是西海岸最大的海滩，自 1930 年代起就作为外国人的度假胜地而建立。白色沙滩长3.5公里，宽100米。坡度平缓，沙质干净。与大波多岛相配的日落尤其美丽。大川海滩主要分为日落广场和泥浆广场两个区域，每个区域在暑假期间都有不同的享受。每年举办的保宁泥浆节不仅吸引了国内民众的关注，也吸引了世界各地人们的关注。将以保宁泥浆为主题的各种活动将举行，包括泥浆检查站和泥浆迪斯科舞厅。海滩的尽头就是保宁泥浆体验中心。提供泥桑拿、泥暖炕房、泥自助、泥按摩等服务。除了游泳之外，大川海水浴场还有很多乐趣。大川高空滑索给您带来冲入大海的快感。 Sky Bike是韩国首个在大川海水浴场和大川港之间行驶的海上铁路自行车。在距水面8至15米的高度安装了一条轨道，沿着海路运行。往返2.3公里，需要40分钟，如果可以的话，建议在满海的涨潮时骑行。

대천해수욕장 스카이바이크는 국내 최초의 해상 스카이바이크이다. 대천해수욕.en: Daecheon Beach Sky Bike is Korea’s first sea sky bike. You can ride your bike for about 40 minutes along the 2.3km round-trip rail from Daecheon Beach to Daecheon Port. The advantage is that you can run while admiring the scenery of the sea off Daecheon. The minimum number of people per bike is 2 and a maximum of 4 people can ride. Reservations are not possible, and tickets can be issued on-site only on the day. Infants and toddlers can also ride when accompanied by a guardian.
대천해수욕장 스카이바이크는 국내 최초의 해상 스카이바이크이다. 대천해수욕.zh: 大川海滩空中自行车是韩国第一辆海上空中自行车。从大川海水浴场到大川港，沿着全长2.3公里的往返铁路骑行约40分钟。好处是可以边跑步边欣赏大川的海景。每辆自行车最少可乘坐 2 人，最多可乘坐 4 人。不可预订，且只能当日现场出票。婴儿和幼儿也可以在监护人的陪同下骑行。

막혔던 가슴이 탁트이도록 시원스레 부서지는 파도, 신이 다듬은 듯 정교하.en: The waves crashing refreshingly to open up the blocked heart, and the columnar joints on the coast of the eastern part of the Jungmun Tourist Complex, surrounded by dark red hexagonal stone pillars stacked elaborately as if carved by God, like a folding screen, are a natural tourist resource where you can feel the greatness and exquisiteness of nature at the same time, and are a designated cultural heritage monument of Jeju Island. When you look at the columnar joints formed due to tectonic shifts in the distant past, it seems as if the sad story of a mason is immediately conveyed in the white crumbling foam. When the waves are strong, they create a spectacular sight with waves rising more than 20 meters high. It is a popular attraction as a theme travel destination due to its natural scenery. Columnar jointing is a vertical joint in the shape of a column that appears mainly in basaltic lava flows and is polygonal (usually 4 to 6 polygonal). It is said that it is formed as a result of the contraction that occurs when thick lava (about 1,100 degrees Celsius) flows from the crater and cools rapidly. It is the largest in Korea, measuring 30 to 40 meters and about 1 km wide.
막혔던 가슴이 탁트이도록 시원스레 부서지는 파도, 신이 다듬은 듯 정교하.zh: 海浪拍打的清爽，打开了堵塞的心扉，中文旅游区东部海岸的柱状节理，周围是神雕琢般精心堆叠的深红色六角形石柱，如屏风一样，是可以同时感受到大自然的伟大和精致的自然旅游资源，也是济州岛指定的文化遗产纪念碑。当你看到遥远的过去因构造变化而形成的柱状节理时，白色破碎的泡沫中仿佛立即传达了石匠的悲伤故事。当海浪强劲时，会形成高达20多米的壮观景象。因其自然风光而成为热门的主题旅游目的地。柱状节理是主要出现在玄武质熔岩流中的呈柱状的垂直节理，呈多边形（一般为4～6个多边形）。据说，它是由于厚厚的熔岩（约1100摄氏度）从火山口流出并迅速冷却时发生收缩而形成的。它是韩国最大的，长30至40米，宽约1公里。

두륜산에 있는 대흥사는 백제 성왕 22년에 아도화상이 창건했다고 전해지는.en: Daeheungsa Temple, located on Mt. Duryun, is a temple said to have been founded by Adohwasang in the 22nd year of King Seong of Baekje, and was registered as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2018 under the name of Korea's Mountain Monastery. Daeheungsa Temple is a temple where the spirit of Buddhism to protect the nation is alive and well, and is where the headquarters of the monks led by the Great Master Seosan was located during the Japanese invasions of Korea. And Zen Master Choui, who believed that tea contained all the truth of Buddha and the joy of meditation, went into the valley of Daeheungsa Temple, built Iljiam Temple, and devoted himself to meditation alone for over 40 years. As a result, Daeheungsa Temple became a sacred place for Korean tea culture. At Daeheungsa Temple, there are relics such as the National Treasure Daeheungsa North Amuleukam Rock-carved Buddha Statue, as well as the Seosan Daesa Relics Hall, which are gifts from our ancestors such as jade feet and jade feet, Seosan Daesa's handwriting, gyoza, shoes, and Buddhist sutras written in gold and silver.
두륜산에 있는 대흥사는 백제 성왕 22년에 아도화상이 창건했다고 전해지는.zh: 位于头云山的大兴寺据说是百济成王22年由阿多化相创建的寺庙，并于2018年以韩国山寺之名被登录为联合国教科文组织世界遗产。大兴寺是一座弘扬护国佛教精神的寺庙，也是日军侵略朝鲜时期瑞山大师率领的僧人大本营所在地。而深信茶蕴含一切佛法和禅定之乐的崔禅师，深入大兴寺山谷，建造一池庵，独自修行四十余年。由此，大兴寺成为韩国茶文化的圣地。大兴寺内有国宝大兴寺北阿弥陀佛石刻佛像等文物，还有瑞山大寺文物馆，有玉足、玉足、瑞山大寺的手迹、饺子、鞋子、金银写成的佛经等祖先赐予的礼物。

더베이 101은 해운대의 야경을 자랑하는 복합문화예술공간으로, 아름다운.en: The Bay 101 is a complex cultural and artistic space boasting the night view of Haeundae, where the beautiful sea, mountains, and modern buildings coexist. It is a famous tourist attraction in Busan where you can see colorful skyscrapers at night, and is located at the entrance to Dongbaek Island in Haeundae. The Bay 101 has a variety of facilities, including a cafe where you can enjoy brunch and drinks while looking at the Haeundae city view, a restaurant with a terrace and rooftop, a prop shop where you can find various props and kitchenware, and a gallery. Additionally, they operate a yacht tour, so you can enjoy the beautiful night view of Haeundae from a yacht. It is also a famous photo zone for taking great pictures of Haeundae's night view or skyscrapers, so many tourists visit it. ◎ Travel information to experience the charm of the Korean Wave - The Bay 101, where Geumju and Big Hands from the drama <Strong Woman Gangnam Soon> enjoyed a yacht tour and talked about Brad Song, is a place where the ocean view and city view of Busan come together. Let’s enjoy a luxurious Busan night while riding a yacht on the sea of ​​Haeundae.
더베이 101은 해운대의 야경을 자랑하는 복합문화예술공간으로, 아름다운.zh: Bay 101是一个以海云台夜景为特色的复合文化艺术空间，美丽的大海、山峦和现代建筑并存。它是釜山著名的旅游景点，晚上可以看到色彩缤纷的摩天大楼，位于海云台冬柏岛的入口处。 Bay 101拥有各种设施，包括可以一边欣赏海云台市景一边享用早午餐和饮料的咖啡厅、带露台和屋顶的餐厅、可以找到各种道具和厨具的道具店以及画廊。此外，他们还经营游艇之旅，因此您可以在游艇上欣赏海云台美丽的夜景。这里也是拍摄海云台夜景或摩天大楼的著名拍照胜地，吸引了众多游客。 ◎ 体验韩流魅力的旅游信息 - 电视剧《大力女江南》中金珠和大手乘游艇游览并谈论Brad Song的Bay 101，是釜山海景和城市景观交汇的地方。乘坐游艇在海云台的海上享受奢华的釜山之夜吧。

글로벌 트렌드 K-콘텐츠의 핵심 서울, 그 중심에 초현대적인 플래그십 스.en: Seoul is the core of global trend K-content, and at its center is the ultra-modern flagship store The Hyundai Seoul. The Hyundai Seoul presents a vision for a happier tomorrow and a new standard of life under the slogan, “Resounding toward the future.” With innovative space design, world-class content curation, and futuristic technology, The Hyundai Seoul is Seoul's largest new global landmark. It boasts an innovative interior design that meets new materials, balances surfaces and lines, and fills it with light. At The Hyundai Seoul, you can see the trends of world-class interior and architectural design at once. The moment you enter, you will encounter Sounds Forest and Waterfall Garden. The unexpected nature found in high-tech buildings designed with an eye to the future is surprisingly beautiful. The large indoor garden of about 1,000 pyeong, natural lawn, and natural light coming from the 20 m high glass ceiling convey the echo of the forest. Art is the largest category of language that can be felt and empathized without having to say anything. The three-dimensional exhibition measuring 180 pyeong is overwhelmingly inspiring the moment you enter. Inspiration for a better life and communication for culture begin here. Unite & Shine, STUDIO SWINE Studio Swine's artwork, which is completed with designs containing messages from nature and the audience enjoying and feeling them, meets high-end brands on the Exclusive Label (1F) floor.
글로벌 트렌드 K-콘텐츠의 핵심 서울, 그 중심에 초현대적인 플래그십 스.zh: 首尔是全球潮流韩国内容的核心，其中心是超现代的旗舰店现代首尔。现代首尔以“响彻未来”为口号，展现了对更幸福的明天和新生活标准的愿景。凭借创新的空间设计、世界一流的内容策划和未来技术，首尔现代酒店成为首尔最大的全球新地标。它拥有创新的室内设计，满足新材料的需求，平衡表面和线条，并充满光线。在首尔现代酒店，您可以立即看到世界一流的室内和建筑设计趋势。一进门，首先映入眼帘的是声音森林和瀑布花园。在着眼于未来的高科技建筑中发现的意想不到的自然景色令人惊讶地美丽。约1,000坪的大型室内花园、天然草坪以及从20m高的玻璃天花板射入的自然光传达出森林的回声。艺术是最大的语言类别，无需言语即可感受到并产生共鸣。占地180坪的3D立体展览一进入就让人心潮澎湃。美好生活的灵感、文化的交流从这里开始。 Unite & Shine, STUDIO SWINE Studio Swine 的艺术作品包含来自大自然的信息，让观众享受和感受它们，在 Exclusive Label (1F) 楼层与高端品牌相遇。

덕구온천 스파월드는 행정자치부가 인정한 경상북도 1호 국민보양온천이며,.en: Deokgu Hot Springs Spa World is the first national health hot spring in Gyeongsangbuk-do recognized by the Ministry of Government Administration and Home Affairs, and is a natural gushing hot spring harmonized with the beautiful natural scenery of about 4,000 pyeong halfway up Eungbong Mountain. The temperature is the natural temperature without heating or cooling, and it is slightly alkaline and contains a lot of ingredients such as sodium bicarbonate, potassium, calcium, iron, and carbonic acid. It is especially effective in treating adult diseases such as neuralgia, arthritis, muscle pain, skin diseases, and diabetes. It is also a place that evokes admiration as it is composed of a beautiful canyon with a world-class view, including the sight of a hot spring where natural hot spring water gushes out naturally, strangely shaped rocks, and clear valley water.
덕구온천 스파월드는 행정자치부가 인정한 경상북도 1호 국민보양온천이며,.zh: 德州温泉温泉大世界是庆尚北道第一个获得行政民政部认可的国民保健温泉，是与鹰峰半山腰约4000坪的美丽自然风光相协调的天然涌泉。温度为未经加热或冷却的自然温度，呈微碱性，含有大量碳酸氢钠、钾、钙、铁、碳酸等成分。对治疗神经痛、关节炎、肌肉痛、皮肤病、糖尿病等成人疾病尤其有效。这里也是一个令人惊叹的地方，它由世界级景观的美丽峡谷、天然温泉水自然涌出的温泉景象、奇形怪状的岩石和清澈的谷水组成。

덕소 자연사박물관에서는 오랜 기간 동안 전 세계 30여 개국에서 수집한.en: Deokso Natural History Museum collects from over 30 countries around the world over a long period of time and collects a huge number of real specimens and fossils, including 5 authentic dinosaur fossils, 500 other fossils, 350 minerals, 2,200 fish and shellfish, 90 stuffed animals, 1,200 insects, 100 immersion specimens, and 50 Cenozoic mammal skeletons, with advice from experts in each field. It is exhibited academically. In addition, a small ecological park has been created to raise birds, mammals, and fish, and is an educational site where children and adults can learn and observe nature in a friendly way.
덕소 자연사박물관에서는 오랜 기간 동안 전 세계 30여 개국에서 수집한.zh: 德沼自然历史博物馆长期收集来自世界30多个国家的大量真实标本和化石，包括5个正宗恐龙化石、500个其他化石、350种矿物、2,200种鱼类和贝类、90个毛绒动物、1,200只昆虫、100个浸没标本和50个新生代哺乳动物骨骼，并得到了各领域专家的建议。它在学术上展出。此外，还建立了一个小型生态公园来饲养鸟类、哺乳动物和鱼类，是儿童和成人可以以友好的方式学习和观察自然的教育场所。

전주는 마한시대 이래 호남지방에서 규모가 큰 고을로 그 이름은 마한의 원.en: Jeonju has been a large-scale town in the Honam region since the Mahan era, and its name comes from Mahan’s Wonsanseong Fortress. It was the capital of Later Baekje for about 40 years, and during the Joseon Dynasty, it was renamed Wansanyusubu because it was the hometown of Lee Seong-gye's ancestor. One of the things to see in Jeonju that leaves a strong impression is the lotus flowers blooming in Deokjin Park. That's why Deokjin Park pond is Jeonju's famous attraction. Deokjin Park, located along Paldal-ro, which enters the city from Jeonju IC, was a natural lake formed during the Goryeo Dynasty and was created as an urban park in accordance with the citizen park decision notice in April 1978, and is a place with a deep history along with Chwihyangjeong. The 45,000 pyeong grounds are divided by a suspension bridge that crosses the pond, which occupies two-thirds of the area to the south, and the boat park to the north to the east and west. You can immerse yourself in endless poetry while walking along the arched suspension bridge in the center of a pond filled with scent. In particular, the characteristics of the park, which reopened in 1998 after extensive maintenance work, are reminiscent of small forests (hills) in rural areas through mounding construction, and maximized historicity by creating a traditional pavilion and a iris wetland. In addition, an artificial waterfall and a wooden bridge were installed to create a nature-friendly facility to suit the sentiments of citizens. It is also famous for the Dano Iris Water Festival, where women wash their hair with pond water early in the morning and pray for good health for the new year.
전주는 마한시대 이래 호남지방에서 규모가 큰 고을로 그 이름은 마한의 원.zh: 全州自马韩时代以来一直是湖南地区的一个大型城镇，其名称来源于马韩的元山城。曾作为后百济的首都约40年，朝鲜王朝时期，因是李成桂祖先的故乡而更名为完山游首府。全州给人留下深刻印象的景点之一就是德津公园盛开的荷花。这就是为什么德津公园池塘是全州著名的景点。德津公园位于从全州 IC 进入市区的八达路沿线，是高丽时代形成的天然湖泊，根据 1978 年 4 月的市民公园决定通知书被创建为城市公园，与醉香亭一样具有深厚的历史。占地 45,000 坪的场地被一座横跨池塘的吊桥分隔开来，南面占据了三分之二的面积，北面则是游船公园，将其分为东西两面。沿着充满香气的池塘中央的拱形吊桥漫步，您可以沉浸在无尽的诗意中。特别是，经过大量维护工作后于1998年重新开放的公园的特点是通过土堆建设让人想起农村地区的小森林（山丘），并通过创建传统的亭子和鸢尾花湿地来最大限度地提高历史性。此外，还设置了人工瀑布和木桥，打造符合市民情感的自然友好设施。这里还因达诺鸢尾水节而闻名，妇女们一大早用池塘水洗头，祈求新的一年身体健康。

덕평 공룡 수목원은 동맥이산 자락에 있으며 범바위 동굴이 위치한 곳이다..en: Deokpyeong Dinosaur Arboretum is located at the foot of Gungeryi Mountain and is where Beombawi Cave is located. Over 3,000 species of plants, including oak, fir, chestnut, and pine trees, grow naturally, and dozens of species of native wild flowers are distributed. In addition, about 1,000 species of succulents and cacti are managed in the greenhouse, and there are about 100 species of tropical plants that are difficult to find in Korea, such as coffee trees and papayas. Out of the 250,000 square meters of Deokpyeong Dinosaur Arboretum, 130,000 square meters are in an undeveloped natural state and serve as a refreshing forest bathing area, and in the remaining space, dinosaurs, the main theme, are created within the arboretum, providing fun and memories for children and families. The insect museum provides an educational experience where you can see the fascinating lives of insects and an opportunity to experience emotional connection with animal friends.
덕평 공룡 수목원은 동맥이산 자락에 있으며 범바위 동굴이 위치한 곳이다..zh: 德坪恐龙树木园位于Gungeryi山脚下，也是Beombawi洞穴的所在地。自然生长着橡树、杉树、板栗、松树等3000多种植物，分布着数十种本土野花。此外，温室内还经营着约1000种多肉植物和仙人掌，还有咖啡树、木瓜等在韩国很难见到的热带植物约100种。德坪恐龙树木园占地25万平方米，其中13万平方米处于未开发的自然状态，可作为清爽的森林浴场，其余空间以恐龙为主题，在植物园内打造，为孩子和家庭提供乐趣和回忆。昆虫博物馆提供教育体验，您可以看到昆虫的迷人生活，并有机会体验与动物朋友的情感联系。

1996년에 개관한 덕포진 교육박물관은 경기도 김포시 대곶면에 자리한 곳.en: Deokpojin Education Museum, opened in 1996, is located in Daegot-myeon, Gimpo-si, Gyeonggi-do, and is a private museum run by directors Kim Dong-seon and Lee In-sook, who were elementary school teachers. In 1990, when his wife, Director Lee In-sook, lost her eyesight in a car accident, her husband, Director Kim Dong-seon, founded the museum with the educational materials and severance pay he had collected to keep his promise to “let students meet again.” It consists of a total of three floors, and the first floor of the museum is the character education center, which displays name tags, report cards, and student ID cards, which are memories of old school days. The 2nd floor is an educational history museum, and displays materials related to the 1st to 7th curriculum from the Japanese colonial period and objects that adults can now reminisce about. The 3rd floor agricultural culture museum displays a variety of objects that can help you learn about the agricultural culture and the traditional culture of our ancestors. Deokpojin Education Museum operates a variety of experience programs. Major programs include School Bell Tinting, which involves listening to teacher Lee In-sook's organ singing class in an old classroom, followed by a tour of the museum, and Humanities on the Road to the Museum, where the theme changes every year.
1996년에 개관한 덕포진 교육박물관은 경기도 김포시 대곶면에 자리한 곳.zh: 德浦镇教育博物馆位于京畿道金浦市大串面，于1996年开馆，是由曾任小学教师的金东宣和李仁淑馆长运营的私立博物馆。 1990年，妻子李仁淑馆长因车祸双目失明，丈夫金东善馆长用自己收集的教材和遣散费创办了博物馆，以兑现“让学生重逢”的承诺。博物馆共三层，一楼是品格教育中心，里面陈列着名牌、成绩单、学生证，都是学生时代的回忆。 2楼是教育史馆，展示着日本殖民时期的1～7年级课程的相关资料以及现在成年人可以回忆的物品。三楼农业文化馆陈列着各种实物，可以帮助您了解农业文化和我们祖先的传统文化。德浦津教育博物馆开展各种体验项目。主要节目有在旧教室听李仁淑老师的管风琴演奏课，然后参观博物馆的“学校铃声”，以及每年主题都会变化的“博物馆路上的人文”等。

델피노의 오션 플레이는 실내 워터파크 및 노천탕으로 구성된 물놀이 테마파.en: Delfino's Ocean Play is a water theme park consisting of an indoor water park and an open-air bath. With the concept of well-being where rest and health coexist, it is a place where families and couples can escape from everyday life and enjoy nature. Ocean Play, located on the first floor of the Sono Felice facilities building, is divided into an indoor zone, an outdoor zone, and a hot spring sauna. Before using the pool, you can take a light shower in the sauna and then go straight to the indoor zone to play. When you enter the indoor swimming pool, you can play in the water while looking at the beach in the distance through the open glass window, so it has a really nice view compared to other swimming pools. The depth of the water is shallow, about 1 meter, so it is safe for children to play in the water, and the water is also lukewarm, so they can play in the water without being cold when playing indoors. Life jackets and tubes can be rented at rental shops. Main facilities include a kids play pool where children can play in shallow water, a kids river, and an outdoor infinity pool.
델피노의 오션 플레이는 실내 워터파크 및 노천탕으로 구성된 물놀이 테마파.zh: Delfino's Ocean Play是一个水上主题公园，由室内水上乐园和露天浴池组成。以休息与健康并存的幸福理念，为家庭、情侣提供逃离日常生活、享受自然的场所。 Ocean Play位于Sono Felice设施楼一楼，分为室内区、室外区、温泉桑拿区。在使用泳池之前，您可以在桑拿浴室洗个小澡，然后直接前往室内区域玩耍。当你进入室内游泳池时，你可以一边在水中玩耍，一边通过敞开的玻璃窗眺望远处的海滩，所以与其他游泳池相比，这里的景色非常好。水深较浅，大约1米左右，孩子们在水中玩耍是安全的，而且水也是微温的，所以在室内玩耍时可以在水中玩耍，不会感到寒冷。救生衣和救生圈可以在租赁店租用。主要设施包括可供孩子们在浅水区玩耍的儿童游乐池、儿童河和室外无边泳池。

도담삼봉은 조선 개국에 공을 세운 정도전이 유년시절을 보낸 곳으로 자신의.en: Dodamsambong is where Jeong Do-jeon, who contributed to the founding of Joseon, spent his childhood, and it is said that he fell in love with the beauty of Dodamsambong to the point that he called himself Sambong. You can see the scenery of Dodamsambong loved by Toegye Yi Hwang, Gyeomjae Jeong Seon, and Danwon Kim Hong-do right before your eyes. Sambong Story Hall, located within the amusement park, exhibits Danyang's famous attractions as an archive. If you board the Hwangpo sailboat, you can go to Dodam Garden on the other side via Seokmun. Dodam Garden is famous for planting yellow cosmos. You can fully experience the beauty of nature along with the scenery of Dodamsambong Peak.
도담삼봉은 조선 개국에 공을 세운 정도전이 유년시절을 보낸 곳으로 자신의.zh: 岛潭三峰是朝鲜开国功臣郑道传度过童年的地方，据说他爱上了岛潭三峰的美丽，并自称三峰。退溪伊黄、谦斋正善、檀园金弘道等人喜爱的岛潭三峰风景就在眼前。三峰故事馆位于游乐园内，展示丹阳著名景点作为档案。如果登上黄浦帆船，可以经石门前往对岸的岛潭花园。都达姆花园以种植黄波斯菊而闻名。伴随着岛潭三峰的风景，您可以充分体验大自然的美丽。

저명산은 보통 도드람산으로 더 알려져 있는데 도드람산은 돗(猪) 울음(鳴.en: Jeomyeongsan Mountain is more commonly known as Dodramsan Mountain. Dodramsan Mountain's Dodram sound seems to have been modified over time. There is a legend that a long time ago, a high priest (also known as Hyoja) who lived in this mountain was digging for medicinal herbs when the rope that tied him to the cliff broke due to friction with the edge, putting his life in danger. A wild pig cried out of nowhere and saved the high priest's life. It faces Seolbongsan Mountain, located in the east of Majang-myeon, and is not very high at 49m above sea level, but the strangely shaped rocks that make up the peak create an exquisite scenery, making it a famous mountain in Icheon that attracts many hikers from outside. In particular, the taste of the cool and cool sarcophagus water that springs from under the cliff behind Yeongbosa Temple on the mountainside is exquisite, and the cuteness of hikers climbing the rocks along the ridge allows you to enjoy the pleasure of hiking. An interesting legend has been passed down that in the past, when the spirit of Samgaksan Mountain first built Samgaksan Mountain, he ordered Magohalmi to move Jiri Mountain and Dodeurambong Peak. While Magohalmi was dragging Dodeurambong Peak, she heard that Samgaksan Mountain was already completed and abandoned it in its place, which became the current Doderamsan Mountain. In an old document, it was said that there was a temple called Jeongaksa Temple on Jeomyeongsan Mountain, but it has now disappeared, and traces of the temple remain at the southern foot of the mountain, and this place is called Jeongakgol.
저명산은 보통 도드람산으로 더 알려져 있는데 도드람산은 돗(猪) 울음(鳴.zh: 绝明山俗称都潭山。多德拉姆山的多德拉姆声音似乎随着时间的推移而发生了变化。相传很久以前，住在这座山上的一位高僧（又名孝子）在采药时，将他绑在悬崖上的绳子因与悬崖边缘摩擦而断裂，危及生命。一只野猪不知从何而来，救了大祭司的命。与位于马场面东部的雪峰山相对，虽然海拔不高，只有49m，但山峰上奇形怪状的岩石形成了绝美的风景，是利川的名山，吸引了很多外来的徒步旅行者。尤其是山腰永保寺后面悬崖下涌出的清凉石棺水味道细腻，沿山脊攀岩的可爱模样，让您尽享徒步的乐趣。流传着一个有趣的传说，过去三岳山的神灵第一次建造三岳山时，就命令马戈哈密移走了智日山和多德兰峰。当Magohalmi拖着Doderambong峰时，她听说Samgaksan山已经完工，并将其遗弃在原处，这就是现在的Doderamsan山。旧文献中记载，祭明山上曾有一座名为正觉寺的寺庙，但现已消失，山南麓还残留着寺庙的痕迹，这个地方被称为正觉谷。

경기도 최북단의 도마치계곡이라 일컫는 곳으로 가평 적목리 방향 시내버스.en: It is called the Domachi Valley in the northernmost part of Gyeonggi-do. If you pass the 3rd and 8th Bridge from Yongsu-dong Village, the last stop of the city bus toward Jeokmok-ri, Gapyeong, and climb endlessly up the uninhabited valley, you will be mesmerized by the scenery of the valley along the roadside. This is the only clean area in the province notified by the Environmental Protection Agency, and is home to the natural monument, scallop fish. There is a cow called Yongso 3km upstream from the 3rd and 8th Bridge. The water is deep and clear, and there is a legend that a pregnant woman found a dragon ascending to heaven, and the dragon fell and became a cow. If you continue going back for about an hour past Yongso, there are many large and small waterfalls and cows, and finally you reach a huge waterfall. There is a legend that in the old days, military officers enjoyed drinking and dancing with vegetables as snacks. It is a beautiful place with beautiful scenery and a place where you can feel the cold even in the middle of summer.
경기도 최북단의 도마치계곡이라 일컫는 곳으로 가평 적목리 방향 시내버스.zh: 位于京畿道最北端，被称为“土町溪谷”。从开往加平赤木里的城市公交车的最后一站——龙水洞村穿过3号桥和8号桥，沿着无人山谷不断攀登，路边的山谷风景就会让您着迷。这是全省唯一经环保局通报的清洁区域，也是天然纪念物扇贝鱼的故乡。在三桥、八桥上游3公里处有一头叫龙沼的牛。水深而清澈，传说有一位孕妇发现一条升天的龙，龙掉下来变成了一头牛。经过龙沼继续往回走一个小时左右，有很多大大小小的瀑布和牛，最后到达一个巨大的瀑布。相传旧时，武将们以蔬菜为零食，饮酒跳舞。这是一个风景优美的地方，也是一个即使在盛夏也能感受到寒冷的地方。

도산서원은 건축물 구성상 크게 도산서당과 이를 아우르는 도산서원으로 구분.en: In terms of its architectural structure, Dosan Seowon is largely divided into Dosan Seodang and Dosan Seowon, which encompasses it. Dosan Seodang is where Toegye personally lived and taught his students, and Dosan Seowon is a shrine and a seowon built after Toegye's death. Dosan Seodang was built by Toegye in 1561 (the 16th year of King Myeongjong's reign) for academic research and training of future generations. It is the oldest building in Seowon and is said to have been designed by Toegye himself. At this time, Nongunjeongsa Temple, which served as a dormitory for Confucian students, and Hagagojiksa, a facility inside Bujeon Church, were also built. Dosan Seowon was completed in 1576 (9th year of King Seonjo’s reign), six years after the death of Toegye. When Toegye passed away in 1570, it was decided to enshrine his memorial tablet at Sangdeoksa Temple in 1572. Two years later, with the support of local Confucian scholars, a shrine was built to enshrine the memorial tablet, and a Jeongyodang and east and west buildings were built to complete it as a seowon. In 1575 (the 8th year of King Seonjo's reign), it received a copy of 『Dosan Seowon』 written by Han Seok-bong and became a Saek Seowon, thereby serving as the headquarters of Confucianism in Yeongnam. In 1615 (the 7th year of King Gwanghaegun's reign), Sarim paid tribute to Jomok, and in 1792 (the 16th year of King Jeongjo's reign), King Jeongjo issued a royal ceremony and implemented Dosanbyeolgwa. In 1796 (the 20th year of King Jeongjo's reign), the Sisadan (試士壇) was established, and in 1819 (the 19th year of King Sunjo's reign), Donggwangmyeongsil (東光明室), a library, was built. In 1870 (the 7th year of King Gojong's reign), it was excluded from Daewongun's order to abolish academies. In 1930 (the year of Gyeong-oh), Seogwangmyeongsil (西光明室) was rebuilt, and in 1932 (the year of Imsin), Hagojiksa (lower temple) was relocated. In 1969, 19 lots (324,945㎡) of forest and fields centered around this academy were designated as historic sites, and from 1970, repair and expansion projects were carried out by presidential decree, making it a sanctuary as a spiritual home of Korean Confucianism. In 1977, the Dosan Seowon Management Office was established, and after the enactment and promulgation of the management and operation ordinance, it has continued to this day.◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave - This is a place where the 16th cast of the entertainment show <I am Solo> wore hanbok and were randomly matched with partners. It is also a place where viewers vicariously felt excitement and tension whenever a partner is chosen based on the color of clothes, regardless of one's will. If you walk along the nearby trail, you can see not only the inside of the Seowon but also various specialties of the Seowon, such as Wangbeodeul and Sisadan.
도산서원은 건축물 구성상 크게 도산서당과 이를 아우르는 도산서원으로 구분.zh: 从建筑结构来看，岛山书院大致分为岛山书堂和岛山书院。岛山书堂是退溪亲自居住和教导学生的地方，岛山书院是退溪死后建造的神社和书院。岛山书堂是退溪于1561年（明宗16年）为学术研究和培养后人而建造的。它是书院最古老的建筑，据说是退溪亲自设计的。此时，还修建了作为儒生宿舍的农云精寺和釜田教会内的设施“福堂寺”。岛山书院于1576年（宣祖9年）竣工，即退溪去世六年后。 1570年退溪去世后，1572年决定在尚德寺供奉他的牌位。两年后，在当地儒生的支持下，修建了祠堂供奉牌位，并修建了正教堂和东西建筑，完成了书院的建设。 1575年（宣祖8年），获得了韩石峰所著的《岛山书院》，成为书院，成为岭南儒学的大本营。 1615年（光海君7年），沙林向祖木进贡，1792年（正祖16年），正祖颁布了皇家仪式，实行了土山别诰。 1796年（正祖20年）建立试士坛，1819年（纯祖19年）建立图书馆东光明室。 1870年（高宗7年），大院君下令废止书院，将其排除在外。 1930年（庆五年）重建西光明室，1932年（壬申年）迁移下古寺。 1969年，以书院为中心的19块林田（324,945平方米）被指定为史迹，1970年起根据总统令进行了修缮和扩建工程，使其成为韩国儒家精神家园的圣地。 1977年，岛山书院管理所成立，管理运营条例制定颁布后，一直延续至今。 ◎ 遇见韩流魅力的旅行信息 - 这里是综艺节目《我是Solo》第16期演员穿着韩服随机配对搭档的地方。每当根据衣服的颜色来选择伴侣时，不管自己的意愿如何，观众都会身感兴奋和紧张。沿着附近的小路散步，不仅可以看到书院的内部，还可以看到王法德、西沙担等书院的各种特产。

도원체육공원은 다양한 체육시설을 갖춘 도심 속 공원이다. 테니스장, 축구.en: Dowon Sports Park is a park in the city with a variety of sports facilities. It is popular with families as it has sports facilities that anyone can use, such as tennis courts, soccer fields, tracks, and basketball courts, as well as a children's playground and a water park that operates in the summer. The wide walking trail is suitable for a quiet walk. Nearby, there is the Hyangnam Multipurpose Gymnasium and the Hwaseong City History Museum, making it a great place to visit together, and is perfect for a family outing.
도원체육공원은 다양한 체육시설을 갖춘 도심 속 공원이다. 테니스장, 축구.zh: 道元体育公园是一个拥有各种体育设施的城市公园。这里拥有网球场、足球场、田径场、篮球场等任何人都可以使用的体育设施，以及儿童游乐场和夏季开放的水上乐园，深受家庭欢迎。步行道宽阔，适合安静散步。附近有乡南综合体育馆和华城市历史博物馆，非常适合一起游览，也非常适合家庭出游。

독립기념관은 외침을 극복하고 민족의 자주와 독립을 지켜온 우리 민족의 국.en: The Independence Hall of Korea was built on August 15, 1987, with generous donations from the people, with the purpose of establishing the identity of the national culture and contributing to establishing the people's solid national spirit and national outlook by collecting, preserving, exhibiting, researching, and researching data on our people's overcoming the national crisis and the history of national development, which overcame the outcry and protected the nation's independence and independence. The Together Independence Movement Experience Center, located within the Independence Hall of Korea, is an experience center where you can learn about the history of the independence movement to reclaim our country in an easy and fun way while feeling the love for your country. It can be used by all generations, from infants to adults. Various experience facilities have been created so that you can play games that stimulate your five senses in a space decorated with national symbols such as the Rose of Sharon and the Taegeukgi, and become an independence activist yourself and indirectly participate in the independence movement to feel the joy of the liberation of your country and the Republic of Korea developing into the world. ◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave - Entertainment <2 Days of Stone> Independence Hall, where you can meet the passionate history of Koreans who created K culture, reveals its majesty even from afar. Gyeore’s Pagoda and Gyeore’s House, the largest tiled building in Asia. We recommend feeling the K-spirit by looking around the Unification Garden and the Unification Bell, where ATEEZ performed the Golden Bell.
독립기념관은 외침을 극복하고 민족의 자주와 독립을 지켜온 우리 민족의 국.zh: 朝鲜独立纪念馆于1987年8月15日在人民的慷慨捐助下建成，其目的是通过收集、保存、展示、研究和研究我国人民克服民族危机和国家发展历史的资料，克服强烈抗议，保护民族独立和独立，确立民族文化认同，为树立人民坚实的民族精神和民族观做出贡献。位于韩国独立纪念馆内的“一起独立运动体验馆”是一个可以轻松有趣地了解光复祖国独立运动历史，同时感受对祖国的热爱的体验馆。从婴儿到成人，各代人都可以使用它。打造了各种体验设施，让您可以在沙龙玫瑰、太极旗等国家象征装饰的空间里，玩刺激五种感官的游戏，自己也成为独立活动家，间接参与独立运动，感受祖国解放和大韩民国走向世界的喜悦。 ◎ 邂逅韩流魅力的旅行信息 - 娱乐<2 Days of Stone> 独立馆，在这里您可以了解到创造K文化的韩国人的热情历史，即使在远处也能感受到它的雄伟。杰尔宝塔和亚洲最大的瓦片建筑杰尔楼。我们建议您参观统一花园和统一钟，感受韩国精神，ATEEZ 曾在此演奏金钟。

독산성은 경기도 오산시 지곶동 일대에 자리한 삼국시대의 산성이다. 독산.en: Doksanseong Fortress is a fortress from the Three Kingdoms period located in the area of ​​Jigot-dong, Osan-si, Gyeonggi-do. It was built at the top of Doksan Mountain, and was first built during the Baekje period and was used until the Unified Silla, Goryeo, and Joseon periods. The circumference is about 1.1km. At the top, there remains the site of Sema Daejeon, where General Kwon Yul used his outstanding strategy during the Japanese invasions of Korea. From here, you can enjoy a panoramic view of not only the city of Osan but also Siwon and Hwaseong. The walking trail connects to the old Gyeonggi Road, and the Doksanseong Forest Bathing Area has been created below the fortress wall, offering a variety of things to enjoy.
독산성은 경기도 오산시 지곶동 일대에 자리한 삼국시대의 산성이다. 독산.zh: 秃山城是位于京畿道乌山市知串洞一带的三国时代的城堡。它建于秃山山顶，始建于百济时期，一直使用到统一新罗、高丽、朝鲜时期。周长约1.1公里。山顶还保留着三马大田遗址，权烈将军在日本侵朝战争中曾在此施展过杰出的战略。从这里不仅可以欣赏到乌山市的全景，还可以欣赏到始源和华城的全景。步行道与旧京畿道相连，城墙下还开辟了秃山城森林浴场，提供了多种享受。

독산성 산림욕장은 오산시의 독산성 및 세마대지 주변의 산림 20만 7,0.en: Doksanseong Forest Bathing Area is a forest bathing area built on 207,000 m² of forest around Doksanseong Fortress and Seema Daeji in Osan City. Opened in 1999, it is used as a space for mental and physical training and relaxation for Osan citizens and as a nature experience center for children. There is an observatory, a rest area, a classroom in the forest, a picnic area, and a tree observation trail, as well as various physical fitness facilities and adventure equipment. If you apply for the ‘Historical Exploration Course’ and ‘Wide Course’ of Osan City Tour, you can experience both a walk along the Doksanseong Forest Bathing Trail and a Doksanseong Fortress Tour.
독산성 산림욕장은 오산시의 독산성 및 세마대지 주변의 산림 20만 7,0.zh: 秃山城森林浴场是以乌山市的秃山城和西马大地为中心，在207,000平方米的森林中建造的森林浴场。于1999年开业，作为乌山市民的身心锻炼和放松空间以及儿童自然体验中心。设有展望台、休息区、林间教室、野餐区、树木观察步道，以及各种体能健身设施和探险装备。如果申请乌山城市观光的“历史探索路线”和“广域路线”，可以同时体验秃山城森林浴场散步和秃山城游览。

돌산공원은 여수 시내에서 돌산대교를 건너 돌산도로 들어가자마자 만날 수.en: Dolsan Park is a park that can be found as soon as you cross Dolsan Bridge and enter Dolsan Road from downtown Yeosu. It was built in 1987 on a site of approximately 87,000 pyeong. In the park, the set filming site for the 2004 SBS morning drama ‘Choice’ was set up and is visited by many tourists. Part of the set was converted into a traditional tea house, so the scenery of drinking tea while looking at Dolsan Bridge is beautiful. The view from the park's viewpoint is also spectacular, including the sunset over Dolsandaegyo Bridge, the night view of Dolsandaegyo Bridge, the night view of the marine park encompassing Jungang-dong and Jonghwa-dong in Yeosu, and the night view of Janggun Island. At the central site of the park, various materials related to the 1994 Samyeo integration are stored in a time capsule, which is scheduled to be opened 100 years later on April 1, 2098.
돌산공원은 여수 시내에서 돌산대교를 건너 돌산도로 들어가자마자 만날 수.zh: 突山公园是从丽水市中心穿过突山大桥进入突山路后就能看到的公园。它建于1987年，占地约87,000坪。公园内设有2004年SBS早间剧《选择》的拍摄地，吸引了众多游客。片场的一部分被改造成传统的茶室，边喝茶边看突山大桥的景色很美。从公园的角度看，突山大桥的日落、突山桥的夜景、丽水中央洞和钟化洞海洋公园的夜景、长君岛的夜景等也非常壮观。在公园的中心地点，与1994年三女一体化有关的各种资料都存放在一个时间胶囊中，计划在100年后的2098年4月1日打开。

동광극장은 옛날 모습을 그대로 간직한 얼마 남지 않은 단관극장이다. 과거.en: Donggwang Theater is one of the few remaining single-screen theaters that still retains its original appearance. The movie ticket sales counter that was used in the past is no longer in use, but the showtime schedule board that has been in use for a long time is hanging there. When you step inside, you see green floors and colorful neon signs. The movie theater scene of the drama ''Reply 1988'' was filmed here. The concession stand at the movie theater is like a supermarket, so you can bring out the drinks you want and popcorn is returned in the microwave. On one side, there is a tank with unusually large fish. Movie tickets can only be purchased in person, and seats cannot be designated, so you can sit wherever you like after entering. There is a soft sofa seat in the front so you can watch a movie comfortably.
동광극장은 옛날 모습을 그대로 간직한 얼마 남지 않은 단관극장이다. 과거.zh: 东光剧场是仅存的几座仍保留原貌的单屏剧场之一。以前使用的电影票售票柜台已经不再使用，但一直使用的放映时间表板挂在那里。当你走进去时，你会看到绿色的地板和色彩缤纷的霓虹灯。电视剧《请回答1988》的电影院场景就是在这里拍摄的。电影院的小卖部就像超市一样，你可以把你想要的饮料拿出来，爆米花则用微波炉退回。一侧有一个水箱，里面有异常大的鱼。电影票只能亲自购买，不能指定座位，进去后可以随意坐。前面有一个柔软的沙发座椅，可以舒适地看电影。

동대구역광장은 2017년 10월에 준공하였다. 광장에는 온대구광장과 컬러.en: Dongdaegu Station Plaza was completed in October 2017. The plaza has facilities such as Ondaegu Square, Colorful Garden, symbolic sculpture, and media wall. The symbolic sculpture of Dongdaegu Station Plaza uses an LED display board to provide useful information to citizens, and the media wall and floor fountain are operated as a space for citizens to share by providing proposals and event videos as a media wall. In addition, it provides a resting place for citizens with LED lighting using solar energy, which is a key industry in Daegu, and there is also a colorful garden with cloud rest areas, variety, and cooling fog.
동대구역광장은 2017년 10월에 준공하였다. 광장에는 온대구광장과 컬러.zh: 东大邱车站广场于2017年10月竣工。广场内设有温大邱广场、多彩花园、象征性雕塑、媒体墙等设施。东大邱站广场的标志性雕塑采用LED显示屏为市民提供有用的信息，媒体墙和地板喷泉则作为媒体墙提供提案和活动视频，作为市民分享的空间。此外，它还利用太阳能LED照明为市民提供休息场所，这是大邱的重点产业，还有一个色彩缤纷的花园，云休息区、种类繁多，还有冷却雾。

펀 클라임, 에어리얼 로프 코스, 슬라이드 등을 갖춘 체험시설실내 체험시.en: The Nolja Center, an indoor experience facility, is equipped with climbing facilities such as a fun climb, aerial ropes course, and slides. Outdoor, it is a new tourist attraction with facilities for families to enjoy in nature, such as a 115m long extreme slide, a net adventure over a valley, a tree house, and a forest playground.
펀 클라임, 에어리얼 로프 코스, 슬라이드 등을 갖춘 체험시설실내 체험시.zh: 诺利亚中心是室内体验设施，设有趣味攀爬、空中绳索课程、滑梯等攀爬设施。室外设有115m长的极限滑梯、山谷网探险、树屋、森林游乐场等适合家庭享受大自然的设施，是一个新的旅游景点。

동문재래시장은 오랜 역사를 지닌 전통 재래시장으로 제주도를 대표하는 시장.en: Dongmun Traditional Market is a traditional market with a long history and is one of the representative markets of Jeju Island. Along with Dongmun Traditional Fish Market, it constitutes the most important and large-scale permanent traditional market in Jeju Island. It was first formed immediately after liberation in August 1945. This market was the only permanent market on Jeju Island at the time and became the base for all commercial activities on Jeju Island. When a large fire occurred in March 1954 and the entire market was reduced to ashes, it was moved to its current location in November of the same year. Main items handled include vegetables, fruits, marine products, medicinal herbs, grains, and clothing. As it is Jeju Island's representative traditional market, fresh seafood is popular. You can purchase a variety of assorted raw fish, including cutlassfish raw fish, at a low price, and fusion foods such as abalone intestine rice samhap and tteokgalbi with whole abalone are attracting attention.
동문재래시장은 오랜 역사를 지닌 전통 재래시장으로 제주도를 대표하는 시장.zh: 东门传统市场是一个历史悠久的传统市场，是济州岛的代表性市场之一。它与东门传统鱼市场一起构成了济州岛最重要、最大规模的永久性传统市场。它最早于1945年8月解放后立即形成。这个市场是当时济州岛唯一的永久性市场，并成为济州岛所有商业活动的基地。 1954年3月发生大火，整个市场化为灰烬，同年11月迁至现址。主要经营蔬菜、水果、海产品、药材、粮食、服装等。作为济州岛代表性的传统市场，新鲜的海鲜很受欢迎。可以以低廉的价格购买到包括带鱼生鱼在内的各种生鱼拼盘，鲍鱼肠饭三合饭、整只鲍鱼的年糕排骨等融合食品也备受瞩目。

동백호수공원은 동백역과 어정역 사이에 위치한 도심형 근린공원으로, 호숫가.en: Dongbaek Lake Park is an urban neighborhood park located between Dongbaek Station and Eojeong Station, and is characterized by the Dongbaek Circular Trail built along the lakeside. It is a space that can be enjoyed by families, couples, and visitors with dogs. There are tables and benches here and there, making it a great place to relax while appreciating the calm lake scenery. It is equipped with convenient facilities such as a deck rest area, outdoor exercise equipment, and a floor fountain, and a musical fountain show is operated from June to July to add to the enjoyment of walking. Performances and events are regularly held on the outdoor stage and it is used as a leisure space for local residents.
동백호수공원은 동백역과 어정역 사이에 위치한 도심형 근린공원으로, 호숫가.zh: 冬柏湖公园是位于冬柏站和御亭站之间的城市邻里公园，以沿湖畔修建的冬柏环形步道为特色。是家庭、情侣、带狗的游客都可以享受的空间。到处都有桌子和长凳，是一个放松身心、欣赏平静湖景的好地方。配备甲板休息区、户外健身器材、地面喷泉等便利设施，6月至7月期间还会举办音乐喷泉表演，增添散步的乐趣。户外舞台定期举办表演和活动，也是当地居民的休闲空间。

동탄 그랑파사쥬는 프랑스 거리의 건축미를 모티브로 한 복합 문화·쇼핑몰로.en: Dongtan Grand Passage is a complex cultural and shopping mall inspired by the architectural beauty of French streets, and has a themed space that reinterprets the Place de la Concorde and the Champs-Elysées. It consists of large commercial facilities, dining, and a medical center, and with 7 CGVs and trendy brands, it is bustling with activity on both weekdays and weekends. Inside the complex, there is an infinity pool overlooking Dongtan's first lake park, so you can enjoy shopping and leisure together. Due to its location adjacent to the lake park, there is high demand for visitors, and public transportation accessibility is expected to be further expanded when the tram opens in the future.
동탄 그랑파사쥬는 프랑스 거리의 건축미를 모티브로 한 복합 문화·쇼핑몰로.zh: 东滩大通道是一座综合性文化购物中心，灵感源自法国街道的建筑之美，拥有重新诠释协和广场和香榭丽舍大街的主题空间。它由大型商业设施、餐饮和医疗中心组成，拥有7辆CGV和时尚品牌，无论工作日还是周末都热闹非凡。大楼内设有无边际泳池，俯瞰东滩第一湖滨公园，购物休闲两相宜。由于其毗邻湖滨公园，游客需求旺盛，未来有轨电车开通后，预计公共交通可达性将进一步扩大。

‘동피랑’이라는 이름은 ‘동쪽’과 ‘비랑’이라는 말이 합쳐져서 생겼다..en: The name ‘Dongpirang’ was created by combining the words ‘east’ and ‘birang.’ ‘Birang’ is a Tongyeong dialect word for ‘vital’, and it is made by adding only ‘dong’ from the word ‘east’, so people came to call it ‘Dongpirang.’ The Green Tongyeong 21 Promotion Council gathered people nationwide to paint on Dongpirang Road in October 2007. Those people painted pictures all over the village walls, walls, roads, etc., and the seaside hill village was reborn as a painting. Dongpirang Alley has dozens of branches. There are paintings in every alley, a village that touches the sky, and the paintings there are enough to turn the village into a fairyland. Additionally, the Gangguan seascape seen from the village is also worth seeing.
‘동피랑’이라는 이름은 ‘동쪽’과 ‘비랑’이라는 말이 합쳐져서 생겼다..zh: “东陂郎”这个名字是由“东”和“birang”两个词组合而成。“birang”是统营方言中的“生命”一词，是在“东”字中加上“dong”而成的，所以人们称之为“Dongpirang”。2007年10月，绿色统营21推进委员会聚集了全国人民在东陂郎路进行绘画。这些人在村庄的墙壁、墙壁、道路等处画满了画，海滨山村重生为一幅画。东皮郎胡同有几十家分店。每条巷子里都有画，一座触天的村庄，那里的画足以把村庄变成仙境。另外，从村里看到的岗关海景也值得一看。

동학산공원은 동탄과 인접한 화성시 석우동에 위치한 낮은 산으로 해발 12.en: Donghaksan Park is a low mountain located in Seokwoo-dong, Hwaseong-si, adjacent to Dongtan. It is 121.3m above sea level, so anyone can climb it easily, and its small area makes it a good trekking course that takes about 40 minutes round trip. It is a neighborhood park with an artificial turf field, a viewing stand, a parking lot, and a forest trail. Reservations can be made for the grass field, and dogs must be refrained from entering the sports facility. However, dogs are allowed on the forest trails as long as they follow the pet ticket. Simple exercise equipment is provided along the forest trail.
동학산공원은 동탄과 인접한 화성시 석우동에 위치한 낮은 산으로 해발 12.zh: 东鹤山公园是位于华城市石雨洞的一座低山，毗邻东滩。海拔121.3m，任何人都可以轻松攀登，而且面积较小，是一个很好的徒步路线，往返时间约为40分钟。这是一个邻里公园，有人造草坪、观景台、停车场和森林步道。草地场地可以预约，并且禁止狗进入运动设施。不过，只要遵守宠物票，狗就可以进入森林步道。森林步道沿线设有简单的健身器材。

경기도 파주시 법원읍, 생태계가 살아있는 십리 계곡의 산림욕장 중심부에.en: Durumoe Museum, located in the center of a forest bathing area in the ecosystem-rich Simni Valley, in Beopwon-eup, Paju-si, Gyeonggi-do, is a museum specializing in the history of folk life that the founders, Kang Wi-soo and Kim Ae-young, who were saddened by the disappearance of our ancestors' daily necessities due to the wave of modernization, have collected and displayed pieces of art over the past 30 years. Durumoe (周山) is the name of the founder's hometown village, located within the Military Demarcation Line in North Korea. It is said to be located in Jangdan-gun. It is also used as a picnic course for elementary school students. Until recently, our traditional household utensils that were used in daily life have become so widespread and universal that their value as historical relics has been neglected, and in the present, damage and loss have intensified, putting them in danger of extinction. Accordingly, the Durumoe Museum focuses on collecting remnants of traditional household utensils, including jangdokdae, earthen dams, ssarimun, teojugari, upyanggari, seonangdan, shrines, jangseung, and jangseung. Folk cultural assets such as sotdae, barns, traditional mills, and coffee huts have been restored and are on display. The back enclosure of the jangdokdae, the jangdokdae located on the sunny side with an earthen wall, the large and small pots and clay pots sitting in a row in order of height centered on a straw rag, etc., are imbued with the breath of our ancestors; It has characteristics that are harmonious and compatible with nature. At the Durumoe Museum, you can encounter things from your hometown that have remained in the past, such as jars, thatched rooms, mills, and barns.
경기도 파주시 법원읍, 생태계가 살아있는 십리 계곡의 산림욕장 중심부에.zh: 杜鲁莫博物馆位于京畿道坡州市法院邑，生态系统丰富的十里溪谷森林浴区的中心，是一家专门展示民俗生活历史的博物馆，创始人姜维洙和金爱英对祖先的生活用品因现代化浪潮而消失感到悲伤，在过去的30年里收集并展示了艺术品。 Durumoe（周山）是创始人家乡村庄的名称，位于朝鲜军事分界线以内。据说位于长坛郡。也被用作小学生的野餐路线。直到最近，我们日常生活中使用的传统家庭用具已经变得如此广泛和普遍，以至于它们作为历史文物的价值被忽视，而目前，损坏和流失加剧，使它们面临灭绝的危险。因此，杜鲁莫博物馆重点收集传统家庭用具的遗迹，包括长德台、土坝、ssarimun、teojugari、upyanggari、seonangdan、神社、长升和长升。草台、谷仓、传统磨坊、咖啡屋等民俗文化资产已得到修复并展出。藏德台的后围、朝阳面的土墙藏德台、以草布为中心按高低排列的大小盆、陶罐等，充满了祖先的气息；它具有与自然和谐、兼容的特点。在杜鲁莫博物馆，您可以看到来自故乡的罐子、茅草房、磨坊和谷仓等过去遗留下来的东西。

딥스테이션은 경기 용인시에 위치한 다이빙 풀장이다. 다양한 연출이 가능한.en: Deep Station is a diving pool located in Yongin-si, Gyeonggi-do. It is a place that provides perfect visibility through an underwater photo zone that allows for a variety of productions, a water depth of up to 36m, rental of various diving equipment, and clear water supply. This is scuba diving and freediving and consists of basic training, dynamic, and static themes. You can see large baobab trees while diving, and there are photo zones in each section, allowing you to have a unique experience.
딥스테이션은 경기 용인시에 위치한 다이빙 풀장이다. 다양한 연출이 가능한.zh: Deep Station是位于京畿道龙仁市的跳水池。水下摄影区视野极佳，可进行各种制作，水深可达36m，可出租各种潜水设备，并提供清澈的海水。这是水肺潜水和自由潜水，由基础训练、动态和静态主题组成。潜水时可以看到高大的猴面包树，每个区间都有拍照区，让你有独特的体验。

글로벌 브랜드의 명성을 갖춘 라마다 프라자 수원 호텔은 풍성한 문화와 최.en: Ramada Plaza Suwon Hotel, with the reputation of a global brand, is located in the center of Suwon, Gyeonggi-do, where rich culture and a cutting-edge business environment coexist. Ramada Plaza Suwon Hotel is a sophisticated and classy business hotel with a modern and contemporary design based on the concept of natural light that comes in through the front glass wall. Guest rooms that exquisitely combine elegance and comfort and an executive lounge for VIP guests provide the best service and relaxation space to guests. By finding special service in the ordinary rather than the unusual, Ramada Plaza Suwon Hotel creates differentiated and unique services, leads hotel culture as a 4-star hotel, and creates a special space so that guests can feel at home.
글로벌 브랜드의 명성을 갖춘 라마다 프라자 수원 호텔은 풍성한 문화와 최.zh: 拥有全球品牌美誉的水原华美达广场酒店位于京畿道水原市中心，这里丰富的文化与尖端的商业环境并存。水原华美达广场酒店是一家精致而优雅的商务酒店，采用现代和当代设计，以自然光透过正面玻璃墙照射进来的概念为基础。优雅与舒适完美结合的客房和VIP贵宾行政酒廊为宾客提供最优质的服务和休闲空间。水原华美达广场酒店通过在平凡而不是不寻常中寻找特殊服务，创造差异化和独特的服务，引领四星级酒店的酒店文化，创造一个特殊的空间，让客人有宾至如归的感觉。

라발스호텔은 부산 영도구에 자리한 호텔이다. 용두산공원, BIFF거리,.en: La Valse Hotel is a hotel located in Yeongdo-gu, Busan. More than 16 nationally famous shopping facilities and tourist attractions are concentrated nearby, including Yongdusan Park, BIFF Street, Jagalchi Market, Gukje Market, Gwangbok Lotte Department Store, International Passenger Terminal, National Maritime Museum, Taejongdae, and Huinyeoul Culture Village. La Valse Hotel, which embraces not only Busan Bridge, Yeongdodaegyo Bridge, and Namhang Bridge, but also Busan Port Bridge, is not only in the optimal location for quick access from anywhere in Busan, but also boasts the best view to capture the night view of Busan at a glance. You can enjoy ocean views from most rooms at La Valse Hotel, and each room type offers the best bridge views, including Namhang Bridge, Yeongdodaegyo Bridge, Busan Bridge, and Busan Port Bridge. Additionally, you can enjoy a panoramic view of the sea and cityscape from within your room.
라발스호텔은 부산 영도구에 자리한 호텔이다. 용두산공원, BIFF거리,.zh: La Valse Hotel是一家位于釜山影岛区的酒店。附近集中了龙头山公园、BIFF街、札嘎其市场、国际市场、光复乐天百货店、国际客运码头、国立海洋博物馆、太宗台、熙烈文化村等16个以上全国知名的购物设施和旅游景点。拉瓦尔斯酒店不仅毗邻釜山大桥、影岛大桥、南港大桥，还毗邻釜山港大桥，不仅地理位置优越，可快速到达釜山各处，而且拥有一览釜山夜景的最佳视野。拉瓦尔斯酒店的大部分客房均可欣赏海景，每种房型均享有最佳的桥梁景观，包括南港大桥、影岛大桥、釜山大桥和釜山港大桥。此外，您还可以在客房内欣赏大海和城市景观的全景。

락트리클라이밍 분당점은 수내역 인근에 자리한 실내 클라이밍장으로, 넓은.en: Rock Tree Climbing Bundang Branch is an indoor climbing site located near Sunae Station, and is spacious and has clean facilities. The high floor height makes it easy to experience the course from various angles, and the routes are divided by level of difficulty, so it can be used by a wide range of people from beginners to experts. A wide protective mat has been installed to increase safety, and there is a bench in the center of the interior for resting and watching. Equipment such as rock shoes and chalk can be rented on site. In addition, it is equipped with auxiliary exercise equipment such as dumbbells, so you can also do basic physical training necessary for climbing.
락트리클라이밍 분당점은 수내역 인근에 자리한 실내 클라이밍장으로, 넓은.zh: Rock Tree Climbing Bundang分店是位于砂苗站附近的室内攀岩场，空间宽敞，设施干净。楼层高度高，可以轻松地从各个角度体验路线，并且路线按难度划分，因此适合从初学者到专家的广泛人群使用。为了增加安全性，安装了宽阔的防护垫，室内中央设有长凳，可供休息和观看。客人可以在酒店内租用岩鞋和粉笔等设备。此外，还配备了哑铃等辅助锻炼器材，还可以进行攀岩所必需的基本体能训练。

레전드스크린야구존 수원인계점은 수원 번화가에 자리한 실내 스크린야구 체험.en: Legend Screen Baseball Zone Suwon Ingye Branch is an indoor screen baseball experience center located in downtown Suwon. Equipped with the latest sensor-based batting system and various game modes, difficulty, velocity, and pitch quality can be set in detail, and it provides step-by-step options such as Lady, Rookie, Ama, Pro, and Major, allowing for a wide range of users from beginners to experts. Bats with the club logo, various uniforms, and signed balls are on display, making it a lot of fun to look around. Just like at a real baseball stadium, you can also enjoy simple food such as chicken, cup noodles, and snacks.
레전드스크린야구존 수원인계점은 수원 번화가에 자리한 실내 스크린야구 체험.zh: Legend Screen棒球区水原仁溪店是位于水原市中心的室内屏幕棒球体验中心。配备最新的传感器式击球系统和多种游戏模式，可详细设置难度、速度和投球质量，并提供Lady、Rookie、Ama、Pro和Major等逐步选项，适合从初学者到专家的广泛用户。展示着带有俱乐部标志的球棒、各种队服、签名球等，让人赏心悦目。就像在真正的棒球场一样，您还可以享用简单的食物，如鸡肉、杯面和小吃。

롯데몰 수지점은 성복역과 바로 연결된 복합 쇼핑몰로, 자라·H&amp;M.en: Lotte Mall Suji branch is a complex shopping mall directly connected to Seongbok Station, with approximately 200 global fashion, living, and F&B brands, including Zara, H&M, and Uniqlo. Lotte Mart is located on the first basement floor and Lotte Cinema is located on the 5th floor, making it great for shopping and leisure activities. In the 'Green Hall', a free rest area on the 4th floor, you can relax and read the books provided. The signature space, Media Tower, is 24m high and extends from the first basement level to the fourth floor, allowing you to enjoy ever-changing video content.
롯데몰 수지점은 성복역과 바로 연결된 복합 쇼핑몰로, 자라·H&amp;M.zh: 乐天购物中心水吉店是与城福站直接相连的综合购物中心，拥有Zara、H&M、优衣库等约200个全球时尚、生活、餐饮品牌。乐天玛特位于地下一层，乐天电影院位于五层，非常适合购物和休闲。在四楼的免费休息区“Green Hall”，您可以放松身心并阅读提供的书籍。标志性空间Media Tower高24m，从地下一层延伸至四层，让您享受千变万化的视频内容。

경상남도 진주시에 있는 롯데몰 진주점은 고객에게 매일 새로움과 즐거운 경.en: Lotte Mall Jinju Branch in Jinju-si, Gyeongsangnam-do provides customers with new and enjoyable experiences every day. It is a place where many people come and go as it has the widest and most comfortable circulation in the area and easy and convenient parking. An outdoor store is located on the first floor, and new brands are located on the third floor. In addition, it is a shopping space where you can find a multiplex theater and a lifestyle mart that is differentiated from existing marts. It is a complex shopping mall in Jinju Innovation City, and nearby are Jinju Stadium and the National Copyright Museum.
경상남도 진주시에 있는 롯데몰 진주점은 고객에게 매일 새로움과 즐거운 경.zh: 位于庆尚南道晋州市的乐天购物中心晋州店每天为顾客提供新的、愉快的体验。这里是区内人流最宽广、最舒适、停车方便的地方。一楼有户外商店，三楼有新品牌。此外，它还是一个购物空间，您可以找到多厅影院和与现有市场不同的生活方式市场。是晋州创新城的综合购物中心，附近有晋州体育场和国家版权博物馆。

롯데백화점 구리점은 구리·남양주권 주요 상권에 위치한 복합 문화·쇼핑 공.en: Lotte Department Store Guri Branch is a complex cultural and shopping space located in a major commercial district in the Guri and Namyangju areas. It is directly connected to Guri Station and a two-story bridge, making it highly accessible. There is a parking lot for about 800 cars, making it convenient for visitors by car. It consists of everyday categories such as fashion, living, and food and beverages, and operates experiential stores such as Wood, El Library, Hanok Workshop, and K Golf, and a cultural center on the 9th floor to provide cultural and experience programs for local customers. The restaurant area is designed so that families can comfortably use it.
롯데백화점 구리점은 구리·남양주권 주요 상권에 위치한 복합 문화·쇼핑 공.zh: 乐天百货九里店是位于九里和南杨州地区主要商业区的综合文化购物空间。与九里站和二层桥直接相连，交通便利。设有约800辆汽车的停车场，方便自驾游客。涵盖时尚、生活、餐饮等日常品类，并运营Wood、El Library、Hanok Workshop、K Golf等体验店，并在9楼设有文化中心，为当地顾客提供文化体验项目。餐厅区域的设计旨在让家人可以舒适地使用。

롯데백화점 동탄점은 연면적 약 24만㎡ 규모의 대형 백화점으로, 동탄역과.en: Lotte Department Store Dongtan Branch is a large department store with a total floor area of ​​approximately 240,000 m2 and is a shopping complex directly connected to Dongtan Station. The country's largest food hall is located on the first basement floor, and various brands ranging from luxury goods to living and F&B are located on the upper floors. In addition to ‘The Terrace’ on the 3rd floor, a rooftop dog park and an experiential gallery are also in operation. There is Lotte Cinema on the top floor, and ‘D.Avenue’ in the form of a street mall is created outside, creating various types of shopping and cultural spaces.
롯데백화점 동탄점은 연면적 약 24만㎡ 규모의 대형 백화점으로, 동탄역과.zh: 乐天百货东滩店是一家总建筑面积约24万平方米的大型百货商店，是与东滩站直接相连的购物中心。全国最大的美食广场位于地下一层，楼上则是从奢侈品到生活餐饮的各种品牌。除了三楼的“The Terrace”之外，屋顶狗狗公园和体验画廊也在运营中。顶层设有乐天电影院，室外以街边购物中心的形式打造“D.Avenue”，打造各种类型的购物和文化空间。

롯데백화점 안산점은 중앙역 인근에 자리한 고잔신도시의 주요 쇼핑 거점이다.en: Lotte Department Store Ansan Branch is a major shopping hub in Gojan New Town, located near Jungang Station. It is a shopping and cultural space for local residents and visitors, providing products and services encompassing all aspects of lifestyle. It consists of a main building and a new building, and houses fashion, beauty, and living brands, as well as Lotte Cinema and a food center. Seasonal events and exhibitions are held frequently, so you can find a variety of products depending on the time of your visit.
롯데백화점 안산점은 중앙역 인근에 자리한 고잔신도시의 주요 쇼핑 거점이다.zh: 乐天百货安山店是古栈新城的主要购物中心，位于中央站附近。它是当地居民和游客的购物和文化空间，提供涵盖生活方式各个方面的产品和服务。它由主楼和新楼组成，汇集了时尚、美容、生活品牌，以及乐天电影院和美食中心。经常举办季节性活动和展览，因此您可以根据访问时间找到各种产品。

롯데백화점 안산점 신관은 2018년 증축되었으며, 라이프스타일과 패션을.en: The new building of Lotte Department Store Ansan branch was expanded in 2018 and is operated in a form that combines lifestyle and fashion. There are stores for family customers, such as MUJI and Pororo Kids Cafe, and there are lifestyle and fashion brands that take into account various tastes. There is a food and beverage specialty store on the basement floor, offering a wide range of choices, from simple meals to cafe use. It is connected to the main building by an underground passage, making it convenient to move between buildings, and the flow of people using the department store flows naturally, allowing for efficient shopping.
롯데백화점 안산점 신관은 2018년 증축되었으며, 라이프스타일과 패션을.zh: 乐天百货安山店新大楼于2018年扩建，以生活方式与时尚相结合的形式运营。这里有无印良品、Pororo Kids Cafe等面向家庭顾客的商店，也有考虑到各种品味的生活方式和时尚品牌。地下一层有一家食品和饮料专卖店，提供多种选择，从简单的餐点到咖啡馆使用。与主楼通过地下通道相连，楼与楼之间的往来十分方便，百货店的人流自然流动，购物高效。

롯데백화점 일산점은 쇼핑·문화·커뮤니티 기능을 모두 갖춘 복합형 백화점이.en: Lotte Department Store Ilsan Branch is a complex department store with shopping, cultural, and community functions. It is directly connected to Jeongbalsan Station, providing excellent accessibility, and is equipped with large parking facilities, making it highly convenient for visitors by car. With about 400 fashion, living, and F&B brands, you can shop, eat, and relax in one place. Community facilities such as a cultural hall and gallery are also provided to provide a variety of cultural experiences. In particular, ‘Attic Villa’, a complex cultural space on the first floor, is a special space operated only at the Ilsan branch.
롯데백화점 일산점은 쇼핑·문화·커뮤니티 기능을 모두 갖춘 복합형 백화점이.zh: 乐天百货店一山店是一家集购物、文化、社区功能为一体的综合百货店。与正钵山站直接相连，交通便利，并设有大型停车设施，开车前来的游客非常方便。约400个时尚、生活、餐饮品牌，集购物、美食、休闲为一体。还设有文化厅、画廊等社区设施，提供丰富多彩的文化体验。尤其是一楼的复合文化空间“阁楼别墅”，是一山分店独有的特殊空间。

롯데아울렛 고양터미널점은 백석역 인근 고양종합터미널 내에 위치한 복합형.en: Lotte Outlet Goyang Terminal Branch is a complex outlet located in Goyang General Terminal near Baekseok Station. Transportation is convenient, as it is directly connected to the terminal, so travelers can stop by for a quick shopping or meal before or after getting on or off the bus. Fashion, sports, children's, and living goods stores are organized on each floor from the first to the fourth floor, and there is a futsal field on the rooftop of the fifth floor that operates on a reservation system, so you can enjoy shopping and leisure at the same time.
롯데아울렛 고양터미널점은 백석역 인근 고양종합터미널 내에 위치한 복합형.zh: 乐天奥特莱斯高阳客运站店是位于白石站附近高阳综合客运站的综合奥特莱斯店。交通便利，与航站楼直接相连，旅客可以在上下车前或下车前顺便顺便购物或用餐。一楼至四楼各层设有时尚、运动、儿童、生活用品专卖店，五楼屋顶设有五人制足球场，实行预约制运营，让您可以同时享受购物和休闲的乐趣。

롯데아울렛 광주수완점은 매일 새로움과 즐거운 경험을 제공한다. 200여.en: Lotte Outlet Gwangju Suwan Branch provides new and enjoyable experiences every day. There are over 200 famous domestic and international brands and international luxury select shops. This is Suwan Lotte Town, where you can find an arena, a mart, and a cinema all at once.
롯데아울렛 광주수완점은 매일 새로움과 즐거운 경험을 제공한다. 200여.zh: 乐天奥特莱斯光州水完店每天都提供新的、愉快的体验。汇聚了200多家国内外知名品牌和国际奢侈品精选店。这里是集竞技场、商场、电影院于一身的Suwan Lotte Town。

매일 새로움과 즐거운 경험을 제공하는 롯데아울렛 남악점이다. 패션부터 식.en: Lotte Outlet Namak Branch offers new and enjoyable experiences every day. It is the largest shopping space in the region where you can shop for a variety of things at once, including fashion, restaurants, kids cafes, and pet boutiques. It is even more convenient because there is a Lotte Mart in the complex. There is a large parking lot, making it easy to visit by car. It is also good for shopping as it is well-equipped with convenient facilities such as a baby lounge, stroller rental, and lost-and-found information.
매일 새로움과 즐거운 경험을 제공하는 롯데아울렛 남악점이다. 패션부터 식.zh: 乐天奥特莱斯纳马克店每天都提供新的、愉快的体验。它是该地区最大的购物空间，您可以同时购买各种商品，包括时装、餐厅、儿童咖啡馆和宠物精品店。园区内还有乐天玛特，更方便。有大型停车场，自驾游览也很方便。婴儿休息室、婴儿车出租、失物招领处等便利设施也很齐全，非常适合购物。

롯데월드는 롯데 그룹이 국민들의 여가 선용과 외국인 관광객 유치를 위해.en: Lotte World is a theme park established and operated by Lotte Group for people's leisure use and to attract foreign tourists. It consists of Lotte World Adventure, an indoor theme park with the theme of adventure and mystery, Magic Island, a lake park, a shopping mall, a folk museum, an ice rink, a hotel, and a department store. It is a large-scale complex living space where tourism, leisure, shopping, and culture can be enjoyed in one place. Lotte World Adventure is the world's largest indoor theme park, where you can enjoy state-of-the-art boarding facilities, fantastic parades, various video systems, laser shows, performances, and food from around the world all year round. At the Folk Museum, Korea's 5,000-year history and folk culture are recreated in an easy and fun way, divided into a historical exhibition hall, model village, amusement park, and a children's street. Lotte World Garden Stage is the central stage of Lotte World performances, and various events such as various seasonal musical shows and public broadcasts are held, and Lotte World Star Avenue is an experiential entertainment facility with a place to create Korean Wave stars.
롯데월드는 롯데 그룹이 국민들의 여가 선용과 외국인 관광객 유치를 위해.zh: 乐天世界是乐天集团为人们休闲使用和吸引外国游客而建立和运营的主题公园。它由以冒险和神秘为主题的室内主题公园乐天世界冒险乐园、魔术岛、湖滨公园、购物中心、民俗博物馆、溜冰场、酒店和百货商店组成。是集旅游、休闲、购物、文化于一体的大型综合生活空间。乐天世界冒险乐园是世界上最大的室内主题公园，在这里您可以全年享受最先进的寄宿设施、精彩的游行、各种视频系统、激光表演、表演以及来自世界各地的美食。民俗博物馆以轻松有趣的方式再现了韩国五千年的历史和民俗文化，分为历史展厅、模型村、游乐园、儿童街。乐天世界花园舞台是乐天世界演出的中心舞台，举办各种季节音乐剧、公共广播等各种活动，乐天世界星光大道是打造韩流明星的体验型娱乐设施。

마법과 환상의 세계! 롯데월드 어드벤처가 부산에서 개장했다. 숲 속의 청.en: A world of magic and fantasy! Lotte World Adventure opened in Busan. It is prepared so that you can perfectly enjoy the refreshing feeling and thrill of the forest. When you think of 'amusement parks', you can always experience fun and exciting performances and parades. Busan Lotte World is located in Busan, the second largest city in Korea, and is conveniently accessible via public transportation, so it has been attracting a steady stream of visitors since the first day of its opening. Lotte World Busan is comprised of six theme zones. There is a talking tree in the center of the fairy village Tinker Falls zone, and this tree uses animatronic technology to tell stories about six themes in the park. Lory Castle in the Royal Garden Zone, located at the highest point in Lotte World, looks as if it is floating on water, and you can enjoy the panoramic view of Busan and the sea off Gijang at a glance. The excitement of other rides, especially representative attractions such as Giant Digger and Giant Splash, is already spreading through word of mouth. In addition to attractions for adults, there are also rides for families with children. It is placed indoors so that children can safely enjoy it regardless of the weather. ◎ Travel information to experience the charm of the Korean Wave - Lotte World Adventure Busan, where Joong-jung and Jun-hee from the drama <Strong Woman Gangnam-soon> enjoyed an enviable date, is a place where fairytale-like scenery, thrilling rides, and fantastic parades coexist. When I stand in front of the ‘Talking Tree’, I am reminded of the happy couple Joong-Joong and Jun-Hee exchanging rings.
마법과 환상의 세계! 롯데월드 어드벤처가 부산에서 개장했다. 숲 속의 청.zh: 一个充满魔法和幻想的世界！乐天世界冒险乐园在釜山开业。让您可以完美享受森林的清爽感和刺激感。当你想到“游乐园”时，你总能体验到有趣而刺激的表演和游行。釜山乐天世界位于韩国第二大城市釜山，公共交通十分便利，自开业第一天起就吸引了源源不断的游客。釜山乐天世界由六个主题区组成。童话村廷克瀑布区的中心有一棵会说话的树，这棵树利用电子动画技术讲述公园内六个主题的故事。位于乐天世界最高点的皇家花园区的鹦鹉城堡，看起来就像漂浮在水面上一样，一眼就能将釜山和机张海域的景色尽收眼底。其他游乐设施的刺激性，尤其是巨型挖掘机和巨型飞溅等代表性游乐设施，已经通过口耳相传而传播开来。除了适合成人的游乐设施外，还有适合带孩子的家庭的游乐设施。它被放置在室内，这样无论天气如何，孩子们都可以安全地享受它。 ◎ 体验韩流魅力的旅游信息 - 乐天世界冒险乐园 电视剧《大力女江南顺》中的中正和俊熙曾在这里度过了令人羡慕的约会，这里是童话般的风景、惊险的游乐设施和梦幻般的游行并存的地方。当我站在“会说话的树”前时，我想起了幸福的情侣中中和俊熙交换戒指。

롯데프리미엄아울렛 기흥점은 가족들과 행복한 추억을 만들수 있는 숲모험 놀.en: Lotte Premium Outlet Giheung Branch has a forest adventure playground, dog playground, mini train, indoor surfing, etc. where you can create happy memories with your family. Over 300 different brands are gathered in one place, including Asia's largest Nike Factory and the first indoor surfing shop in a shopping mall. It is adjacent to the Gyeongbu Expressway (Giheung IC), Yeongdong Expressway, and the Bundang-Suseo Road, so it is close and convenient to visit.
롯데프리미엄아울렛 기흥점은 가족들과 행복한 추억을 만들수 있는 숲모험 놀.zh: 乐天名品奥特莱斯器兴店设有森林探险游乐场、狗狗游乐场、小火车、室内冲浪等，您可以在这里与家人一起创造幸福的回忆。超过300个不同品牌齐聚一处，其中包括亚洲最大的耐克工厂和首家购物中心室内冲浪店。毗邻京釜高速公路（器兴IC）、岭东高速公路、盆唐水西路，交通便利。

롯데프리미엄아울렛 의왕점은 매일 새로움과 즐거운 경험을 제공하는 복합 쇼.en: Lotte Premium Outlet Uiwang Branch is a shopping mall complex that provides new and enjoyable experiences every day. It is a space where you can relax and experience various experiences amidst nature (Barasan Mountain and Baekun Lake) that changes over time. Like the slogan ‘Every Single Moment’, you can enjoy shopping in a nature that changes with time.
롯데프리미엄아울렛 의왕점은 매일 새로움과 즐거운 경험을 제공하는 복합 쇼.zh: 乐天名牌折扣购物中心义王店是一家每天都提供新的、愉快的体验的购物中心。这是一个可以在随时间变化的自然（巴拉山和白云湖）中放松身心并体验各种体验的空间。正如口号“Every Single Moment”一样，您可以在随时间变化的自然中享受购物。

롯데피트인 산본점은 산본역에서 도보로 이동 가능한 위치에 자리한 복합 쇼.en: Lotte Fitin Sanbon Branch is a complex shopping mall located within walking distance from Sanbon Station, and is close to the local living area, making it highly accessible. From the 1st to the 10th floor, there are various stores including fashion, F&B, living, and home appliances, and Starbucks, Olive Young, Uniqlo, Lotte Super, and Hi-Mart are located there. Lotte Cinema operates on the 10th floor, and leisure facilities such as a golf academy and fitness center are also provided, allowing daily shopping and cultural activities to be enjoyed in one place.
롯데피트인 산본점은 산본역에서 도보로 이동 가능한 위치에 자리한 복합 쇼.zh: 乐天Fitin三本店是一家综合型购物中心，距离三本站步行即可到达，并且靠近当地生活区，交通便利。 1至10楼设有时尚、餐饮、生活、家电等各类商铺，星巴克、Olive Young、优衣库、乐天超市、Hi-Mart等都有。乐天电影院位于10楼，还设有高尔夫学院、健身中心等休闲设施，让日常购物和文化活动一处享受。

리빙파워센터는 2020년 4월 개관한 국내 최초·최대 규모의 가전·가구.en: Living Power Center is Korea's first and largest living shopping mall specializing in home appliances and furniture, which opened in April 2020. It is operated under the concept of ‘All the living in the world in one place!’ and has a variety of stores, including home furnishings, home appliances, entertainment, F&B, and sports, from the 3rd basement floor to the 5th floor above ground. Beyond shopping, it functions as a complex cultural space that the whole family can enjoy together, and is highly accessible as it is only 3 minutes away from Giheung IC on the Gyeongbu Expressway.
리빙파워센터는 2020년 4월 개관한 국내 최초·최대 규모의 가전·가구.zh: Living Power Center是韩国第一家也是最大的家电和家具专营生活购物中心，于2020年4月开业。它以“世界上所有的生活都在一个地方！”为理念运营，从地下3层到地上5层，拥有家居、家电、娱乐、餐饮和体育等各种商店。除了购物之外，它还具有全家人一起享受的复合文化空间的功能，并且距离京釜高速公路器兴IC仅3分钟路程，交通便利。

공주 마곡사는 신라 선덕여왕 9년(640) 자장(慈藏)이 창건한 사찰이다.en: Gongju Magoksa Temple is a temple founded by Jajang in the 9th year of Queen Seondeok of Silla (640). It is said that the name Magoksa Temple was given by Bocheolhwasang of Silla because the congregation gathered when he was preaching was like the three generations of Sambat. At the time of its founding, it was a large temple with about 30 rooms, but now Daeungbojeon, Daegwangbojeon, Yeongsanjeon, Four Heavenly Kings Gate, and Haetalmun Gate remain. In addition, there is a five-story stone pagoda, a Buddhist hanging, a wooden plaque, the kite that King Sejo of the Joseon Dynasty rode, a bronze incense burner, and ancient books. There are also several manuscript Buddhist scriptures copied with gold and silver objects, a representative legacy of the Buddhist culture of the late Goryeo Dynasty. The area around Magoksa Temple is known as one of the Sipseungjijijis of the Joseon Dynasty, that is, one of the special areas where people could avoid danger during times of war. According to Lee Jung-hwan's 『Taekri』, Magoksa Temple escaped the Japanese invasions of Korea and survived the Korean War without suffering any damage. In recognition of its value, it was selected as a UNESCO World Heritage mountain temple and Korea's mountain monastery, and several cultural properties within the temple were designated as tangible cultural properties and cultural property materials of Chungcheongnam-do.
공주 마곡사는 신라 선덕여왕 9년(640) 자장(慈藏)이 창건한 사찰이다.zh: 公州麻谷寺是新罗善德女王9年（640年）由紫藏创建的寺庙。据说，麻谷寺这个名字是新罗的宝哲和尚所起的，因为他传法时聚集的信徒就像三代三拔一样。始建时是一座拥有约30间房间的大型寺院，现存有大雄宝殿、大光宝殿、灵山殿、四大天王门、解达门。此外，还有五层石塔、佛挂、木匾、朝鲜世祖所乘的风筝、青铜香炉、古籍等。还有多部用金银器抄写的佛经手稿，是高丽后期佛教文化的代表性遗产。麻谷寺周边地区被称为朝鲜王朝的始胜地基地之一，即战争时期人们可以躲避危险的特殊地区之一。据李正焕的《跆梨》记载，麻谷寺躲过了日本侵略朝鲜，并在朝鲜战争中幸存下来，没有受到任何损害。由于其价值得到认可，它被选为联合国教科文组织世界遗产山寺和韩国山寺，寺庙内的多项文化财产被指定为忠清南道有形文化财产和文化财产资料。

마나스아트센터는 물 맑고 공기 좋은 경기도 양평군 병산리 남한강 옆에 자.en: Manas Art Center is an exhibition hall located next to the Namhan River in Byeongsan-ri, Yangpyeong-gun, Gyeonggi-do, where the water is clear and the air is good. It consists of the 700 pyeong Shona Sculpture Park and the 100 pyeong Makonde Sculpture Exhibition Hall. It is a famous place for African sculpture that owns and exhibits the largest number of Shona and Makonde sculptures in the country. The energy of African sculpture, completed through exchange with spirits, can be said to be the beginning of Cubism art, which conveyed the soul of art to Picasso. Manas Art Center is being reborn as a place where you can see the depth of African art.
마나스아트센터는 물 맑고 공기 좋은 경기도 양평군 병산리 남한강 옆에 자.zh: 玛纳斯艺术中心是位于京畿道杨平郡屏山里南汉江畔的一个展览馆，这里的水清澈，空气良好。由700坪的绍纳雕塑公园和100坪的马孔德雕塑展览馆组成。它是非洲雕塑的著名地，拥有和展示该国数量最多的绍纳语和马孔德语雕塑。非洲雕塑的能量通过与精神的交流而完成，可以说是立体主义艺术的开端，它向毕加索传达了艺术的灵魂。玛纳斯艺术中心正在重生，成为一个可以看到非洲艺术深度的地方。

마니산은 강화 8경 중 한 곳으로, 마리산, 마루산, 두악산이라고도 한다.en: Manisan Mountain is one of the eight scenic spots of Ganghwa, and is also called Marisan Mountain, Marusan Mountain, and Duaksan Mountain. It is located at the southwestern tip of Ganghwa Island and in the center of the Korean Peninsula. It is also the highest in Ganghwa Island at 472.1m above sea level. At the top of Mt. Manisan, there is Chamseongdan, which is recorded as the place where Dangun Wanggeom offered his heavenly offering. The foundation is round to symbolize the sky, and the altar is square to symbolize the earth, forming a lower-upward shape. It is still a spiritual mountain of the nation where ancestral rites are held every National Foundation Day and where the National Sports Festival torch is lit and relayed here every year. If you climb the 918 stone steps along the hiking trail, you can enjoy the beautiful scenery of the West Sea at a glance.
마니산은 강화 8경 중 한 곳으로, 마리산, 마루산, 두악산이라고도 한다.zh: 马尼山是江华八景之一，又名马里山、丸山、多岳山。它位于江华岛西南端、朝鲜半岛中部。海拔472.1m，也是江华岛最高的。摩尼山山顶有禅圣坛，据记载是檀君王鉴祭天的地方。基座为圆形，象征天，祭坛为方形，象征地，形成下低上高的形状。如今，这里仍然是民族的一座精神之山，每年建国纪念日都在这里举行祭祀活动，每年的全国体育节火炬在这里点燃和传递。沿着登山步道登上918级石阶，西海美景尽收眼底。

마이다스레이크 이천은 마치 신이 숨겨 놓은 듯, 자연의 아름다움을 그대로.en: Midas Lake Icheon is a golf course that contains the beauty of nature as if it was hidden by God. Become the new protagonist of Midas Hand, who can achieve success in everything you touch through the optimal course composition to satisfy all golfers in the embrace of nature with a shining sun and ancient temples.
마이다스레이크 이천은 마치 신이 숨겨 놓은 듯, 자연의 아름다움을 그대로.zh: 利川米达斯湖是一座蕴藏着上帝隐藏的自然之美的高尔夫球场。 成为迈达斯之手的新主角，通过最佳的球场构成，让你所触及的一切都获得成功，满足所有高尔夫球手在阳光明媚、古老寺庙的大自然怀抱中的满足。

자연이 숨겨 놓은 마지막 휴양지, 그 곳에 위치한 마이다스밸리 청평 골프.en: Midas Valley Cheongpyeong Golf Club is located in the last resort hidden by nature! It is the pinnacle of beauty gifted by nature, including a completely pollution-free and nature-friendly environment. The moment you step on the field, your new myth is born. A golf club built with perfect design and pure capital. It is a work of art that harmonizes the majesty that overwhelms the view of 18 holes as if each hole was made by the hand of God and the delicacy of a goddess. Midas Valley for your high-class life. We invite you to Cheongpyeong Golf Club.
자연이 숨겨 놓은 마지막 휴양지, 그 곳에 위치한 마이다스밸리 청평 골프.zh: 麦达斯谷清平高尔夫俱乐部位于大自然隐藏的最后一个度假村！这是大自然赋予的美丽巅峰，包括完全无污染和自然友好的环境。当你踏上赛场的那一刻，你的新神话就诞生了。一个用完美的设计和纯粹的资本打造的高尔夫俱乐部。仿佛每个球洞都是上帝之手打造的，18个球洞的壮丽景色与女神的精致融为一体，堪称一件艺术品。迈达斯谷，为您打造高端生活。我们邀请您来到清平高尔夫俱乐部。

마이산 벚꽃은 진안고원의 특이한 기후 덕분에 전국에서 가장 늦게 피며,.en: Maisan cherry blossoms are the last to bloom in the country thanks to the unique climate of the Jinan Plateau, and thousands of mountain cherry blossoms are in full bloom at once, creating a spectacular sight. The native wild cherry blossoms, which are 20 to 30 years old, are famous for their clear and vivid flower colors, and the 2.5 km cherry blossom road that runs from Isanmyo to Tapsa Temple is loved by many for its pink scenery. At Tapyeongje, you can enjoy a quiet atmosphere with the cherry blossoms as the peak of Maisan Mountain is reflected in the stagnant water. It is Jinan's spring flower spot, visited by tens of thousands of tourists, especially on weekends when the cherry blossoms are in full bloom.
마이산 벚꽃은 진안고원의 특이한 기후 덕분에 전국에서 가장 늦게 피며,.zh: 由于济南高原独特的气候，麦山樱花是全国最晚开花的，数千株山樱花同时盛开，蔚为壮观。当地的野生樱花树龄为20至30年，以其鲜艳鲜艳的花色而闻名，从二三庙到塔普寺的2.5公里樱花路因其粉红色的景色而受到许多人的喜爱。在塔平济，梅山的山峰倒映在静止的水中，您可以享受樱花盛开的宁静氛围。这里是济南春天的赏花胜地，每年都有成千上万的游客前来参观，尤其是在樱花盛开的周末。

산과 호수를 끼고 있어 물빛과 낙조가 주변 군락목과 푸른 산과 조화를 이.en: It is a representative natural tourist destination in Paju where you can escape from the suffocating daily life and take a comfortable rest as if you are buried in the arms of nature, as it is located next to a mountain and a lake, and the water color and sunset are beautiful in harmony with the surrounding community trees and green mountains. Majang Lake, with its beautiful water scenery, has been created as an eco-friendly park and is the perfect place for an outing for families and couples. There is a 3.6km waterside deck and a 220m long suspension bridge where you can walk while looking at the waterside scenery. From the moment you cross the suspension bridge, the bridge shakes and shakes, eliciting gasps from tourists. Among the convenience facilities, there is a cafe located in the observatory and management building where you can enjoy a cup of tea while looking at the large lake. The camping site, which is a combination of a forest and a lake, provides a comfortable rest area while enjoying the sunset and early morning mist. You can also enjoy canoeing and kayaking at Majang Lake.
산과 호수를 끼고 있어 물빛과 낙조가 주변 군락목과 푸른 산과 조화를 이.zh: 这里依山傍湖，水色、夕阳美丽，与周围的群树、青山相得益彰，是坡州代表性的自然旅游胜地，可以逃离令人窒息的日常生活，舒适地休息，仿佛埋入大自然的怀抱。马将湖水景优美，被打造成生态公园，是家庭、情侣郊游的绝佳去处。有3.6公里的水边甲板和220m长的吊桥，可以边走边看水边风景。从跨过吊桥的那一刻起，桥就摇摇晃晃，引得游客喘不过气来。便利设施中，展望台和管理楼内设有咖啡厅，您可以一边喝茶一边欣赏大湖的景色。森林与湖泊相结合的露营地，在欣赏日落和清晨薄雾的同时，提供了舒适的休息区。您还可以在马江湖享受独木舟和皮划艇的乐趣。

단양군 적성면에 위치한 만천하스카이워크에서는 남한강 절벽 위에서 80~9.en: At Mancheonha Skywalk, located in Jeokseong-myeon, Danyang-gun, you can enjoy the thrill of walking on a skywalk while looking down 80 to 90 meters below the water from the cliffs of the Namhan River. In the spiral section leading to the observatory, you can enjoy the scenery from various angles, and when you stand at the observatory, you will be impressed by the view of the Namhangang River flowing across the ridge. If you go up to the observatory, you can see the panoramic view of the city and Sobaeksan Mountain Yeonhwabong in the distance. At the horseshoe-shaped Manhakcheonbong Observatory, you can experience the thrill of walking on the edge of a cliff while looking down on the Namhangang River flowing beneath you through high-strength triple-layer glass in the shape of three fingers, 15m long and 2m wide.
