Next to the observatory, there are various experience facilities such as a 980m long zip wire, a 1,000m long alpine coaster, and slides. ◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave - Entertainment <Point of Omniscient Interfere> This is the place where Lee Young-ja received a plaque of appreciation and Jeon Hyun-moo and Yoo Byeong-jae presented a congratulatory performance. Although it served as an event venue for entertainment, it is usually famous as an observatory with a panoramic view of Danyang. Many tourists visit here because they can enjoy not only the scenery but also various activities.
단양군 적성면에 위치한 만천하스카이워크에서는 남한강 절벽 위에서 80~9.zh: 在位于丹阳郡赤城面的万川河空中步道，您可以一边从南汉江的悬崖上俯瞰水下80至90米的地方，一边享受在空中步道上行走的快感。在通向展望台的螺旋路段，可以从各个角度欣赏风景，站在展望台上，南汉江流过山脊的景色会给您留下深刻的印象。登上展望台，可以看到城市全景和远处的小白山莲花峰。在马蹄形的万鹤川峰展望台，您可以体验在悬崖边缘行走的快感，同时透过长15m、宽2m的三指状高强度三层玻璃俯瞰脚下流淌的南汉江。展望台旁边有980m长的高空滑索、1000m长的高山过山车、滑梯等各种体验设施。 ◎ 感受韩流魅力的旅游信息 - 娱乐 <全知干涉点> 这里是李英子接受感谢牌、全贤武、刘秉宰进行祝贺表演的地方。虽然它是一个娱乐活动场所，但它通常以俯瞰丹阳全景的观景台而闻名。许多游客来到这里，不仅可以欣赏风景，还可以参加各种活动。

망상해변은 묵호항에서 북쪽으로 3㎞쯤 떨어져 있는 국민관광지로서 부근의.en: Mangsang Beach is a national tourist site located about 3km north of Mukho Port and is a famous tourist destination on the east coast along with nearby Okgye and Gyeongpo. It has the widest and most comfortable environment among East Coast beaches, including a wide white sand beach, dense pine forest (20 to 30 years old), clean sea water, and shallow water (slope of 2 to 4 degrees, average water depth of 0.5 to 1.5 m). It is convenient for tourists to use as it is well-equipped with various convenience facilities such as parking lots, camping sites, showers, and public restrooms. There is an auto camping site right above the beach. It is popular with family tourists. There are many simple beaches (Nobong, Daejin, Eodal, Hanseom, Gamchu, and Chuam beaches) to the south, including the nearby Cheongok Natural Cave, Mureung Valley, and Chuam Candlestick Rock. Along with nearby Mukho Port, it is one of the coastal tourist destinations connecting Gangneung and Samcheok, and is full of abundance and abundance with abundant seafood such as squid, conches, sea cucumbers, sea squirts, and flatfish.
망상해변은 묵호항에서 북쪽으로 3㎞쯤 떨어져 있는 국민관광지로서 부근의.zh: 望尚海水浴场位于墨湖港以北约3公里处，是国家级旅游胜地，与附近的玉溪、镜浦一起，是东海岸著名的旅游胜地。这里拥有东海岸海滩中最宽阔、最舒适的环境，包括宽阔的白色沙滩、茂密的松林（20至30年树龄）、洁净的海水、浅水（坡度2至4度，平均水深0.5至1.5m）。停车场、露营地、淋浴、公共卫生间等各种便利设施齐全，方便游客使用。海滩上方有一个汽车露营地。它很受家庭游客的欢迎。南部有许多简单的海滩（Nobong、Daejin、Eodal、Hanseom、Gamchu 和 Chuam 海滩），包括附近的 Cheongok 天然洞穴、Mureung Valley 和 Chuam Candlestick Rock。与附近的墨湖港一起，是连接江陵和三陟的沿海旅游胜地之一，盛产鱿鱼、海螺、海参、海鞘、比目鱼等丰富的海鲜。

망원유수지체육공원은 수해 조절용 유수지를 정비해서 2004년에 문을 연.en: Mangwon Reservoir Sports Park is a sports park in Mangwon-dong that opened in 2004 by renovating a reservoir for flood control. In 2008, an inline skating track, a urethane athletics track for pedestrians, a soccer field of international stadium standards, and night lighting facilities were additionally installed. Currently, it has facilities such as a soccer field, foot volleyball court, basketball court, inline practice field, multi-purpose track, gateball field, and physical training equipment. There is a night lighting facility, so evening exercise is possible. Additionally, there is a small path between the sports parks, so you can see many citizens taking a walk.
망원유수지체육공원은 수해 조절용 유수지를 정비해서 2004년에 문을 연.zh: 望远水库体育公园是位于望远洞的体育公园，于2004年通过改造防洪水库而开放。 2008年，增设直排轮滑道、聚氨酯步行跑道、国际体育场标准足球场、夜间照明设施。目前拥有足球场、足排球场、篮球场、直排练习场、多功能跑道、门球场、体能训练器材等设施。有夜间照明设施，可以进行夜间锻炼。另外，体育公园之间有一条小路，可以看到很多市民在散步。

서울 시민의 휴식공간인 한강시민공원 중 망원한강공원은 원효대교와 성산대교.en: Among the Hangang River Parks, which are a resting place for Seoul citizens, Mangwon Hangang Park is located at the northern end of the river between Wonhyodaegyo Bridge and Seongsandaegyo Bridge, and is adjacent to Mapo-gu. The berm has a well-developed resting area, including a lawn and a walking path, and various exercise facilities and bicycle paths are also provided. You can visit with friends and loved ones and have some relaxation time. In addition, water leisure activities such as windsurfing, water skiing, and motor boating are conducted on the water, and there are cultural heritage sites such as Mangwonjeong Pavilion and Jeoldusan Shrine nearby, and it is connected to the World Cup Stadium and Incheon International Airport.
서울 시민의 휴식공간인 한강시민공원 중 망원한강공원은 원효대교와 성산대교.zh: 作为首尔市民休憩场所的汉江公园中，望远汉江公园位于元晓大桥和城山大桥之间的汉江北端，与麻浦区相邻。护堤有完善的休息区，包括草坪和步行道，还提供各种健身设施和自行车道。您可以拜访朋友和亲人，享受一些放松的时光。此外，水上还可以进行帆板、滑水、摩托艇等水上休闲活动，附近还有望远亭、断头山神社等文化遗产地，并与世界杯体育场和仁川国际机场相连。

망월사는 자운봉, 만장봉, 선인봉, 주봉 등의 암봉이 수려하고 빼어난 도.en: Mangwolsa Temple is located on Dobongsan Mountain, which has beautiful and outstanding rock peaks such as Jaunbong, Manjangbong, Seoninbong, and Jubong. There is a course that goes from the ticket office to Daewonsa Temple, Wonhyosa Temple, and Gwangbeopsa Temple in order, and a course that follows the Wondobong Valley. From Mangwolsa Temple, whichever of the two hiking trails you climb, you will reach Podae Ridge. Mangwolsa Temple was founded by Monk Haeho in the 8th year of Queen Seondeok's reign (639), the 27th queen of Silla, at the queen's order to commemorate the prosperity of the royal family. At that time, it was named Mangwolsa Temple to pray for Wolseong (月城) in Seorabeol. Many great masters of fortune have passed through this place since ancient times, and many famous monks such as Hyegeo and Yeongsodaesa from the Goryeo Dynasty and Cheonbong, Yeongwol, and Doam from the Joseon Dynasty stayed here, and it is a place where Zen scholars such as Mangong, Hanam, and Seongwol, who are called modern Taoists, stayed. If you go up the hill to the southwest from the main shrine of Mangwolsa Temple, you will find the Buddha statue of State Preceptor Hyegeo (Gyeonggi-do tangible cultural property). Even now, many monks are practicing meditation. If you go over the hill to the southwest from the large shrine of Mangwolsa Temple, you will find the stupa of State Preceptor Hyegeo. A stupa is a stone pagoda that enshrines the relics or remains of a famous monk, and is usually built near a temple. This stupa, which enshrines State Preceptor Hyegeo’s relics, is octagonal in shape. The overall height is 3.4m and the circumference of the tower is 3.1m. Looking at the overall shape of the pagoda, it consists of a spherical pagoda body placed at the stylobate, a roof stone, and an upper ring. The stylobate is composed of a foundation stone and a pedestal stone. The foundation stone is made of an octagonal three-tiered stone and is 80cm high. And then a false lease was placed on top of it. The body of the tower is shaped like a ball, and grooves are carved on the top of the roof stone and the bottom of the roof stone to ensure stability of the entire tower. The roof stone, including the bokbal and the orb, is made of a single stone, the falling surface represents the roof shape of a wooden building, and there are a total of eight ear flowers. The upper part has a roof stone and a single stone, and the characteristic feature is that the lotus flower pattern is engraved on the upper surface. State Preceptor Hyegeo, the main character of Budo, was of the Noh clan and served as a state preceptor during the Goryeo Dynasty as Hongso. However, Haengjang is not well known to the world.
망월사는 자운봉, 만장봉, 선인봉, 주봉 등의 암봉이 수려하고 빼어난 도.zh: 望月寺位于道峰山，这里有紫云峰、万丈峰、仙人峰、十峰等美丽而杰出的岩峰。有从售票处依次前往大院寺、元晓寺、光法寺的路线和沿着元道峰溪谷的路线。从望月寺出发，无论攀登两条徒步路线中的哪一条，都将到达普台岭。望月寺是新罗第27代王后善德王后8年（639年），为纪念王室的昌盛，由僧人慧镐根据王后的命令创建的。当时，为了祈求西罗伐的月城，它被命名为望月寺。自古以来，许多大造化大师都经过此地，高丽时代的惠吉、映修大士，朝鲜时代的天峰、宁越、朵庵等许多名僧都曾在此居住过，被称为现代道士的万工、河南、成月等禅宗学者也曾在此居住过。从望月寺正殿向西南方向上山，可以看到惠居国师佛像（京畿道物质文化财产）。即使现在，仍有许多僧侣在练习冥想。从望月寺大殿向西南翻过山坡，就能看到慧国师的灵塔。佛塔是供奉着名僧舍利或遗骸的石塔，通常建在寺庙附近。这座佛塔供奉着惠吉国师的舍利，呈八角形。总高3.4m，塔周长3.1m。从塔的整体造型来看，它由置于基台的球形塔身、顶石、上环组成。台座由基石和台座石组成。基石由八角三层石砌成，高80厘米。然后在其上面放置了虚假租约。塔身呈球状，在顶石的顶部和底部均刻有凹槽，以保证整个塔的稳定性。屋顶石，包括博克巴尔和球体，由一块石头制成，落面代表木建筑的屋顶形状，共有八朵耳花。上部有顶石和单石，其特征是上表面刻有莲花图案。 《武道》的主角惠吉国师出身于高丽时代，号称弘祖，出身于能氏。然而，Haengjang并不为世人所熟知。

거제 매미성은 2003년 태풍 매미로 인해 삶의 터전을 잃은 백순삼 씨가.en: Geoje Maemi Fortress is a wall built by Baek Soon-sam, who lost his home due to Typhoon Maemi in 2003, to protect his farmland from natural disasters. After farmland was washed away by a typhoon, he built a castle by himself over a long period of time by stacking square stones one by one near the beach and filling in the gaps with cement. The resulting Cicada Castle was not just a breakwater or fence, but had a unique appearance reminiscent of the European Middle Ages. Thanks to this unique scenery, which creates a rare exotic atmosphere, Maemisung Castle has now become one of Geoje's tourist attractions, and with photo zones everywhere, it is considered a good place for visitors to take pictures of their lives.
거제 매미성은 2003년 태풍 매미로 인해 삶의 터전을 잃은 백순삼 씨가.zh: 巨济前美城是2003年因台风前美而失去家园的白顺三为了保护农田免受自然灾害而修建的城墙。农田被台风冲毁后，他在海边把方石一块一块堆起来，用水泥填平空隙，花了很长时间，自己建造了一座城堡。由此产生的蝉城堡不仅仅是防波堤或栅栏，而且具有独特的外观，让人想起欧洲中世纪。由于这种独特的风景，营造出罕见的异国情调，梅美星城现已成为巨济的旅游景点之一，并且随处可见拍照区，被认为是游客拍摄生活的好地方。

수원시 매탄공원은 1989년에 조성된 공원으로, 아파트 밀집 지역에 위치.en: Maetan Park in Suwon City is a park created in 1989. It is located in a densely populated area of ​​apartments and is in the spotlight as a resting place for citizens. The park has sports facilities such as a multi-purpose playground, tennis court, badminton court, and basketball court. Multipurpose playgrounds are often used as event venues for companies, religious organizations, etc. In addition, there are convenient facilities such as a senior citizen center, mineral spring, and restrooms. The forest is thick, making it a suitable place for forest bathing.
수원시 매탄공원은 1989년에 조성된 공원으로, 아파트 밀집 지역에 위치.zh: 水原市梅滩公园是1989年创建的公园。它位于人口稠密的公寓区，作为市民的休息场所而备受瞩目。公园内设有多功能游乐场、网球场、羽毛球场、篮球场等体育设施。多功能游乐场经常被用作公司、宗教组织等的活动场所。此外，还有老年人中心、矿泉、卫生间等便利设施。森林茂密，适宜森林浴。

1951년부터 54년간 주한미군이 전투기 사격장으로 이용하던 곳이다. 쿠.en: It was used as a fighter jet shooting range by the U.S. Forces Korea for 54 years from 1951. The name ‘Kuni’ at Kuni Shooting Range originated from the U.S. military mispronouncing Goon-ri, the old name for Maehyang-ri. As it was a shooting range, various bomb remnants remain. It was reborn as a cultural and artistic space to publicize the pain of the Korean War. There are works made from shells and shell casings that are remnants of bombing training, such as the Statue of Peace.
1951년부터 54년간 주한미군이 전투기 사격장으로 이용하던 곳이다. 쿠.zh: 从1951年起，它被韩国美军用作战斗机射击场，长达54年。六合射击场的“六合”这个名字源于美国军方将梅香里的旧称“Goon-ri”读错了。由于这里是射击场，所以还残留着各种炸弹残留物。它重生为宣传朝鲜战争痛苦的文化艺术空间。还有一些用炮弹和弹壳制成的作品，这些作品是轰炸训练的残余物，例如和平雕像。

오랜 아픔을 이겨낸 평화의 상징&nbsp;매향리평화기념관은 매향리의 아픈.en: Maehyang-ri Peace Memorial Hall, a symbol of peace that overcame long pain, was established to remember the painful history of Maehyang-ri and to convey the value of peace to future generations. After the outbreak of the Korean War in 1950, Kuni Shooting Range was established in Maehyang-ri for shooting training by US military units. Until the closure of the Kuni Shooting Range in 2005, the roar of military aircraft and the sound of shells continued to be heard in Maehyang-ri Village, and residents had to live in pain due to casualties and environmental pollution caused by accidental explosions and unexploded bombs. After the Kuni Shooting Range was closed due to the active struggle of residents, the barbed wire surrounding the Kuni Shooting Range and some buildings were preserved to remember the pain of the past and the history of the closure movement, and in 2016, the Kuni Shooting Range was registered as Korea's first 'excellent architectural asset'. The famous Peace Memorial Hall, designed by world-renowned architect Mario Botta, is located on the right side of the site. Mario Botta, who values ​​‘connection with the past,’ designed a shape that embraces the entire Kuni Shooting Range site without encroaching on the existing Kuni Shooting Range buildings, and designed the current semicircular building. The memorial cenotaph located in front of the corridor of the memorial hall is a structure in which circular passages are vertically repeated. It is a cenotaph in memory of the victims, and functions as an observatory overlooking the Kuni Shooting Range, Nongseom Island, and the vicinity of Maehyang-ri. The Maehyang-ri Peace Memorial Hall consists of a permanent exhibition room that examines the process from the establishment of the Kuni Shooting Range to its closure, a special exhibition room that presents exhibitions planned by researching various topics related to the history and culture of Maehyang-ri, and a children's experience room. In addition, an exhibition room has been created in some of the existing buildings of Kuni Shooting Range, which is listed as Gyeonggi-do's No. 1 outstanding architectural asset, so you can view unique and lively exhibitions.
오랜 아픔을 이겨낸 평화의 상징&nbsp;매향리평화기념관은 매향리의 아픈.zh: 梅香里和平纪念馆是克服长期痛苦的和平象征，是为了纪念梅香里的痛苦历史并向子孙后代传达和平的价值而设立的。 1950年朝鲜战争爆发后，在梅香里建立了六合射击场，供美军部队进行射击训练。直到2005年六合射击场关闭，梅香里村军机轰鸣声和炮弹声不断，居民因意外爆炸和未爆炸炸弹造成的人员伤亡和环境污染而生活在痛苦之中。 由于居民的积极斗争，六合射击场被关闭后，六合射击场周围的铁丝网和一些建筑物被保留下来，以铭记过去的痛苦和关闭运动的历史，并于2016年，六合射击场被注册为韩国第一个“优秀建筑资产”。 著名的和平纪念馆位于场地右侧，由世界著名建筑师马里奥·博塔设计。 重视“与过去联系”的马里奥·博塔设计了一个拥抱整个六合射击场场地而不侵占现有六合射击场建筑的形状，并设计了现在的半圆形建筑。 位于纪念堂走廊前的纪念碑是一个垂直重复圆形通道的结构。它是纪念遇难者的纪念碑，也是俯瞰六合射击场、农岛和梅香里附近的展望台。 梅香里和平纪念馆由展示六合射击场从建立到关闭的过程的常设展览室、展示梅香里历史和文化相关各种主题的展览的特别展览室以及儿童体验室。 此外，在被列为京畿道第一优秀建筑资产的六合射击场的部分现有建筑中还设置了展示室，可以观赏到独特而生动的展览。

메디테리움은 파주 출판도시 인근에 위치한 의학 테마 문화공간으로 의학 서.en: Meditherium is a medical-themed cultural space located near Paju Book City and is operated by Gunja Publishing, a publisher specializing in medical books. The purpose of this place is to acquire basic knowledge and relieve fears about medicine, which is inseparable from our lives. To this end, it is equipped with a cafe and bookstore where you can access medical books, a medical history museum, and a medical experience center where you can enjoy medical experiences such as playing a doctor, so you can read, learn, and experience medicine. In particular, the Medical History Museum displays medical tools and specimens used in the past, and at the Medical Experience Center, you can also learn CPR, which is essential in emergency situations. Nearby are tourist attractions such as Odusan Unification Observatory and Heyri Art Village, and Unjeong City and Jayu-ro are adjacent, making it easily accessible.
메디테리움은 파주 출판도시 인근에 위치한 의학 테마 문화공간으로 의학 서.zh: Meditherium是位于坡州书城附近的一个以医学为主题的文化空间，由专门出版医学书籍的出版商Gunja Publishing运营。这个地方的目的是为了获得基础知识并解除对医学的恐惧，医学与我们的生活密不可分。为此，这里配备了可以查阅医学书籍的咖啡馆和书店、病史博物馆、可以享受扮演医生等医疗体验的医疗体验中心，让您可以阅读医学、学习医学、体验医学。特别是，医学历史博物馆展示了过去使用过的医疗工具和标本，在医疗体验中心，您还可以学习紧急情况下必不可少的心肺复苏术。附近有五头山统一展望台、Heyri艺术村等旅游景点，且与云井市和自由路相邻，交通便利。

명달리는 경기도 양평군 서종면에 자리 잡은 두메산골마을의 지명이다. 이.en: Myeongdali is the name of Dume Mountain Valley Village located in Seojong-myeon, Yangpyeong-gun, Gyeonggi-do. This village is considered a remote area of ​​Gyeonggi-do and is untouched by development. Even now, only a small number of people are guarding this place. This is why Myeongdali Valley at the foot of Samtaebong Peak preserves its pristine, ancient natural ecology. Because of the lack of foot traffic, this valley is still rich in a variety of wild flowers.
명달리는 경기도 양평군 서종면에 자리 잡은 두메산골마을의 지명이다. 이.zh: 明达里是位于京畿道杨平郡西宗面的杜梅山谷村的名称。这个村庄被认为是京畿道的偏远地区，未受开发影响。即便是现在，也只有少数人守护着这里。这就是为什么三泰峰脚下的明达里谷保留了原始、古老的自然生态。由于人迹罕至，这个山谷仍然盛产各种野花。

가을철이면 억새산행 대상지로 유명한 산이다. 서울에서 동북으로 84km,.en: This mountain is famous as a destination for silver grass hiking in the fall season. Myeongseongsan Mountain (922.6m), located 84km northeast of Seoul and about 7km from Uncheon, has Sanjeong Lake at the foot of the mountain, so you can enjoy hiking and the atmosphere of the lake. There is a legend that the joys and sorrows of Gungye, who founded Taebongguk, were hidden in the magnificent Myeongseong Mountain, which spreads out like a folding screen behind the lake. There is a theory that the mountain also cried as they cried over the sorrow of the fall of the country. There is also a legend that it is called Weeping Mountain because a servant and a horse who lost their owner to Wang Geon's servant cried so hard that the mountain cried. There is a legend that it is called Myeongseongsan Mountain by using the characters 'ul' and 'myeong'. Accordingly, starting in 1997, the Silver Grass Flower Festival at Sanjeong Lake and Myeongseongsan Mountain began to be held from late September to early October. With the development of a hiking trail in connection with the Sanjeong Lake tourist attraction, it is gaining attention as a hiking course preferred by professional mountaineers, beginners, and people of all ages. The view from the summit is Oseongsan Mountain to the north, Shanghai Peak, Daeseongsan Mountain, and Baekamsan Mountain to the northeast, Gwangdeoksan Mountain to the east, and Baekunsan Mountain and Gumgangbong Peak to the southeast.
가을철이면 억새산행 대상지로 유명한 산이다. 서울에서 동북으로 84km,.zh: 这座山作为秋季紫芒徒步旅行的目的地而闻名。明城山（922.6m）位于首尔东北84公里处，距仁川约7公里，山脚下有山井湖，可以享受徒步旅行和湖水氛围。相传，湖后如屏风般展开的雄伟明城山中，隐藏着太凤国创建者弓溪的悲欢离合。有一种说法是，山也哭了，就像他们为国家沦陷的悲伤而哭泣一样。还有一个传说，因为王建的仆人失去了主人的仆人和一匹马哭得山哭，所以被称为哭泣山。传说以“ul”和“mying”的文字被称为明城山。因此，从1997年开始，山井湖和明城山开始于9月下旬至10月上旬举办紫芒花节。随着与山井湖旅游景点相连的登山路线的开发，它作为专业登山者、初学者和所有年龄段的人首选的登山路线而受到关注。从山顶眺望，北面是五圣山，东北面是上海峰、大城山、白岩山，东面是光德山，东南面是白云山、金刚峰。

가평 명지계곡은 명지산 군립 공원 매표소에서 시작하여 승천사를 거쳐 명지.en: Gapyeong Myeongji Valley starts from the Myeongjisan County Park ticket office, passes Seungcheonsa Temple, and reaches Myeongji Falls. The water is clear and abundant, and many large and small reservoirs are distributed. This is where the water flowing down from Myeongji Mountain and Hwaak Mountain meet to form a 5km long valley. The water is so clear that you can see the bottom, and the water is cold enough to make you forget about summer. The water gets clearer as you go upstream, but it is too low for swimming, so most people enjoy swimming in the downstream. The depth of the water varies from shallow to deep, and the current is strong in some places, so you must wear a life jacket and play safely when playing in the water. It is easy to go down to the valley through the guesthouse at the entrance to Myeongjisan Mountain, and there is a path down to the valley next to the Dodae 1-ri Bridge. The parking lot at the entrance is also quite large, so you can park here or, when using public transportation, get off at the bus stop at the entrance to Myeongjisan Mountain and come to Myeongji Valley. Since there is little shade, it would be good to pitch a tent or shade cloth on a flat surface, and above all, it would be refreshing to take a dip in the valley water. The valley is wide, so you can enjoy it comfortably even if there are a lot of people. The water is clear, so it's good for snorkeling, and there are places for diving, so you can enjoy a variety of water activities. There is a tap at the top of the valley where you can wash your hands and feet, making it a convenient place to enjoy the summer with family and friends.
가평 명지계곡은 명지산 군립 공원 매표소에서 시작하여 승천사를 거쳐 명지.zh: 加平明知溪谷从明知山郡立公园售票处出发，经过升天寺，到达明知瀑布。水质清澈、水量充沛，分布着许多大大小小的水库。从明知山和华岳山流下的水在这里交汇，形成了5公里长的山谷。水清得见底，水凉得让人忘记夏天。越往上游，水越清澈，但水位太低，不适合游泳，所以大多数人喜欢在下游游泳。水深有浅有深，有的地方水流较强，所以玩水时一定要穿上救生衣，安全玩耍。通过明池山入口处的宾馆可以轻松下到山谷，在都台一里大桥旁边有一条下到山谷的路。入口处的停车场也很大，可以在这里停车，或者乘坐公共交通工具时，在明知山入口处的公交车站下车，来到明知谷。由于阴凉处很少，最好在平坦的地面上搭个帐篷或遮光布，最重要的是，泡在山谷里的水会很清爽。山谷很宽阔，即使人多也能舒适地享受。海水清澈，很适合浮潜，还有潜水的地方，可以享受各种水上活动。山谷顶部设有水龙头，可以洗手洗脚，是与家人朋友共度夏日的便捷场所。

명지산 군립 공원은 경기도 가평군 북면과 조종면에 걸쳐 있는 명지산에 지.en: Myeongjisan County Park is a designated county park on Myeongjisan Mountain, which straddles Buk-myeon and Jojong-myeon, Gapyeong-gun, Gyeonggi-do. There is an ecological exploration center at the entrance, where you can learn about medicinal herbs, rare plants, and wild flowers. There is a firefly cave, insect experience, plants, and fish on display, and various ecological experiences are possible. The hiking course starts at the end of Baekdun-ri, passes the 2nd peak of Myeongjisan Mountain, reaches the summit, and then descends to Ikgeun-ri via Seungcheonsa Temple. It takes about 6 hours. The second hiking trail starts from the Baekdun-ri bus terminal and passes through Ajaebi Hill and Myeongji 3 Peaks to the summit. It is about 6.5km long and takes about 4 hours and 20 minutes. Myeongjisan County Park carried out a Sky Cloud Bridge installation project inside the park in October 2019 and completed the first and second Sky Cloud Bridges. When you cross the skybridge, you will feel a different thrill from hiking. In spring, azaleas bloom here and there in abundance, and the 28km-long Myeongji Valley serves as a summer resort for travelers from the metropolitan area in the summer. The fall foliage is beautiful in the Ikgeun-ri Valley, Seungcheonsa Temple, and Myeongji Falls. This is because there are a lot of broad-leaved trees growing there. The course that goes from Sangpan-ri on the west side of Myeongjisan Mountain to the summit and down to Ikgeun-ri on the east side is an easy hiking course even for beginners.
명지산 군립 공원은 경기도 가평군 북면과 조종면에 걸쳐 있는 명지산에 지.zh: 明芝山郡立公园是位于京畿道加平郡北面和朝宗面之间的明芝山上的指定郡立公园。入口处有一个生态探索中心，可以了解药材、珍稀植物、野花。有萤火虫洞、昆虫体验、植物、鱼类展示，可以进行各种生态体验。徒步路线从白墩里的尽头开始，经过明池山第二峰，到达山顶，然后经升天寺下降到益根里。大约需要6个小时。第二条徒步路线从白墩里巴士总站出发，经过阿才鼻山和明知三峰到达山顶。全长约6.5公里，耗时约4小时20分钟。明知山郡立公园于2019年10月在公园内实施了天云桥安装工程，完成了第一座和第二座天云桥。当你跨过天桥时，你会感受到与徒步旅行不同的刺激。春天，杜鹃花到处盛开，而全长28公里的明知溪谷则是夏季来自首都圈的游客的避暑胜地。益根里溪谷、升天寺、明池瀑布的红叶非常美丽。这是因为那里生长着很多阔叶树。从明池山西侧的上板里到山顶，再到东侧的益根里的路线，即使是初学者也能轻松上路。

한국의 백두대간 한가운데 위치한 모나 용평은 인간의 신체에 가장 이상적인.en: Mona Yongpyeong, located in the middle of Korea's Baekdudaegan Mountain Range, is located on a pristine plateau 700 to 1,500 meters above sea level that provides the most ideal biorhythm for the human body. It is called the Korean Alps and is about 200 km away from Seoul. Mona Yongpyeong, which started as Korea's first ski resort with modern facilities in 1975, is the ‘Mecca of Korean skiing’ and has played a leading role in the development and popularization of domestic skiing. Located at the foot of Balwangsan Mountain, 1,458 meters above sea level, it has an ideal location for skiing from mid-November to early April of the following year with an average annual snowfall of 250 cm. In addition, within the 5.2 million pyeong complex, various leisure sports facilities such as a 45-hole golf course, gondolas, swimming pools, and accommodations such as luxury hotels, condominiums, and hostels are in harmony with Mother Nature, making it a four-season comprehensive resort where you can enjoy a comfortable and pleasant vacation as well as leisure life away from daily business. The history of Korean skiing has developed along with Yongpyeong, and through the IOC Winter Olympics due diligence, It was evaluated as a world-class ski resort with complete hardware and software. Equipped with 28 diverse slopes including the Rainbow Slope, 14 lift facilities including a 3.7 km one-way gondola, and Korea's largest ski house (Dragon Plaza), Yongpyeong is used by the largest number of skiers in Korea. It is well-known internationally for successfully hosting the World Cup ski competition and the Asian Winter Games international competition for many years, and is also renowned among skiers and tourists from Japan and other Asian countries.
한국의 백두대간 한가운데 위치한 모나 용평은 인간의 신체에 가장 이상적인.zh: 莫那龙平位于韩国白头大干山脉中部，地处海拔700至1500米的原始高原上，为人体提供了最理想的生物节律。它被称为韩国阿尔卑斯山，距首尔约200公里。莫那龙平滑雪场始建于1975年，是韩国第一个拥有现代化设施的滑雪场，被誉为“韩国滑雪圣地”，在国内滑雪运动的发展和普及中发挥了主导作用。位于发王山山麓，海拔1458米，11月中旬至次年4月初，年平均降雪量250厘米，是滑雪的理想场所。此外，在占地520万坪的综合体内，45洞高尔夫球场、缆车、游泳池等各种休闲运动设施，以及豪华酒店、公寓、旅馆等住宿设施，与大自然融为一体，使其成为一个四季皆宜的综合度假村，让您享受舒适愉快的假期以及远离日常事务的休闲生活。韩国滑雪历史与龙平一起发展，并通过国际奥委会冬奥会尽职调查，被评价为软硬件齐全的世界级滑雪场。龙平滑雪场拥有彩虹滑雪场等28个不同的滑雪场、3.7公里单程缆车等14个缆车设施以及韩国最大的滑雪场（龙广场），是韩国滑雪人数最多的滑雪场。它因连续多年成功举办世界杯滑雪比赛和亚洲冬季运动会国际比赛而享誉国际，在日本和亚洲其他国家的滑雪者和游客中也享有盛誉。

모다아울렛 구리남양주점은 패션부터 식음료까지 다양한 카테고리를 한 공간에.en: Moda Outlet Guri-Namyangju branch is an outlet that offers a variety of categories from fashion to food and beverage in one space. Located near Galmae Station, local residents visit it on a daily basis, and it is loved as a major shopping facility in the Guri and Namyangju areas. The brand composition was expanded through renewal in September 2025. Fashion, sports, living, and F&B brands are evenly distributed across four floors, so you can browse the products you need at once. The interior is neatly organized and provides a pleasant shopping environment, and it is relatively quiet, allowing for leisurely movement.
모다아울렛 구리남양주점은 패션부터 식음료까지 다양한 카테고리를 한 공간에.zh: Moda Outlet 九里南阳州店是一家在同一空间内提供从时装到餐饮等多种品类的奥特莱斯。位于葛美站附近，当地居民每天都会光临，作为九里、南杨州地区的主要购物设施而深受喜爱。 2025年9月通过更新扩大了品牌构成，时尚、运动、生活、餐饮品牌均匀分布在四层楼，您可以一次性浏览到您需要的商品。店内布局整齐，购物环境宜人，而且相对安静，可以悠闲地活动。

모란미술관은 경기도 마석에 위치한 사립미술관으로 1990년 4월에 개관하.en: The Moran Art Museum is a private art museum located in Maseok, Gyeonggi-do and opened in April 1990. The Moran Art Museum, which started out as a sculpture museum, has held various special exhibitions and currently introduces and exhibits not only sculpture but also various genres of art. The Moran Art Museum's outdoor sculpture exhibition hall is a space of approximately 8,600 pyeong, where works by famous domestic and foreign sculptors are displayed and various cultural events are held. The main building of the Moran Art Museum is a two-story building with six exhibition rooms where exhibitions are held. The storage and peony tower designed by architect Lee Young-beom are buildings that received a design award from the New York City branch of the American Institute of Architects, and can be said to be a place to store the museum's collections and materials as well as a sculpture. Inside the Peony Tower is the [Balzac] sculpture by Auguste Rodin (1840-1917), which was cast in plaster based on Rodin's original work at the Louvre's casting atelier. Moran Space (annex building) is a space that can be rented for cultural events and various exhibitions, and is where the Moran Museum's school and educational programs are held. At the Moran Art Museum, you can listen to exhibition explanations from professional commentators, and if you wish to apply, you can do so through the website. In addition, if you want to participate in exhibition-related programs, special education programs, and various cultural events, you can check detailed information and apply through the website. Not only indoor space but also outdoor space can be rented. The outdoor space (Area B) is rented out for wedding events, and other spaces are also rented out for performances, concerts, dramas and movie filming, etc.
모란미술관은 경기도 마석에 위치한 사립미술관으로 1990년 4월에 개관하.zh: 莫兰美术馆是位于京畿道马石的一家私立美术馆，于1990年4月开馆。莫兰美术馆最初是一家雕塑博物馆，举办过各种特别展览，现在不仅介绍和展示雕塑，还介绍和展示各种类型的艺术。莫兰美术馆的户外雕塑展厅面积约8,600坪，展示国内外著名雕塑家的作品，并举办各种文化活动。莫兰艺术博物馆的主楼是一栋两层楼的建筑，有六个展览室，举办展览。由建筑师李英范设计的储藏室和牡丹塔是获得美国建筑师学会纽约市分会设计奖的建筑，可以说是储存博物馆藏品和材料以及雕塑的地方。牡丹塔内有奥古斯特·罗丹（1840-1917）的“巴尔扎克”雕塑，是根据罗丹在卢浮宫铸造工作室的原作石膏铸造的。莫兰空间（附楼）是一个可出租举办文化活动和各种展览的空间，也是莫兰博物馆学校和教育项目的举办地。在莫兰艺术博物馆，您可以聆听专业解说员的展览讲解，如果您想申请，可以通过网站申请。此外，如果您想参加展览相关项目、特殊教育项目以及各种文化活动，您可以通过网站查看详细信息并申请。不仅可以租用室内空间，还可以租用室外空间。室外空间（B区）出租用于婚礼活动，其他空间也出租用于表演、音乐会、戏剧和电影拍摄等。

목아박물관은 한국의 전통 목공예와 불교미술의 계승 발전을 위해 설립된 사.en: Mok-a Museum is a private museum established to inherit and develop traditional Korean woodcraft and Buddhist art. It was founded by Park Chan-soo, Intangible Cultural Heritage No. 108 (Wood Carving). Construction began in February 1989, the exhibition hall was completed the following year, and it opened as a traditional crafts hall, followed by the construction of auxiliary buildings such as an arts and science laboratory, Sobanjeongsa, and an outdoor exhibition hall. It was officially opened in 1993 with the installation of the Maitreya Triad Buddha in the outdoor exhibition hall. The museum consists of an outdoor sculpture park and an exhibition hall on the first basement floor and three above-ground floors. The exhibition hall displays relics such as Buddhist statues, Buddhist paintings, and Buddhist woodwork, as well as Buddhist wood sculptures and woodwork works by Director Mok-a Park Chan-soo, and the outdoor sculpture park features the Maitreya Triad Buddha, Vairocana Buddha, White-robed Avalokitesvara, and a three-story stone pagoda in harmony.
목아박물관은 한국의 전통 목공예와 불교미술의 계승 발전을 위해 설립된 사.zh: 木阿博物馆是一家私人博物馆，旨在继承和发展韩国传统木工艺和佛教艺术。由非物质文化遗产第108号（木雕）朴赞秀创立。 1989年2月开始动工，次年展厅竣工，作为传统工艺馆开放，随后又兴建了文理实验室、小板精舍、室外展厅等辅助建筑。 1993年正式开放，室外展厅安置弥勒三尊佛。博物馆由地下一层、地上三层的室外雕塑公园和展厅组成。展厅内陈列有佛像、佛画、佛教木制品等文物，以及朴灿洙木雅馆长的佛教木雕、木制品作品，室外雕塑公园内有弥勒三尊佛、毗卢遮那佛、白衣观音、三层石塔等，和谐共存。

목포연안여객선터미널은 목포시 항동에 위치한 여객터미널이다. 전라남도 서남.en: Mokpo Coastal Ferry Terminal is a passenger terminal located in Hang-dong, Mokpo-si. It plays a role in connecting islands in the southwestern region of Jeollanam-do and Dadohaehaesang National Park. The waiting room can accommodate 1,738 people, and there are 7 shipping companies, including Namhae Express, Joyang Transportation, and Shinjin Shipping. Inside, it is well-equipped with convenient facilities such as a ticket office, information room, concession stand, snack corner, unmanned civil service issuance machine, nursing room, rest area, and restroom. In addition, the Mokpo Shinan Tourism Promotion Center is located in Building 2, where you can take a quick look around, and the 4th floor has a comprehensive culture and arts gallery and an outdoor garden, creating a space for resting.
목포연안여객선터미널은 목포시 항동에 위치한 여객터미널이다. 전라남도 서남.zh: 木浦沿海客运码头是位于木浦市杭洞的客运码头。它起着连接全罗南道西南部岛屿和多岛海海上国立公园的作用。候车室可容纳1738人，有南海急运、朝阳运输、新进海运等7家船运公司。馆内设有售票处、问询处、小卖部、小吃角、无人公务员发卡机、哺乳室、休息区、卫生间等便利设施。此外，木浦新安旅游宣传中心位于2号楼，可以快速浏览，4楼设有综合文化艺术画廊和室外花园，营造休息空间。

목포해상케이블카는 슬로시티 목포의 옛 중심지인 목포 원도심과 북항, 유달.en: Mokpo Marine Cable Car is a new central axis of marine tourism, leisure, and cultural tourism that provides a panoramic view of the beautiful scenery of Mokpo's original downtown, North Port, Mt. Yudal, as well as Gohado Island, the old center of Slow City Mokpo. Considering the topographical characteristics and excellent scenery of Yudalsan Mountain, it boasts the longest mountain in Korea at 3.23km and the highest height in Korea at 155m, offering a view of the original city center and the entire Dadohae Sea.
목포해상케이블카는 슬로시티 목포의 옛 중심지인 목포 원도심과 북항, 유달.zh: 木浦海上缆车是木浦原来的市中心、北港、儒达山以及木浦慢城旧中心高下岛的美景尽收眼底的海上旅游、休闲、文化旅游的新中轴。考虑到儒达山的地形特点和绝佳的风景，这里拥有韩国最长的山峰（3.23km）和韩国最高的山峰（155m），可以看到原来的市中心和整个多岛海。

김포 몬스터리움은 동물원과 아쿠아리움을 한곳에서 체험할 수 있는 곳으로,.en: Gimpo Monsterrium is a place where you can experience a zoo and aquarium in one place, and is located next to the Gimpo Fisheries Park cafe. It is also a famous filming location for the drama 'Weird Lawyer Woo Young-woo', and the exterior of the building, filled with the mysterious appearance of a swimming humpback whale, attracts visitors' attention. Here, you can see a variety of crustaceans, reptiles, rare animals, and even ancient fish. Although the scale is not comparable to large aquariums, the well-maintained transparent aquarium and clean indoor facilities give a pleasant feeling. You can take memorable photos at cute and fun photo zones located throughout the area. For children, the experience of feeding animals such as carp, turtles, rabbits, and alpacas is popular. At the reptile museum, you can also have the opportunity to touch the animals yourself. In addition, you can see the piraruq, the world's largest freshwater fish, which mainly lives in the Amazon River. If you go at the designated time, you can also enjoy the piraruq show. On the rooftop of the building, you can take the photo of your life at a place called the Stairway to Heaven, with the rooftop deck decorated with trick art as the background. The rooftop is also connected to the Fisheries Park cafe right next door, so it's a good idea to visit together.
김포 몬스터리움은 동물원과 아쿠아리움을 한곳에서 체험할 수 있는 곳으로,.zh: 金浦怪兽馆位于金浦水产公园咖啡厅旁边，是一处可以同时体验动物园和水族馆的地方。这里还是电视剧《奇怪的律师吴英宇》的著名拍摄地，建筑物的外观充满了座头鲸游泳的神秘外观，吸引了游客的目光。在这里，你可以看到各种甲壳类、爬行类、珍稀动物，甚至远古鱼类。虽然规模无法与大型水族馆相媲美，但维护良好的透明水族馆和干净的室内设施，给人一种赏心悦目的感觉。您可以在遍布整个区域的可爱有趣的拍照区拍出令人难忘的照片。对于孩子们来说，喂鲤鱼、乌龟、兔子、羊驼等动物的体验很受欢迎。在爬行动物博物馆，您还可以有机会亲自触摸动物。此外，您还可以看到世界上最大的淡水鱼皮拉鲁克鱼，它主要生活在亚马逊河中。如果在指定时间前往，还可以欣赏皮拉鲁克表演。在大楼的屋顶上，您可以在一个名为“天国的阶梯”的地方，以装饰有特技艺术的屋顶平台为背景，拍摄自己的生活照片。屋顶还与隔壁的渔业公园咖啡馆相连，所以一起参观是个好主意。

백봉산은 해발 589m로 산세가 아름답고 동쪽으로 한강을 끼고 있어 전망.en: Baekbongsan Mountain is 589m above sea level, has a beautiful mountainous landscape, and is located along the Han River to the east, providing an excellent view. In the southern valley of Baekbongsan Mountain, there is Myojeoksa Temple, which is said to have been founded by Master Wonhyo during the reign of King Munmu of Silla. The long valley below is called Myojeoksa Valley. Myojeoksa Valley runs along a mountain path from Wolmun-ri, Wabu-eup, Namyangju-si, Gyeonggi-do to Myojeoksa Temple. After passing Myojeok Bridge, the valley begins in earnest. Many people visit the winding mountain road, which changes from narrow to wide depending on the section, and waterfalls with cool streams of water are formed here and there. Myojeoksa Valley is also undergoing changes due to the river gardening project that began in 2018. The water in Myojeoksa Valley is not deep, so anyone can enjoy swimming safely, and the depth of the water under the cool waterfall is about the knee level of an adult. It's great for family fun in the water.
백봉산은 해발 589m로 산세가 아름답고 동쪽으로 한강을 끼고 있어 전망.zh: 白峰山海拔589m，山地景观优美，东临汉江，风景优美。白峰山南麓有一座妙寂寺，据说是新罗文武王时期元晓法师创建的。下面那条长长的山谷叫做妙积寺溪谷。妙寂寺溪谷从京畿道南杨州市洼府邑月门里一直延伸到妙寂寺。过了妙寂桥后，山谷就正式开始了。蜿蜒的山路，根据路段的不同，由窄到宽，随处可见瀑布和清凉的水流，游客络绎不绝。妙积寺溪谷也因2018年开始的河川园艺工程而发生着变化。妙积寺溪谷的水不深，任何人都可以安全地享受游泳的乐趣，凉爽的瀑布下的水深约为成人的膝盖深。非常适合家庭在水中玩耍。

무주군은 덕유산국립공원을 품고 있는 전북의 고산 지방이다. 진안, 장수와.en: Muju-gun is an alpine region in Jeonbuk that contains Deogyusan National Park. Along with Jinan and Jangsu, Jeonbuk people also call these towns, the roof of Jeonbuk, collectively Mujinjang. The eastern part of Muju-gun forms a border with Gimcheon-si in Gyeongsangbuk-do and Geochang-gun in Gyeongsangnam-do. The Sobaek Mountain Range lies between them. During the Three Kingdoms period, the eastern part of Muju-gun was also the border between Silla and Baekje. Muju Deogyusan Resort, located at the foot of Deogyusan Mountain, boasts an area of ​​approximately 2.123 million pyeong. It is a four-season comprehensive resort for the whole family, and is equipped with an Austrian-style deluxe hotel called Tyrol, which suits the mountainous terrain, as well as family hotels and national hotels, providing comfortable accommodations for visitors and allowing them to enjoy a variety of leisure sports in the clean air.
무주군은 덕유산국립공원을 품고 있는 전북의 고산 지방이다. 진안, 장수와.zh: 茂朱郡是全北的高山地区，拥有德裕山国立公园。与济南、长寿一样，全北人民也将这些城镇称为全北的屋顶，统称为“无真庄”。茂朱郡东部与庆尚北道金泉市、庆尚南道居昌郡接壤。小白山脉位于它们之间。三国时期，茂朱郡东部也是新罗和百济的边界。茂朱德裕山度假村位于德裕山山麓，面积约212.3万坪。它是适合全家度假的四季综合度假胜地，配有适合山地地形的奥地利风格的蒂罗尔豪华酒店，以及家庭旅馆和民族旅馆，为游客提供舒适的住宿，让他们在洁净的空气中享受各种休闲运动。

경기 가평군 북면 적목리에 있는 무주채 폭포는 도마치봉에서 시작하여 견치.en: Mujuchae Waterfall, located in Jeokmok-ri, Buk-myeon, Gapyeong-gun, Gyeonggi-do, is a waterfall formed by water flowing down the mountain range of the Gwangju Mountain Range, which starts from Domachibong Peak and continues to Gyeonchisan Mountain, Gangsibong Peak, and Cheonggyesan Mountain. It is located about 1km up past Yongso Waterfall. The waterfall flows down the rock wall, hits the rock, and falls like a spray of water. When viewed from a distance, it looks like unraveled white silk thread. It is located 34km away from Gapyeong-eup, and the area around the waterfall is well-organized with various forests, and it is famous for its fall foliage, which is as beautiful as the spectacular view of Seoraksan Mountain. There is a legend that in the past, military officers enjoyed drinking and dancing with vegetables as snacks, so it is called Mujuchae Falls, and the water is so cold that you feel cold even in the middle of summer. You can use the parking lot in front of Domachi Valley at Mujuchae Falls, and the path up there is well-maintained with deck paths and bridges, so you can walk while looking around comfortably and safely. As you climb the road, you can feel the fresh air with your whole body, and there is a bench installed in the middle of the road so you can rest if you are tired. Mujuchae Waterfall, which pours from the top of the rock, falls in two stages and is impressive with its grandeur and coolness. It would be nice to go here with the family and see the wonderful waterfall.
경기 가평군 북면 적목리에 있는 무주채 폭포는 도마치봉에서 시작하여 견치.zh: 武朱蔡瀑布位于京畿道加平郡北面赤木里，是从光州山脉的山脉流下的水流形成的瀑布，从多马池峰开始，一直延伸到镜池山、江丝峰和清溪山。它位于龙沼瀑布上方约1公里处。瀑布顺着岩壁流下，撞击岩石，如水花般落下。从远处看去，它就像一根未散开的白色丝线。距离加平邑34公里，瀑布周围森林茂盛，以红叶而闻名，与雪岳山的壮丽景色一样美丽。相传以前，军官们以蔬菜为零食，饮酒跳舞，故名“无朱蔡瀑布”，水流冰凉，即使在盛夏也感觉寒冷。可以使用Mujuchae瀑布的Domachi山谷前的停车场，那里的道路维护良好，有甲板路径和桥梁，因此您可以舒适安全地一边散步一边环顾四周。爬上马路，全身都感受到新鲜的空气，路中央还设有长凳，走累了可以休息。 Mujuchae瀑布从岩石顶部倾泻而下，分两段落下，其雄伟和凉爽令人印象深刻。如果能和家人一起去这里看看美丽的瀑布就好了。

무창포해수욕장은 1928년 서해안에서 최초로 개장된 해수욕장이다. 백사장.en: Muchangpo Beach is the first beach to open on the west coast in 1928. It is a beach with a 1.5km long white sand beach, 1~2m water depth, 50m white sand beach, water temperature of 22 degrees Celsius, and slope of 4 degrees. The surrounding area is dense with pine forests, making it a place where you can enjoy both sea bathing and forest bathing. Muchangpo Beach, which adds to the charm with its beautiful natural scenery of strangely shaped rocks and sea pine trees, is visited by many tourists every year due to the nearby sea fishing and abundant groundwater. In particular, here, a 1.5km sea road opens from the beach to Seokdaedo Island 2-3 times every month around the full moon and the last day of the lunar calendar. This is called the ‘Miracle of Moses.’ The opening of the Mysterious Sea Road in Muchangpo is a phenomenon in which the sea water is revealed during low tide due to the phenomenon of sea water splitting. When the sea road opens, it is very fun to catch crabs, clams, etc. along this road. If you climb up to the Muchangpo Observatory, located on a hill 50 meters away from the entrance to Muchangpo, you can enjoy a panoramic view of the mysterious sea road. With the phenomenon of water splitting as a motif, the Mysterious Sea Road Festival is also held every year in accordance with the sea road held on the first and last days of the lunar calendar. You can enjoy a variety of attractions such as celebratory performances by celebrities, a blow-blow fishing experience, and a mysterious sea road torch parade, as well as a variety of experiences such as bare-handed fishing experience, poisonous fishing ecology experience, clam catching experience, and crab meat catching experience.
무창포해수욕장은 1928년 서해안에서 최초로 개장된 해수욕장이다. 백사장.zh: 木场坡海水浴场是西海岸第一个开放的海水浴场，于1928年开放，是一个海滩，有长1.5公里的白沙滩，水深1~2m，白沙滩50m，水温22摄氏度，坡度4度。周边松树林茂密，是既可以享受海水浴又可以享受森林浴的地方。木场坡海滩以其奇石、海松等自然风光增添了魅力，由于附近有海钓和丰富的地下水，每年都有许多游客前往游览。特别是，这里有一条1.5公里的海路，每月在满月和农历最后一天期间有2-3次从海滩通往石大岛。这被称为“摩西的奇迹”。木场坡神秘海路的开通，是由于海水分裂现象，退潮时海水显露出来的现象。海路开通的时候，沿着这条路抓螃蟹、蛤蜊等，非常好玩。登上木场坡观景台，木场坡观景台位于距木场坡入口50米的小山上，神秘的海路尽收眼底。以水裂现象为主题，每年还按照农历初一和末日举办的海路举行神秘海路节。可以享受明星庆功表演、吹鱼体验、神秘海路火炬巡游等多种景点，还有徒手钓鱼体验、毒钓生态体验、抓蛤体验、抓蟹肉体验等多种体验。

강원도 동해시 묵호항은 1937년에 개항하였으며 동해안 제1의 무역항으로.en: Mukho Port in Donghae-si, Gangwon-do opened in 1937 and started as the first trading port on the east coast, but has now become a fishing base on the east coast. If you go to Mukho Port early in the morning when a fishing boat enters the port, you can buy freshly caught raw fish at the fish market, and it is also unique to watch the auction of the caught fish. Additionally, there are stores where you can shop for dried fish, etc. On Dongmunsan Mountain in Mukho Port, there is the Mukho Lighthouse, a manned lighthouse built in June 1963. The 12m high internal structure is made of two-story circular reinforced concrete, and the pure white lighthouse blends in with the blue sea to create a clear and clean image. A small park has been created around the lighthouse to provide a panoramic view of the sea, and as soon as you enter the entrance to the small park, a sculpture engraved with the words ‘From the Sun to the Boy’ is spread out widely.
강원도 동해시 묵호항은 1937년에 개항하였으며 동해안 제1의 무역항으로.zh: 江原道东海市的墨湖港于1937年开港，最初是东海岸第一个贸易港口，现在已成为东海岸的渔业基地。如果一早去墨湖港，当渔船进港时，你可以在鱼市购买刚捕获的生鱼，观看捕获的鱼的拍卖也是别具一格的。另外，还有可以购买干鱼等的商店。墨湖港东门山上有墨湖灯塔，这是一座建于1963年6月的有人灯塔。内部结构高12m，由两层圆形钢筋混凝土构成，纯白色的灯塔与蔚蓝的大海融为一体，呈现出清晰干净的形象。灯塔周围修建了一个小公园，可以将大海尽收眼底，一进入小公园的入口，刻着“从太阳到男孩”字样的雕塑就广泛展开。

전국 최고의 레포츠 체험 관광지 문경에서 백두대간을 둘러볼 수 있는 최장.en: The longest monorail (3.6 km round trip) that allows you to tour the Baekdudaegan Mountain Range has been launched from Mungyeong, the best leisure sports experience tourist destination in the country. Dansan, which is said to have a flat mountain top that resembles a huge sky altar built by hermits in ancient times to offer sacrifices to the sky, is also famous for being a place where the sky meets, with good mountains, good water, and good air. Dansan, with its tourist and leisure spaces and beautiful natural scenery in all directions, is also in the spotlight as a filming location for various dramas such as the drama <Joseon Survival>. In addition to the monorail that can be enjoyed all year round, Dansan is growing into a true mecca of mountain tourism with a variety of experiences to enjoy, such as the starlight observatory around the summit of Dansan, a forest sledding slope, a forest camping site, a mountain bike road, Ojeongsan Mountain deck road, and a Doline wetland deck road.
전국 최고의 레포츠 체험 관광지 문경에서 백두대간을 둘러볼 수 있는 최장.zh: 可以游览白头大干山脉的最长单轨电车（往返3.6公里）从韩国最佳休闲运动体验旅游胜地闻庆出发。据说担山山顶平坦，酷似古代隐士祭天而建的巨大天坛，也因天交合处、好山、好水、好空气而闻名。坛山以其旅游休闲空间和四面八方的美丽自然风光，还作为电视剧《朝鲜生存》等各种电视剧的拍摄地而受到关注。除了一年四季都可以享受的单轨电车外，坛山还正在发展成为名副其实的山地旅游圣地，这里有坛山山顶周围的星光展望台、森林雪橇场、森林露营地、山地自行车道、乌精山山地甲板路、天坑湿地甲板路等。

드라마 <킹덤>, <옷소매 붉은 끝동>, <해를 품은 달> 등을 촬영한.en: It is a filming set for the dramas <Kingdom>, <Red Sleeves>, and <The Moon Embracing the Sun>, and is connected to Mungyeong Provincial Park. The Gwanghwamun Set, which vividly embodies Gwanghwamun, is one of the most famous spots. Sets with various atmospheres, such as a hanok village, a low-income village, and a common people's village, are spread out over a large site, making it feel like time travel to the Joseon Dynasty. The motive for setting up the filming location in Mungyeong Saejae was, above all, because the mountainous terrain of Joryeongsan Mountain and Juheulsan Mountain is similar to Songaksan Mountain in Gaeseong, the capital of Goryeo, and the old roads are well preserved, making it a very suitable filming location for a historical drama. The current Mungyeong Saejae open set was completed on April 16, 2008, with production support from Mungyeong City, by demolishing a set set in the Goryeo Dynasty and creating a new Joseon Dynasty. The construction cost was 7.5 billion won, and 103 buildings, including Gwanghwamun, Gyeongbokgung Palace, Donggung Palace, Seoungwan, Palace Cabinet Temple, and noblemen's houses, were built on a 70,000㎡ site. There are 130 set buildings, including 22 existing thatched houses and 5 tile-roofed houses.◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave ‘Mungyeong Saejae Open Set’ is famous as a filming location for many historical dramas such as <Hwanhoon>, <Kingdom>, <Shuroop>, and <Moon Embracing the Sun>. The setting of this set is the Joseon Dynasty, and anyone who was curious about the Joseon Dynasty in the drama will be surprised by the vivid sense of reality as if they have stepped into the past. If you want to feel like you are in a historical drama, I recommend visiting the Mungyeong Saejae open set.
드라마 <킹덤>, <옷소매 붉은 끝동>, <해를 품은 달> 등을 촬영한.zh: 是电视剧《王国》、《红袖》、《拥抱太阳的月亮》的拍摄地，与闻庆道立公园相连。生动地体现了光化门的光化门场景是最著名的景点之一。韩屋村、低收入村、平民村等各种氛围的场景分布在广阔的场地上，让人有一种穿越到朝鲜王朝的感觉。之所以把外景地设在闻庆新斋，首先是因为鸟岭山和主鹤山的山地地形与高丽首都开城的松岳山相似，古道保存完好，非常适合历史剧的拍摄地。现在的闻庆新斋公开布景是在闻庆市的制作支持下，拆除高丽时代的布景，创建新的朝鲜王朝，于2008年4月16日完成的。工程耗资75亿韩元，在7万平方米的土地上建造了光化门、景福宫、东宫、宣官、宫阁寺、贵族住宅等103栋建筑物。共有130栋布景建筑，其中现存茅草屋22栋、瓦房5栋。 ◎ 感受韩流魅力的旅游信息 “闻庆新菜露天场景”作为《焕勋》、《王国》、《守鲁》、《拥抱太阳的月亮》等多部历史剧的拍摄地而闻名。本剧以朝鲜王朝为背景，任何对剧中朝鲜王朝感到好奇的人都会被剧中栩栩如生的真实感所震惊，仿佛踏入了过去。如果您想体验历史剧的感觉，我建议您参观闻庆新斋露天场景。

백두대간 조령산 마루를 넘는 이 재는 예로부터 한강과 낙동강유역을 잇는.en: This mountain, which crosses the ridge of Mt. Joryeong in the Baekdudaegan Mountain Range, has long been the highest and steepest hill on Yeongnam-daero, connecting the Han River and Nakdong River basin, and has been a key point for social, cultural, economic, and national defense. Saejae (鳥嶺) is also said to mean ‘a hill that is difficult for even a bird to fly over’ and ‘Sae (new jae)’ of a new hill. This place is famous for its beautiful natural scenery, historical ruins, folk tales, and folk songs. After the Japanese invasions of Korea, three gates (Juheulgwan, Jogokgwan, and Joryeonggwan) were installed in Mungyeong Saejae to serve as a fortress of national defense. The only remaining site, the winter site where travelers stayed, and the site of Gyogwijeong, where the new and old Gyeongsang provincial governors exchanged official seals, were rebuilt in 1999, and the Korean monument ‘Forest Fire’s Heart’, erected in the past to prevent forest fires, remains. It is a historical site steeped in various legends related to history, as well as the events of the Japanese Invasion of Korea, General Shin Rip, and Saddam left behind by Donghak and the Righteous Army. This area was designated and protected as a provincial park in 1981. Many cultural resources such as Hyeguksa Temple's Chungnyeol Monument, Joryeongwonji, and Donghwawonji, as well as natural scenery include Suok Falls, Yeogung Falls, Palwang Falls, and Yeongcheon Mineral Water. In particular, it is connected to Suanbo Hot Springs, Mungyeong Hot Springs, Mungyeong Island, Bongamsa Temple in Heeyangsan Mountain, and Seonyudong Valley, and is visited by many tourists. In addition, the plant resources observed in the Mungyeong Saejae area are classified by habitat and created under the theme of wet grass support, ecological wetland, ecological pond, dry grass support, and wild flower garden, and there is a natural ecological park and ecological maze park where visitors can engage in ecological learning and eco-tourism. There is a KBS filming site built by the Korea Broadcasting Corporation in Yongsagol behind the first gate of Mungyeong Saejae on February 23, 2000 to film a historical drama set in the Goryeo Dynasty. Mungyeong Saejae's Joryeongsan Mountain and Juheulsan Mountain are similar to Songaksan Mountain in Kaesong, the capital of Goryeo, and the old roads are well-preserved, making it a very suitable filming location for historical dramas. It has been the main filming location for KBS historical dramas such as Taejo Wang Geon, Morning of the Empire, The Age of the Unmanned, Dae Jo-yeong, and King Sejong the Great. It is also the location where films such as Scandal and Romantic Assassin were filmed, providing many tourists with things to see and enjoy.
백두대간 조령산 마루를 넘는 이 재는 예로부터 한강과 낙동강유역을 잇는.zh: 这座山横跨白头大干山脉的鸟岭山脊，自古以来就是岭南大路最高、最陡的山丘，连接汉江和洛东江流域，一直是社会、文化、经济和国防的要地。鸟岭也有“连鸟都难以飞越的山丘”和新山的“新山”之意。这里以其美丽的自然风光、历史遗迹、民间故事、民歌而闻名。日本侵略朝鲜后，在闻庆新斋设置了三座城门（主兴关、鸟谷关、鸟灵关），作为国防要塞。唯一残存的遗址是1999年重建的冬季旅行者住宿地和新旧庆尚道知事交换印章的交归亭遗址，以及过去为防止森林火灾而竖立的韩国纪念碑“森林火灾之心”。这是一个历史遗迹，充满了与历史有关的各种传说，以及东学和正义军留下的日本侵朝事件、申立将军和萨达姆事件。该地区于1981年被指定为道立公园并受到保护。惠国寺忠烈碑、鸟灵院寺、童化院寺等文化资源以及石玉瀑布、烈宫瀑布、八王瀑布、永川矿泉水等自然景观。特别是与水安堡温泉、闻庆温泉、闻庆岛、熙阳山凤岩寺、仙游洞溪谷相连，吸引了众多游客。此外，闻庆新才地区观察到的植物资源，按生境分类，以湿草支持、生态湿地、生态池塘、干草支持、野花园为主题，设有自然生态公园和生态迷宫公园，可供游客进行生态学习和生态旅游。 2000年2月23日，韩国广播公司在闻庆新斋第一门后的龙四谷修建了KBS拍摄场地，用于拍摄以高丽王朝为背景的历史剧。闻庆新才的鸟岭山和主鹤山与高丽首都开城的松岳山相似，古道保存完好，非常适合历史剧的拍摄地。这里曾是KBS历史剧《太祖王建》、《帝国的早晨》、《无人时代》、《大朝英》、《世宗大王》等的主要拍摄地。这里也是《绯闻》、《浪漫刺客》等电影的拍摄地，为众多游客提供了观赏和享受的场所。

한남정맥의 최 북서쪽에 위치한 문수산은 해발고도는 376m로 아기자기한.en: Munsusan Mountain, located in the northwest of the Hannam Valley, is 376m above sea level and offers a cute mountaineering experience. It is also called the Geumgangsan Mountain of Gimpo due to its beautiful scenery in all four seasons. When you climb to the top, you can feel the pain of division as the waters of the Yeomha River and Han River flow leisurely below the mountain, and on a clear day, you can even see Songaksan Mountain in Kaesong, North Korea, across the Han River, almost within reach. At Munsusan Mountain, there is Munsusanseong Fortress, which was built in the 20th year of King Sukjong's reign (1694), the 19th king of the Joseon Dynasty, to defend Ganghwa Island against foreign enemies coming from the sea. You can feel the breath of our ancestors who resisted foreign invasions. There is a forest bathing area at the beginning of the hiking trail, which is perfect for a light rest and a walk while receiving phytoncide and negative ions.
한남정맥의 최 북서쪽에 위치한 문수산은 해발고도는 376m로 아기자기한.zh: 文殊山位于汉南溪谷西北部，海拔376m，提供可爱的登山体验。由于四季景色优美，也被称为金浦金刚山。登上山顶，山下有盐河和汉江的水在悠闲地流淌，你可以感受到分裂的痛苦，天气晴朗的时候，甚至可以看到隔着汉江的朝鲜开城的松岳山，近在咫尺。文殊山上有文殊山城，是朝鲜第十九代王肃宗20年（1694年）为保卫江华岛抵御来自海上的外敌而修建的。你可以感受到我们的祖先抵抗外来入侵的气息。登山步道的起点处设有森林浴区，非常适合在接受芬多精和负离子的同时进行轻松休息和散步。

문수산은 김포에서 가장 높은 명산으로 동쪽으로는 한강 포구와 서울의 삼각.en: Munsusan Mountain is the highest and famous mountain in Gimpo. It is a scenic area with views of the Hangang Port and Seoul's Samgaksan Mountain to the east and the sea off Incheon in the distance to the west. The scenery is beautiful all year round and is called "Geumgang of Gimpo." It can be said to be a famous spot in Gimpo where you can enjoy forest bathing, a natural health method that involves walking in a lush forest and drinking the scent emitted from the forest, i.e., terpenes, essential oils, or putting it in contact with your skin. When you take a forest bath in Munsusan Mountain, your body and mind become clear and you feel stable. It is known to be effective in expectorating (removing phlegm), tonic, and constipation. It is also known to strengthen cardiopulmonary function. It acts on the circulatory system to increase blood pressure and stimulates the central nervous system to provide sedation. Munsusan Forest Bathing Ground, which provides various benefits such as emotional purification, mental and physical training, and fatigue recovery, consists of a hiking trail of approximately 4.6 km and a forest bathing trail of 1.4 km. Convenience facilities include an octagonal pavilion, benches, wooden huts, benches, outdoor tables, artificial trees, and lantern chairs, providing a comfortable space for citizens to relax. Equipped with sports facilities such as iron bars, parallel bars, forest bathing tables, crotch stretching, badminton courts, wrestling courts, volleyball, foot volleyball courts, and gateball courts, it can be said to be a resting area for citizens where they can engage in leisure activities. It is connected to Munsusanseong Fortress, which is about 4km long, and is a mountain education center with a history of resisting foreign invasions in the late Joseon Dynasty, making it the perfect place to feel the body odor.
문수산은 김포에서 가장 높은 명산으로 동쪽으로는 한강 포구와 서울의 삼각.zh: 文殊山是金浦最高且著名的山。这里东临汉江港和首尔三岳山，西临仁川大海，是一个风景区。一年四季风景秀丽，被称为“金浦金刚”。这里可以说是金浦的一个著名景点，在这里您可以享受森林浴，这是一种在茂密的森林中行走，饮用从森林中散发出来的萜烯、精油的香味，或将其接触皮肤的自然健康方法。当你在文殊山享受森林浴时，你的身心都会变得清晰、稳定。众所周知，它可以有效祛痰、补虚和便秘。它还可以增强心肺功能。它作用于循环系统以升高血压并刺激中枢神经系统以提供镇静作用。文殊山森林浴场具有净化情绪、锻炼身心、恢复疲劳等多种功效，由约4.6公里的登山步道和1.4公里的森林浴步道组成。便利设施有八角亭、长凳、木屋、长椅、户外桌子、人造树、灯笼椅等，为市民休闲提供了舒适的空间。配备铁栏、双杠、森林浴桌、胯部伸展、羽毛球场、摔跤场、排球场、足排球场、门球场等体育设施，可以说是市民进行休闲活动的休息区。它与全长约4公里的文殊山城相连，是朝鲜末期具有抵御外敌入侵历史的山地教育中心，是感受狐臭的最佳场所。

* 가족 산행지로 적합한 산, 문안산 *문안산은 남양주시의 화도읍에 위치.en: * Munansan Mountain, a mountain suitable for family hiking * Munansan Mountain is a 533m mountain located in Hwado-eup, Namyangju City. There are two theories about the origin of the name Munansan Mountain. One theory is that it was named Munansan Mountain because there is a gate-shaped rock called Munbawi, and the other theory is that it was named so because the inside of the four main gates of Seoul can be seen from the ridge. Munansan Mountain is not steep, so you can hike it lightly. There is a course that starts from the 1st Geumnam Bridge, passes the summit, and comes down to Sambong-ri, Joan-myeon. You can also briefly go down to Baekwol-ri, Hwado-eup in the middle. The trail that passes through Munansan Mountain is the Munansan Trail, which is Course 5 of Dasan-gil in Namyangju-si. It starts from Ungilsan Station, goes around the village roads of Songchon-ri and Sambong-ri, passes Jaejaegi Pass, goes over the ridge of Munansan Mountain, and comes down to Piano Falls. There are many things to see along the route of Munansan Mountain, including the birthplace of Lee Deok-hyeong, a civil servant from the Joseon Dynasty, the Namyangju Studio Complex, the piano waterfall created at the Hwado Blue Water Center, a piano restroom, an environmental experience center, and an ecological park. Near the summit of Munansan Mountain and the ridge of the mountain, you can enjoy a view of the Bukhangang River and the outskirts of Seoul, including a rock called Munbawi. Although the mountain is low, it is located on the banks of the Bukhangang River, so the scenery is excellent and the hiking trail is not rough, making it a suitable hiking destination for families with young children. The biggest attraction of Munansan Mountain is Munbawi Rock. There is a first course that climbs to the top of Geumnam Bridge, passes through Musul in the north, and comes down to Sindangjae, and a second course that climbs to the top of Geumnam Bridge, then crosses 520 peaks and descends along the ridge to Sambong-ri in the south. The first course is about 9km and takes about 3 hours and 20 minutes, and the second course is 9.6km and takes about 3 hours and 45 minutes. There is also a short course that starts from Geumnam Bridge, climbs to the top, and then comes down to Baekwol-ri in the south. The hiking distance is 6 km and takes 2 hours and 30 minutes. There are park cemeteries and factories on the north side of the mountain, and there are few people.
* 가족 산행지로 적합한 산, 문안산 *문안산은 남양주시의 화도읍에 위치.zh: * 适合家庭徒步旅行的武南山 * 武南山是位于南杨州市华岛邑的一座海拔533m的山。关于目南山名称的由来，有两种说法。一种说法是因为这里有一块叫做门波威的门状岩石而得名文南山，另一种说法是因为从山脊上可以看到首尔的四个大门的内部而得名。武南山并不陡峭，可以轻松徒步。有一条路线是从金南第一桥出发，经过山顶，到达贞面三峰里的路线。也可以短暂前往中间的华岛邑白月里。穿过武安山的路线是武南山路线，是南杨州市茶山路第5路线。从云吉山站出发，绕过松村里、三峰里的村道，经过才才岭，越过武南山的山脊，来到钢琴瀑布。武南山沿途有朝鲜文官李德亨的出生地、南杨州演播室、华岛碧水中心的钢琴瀑布、钢琴洗手间、环境体验中心、生态公园等景点。在武安山山顶和山脊附近，可以欣赏到北汉江和首尔郊区的景色，其中包括一块叫做文波威的岩石。山虽低，但地处北汉江河畔，风景极佳，徒步路线也不崎岖，适合带小孩的家庭徒步目的地。文南山最大的看点就是文岩。第一条路线是登上锦南大桥顶部，穿过北边的武秀，下到新堂斋；第二条路线是登上锦南大桥顶部，翻过520座山峰，沿着山脊下降到南部的三峰里。第一条路线全长约9公里，耗时约3小时20分钟，第二条路线全长约9.6公里，耗时约3小时45分钟。还有一条短途路线，从锦南桥出发，爬到山顶，然后下到南部的白月里。徒步距离6公里，需时2小时30分钟。山北侧有公园墓地和工厂，人烟稀少。

용인문화복지행정타운 내에 있는 문화예술원 마루홀은 용인 시민의 여가와 문.en: The Maru Hall of the Culture and Arts Center, located in Yongin Culture and Welfare Administration Town, opened in 2005 to promote the leisure and cultural life of Yongin citizens. It is operated by the Yongin Cultural Foundation, which was launched in 2011. The Culture and Arts Center is a building with 4 floors above ground and 1 floor underground, with a total area of ​​1,978 m². Yongin Cultural Foundation and several affiliated organizations are housed there, and it has a performance hall, exhibition hall, conference room, and Yongin Digital Information Library. In particular, it is equipped with facilities such as Maru Hall, a small theater that can accommodate 290 people (including 4 seats for the disabled), and an international conference room that can accommodate 180 people. In particular, Maru Hall has a stage area of ​​129.22 m² and was created to deliver the best sound by maximizing sound effects by reducing reflected sounds in the performance hall and maximizing reverberation. A variety of performances, focusing on children's plays and family plays, are held, and it is loved as a space where the whole family can enjoy cultural life comfortably. It takes about 4 minutes from Seoyongin IC and a 9-minute walk (462m) from Everline City Hall/Yongin University Station. Nearby are Everland, Korean Folk Village, Korea Job World, World Cultural Heritage Yunggeonreung Royal Tomb, Mulhyanggi Arboretum, Yongin Rural Theme Park, and Deokpyeong Dinosaur Arboretum.
용인문화복지행정타운 내에 있는 문화예술원 마루홀은 용인 시민의 여가와 문.zh: 位于龙仁文化福利行政城的文化艺术中心Maru Hall于2005年开业，旨在促进龙仁市民的休闲文化生活。由2011年启动的龙仁文化财团运营。文化艺术中心是一栋地上4层、地下1层的建筑，总面积1,978平方米。龙仁文化财团及多个附属机构均设在此处，设有表演厅、展览厅、会议室和龙仁数字信息图书馆。特别是配备了丸厅、可容纳290人的小剧场（含4个残疾人座位）、可容纳180人的国际会议室等设施。特别是，Maru Hall的舞台面积为129.22平方米，旨在通过减少表演厅内的反射声音和最大化混响来最大化声音效果，从而提供最佳的声音。举办以儿童剧和家庭剧为主的丰富多彩的演出，作为全家人可以舒适地享受文化生活的空间而深受喜爱。距离西龙仁IC约4分钟，距离爱宝线市政厅/龙仁大学站步行9分钟（462m）。附近有爱宝乐园、韩国民俗村、韩国就业世界、世界文化遗产龙庆陵、水香树木园、龙仁乡村主题公园、德坪恐龙树木园等。

남양주시에서 운영하는 '물맑음수목원' 수동면에 자연 친화적으로 조성된 물.en: 'Mulmalgeum Arboretum' operated by Namyangju City. At the nature-friendly Arboretum in Sudong-myeon, you can enjoy a variety of plants in a beautiful scenery that changes with each season, and also enjoy the pleasure of directly observing various creatures living in the forest. In particular, the Mulmareum Arboretum, which was selected as a ‘Gyeonggi-do Wellness Tourist Destination’, operates in-depth and diverse programs. There are a variety of experiential activities tailored to different ages and interests, such as woodcraft experience, play forest (crafts made with natural materials), forest healing, forest interpretation in the children's forest, and firefly ecology learning center. Spend a special time relaxing to your heart’s content in the spacious and peaceful nature of Mulmareum Arboretum.
남양주시에서 운영하는 '물맑음수목원' 수동면에 자연 친화적으로 조성된 물.zh: 南杨州市运营的“墨马金植物园”。在水洞面的自然植物园，您可以在四季变换的美丽风景中欣赏各种植物，还可以享受直接观察生活在森林中的各种生物的乐趣。特别是被选为“京畿道健康旅游胜地”的墨马植物园，开展了深入且多样化的项目。适合不同年龄段、不同兴趣的体验活动有木工体验、玩森林（天然材料制作的工艺品）、森林疗愈、儿童森林森林解读、萤火虫生态学习中心等。在马尔马勒姆植物园 (Mulmareum Arboretum) 宽敞、宁静的大自然中，度过一段特别的放松时光。

한 점 쉬어가는 공간이 되어주는 ‘물미해안전망대’는 자유로운 여행객들의.en: ‘Mulmi Coastal Observatory’, which serves as a place to rest, is another bunker for free travelers and is very popular. ‘Mulmi Coastal Observatory’, also nicknamed ‘Daejipo Observatory’ by local residents because it was built near Daejipo Village in Samdong-myeon, began construction in 2016 and opened in December 2019. Built with the concept of a lighthouse illuminating the South Sea, this place is cylindrical in shape with a 360-degree view, allowing you to enjoy the ‘feeling of floating in the sky.’ It consists of two floors. The first floor is a Namhae-gun specialty product store where you can buy a variety of items, and the second floor is decorated with a bakery cafe and a rooftop observatory.
한 점 쉬어가는 공간이 되어주는 ‘물미해안전망대’는 자유로운 여행객들의.zh: 作为休息场所的“木尔米海岸展望台”是自由行游客的另一个掩体，非常受欢迎。 “物美海岸展望台”因建在三洞面大芝浦村附近，也被当地居民昵称为“大芝浦展望台”，于 2016 年动工，于 2019 年 12 月开放。以照亮南海的灯塔为概念而建造的，呈圆柱形，可 360 度观看，让您享受“漂浮在天空中的感觉”。它由两层楼组成。一楼是南海郡特产商店，可以购买各种商品，二楼则装饰有面包店咖啡馆和屋顶展望台。

시흥시에서 가장 규모가 큰 물왕호수의 다른 이름은 흥부 저수지이다. 저수.en: Another name for Mulwang Lake, the largest in Siheung City, is Heungbu Reservoir. When the reservoir was installed in 1945, the administrative districts were Siheung-gun and Bucheon-gun, so the prosperity of Siheung and the wealth of Bucheon-gun were taken. It is the largest freshwater lake in Siheung City and a representative resting place. It is located near the metropolitan area, including Seoul, Anyang, and Ansan, and is surrounded by Mt. Gwanmusan (aka Seonginbong), Mt. Mahasan, and Mt. Unheung. A bicycle road was created between Podong Salt Farm and Mulwangho in 2003, and Suin Industrial Road is nearby, making transportation convenient and convenient facilities abundant. In 2023, the name was changed from Mulwang Reservoir to Mulwang Lake, and the rainbow that appears across Mulwang Lake after the rain is so beautiful that it is called a fresh scenery. The night view of the lake illuminated by colorful lights is beautiful, making you want to visit Mulwang Lake again. It is fun to visit hidden restaurants and colorful cafes in every nook and cranny, and the beautiful flowers and trees that bloom and fall each season are another attraction.
시흥시에서 가장 규모가 큰 물왕호수의 다른 이름은 흥부 저수지이다. 저수.zh: 始兴市最大的物王湖的别称是兴府水库。 1945年修建水库时，行政区划为始兴郡和富川郡，始兴的繁荣和富川郡的财富被夺走了。它是始兴市最大的淡水湖，也是具有代表性的休息场所。位于首尔、安养、安山等首都圈附近，周围有观武山（又名圣人峰）、马哈山、云兴山。 2003年，浦东盐场与水旺湖之间修建了自行车道，附近还有水仁工业路，交通便利，便利设施丰富。 2023年，由木王水库更名为木王湖，雨后木王湖对面出现的彩虹美不胜收，堪称一道清新风景。色彩缤纷的灯光照射下的木王湖夜景非常美丽，让人忍不住想再去一次木王湖。参观每个角落里隐藏的餐厅和色彩缤纷的咖啡馆很有趣，而每个季节盛开和秋天的美丽花草树木也是另一个景点。

물의정원은 2012년 한강 살리기 사업으로 조성한 수변공원으로 자연과 소.en: The Water Garden is a waterside park created as part of the Han River Restoration Project in 2012 and is a nature-friendly relaxation space where you can purify and heal your body and mind by communicating with nature. When you cross Baetnadeuri Bridge, the symbolic bridge of the Water Garden, a large flower complex has been created along the riverside promenade facing the beautiful Bukhangang River, where you can enjoy flowers in spring (poppy flowers) and autumn flowers (yellow cosmos). It's a great place to ride a bike, take a walk with your partner, or go on a family outing. (Source: Namyangju City Culture and Tourism website)
물의정원은 2012년 한강 살리기 사업으로 조성한 수변공원으로 자연과 소.zh: 水上花园是2012年汉江整治工程中创建的水边公园，是一个亲近自然的休闲空间，在这里您可以与自然交流，净化身心，治愈身心。穿过水上花园的象征桥Baetnadeuri桥，面向美丽的北汉江的滨江长廊形成了大型花卉综合体，可以观赏春花（罂粟花）和秋花（黄波斯菊）。这里是骑自行车、与伴侣散步或全家出游的好地方。 （来源：南杨州市文化观光网站）

1호선 오산대역 앞에 위치한 물향기수목원은 연간 35만 명 이상 방문하는.en: Mulhyanggi Arboretum, located in front of Osan University Station on Line 1, is one of the representative arboretums in Gyeonggi-do, visited by more than 350,000 people annually. It was named Mulhyanggi Arboretum from the name of Sucheong-dong, which was said to be a place with clear water flowing since ancient times. The Gyeonggi Provincial Arboretum was built from 2000 to 2005 under the theme of 'Meeting of Water, Trees, and Humans' and opened in May 2006. Mulhyanggi Arboretum, built in downtown Osan City with an area of ​​34 ha, has a total of 1,930 species of plants in 24 theme gardens, including Mulhyanggi Forest Exhibition Hall, Water Drop Greenhouse, Warm Zone Botanical Garden, Bonsai Garden, and Rose of Sharon Garden, and is equipped with convenient facilities such as a visitor center, plant library, observatory, lawn, forest rest area, and nursing room. The arboretum is close to the subway station, has a gentle slope, has many rest areas such as shade and chairs, and has created a barrier-free sharing path, making it comfortable for people with transportation disabilities, children, and pregnant women to walk.
1호선 오산대역 앞에 위치한 물향기수목원은 연간 35만 명 이상 방문하는.zh: 水香植物园位于1号线乌山大学站前，是京畿道代表性植物园之一，每年参观人数超过35万人次。水清洞因自古以来就有清水流淌的地名而被命名为水香植物园。京畿道植物园以“水、树木、人类的相遇”为主题于2000年至2005年建成，于2006年5月开放。水香植物园建于乌山市市中心，占地34公顷，拥有水香森林展示馆、水滴温室、温暖地带等24个主题园，共有1,930种植物植物园、盆景园、沙伦玫瑰园，并设有游客中心、植物图书馆、展望台、草坪、森林休息区、哺乳室等便利设施。植物园紧邻地铁站，坡度缓和，设有遮阳、椅子等多个休息区，并打造了无障碍共享路径，方便交通残疾人、儿童、孕妇行走。

산속에 감춰진 Museum SAN(Space, Art, Nature)은.en: Museum SAN (Space, Art, Nature), hidden in the mountains, began construction with a design by Tadao Ando, ​​a master of minimalist architecture of exposed concrete, and opened in May 2013 with the final work of James Turrell, an artist of light and space. The museum begins with the Welcome Center and lawn parking lot along the trail and continues to the Flower Garden, Water Garden, Main Building, Meditation Hall, Stone Garden, and James Turrell Hall. The main building contains four wing structures connected into square, triangular, and circular spaces, embodying the architect's philosophy of connecting the land, sky, and people. In addition, the museum is running a variety of experiential and educational programs as well as permanent and temporary exhibitions. The Cafe Terrace, located on one side of the main building, is, as the name suggests, a good place to relax and enjoy the 360-degree view of the mountain. And at the meditation hall near the Stone Garden, you can relax your body and mind by concentrating on the aroma and the sound of the singing bowl, and enjoy a quiet time while appreciating the scenery through the curved window.
산속에 감춰진 Museum SAN(Space, Art, Nature)은.zh: 隐藏在山中的Museum SAN（空间、艺术、自然）由裸露混凝土极简主义建筑大师安藤忠雄设计开始建造，并于2013年5月以光与空间艺术家詹姆斯·特雷尔的最后作品开幕。博物馆从沿步道的迎宾中心和草坪停车场开始，一直延伸到花园、水花园、主楼、冥想厅、石头花园和詹姆斯·特雷尔大厅。主楼包含四个翼结构，连接成方形、三角形和圆形空间，体现了建筑师连接土地、天空和人的理念。此外，博物馆还举办各种体验和教育项目以及永久和临时展览。露台咖啡厅位于主楼一侧，顾名思义，是一个放松身心、欣赏360度山景的好地方。而在石园附近的禅堂，你可以专注于香气和颂钵的声音，放松身心，透过弧形窗欣赏风景，享受宁静的时光。

공주에 위치한 미르섬은 금강 위에 떠 있는 아름다운 섬으로, 계절마다 다.en: Mir Island, located in Gongju, is a beautiful island floating on the Geumgang River. It is a natural healing spot where various flowers brighten up the entire island every season. Starting with cosmos, a variety of plants such as pink muhly, dapsari, and sukrung harmonize together to create a spectacular sight. Especially in the fall, the pink muhly road along the island becomes popular, and the light pink waves blend in with the scenery of the Geumgang River, making it a popular photo spot. The trail across the flower field follows a gentle curve, and you can enjoy the harmonious scenery of the Gongju Railroad Bridge and the greenery of the mountain behind you while walking along the river. The road is well paved, so anyone of any age can take a walk comfortably. In particular, the deeper you go toward Gongju Bridge, the more beautiful the natural scenery becomes. It is a perfect space not only for families but also for people to enjoy a walk with their dogs.
공주에 위치한 미르섬은 금강 위에 떠 있는 아름다운 섬으로, 계절마다 다.zh: 米尔岛位于公州，是一座漂浮在锦江上的美丽岛屿。这里是一个天然的疗愈胜地，每个季节都有各种各样的鲜花照亮整个岛屿。从波斯菊开始，各种植物（如粉红穆赫利、达普萨里和苏克龙）协调在一起，创造出壮观的景象。尤其到了秋天，岛上的粉色穆赫利路变得很受欢迎，浅粉色的波浪与锦江的景色融为一体，成为热门的拍照胜地。穿过花田的步道呈平缓的曲线，沿着河边散步，可以欣赏到公州铁路大桥与背后山的绿意的和谐景色。道路铺设得很好，所以任何年龄段的人都可以舒适地散步。尤其是公州桥越往深处走，自然风光就越美丽。这里不仅适合家庭，也适合人们与狗一起散步。

경기도 안성에서 북쪽으로 40리쯤 떨어져 은하수라는 뜻의 아름다운 우리말.en: Mirinae Shrine, located about 40 miles north of Anseong, Gyeonggi-do and called the beautiful Korean word for the Milky Way, is where the tombs of Korea's first priest, Father Kim Dae-geon, his mother Ursula, the third bishop of the Joseon Diocese who ordained Father Kim, Bishop Perreol, and Vincent Lee Min-sik, who buried Father Kim's body, are located side by side. This place came to be called Mirinae because Catholic believers hid here to escape the Shinyu and Gihae persecutions and formed a village of believers. At night, the lights coming from each house combined with the stream under the moonlight made it look like the Milky Way. Originally, Mirinae was one of the early Catholic missionary areas, including Gwangju, Siheung, Yongin, Yangpyeong, Hwaseong, and Anseong in Gyeonggi-do. When the parish was established in 1896, 50 years after Father Kim was buried in Mirinae, there were about 1,600 believers. Father Kim Dae-geon, who was martyred at the age of 26, was not even allowed to have a funeral by the government, so only 40 days after his execution, Vincenzo Lee Min-sik managed to remove the body and carry it on his back for a week, avoiding public attention, to bring it here to Mirinae and bury it. The full-fledged work to transform Mirinae into a sanctuary began in 1972, and the 103rd Saint Memorial Basilica was completed in 1989. When you enter the shrine, the first thing you see is the memorial cathedral standing in the middle of the shrine. This cathedral was built to commemorate the canonization of the 103rd person in the Catholic Church. On the Way of the Cross behind the memorial cathedral, there are 15 bronze sculptures depicting the process of Jesus being captured by Roman soldiers, hanging on a cross, suffering, dying, and being buried in a tomb. It takes 2 to 3 hours to tour the Mirinae Cathedral, where the tomb of Father Kim Dae-geon and the mandible (lower jawbone) are enshrined, the statue of Father Kim, the Cathedral of the Virgin Mary, and the Garden of Gethsemane (a garden made of natural rocks).
경기도 안성에서 북쪽으로 40리쯤 떨어져 은하수라는 뜻의 아름다운 우리말.zh: 美里神社位于京畿道安城以北约 40 英里处，在韩语中被称为“银河”，韩国第一位神父金大建神父、他的母亲乌苏拉、任命金神父为圣的朝鲜教区第三任主教、佩雷奥尔主教以及埋葬金神父遗体的文森特·李民植的坟墓并排坐落于此。这个地方后来被称为Mirinae，因为天主教信徒为了躲避新余和Gihae的迫害而躲藏在这里，形成了一个信徒村庄。夜晚，各家各户的灯光与月光下的溪流相映成趣，宛如银河。美里原原本是天主教早期传教地区之一，包括京畿道的光州、始兴、龙仁、杨平、华城、安城等地。 1896年，即金神父被埋葬在米里奈50年后，教区成立时，约有1,600名信徒。 26岁时殉道的金大建神父甚至不被允许举行葬礼，因此在他被处决后仅40天，文森佐·李民植就设法将尸体搬到背上，避开公众关注，将其运到美里埋葬了一周。 1972年，米里奈圣殿正式开始改建，1989年，第103座圣纪念大教堂竣工。进入神社，首先映入眼帘的是矗立在神社中央的纪念大教堂。这座大教堂是为了纪念天主教会第103位人物的封圣而建造的。纪念大教堂后面的十字架之路上，有15座青铜雕塑，描绘了耶稣被罗马士兵俘虏、挂在十字架上、受苦、垂死、被埋在坟墓里的过程。游览供奉着金大建神父坟墓和下颌骨（下颌骨）的美里那大教堂、金神父雕像、圣母玛利亚大教堂、客西马尼园（天然岩石构成的花园）等，需要2~3小时。

미메시스 아트 뮤지엄은 대지 1,400평에 연면적 1,100평으로, 지상.en: Mimesis Art Museum has a land area of ​​1,400 pyeong, a total floor area of ​​1,100 pyeong, and consists of 3 floors above ground (1 floor underground). It is famous for its design that contains exhibition spaces of various sizes and numbers in one lump. The main feature of the white exhibition space, which is made up of various curved surfaces, is that it excludes artificial light as much as possible and brings in natural light, creating a soft and calm atmosphere, and allowing you to see the feast of light that changes from time to time. The Mimesis Art Museum does not lure visitors as a commercial exhibition space, but rather becomes a space that provides greater enjoyment than just the exhibition through the architecture itself. As Fernando Geha, a famous Portuguese architectural photographer, said that it will attract more visitors from all over the world than Brazil's Iberi Carmago Museum, designed by Alvaro Siza, the Mimesis Art Museum has been introduced to various foreign media even before its opening, and is having a great influence on domestic and foreign architects. Even now, there is a constant flow of visitors. Mimesis Art Museum plans to actively introduce ‘art that stimulates imagination’ in the future.
미메시스 아트 뮤지엄은 대지 1,400평에 연면적 1,100평으로, 지상.zh: 模仿美术馆占地面积1,400坪，总建筑面积1,100坪，由地上3层（地下1层）组成。它以其将各种尺寸和数量的展览空间集中在一起的设计而闻名。由各种曲面组成的白色展览空间的主要特点是尽可能排除人造光，引入自然光，营造出柔和、平静的氛围，让你看到时时刻刻变化的光的盛宴。模仿艺术博物馆并不是作为一个商业展览空间来吸引游客，而是通过建筑本身成为一个提供比展览更大享受的空间。正如葡萄牙著名建筑摄影师费尔南多·格哈所说，它将比阿尔瓦罗·西扎设计的巴西伊比利亚卡尔马戈博物馆吸引更多来自世界各地的参观者，模仿艺术博物馆在开馆前就已被多家国外媒体介绍，在国内外建筑师中产生了巨大影响。即使现在，游客络绎不绝。拟态美术馆未来计划积极引入“激发想象力的艺术”。

미사한강공원 5호는 산책과 운동을 즐기기 좋은 한강 수변 공원이다. 어린.en: Misa Hangang Park No. 5 is a park along the Han River that is great for walking and exercising. It is equipped with a variety of facilities, including children's play facilities, a children's pool operated in the summer, a basketball court, and a grass plaza. The grass plaza also has a urethane track to help citizens engage in healthy activities. When you climb up to the observatory, you can see not only Hanam's Geomdansan Mountain, but also Namyangju and Yebongsan Mountain on the other side, and the open scenery in all directions is very beautiful.
미사한강공원 5호는 산책과 운동을 즐기기 좋은 한강 수변 공원이다. 어린.zh: 三佐汉江公园5号是汉江沿岸的公园，非常适合散步和锻炼。设施齐全，包括儿童游乐设施、夏季开放的儿童游泳池、篮球场、草地广场等。草地广场还设有聚氨酯跑道，帮助市民进行健康活动。登上展望台，不仅可以看到河南的黔丹山，还可以看到对岸的南杨州和礼峰山，四面八方的开阔景色非常美丽。

미호 박물관은 자연의 역사를 담아 2014년 7월에 개관하다. 미호박물관.en: Miho Museum opened in July 2014 and contains the history of nature. Miho Museum is a place where you can learn about the past and present of the blue planet Earth, and it tells the story of the history of the Earth. It houses and exhibits a large number of animal and plant fossils from the Paleozoic and Mesozoic eras, including stromatolites, the first fossils of life on Earth. Additionally, a variety of mysterious minerals and insect specimens are on display. You can escape the gray city in the metropolitan area and feel the green nature, and in Dinosaur Village 1 and 2, where there are petrified wood and dinosaur exhibits, children welcome nature and dinosaurs as friends. You can engage in sensory and experiential activities with various exhibition specimens.
미호 박물관은 자연의 역사를 담아 2014년 7월에 개관하다. 미호박물관.zh: 美秀博物馆于 2014 年 7 月开放，展示了自然的历史。美秀博物馆是一个可以了解蓝色星球地球的过去和现在的地方，它讲述着地球的历史故事。这里收藏并展示了大量古生代和中生代的动植物化石，其中包括地球上最早的生命化石——叠层石。此外，还展出各种神秘矿物和昆虫标本。你可以逃离大都市的灰色城市，感受绿色的大自然，而在恐龙村一号和二号，那里有硅化木和恐龙展品，孩子们欢迎大自然和恐龙为朋友。您可以通过各种展览标本进行感官和体验活动。

부산 수영구에 위치한 밀락더마켓은 보리에에서 운영하는 복합문화공간이다..en: Mille Rock The Market, located in Suyeong-gu, Busan, is a complex cultural space operated by Borrier. There are escalators and elevators on both sides for convenient use. The graffiti on the wall you see as you enter creates an impressive photo zone. Aiming to be a differentiated open plaza-type experience space, this is a new lifestyle space that connects locals and culture. The space consists of Busking Square, a dream stage where anyone can be the protagonist, an ocean view stand where you can feel the Busan sea, and an F&B zone where you can experience high-quality domestic and foreign restaurant brands. Depending on the brand, some stores operate as pop-up stores for a set period of time, so if there is a brand you want to visit, it would be a good idea to check in advance before visiting.
부산 수영구에 위치한 밀락더마켓은 보리에에서 운영하는 복합문화공간이다..zh: Mille Rock The Market位于釜山水营区，是由Borrier运营的复合文化空间。两侧设有自动扶梯和电梯，使用方便。一进门就看到墙上的涂鸦，营造出令人印象深刻的拍照区。旨在成为差异化的开放广场式体验空间，是连接当地人与文化的新生活方式空间。空间由任何人都可以成为主角的梦想舞台Busking Square、可感受釜山大海的海景看台、以及可体验国内外优质餐饮品牌的F&B区组成。根据品牌的不同，有些商店会在规定的时间内以快闪店的形式运营，因此如果您想参观某个品牌，最好在参观前提前确认一下。

경기도는 식물 유전자원을 보존하고, 서해안에 훌륭한 산림휴양 공간을 만들.en: With the desire to preserve plant genetic resources and create a great forest recreation space on the west coast, Gyeonggi Province began the project in 2007 by establishing a basic plan to create an arboretum using provincial forests. Since then, steady efforts have been made to build various infrastructure facilities and a theme park, and it was officially opened in May 2019. Currently, about 300,000 plants of about 1,000 types are growing in the Sea Fragrance Arboretum, mainly plants from the coastal islands of central Korea. The total area is 300,000 pyeong (1,010,000 ㎡), and there are various unique theme gardens such as Sangsang Observatory, Sea Wave Garden, Rock Garden, and Rose Garden, which provide a view of the beautiful west coast scenery, as well as various recreational spaces such as a lily rest area and a small performance hall. Gyeonggi-do Sea Fragrance Arboretum will continue to strive to preserve plant genetic resources, which is the original purpose of the arboretum, and will continue to serve as a forest recreation space where one can experience the importance of the natural environment.
경기도는 식물 유전자원을 보존하고, 서해안에 훌륭한 산림휴양 공간을 만들.zh: 为了保护植物遗传资源并在西海岸创建一个良好的森林休闲空间，京畿道于2007年启动了该项目，制定了利用省级森林创建植物园的基本计划。此后，稳步建设各类基础设施和主题公园，并于2019年5月正式开放。目前，海香植物园内种植着约1000种、约30万株植物，主要​​是来自朝鲜中部沿海岛屿的植物。总面积达30万坪（1,010,000平方米），拥有可观赏美丽西海岸风景的桑桑展望台、海浪花园、岩石花园、玫瑰花园等各种独特的主题花园，以及百合休息区、小型表演厅等各种休闲空间。京畿道海香植物园将继续努力保护植物遗传资源，这是植物园的初衷，并将继续作为一个可以体验自然环境重要性的森林休闲空间。

소풍정원은 2013년 평택시 고덕면 궁리에 조성된 수변공원이다. 소풍정원.en: Picnic Garden is a waterside park created in Gung-ri, Godeok-myeon, Pyeongtaek-si in 2013. Picnic Garden, which means ‘a garden where a smile (wind) stays,’ is a space where nature and people can come together to experience and relax in the nature of the Jinwi Stream. In 2018, the previously neglected island area was created into a themed island with four themes, including Ewha's Island and Garden of Light, so you can enjoy unique scenery and a unique night view through landscape lighting at night. You can enjoy seeing the sotdae and pinwheels installed here and there along the waterside deck and walking path, and experience and feel nature at the playground and various rest areas. (Source: Picnic Garden official website)
소풍정원은 2013년 평택시 고덕면 궁리에 조성된 수변공원이다. 소풍정원.zh: 野餐花园是2013年在平泽市古德面公里建成的水边公园。野餐花园的意思是“微笑（风）停留的花园”，是一个可以在振威溪流的自然中体验和放松自然和人们的空间。 2018年，以前被忽视的岛屿区域被打造成主题岛，拥有梨花岛、光之花园等四大主题，让您在夜晚可以通过景观照明欣赏到独特的风景和独特的夜景。沿着水边的甲板和步行道，可以欣赏随处可见的风车和风车，还可以在游乐场和各种休息区体验和感受大自然。 （来源：野餐花园官网）

해금강 가는 길 왼쪽으로 내려가면 도장포 마을이 나오고, 그 마을 북쪽에.en: If you go down to the left on the way to Haegeumgang, you will come across Dojangpo Village, and to the north of that village is Windy Hill. The original name was ‘Ttibatneul’, but since 2002 it has been changed to ‘Windy Hill’. When you look at the sea from the hill, it is infinitely spacious and quiet, and the cool breeze gives you a refreshing feeling. Everything you see here has a leisurely, not boring feel to it. The island, the lighthouse, the cruise ship, and even the wind seem leisurely. It is the perfect place to throw the burden of your heart into the sea or let it blow away in the wind. A windmill was installed in November 2009 to provide tourists with something to see. (Source: Geoje Culture and Tourism website)
해금강 가는 길 왼쪽으로 내려가면 도장포 마을이 나오고, 그 마을 북쪽에.zh: 去海金刚的路上向左走，就会看到道藏浦村，村子的北边就是风之丘。原名是“Ttibatneul”，但自2002年起改为“Windy Hill”。从山上看海，无限宽敞、静谧，凉风习习，给人一种心旷神怡的感觉。在这里看到的一切都给人一种悠闲而不乏味的感觉。岛屿、灯塔、游船，甚至风都显得悠闲。这里是您将内心的负担抛入大海或让它随风飘散的完美场所。 2009年11月安装了一座风车，为游客提供了可看的东西。 （来源：巨济文化观光网站）

수원시에는 일반적인 도서관 외에 어린이만을 위한 전용 도서관인 슬기샘,.en: In Suwon City, in addition to general libraries, there are libraries exclusively for children: Wise Saem, Bareun Saem, and Wisdom Saem. Among these, Barunsaem Library is located in Maebong-ro, Yeongtong-gu, and is a knowledge information and cultural space established to help children, who can be said to be Suwon's future dreamers, grow into wise, wise, and upright children. We want to help growing sprouts have dreams, hopes, and curiosity, thereby improving their cultural experience and information mindset. This library also has a baby nest for toddlers, helping to create an atmosphere of reading books with parents from an early age.
수원시에는 일반적인 도서관 외에 어린이만을 위한 전용 도서관인 슬기샘,.zh: 水原市除了一般图书馆外，还设有儿童专用图书馆：Wise Saem、Bareun Saem、Wisdom Saem。其中，Barunsaem图书馆位于灵通区梅峰路，是为了帮助可以说是水原未来梦想家的孩子们成长为聪明、聪明、正直的孩子而建立的知识信息和文化空间。我们希望帮助成长中的豆芽拥有梦想、希望和好奇心，从而提高他们的文化体验和信息思维。图书馆还设有幼儿窝，营造从小就与父母一起读书的氛围。

바운스슈퍼파크 수원영통센터는 수원시 망포역 인근 판타지움 건물 3층에 있.en: Bounce Super Park Suwon Yeongtong Center is located on the 3rd floor of the Fantasium building near Mangpo Station in Suwon, and unlike a typical kids cafe, it is a unique indoor playground that adults can also experience. It is divided into Zip Coaster, Giant Tower, Free Jump Zone, Net Play, Adventure Zone, Challenge Zone, Bounce Runner, Dunk Zone, Racing Zone, Multi-Court, Sports Arcade Zone, Super Trampoline Zone, and VR Zone, and is operated for 30 minutes each with facility inspection and charging. It is the first trampoline park in Korea, and it is mandatory to wear anti-slip socks for safety when using the trampoline. It is an indoor playground that adults can also enjoy, allowing them to understand childhood and increase intimacy with children. It is also popular as a date course for young people. It is a place where children can also enjoy special occasions such as birthdays, Christmas, and the end of the year.
바운스슈퍼파크 수원영통센터는 수원시 망포역 인근 판타지움 건물 3층에 있.zh: Bounce Super Park水原灵通中心位于水原市望浦站附近的Fantasium大楼3楼，与典型的儿童咖啡馆不同，它是一个成人也可以体验的独特室内游乐场。分为过山车、巨型塔、自由跳跃区、网游区、冒险区、挑战区、弹跳跑区、扣篮区、赛车区、多功能球场、运动街机区、超级蹦床区、VR区，每个运行30分钟，并设有设施检查和充电。这是韩国第一个蹦床公园，使用蹦床时必须穿防滑袜以确保安全。这是一个大人也可以玩的室内游乐场，让他们了解童年，增加与孩子的亲密感。作为年轻人的约会课程也很受欢迎。在这里，孩子们还可以享受生日、圣诞节和年末等特殊场合。

반달섬은 반달 모양의 독특한 지형 때문에 붙은 이름이다. 물길을 따라 산.en: Bandalseom Island is named so because of its unique half-moon shaped topography. There is a long walking path along the waterway, so you can enjoy the ocean view while feeling the cool breeze. The scenery created by the open water and anchored ships provides a sense of openness that is difficult to feel in the city. There are restaurants and cafes scattered throughout, making it convenient to relax and eat. Bandal Island Cultural Park in the center of the island is a great rest area for taking a break while walking and is popular with families.
반달섬은 반달 모양의 독특한 지형 때문에 붙은 이름이다. 물길을 따라 산.zh: 班达岛因其独特的半月形地形而得名。水道上有一条长长的步行道，可以一边欣赏海景，一边感受凉爽的微风。开阔的水域和停泊的船只营造出的景色给人一种在城市中很难感受到的开放感。餐厅、咖啡厅星罗棋布，休闲吃饭很方便。位于岛中心的班达尔岛文化公园是散步休息的好去处，深受家庭游客的欢迎。

반딧불마을은 가평군의 남쪽 설악면 엄소리에 있는 전형적인 산촌마을로, 천.en: Firefly Village is a typical mountain village located in Eomsori, Seorak-myeon, south of Gapyeong-gun, and boasts beautiful natural scenery. Eomsori, where the firefly village is located, was named 'Eomsori' because it is a neighborhood with many cows (puddles) that can be scary even during the day when you cross the many stone bridges and see large rocks and blue, deep water. It means to always live kindly and honestly with a solemn heart. A clear, clean and wide stream flows in the center of the village, and on both sides it is surrounded by pine pine forests, allowing you to breathe air rich in phytoncide. It is also a village that produces excellent agricultural products with fertile soil and abundant agricultural water. Most of the residents are engaged in agriculture rather than commerce, preserving the warm hospitality of our mountain village.
