사려니숲길은 제주의 숨은 비경 31곳 중 하나로, 비자림로를 시작으로 물.zh: 思连尼森林步道是济州岛31处隐秘景点之一。是一条以榧子林路为起点，经过水草岳、思连岳的森林小道，周围遍布杉树。因为是通往思连岳的森林道路，所以被称为思连连森林道路。 “Saryoni”的意思是神圣的森林或“将线绕成一圈，这样它们就不会散开”。当您穿过森林时，您会感觉自己仿佛被雪松树的清新香气所包围。除了茂密的雪松外，这里还栖息着橡树、角树、竹树、柏树等多种树种。由于栖息着多种树种，这里也是獾和济州黄鼠狼等哺乳动物、八色鸫和苍鹰等鸟类以及坑毒蛇等爬行动物的家园。 Saryeoni森林步道是喜欢徒步旅行者的热门目的地，因为森林的原始面貌没有受到太大破坏。 2002年，这里被联合国教科文组织指定为济州生物圈保护区。为了保护森林，由于自然休养年，水鹿山的参观受到限制，但举办了“思连尼森林生态治愈”活动，暂时开放了该地区。

사적인서점은 책방지기가 한 사람의 취향과 고민을 듣고 알맞은 책을 추천해.en: Private bookstores are independent bookstores known for their ‘book doctor’ concept, where the bookstore manager listens to a person’s tastes and concerns and recommends appropriate books. Beyond simply selling books, we help you look into your inner self through reading consultation. This is also the reason why customers continue to visit even remote alleys. The books on the shelves have underlines and notes from other visitors, so you can feel a strange sense of intimacy as you catch a glimpse of other people's reading traces.
사적인서점은 책방지기가 한 사람의 취향과 고민을 듣고 알맞은 책을 추천해.zh: 私人书店是以“图书医生”理念而闻名的独立书店，书店经理会倾听人们的品味和关注点，并推荐合适的书籍。除了单纯卖书之外，我们还通过阅读咨询帮助您洞察内心的自我。这也是顾客不断光顾甚至偏僻小巷的原因。书架上的书上有其他参观者的下划线和注释，所以当你瞥见别人的阅读痕迹时，你会产生一种奇怪的亲密感。

바다와 산을 동시에 운행하는 국내 최초의 케이블카로 바다 또는 산으로만.en: As Korea's first cable car that operates both on the sea and in the mountains, it can solve all the shortcomings of existing cable cars that only operate on the sea or mountains, resulting in high passenger satisfaction. The total length is 2.43km, and you can get off at Gaksan Bus Stop and go up to the observatory to enjoy the beautiful scenery of the Sacheon Sea. While traveling by cable car, the boats floating in the sea for fishing can make you feel like you are looking at a watercolor painting, and sometimes you can even meet the native dolphin, ‘Sanghoe’. The cable car runs from Daebang Stop to Choyang Stop and Gaksan Stop and back to Daebang Stop on a round-trip basis, with a total of 42 cabins (28 regular cabins and 14 crystal cabins).
바다와 산을 동시에 운행하는 국내 최초의 케이블카로 바다 또는 산으로만.zh: 作为韩国首个同时在海上和山上运营的缆车，它可以解决现有缆车仅在海上或山上运营的所有缺点，从而带来很高的乘客满意度。全长2.43公里，可在阁山公交车站下车，上展望台欣赏泗川海的美景。乘坐缆车旅行时，漂浮在海中钓鱼的小船让你有如在欣赏一幅水彩画的感觉，有时甚至还能遇见本土海豚“桑河”。缆车往返于大方站、朝阳站、阁山站和返回大方站之间，共有42个车厢（普通车厢28个，水晶车厢14个）。

사천 해변은 경포대 해변과 연곡 해변 사이에 있는 길이 300m, 18,.en: Sacheon Beach is a very quiet and clean beach with a length of 300m and an area of ​​18,000㎡ located between Gyeongpodae Beach and Yeongok Beach. It opened on July 1, 1975, and is adjacent to Gyeongpo Provincial Park, so many vacationers visit it every year. It is a great place to enjoy a quiet summer vacation with a large pine forest, clean white sand beach, and shallow water. The fragrant smell and cool shade from the pine forest are even better for creating deep memories. Located near Anmok Beach, there are not many people here, so it is a secluded and quiet beach. The color of the sea here is a jewel emerald, giving the impression that you are on a foreign coast. If Gyeongpodae is a place visited by young couples, the nearby Sacheon Beach is a place visited by scuba divers, fishermen, and family tourists due to its clear water and calm waves. Because the sea changes its colors depending on the season, many people come to enjoy the seasons as they change. In addition, Sacheon Beach is considered a paradise for auto camping enthusiasts as it has a good environment for auto camping. Auto Camping Site is a comfortable camping site where you can smell the fragrant scent of pine trees.
사천 해변은 경포대 해변과 연곡 해변 사이에 있는 길이 300m, 18,.zh: 泗川海水浴场位于镜浦台海水浴场和莲谷海水浴场之间，长300m，面积18,000㎡，是一个非常安静、干净的海水浴场。它于1975年7月1日开业，毗邻镜浦道立公园，每年都有很多游客前来参观。这里有大片的松树林、干净的白色沙滩、浅浅的海水，是享受安静暑假的好地方。松林的芳香和凉爽的树荫更能留下深刻的回忆。位于安木海滩附近，这里人不多，所以是一个僻静安静的海滩。这里海水的颜色是宝石般的翡翠色，给人一种身处异国海岸的感觉。如果说镜浦台是年轻情侣们常去的地方，那么附近的泗川海滩则因其清澈的海水和平静的海浪而成为潜水者、渔民和家庭游客的聚集地。由于海水会根据季节变换颜色，因此很多人都会来享受季节的变换。此外，泗川海滩拥有良好的汽车露营环境，被认为是汽车露营爱好者的天堂。 Auto Camping Site是一处可以闻到松树芳香的舒适露营地。

산골수목원은 시흥시에 위치한 수목원 겸 대형 베이커리 카페다. 싱그러운.en: Sangol Arboretum is an arboretum and large bakery cafe located in Siheung City. You can enjoy nature with your whole body in a space filled with the fresh scent of grass. On the second floor, you can get lost in thought while looking at the lush trees, and on the third floor terrace, you can spend a quiet time feeling the breeze. If you follow the walking path behind the cafe, a greenhouse garden appears, adding to the relaxation of a cup of coffee. The menu is diverse, from bakeries such as croissants, salt bread, and Mont Blanc to coffee and ade, so it is fun to choose according to your taste.
산골수목원은 시흥시에 위치한 수목원 겸 대형 베이커리 카페다. 싱그러운.zh: Sangol树木园是位于始兴市的树木园和大型面包店咖啡馆。在充满草香的空间里，全身心地享受大自然。在二楼，您可以眺望郁郁葱葱的树木陷入沉思，在三楼的露台上，您可以感受微风，度过一段安静的时光。沿着咖啡馆后面的步道走，就会看到一个温室花园，为喝咖啡增添了一丝放松。菜单种类丰富，从牛角面包、盐面包、勃朗峰等面包到咖啡和阿德酒，根据自己的口味选择很有趣。

산굼부리는 천연기념물로 둘레가 2㎞가 넘는 화구이다. 제주도에는 360여.en: Sangumburi is a natural monument and a crater with a circumference of over 2km. There are about 360 parasitic volcanoes distributed on Jeju Island, but except for Sangumburi, all volcanoes are in the form of craters that look like an overturned bowl, and Sangumburi Crater is the only volcano in Jeju Island that exploded without erupting lava or ash, blowing away the rocks there, leaving only a hole. This type of volcano is called Maar, and it is a very rare volcano in the world, with only one in Korea. In particular, there are many gaps at the bottom of Sangumburi, so all the water seeps through, so the plant ecosystem is uniquely distributed within this crater. Temperate and subtropical regions are formed depending on the height of the crater's interior, and are distributed in various ways depending on the amount of solar radiation and sunlight hours. In other words, the sunny northern cliff forms a subtropical zone, with a group of evergreen broad-leaved trees such as red thorn, red thorn, cypress, and sendal trees. The lower layer is home to rare plants such as eucalyptus orchids, as well as winter berries, etc. In addition, on the southern cliff, which does not receive much sunlight, there is a colony of temperate deciduous trees such as oaks, Japanese oaks, maples, and Korean pine trees, which have a distribution that is very different from that of the north. In addition, the Sangsan community, Jeju Korean lily community, Boksu community, and Byeonsan wind flower community, as well as the Sangsan community, Jeju Korean lily community, Boksu community, and Byeonsan wind flower community, as well as the Japanese oak community, which are difficult to find elsewhere, are very colorful and perfectly preserved, which is highly regarded as having a high academic research value. There is. It is also famous as a habitat for wild animals such as mammals such as roe deer and badgers, as well as birds and reptiles. In spring, the shape of clouds forming at the bottom of the crater and rising upward is almost mysterious, and along with colorful flowers such as sagebrush, gentian, and whirligig, Sangumburi shows mystery and beauty to tourists all year round.
산굼부리는 천연기념물로 둘레가 2㎞가 넘는 화구이다. 제주도에는 360여.zh: Sangumburi是一个天然纪念物，也是一个周长超过2公里的火山口。济州岛上分布着大约360座寄生火山，但除了山君不离火山外，所有的火山都是火山口的形状，看起来像一个翻倒的碗，而山君不离火山口是济州岛唯一一座没有喷发熔岩或火山灰而爆炸的火山，把那里的岩石都吹走了，只留下一个洞。这种类型的火山被称为玛珥岛，是世界上非常罕见的火山，韩国仅有一座。特别是山君不离山底部有很多缝隙，所有的水都渗透进去，因此植物生态系统在这个火山口内分布得独特。温带和亚热带地区的形成取决于火山口内部的高度，并根据太阳辐射量和日照时间以不同的方式分布。也就是说，阳光充足的北崖形成了一个亚热带地带，生长着红刺、红刺、柏树、楝树等一群常绿阔叶树。下层生长着桉树、兰花等珍稀植物，还有冬季浆果等。此外，在阳光照射不多的南面悬崖上，生长着橡树、日本橡树、枫树、红松等温带落叶乔木群落，其分布与北方有很大不同。此外，上山群落、济州百合群落、福水群落、边山风花群落，以及其他地方很难找到的上山群落、济州百合群落、福水群落、边山风花群落以及日本橡树群落，色彩缤纷，保存完好，被认为具有很高的学术研究价值。有。它还作为野生动物的栖息地而闻名，例如狍子和獾等哺乳动物以及鸟类和爬行动物。春天，火山口底部形成并向上升起的云朵形状近乎神秘，再加上山艾树、龙胆、旋花等色彩缤纷的花朵，山君布里一年四季都向游客展示着神秘和美丽。

산막이옛길은 충북 괴산군 칠성면 외사리 사오랑 마을에서 산골 마을인 산막.en: Sanmagi Old Road is an old road that connected Saorang Village, Oesa-ri, Chilseong-myeon, Goesan-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do, to Sanmangi Village, a mountain village. It is a trail that has been restored as if drawing on the old road that remains like a trace. Most of the old road section was made into a deck, minimizing environmental damage to show the living natural beauty, and the beauty of the mountains, water, and forests along the old mountain road is considered the highlight of Goesan. The Sanmagi Old Trail Trail consists of two courses and is full of things to see, with representative attractions such as the Dolmen Rest Area and the Pine Suspension Bridge. It was built along the Goesan Dam, showing the natural beauty that harmonizes with the Goesan Dam Lake. From Goesan Lake, you can tour the mountain village using a cruise ship or motorboat.
산막이옛길은 충북 괴산군 칠성면 외사리 사오랑 마을에서 산골 마을인 산막.zh: 三马基古道是连接忠清北道槐山郡七星面大沙里小郎村和山村三马基村的古老道路。这是一条经过修复的小路，就像在残留的痕迹一样的旧路上绘制的。旧路段大部分被打造成甲板，最大限度地减少对环境的破坏，展现生机勃勃的自然美景，而旧山路沿线的山、水、林之美被认为是槐山的一大亮点。三马木古道步道由两条路线组成，景点众多，代表性景点有支石墓休息区和松树吊桥等。它沿着槐山水坝而建，展示了与槐山水坝湖相协调的自然美景。从槐山湖出发，您可以乘坐游船或摩托艇游览山村。

산지천은 한라산 부근에서 제주시 도심을 관통하여 제주시 최대의 재래시장인.en: Sanjicheon Stream is a stream that runs from near Hallasan Mountain, through downtown Jeju City, next to Dongmun Market, the largest traditional market in Jeju City, and all the way to Jeju Port. In the 1960s, when industrialization was in full swing, environmental pollution problems arose when houses and commercial buildings were built over mountain streams, so a restoration project began in 1995. In 2002, Sanjicheon took on its current appearance with clear water flowing. Freshwater fish such as silverfish, mullet, yellowtail, and carp live there, so you can often see people enjoying fishing and children swimming in the summer. The shopping center Chilseongtong and Dongmun Traditional Market are located nearby, and it is also the starting point of the Jeju Olle Course 18, so the area is always crowded with people. The Sanjicheon Festival is held every year and various experience spaces, exhibitions, food markets, and exciting stages and performances are held along the path of Sanjicheon spring water. If you walk along Sanjicheon, you will find the Arario Museum, which has renovated old buildings into a unique modern art exhibition space, and other famous attractions include the Kim Man-deok Memorial Hall, which honors grandmother Kim Man-deok, who practiced sharing and service by giving everything she had to the people of Jeju in the past.
산지천은 한라산 부근에서 제주시 도심을 관통하여 제주시 최대의 재래시장인.zh: 山地川是一条从汉拿山附近流经济州市区，紧邻济州市最大的传统市场东门市场，一直到达济州港的一条溪流。 20世纪60年代，工业化如火如荼的时候，由于在山间溪流上修建房屋和商业建筑，出现了环境污染问题，因此从1995年开始进行修复工程。2002年，山地川呈现出现在清澈流水的面貌。这里生活着银鱼、鲻鱼、鰤鱼、鲤鱼等淡水鱼，因此夏天经常可以看到钓鱼的人们和游泳的孩子。七星洞购物中心和东门传统市场就在附近，而且这里也是济州偶来路线18的起点，所以这里总是人潮拥挤。每年都会举办山地川节，山地川泉水沿途会举办各种体验空间、展览、美食市场以及精彩的舞台和表演。沿着山地川漫步，您会看到阿拉里奥博物馆，该博物馆将旧建筑改造成独特的现代艺术展览空间，其他著名景点还包括金万德纪念馆，该馆纪念金万德祖母，她过去将自己的一切奉献给济州人民，实践分享和服务。

경남 산청군의 왕산과 필봉산 기슭에 자리 잡은 동의보감촌은 전국에서 처음.en: Donguibogamchon, located at the foot of Wangsan and Pilbongsan Mountain in Sancheong-gun, Gyeongsangnam-do, is the first oriental medicine-themed health experience tourist destination in the country. It is equipped with various facilities related to oriental medicine, such as the Expo Theme Hall, Oriental Medicine Museum, Oriental Medicine Experience Center, Oriental Medicine Theme Park, Donguibonga, Oriental Medicine Natural Recreation Forest, Bondiol Oriental Medicine Clinic, lodging facilities, and herbal medicine store, making it the mecca of Oriental medicine resort tourist destinations in name and reality. It is the number one healing trip. You can also use various oriental medicine-related experience programs such as oriental medicine heating experience, herbal scent bag making experience, wearing a medical doctor/medicine woman’s costume, and oriental medicine foot bath experience. ◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave - The place where Ban Ji-eum from the drama <Please Take Care of Me This Life Too’ took Seo-ha Seo-ha, showing her his past life, and enjoyed a tickling date is ‘Donguibogamchon’, an oriental medicine-themed space located in Sancheong-gun, the home of traditional oriental medicine. There are a variety of things to enjoy here, including a garden full of flowers and trees, an Oriental medicine museum, an Oriental medicine experience center, an observatory, and the Mureung Bridge that Banjieum and Documentoha crossed, so we recommend stopping by.
경남 산청군의 왕산과 필봉산 기슭에 자리 잡은 동의보감촌은 전국에서 처음.zh: 东医宝甘村位于庆尚南道山清郡王山和必峰山山麓，是韩国首个以韩医学为主题的健康体验旅游胜地。拥有世博会主题馆、东方医学博物馆、东方医学体验中心、东方医学主题公园、东归邦加、东方医学自然休养林、邦迪奥尔东方医学诊所、住宿设施、草药店等各种与东方医学相关的设施，使其成为名副其实的东方医学度假旅游胜地的圣地。这是排名第一的治愈之旅。还可以体验韩药加热体验、药草香包制作体验、医生/药师服装、韩药足浴体验等各种与韩医学相关的体验项目。 ◎ 邂逅韩流魅力的旅游信息 - 电视剧《今生请多多关照》中的班智音带着徐河徐河向她展示自己的前世，并进行了一场令人心旷神怡的约会的地方，是位于传统韩医学之乡山清郡的韩医学主题空间“东医宝甘村”。这里有花木繁茂的庭园、韩医药博物馆、韩医药体验馆、展望台、半截庵和Documentoha所跨越的武陵桥等，值得一去，值得推荐。

삼막사계곡은 삼성산에서 흐르는 맑고 깨끗한 물줄기가 모여 형성된 계곡으로.en: Sammaksa Valley is a valley formed by the gathering of clear and clean water streams flowing from Samseongsan Mountain. It is a popular summer attraction because you can enjoy water play in a dense forest. The current is not strong and the water is shallow, making it a popular destination for families. There are plenty of shaded areas, making it perfect for spreading out a mat and resting. Visitors with families with children are recommended to enjoy water play downstream, where various convenience facilities such as public parking lots, restrooms, and shops are nearby.
삼막사계곡은 삼성산에서 흐르는 맑고 깨끗한 물줄기가 모여 형성된 계곡으로.zh: 三草溪谷是由三圣山流淌的清澈溪流汇集而成的溪谷。这里是夏季的热门景点，因为您可以在茂密的森林中享受戏水的乐趣。水流不强，水浅，是家庭旅游的热门目的地。有很多阴影区域，非常适合铺上垫子休息。建议带孩子的家庭游客到下游玩水，附近有公共停车场、卫生间、商店等各种便利设施。

경기도 시흥시 신천동에 위치한 전통시장으로 채소,과일,육류,생선 등 각종.en: It is a traditional market located in Sincheon-dong, Siheung-si, Gyeonggi-do, selling various foods and miscellaneous goods such as vegetables, fruits, meat, and fish. It is a representative traditional market in Siheung that is visited not only by locals but also by tourists due to its clean facilities and low prices. The food stall street located in the middle of Sammi Market is a great place to enjoy a variety of food and feel the warmth of a traditional market.
경기도 시흥시 신천동에 위치한 전통시장으로 채소,과일,육류,생선 등 각종.zh: 位于京畿道始兴市新川洞的传统市场，出售蔬菜、水果、肉、鱼等各种食品和杂货。它是始兴具有代表性的传统市场，由于干净的设施和低廉的价格，不仅受到当地人的欢迎，也受到游客的欢迎。位于三美市场中心的大排档街，是享受各种美食、感受传统市场温暖的好地方。

삼선산수목원은 1,160여 종의 식물이 자라고 있는 자연 체험 학습장이다.en: Samseonsan Arboretum is a nature experience learning center where over 1,160 species of plants grow. There are 10 facilities, including an outdoor garden where you can see various flowers and trees, as well as an exhibition greenhouse, Kids' Dream Forest, and the Korean Peninsula Small Park. There are also 23 exhibition gardens, including a hydrangea garden and an azalea garden. In addition, you can see diverse and beautiful scenery depending on the season, and it is well-equipped with convenient facilities such as a children's play area in the forest, a picnic area, a cafe, and water play facilities in the summer. Samseonsan Arboretum operates a variety of programs for children, teenagers, and the general public. We operate a forest interpretation program where you can experience nature while exploring the arboretum with a forest guide, a forest ecology experience for children, and a weekend experience program where you can experience hands-on activities such as playing and crafting.
삼선산수목원은 1,160여 종의 식물이 자라고 있는 자연 체험 학습장이다.zh: 三仙山树木园是一个自然体验学习中心，生长着 1,160 多种植物。园内设有可观赏各种花草树木的室外花园、展示温室、儿童梦想森林、朝鲜半岛小公园等10个设施。还有23个展览花园，包括绣球花园和杜鹃花园。此外，根据季节的不同，可以看到多种多样的美丽风景，森林里的儿童游乐区、野餐区、咖啡厅、夏季的戏水设施等便利设施也很齐全。三仙山植物园为儿童、青少年和公众举办各种活动。我们运营有森林解说项目，您可以在森林导游的带领下探索植物园，体验自然；还有儿童森林生态体验项目，以及可以体验玩耍和手工等动手活动的周末体验项目。

청암면 묵계리에 소재하며 한민족의 영산인 지리산 품속 깊이 청암면 청학동.en: Located in Mukgye-ri, Cheongam-myeon, deep in the arms of Jirisan Mountain, the sacred mountain of the Korean people, if you walk about 1.5km around the mountain path in Cheonghak-dong, Cheongam-myeon, Samseong Palace is located at 850m above sea level. The exact name of Samseong Palace is Baedalseongjeon Samseong Palace. In 1983, Kang Min-ju (Hanpul Zen Master), a local native, restored Sodo from the Gojoseon Dynasty. It is a Baedal National Temple dedicated to the ancestors of the nation, Hwanin, Hwanwoong, and Dangun. It is establishing itself as a dojo for the people who protect Seondo, the orthodox domain of the nation, and practice Shinseondo. The 1,500 stone pagodas built by Master Hanpul, who inherited the practice of Seondo that has been passed down since ancient times, while practicing with monks, blend in with the surrounding forest and give off an exotic atmosphere. These stone towers are called Wonryeok Sotdae here. Sodo, a sacred place where ancestral rites were held to the heavenly gods during the Samhan Dynasty, was marked with a tall tree with a sculpture of a wild goose on it to prevent the common people from approaching. As if praying at Seonghwangdang, the old Sodo Island is being restored by building a sotdae with stones from the foot of Jiri Mountain to make a wish. It is the home of those who train martial arts, singing, dancing, and music to build a temple by building 3,333 sotdaes and regaining the unique spiritual culture of our people to create a Hongik Ingan world.
청암면 묵계리에 소재하며 한민족의 영산인 지리산 품속 깊이 청암면 청학동.zh: 三圣宫位于清岩面木溪里，在韩国人民的圣山智异山的怀抱中，沿着清岩面清鹤洞的山路步行约1.5公里，就可以看到海拔850m的三成宫。三成宫的确切名称是白达圣殿三成宫。 1983年，当地当地人姜敏珠（韩普禅师）恢复了古朝鲜王朝的索道。这是一座祭祀民族祖先焕仁、焕雄、檀君的拜达国寺。它正在将自己打造成守护国家正统领地仙岛并修行仙岛的人们的道场。翰普法师继承自古以来流传的仙道修法，与僧人一起修行，建造的1500座石塔与周围的森林融为一体，散发出异域风情。这些石塔在这里被称为圆礼索塔。索多是三韩王朝时期祭祀天神的圣地，树上有一棵大树，树上有一只大雁的雕塑，以防止平民靠近。就像在圣皇堂祈祷一样，用智异山山麓的石头建造了一座小台来许愿，古老的小岛正在被修复。它是训练武术、歌舞、音乐的人的家园，通过建造3333座佛塔，恢复我们人民独特的精神文化，创造一个弘益仁安世界。

''삼성산''은 서울특별시의 관악구 신림동과 경기도 안양시 석수동에 걸쳐.en: ''Samseongsan Mountain'' is a mountain located across Sillim-dong, Gwanak-gu, Seoul, and Seoksu-dong, Anyang-si, Gyeonggi-do. It is the jinsan of Geumcheon-hyeon (the main mountain that protects each village), and Gwanaksan is the jinsan of Gwacheon-hyeon, located 5 ri west of the point where Ononsa Temple is located in Gwanmun-dong, Gwacheon-si, making it clear that the two mountains are separate mountains. There are also many theories about the origin of Samseongsan Mountain. It is widely known that the origin of Sammaksa Temple is the place where three great monks, Wonhyo, Uisang, and Yunpil, built a small hermitage and advanced to the capital in 677 (the 17th year of King Munmu's reign in Silla), and that the name of Samseongsan Mountain was purified by these three great monks and was called "Samseongsan Mountain." However, some in the Buddhist world believe that Sammaksa is the leader of the world of paradise as spoken of in Buddhism. Amitabha Buddha, Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva on the left, and Bodhisattva Mahasaeji on the right are called the Three Saints, and this is where the name of the mountain comes from. There are temples such as Sammaksa Temple, Yeombulam Temple, Mangwonam Temple, Anyangsa Temple, and Seongjuam Temple (Seoul), and the Baeksa Lee Hang-bok (1556-1618), who served as Byeongjopanseo five times during the Japanese Invasion of Korea (1592) and later as Uuijeong, climbed this mountain and recited it during his lifetime. The long poem “Chayuseongsamseongsanun (次游三聖山韻)” and the origin of Gogonokrok (高百祿) during the Japanese colonial period are said to have been passed down here. It is also a place with a deep history, where as early as 900, Wang Geon was passing through this place to conquer towns such as Geumju and Gwaju, where he met a monk named Neungjeong and built Anyangsa Temple, giving birth to the city name of Anyang today.
''삼성산''은 서울특별시의 관악구 신림동과 경기도 안양시 석수동에 걸쳐.zh: “三成山”是一座横跨首尔冠岳区新林洞和京畿道安阳市石水洞的山。它是金川县的镇山（守护各村庄的主山），冠岳山是位于果川市观门洞奥农寺西侧5里的果川县的镇山，可见两座山是不同的山。关于三圣山的起源也有多种说法。众所周知，三草寺的起源是元晓、义相、云弼三位高僧于677年（新罗文武王17年）建小隐居进京的地方，三圣山的名字是由这三位高僧净化的，被称为“三圣山”。然而，佛教界有些人认为，三马叉是佛教所说的极乐世界的领袖。阿弥陀佛与左观世音菩萨、右摩诃萨菩萨并称为三圣，山名由此而来。这里有三木寺、炼佛庵、望远庵、安养寺、圣主庵（首尔）等寺庙，侵朝时期（1592年）五次担任屏祖盘修，后来又担任议政的白寺李恒福（1556-1618）生前曾登上这座山并诵读过此山。相传日本殖民时期的长诗《次游三圣山韵》和高百禄的由来就在这里流传。这也是一个有着深厚历史的地方，早在900年，王建征伐金州、果州等城镇时途经此地，结识了一位名叫灵精的僧人，并建造了安养寺，从而诞生了今天的安养市名。

서울과 안양 도심에서 가까운 삼성산 산림욕장은 가볍게 즐기기 좋은 산림휴.en: Samseong Mountain Forest Bathing Area, close to downtown Seoul and Anyang, is a forest resort that is great for light enjoyment. It is mainly used as a hiking trail for Sanseongsan Mountain and Gwanaksan Mountain. The forest bathing area is a 5km section that runs from the entrance to Anyang Art Park and passes Anyangsa Temple and the first and second observatories. It is part of a hiking trail that passes Anyangsa Temple and connects to the summit of Samseongsan Mountain and Gwanaksan Mountain. Convenience facilities such as exercise equipment and rest areas have been created between the dense forest paths, and you can see an open view as if you have reached the top after only 30 minutes of climbing. In particular, it is gentle for elementary and middle school grades, making it a great walking and trekking course for families with children. If you are a beginner or hiking with your family, we recommend climbing to the rest area in the middle, Anyangsa Temple, or Observatory 1. If you enjoy hiking, you can go up to Observatory 2 and try Sammaksa Temple or the summit of Samseongsan Mountain. From the forest bathing area, you can visit Anyangsa Temple. It is a fairly large temple that contains the origin of Anyang City's city name, and Anyangsa Temple's tombs and stupas, which are designated as tangible cultural assets of Gyeonggi Province, are well preserved. Nearby are Gwanaksan Mountain, Cheonggyesan Mountain, Gwanggyosan Mountain, and Pyeongchon Central Park. There are 44 convenience facilities of 9 types, including sports facilities such as iron bars, parallel bars, and waist twists, information signs, and hexagonal pavilions. The forest bathing course is about 5 km long, starting from the Anyang Amusement Park parking lot, passing Anyangsa Temple, Sammaksa Junction, a large pool, and ending with the Parkji Suspension Bridge.
서울과 안양 도심에서 가까운 삼성산 산림욕장은 가볍게 즐기기 좋은 산림휴.zh: 三成山森林浴场靠近首尔市中心和安养，是一个非常适合光享受的森林度假胜地。主要用作山城山、冠岳山的登山步道。森林浴场是从安养艺术公园入口处经过安养寺、第一、第二展望台的5公里路段。它是经过安养寺并连接三圣山和冠岳山山顶的徒步旅行路线的一部分。茂密的林间小道之间设置了健身器材、休息区等便利设施，仅需30分钟的攀登即可看到如登顶般开阔的视野。特别适合中小学生，适合带孩子的家庭散步、徒步旅行。如果您是初学者或与家人一起徒步旅行，我们建议您爬到中间的休息区、安养寺或展望台1。如果您喜欢徒步旅行，您可以登上展望台2，尝试三马寺或三圣山山顶。从森林浴区可以参观安养寺。是一座蕴藏着安养市市名由来的相当大的寺庙，安养寺的坟墓和佛塔被指定为京畿道有形文化遗产，保存完好。附近有冠岳山、清溪山、光教山、坪村中央公园。设有铁栏、双杠、扭腰等体育设施、信息指示牌、六角亭等9类44个便民设施。森林浴路线全长约5公里，从安养游乐园停车场出发，经过安养寺、三马寺交叉口、大水池，最后到朴智吊桥。

자연 그 자체를 느낄 수 있는 드넓은 초원과 풍력발전기의 풍경, 그 아래.en: A tourist ranch where you can commune with nature in the vast grasslands where you can feel nature itself, the scenery of wind power generators, and the peaceful pastures of sheep and cows spread out below. It is an affiliated farm of Samyang Foods, which operates the Samyang Ramen and Buldak brands. It was established in 1972 with the purpose of supplying good protein to the public and opened for tourism in 2007. In addition to the outstanding natural scenery, it is the only ranch in Gangwon-do where you can see a sheep herding performance and enjoy feeding sheep and ostriches. At the gift shop and cafe, you can find snacks and ice cream made from organic milk, boiled ramen, MD products, and local food products.
자연 그 자체를 느낄 수 있는 드넓은 초원과 풍력발전기의 풍경, 그 아래.zh: 一个可以与大自然亲密接触的旅游牧场，在广阔的草原上，您可以感受到大自然的原汁原味，风力发电的风景，以及绵延在下面的绵羊和牛的宁静牧场。它是三养食品的附属农场，经营三养拉面和Buldak品牌。它成立于1972年，以向公众提供优质蛋白质为目的，并于2007年开放旅游。除了出色的自然风光之外，它还是江原道唯一可以观看羊群放牧表演并享受喂养羊和鸵鸟的牧场。在礼品店和咖啡厅，您可以找到有机牛奶制成的小吃和冰淇淋、煮拉面、MD产品和当地食品。

동해안에서 아름답기로 소문난 용화-장호해변을 한눈에 내려다볼 수 있는 케.en: This is a cable car that offers a panoramic view of Yonghwa-Jangho Beach, which is famous for being beautiful on the east coast. When you get on the cable car, a beautiful sight unfolds where the emerald sea and strangely shaped rocks come together in harmony. The open East Sea seen through the car window borders the horizon, so when you look at the end, it is difficult to tell which is the sky and which is the sea. The view from the cable car varies depending on the weather. On a clear day, it feels like looking at a watercolor painting with pretty paints drawn by an artist, and on a rainy and cloudy day, it feels like looking at an elegant ink painting drawn by nature. Both Yonghwa and Jangho have walking trails leading to the coast, providing an opportunity to see the sea up close before your eyes.
동해안에서 아름답기로 소문난 용화-장호해변을 한눈에 내려다볼 수 있는 케.zh: 搭乘缆车可将东海岸美丽的龙和江湖海水浴场尽收眼底。坐上缆车，碧波荡漾的大海与奇形怪状的岩石交相辉映，美丽的景色尽收眼底。透过车窗看到的开阔的东海与地平线接壤，所以当你看向尽头时，很难分辨哪是天空，哪是海。缆车上的景色因天气而异。晴天时，感觉就像是艺术家画出的一幅漂亮的水彩画；雨天、阴天时，感觉就像是大自然绘制的一幅淡雅的水墨画。龙和和江湖都有通往海岸的步行道，让您有机会近距离欣赏大海。

상대원시장은 성남시 중원구 상대원동에 있는 전통시장이다. 크게 A, B,.en: Sangdaewon Market is a traditional market located in Sangdaewon-dong, Jungwon-gu, Seongnam-si. It is largely divided into sections A, B, and C, and each section has 20 to 30 stores. There are a variety of facilities, including side dish shops, rice cake shops, butcher shops, and restaurants, as well as repair shops and saunas. Thanks to the arcade, you can shop comfortably without being affected by the weather, such as rain, snow, sunlight, or wind. A comfortable and luxurious traditional market environment has been created, resulting in high satisfaction for both customers and merchants who come out to shop.
상대원시장은 성남시 중원구 상대원동에 있는 전통시장이다. 크게 A, B,.zh: 上大院市场是位于城南市中原区上大院洞的传统市场。主要分为A、B、C三个区域，每个区域有20至30家店铺。这里有各种设施，包括小菜店、年糕店、肉店、餐馆、以及修理店和桑拿浴室。借助商场，您可以舒适地购物，而不受雨、雪、阳光或风等天气的影响。营造了舒适、豪华的传统市场环境，让前来购物的顾客和商家都获得了较高的满意度。

함양상림은 함양읍의 서쪽에 있는 위천(渭川)강가에 있는 숲으로서, 통일신.en: Hamyang Sanglim is a forest located on the Wicheon River to the west of Hamyang-eup. It is said to have been created by Choi Chi-won during the reign of Queen Jinseong of Unified Silla to prevent flood damage in Hamyang-eup. In the past, it was called Daegwallim, but as the middle part of this forest collapsed due to a flood, it was divided into Sanglim (upper forest) and Harim (lower forest). Currently, Harim has been damaged and only traces remain, and only Sanglim maintains its former appearance. It is mainly composed of oak trees and hornbeam trees, and the tangle of wild herbaceous trees and kudzu is reminiscent of the natural vegetation of a valley. With over 120 species of trees growing along the banks, it is also a great place for children to learn about nature.
함양상림은 함양읍의 서쪽에 있는 위천(渭川)강가에 있는 숲으로서, 통일신.zh: 咸阳尚林是位于咸阳邑以西维川河畔的森林。据说是统一新罗真成王后崔致远时期为了防止咸阳邑水灾而修建的。过去被称为大关林，但由于洪水导致森林中部倒塌，因此分为上林和下林。目前，下林已被破坏，只剩下痕迹，只有上林还保持着昔日的面貌。它主要由橡树和角树组成，野生草本树木和葛藤的缠绕让人想起山谷的自然植被。沿岸生长着120多种树木，也是孩子们了解自然的好地方。

금산의 절경을 긴 병풍으로 삼은 상주은모래비치는 은빛 고운 모래로 이루어.en: Sangju Eunsand Beach, which uses the spectacular view of Geumsan Mountain as a long folding screen, is surrounded by a wide white sand beach with fine silver sand and a dense pine forest, making it one of the few beaches in the country with beautiful natural scenery. This place, located 21km south of Namhae-eup, is a place where the sand feels good under bare feet, and as many as 1 million travelers come here every summer. The 2km long half-moon white sand beach has a gentle slope and high water temperature, making it ideal as a summer resort for families. In addition, the Summer Festival is held in the summer and the Sunrise Festival in the winter, and there is a long tradition of vegetable hot dogs that can only be tasted here, emotional cafes that have become popular Instagram spots, and restaurants run by residents, so there is plenty to see and do.
금산의 절경을 긴 병풍으로 삼은 상주은모래비치는 은빛 고운 모래로 이루어.zh: 尚州恩沙海水浴场以锦山壮丽的景色为长屏，周围是宽阔的白色沙滩、细细的银沙和茂密的松树林，是全国为数不多的自然风光优美的海滩之一。这里位于南海邑以南21公里处，是一个赤脚踩沙的好地方，每年夏天来这里的游客多达100万。长达2公里的半月形白沙滩，坡度平缓，水温较高，是家庭避暑的理想场所。此外，夏季举办夏季祭典，冬季举办日出祭典，还有只有在这里才能品尝到的悠久传统的蔬菜热狗、成为Instagram热门景点的情感咖啡馆以及居民经营的餐厅，所以有很多值得一看和做的事情。

보령 9경 플러스 중 2경인 상화원은 조화를 숭상한다는 이름대로 죽도가.en: Sanghwawon, which is number 2 of Boryeong's 9 Scenic Views Plus, is a traditional Korean garden created by preserving the natural beauty of Jukdo Island as much as possible, cherishing every tree and piece of stone without damaging nature as much as possible, as its name suggests, which reveres harmony. As you walk along the ‘corridor’, a 2km-long roof-shaped promenade surrounding the entire island, you will see 33 seaside ponds with all kinds of aquatic life living in them, and the open West Sea beyond the stone walls made of five stones, a specialty of Jukdo Island. Inside, you can reach a forest path filled with pine trees soaring high into the sky, adding to the scent of pine trees, a sunset garden where you can enjoy the spectacular view of the West Sea sunset, and a Hanok village with eight traditional hanoks that were relocated and restored from all over the country in a place that was used as a rice field by the indigenous people of Jukdo Island. Additionally, on weekdays when it is not open for viewing, you can enjoy the Sanghwawon space privately and enjoy various programs such as family banquets, weddings, and workshops at the Hanok in the Hanok Village. Sanghwawon Korea Villa, an accommodation facility within Sanghwawon, is open only from Friday to Saturday, and individual reservations can be made through the website. If you want to enjoy the sunset in a quiet evening when there are no visitors and the beautiful natural garden at dawn, it is a good idea to stay here. Before visiting Sanghwawon, we recommend that you check the available visit schedule and time before visiting.
보령 9경 플러스 중 2경인 상화원은 조화를 숭상한다는 이름대로 죽도가.zh: 上花院是保宁九景中排名第二的韩国传统园林，顾名思义，是最大限度地保留竹岛的自然美景，珍惜每一棵树、每一块石头，不破坏自然，崇尚和谐的韩国传统园林。沿着环绕全岛的2公里长的屋顶状长廊“走廊”行走，可以看到33个栖息着各种水生生物的海边池塘，以及竹岛特产、由五块石头砌成的石墙外一望无际的西海。里面有一条长满高耸入云、散发着松香的松树的林间小道，还有可以欣赏到西海日落美景的日落花园，以及从竹岛原住民用作稻田的地方从全国各地搬迁和修复的八座传统韩屋的韩屋村。另外，在不开放参观的平日，您可以享受私人空间，在韩屋村的韩屋享受家庭宴会、婚礼、工作坊等各种活动。上花院韩国别墅是上花院内的住宿设施，仅周五至周六开放，可通过网站进行个人预订。如果你想在没有游客的安静夜晚欣赏日落和黎明时分美丽的自然花园，那么住在这里是个好主意。在参观上花院之前，我们建议您在参观之前查看可用的参观时间表和时间。

새별오름은 서부의 대표 오름으로, ‘저녁 하늘에 샛별과 같이 외롭게 서있.en: Saebyeol Oreum is a representative mountain in the West, and was named so because it ‘stands alone like a morning star in the evening sky.’ Starting from the southern peak, there are ridges in the southwest, northwest, and northeast directions, and each ridge has its own peak. The west side is wide open in the shape of Samtaegi, and the north side is hollow. There are five peaks that are round like stars. Overall, it is a grassy field, but there are some scrub trees on the northern slope, and a cemetery has been created on the northwest slope.
새별오름은 서부의 대표 오름으로, ‘저녁 하늘에 샛별과 같이 외롭게 서있.zh: 新星岳是西方的代表性山峰，因其“像夜空中的晨星一样孤独地矗立着”而得名。从南峰开始，西南、西北、东北方向有山脊，每条山脊都有自己的峰顶。西侧敞开，呈三台形状，北侧凹陷。有五座山峰，圆润如星。总体来说，这里是一片草地，但北坡有一些灌木丛，西北坡开辟了一片墓地。

서귀포 올레시장은 서귀포시에서 가장 큰 시장이며 1960년대 초반 자연발.en: Seogwipo Olle Market is the largest market in Seogwipo City. It is a traditional market that was created naturally in the early 1960s and has been a major foundation for Seogwipo's economy with over 60 years of tradition. Starting with 120m in 2001, arcade shopping malls currently totaling 620m have been installed, playing a pivotal role in Seogwipo's low-income economy. This parking lot provides maximum convenience to customers by introducing a one-hour free parking system, and for the convenience of customers who purchase goods at the market, it has a courier system that delivers them to the desired location free of charge. It also has an outdoor performance hall and a park with a fountain for youth, who are potential future customers.
서귀포 올레시장은 서귀포시에서 가장 큰 시장이며 1960년대 초반 자연발.zh: 西归浦偶来市场是西归浦市最大的市场。它是 1960 年代初自然形成的传统市场，拥有 60 多年的传统，一直是西归浦经济的主要基础。从2001年的120m开始，目前已安装了总计620m的拱廊购物中心，在西归浦的低收入经济中发挥着举足轻重的作用。该停车场引入一小时免费停车制度，为顾客提供最大的便利，并为方便在市场购买商品的顾客，设有快递系统，免费将商品运送到所需地点。它还拥有一个室外表演厅和一个带喷泉的公园，供青少年使用，他们是未来的潜在客户。

서대문자연사박물관은 서울 도심 속 안산 자락에 위치한 공공 자연사박물관으.en: Seodaemun Natural History Museum is a public natural history museum located at the foot of Ansan in downtown Seoul, and opened on July 10, 2003. This museum was established by a public institution to increase citizens' understanding of nature and provide opportunities for especially dreamy children and teenagers to directly see and experience information about various creatures, geology, and the environment. Museums provide both knowledge and interest in nature through not only exhibitions but also educational programs and experiential activities. It also serves as a cultural activity space for local residents. Seodaemun Natural History Museum provides an opportunity to experience the value of life and nature even in city life.
서대문자연사박물관은 서울 도심 속 안산 자락에 위치한 공공 자연사박물관으.zh: 西大门自然历史博物馆是位于首尔市中心安山脚下的一座公立自然历史博物馆，于2003年7月10日开馆。该博物馆是由公共机构设立的，目的是增加公民对自然的了解，并为特别有梦想的儿童和青少年提供直接看到和体验有关各种生物、地质和环境信息的机会。博物馆不仅通过展览，还通过教育项目和体验活动提供对自然的知识和兴趣。它还作为当地居民的文化活动空间。即使在城市生活中，西大门自然历史博物馆也提供了体验生命和自然价值的机会。

서대문형무소는 대한제국 말에 일제의 강압으로 감옥이 지어져 80여 년 동.en: Seodaemun Prison was built under Japanese coercion at the end of the Korean Empire. For over 80 years, it was a site of suffering and history during a turbulent period in our modern and contemporary history, and was a representative institution of Japanese imperialism's oppression of our people's anti-Japanese independence movement. After opening under the name of Gyeongseong Prison on October 21, 1908, when our national sovereignty was taken away by the Japanese, a strong national independence movement protested against it, and the Japanese arrested and imprisoned many of our patriots. As the number of prisoners increased, they built another prison in Gongdeok-dong, Mapo, which was renamed Seodaemun Prison on September 3, 1912. It opened as the current ‘Seodaemun Independence Park’ on August 15, 1992, retaining as much history of national suffering as the name change. Seodaemun-gu began a project to turn the Seodaemun Independence Park historic site into a sanctuary in 1995. It was newly renovated and opened as the Seodaemun Prison History Museum to honor the souls of patriotic ancestors who fought against the Japanese invasion for the independence of the country and were imprisoned and died under severe torture and oppression, and to serve as a living educational center for history that awakens the spirit of independence of our ancestors to future generations.
서대문형무소는 대한제국 말에 일제의 강압으로 감옥이 지어져 80여 년 동.zh: 西大门监狱是大韩帝国末期在日本的胁迫下建造的。 80多年来，它是我国近现代历史动荡时期的苦难历史之地，是日本帝国主义镇压我国人民抗日独立运动的代表机构。 1908年10月21日，当我国的国家主权被日本人夺走时，庆城监狱的名义启用后，引起了强烈的民族独立运动的抗议，日本人逮捕并监禁了我们许多爱国人士。随着囚犯人数的增加，他们在麻浦孔德洞建造了另一所监狱，并于1912年9月3日更名为西大门监狱。1992年8月15日，它作为现在的“西大门独立公园”开放，与更名一样保留了民族苦难的历史。西大门区于1995年启动了将西大门独立公园遗址改造成庇护所的计划。为了纪念为国家独立而抗击日本侵略并在监狱中遭受酷刑和压迫而死亡的爱国先辈的灵魂，将其重新整修并开放为西大门监狱历史博物馆，并作为一个活生生的历史教育中心，唤醒我们祖先的独立精神。

궁남지는 백제시대의 연못으로, 삼국사기에 의해 백제 무왕이 궁궐 남쪽에.en: Gungnamji is a pond from the Baekje period. According to the Samguksagi (History of the Three Kingdoms), King Mu of Baekje built it to the south of the palace and is called Gungnamji. It is recorded in the Samguk Yusa that King Mu's mother gave birth to King Mu through a relationship with Yong and Jeong of Gungnamji. Currently, wells and foundation stones remain around the pond, which is the oldest artificial landscaping in Korea and provides a glimpse into the level of Baekje's landscaping technology. Gungnamji Pond, which created an island in the middle of a pond to express the idea of ​​immortals, is Korea's oldest artificial garden. It is said that Baekje's Lao Tzu-gong traveled to Japan and introduced Baekje's garden landscaping techniques to it. It can be seen that Baekje had outstanding garden decoration skills among the three kingdoms. It is a beautiful tourist destination in all four seasons. Currently, Gungnamji has developed into an ideal eco-friendly travel destination where nature and humans coexist, and active management is underway to preserve the natural environment. Thanks to this, tourists can experience history and nature at the same time, and more eco-friendly tourism is possible through bicycles and walking. Additionally, by touring historical sites, you can gain a deeper understanding of the historical value of tourist destinations. In July, the Seodong Lotus Festival, a beautiful feast of 10 million lotus flowers, is held, and in October and November, the Guttrerae Chrysanthemum Exhibition, decorated with various works, is held, adding to the beauty of Gungnamji.
궁남지는 백제시대의 연못으로, 삼국사기에 의해 백제 무왕이 궁궐 남쪽에.zh: 宫南池是百济时代的一个池塘。据《三国史》记载，百济武王将其建于宫殿南侧，称为宫南寺。 《三国舆书》记载，武王的母亲通过与宫南地的龙、郑的关系生下了武王。目前，池塘周围还保留着水井和基石，是韩国最古老的人工造景，可以一窥百济造景技术的水平。宫南池是韩国最古老的人工花园，在池塘中央建造了一座岛屿来表达神仙的想法。相传百济的老子公游历日本，将百济的造园技术传入日本。可见，百济在三国中具有杰出的园林装饰技艺。四季皆宜，是美丽的旅游胜地。目前，宫南地已发展成为自然与人类共存的理想生态旅游目的地，并正在进行积极的管理以保护自然环境。这样，游客可以同时体验历史和自然，通过自行车和步行实现更加环保的旅游。另外，通过游览历史遗迹，可以更深入地了解旅游目的地的历史价值。 7月举办千万朵莲花盛宴的西洞莲花节，10月、11月举办各种作品装饰的菊花展，为宫南地增添了美丽。

서봉산은 정남면 문학리에서 시작하여 멀리 봉담면으로 이어지는 산으로 해발.en: Seobongsan Mountain starts from Munhak-ri, Jeongnam-myeon and continues all the way to Bongdam-myeon. At 249m above sea level, it is a relatively high mountain in Hwaseong City. There are two theories: one is that the name was given because the summit resembles a phoenix when viewed from a distance, and the other is that it was named because it was said that a phoenix once lived here. Seobongsan Forest Bathing begins at the Hwaseong Food Integrated Support Center. Parking is free and you can purchase fresh local produce after completing the hike. Seobongsan Mountain has a forest bathing area centered around the Seobongsan Mountain Trail, where you can enjoy three different courses, so you can heal while looking at the greenery. There is an exercise facility 200m away on the way to the top, and at the beginning of the forest path, wild cherry trees, oak trees, pine trees, and maple trees form a tree tunnel in each section. After the second exercise facility, there is a long and steep uphill climb. The floor was covered with palm mats to prevent hikers from slipping, and ropes were tied between trees to ensure the safety of hikers. There are benches where you can rest along the way, and there is an octagonal pavilion at the top of Seobongsan Mountain, 2 km from the starting point, so you can enjoy the cool scenery of low mountains surrounding Deokwoo Reservoir like a folding screen. Seobongsan Mountain Forest Bathing Area is a place full of green and refreshing feeling, as the forest is so good that some people even turn back on the forest path even if they do not climb to the top of the mountain.
서봉산은 정남면 문학리에서 시작하여 멀리 봉담면으로 이어지는 산으로 해발.zh: 西峰山从正南面文鹤里一直延伸到峰潭面。海拔249m，是华城市中相对较高的山峰。有两种说法：一是因为山顶远看形似凤凰而得名，二是因为相传曾有凤凰在此栖息而得名。西峰山森林浴从华城食品综合支援中心开始。停车免费，徒步结束后您可以购买新鲜的当地农产品。西峰山以西峰山登山道为中心设有森林浴场，可以享受三种不同的路线，一边欣赏绿色，一边疗愈身心。登顶途中200m处设有健身设施，林道起点处，各段野樱桃树、橡树、松树、枫树形成树木隧道。在第二个健身设施之后，有一段又长又陡的上坡路。地板上铺有棕榈垫，以防止徒步旅行者滑倒，树木之间系有绳索，以确保徒步旅行者的安全。沿途有可以休息的长凳，距离起点2公里的西峰山山顶有一座八角亭，可以像屏风一样欣赏德宇水库周围低山的清凉景色。西峰山森林浴场是一个充满绿色和清爽感的地方，因为森林非常好，有些人甚至不爬到山顶就折回林间小路。

서수원지식정보관으로 개관한 이래 2016년 8월 서수원도서관으로 명칭을.en: After opening as the Seosuwon Knowledge Information Center, the name was changed to Seosuwon Library in August 2016. This is a small, quiet and cozy library that is constantly visited by Seosuwon citizens. Seosuwon Library has a variety of books, including philosophy and religion, and operates a variety of children's library programs to serve as a space for activities with citizens. The biggest feature of this place is that it collects works that have won famous domestic and foreign literary awards, provides book information services, operates various programs linked to award-winning books, and promotes specialized materials. In addition to various cultural activities, this place also provides [my first library service in my life], which allows pregnant women and infants who have difficulty visiting the library in person to borrow books from the local library via courier at home. In the 21st century era of knowledge and information, Suwon City has taken the lead as the nation's leading city for lifelong learning and culture, and has established 3 children's libraries in each region, the West Suwon and Buk Suwon libraries, and 2 general libraries in each region so that all citizens can use libraries nearby, resulting in 8 libraries along with the existing Seongyeong, Jungang, and Yeongtong libraries. In order to increase the number of libraries and stay ahead of the curve in service quality, excellent books are donated by citizens (groups) and new ones are purchased. We are making sure that citizens do not lack in acquiring specialized knowledge, and we are also building a user-centered one-stop electronic library, including books, member information, and unmanned automation, to ensure that there is no inconvenience in use.
서수원지식정보관으로 개관한 이래 2016년 8월 서수원도서관으로 명칭을.zh: 作为瑞水原知识信息中心开放后，于2016年8月更名为瑞水原图书馆。这是一个小型、安静、舒适的图书馆，是瑞水原市民经常光顾的图书馆。瑞水院图书馆藏有哲学、宗教等各种书籍，并运营各种儿童图书馆项目，作为与市民一起活动的空间。这里的最大特色是收集国内外著名文学奖项的作品，提供图书信息服务，运营与获奖图书挂钩的各类节目，推广专业资料。除了各种文化活动外，这里还提供【人生第一次图书馆服务】，让那些有困难亲自去图书馆的孕妇和婴儿在家中通过快递从当地图书馆借书。在21世纪的知识和信息时代，水原市率先成为全国终身学习和文化的领先城市，在每个地区建立了3个儿童图书馆，即西水原图书馆和北水原图书馆，并在每个地区建立了2个综合图书馆，以便所有市民都可以就近使用图书馆，与现有的城庆、中央和灵通图书馆一起，形成了8个图书馆。为增加图书馆数量，保持服务质量领先，市民（团体）捐赠优秀图书，购买新书。我们确保公民不缺乏专业知识的获取，我们也在建设以用户为中心的一站式电子图书馆，包括图书、会员信息、无人自动化，确保使用上没有不便。

경기도와 충청남도의 경계 지역에 위치한 서운산은 경기도 안성시에서 남쪽으.en: Seounsan Mountain, located on the border between Gyeonggi-do and Chungcheongnam-do, is about 12km south of Anseong-si, Gyeonggi-do. At 547m above sea level, it is a small, gentle mountain with few rocks, making it ideal for a light hike with the family. In addition, there are many cultural historic sites such as Cheongnyongsa Temple and Seoknamsa Temple, so it is good for leisurely studying history, and there are even lakes around the mountain, so you can enjoy an elegant hike. If you climb from Cheongnyongsa Temple, follow the hiking trail on the left side of the temple for about 20 minutes, pass a private farm, and on the left, you will find Togulam Grotto, where Zen Master Naong prayed. After climbing through a dense forest for about 40 minutes, you will come to Jwaseongsa Temple, which overlooks the ridge of the Charyeong Mountain Range. Jwaseongsa Temple is a relatively recent prayer temple with a history of about 100 years. If you pass Yosachae above Jwaseongsa Temple and climb the path, you will come across Seounjeong Pavilion, which appears to be newly built. If you go up the trail again and climb the steep slope to the left at the fork in front of Toseong, you will come across Tanghyungdae, which is said to cleanse your heart. Tanghyungdae is considered one of the best observatories on Seounsan Mountain. From here, Anseong, Pyeongtaek, Seonghwan, and Cheonan can be seen. The feeling of turning back the way you came up and walking along the mountain path along the Saturn gives you a mysterious pleasure. After cooling off from the sweat at the summit, you can see the Eunjeokum and go down the dense forest path to meet the path you came up from Cheongnyongsa Temple again. Even if you look around and enjoy the mountain scenery here and there, two hours is a sufficient distance. If you turn off the path toward Cheongnyongsa Temple at the top and go down to the northeastern foot, you can go down to the front of the rock-carved Buddha statue of Seoknamsa Temple.
경기도와 충청남도의 경계 지역에 위치한 서운산은 경기도 안성시에서 남쪽으.zh: 瑞云山位于京畿道和忠清南道交界处，位于京畿道安城市以南约12公里处。海拔547m，山势小而平缓，岩石少，非常适合与家人一起轻松徒步。此外，还有清龙寺、石南寺等众多文化古迹，适合悠闲地学习历史，山的周围还有湖泊，可以享受优雅的徒步旅行。如果从清龙寺登山，沿着寺庙左侧的登山步道步行约20分钟，经过一个私人农场，左侧就是Naong禅师祈祷的土古兰石窟。穿过茂密的森林约40分钟后，就来到了佐城寺，这里可以俯瞰车岭山脉的山脊。佐城寺是一座相对较新的祈祷寺庙，已有约100年的历史。经过佐城寺上方的如舍斋，沿着小路向上走，就会看到新建的宣云亭。再次沿路向上走，在土城前面的岔路口爬上左边的陡坡，就能看到据说可以净化心灵的汤亨台。汤亨台被认为是瑞云山最好的天文台之一。从这里可以看到安城、平泽、城焕、天安。折返来时的路，沿着土星山路行走的感觉，给你一种神秘的快感。山顶汗流浃背后，可以看到银积庵，沿着茂密的林间小道，又与从清龙寺上来的小路相遇了。即使环顾四周，欣赏这里那里的山景，两个小时的距离也足够了。从山顶往清龙寺方向拐弯，往东北麓走下去，就能看到石南寺的石刻佛像正面。

서울 대교구 주교좌 명동대성당은 한국 가톨릭교회 공동체가 처음으로 탄생한.en: Myeongdong Cathedral, the cathedral of the Archdiocese of Seoul, is the place where the Korean Catholic Church community was first born and is the representative shrine of Korean Catholicism, housing the remains of martyred saints. It is located in Myeongdong 2-ga, Jung-gu, Seoul. It is the first large-scale Gothic Catholic cathedral built on the Korean Peninsula and the first parish church (cathedral where a priest resides and provides pastoral care) in Korea. It was designated as a historic site in Korea on November 22, 1977. It is a holy shrine where the remains of martyrs such as Bishop Imbert, Father Mimic, and Father Chastan are buried in the underground cathedral. On September 10, 1900, the remains of martyrs during the Byeongin Persecution, including Bishop Bernu, were placed in the cathedral's crypt from Yongsan Theological Seminary, but were later moved to their hometown. In 1926, the remains of the 79 martyrs from the Gihae Rebellion and Byeongo Rebellion were placed in the crypt, and then a beatified altar was installed in the left corridor of the cathedral and the 79th icon was placed there. During the war in 1950, the cathedral was occupied by the People's Army, and the remains of martyrs enshrined in the underground tomb were damaged. After the military regime era, it was recognized as the center of the struggle for democratization. In 1991, the decomposed remains were packaged, new corroded lead coffins were made, the remains were enshrined, sealed, placed in a sarcophagus, placed in a newly neatly renovated reality, and a stone tablet with an inscription written on it was completed. The entrance to the cemetery was remodeled with a glass door so that pilgrims could visit from time to time. Mass and confession times are held on weekdays and weekends. Even if you are not a believer, you can participate, and during Christmas, you can feel the reverent atmosphere among the colorful street decorations around you.
서울 대교구 주교좌 명동대성당은 한국 가톨릭교회 공동체가 처음으로 탄생한.zh: 明洞主教座堂是首尔总教区的主教座堂，是韩国天主教团体最早诞生的地方，也是韩国天主教的代表圣地，安放着殉难圣人的遗骸。它位于首尔中区明洞2街。它是朝鲜半岛上第一座大型哥特式天主教堂，也是韩国第一座教区教堂（神父居住和牧灵的大教堂）。 1977年11月22日被指定为韩国史迹。地下大教堂埋葬着英伯特主教、米米克神父、查斯坦神父等烈士的遗骸，是一座圣地。 1900年9月10日，包括贝尔努主教在内的丙仁迫害烈士的遗骸从龙山神学院被安放在大教堂的地下室，但后来被转移到他们的家乡。 1926年，机海叛乱和兵戈叛乱的79位烈士的遗骸被安置在墓穴中，然后在大教堂的左侧走廊上设置了一个宣福坛，并放置了第79个圣像。 1950年战争期间，大教堂被人民军占领，地下墓穴中供奉的烈士遗骸遭到破坏。军政权时代结束后，它被认为是民主化斗争的中心。 1991年，将腐烂的遗骸包装起来，制作了新的腐蚀铅棺，将遗骸安奉、密封，放入石棺中，放置在新修整整齐的现实中，一块刻有铭文的石碑就完成了。墓地入口改建为玻璃门，以便香客时常参观。弥撒和忏悔时间在工作日和周末举行。即使你不是信徒，也可以参加，圣诞节期间，你可以在周围色彩缤纷的街道装饰中感受到虔诚的气氛。

헌릉은 조선 3대 태종(재위 1400~1418)과 원경왕후 민씨(1365.en: Heonreung is the tomb of King Taejong (reign 1400-1418), the 3rd king of Joseon, and Queen Wongyeong (1365-1420). It is a twin tomb with burial mounds arranged side by side within a single tomb. When looking at the tomb from the front, the tomb of King Taejong is on the left (west) and the tomb of Queen Wongyeong is on the right (east). In 1420 (the 2nd year of King Sejong's reign), Queen Wongyeong passed away and a tomb was built at the current location. When constructing Queen Wongyeong's tomb, King Taejong created his own tomb site in advance. Two years later, in 1422 (the 4th year of King Sejong's reign), when King Taejong passed away, a tomb was built on the west side of Queen Wongyeong's tomb, and it took on its current appearance. The tomb mounds were all surrounded by folding screen stones and railing stones, and the zodiac signs, Yeongjeo (Geumgangjeo), and Yeongtak (Geumgangryeong) were engraved on the folding screen stones. Around the burial mound, Munseokin, Museokin, Seokma, Jeongjeongseok, Jangmyeongdeung, stone statue (Honyuseok), Mangjuseok, setting sun, and lagoon were placed. In particular, Munseokin, Museokin, Seokma, Seokyang, and Seokho were placed twice as often as in other royal tombs, following the Hyeon·Jeongneung (玄·正陵) system of King Gongmin and Princess Noguk of Goryeo. There are two shrines in the shrine below the royal tomb, one erected after the death of King Taejong and the other stele erected again in 1695 (the 21st year of King Sukjong's reign) after the original stele was damaged. Inreung is the tomb of Sunjo, the 23rd king of the Joseon Dynasty (reigned 1800-1834), and Empress Sunwon of the Kim clan (1789-1857). Inreung is a joint tomb in which the king and queen are enshrined together in one mound. When viewed from the front, Sunjo is on the left and Empress Sunwon is on the right, following the principle of right-top-left-bottom. When King Sunjo passed away in 1834 (the 34th year of King Sunjo’s reign), it was built near Jangneung (Injo’s) tomb in Gyoha, Paju, the following year. However, it was said to be inauspicious according to feng shui, so it was moved to its current location in 1856 (the 6th year of King Cheoljong's reign). The site of the relocated Inreung was originally the site of King Sejong's old royal tomb. While constructing Inlleung, the stone monuments from King Sejong's old royal tomb and the old Heireung stone monuments of King Jungjong's second queen, Queen Janggyeong, which had been buried in the surrounding land, were taken out, polished, and used. The stone objects that were reused were the Munseokin, the Museokin, the Seokma, the Jangmyeongdeung, the stone statue (Honyuseok), the Mangjuseok, the sunset, and the Seokho, and some of the Seokyang, Mangjuseok, and Seokma were newly manufactured. This is recorded in 『Inreung Cheonbongsanneung Dogam Uigwe』, which was compiled after moving Inreung. After moving the tomb, when Empress Sunwon passed away the following year, she was buried in the tomb. There are two monuments inside the monument below the tomb. The first monument is a monument erected during the Joseon Dynasty (King Sunjo, Queen Sunwon), and the second monument is a monument erected during the Korean Empire (Emperor Sunjo Suk, Empress Sunwonsuk).
헌릉은 조선 3대 태종(재위 1400~1418)과 원경왕후 민씨(1365.zh: 献陵是朝鲜第三代国王太宗（1400-1418 年在位）和元庆王后（1365-1420 年）的陵墓。这是一座双坟墓，坟包并排排列在一个坟墓内。从正面看，太宗王陵位于左侧（西），元庆王后陵位于右侧（东）。 1420年（世宗2年）元庆王后去世，在现址修建了陵墓。太宗大王在修建元庆王后陵墓时，预先修建了自己的陵墓。两年后，即1422年（世宗4年），太宗去世后，在元庆王后墓的西侧修建了一座坟墓，就成了现在的样子。坟包的周围均设有屏风石和栏杆石，屏风石上刻有十二生肖、金刚节、金刚陵。古坟周围有文西金、无西金、石马、正正石、长明灯、石像、望珠石、夕阳、泻湖等。特别是文西金、无西金、石马、石阳、石湖的墓葬数量是其他王陵的两倍，遵循高丽恭愍王和绿国公主的玄·正陵制度。王陵下方的祠堂内有两座神龛，一座是太宗死后立的，另一座是在原碑受损后于1695年（肃宗21年）再次立碑的。仁陵是朝鲜王朝第23代国王纯祖（1800-1834年在位）和金氏纯元皇后（1789-1857年）的陵墓。仁陵是一座合葬陵，国王和王后合葬于一座坟墓中。从正面看，纯祖在左边，纯皇后在右边，遵循右上左下的原则。 1834年（纯祖34年）纯祖去世后，次年在坡州交河长陵（仁祖）陵附近修建。但根据风水学认为不吉利，因此于1856年（哲宗6年）移至现址。仁陵迁址原址是世宗大王的旧王陵所在地。建造仁陵时，将世宗旧王陵的石碑和埋在周围土地上的中宗第二任王妃长庆王后的旧熙陵石碑取出、打磨并使用。被再利用的石器有文石金、无石金、石马、长明灯、石像、望柱石、夕照、石湖等，石阳、望柱石、石马的一部分是新制作的。这是在仁陵搬迁后编撰的《仁陵天峰山陵多岩仪轨》中记载的。迁坟后，次年淳元皇后去世，就葬于此陵。墓下碑内有两碑。第一个纪念碑是朝鲜王朝时期（纯祖、纯元王后）建立的纪念碑，第二个纪念碑是大韩帝国时期建立的纪念碑（纯祖淑​​皇帝、纯元淑皇后）。

한국 최초의 놀이공원이라는 타이틀을 가진 서울랜드는 개장과 동시에 대한민.en: Seoul Land, which has the title of Korea's first amusement park, established itself as Korea's representative theme park as soon as it opened. It is located about 30 minutes away from Seoul Station and Myeongdong Station, so transportation is convenient, and nearby are the zoological and botanical gardens of Seoul Grand Park, a forest bathing area, and the National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art, making it a widely loved tourist destination representing Korea. Seoul Land not only operates over 50 types of rides decorated with Korean animation characters, but also seasonal facilities such as water play facilities (summer) and sledding slopes (winter), and introduces new performances, festivals, and events to provide fresh enjoyment for each season. In addition to various attractions, there are also spaces where visitors can enjoy a variety of experiences, such as Korea's largest all-in-one play park 'Seoulland Kraken Island', dinosaur exhibition and experience center 'Jurassic Land', and light festival 'Luna Park', making it an all-round theme park that the whole family can enjoy. 'Seoul Land Kraken Island', which opened in April 2024, is an experiential attraction that boasts an overwhelming scale with the main structure being similar to the height of a 6-story apartment. Children can run, roll, and climb as much as they like, and can have a new adventure with different experiences by directly hitting it with their bodies. In particular, Seoul Land's Kraken Island is gaining popularity among children with its new concept 'amphibious' type play gym that adds water play functions such as water bombs, water screens, and floor fountains. ‘Jurassic Land’, where you can see moving dinosaurs up to 18 meters long, is also popular. More than 100 different types of dinosaurs, fossils, and eggs are on display, and beyond simple viewing, you can expect an educational effect that stimulates children's five senses through experiences such as excavating dinosaur fossils and matching bones. In addition, Seoul Land's representative performances include the children's musical 'Animal Kingdom', 'The Legend of Luna Light' with a spectacular fireworks show, and the character fairy tale play 'Fairy Tale Forest'. It is full of attractions, things to see, and things to do, so we recommend visiting with the whole family.
한국 최초의 놀이공원이라는 타이틀을 가진 서울랜드는 개장과 동시에 대한민.zh: 有着韩国第一游乐园称号的首尔乐园一开业就确立了韩国代表性主题公园的地位。距首尔站、明洞站约30分钟路程，交通便利，附近有首尔大公园动植物园、森林浴场、国立现代美术馆等，是深受人们喜爱的代表韩国的旅游胜地。首尔乐园不仅运营着50多种以韩国动漫人物装饰的游乐设施，还有水上乐园（夏季）和雪橇场（冬季）等季节性设施，并推出新的表演、节日和活动，为每个季节提供新鲜的享受。除了各种游乐设施外，还有韩国最大的一体式游乐公园“首尔海妖岛”、恐龙展示体验中心“侏罗纪世界”、灯光节“月神公园”等多种体验空间，是适合全家人一起游玩的全方位主题公园。 2024年4月开业的“Seoul Land Kraken Island”是一个体验性景点，其主体结构与6层公寓的高度相似，规模压倒性。孩子们可以随心所欲地奔跑、翻滚、攀爬，用身体直接撞击即可进行不同体验的新冒险。特别是首尔乐园的克拉肯岛，其新概念的“两栖”型游乐馆增加了水弹、水幕、地板喷泉等水上游乐功能，深受孩子们的欢迎。可以看到长达18米的移动恐龙的“侏罗纪世界”也很受欢迎。展示了100多种不同种类的恐龙、化石、恐龙蛋，除了简单的观赏之外，还可以通过挖掘恐龙化石、匹配骨骼等体验，激发孩子五种感官的教育效果。此外，首尔乐园的代表表演还包括儿童音乐剧《动物王国》、带有壮观烟花表演的《月光传说》以及人物童话剧《童话森林》。这里充满了景点、景点和活动，因此我们建议全家人一起游览。

서울숲은 1908년 설치된 서울 최초의 상수원 수원지였으며, 2005년에.en: Seoul Forest was the first water source in Seoul, established in 1908, and was newly opened in 2005 to turn the area around Ttukseom Sports Park into a large-scale urban forest. Currently, it consists of four unique spaces: Culture and Arts Park, Experiential Learning Center, Ecological Forest, and Wetland Ecological Garden, and provides a variety of cultural and leisure spaces adjacent to the Han River. In addition, Seoul Forest Park is the first park with citizen participation from creation to program operation.
서울숲은 1908년 설치된 서울 최초의 상수원 수원지였으며, 2005년에.zh: 首尔林是首尔的第一个水源地，于1908年建立，2005年新开放，将纛岛体育公园周边地区变成了大型城市森林。目前由文化艺术园、体验学习中心、生态森林、湿地生态园四大特色空间组成，毗邻汉江，提供多种文化休闲空间。此外，首尔森林公园是第一个从创建到项目运营都由公民参与的公园。

서해안의 수려한 자연경관과 어울릴 수 있는 전곡항, 제부도 바다 위 2..en: Jeongok Port, which matches the beautiful natural scenery of the west coast, and the location of Korea's longest maritime cable car, 2.12km above the sea on Jebudo Island, have been selected to create a new landmark where nature and people come together. Jebudo Island has a modern appearance and function that reflects the unique characteristics and beauty of the region, making it a tourist spot on the west coast and the metropolitan area. From the Seohaerang Cable Car, you can enjoy both the mud flat and the sea at the same time, and the best time to enjoy it is at sunset. Another special feature of the Seohaerang Cable Car is that you can view the mudflats from above. You can board the bus at either stop, and it is a west coast tourist destination where you can enjoy both Jebudo Island and Jeongok Port.
서해안의 수려한 자연경관과 어울릴 수 있는 전곡항, 제부도 바다 위 2..zh: 选择与西海岸美丽的自然风光相匹配的全谷港以及济扶岛海拔2.12公里的韩国最长海上缆车所在地，打造自然与人文融合的新地标。济扶岛具有现代化的外观和功能，体现了该地区独特的特色和美丽，使其成为西海岸和首都圈的旅游胜地。乘坐西海岸缆车，您可以同时欣赏泥滩和大海，最佳欣赏时间是日落时分。西河浪缆车的另一个​​特色是可以从上面看到泥滩。任一站均可搭乘巴士，是可以同时游览济扶岛和全谷港的西海岸旅游胜地。

남양주시 북한강변에 있는 서호미술관은 인사동의 갤러리 서호가 지방 문화의.en: Seoho Art Museum, located on the Bukhangang River in Namyangju, was established by Gallery Seoho in Insa-dong for the balanced development of local culture and opened in May 2001. We sponsor local artists, plan exhibitions and projects, and carry out various cultural education and experience programs for local residents. The first floor of the building has a 70 pyeong exhibition room, art shop, and art room. In addition, various cultural events will be held in an outdoor lawn space of about 500 pyeong. The educational program being conducted at the museum is an exhibition-linked program for local elementary school students, and includes classes that involve viewing works on display at the museum and engaging in practical expression activities, as well as special experience programs held during vacation periods. In addition, we are also operating a visiting art museum program for people who have difficulty visiting art museums, such as married immigrant women and the elderly. Seoho Museum of Art provides opportunities for rich cultural experiences by holding not only exhibitions but also cultural events such as concerts, various performances, and seminars. On the second floor, there is a restaurant called [The Seoho] operated by the museum. It is a place where you can spend leisure time looking at the Bukhangang River seen through the full-length windows, and enjoy the pleasure of both sights and food.
남양주시 북한강변에 있는 서호미술관은 인사동의 갤러리 서호가 지방 문화의.zh: 瑞湖美术馆位于南杨州北汉江河畔，是仁寺洞瑞湖画廊为了当地文化的均衡发展而设立的，于2001年5月开馆。我们赞助当地艺术家，策划展览和项目，并为当地居民开展各种文化教育和体验项目。大楼一楼设有70坪的展览室、美术商店、美术室。此外，还将在约500坪的室外草坪空间举办各种文化活动。博物馆正在开展的教育活动是针对当地小学生的展览联动活动，包括观看博物馆展出作品和进行实践表达活动的课程，以及假期期间举办的特别体验活动。此外，我们还针对已婚移民妇女和老年人等参观美术馆有困难的人运营美术馆参观计划。瑞湖美术馆不仅举办展览，还举办音乐会、各种演出、研讨会等文化活动，提供丰富的文化体验机会。二楼有一家博物馆经营的餐厅，名为【The Seoho】。透过落地窗眺望北汉江，享受美景与美食的双重乐趣，度过悠闲的时光。

2014년 개장한 10만 평 규모의 수목원이다. 자연 그대로의 숲을 모토.en: It is a 100,000 pyeong arboretum that opened in 2014. It is a beautiful space where the landscaping, which is based on the motto of a pristine forest but does not harm the natural feel, feels delicate. Depending on the species of trees, the inside of the forest consists of a pine forest, a secret forest, a maple forest, a metasequoia forest, a ginkgo forest, a dogwood forest, a birch forest, and an azalea forest. The forest bathing walking course is divided into Course A, which is 1 hour long, and Course B, which is 30 minutes long, depending on the length.
2014년 개장한 10만 평 규모의 수목원이다. 자연 그대로의 숲을 모토.zh: 2014年开园的占地10万坪的植物园。以原始森林为主题，但又不损害自然感的景观，是一个精致而美丽的空间。林内根据树种不同，分为松林、秘林、枫林、水杉林、银杏林、山茱萸林、桦林、杜鹃林等。森林浴徒步路线根据长度的不同，分为A路线（1小时）和B路线（30分钟）。

석룡산 정상에 꾸불꾸불하게 용처럼 생긴 바위가 있어 석룡산이라 부르게 된.en: Seokryongsan Mountain, which came to be called Seokryongsan Mountain because there is a curved, dragon-shaped rock at the top, is a mountain that straddles Sanae-myeon, Hwacheon-gun, Gangwon-do and Buk-myeon, Gapyeong-gun, Gyeonggi-do. Seokryongsan Mountain, where waterfalls, walls, and cows are connected, has relatively gentle hiking trails compared to its majestic mountain scenery, but there are some steep points along the way. This forested area is a great place to walk while listening to the sound of clear water flowing in the Jomurak Valley. There are benches here and there where you can sit and rest, making it a great place to take a break in the forest. Also, there are a lot of wild flowers along the road, so it will be fun to hike up and see them. A total of 534 types of vascular plants growing in the Seokryongsan Mountain area are known to be distributed. Among them, a total of 16 types of Korean endemic plants were investigated, including sedge, cypress, cypress, and widower's windflower, and a total of 15 types of rare and endangered plants, including widower's windflower, Gaejokdori, and white peony, were observed. The hiking trail is gentle compared to the mountain terrain, making it good for hiking, but the temperature difference is relatively severe and more than 50% of precipitation is concentrated between July and September, so caution must be taken when hiking in the summer. Because there are a lot of rocks, it is better to take at least twice as much hiking time as walking on the mountain path. From the summit, you can see Baekun Mountain and Sachang-ri at a glance, as well as Hwaak Mountain, Myeongji Mountain, Gukmangbong Peak, Daeseong Mountain near the ceasefire line, and Baekam Mountain. The starting point of the hike is from Yongsumuk Jomurakgol.
석룡산 정상에 꾸불꾸불하게 용처럼 생긴 바위가 있어 석룡산이라 부르게 된.zh: 石龙山是一座横跨江原道华川郡早爱面和京畿道加平郡北面的山峰，因顶部有弯曲的龙形岩石而被称为石龙山。瀑布、墙壁和牛相连的石龙山，与雄伟的山景相比，徒步路线相对平缓，但沿途也有一些陡峭的地方。这片森林地区是散步的好地方，同时聆听乔穆拉克山谷清澈的水流声。到处都有长凳可以坐下来休息，是森林里休息的好地方。另外，路边还有很多野花，徒步上去看看也很有趣。石龙山地区已知分布有534种维管束植物。其中，共调查了莎草、柏树、桧木、鳏鳏金花等韩国特有植物16种，观察了鳏金银花、开足通、白牡丹等15种珍稀濒危植物。登山步道相对山地地势平缓，非常适合徒步，但温差较大，50%以上的降水集中在7月至9月之间，夏季徒步需谨慎。因为岩石较多，徒步的时间最好比走山路的时间至少多一倍。从山顶可以一览白云山、舍仓里、华岳山、明知山、国望峰、停火线附近的大城山、白岩山等。徒步旅行的起点是Yongsumuk Jomurakgol。

양평과 홍천군의 경계 지점인 단월면에는 봉미산에서 시작되어 홍천강으로 흘.en: In Danwol-myeon, the border point between Yangpyeong and Hongcheon-gun, the Seoksan Valley, formed by the water stream that starts from Bongmisan Mountain and flows into Hongcheon River, swirls around Sorisan Mountain, continues next to the road. The valleys are deep and the forest is thick, so the sky is not visible, and the scenery is completely different from the tributaries of the Namhan River in Yangpyeong, so even in the middle of summer, a cool breeze flows through it. As you can see from the name Seoksan-ri due to its abundance of rocks, it is a clean area where fireflies can be found in abundance in the summer. As can be seen from the name Seoksan-ri, it boasts an unspoiled scenery and beauty along with Mt. Sorisan, and presents a superb view of strangely shaped cliffs and pine trees. The water is clear and smooth, and it is not deep, so it is safe to play in the water. The forest is thick and provides shade. The length of the valley is quite long, the amount of water is abundant, and there are many places to rest around the valley, making it a great place for a family resort or summer resort. Also, at the entrance of Yongmunsan Mountain, turn right at Deokchon Intersection and the road leading to Deoksu Intersection - Local Road 328 - Biseulgogae - Saneum Bridge - Yongsu Valley is a fantastic driving course. The evening water that comes out of the mud near the valley is famous for its delicious taste, and there are several pensions there. There is a paved road to the right of the three-way intersection in Saenggol Village from the closed Saneum Branch School. From the village where the paved road ends, take the road to the right and climb 300 meters, passing through a fir forest, you will reach a forest road. If you go about 150m along the forest road, there is a sign on the right informing you of the Bongmisan Mountain hiking trail.
양평과 홍천군의 경계 지점인 단월면에는 봉미산에서 시작되어 홍천강으로 흘.zh: 在杨平与洪川郡交界处的檀月面，从凤美山流淌而出的水流流入洪川，绕着牛里山旋转，形成石山溪谷，一直延续到公路旁。这里山谷深密，森林茂密，所以看不到天空，景色与杨平的南汉江支流完全不同，所以即使在盛夏，也有凉爽的微风从中流过。从石山里这个名字就可以看出，石山里的岩石很多，这里是一个干净的地方，夏天可以看到很多萤火虫。从石山里这个名字就可以看出，它与索里山一起拥有未受破坏的风景和美丽，并呈现出奇形怪状的悬崖和松树的绝佳景色。水清且平，水不深，玩水很安全。森林茂密，提供荫凉。山谷长度相当长，水量充沛，山谷周围休息的地方很多，是家庭度假或避暑的好去处。另外，在龙门山入口处，在德村十字路口右转，通往德水十字路口的道路 - 328号地方道路 - 碧瑟高盖 - 新音大桥 - 龙水溪谷也是一条绝佳的驾车路线。山谷附近的泥里流出来的晚水以其味道鲜美而闻名，那里有几处膳宿。从关闭的 Saneum 分校到 Saenggol 村的三岔路口右侧有一条铺好的道路。从铺路尽头的村子向右走，爬300米，穿过一片杉树林，就到了林间公路。沿着林道走约150m，右侧就会有一个指示牌，告知您凤尾山登山路线。

석수체육공원은 안양시 만안구에 위치한 생활체육 중심 공원으로, 주민들이.en: Seoksu Sports Park is a daily sports-centered park located in Manan-gu, Anyang-si, and was created so that residents can enjoy exercise and relaxation in their daily lives. There are various sports facilities, including soccer fields, baseball fields, basketball courts, and badminton courts, as well as walking trails and rest facilities, so the whole family can use them comfortably. Family visitors and local club gatherings are active, and it is especially crowded with citizens enjoying soccer and baseball on weekends.
석수체육공원은 안양시 만안구에 위치한 생활체육 중심 공원으로, 주민들이.zh: 石水体育公园是位于安阳市马安区的一个以日常体育为中心的公园，是为了让居民在日常生活中享受运动和放松而创建的。体育设施齐全，包括足球场、棒球场、篮球场、羽毛球场以及步行道和休息设施，全家人都可以舒适地使用。家庭游客和当地俱乐部聚会很活跃，周末踢足球和棒球的市民尤其拥挤。

서울과 경기도를 잇는 과천의 수려하고 쾌적한 환경 속에 자리 잡은 선바위.en: Seonbawi Art Museum, located in the beautiful and pleasant environment of Gwacheon, connecting Seoul and Gyeonggi-do, is a genre art museum established in 2004 by genre painter Lee Seo-ji with the purpose of reviving, recording, and preserving disappearing traditional customs and disseminating them to future generations. On a site of about 780 pyeong and an exhibition area of ​​22 pyeong, it houses and displays about 1,000 genre paintings by the late Lee Seo-ji, who painted the lifestyles, customs, and natural scenery of our ancient ancestors throughout his life, as well as traditional dolls and miniature village models by Kim Si-on, a traditional doll artist who created humorous images of our ancient ancestors.
서울과 경기도를 잇는 과천의 수려하고 쾌적한 환경 속에 자리 잡은 선바위.zh: 仙岩美术馆坐落在连接首尔和京畿道的果川市，环境优美宜人，是风俗画家李瑞智于2004年建立的风俗美术馆，其目的是复兴、记录、保存正在消失的传统习俗，并将其传播给后代。在约780坪的场地和22坪的展示区中，收藏并展示了已故李瑞智的风俗画约1,000幅，他描绘了我们古代祖先一生的生活方式、风俗和自然风景，以及传统人偶艺术家金时温创作的传统人偶和微型村庄模型，他创造了我们古代祖先的幽默形象。

조계산 기슭 동쪽에 자리 잡은 선암사는 백제 성왕 7년(529년)에 아도.en: Seonamsa Temple, located on the east side of the foot of Jogyesan Mountain, built Biroam in the 7th year of King Seong of Baekje (529), and in the 1st year of King Gyeongmun of Silla, State Preceptor Doseon founded the current Seonamsa Temple with Seonpung at Dongri Sanmun, one of the 9 mountains of King Seonjong. On the other side, on the western side of the mountain, is the famous Seungbo Temple, Songgwangsa Temple. Around Seonamsa Temple, there are oak trees, camellias, maples, and chestnut trees that are hundreds of years old, and the fall foliage is especially famous. In addition, there is an arch-shaped Seungseong Bridge in front of the temple (treasure). The pedestal is made of natural rock, so it is sturdy, and the dragon head in the center is very mysterious. The three-story stone pagodas (treasures) standing on the left and right in front of the main hall also attract the attention of tourists. It is one of the temples where the most traditional temple culture remains. In addition to the 7 treasures, there are 12 local cultural assets, including the majestic and splendid Daeungjeon, Palsangjeon, Wontongjeon, gilt-bronze incense burner, and Iljumun. If you climb the hiking trail on the left side of the main temple of Seonamsa Temple, you can see the rock-carved Buddha carved on a huge rock that is 7m high and 2m wide. A native tea garden with 800 years of tradition, the Jogyesan Mountain hiking trail connecting Songgwangsa Temple to Seonamsa Temple, crystal-like valley water, lush trees, and fall foliage add to the beauty of this place. In addition, near Seonamsa Temple, like Jirisan Mountain and Baekunsan Mountain, Korean cypress trees grow naturally, so you can taste the mineral water around Gyeongchip every year. Seonamsa Chiljeon Seonwon is a Zen meditation place at Seonamsa Temple, a temple located on the eastern foot of Jogyesan Mountain, Songju-eup, Suncheon-si, Jeollanam-do. As Taegochonglim, the only general forest of the Taego Order, it is a general monastery where numerous monks are practicing in Gangwon and Seonwon. ‘Chiljeon’ is a group of seven buildings located at the top of Seonamsa Temple. In the wild tea field behind Seonamsa Temple, there is a colony of native tea that is over 800 years old. When it comes to wild tea produced from tea farms, Hwagae tea is considered the best, but when it comes to purely natural wild tea, Seonamsa tea is considered the best. The characteristics of Seonamsa wild tea are described as ‘savory and deep taste.’ This is because the tea trees grow in shaded areas thick with cedar and oak trees, so the tea leaves are soft, and the fog and humid climate create a deep taste. However, it is not easy to taste Seonamsa tea. The Seonamsa tea field is not large, so the yield is small and it is treated as a precious treat.
조계산 기슭 동쪽에 자리 잡은 선암사는 백제 성왕 7년(529년)에 아도.zh: 仙岩寺位于曹溪山麓东侧，于百济成王7年（529年）修建毗罗庵，新罗庆文王1年，道宣国师在宣宗九山之一的东里山门与宣风共同创建了现在的仙岩寺。另一边，山的西侧，是著名的胜宝寺——松光寺。仙岩寺周围有数百年树龄的橡树、山茶花、枫树、板栗树，其中秋天的红叶尤其有名。另外，寺前有一座拱形的升城桥（宝物）。基座由天然岩石制成，因此坚固，中央的龙头显得十分神秘。大雄宝殿前左右矗立的三层石塔（宝物）也吸引着游客的目光。是保留最传统寺庙文化的寺庙之一。除7件宝物外，还有雄伟壮丽的大雄殿、八相殿、圆通殿、鎏金香炉、一柱门等12处地方文化遗产。沿着仙岩寺主殿左侧的登山步道攀登，可以看到高7m、宽2m的巨石上雕刻的石刻佛像。拥有800年传统的本土茶园、连接松光寺和仙岩寺的曹溪山登山步道、晶莹剔透的谷水、茂盛的树木和秋天的红叶为这里增添了美丽。另外，仙岩寺附近的智异山、白云山等处自然生长着红柏树，每年都可以品尝到庆济周边的矿泉水。仙岩寺七殿禅院是位于全罗南道顺天市松州邑曹溪山东麓仙岩寺的禅修场所。太古宗林是太古宗唯一的总林，是江原道和宣原地区众多僧人修行的总寺院。 “七殿”是位于仙岩寺顶部的七座建筑群。在仙岩寺后面的野生茶园里，有一个已有800多年历史的原生茶群。说到茶园生产的野生茶，华盖茶被认为是最好的，但说到纯天然野生茶，仙岩茶被认为是最好的。仙岩寺野生茶的特点被描述为“味道鲜美、味道浓郁”。这是因为茶树生长在雪松和橡树茂密的阴凉地区，因此茶叶柔软，加上雾气和潮湿的气候，营造出浓郁的味道。然而，品尝仙岩茶并不容易。仙岩寺茶田面积不大，产量较少，被视为珍贵茶品。

포천 8경 중 5경으로 이동면 도평리 백운동 계곡에 자리하고 있다. 이름.en: It is located in the Baekun-dong Valley in Dopyeong-ri, Idong-myeon, and is one of the 8 scenic spots in Pocheon. As the name suggests, it is said to be a place where immortals used to play, so it is called Seonyudam. The upper stream of Yeongpyeong Stream, which circles the foot of Baekun Mountain, is blue and very beautiful. The shadow of the steep rock wall submerged in water is nice, and the light reflecting off the rock wall is also beautiful. Three letters called Seonyudam are engraved on the rock wall, which are said to have been written by Yang Sa-eon during the Japanese invasions of Korea. Seonyudam Valley is over 10km long, and the water in the valley is clear and fresh in spring and fall. In particular, the valley that descends from west to east is backed by cliffs and dense forests, so the sun does not shine on the valley water throughout the day, making it even cooler. There are about 10 households residing in the upper valley, and there are both bed and breakfasts and restaurants, so eating is not a big inconvenience. Also, if you go briefly to Baekun Valley, you will find the famous Idong Galbi. Cooking is prohibited in Seonyudam Valley, and although there is a free parking lot opposite the Riverside Pension, it is full even on weekdays and you have to be very early to park on weekends. There are free tents and tables set up by Pocheon City, so you can grab an empty shaded spot. The water depth is shallow and the current is not fast, so it's perfect for playing in the water by bringing a tube and goggles.
포천 8경 중 5경으로 이동면 도평리 백운동 계곡에 자리하고 있다. 이름.zh: 位于二洞面都平里白云洞溪谷，是抱川八景之一。顾名思义，据说这里是以前神仙嬉戏的地方，所以被称为仙游潭。永平溪上游环绕白云山麓，水色碧蓝，非常美丽。陡峭的岩壁浸在水中的影子很好看，岩壁反射的光也很美。岩壁上刻有“仙游潭”三个字，据说是日本侵朝时期梁世彦所写。仙游潭溪谷全长10多公里，泉水春秋两季清澈见底。尤其是自西向东下降的山谷，背靠悬崖峭壁，森林茂密，所以阳光全天照射不到谷水中，显得更加凉爽。上山谷大约有10户人家居住，既有民宿，也有餐馆，吃饭并没有太大的不便。另外，如果你短暂前往白云溪谷，你会发现著名的二东排骨。仙游潭溪谷禁止做饭，虽然Riverside Pension对面有免费停车场，但即使是工作日也停满了，周末必须很早停车。抱川市设有免费的帐篷和桌子，因此您可以抢占空旷的阴凉处。水深浅，水流也不急，带上管子和护目镜就很适合玩水了。

본래 군산도라 불렸으나 섬의 북단 해발 100여 미터의 봉 정상의 형태가.en: It was originally called Gunsando, but it came to be called Seonyudo because the shape of the peak, which is about 100 meters above sea level at the northern end of the island, looks like two immortals sitting face to face and playing baduk. Seonyudo, which has an area of ​​2.13km and a population of over 500, forms the Gogunsan Archipelago along with Sinsido, Munyeodo, Bangchukdo, and Maldo, and is the central island of the archipelago. Seonyudo is the center of the Gogunsan Archipelago and is an important strategic point in the West Sea. Seonyudo, which served as the headquarters of the naval forces during the Joseon Dynasty and served as a base, was also controlled by a naval commander. During the Goryeo Dynasty, it was not only a port of call on the Yeo-Song trade route, but it was also a maritime hub as an anchorage base for ships during the Japanese invasions of Korea, with Admiral Yi Sun-sin staying at Seonyudo for 11 days to reorganize his battle lines after his victory in the Battle of Myeongnyang. There is a famous spot called the Eight Scenic Views of the Gogunsan Archipelago, and the center of the eight scenic spots of Gogunsan Mountain is Jinmal of Seonyudo. The Lee and Kim clans dominate Seonyudo, with the Park, Lim, and Go clans also living there. As a folk religion, there were the Oryongmyoje, Jangsaengje, Susuje, and Burakje, but the traditions have been cut off, and relics include a shell mound and a group of monuments depicting a naval ancestor. It is connected to Jangjado Island in the southwest by Jangja Bridge, so it can be easily accessed. (Source: Gunsan City Culture and Tourism)
본래 군산도라 불렸으나 섬의 북단 해발 100여 미터의 봉 정상의 형태가.zh: 原名群山岛，后因岛北端海拔约100米的山峰形状酷似两位仙人面对面坐着玩围棋而得名仙游岛。仙游岛面积2.13平方公里，人口超过500人，与新西岛、文如岛、芳竹岛、马尔岛一起构成古群山群岛，是该群岛的中心岛。仙游岛是古群山群岛的中心，是西海的战略要地。仙游岛是朝鲜王朝时期海军总部和基地的所在地，也由海军司令官控制。高丽时期，这里不仅是丽宋贸易路线上的停靠港，而且是日本侵朝时期作为船只停泊基地的海上枢纽，明梁海战胜利后，李舜臣将军曾在仙游岛停留11天，重新整理战线。古群山群岛有一个著名的景点，叫做古群山八景，而古群山八景的中心就是仙游岛的金末。李氏家族和金氏家族统治着仙游岛，朴氏家族、林氏家族和高氏家族也居住在那里。作为民间宗教，有五龙庙、长生祭、水寿祭、不拉祭等，但这些传统已被切断，遗迹包括贝冢和一组描绘海军祖先的纪念碑。西南有长子桥与长子岛相连，交通便利。 （来源：群山市文化观光）

설매재자연휴양림은 서울에서 1시간 이내 도착할 수 있는 수도권 휴양림이다.en: Seolmaejae Natural Recreation Forest is a recreation forest in the metropolitan area that can be reached within one hour from Seoul. This natural recreation forest opened on June 1, 1999 and has a total area of ​​70ha. Seolmaejae refers to the hill at the entrance to the main gate of the recreation forest. It is said that it was called Seolmaejae because plum blossoms bloomed in the snow on a winter day when there was a lot of snow in the past. The pine and larch forested areas, gorosoe, maple colonies, azalea, and pine hiking trails lead to Yumyeongsan Mountain and Yongmunsan Mountain, and the Yongcheon Valley and Yumyeongsan Valley are adjacent, making the scenery very impressive. The recreation forest has lodging facilities, a campsite, a playground, a badminton court, a foot volleyball court, and a sky water table, as well as auxiliary facilities such as a large auditorium, an event hall, and a lounge. Experience programs include valley trekking and woodworking experiences. It is suitable for group picnics, outdoor training, etc., and is adjacent to a survival game center, a paragliding slope at Yumyeongsan Mountain, and a paragliding practice range for beginners, making it great for enjoying outdoor leisure sports. In addition, Yongcheon Valley and Yumyeongsan Valley are close by, making it a suitable resort area. When using public transportation, get off at Yangpyeong Station on the Gyeongui-Jungan Line and take a city bus to Yongcheon-ri. It is a 20-minute ride.
설매재자연휴양림은 서울에서 1시간 이내 도착할 수 있는 수도권 휴양림이다.zh: 雪梅斋自然休养林是距离首尔一小时车程的首都圈休养林。这片自然休闲林于1999年6月1日开放，总面积70公顷。雪梅斋是指休养林正门入口处的山丘。据说，过去大雪纷飞的冬天，梅花在雪中绽放，因此被称为“雪梅斋”。松树、落叶松林区、戈罗苏、枫树丛、杜鹃花、松树登山步道通向有明山和龙门山，龙川溪谷和有明山溪谷毗邻，风景十分优美。休闲林内设有住宿设施、露营地、游乐场、羽毛球场、足排球场、空中地下水台，以及大礼堂、活动厅、休息室等辅助设施。体验项目包括山谷徒步和木工体验。适合团体野餐、户外训练等，毗邻生存游戏中心、有明山滑翔伞坡道、滑翔伞初学者练习场，非常适合享受户外休闲运动。此外，龙川溪谷和有明山溪谷也近在咫尺，是适合度假的地区。乘坐公共交通时，可在京义中央线杨平站下车，乘坐市内巴士至龙川里。车程 20 分钟。

설미재미술관은 천혜의 자연향기가 가득한 문화 예술 공간이다. 가평지역사회.en: Seolmijae Art Museum is a cultural and artistic space filled with the scent of nature. It is responsible for one axis of Korean contemporary art by planning cultural education and artist invitation exhibitions and exchange exhibitions for the Gapyeong community. In order to develop Gapyeong region culture, it holds special exhibitions by inviting artists from Gapyeong through an annual contest. It all started when Director Chugyeong opened a studio in Seorak-myeon, Gapyeong-gun after living in Seoul in 2007. It was established to not only cultivate the cultural knowledge of Gapyeong-gun residents, but also to nurture young artists and provide creative art education to students in Gapyeong area. The exhibition room on the first floor of the Seolmijae Museum of Art is 35 pyeong, and special exhibitions are mainly held there. Seminars are mainly held at the Art Institute, and through three creative studios, new artists are fostered and a community is formed and revitalized. In addition, it is equipped with an outdoor experiential learning room to provide experiential education programs to students in Gapyeong. In addition, we are making efforts to develop art through exhibitions, projects, and art education.
설미재미술관은 천혜의 자연향기가 가득한 문화 예술 공간이다. 가평지역사회.zh: 雪美斋美术馆是一个充满自然气息的文化艺术空间。它通过为加平社区策划文化教育和艺术家邀请展览和交流展览，负责韩国当代艺术的一轴。为了发展加平地区文化，每年通过竞赛邀请加平艺术家举办特别展览。这一切都始于2007年，秋庆导演在首尔生活后，在加平郡雪岳面开设了工作室。该工作室的成立不仅是为了培养加平郡居民的文化知识，也是为了培养年轻艺术家，为加平地区的学生提供创意艺术教育。雪美斋美术馆一楼的展览室面积为35坪，主要举办特别展览。研讨会主要在艺术学院举行，通过三个创意工作室培养新艺术家，形成和振兴社区。此外，还配备了户外体验式学习室，为加平的学生提供体验式教育项目。此外，我们还致力于通过展览、项目和艺术教育来发展艺术。

설봉산은 높이 약 394m로 이천시를 수호하는 진산이다. 이천 시가지를.en: Seolbongsan Mountain is about 394m high and is a mountain that protects Icheon City. Seolbongsan Mountain, which surrounds the city of Icheon from the west, is also called Buaksan Mountain, Muhaksan Mountain, and Buhaksan Mountain. Seolbongsan Mountain has a total of five hiking trails, with both Deulmeori and Nalmeori being the parking lot of Seolbong Park. Course 3 is a course that goes through park entrance → Hoam Mineral Water → Seolbongsanseong Fortress → Summit → Hwadujae → Haksojeong. It is considered a representative hiking course that allows you to see cultural relics such as Seolbongsanseong Fortress, a castle from the Silla Dynasty, Yeongwolam Hermitage and Seolbong Seowon built during the Goryeo Dynasty, and various rock peaks including Kalbawi on the way to the summit, Three Brothers Rock, Hoam Valley, and Hoam Mineral Springs. The course is 6.85km in total and takes about 120 minutes. Although it is a bit long, it is an easy course that even beginners and children can climb. In particular, Seolbongsan Mountain is widely known for its azalea colonies that bloom in abundance in spring, and many tourists flock there. After hiking, you can tour the museums and art galleries in Seolbong Park, Seolbong Sculpture Park, etc., or relieve fatigue by taking a hot spring bath at the nearby Anheung Recreation Area in the city. There is a Icheon Tourist Information Center near the first parking lot near Seolbong Reservoir, where you can get tourist information if necessary. In addition to Seolbong Park Parking Lot 1, which is the main parking lot, there are separate parking lots at all museums, art galleries, and other facilities in the park, so you can use the parking lot located nearby for each course. It takes about 8 minutes by car from Sindun IC, and about 10 minutes by car from Icheon Station on the Gyeonggang Line and Icheon General Terminal. Nearby are Sagimaggol Ceramic Village, Yes Park, Icheon Seolbong Hot Springs Land, Miranda Hotel Spa Plus, Seongho Lake Lotus Complex, Hantaek Botanical Garden, Jisan Forest Resort Ski Resort, Icheon Termeden, and Deokpyeong Dinosaur Arboretum.
설봉산은 높이 약 394m로 이천시를 수호하는 진산이다. 이천 시가지를.zh: 雪峰山高约394m，是保护利川市的山。雪峰山从西边环绕利川市，也被称为不鹤山、无鹤山、不鹤山。雪峰山共有5条登山步道，其中Deulmeori和Nalmeori都是雪峰公园的停车场。第3路线是公园入口→湖岩矿泉水→雪峰山城→山顶→花头斋→鹤沼亭的路线。这条路线可以观赏到新罗时期的雪峰山城、高丽时期建造的灵月庵、雪峰书院等文物古迹，以及登山途中的甲骨、三兄弟岩、虎岩溪谷、虎岩矿泉等各种岩峰，是具有代表性的徒步路线。赛道总长6.85公里，耗时约120分钟。虽然有点长，但是初学者和小孩也能轻松攀登。尤其是雪峰山，春天盛开的杜鹃花群而闻名，吸引了众多游客。徒步结束后，您可以游览雪峰公园、雪峰雕刻公园等博物馆和美术馆，也可以在市内附近的安兴游憩区泡温泉缓解疲劳。雪峰水库附近第一个停车场附近有一个利川旅游信息中心，必要时可以在那里获取旅游信息。除了作为主要停车场的雪峰公园第1停车场外，园内所有的博物馆、美术馆等设施均设有独立的停车场，因此您可以使用每个路线附近的停车场。距离新屯IC约8分钟车程，距离京江线利川站、利川综合客运站约10分钟车程。附近有沙吉玛谷陶瓷村、Yes Park、利川雪峰温泉乐园、Miranda Hotel Spa Plus、星湖湖莲花园区、汉泽植物园、芝山森林度假村滑雪场、利川浴场和德坪恐龙植物园。

설악산의 비경을 편하게 감상하는 최적의 방법은 설악 케이블카를 이용하는.en: The best way to comfortably enjoy the secret scenery of Seorak Mountain is to use the Seorak Cable Car. The cable car station is located in Seoraksan National Park, and it takes about 10 minutes to reach Gwongeumseong Fortress, which is 700 meters above sea level. Since one-way tickets are not available, you must purchase a round-trip ticket. Even while traveling by cable car, you can admire famous attractions such as Ulsan Rock and Manmulsang through the glass window. When you reach Gwongeumseong Fortress, the majestic scenery of Seoraksan Mountain unfolds like a panorama. There is a legend that Gwongeumseong Fortress, built during the Goryeo Dynasty to prevent enemy invasions, was built by two generals from the Gwon and Kim clans in one day. Now only the foundation remains, reminding us of past history. Seoraksan Mountain, seen from the top of Gwongeumseong Fortress, is majestic and mysterious with various strangely shaped rocks. If you stand at the top, you can capture the entire scenery of Oeseorak. Just below Gwongeumseong Fortress, Anakam Rock, built during the Silla Dynasty, and the Muhak Pine Tree, which has survived for hundreds of years, cannot help but excite one's admiration. There are many tourists on weekends, public holidays, and fall foliage season, so it is best to plan your trip taking the waiting time into account.
설악산의 비경을 편하게 감상하는 최적의 방법은 설악 케이블카를 이용하는.zh: 舒适地欣赏雪岳山秘境风景的最佳方式就是乘坐雪岳缆车。缆车站位于雪岳山国立公园内，大约需要10分钟即可到达海拔700米的权金城。由于没有单程票，您必须购买往返票。即使乘坐缆车旅行，也可以透过玻璃窗欣赏蔚山岩、万物象等著名景点。到达权金城时，雪岳山的壮丽景色尽收眼底。传说权金城是高丽时期为了防御外敌入侵而修建的，是由权氏、金氏两位将军一天建成的。现在只剩下地基了，提醒着我们过去的历史。从权金城山顶望去，雪岳山雄伟而神秘，岩石奇形怪状。如果站在山顶，可以看到外雪岳的全貌。权金城的正下方，新罗时期修建的阿纳岩和已经存活了数百年的无鹤松，不禁让人赞叹不已。周末、节假日、红叶季节游客较多，最好考虑等待时间来计划行程。
