양양 설악해변은 물놀이와 서핑을 즐길 수 있는 곳으로, 여름휴가를 보내기.en: Yangyang Seorak Beach is a place where you can enjoy water play and surfing, making it a great place to spend your summer vacation. Seorak Beach, located 8km north of Yangyang-eup, has shallow, quiet waters and is located on a road where you can tour Mt. Seorak, Naksansa Temple, and Osaek Mineral Water, making it an optimal travel destination for families. The white sand beach is 1km long and 80m wide and has a gentle slope, making it suitable for children to play. There are many tourist resources nearby, including Naksansa Temple, a thousand-year-old temple, Uisangdae Pavilion, Hongnyeonam Hermitage, and the Seawater Avalokitesvara Statue, making it a place where you can enjoy both summer vacation and sightseeing. The waves are high, making it great for swimming and surfing, and there is also a space where you can relax with an umbrella and a mat. It is a small beach that is not widely known among the beaches on the East Sea, so it is popular with tourists looking for a quiet and secluded beach. Naksan Beach is located to the south, and Mulchi Port and Hujin Port are located to the north, making it a good place to enjoy fresh seafood.
양양 설악해변은 물놀이와 서핑을 즐길 수 있는 곳으로, 여름휴가를 보내기.zh: 襄阳雪岳海水浴场可以戏水、冲浪，是暑假的好去处。雪岳海水浴场位于襄阳邑以北8公里处，海水浅而安静，位于可游览雪岳山、洛山寺、五色矿泉水的道路上，是家庭旅游的最佳目的地。白沙滩长1公里，宽80米，坡度平缓，适合儿童玩耍。附近有千年古刹洛山寺、义祥台、弘莲庵、海水观音像等旅游资源，是避暑观光的好去处。海浪很高，非常适合游泳和冲浪，还有一个可以用雨伞和垫子放松的空间。这是一个在东海海滩中并不广为人知的小海滩，因此很受寻找安静僻静海滩的游客的欢迎。南边有洛山海水浴场，北边有墨池港和湖津港，是享用新鲜海鲜的好地方。

양양국제공항 뒤편에 자리한 럭셔리 복합 리조트다. 설악권에서의 휴식과 힐.en: It is a luxury integrated resort located behind Yangyang International Airport. It is a resort that presents a vision of relaxation and healing in the Seorak region, and you can enjoy a golf course, luxury accommodations, hot spring sauna, and auxiliary facilities. Seolhaewon means ‘a garden of rest embracing Seorak Mountain and the East Sea.’ As befits its name, Yangyang Dongho Beach is located to the east of the accommodation, and the foot of Seoraksan Mountain is located to the west. The resort is centered around Seolhaewon, which was selected as one of the top 10 golf courses in Korea, and has various types of rooms, including mountain stays, Seol Hot Springs, and golftels. All rooms have a view of the golf course, and depending on the room location, you can see the natural scenery of Seoraksan Mountain and the East Sea. Mountain Stay, a two-story luxury villa, consists of seven types, including a pool suite with a pool and a spa suite with a cypress sauna. Seol Hot Springs, a condominium with hot spring water supplied to all rooms, stands out with its 10 different room designs, including a pool suite with a family pool. There are several auxiliary facilities within the resort. You can use the clubhouse restaurant that serves unique seasonal food, the Seolhae trail where you can take a walk while smelling the scent of pine trees, and the hot spring sauna where you can wash away fatigue with hot spring water.
양양국제공항 뒤편에 자리한 럭셔리 복합 리조트다. 설악권에서의 휴식과 힐.zh: 它是位于襄阳国际机场后面的豪华综合度假村。这是一个呈现雪岳地区放松和治愈愿景的度假村，您可以享受高尔夫球场、豪华住宿、温泉桑拿和辅助设施。雪海院的意思是“拥抱雪岳山和东海的休息花园”。顾名思义，襄阳东湖海水浴场位于酒店东侧，雪岳山山麓位于西侧。度假村以被选为韩国十大高尔夫球场之一的雪海院为中心，拥有山间住宿、雪温泉、高尔夫酒店等多种类型的客房。所有客房均享有高尔夫球场的景观，根据房间位置，还可观赏雪岳山和东海的自然风光。 Mountain Stay是一栋两层楼的豪华别墅，共有七种类型，包括带泳池的泳池套房和带柏树桑拿浴室的水疗套房。 Seol Hot Springs 是一座向所有房间提供温泉水的公寓，以其 10 种不同的房间设计而脱颖而出，其中包括带家庭游泳池的泳池套房。度假村内有多种辅助设施。您可以使用提供独特时令美食的俱乐部餐厅、可以一边闻着松树的香味一边散步的雪海小路、以及可以用温泉水洗去疲劳的温泉桑拿浴室。

섭지코지는 코지(코지곶을 의미하는 제주 방언)라는 지명에서 알 수 있듯.en: As can be seen from the name of Seopjikoji (Jeju dialect meaning Koji Cape), Seopjikoji is a landform with a protruding tip shaped like a nose tree. Location-wise, it protrudes from the coast of Shinyang-ri, Seongsan-eup, Seogwipo-si. It is not that easy to get to for outsiders, but in most cases, you can reach the end of Koji by entering the village from the Shinyang-ri coastal national highway, looking at the sign, and following the concrete road. Or, if you are coming from Seogwipo, go about 7km past downtown Pyoseon, and when you see a coastal road sign on the right, turn right here and run along the sea all the way while looking at the panoramic view of Seopjikoji. Soon you will see the white sand beach of Shinyang Beach, and when you reach the village, turn right and follow the concrete road. In particular, the rape blossoms here have a more vivid and beautiful color than anywhere else in harmony with the bright sunlight and blue sea. On top of Koji Hill, which is wide and flat, there is a stone beacon station called Hyeopjeondae, where beacon fires were lit in the old days. It is about 4m high and 9m wide, and is relatively preserved in its original form. The peak rising northeast of Yeondong is called Red Oreum, an oreum made of red volcanic ash called song in Jeju. The sight of the white lighthouse at the top evokes another exotic atmosphere, contrasting with the yellow rape flower field, the red earth of the Oreum, and the blue sky and sea. There are iron stairs up to the lighthouse, so you can easily climb up. If you climb up on the railing of the lighthouse, the amazing coastal scenery of Seopjikoji unfolds right in front of you.
섭지코지는 코지(코지곶을 의미하는 제주 방언)라는 지명에서 알 수 있듯.zh: 从涉地可支（济州话，意思是“可支岬”）的名字就可以看出，涉地可支是一个尖部突出，形状像鼻树的地貌。从位置上看，它从西归浦市城山邑新阳里海岸突出。对于外地人来说不太容易到达，但大多数情况下，从新阳里沿海国道进入村庄，看着指示牌，沿着水泥路走，就可以到达小路的尽头。或者，如果从西归浦出发，经过表善市中心约7公里，看到右侧的沿海路标时，在此右转，一路沿着大海奔跑，同时欣赏涉地可支的全景。很快你就会看到新阳海滩的白色沙滩，到达村庄后右转，沿着水泥路走。尤其是这里的油菜花，与明媚的阳光和蔚蓝的大海相映成趣，色彩比其他地方更加鲜艳美丽。宽阔平坦的高支山顶上有一座名为挟殿台的石砌烽火台，过去曾在此点燃烽火。高约4m，宽约9m，较保存原貌。连洞东北方的山峰被称为“红火山”，是由红色火山灰构成的火山，在济州岛被称为“松”。山顶的白色灯塔与黄色的油菜花田、红色的火山大地、蓝色的天海相映成趣，别有一番异域风情。灯塔有铁梯通往，可以轻松攀登。爬上灯塔的栏杆，涉地可支的海岸风光尽收眼底。

성남문화원은 지역 문화의 전통문화 발굴 보존과 각종 문화행사를 주최하고.en: Seongnam Cultural Center is a cultural facility that discovers and preserves traditional local culture, hosts various cultural events, and serves as a cultural center. As part of Seongnam City's various cultural events, we are striving to satisfy the cultural needs of local residents by holding a total of 40 events, including the Seongnam Love Writing Contest, Gangjeong Daily Dang Award, New Year's Day Folk Festival, Dunchon Chinese Baekiljeon, Songsan Baekiljeon, Gyeonggi-do Folk Arts Festival 'Grand Prize', Gyeonggi-do Youth Folk Arts Festival 'Grand Prize', and Dunchon Cultural Festival. In addition, we are helping to provide high-quality cultural life by operating a cultural school. Cultural classes include folk songs, Chinese calligraphy, Korean dance, pansori, gayageum, and pungmul.
성남문화원은 지역 문화의 전통문화 발굴 보존과 각종 문화행사를 주최하고.zh: 城南文化中心是发现和保存地方传统文化、举办各种文化活动并作为文化中心的文化设施。作为城南市各种文化活动的一部分，我们举办了城南爱情写作大赛、江正日报奖、元旦民俗节、端村中华百节节、松山百节节、京畿道民俗艺术节“大奖”、京畿道青年民俗艺术节“大奖”、节村文化等共计40项活动，努力满足当地居民的文化需求。节日。此外，我们还通过运营文化学校来帮助提供高质量的文化生活。文化课程包括民歌、中国书法、韩国舞蹈、板索里、伽倻琴和风物。

성남시 야외공연장은 분당 중앙공원 내에 위치한 공연장으로, 아름다운 자연.en: The Seongnam City Outdoor Performance Hall is a performance hall located within Bundang Central Park, and has established itself as a cultural and artistic space for citizens in harmony with beautiful nature. It is a performance hall that can accommodate up to 11,000 audiences in 480 fixed seats and lawn seats. Through various performances and events such as park concerts, art festivals, and expos held every year, we are providing high satisfaction to visitors by increasing opportunities for citizens to enjoy culture.
성남시 야외공연장은 분당 중앙공원 내에 위치한 공연장으로, 아름다운 자연.zh: 城南市户外表演厅是位于盆唐中央公园内的表演厅，是与美丽的自然和谐相处的市民文化艺术空间。这是一个可容纳多达11,000名观众、480个固定座位和草坪座位的表演厅。通过每年举办的公园音乐会、艺术节、博览会等各种演出和活动，增加市民享受文化的机会，提高游客的满意度。

성남아트리움은 시민과 함께 소통하는 창의적 문화예술공간을 지향하는 공연.en: Seongnam Atrium is a performance facility that aims to be a creative cultural and artistic space that communicates with citizens. It is built with 4 floors underground and 2 floors above ground, and has a large theater with 645 seats and a small theater with about 200 seats. The grand theater provides a comfortable performance environment with high-end speakers and an acoustic design that minimizes the inflow of external sounds. In addition, office space for local art groups such as the Seongnam Arts Council and the Seongnam Women's Choir are located together, serving as a center for civic art activities.
성남아트리움은 시민과 함께 소통하는 창의적 문화예술공간을 지향하는 공연.zh: 城南中庭是一个表演设施，旨在成为与市民交流的创意文化艺术空间。建筑地下4层，地上2层，设有645个座位的大剧场和约200个座位的小剧场。大剧院采用高端扬声器和尽量减少外部声音流入的声学设计，提供舒适的演出环境。此外，城南艺术委员会、城南女子合唱团等当地艺术团体的办公空间也集中在一起，成为市民艺术活动的中心。

2005년 10월 14일 개관한 성남아트센터는 공연, 전시예술의 첨단 흐.en: Seongnam Arts Center, which opened on October 14, 2005, embodies cutting-edge trends in performing and exhibition arts and aims to be a local cultural space. Since its opening in three performance halls (Opera House, Concert Hall, and Ensemble Theater) and exhibition spaces (Cube Art Museum, Gallery 808, Bandal Gallery, and Permanent Exhibition Hall), Seongnam Arts Center, operated by Seongnam Cultural Foundation, has established itself as the center of Seongnam culture and arts by presenting original cultural contents such as domestic premieres, Seongnam exclusives, self-produced projects, and local programs. In addition, it operates various facilities such as the World Musical Instrument Exhibition Hall, Seongnam Media Center, Central Park Outdoor Performance Hall, and Book Theme Park, providing citizens with a friendly cultural rest area and bringing joy to their daily lives. Various culture and arts support policy projects, including the Sarangbang Culture Club, which has attracted attention as a cultural brand symbolizing Seongnam, and the creative education programs of the Seongnam Media Center and Academy in cooperation with the local community, including citizens, schools, and companies, are laying the foundation for all citizens to enjoy culture and arts and communicate through culture and arts.
2005년 10월 14일 개관한 성남아트센터는 공연, 전시예술의 첨단 흐.zh: 城南艺术中心于2005年10月14日开业，体现了表演和展览艺术的前沿趋势，旨在成为当地的文化空间。由城南文化财团运营的城南艺术中心，自开设三个表演厅（歌剧院、音乐厅、合奏剧场）和展览空间（立方体美术馆、808画廊、班达尔画廊、常设展示厅）以来，通过展示国内首映、城南独有、自制项目和地方节目等原创文化内容，确立了城南文化艺术中心的地位。此外，还运营世界乐器展览馆、城南媒体中心、中央公园户外表演厅、图书主题公园等各类设施，为市民提供友好的文化休憩场所，为日常生活带来欢乐。作为城南象征的文化品牌而备受瞩目的舍廊房文化俱乐部、城南媒体中心和学院与市民、学校、企业等地区社会合作的创意教育项目等各种文化艺术支援政策项目，为全体市民享受文化艺术、通过文化艺术进行交流奠定了基础。

해발 180m인 성산 일출봉은 약 5,000년 전 제주도 수많은 분화구.en: Seongsan Ilchulbong, which is 180 meters above sea level, is a volcanic body that exploded underwater about 5,000 years ago, which is rare among Jeju Island's numerous craters. The explosion that occurs when lava mixes with water breaks the lava into fine volcanic ash, which is piled up in a cone around the crater. It was originally a volcanic island, but sand and gravel piled up between the island and the land near Shinyang Beach, connecting it to the mainland. At the top of Ilchulbong Peak, there is a crater with a diameter of 600 m, a floor height of 90 m above sea level, and an area of ​​214,400 m2. Since ancient times, the sunrise view seen from the top of Seongsan Ilchulbong Peak has been said to be the best among the 10 scenic spots in Yeongju (Jeju's scenic spots). The sunrise rising from the horizon beyond the flowing blue sea colors the entire sea, captures the hearts of those who see it, and makes them admire it.
해발 180m인 성산 일출봉은 약 5,000년 전 제주도 수많은 분화구.zh: 城山日出峰海拔180米，是大约5000年前在水下爆发的火山体，这在济州岛众多的火山口中是罕见的。当熔岩与水混合时发生的爆炸将熔岩分解成细小的火山灰，这些火山灰堆积在火山口周围的圆锥体中。它原本是一座火山岛，但岛与新阳海滩附近的陆地之间堆积着沙子和砾石，将其与大陆连接起来。日出峰山顶有一个直径600m、海拔90m、面积214,400m2的火山口。自古以来，城山日出峰的日出景色被认为是荣州十景中最好的。日出从地平线升起，碧波荡漾的大海将整片大海染红，让观者心醉神迷，赞叹不已。

업성동의 '성', 성성동의 '성'을 따서 합쳐 만든 업성저수지가 탈바꿈한.en: Eopseong Reservoir, which was created by combining the 'seong' of Eopseong-dong and the 'seong' of Seongseong-dong, was transformed. The water quality of Eopseong Reservoir deteriorated to grade 6 and it lost its function as an agricultural reservoir. As a result of Cheonan City's water quality improvement and natural ecosystem restoration project, it was transformed into 'Seongseong Lake Park'. Visitor center (promotion center/experience center), grass yard and forest playground, ecological trail, and Seongseong Mulbit, a nature observation bridge. It is an eco-friendly ecological park in the midst of urban life where nature and people coexist, including Nuri Bridge, artificial plant islands, and water circulation facilities. In this park, you can see various amphibians such as endangered golden frogs and mallards, as well as mandarin ducks, mallards, and white-cheeked ducks.
업성동의 '성', 성성동의 '성'을 따서 합쳐 만든 업성저수지가 탈바꿈한.zh: 将御城洞的“城”和城城洞的“城”合并而成的御城水库被改造。御城水库水质恶化至6级，失去了农业水库的功能。天安市水质改善和自然生态系统恢复工程的成果，被改造成“城城湖公园”。游客中心（推广中心/体验中心）、草地森林游乐场、生态步道、自然观察桥城城木比特。它是城市生活中自然与人共存的生态友好型生态公园，包括努日桥、人工植物岛和水循环设施。在这个公园里，你可以看到濒临灭绝的金蛙、绿头鸭等各种两栖动物，还有鸳鸯、绿头鸭、白颊鸭等。

성저공원은 성저마을 사이에 자리잡은 산림형 근린공원이다. 공원 산책로에는.en: Seongjeo Park is a forest-type neighborhood park located between Seongjeo Village. The park's trails are equipped with anti-slip facilities and have solar-powered pest deterrents to exterminate insects. If you go up the trail while looking at plants such as hydrangea, sycamore, and maekmundong, there are stairs made of stone and wood here and there, so you can trek without getting bored. At the top of the park, there is a fitness center with exercise equipment and a tap with cool mineral water. There is a high-pressure duster at the exit, and there is also a cool mineral spring that is the pride of this park. ※ Pets are allowed (bring leash and waste bag)
성저공원은 성저마을 사이에 자리잡은 산림형 근린공원이다. 공원 산책로에는.zh: 圣堤公园是位于圣堤村之间的森林型邻里公园。公园步道设有防滑设施，并设有太阳能驱虫器，可消灭昆虫。一边观赏绣球花、梧桐树、梅门洞等植物一边沿着步道向上走，到处都有石头和木头制成的楼梯，所以徒步不会感到无聊。公园顶部设有健身中心，配有健身器材和清凉矿泉水的水龙头。出口处有高压除尘器，还有清凉的矿泉是这个公园的骄傲。 ※ 允许携带宠物（请携带牵引绳和垃圾袋）

세미원은 팔당호가 삼면에 둘러싸인 물과 꽃의 정원으로 동양의 전통적인 정.en: Semiwon is a water and flower garden surrounded on three sides by Paldang Lake. It has about 270 types of plants, including traditional Oriental garden styles and aquatic plants, and is a place with various things to see. In June 2019, it was designated as Gyeonggi-do's first local garden, and Jeong Yak-yong built a boat bridge over the Namhan River in Yangju, where the river narrows, and this is known to be the site of today's Semiwon. In addition, it is a garden of water and flowers that was created as a space for culture and art and a breath of our history through the creation of various facilities and experiential events, including the Lotus Museum, Water Lily Greenhouse, Seokchangwon, and Sangchunwon.
세미원은 팔당호가 삼면에 둘러싸인 물과 꽃의 정원으로 동양의 전통적인 정.zh: 半园是一个三面被八堂湖包围的水花花园。这里有约270种植物，包括传统东方园林风格和水生植物，是一个可以观赏的地方。 2019年6月，它被指定为京畿道第一个地方花园，郑若镛在河流变窄的杨州南汉江上修建了一座船桥，这就是今天的塞米院所在地。此外，还通过莲花博物馆、睡莲温室、石仓院、上春院等各种设施和体验活动，打造了一个文化艺术空间和历史气息的水花花园。

세이브존 광명점은 쇼핑과 여가, 생활 편의시설을 함께 갖춘 복합 쇼핑몰이.en: Save Zone Gwangmyeong branch is a complex shopping mall equipped with shopping, leisure, and living convenience facilities. There is an underground food hall and food court, outdoor, sports, and golf wear brands, young casual and ladies clothing stores, a cultural center, and specialty restaurants on each floor, and a futsal court is provided on the 5th floor for leisure activities. Equipped with a practical brand structure and various convenient facilities, it is establishing itself as a shopping space closely related to the lives of local residents.
세이브존 광명점은 쇼핑과 여가, 생활 편의시설을 함께 갖춘 복합 쇼핑몰이.zh: Save Zone光明店是集购物、休闲、生活便利设施于一体的综合型购物中心。每层设有地下美食街及美食广场，户外、运动、高尔夫服饰品牌，年轻休闲女装店，文化中心，特色餐厅，五楼设有五人制足球场，可供休闲活动。凭借实用的品牌结构和各种便利设施，将其打造成与当地居民生活密切相关的购物空间。

세이브존 부천상동점은 상동역 인근에 자리한 아울렛형 복합 쇼핑시설로, 쇼.en: Save Zone Bucheon Sangdong Branch is an outlet-type shopping complex located near Sangdong Station, where you can enjoy shopping, food, beverages, and leisure. It is also suitable for families as it is equipped with stores related to hobbies such as sports and golf, as well as lifestyle facilities such as a kids cafe and cultural center. The renovated food hall ‘Selfresh’ will be operated on the first basement floor in October 2025, providing a pleasant shopping environment through wider circulation and lower shelves.
세이브존 부천상동점은 상동역 인근에 자리한 아울렛형 복합 쇼핑시설로, 쇼.zh: Save Zone富川上东店是位于上东站附近的奥特莱斯型购物中心，在这里您可以享受购物、美食、饮料和休闲。这里还设有与体育和高尔夫等爱好相关的商店以及儿童咖啡厅和文化中心等生活设施，因此也适合家庭入住。翻新后的美食广场“Selfresh”将于 2025 年 10 月在地下一层运营，通过更广泛的流通和更低的货架提供宜人的购物环境。

세이브존 성남점은 단대오거리역 인근에 자리한 패션 아울렛이다. 의류·가전.en: Save Zone Seongnam branch is a fashion outlet located near Dandae Ogeori Station. Visitors who want practical shopping often visit here as they can find mid- to low-priced brands in various categories such as clothing, home appliances, groceries, household goods, and miscellaneous goods in one place. Thanks to its reasonable price range and wide range of products, it is convenient to purchase items you need on a daily basis. By operating a cultural center, it also serves as a living and cultural space where local residents can participate in classes and programs.
세이브존 성남점은 단대오거리역 인근에 자리한 패션 아울렛이다. 의류·가전.zh: Save Zone城南店是位于端大大乔里站附近的时尚奥特莱斯店。想要实用购物的游客经常来这里，因为这里可以一站式找到服装、家电、杂货、家居用品、杂货等各种品类的中低价位品牌。由于其合理的价格范围和广泛的产品，可以方便地购买您日常所需的物品。通过运营文化中心，它还可以作为当地居民可以参加课程和活动的生活和文化空间。

세이브존 화정점은 1998년 개점한 세이브존의 첫 번째 지점으로, 패션과.en: Save Zone Hwajeong Branch is the first branch of Save Zone, which opened in 1998, and is a discount department store focusing on fashion and household goods. It offers a variety of fashion brands at reasonable prices, and is equipped with a food hall and private label products, allowing for practical shopping. The cultural center within the building operates classes and programs for local residents and is also used as a living and cultural space. As a regional distribution facility that combines shopping and culture, many visitors come through word of mouth.
세이브존 화정점은 1998년 개점한 세이브존의 첫 번째 지점으로, 패션과.zh: Save Zone华亭店是Save Zone的第一家分店，于1998年开业，是一家以时尚和家居用品为主的折扣百货店。汇集了各种时尚品牌，价格合理，并设有美食广场和自有品牌产品，购物实用。大楼内的文化中心为当地居民开设课程和项目，也可用作生活和文化空间。作为集购物与文化于一体的区域流通设施，许多游客都是通过口碑而来。

세종국악당은 여주시에 있는 시립공연장으로 1990년에 건립되었다. 여주시.en: Sejong Gugakdang is a municipal performance hall in Yeoju City and was built in 1990. The Korean traditional music hall, built by Yeoju City to support and promote the cultural and artistic activities of Yeoju citizens, was built with one floor underground and one floor above ground. The Korean traditional music hall, which has a performance hall with 388 seats and a practice room, is a base for various cultural and artistic activities, where various cultural and artistic performances are held. It is well-equipped with auxiliary facilities necessary for performances, such as special lighting facilities, stage curtains, projection screens, pianos, and stage sound equipment, and supports Yeoju citizens to enjoy high-quality cultural and artistic performances such as concerts, performances, plays, exhibitions, and lectures. To apply for rental, you can apply in person or by email after checking the facility. Nearby, there are tourist attractions such as Yeojuhyanggyo Confucian School, Joseon Hyojong Yeongneung Relic, and Yeoju Ceramics Complex, and you can also enjoy the Icheon Rice Culture Festival.
세종국악당은 여주시에 있는 시립공연장으로 1990년에 건립되었다. 여주시.zh: 世宗国乐堂是骊州市的市立表演厅，建于1990年。骊州市为支持和促进骊州市市民的文化艺术活动而兴建的韩国传统音乐厅，地下一层、地上一层。韩国传统音乐厅设有388个座位的表演厅和练习室，是各种文化艺术活动的基地，举办各种文化艺术表演。拥有专用灯光设施、舞台幕布、投影屏幕、钢琴、舞台音响设备等演出所需的配套设施，支持骊州市民享受音乐会、演出、戏剧、展览、讲座等高品质文化艺术表演。如需申请租赁，您可以亲自或在检查设施后通过电子邮件申请。附近有骊州乡校、朝鲜孝宗永陵遗址、骊州陶瓷园区等旅游景点，还可以参加利川稻米文化节。

제주올레 20코스를 걷다 보면 세화민속오일장과 해녀박물관 사이에 작은 해.en: If you walk Jeju Olle Course 20, you can come across Sehwa Beach, a small beach between Sehwa Folk Oil Market and Haenyeo Museum. This beach, located in Sehwa-ri, Gujwa-eup, is not an official beach and is not large in size, but it offers clear and blue sea. It is a place where the white sand and black basalt that are revealed when the water goes out are in beautiful harmony with the emerald sea. Among Jeju's many beaches, the small Sehwa Beach is widely known thanks to Bellongjang and Sehwa Folk Oil Market. This five-day market, the largest in the eastern region and held right next to the beach, provides a glimpse into the lives of the islanders every five days.
제주올레 20코스를 걷다 보면 세화민속오일장과 해녀박물관 사이에 작은 해.zh: 如果沿着济州偶来路线20行走，就能看到细花海滩，这是细花民油市场和海女博物馆之间的一个小海滩。这个海水浴场位于旧左邑细花里，不是官方海水浴场，面积不大，但海水清澈碧蓝。海水退去后露出的白色沙滩和黑色玄武岩与翠绿的大海完美地融为一体。在济州岛众多的海滩中，细花海滩因Bellongjang和细花民俗油市场而广为人知。这个为期五天的市场是东部地区最大的市场，毗邻海滩，每五天可以一睹岛民的生活。

휘돌아 흐르는 남한강과 소백산 줄기를 따라 우뚝 솟은 산봉우리가 장관인.en: Sono Belle Danyang, located in Danyang, where the flowing Namhangang River and the towering mountain peaks along the Sobaeksan Mountain range are spectacular, is a lodging that makes your trip special as it is quietly located among the breathtaking mountains. It is a place where you can go on an interesting and special trip to find beautiful scenic spots, the breath of our ancestors everywhere, and interesting stories and legends. You can also experience a thrilling and energetic time at Ocean Play, an activity enjoyed in nature.
휘돌아 흐르는 남한강과 소백산 줄기를 따라 우뚝 솟은 산봉우리가 장관인.zh: 丹阳索诺贝尔酒店 (Sono Belle Danyang) 坐落在丹阳，这里流淌的南汉江和小白山山脉的高耸山峰十分壮观，是一家安静地坐落在令人叹为观止的群山之中的住宿，让您的旅行变得与众不同。这是一个你可以进行一次有趣而特别的旅行的地方，在这里你可以发现美丽的风景，到处都有我们祖先的气息，还有有趣的故事和传说。您还可以在“Ocean Play”大自然活动中体验刺激又充满活力的时光。

홍천 소노벨 비발디파크는 강원도 홍천군에 위치한 사계절 레저복합시설이다..en: Hongcheon Sonobell Vivaldi Park is a four-season leisure complex located in Hongcheon-gun, Gangwon-do. It has a variety of leisure sports facilities such as golf, skiing, and water play, as well as a variety of accommodations such as hotels, condos, and pensions. Ocean World, located within Sonobell Vivaldi Park, opened on July 5, 2006 and provides people with fun and enjoyment with a variety of water play facilities. Ocean World is an eco-friendly water park that minimizes damage to the natural environment, and all ages can enjoy comfortable relaxation and thrilling fun at the same time. The total size is 126,645㎡, including 43,291㎡ indoor zone, 25,787㎡ extreme zone, 19,284㎡ wave pool zone, 31,242㎡ dynamic zone, and 7,041㎡ mega slide zone. This is 14 times the size of a soccer field and can accommodate 23,000 people at the same time. Gangwon area Ocean World, which was built to create the illusion of being transported to an unimaginable sea amidst a clean forest with curving ridges, closely resembles Egypt. It is an even more attractive place as it is equipped with various sculptures that convey the breath of Egypt, such as pyramids, sphinxes, and pharaohs. This place is largely divided into indoor zone, extreme zone, dynamic zone, and mega slide zone. The indoor zone can be used by various age groups, including a wave pool, lazy river, tube/body slide, bathe pool, waterplex for infants/children, sauna, and outdoor open-air bath. True to its name, the Extreme Zone is in the spotlight among young people, including Surfing Mount, which boasts Korea's only 8-foot V wave, and Extreme River, where you can experience the thrill of continuous waves. The Dynamic Zone is a space that provides thrilling fun with thrilling themed water play facilities such as the world's longest Monster Blaster at 300m, the 6-seater Super Boomerango, and the ultra-large Giant Waterplex. The Mega Slide Zone, newly created in 2011, allows you to enjoy a variety of thrills, including the world's first Super S Ride, Korea's first and largest 8-seater Cairo Racing, the ultimate thrill Double Tornado Slide, and the maximum centrifugal force Double Spin Slide.
홍천 소노벨 비발디파크는 강원도 홍천군에 위치한 사계절 레저복합시설이다..zh: 洪川索诺贝尔维瓦尔第公园是位于江原道洪川郡的一个四季休闲综合体。拥有高尔夫、滑雪、戏水等多种休闲运动设施，以及酒店、公寓、养老金等多种住宿设施。海洋世界位于索诺贝尔维瓦尔第公园内，于2006年7月5日开业，以各种水上游乐设施为人们提供欢乐和享受。海洋世界是一个生态友好型水上乐园，最大限度地减少对自然环境的破坏，各个年龄段的人都可以同时享受舒适的放松和惊险的乐趣。总面积126,645平方米，包括室内区43,291平方米、极限区25,787平方米、造浪池区19,284平方米、动感区31,242平方米、巨型滑梯区7,041平方米。这是一个足球场的14倍大小，可同时容纳23,000人。江原道海洋世界的建造目的是为了营造一种幻觉，让人们感觉自己被运送到一片难以想象的海洋中，周围是一片干净的森林，山脊弯曲，与埃及非常相似。更吸引人的是这里有金字塔、狮身人面像、法老等各种传达埃及气息的雕塑。这个地方大致分为室内区、极限区、动感区、巨型滑梯区。室内区设有造浪池、漂流河、管道/身体滑梯、沐浴池、婴儿/儿童水上乐园、桑拿浴室和室外露天浴池，适合各个年龄段的客人使用。正如其名，极限地带是年轻人关注的焦点，包括拥有韩国唯一的 8 英尺 V 浪的冲浪山，以及可以体验连续波浪的刺激的极限河。动态区是一个提供惊险乐趣的空间，拥有世界上最长的300m Monster Blaster、6 座Super Boomerango 和超大型Giant Waterplex 等惊险主题水上游乐设施。 2011年全新打造的巨型滑道区，让您享受各种惊险刺激，包括全球首创的Super S Ride、韩国首创、最大的8座开罗赛车、极致惊险的双旋风滑道、最大离心力的双旋转滑道等。

소노캄 거제는 전체 객실이 한려해상국립공원을 바라보는 오션뷰 전망을 갖추.en: All rooms at Sono Calm Geoje have an ocean view overlooking Hallyeohaesang National Park. It is equipped with various auxiliary facilities, including Ocean Adventure, a large-scale water park that can accommodate 3,500 people at the same time, and a banquet hall with 700 seats. In 2014, a marina facility equipped with a 55F/T catamaran yacht with a capacity of 45 passengers and two jet cruisers with a capacity of 13 passengers was added, establishing itself as the best marine marina resort beyond the marine tourist city of Geoje. Ocean Adventure, an amusement facility, is a comprehensive marine tourism complex equipped with a wave pool, extreme river, water plex, infinity zone, and body slide, and operates various yacht cruiser travel courses such as blue ocean tour, romance tour, and on-board fishing tour.
소노캄 거제는 전체 객실이 한려해상국립공원을 바라보는 오션뷰 전망을 갖추.zh: Sono Calm Geoje酒店的所有客房均享有俯瞰Hallyeohaesang国立公园的海景。配套设施齐全，包括可同时容纳3500人的大型水上乐园海洋探险、700个座位的宴会厅等。 2014年，增设了一艘55F/T双体游艇（可容纳45名乘客）和两艘喷气式巡洋舰（可容纳13名乘客）的码头设施，使其成为继海洋旅游城市巨济之后最好的海洋码头度假胜地。游乐设施海洋探险是一座综合性海洋旅游综合体，设有造浪池、极限河道、水上乐园、无边际地带、水上滑道等，并经营蓝色海洋游、浪漫游、船上垂钓游等各类游艇旅游课程。

소노캄 경주는 계절이 수놓은 빛깔과 자연이 주는 안온함이 있는 공간이다..en: Sono Calm Gyeongju is a space filled with the colors of the seasons and the peace provided by nature. Visiting customers can feel comfortable and practical when using the rooms and facilities provided by Sono Calm Gyeongju. At Sono Calm Gyeongju, you can enjoy a quiet and comfortable rest while admiring the beautiful scenery of Bomun Lake. It is a place where rest and health coexist in nature, away from everyday life, and you can feel the tradition and modernity of Gyeongju.
소노캄 경주는 계절이 수놓은 빛깔과 자연이 주는 안온함이 있는 공간이다..zh: Sono Calm 庆州是一个充满季节色彩和大自然赋予的宁静的空间。来访的顾客可以在使用Sono Calm庆州提供的房间和设施时感到舒适和实用。在庆州Sono Calm酒店，您可以一边欣赏普门湖的美丽景色，一边享受安静舒适的休息。这是一个在大自然中休息与健康共存的地方，远离日常生活，可以感受到庆州的传统与现代。

소노캄 고양은 국제 행사와 다양한 문화행사가 개최되는 컨벤션 센터 킨텍스.en: Sono Calm Goyang is a 5-star hotel in Gyeonggi-do, located close to the convention center KINTEX, where international events and various cultural events are held. Sono Calm Goyang, which is optimized for business, is close to the international airport and is highly accessible with convenient transportation facilities. You can also enjoy the society of pets and their guardians at the premium pet complex cultural space, which is the attractive point of Sono Calm Goyang.
소노캄 고양은 국제 행사와 다양한 문화행사가 개최되는 컨벤션 센터 킨텍스.zh: Sono Calm Goyang 是一家位于京畿道的五星级酒店，靠近举办国际活动和各种文化活动的 KINTEX 会议中心。 Sono Calm 高阳市靠近国际机场，交通便利，适合商务出行。在高级宠物复合文化空间中，您还可以享受宠物及其监护人的社会，这也是Sono Calm高阳的魅力所在。

세계 4대 미항 여수의 오동도와 2012 여수세계박람회장에 위치한 소노캄.en: Sono Calm Yeosu, located on Odongdo Island in Yeosu, one of the world's four most beautiful ports, and the 2012 Yeosu World Expo Center, is a space where customers live their most valuable lives. We are waiting for special meetings with special people by providing high-quality service that adds value the longer you stay, a stylish interior sailing toward the southern seas, a comfortable environment, and a convention center with cutting-edge facilities. It creates a meaningful trip and a resting place where you can feel relaxation and romance while looking at the emerald South Sea sea from all rooms. We hope you will experience the beautiful romance of a maritime city and the new hotel culture and quality at Sono Calm Yeosu, which has established itself as a new landmark on the southern coast in name and reality.
세계 4대 미항 여수의 오동도와 2012 여수세계박람회장에 위치한 소노캄.zh: Sono Calm丽水位于世界四大美丽港口之一的丽水梧桐岛，与2012年丽水世界博览中心相邻，是顾客度过最有价值生活的空间。我们提供让您住宿时间越长越增值的优质服务、南海时尚的内饰、舒适的环境以及配备尖端设施的会议中心，等待着与特殊人士的特殊会议。为您打造一次有意义的旅行，让您在所有客房都能眺望碧绿的南海，感受轻松与浪漫的休憩之所。我们希望您能在名副其实的南部海岸新地标——丽水 Sono Calm 体验海上城市的美丽浪漫和新的酒店文化和品质。

도시 재생사업의 일환으로 방치된 채 버려진 대형 찜질방을 리모델링하여 문.en: It is the first private art museum in Hwaseong City that remodeled a large abandoned sauna as part of an urban regeneration project and transformed it into a cultural regeneration space. Soda Museum's philosophy is to rediscover the discarded things in our lives through a cyclical process called ''ReDesign''. Let's reinterpret and reproduce.' We strive to communicate with visitors by providing various experiment and experience spaces. On-site reservations are not possible and must be reserved online in advance. Confirm your reservation at the entrance desk and proceed with payment. At this time, you can enter by attaching the sticker you received to your clothes. If you have a photo taken with your face and the sticker in the re-entry photo zone, you can re-enter without limit.
도시 재생사업의 일환으로 방치된 채 버려진 대형 찜질방을 리모델링하여 문.zh: 作为城市复兴项目的一部分，它是华城市第一家将废弃的大型桑拿房改造成文化再生空间的私人美术馆。苏打博物馆的理念是通过一个名为“重新设计”的循环过程重新发现我们生活中丢弃的东西。让我们重新解释和重现。我们努力通过提供各种实验和体验空间来与参观者进行交流。无法现场预订，必须提前在线预订。在入口处确认您的预订并继续付款。此时，将收到的贴纸贴在衣服上即可进入。如果您在再入场拍照区有脸部和贴纸的照片，则可以无限次再次入场。

''소래''란 지명은 첫째 지형이 소라처럼 생겼다는 설과 둘째 냇가에 숲.en: The name ''Sorae'' is said to have originated for the following reasons: firstly, the terrain is shaped like a conch; secondly, there are many forests near the stream, i.e., it originated from Solnae (松川); and thirdly, the terrain is narrow, i.e., Solda → Narrow. According to the story, in the 7th year of King Muyeol of Silla (660), So Jeongbang of the Tang Dynasty personally led the military as a member of the Silla-Tang allied army to attack Baekje, departing from Laeju in Shandong Province, China, passing through Deokjeokdo Island and staying on this mountain. From then on, it is said that it began to be called ''Soraesan'' by combining the ''So(蘇)'' of Sojeongbang and the ''Rae'' of Raeju. Sorae Mountain, which has such a beautiful natural scenery that even citizens of nearby Incheon and Bucheon come to enjoy it on holidays, is a place that is loved by citizens as a resting place where they can comfortably relieve accumulated fatigue and tension if they take a little time out of their busy daily lives. On a clear day, Sorae Mountain Forest Bathing Park, which clearly overlooks downtown Seoul and the West Sea with the naked eye, was established in 1992 by the city of Siheung to improve the health and emotional life of citizens. It was created with an investment of 50 million won. The existing 5km long trail from the entrance to Naewonsa Temple to the summit has been maintained with various sports facilities, a reading forest, and a forest for strength training using wooden ropes. In addition, Soamcheon Mineral Spring and Cheongryong Mineral Spring quench the thirst of all those who visit Soraesan Forest Bathing Area by providing high-quality water. At the foot of the mountain is the tomb of Hayeon, who served as Yeonguijeong during the reign of King Sejong of the Joseon Dynasty, and on the eastern side of the mountain, Korea's largest rock-carved Bodhisattva statue, known to be from the early Goryeo Dynasty, is engraved on a folding screen rock, making it an excellent nature study center and the birthplace of history for children. If you walk for about 1 hour and 30 minutes through a lush forest of pine trees and pine trees, you can find peace of mind and body thanks to the aromatic substance called phytoncide emitted from the trees. There is no place like this as a resort using natural health therapy. In addition, hang glider demonstrations that sometimes decorate the skies of Sorae Mountain on weekends provide a new world for enthusiasts and a variety of attractions for the general public.
''소래''란 지명은 첫째 지형이 소라처럼 생겼다는 설과 둘째 냇가에 숲.zh: 据说“Sorae”这个名字的由来是这样的：一是地形像海螺；二是地势像海螺。其次，溪流附近有许多森林，即发源于松川；第三，地形狭窄，即索尔达→狭窄。相传新罗武烈王七年（660年），唐朝苏正方作为新罗唐联军成员亲自率军攻打百济，从中国山东莱州出发，途经德积岛，驻扎在这座山上。据说从那时起，它开始被称为“Soraesan”，结合了Sojeongbang的“So（苏）”和Raeju的“Rae”。苏来山自然风光优美，附近的仁川和富川市民每逢节假日都会来此观赏，是市民在忙碌的日常生活中抽出一点时间，可以舒舒服服地缓解累积的疲劳和紧张的休息场所，深受市民喜爱。天气晴朗的时候，可以用肉眼清晰地俯瞰首尔市中心和西海的苏来山森林浴公园，是始兴市于 1992 年为了改善市民的健康和情感生活而建立的。它是投资5000万韩元创建的。现有的从内院寺入口到山顶的5公里长的步道一直保留着各种体育设施、阅读森林和使用木绳进行力量训练的森林。此外，小岩川矿泉水和清龙矿泉水为所有来苏莱山森林浴场的游客提供优质水源解渴。山脚下有朝鲜世宗时期的演义政海渊墓，山东侧的屏风岩上刻有韩国最大的高丽初期石刻菩萨像，是优秀的自然学习中心和儿童历史的发源地。如果步行约1小时30分钟穿过茂密的松树林和松树林，树木散发出的名为芬多精的芳香物质会让您感到身心平静。没有像这里一样使用自然健康疗法的度假村。此外，周末时不时装点苏来山天空的悬挂式滑翔机表演，为爱好者提供了一个新世界，也为普通大众提供了丰富多彩的景点。

높이는 479m로 그리 높지는 않지만, 산세가 험한 편이며, 주민들이 소.en: Although the height is not that high at 479m, the mountain slope is rather steep, and the scenery is so beautiful that locals call it Salt River. There is a story that it was called Surisan Mountain because vultures lived on the rocky cliffs of the mountain, but it was later changed to Sorisan Mountain. Because the forest is dense and the valley is beautiful, many families visit here for vacation in the summer. The summit and main ridge are made of rocks, and the side of Saneumcheon Stream is a rocky cliff. Yongso Valley, located between Saneum-ri and Seoksan-ri, is a popular resting place due to its strangely shaped cliffs, abundant, clear water, and pebbly spaces here and there. The Sorisan Gorosoe Festival is held every March.
높이는 479m로 그리 높지는 않지만, 산세가 험한 편이며, 주민들이 소.zh: 虽然海拔不高，只有479m，但山坡却相当陡峭，景色非常美丽，当地人称之为“盐河”。有一个故事，因为山上的岩石悬崖上栖息着秃鹰，所以被称为苏里山，但后来改为苏里山。由于森林茂密，山谷美丽，许多家庭在夏季来这里度假。山顶和主脊由岩石构成，新音川一侧是岩石峭壁。龙沼溪谷位于新音里和石山里之间，由于奇形怪状的悬崖、丰富而清澈的水以及随处可见的卵石空间，是一个受欢迎的休息场所。每年三月都会举办 Sorisan Gorosoe 节。

소요산(587.5 m)은 천연 기암괴석이 절묘하게 봉우리를 이루어 놓아.en: Soyosan Mountain (587.5 m) is made up of exquisitely shaped natural rocks and strangely shaped peaks, reminiscent of a panoramic view. The mysterious atmosphere of the abyssal valley on a summer day and the deep beauty of fall foliage make it the most famous mountain north of Hansu, and is called Sogeumgang (Mt. Geumgangsan) of Gyeonggi. Starting with the Freedom Protection Peace Museum located at the entrance to the Soyosan tourist attraction, there are tourist attractions such as the Healthy Five Elements Road, which prays for the happiness and health of tourists, the site of Princess Yoseok's villa filled with the affectionate story of Great Master Wonhyo and Princess Yoseok, Wonhyodae, where Great Master Wonhyo prayed, Jajae Rock, a thousand-year-old temple, Cheongnyang Falls, and Wonhyo Falls.
소요산(587.5 m)은 천연 기암괴석이 절묘하게 봉우리를 이루어 놓아.zh: 少阳山（587.5 m）由形状精美的天然岩石和奇形怪状的山峰组成，令人联想到全景。夏季深渊的神秘气氛和秋季红叶的深邃之美使其成为汉水以北最著名的山，被称为京畿道小金刚山。以昭阳山旅游区入口处的自由保护和平博物馆为首，还有祈愿游客幸福健康的健康五行路、充满元晓大师与耀石公主深情故事的耀石公主别墅遗址、元晓大师祈愿的元晓台、千年古寺紫斋岩、清凉瀑布、元晓瀑布等旅游景点。

소요생활체육공원은 지역 주민의 건강 증진과 여가 활동을 지원하는 생활체육.en: Soyo Life Sports Park is a sports-centered park and multi-purpose sports space that supports local residents’ health promotion and leisure activities. It is equipped with a variety of sports facilities, including an artificial turf soccer field, badminton court, basketball court, and futsal court, so anyone can enjoy exercising without burden. Sincheon flows in front of the park, making it pleasant to take a walk or walk along the waterway. Ssamzie Park in Sangbongam-dong is located nearby, so you can take a break after exercising.
소요생활체육공원은 지역 주민의 건강 증진과 여가 활동을 지원하는 생활체육.zh: 索约生活体育公园是一个以体育为中心的公园和多功能体育空间，支持当地居民的健康促进和休闲活动。拥有人造草坪足球场、羽毛球场、篮球场、五人制足球场等多种体育设施，任何人都可以无负担地享受运动。公园前有新川流过，散步或沿着水路散步都很愉快。附近有上凤岩洞三子公园，运动后可以休息一下。

‘소전미술관’은 소전재단 이사장이었던 故김용산 회장의 도자기컬렉션을 기증.en: ‘Sojeon Art Museum’ is based on a ceramic collection donated by the late Kim Yong-san, who was the chairman of the Sojeon Foundation. It was exhibited in Yeonji-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul in 1994, and then moved to Daeya-dong, Siheung-si, Gyeonggi-do in 1996 and opened. Designated as a ceramics-centered theme art museum by Gyeonggi Province in 1997, it preserves and exhibits masterpieces of ceramics, Buddhist art, paintings, crafts, and sculptures that express a variety of Korean aesthetics. The Sojeon Museum of Art, located in a beautiful natural environment, consists of a permanent exhibition hall where you can see luxury ceramics from the Goryeo and Joseon Dynasties and an outdoor garden where sculptures by masters such as César and Bourdelle are displayed.
‘소전미술관’은 소전재단 이사장이었던 故김용산 회장의 도자기컬렉션을 기증.zh: “小田美术馆”以已故小田财团会长金勇山捐赠的陶瓷收藏为基础。 1994年在首尔钟路区莲池洞展出，1996年迁至京畿道始兴市大雅洞开馆。 1997年被京畿道指定为以陶瓷为中心的主题美术馆，保存并展示了表达韩国多种美学的陶瓷、佛教艺术、绘画、工艺品和雕塑的杰作。小田美术馆坐落在美丽的自然环境中，由展示高丽、朝鲜时期高级陶瓷的常设展厅和展示塞萨尔、布德尔等大师雕塑作品的室外花园组成。

바다향기로는 속초해수욕장에서 외옹치항까지 1.74㎞에 걸쳐 이어진 이색적.en: Sea Fragrance is a unique coastal walking course that stretches 1.74km from Sokcho Beach to Oeongchi Port. It is largely divided into the Sokcho Beach section (850m) and the Oeongchi section (890m), and each section has a different atmosphere. If you want to take a leisurely walk along the beach, the Sokcho Beach section is suitable, and if you want to capture dynamic scenery, the Oeongchi section is recommended. The Oeongchi section has been off-limits to civilians for decades, and contains a natural beauty that has remained untouched for a long time. It is also famous as a filming location for the drama ‘Boyfriend’. Along the wooden deck trail and the dirt road, the blue sea continues endlessly, and the sound of crashing waves adds to the refreshing feeling. The sea water is so clear and clean that the bottom is clearly visible. The Oeongchi section is comprised of four themed courses: Bamboo Meditation Path, Sky Deck Path, Security Experience Path, and Rock Observation Path. The coastal border fence surrounding the security experience road is a partial remnant of what was installed after the armed communist infiltration incident in 1970. It is also very fun to see the strange rocks formed on the coast, such as Oyster Rock and Centipede Rock.

속초 여행의 필수 코스로 꼽히는 속초관광수산시장은 동해안의 싱싱한 수산물.en: Sokcho Tourist & Fishery Market, considered a must-visit for a trip to Sokcho, is a place overflowing with fresh seafood and specialties from the East Coast. Also, it is full of all kinds of food, including squid sundae, abai sundae, and fried chicken. The combination of large commercial buildings with one floor underground and two floors above ground and specialized alley markets adds to the attractions. The first floor of the commercial building houses dry goods, vegetables, and food, and the second floor houses clothing, daily necessities, general stores, and Nonghyup Hanaro Mart, where you can purchase a variety of products. There is also a raw fish center in the basement, where you can taste fresh live fish and seafood at low prices. The alley market is divided into five alleys, including Fruit and Vegetable Alley, Sundae Alley, and Salted Fish Market Alley, depending on the product. The fresh produce, fish, and dried fish spread out on the stalls make me slow down. Dakgangjeon Alley, a popular destination for tourists, has many crispy and spicy chicken gangjeong stores. Each store captivates the taste buds of tourists with different know-how. All alley markets are equipped with rain protection facilities, so you can visit comfortably even when it rains. They have a clean and comfortable environment and a spacious parking lot.

속초시립박물관은 선사시대부터 현대에 이르기까지 속초의 역사와 문화, 자연.en: Sokcho City Museum is a cultural experience tourist attraction where you can experience and learn about the history, culture, and natural environment of Sokcho from prehistoric times to modern times. In addition to the old traditional culture, the mountain culture formed around Mt. Seorak, the fishing village culture with the East Sea as its base of life, and the culture of displaced people who fled during the Korean War are explained step by step in an easy-to-understand manner. The museum’s permanent exhibition is divided into four exhibition rooms. The first exhibition room introduces the natural environment and cultural characteristics of Sokcho, and the second exhibition room displays the fishing village formed on the beach and the lives of the displaced people. The third exhibition room is a space tailored to the eye level of children and provides a variety of traditional cultural experiences. Inside the Sokcho City Museum, the Displaced People’s Culture Village and Balhae History Museum are located together. In the outdoor Cultural Village for Displaced Persons, North Korean houses such as Gaeseong House, Pyeongyang House, and Hwanghae-do House are on display, and lodging experiences are also available. The Cheongho-dong alley, where refugees from the North lived together after the Korean War, and the old Sokcho Station, which was demolished in 1978, are also recreated. The Balhae History Museum is a space that examines the history of Balhae, which ruled Manchuria and the northern region of the Korean Peninsula. Photos, videos, and relics of historical sites are on display, and you can also experience Balhae's tomb culture.

1976년 처음 개장한 속초해수욕장은 국내 대표적인 해수욕장 가운데 하나.en: Sokcho Beach, which first opened in 1976, is one of Korea's representative beaches. The advantage is that it is close to downtown Sokcho and the express bus terminal is within walking distance, so transportation is convenient. Sokcho Beach has clear and clean sea water, shallow depth, and gentle slope, so it is crowded with vacationers from all over the country every summer. Especially during the peak season of July and August, the wide beach is filled with people without space to step on them. The area around the beach is well-equipped with restaurants and convenience facilities. There is a pine forest behind the beach, and there is also a small park and walking path. Even after the holiday season, tourists continue to visit the beach. This is because the sculptures installed all over the sandy beach offer a variety of things to see regardless of the season. The initials ‘ㅅㅊ’ symbolizing Sokcho, a large compass showing the directions of countries around the world, and vibrant dolphin sculptures all catch the eye. The large picture frame with the blue sea in the background and the Stairway to Heaven stretching toward the sky are the most popular photo zones here. Every year, tourists can enjoy busking, summer beach festivals, and Sokcho Craft Beer Festivals here to create more enjoyable memories. If you visit at the right time, you can enjoy performance events such as band performances and concerts.

국내 유일하게 해변에 위치해 속초의 푸른 바다를 한눈에 감상할 수 있으며.en: It is the only place in Korea located on a beach, so you can enjoy a panoramic view of the blue sea of ​​Sokcho and the beautiful scenery of Seoraksan Mountain. Sokcho i is a 22-story apartment building with 36 Ferris wheels with a capacity of 6, allowing up to 216 people to use them at the same time. The travel time is approximately 15 minutes and air conditioning is provided during the summer. Bringing in food other than bottled water is prohibited. You can feel the sparkling clear sea and Sokcho during the day, and a romantic atmosphere with bright lights at night.

송도 고층빌딩 숲 사이, 자연을 담은 공원인 송도 센트럴파크는 뉴욕 센트.en: Songdo Central Park, a park filled with nature between a forest of high-rise buildings in Songdo, was created with New York's Central Park as a motif. It is Korea's first seawater park using seawater and an urban park that takes advantage of Korea's topographical characteristics. The artificial waterway is equipped with water leisure facilities such as water taxis and canoes, and it is a landmark and relaxation space in Songdo where you can enjoy various cultures and arts throughout the park. There are five themed gardens within Central Park. The Sunset Garden, located at the western end of Central Park, is a space with attractions such as the West Boat House, waterside stage, children's garden, and cube sculpture, while the Emotional Garden is a landscape observation space consisting of facilities such as an observation deck and tidal support, as well as the Face of the Global Village, a work of art made with masks symbolizing 120 countries around the world. Grass Garden is a complex art space where you can enjoy various sculptures and public art works, such as the Manneken Pis statue, observation deck, wetland garden, and firefly house. The Walking Garden is a traditional theme space where you can see deer grazing leisurely. Songhwajeong, located high in the east, offers a picturesque night view with the moonlight. The Terrace Garden, where the UN Square, East Boat House, and Folk Playground are located, is a cultural and artistic space where various events are held throughout the year.

송산사지근린공원은 자연과 유적을 함께 즐길 수 있는 녹지 공간이다. 공원.en: Songsansaji Neighborhood Park is a green space where you can enjoy nature and historical sites. In the middle of the park is the ruins of Songsansa Temple, a Gyeonggi-do monument that houses the memorial tablets of six loyal subjects of the late Goryeo Dynasty, and around the shrine is a dense pine forest and a wide lawn plaza. The garden, which reflects traditional elements such as a pond and a crepe myrtle garden, gives you a sense of the tranquil elegance of a Korean garden. It is also suitable for families as it is well-equipped with convenient facilities such as a folk yard where you can experience traditional swings and neolttwigi, walking trails, a children's playground, and exercise equipment.

송정역은 부산 해운대구 송정동에 있는 기차역이다. 동해안의 해산물과 자원.en: Songjeong Station is a train station in Songjeong-dong, Haeundae-gu, Busan. It belongs to the Donghae Nambu Line built for the purpose of transporting seafood and resources on the East Coast. The Donghae Nambu Line opened to Gyeongju and Pohang in 1918, and to Busan, Ulsan, and Gyeongju in 1935, serving people for a long time. In particular, the scenery outside the window along the sea was considered beautiful. Songjeong Station began operations as a simple station staffed by station staff in 1934 and was promoted to a regular station in 1941. It appears that the station was rebuilt at this time, and it retains the architectural characteristics of train stations from the 1940s, similar to Unsan Station and Danchon Station. Although cargo operations were discontinued in 1976, its railroad historical value was recognized and it was designated as a registered cultural property. It has recently been renovated as the starting and ending station of the Haeundae Beach Train, which utilizes the old railroad tracks of the Donghae Nambu Line, and is attracting many tourists.

송추계곡은 경기 양주시 장흥면 울대리에 위치한 계곡이다. 북한산국립공원.en: Songchu Valley is a valley located in Uldae-ri, Jangheung-myeon, Yangju-si, Gyeonggi-do. It is located at the Songchu Obong branch of Bukhansan National Park and is easily accessible from anywhere in the metropolitan area. The name was given because it is a valley with many pine trees and sycamore trees. Around the valley, there are dense forests such as pine trees, cottonwood trees, and maple trees, and strangely shaped rocks that harmonize with the valley water, creating a beautiful scenery.

수덕사는 덕산온천 근처에 솟은 차령산맥 덕숭산(495m) 남쪽 자락에 위.en: Sudeoksa Temple is a temple located at the southern foot of Deoksungsan Mountain (495m) in the Charyeong Mountain Range near Deoksan Hot Springs. It is so large that it is the headquarters of the 7th Diocese of the Jogye Order of Korean Buddhism, which oversees the Jogye Order temples in the Naepo region of South Chungcheong Province. It is an ancient temple that was founded around the 6th century during the Baekje Dynasty and boasts a history of nearly 1,500 years. It boasts a scenery so beautiful that it was selected as the No. 1 scenic spot in Yesan-gun. The founding story is that a young man fell in love with a young woman, and her condition for marriage was that he build a temple. After building the temple, he held Nangja's hand and she disappeared, and it turned out that she was the incarnation of Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva. Sudeoksa Temple, which was founded with these tales, went through several renovations during the Goryeo, Joseon, and Japanese colonial periods and is still standing today. Here, cultural assets from the Baekje period to the Joseon Dynasty remain. In addition to the Daeungjeon Hall designated as a national treasure, the Nosanabulgwaebultaeng and Myobop Lotus Sutra designated as treasures, as well as the three-story stone pagoda and seven-story stone pagoda, many cultural assets designated by Chungcheongnam-do are also preserved. In addition, various Buddhist cultural assets are stored in the Geunyeokseong Archives, and the thatched house where artist Lee Eung-no (1904-1989) practiced his art, the historical site of Lee Eung-no (Sudeok Inn), and the Seon Art Museum, which displays works by Lee Eung-no and modern and contemporary artists as well as Buddhist artworks, are also located within the precincts. Temple Stay operates a variety of programs to suit needs and tastes.

수덕산은 경기도 최고봉인 화악산 정상에서부터 남쪽으로 곧게 뻗어 내려온.en: Sudeoksan Mountain is a mountain formed by a mountain range that extends straight down to the south from the summit of Hwaaksan Mountain, the highest peak in Gyeonggi-do, and rises again. Near the top of this place are Sinseonbawi Rock and Daewonsa Temple. It is said that it was called Sudeoksan Mountain or Suseopsan Mountain because a high monk helped him and accumulated virtue at Daewonsa Temple. Sudeoksan Mountain is not well-known as a hiking destination because it is overshadowed by the fame of nearby Myeongjisan Mountain and Hwaaksan Mountain, but it is not visited often by people, so it maintains its natural appearance. The height of the summit of Sudeoksan Mountain is 795m, and when you reach the top, you can see Mongdeoksan Mountain and Bukbaesan Mountain to the east and Myeongjisan Mountain to the west, offering a panoramic view of Gyeonggi-do's famous mountains. Since it is relatively natural, beginners should carefully read the hiking guide before visiting. In spring, trees begin to bud and you can see azaleas and various wildflowers.

제주도에서 가장 오래되고 규모가 큰 소나무군락지에 복합테마파크 형태의 관.en: It is a night market created as a tourist attraction in the form of a complex theme park in the oldest and largest pine tree colony in Jeju Island. It is the first night market in Korea with an area of ​​approximately 4,000 pyeong and a pristine night market created in a pine forest. Currently, there are a total of 18 food trucks in operation, including 2 trucks operated by multicultural families, 9 trucks operated by young entrepreneurs, and 7 trucks in the Jeju region, and about 30 teams of sellers comprised of small business owners in the Jeju region are operating.

수원시에서는 21세기 지식정보화 시대를 맞이하여 전국 제일의 평생학습 및.en: In the 21st century era of knowledge and information, Suwon City has taken the lead as the nation's leading city of lifelong learning and culture, and has established 3 children's libraries in each region, the West Suwon and Buksuwon libraries, and 2 general libraries so that all citizens can use libraries nearby, resulting in 8 libraries along with the existing Seongyeong, Jungang, and Yeongtong libraries. In order to increase the number of libraries and stay ahead of the curve in service quality, we receive donations of excellent books from citizens (groups) and purchase new ones so that citizens can acquire specialized knowledge. We are also building a user-centered one-stop electronic library with books, member information, and unmanned automation to ensure convenient use.

수원화성은 조선 제22대 정조대왕이 장헌세자에 대한 효심으로 부친의 원침.en: Suwon Hwaseong Fortress was completed in September 1796 after King Jeongjo, the 22nd king of the Joseon Dynasty, moved his father's acupuncture point to Suwon Hwaseong out of filial piety toward Crown Prince Jangheon. Suwon Hwaseong Fortress was built by King Jeongjo, the 22nd king of the Joseon Dynasty, who was installed as crown prince, but was embroiled in a factional dispute and could not ascend to the throne. He enshrined the wish of his father, Crown Prince Sado, who died in a dungeon from Baebongsan Mountain in Yangju to Suwon Hwasan, the most famous site of Joseon, and moved the town office near Hwasan to its current location under Paldalsan Mountain in Suwon. Not only did King Jeongjo's filial piety become the basis for the fortress, but it was also built as the center of a political plan containing grand political aspirations to eradicate factional politics caused by party strife and realize strong royal politics, and was intended to be used as a defense fortress south of the capital. Suwon Hwaseong Fortress is a type of fortress that cannot be found in China or Japan, and has both military defense and commercial functions. It can be said to be the best of Oriental castles with the most scientific, rational, and practical facility functions. (Source: Suwon Cultural Foundation website)

수원KT위즈파크는 1989년에 개장한 수원의 야구장으로 온도, 습도, 조.en: Suwon KT Wiz Park is a baseball stadium in Suwon that opened in 1989 and provides an optimal playing environment for both players and visitors by introducing a ubiquitous sensor network system that automatically controls temperature, humidity, and lighting. ICT infrastructure such as wireless Internet has been established within the stadium, allowing various services such as admission registration, parking information, seat search, and food ordering to be conveniently used through mobile devices. Considering the tastes and convenience of visitors, various types of seats are provided, including exciting seats, friendly seats, couple seats, and disabled seats.

수원광교박물관은 광교신도시 조성 시 출토되었던 유물들을 중심으로 광교의.en: Suwon Gwanggyo Museum is composed of the ''Gwanggyo History and Culture Room'', where you can see the history of Gwanggyo at a glance, focusing on relics excavated during the construction of Gwanggyo New Town, the ''Sogang Civil Service Room'', which displays donated materials covering various aspects of Korea's modern history, including politics, society, and culture, and the ''Saun Jonghak Room'', which consists of various donated relics related to the territory including Admiral Yi Sun-sin and Dokdo, and the history of the Japanese invasion. Suwon Gwanggyo Museum is located within Gwanggyo Historical Park, along with historical sites such as Sim On's tomb and Hyeryeong-gun's tomb, and is a cultural space for 1.2 million Suwon citizens where they can learn and relax at the same time. In addition, artifacts from prehistoric times to modern times excavated in the Gwanggyo New Town development area are on display, allowing visitors to explore a variety of history and culture, and experience history and culture through donated artifacts. It is also attracting attention as a place for weekend family outings by providing opportunities for children to encounter and understand the artifacts on display in various ways through the Children's Experience Room.

수원메쎄는 대한민국 1위 전시회 주최사인 메쎄이상과 토지 소유주인 KCC.en: Suwon Messe, an exhibition and convention center, was built by a consortium between Messe Awards, Korea's No. 1 exhibition organizer, and KCC, the land owner. It is the largest exhibition hall in southern Gyeonggi Province and is Korea’s first private convention center operated by the private sector. As this is the first project attempted in Korea, it was built with reference to many overseas operation cases, such as visiting and consulting on the Sands Expo and Convention Center, the first private convention center in the United States at the time of construction. Suwon Messe is located at the top industrial center in Korea, with over 90 industrial complexes within a 30km radius, and is located adjacent to the Suwon Station transfer center, making it easily accessible by public transportation. Suwon Messe has established itself as an exhibition and convention center that turns everything you imagine into reality. Admission fees for exhibitions displayed at Suwon Messe are selected and set by each exhibition host company.

수원문화원은 지역사회 문화진흥을 목적으로 1957년에 설립된 비영리 문화.en: Suwon Cultural Center is a non-profit cultural organization established in 1957 for the purpose of promoting local culture and was established to provide various cultural benefits to citizens. There is a cultural school for the lifelong education of citizens, which opens various courses and runs them all year round, and plays a pivotal role in the cultural development of Suwon by planning and holding cultural events. Major projects include the Daeboreum Folk Game Festival, King Jeongjo's Tomb Road Experience Pilgrimage, Humanities History Tour, Let's Play at Suwon Hwaseong Fortress with Straw Shoes, Suwon Hwaseong Fortress Construction Experience, Special Performances, and New Year's Bell Ringing on New Year's Eve. We are making great efforts to discover local history and preserve and transmit local culture, and we also run cultural and artistic events. By playing a leading role in the restoration of Suwon Fortress, the root of Suwon, it is contributing greatly to the formation of Suwon's modern cultural scene, including contributing to the development of Suwon as a cultural and tourism city by laying a stepping stone to be registered as a World Cultural Heritage.

수원 최초의 시립미술관인 수원시립미술관은 수원 화성행궁 광장에 위치한 문.en: Suwon Museum of Art, Suwon's first municipal art museum, is a cultural and artistic space located in Suwon Hwaseong Temporary Palace Square and aims to provide art for the public, creative art education, and a shared art space. The art museum operates four spaces, including ‘Suwon City Art Museum’, ‘Suwon City Manseok Exhibition Hall (formerly Suwon Art Exhibition Hall)’ located in Manseok Park, ‘Suwon Children’s Art Experience Center (formerly Children’s Ecological Art Experience Center)’ in Pajang-dong, and ‘Suwon City Art Space Gwanggyo’. Based on this, the Suwon Museum of Art is developing into an art museum that cultivates citizens' emotions and represents the metropolitan area through diverse and high-quality exhibitions that take advantage of the characteristics of each museum, exhibitions that can be enjoyed and appreciated, and unique exhibitions based on the region. (Source: Suwon Museum of Art)

수원올림픽공원은 88서울올림픽 개최를 기념해 1987년 수원시청 앞에 조.en: Suwon Olympic Park is a park created in front of Suwon City Hall in 1987 to commemorate the hosting of the 88 Seoul Olympics. It is loved as a resting place for citizens as it has sports facilities such as a badminton court, foot volleyball court, tennis court, and basketball court, as well as a pavilion, a grass plaza, and a pine forest path. In the summer, a water park with water slides, showers, and changing rooms is open, making it great for use with children. Additionally, the dog shelter has separate areas for large dogs and small and medium-sized dogs, so dogs can run around safely.

수원종합운동장은 1971년에 개장한 스포츠 종합 경기장 단지다. 주경기장.en: Suwon Sports Complex is a sports complex that opened in 1971. A variety of sports facilities, including the main stadium, baseball field, indoor gymnasium, and artificial turf field, are gathered in one place and are used as a venue for citizens' health promotion, sports activities, and local community exchange. The main stadium is the home stadium of K-League Suwon FC and is operated as a type 2 stadium certified by the Korea Association of Athletics Federations, and is open to the public for free on days when there are no games. Volleyball games are mainly held at Suwon Gymnasium, and you can enjoy daily sports such as badminton and table tennis at the National Sports Center.

수원컨벤션센터는 2019년 개관한 현대적 컨벤션 시설로, MICE 복합단.en: Suwon Convention Center is a modern convention facility that opened in 2019 and is located within the MICE complex, providing convenient facilities for international conferences, exhibitions, and various business events. It is operated as a space where various MICE events such as international conferences, exhibitions, and forums are held, and efforts are also being made to create a green MICE environment for sustainable operation. Since it is adjacent to Gwanggyo Lake Park, it also serves as a comfortable resting place for citizens.

수원탑동시민농장은 넓은 들판에 계절별 꽃밭을 조성해 시민들이 산책과 휴식.en: Suwon Tapdong Citizen's Farm is a space where citizens can enjoy walking and relaxation by creating seasonal flower gardens in a large field. Every year, various themed flower fields such as cosmos and lotus are operated, and especially in the fall season, the dapsari and reeds are spectacular, attracting many visitors. The four areas of vegetable garden on one side are sold only to Suwon citizens. After receiving an application, only those who are finally selected through a lottery and training can use it, and it must be grown using ecological farming methods that do not use chemical fertilizers and pesticides.

수원 화성 박물관은 화성의 역사와 문화를 총체적으로 보여줄 수 있으며,.en: Suwon Hwaseong Museum is a specialized museum that can comprehensively show the history and culture of Hwaseong, and provides effective and systematic guidance to visitors to Hwaseong, the cultural prosperity of the King Jeongjo era, and the excellence of Hwaseong. Suwon City established Suwon Hwaseong Museum, a UNESCO World Heritage site that is the pride of our nation's cultural heritage, and the Suwon Hwaseong Museum to publicize the excellence of our culture in the late Joseon Dynasty and to create a space where local culture and art can breathe. Hwaseong Fortress is considered a model of military architecture around the world in the 18th century and the flower of the castle culture of the Joseon Dynasty. It is not just a castle, but an entire city. The Hwaseong Museum displays various cultural events through models and relics, including the thoughts and spirit of King Jeongjo, who built Suwon New Town and built Hwaseong, as well as the people who participated in the construction of Hwaseong, Jang Yong-yeong, a soldier stationed in Hwaseong, and King Jeongjo's eight-day journey to Hwaseong.

수종사는 남양주 조안면 송촌리 운길산의 정상 부근에 있는 봉선사의 말사이.en: Sujongsa Temple is a subsidiary temple of Bongseonsa Temple, located near the summit of Ungilsan Mountain in Songchon-ri, Joan-myeon, Namyangju. This temple was once praised by Seo Geo-jeong as having the best view among Eastern temples. It offers a view of Yangsu-ri, where the Bukhan River and Namhan River meet, and even the nearby mountains. It is said that Sujongsa Temple was first built during the Silla Dynasty, but the detailed history is unknown, and there is an anecdote related to King Sejo of the Joseon Dynasty. It is said that while King Sejo was spending a night in Yangsu-ri on his way to Gangwon-do for treatment of a chronic illness, he went to a place where he could hear the soft sound of a bell, and found that there were 18 statues of Arhats in the crypt, and water drops falling from a crevice in the rock made the sound of the bell. Accordingly, there is a legend that King Sejo built a temple to enshrine 18 Arhats and named it Sujongsa Temple. However, the remains of King Sejo's aunt, Princess Jeonggi, in the temple indicate that it was already a sizeable temple before that. Existing temples include Daeungbojeon, Eungjinjeon, Yaksajeon, Sansingak, Jonggak, Gyeonghakwon, and Yosa. Important cultural heritages include the relics in Sujongsa Temple and the Sujongsa Five-story Stone Pagoda, which are designated as treasures. Inside the temple, there is a 500-year-old ginkgo tree that is said to have been given by King Sejo. Although the scenery in all four seasons is beautiful, the scenery in the fall when the leaves change color is known to be especially spectacular. It takes about 15 minutes to walk 400m from the Sujongsa Temple parking lot to the temple.

공작산은 해발 887m로 산 정상에서 바라보면 홍천군 일대가 한눈에 들어.en: Gongjaksan Mountain is 887m above sea level, and when viewed from the top of the mountain, the entire Hongcheon-gun area can be seen at a glance. The mountain was named so because its shape resembles a peacock with its wings spread. Also, when viewed from Hongcheon-eup, it looks like a giant lying down toward the sky. The azaleas in the spring and the autumn leaves in the fall are very beautiful, and the strangely shaped cliffs, bonsai-shaped cypress colonies, and snow-covered winter mountains are also spectacular. Sutasa Valley, which stretches for about 12km from Sutasa Temple to Nocheon-ri, Dongmyeon, has wide rock formations and large ponds forming a mysterious scenery. On both sides of the valley, strangely shaped cliffs and dense forests protect it, so if you take a break here, you can often fall into a state of samadhi. In addition, Sutasa Temple, a thousand-year-old temple located at the end of Gongjaksan Mountain, one of Korea's 100 famous mountains, is the 33rd generation of Silla. It is said to have been founded by Master Wonhyo in the 7th year of King Seongdeok's reign (AD 708). It is the best ancient temple in the inland region of Yeongseo, preserving the hipped roof of Daejeokgwangjeon, bronze bell made in 1364, and three-story stone pagoda, and housing numerous cultural assets, including Wolinseokbo, Daejeokgwangjeon, temple bells, a posthumous Buddhist painting, and Hongwudangbudo.

순천만은 우리나라 남해안 중서부에 위치한 만으로서, 전라남도 순천시와 고.en: Suncheon Bay is a bay located in the midwestern part of the southern coast of Korea, surrounded by Suncheon City, Goheung County, and Yeosu City in South Jeolla Province. The large bay surrounded by the long stretches of Goheung Peninsula and Yeosu Peninsula is sometimes called Suncheon Bay, and the northern sea-level bay surrounded by Inan-dong and Daedae-dong of Suncheon-si and Seonhak-ri and Sangnae-ri of Haeryong-myeon is also called Suncheon Bay. Even if we consider only the seawater area of ​​Suncheon Bay in the administrative district, it is a very large area of ​​over 75㎢. The total area of ​​the tidal flats exposed during low tide reaches 12㎢, and the total area of ​​the tidal flats is 22.6㎢. In addition, from the confluence of Dongcheon and Isacheon in Suncheon to the front of the tidal flat of Suncheon Bay, a huge reed colony with a total area of ​​5.4㎢ is spread out.

스누피 가든 하우스는 감정에 솔직하고 개성 있는 피너츠 친구들을 만나 그.en: Snoopy Garden House is a place where you can meet honest and unique Peanuts friends and receive messages of sympathy and comfort through their mutual relationships. Garden House’s theme hall is a space where you can connect your daily life with the theme of ‘Peanuts, Nature & Life’ and the daily stories contained in Peanuts episodes. As you walk, look, eat, and rest in the five themed halls, Cafe Snoopy, and Peanuts Store, I hope that you will receive a message of rest and comfort through the Peanuts characters. Every Wednesday is pet day, and pets are allowed to enter. Pets must be kept on a leash in the garden out of sight, and riding in a cage/slingback/pet stroller is required indoors (exhibitions, cafes, stores).

스타필드 고양은 서울과 경기 서북부를 연결하는 관문적 위치에 있다. 북한.en: Starfield Goyang is located at a gateway connecting Seoul and northwestern Gyeonggi Province. The beautiful natural environment of Bukhansan Mountain and traditional Korean architectural motifs, such as castles, towering gates, and watchtowers, were reinterpreted in a modern way and incorporated into architectural design. From trendy fashion and beauty specialty stores to reasonably priced warehouse hypermarkets and upgraded markets, you can enjoy a variety of shopping and leisure cultures comfortably and comfortably in one space. The whole family can make precious memories together, with an Aqua Field where you can enjoy hot spring water all year round, a cinema with the latest facilities, a complex play area for children, and various specialized service facilities. (Source: Starfield Goyang website)

스타필드 중 5번째로 개장한 스타필드 수원은 플래그십 스토어, 열린 문화.en: Starfield Suwon, the fifth Starfield to open, is an 8-story complex shopping mall center consisting of a flagship store, the open cultural space Byulmadang Library, and about 80 various stores. Starfield Suwon is a place that many people visit because they can enjoy food, beverages, and cultural activities all in one place. Stores of various categories such as large supermarkets, restaurants and cafes, beauty, fashion clothing, and lifestyle are lined up. By introducing a complex space that combines carefully selected flagship stores and pop-up stores with entertainment, it provides an extraordinary experience of feeling the brand identity by directly seeing, hearing, and touching.

스타필드 시티 위례는 쇼핑, 문화, 휴식까지 삶에 필요한 모든 것이 한.en: Starfield City Wirye is a new type of urban lifestyle mall where everything you need for life, including shopping, culture, and relaxation, can be found in one place. We propose happiness that can be enjoyed in everyday life through accessibility close to the city and comfortable space aesthetics on a human scale. From movie theaters, bookstores, trendy restaurants, E-Mart Traders, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle, it is a one-stop shopping paradise that satisfies both cost-effectiveness and convenience. At Starfield City, performances for children are held every week, and there is a pet park on the 10th floor rooftop garden where dogs can play without a leash. ※ Information on traveling with dogs - Only vaccinated pets (dogs, cats) are allowed on leashes or accompanied by cages - However, fierce dogs are not allowed (Tosa dog, American pit bull terrier, American Staffordshire terrier, Staffordshire bull terrier, Rottweiler, Dogs such as Dogo Argentino, Fila Brasilei, English Bull Terrier and their mixed breeds, and other dogs with a high risk of attacking and injuring people) - The leash is adjusted and fixed within 1.5m for safety - Entry standards vary by store.

스타필드 안성은 쇼핑·레저·엔터테인먼트가 결합된 경기 남부권 복합쇼핑테마.en: Starfield Anseong is a complex shopping theme park in the southern part of Gyeonggi Province that combines shopping, leisure, and entertainment. Equipped with Traders, Megabox, and Aquafield, you can enjoy shopping and leisure in one place, and with a family zone-centered structure, it is actively used by families. There are experiential spaces such as Byul Madang Kids and Pet Park, and the food zone featuring major restaurants across the country is also popular. From the 63m observatory, you can view the entire Anseong area, increasing the satisfaction of your visit.

스타필드 마켓 일산점은 기존 ‘더 타운 몰’을 리뉴얼해 선보인 복합쇼핑몰.en: Starfield Market Ilsan Branch is a shopping mall complex introduced by renewing the existing ‘The Town Mall’. Rest and cultural spaces such as the Book Ground and Kids Ground were expanded to enhance experience elements for family visitors. Traders and Electro Mart are located on the first basement level, and retail and F&B stores are located on the first and second ground floors. In addition, various brands such as Daiso, Olive Young, and Musinsa Standard are located here, making it ideal for enjoying shopping and leisure in one place.

스타필드 시티 부천은 지역 쇼핑복합센터로, 일상에 필요한 생활밀착형 쇼핑.en: Starfield City Bucheon is a regional shopping complex that serves as a lifestyle-friendly shopping infrastructure necessary for daily life. A shopping environment where people stay is created by adding experiential content such as F&B, a book cafe-type space, and a kids zone to the sales-oriented structure. Convenience facilities such as a hospital, dental clinic, beauty salon, fitness club, daycare center, and playground are all located in one place, making it convenient to use. In addition, various pop-up stores are periodically operated to expand the range of experiences for visitors.

스토리 미니어처 뮤지엄은 파주시 헤이리 예술마을에 위치한 박물관으로, 아.en: Story Miniature Museum is a museum located in Heyri Art Village, Paju City, and was established within Aji-dong Theme Park. Ajidong Theme Park is a company that develops customized content under the Korean theme park brand Ajidong and conducts business such as theme parks, characters, entertainment, trade, and venture business support and fostering. The Story Miniature Museum is comprised of artists from Heyri Village with a 20-year history and artists from Switzerland, Germany, Taiwan, France, and Korea who love art, giving messages of love and hope through music boxes, artists' dolls, fairy tale dioramas, and miniatures. The exhibition room is comprised of a music box zone that reminds us of the importance of human life and nature, a fairy tale zone that takes you to the world of the deepest, a Nutcracker zone that represents the dolls that come to mind in winter, a miniature village Dream Village zone, a ball-jointed doll zone with free joint movement, and a world doll zone that depicts traditional costumes of each country with Madame Alexander's dolls on a world map. It is enough space to create unforgettable memories with your children.

경기도 남양주시 다산동에 위치한 스파디움24는 24시간 이용 가능한 찜질.en: Spadium 24, located in Dasan-dong, Namyangju-si, Gyeonggi-do, is a 24-hour jjimjil spa facility where you can enjoy not only a jjimjilbang but also cultural facilities. The sauna has a variety of facilities, including a book cafe, lounge, and active zone, so you can experience everything in one place. It is designed to provide a variety of ways to relax for those who want a quiet and comfortable vacation. It is a good place to visit if you want to escape from the daily life of the city and enjoy relaxation and healing in nature.

스플라스 리솜은 약 600년의 오랜 역사를 간직한 용출온도 49.6도에.en: Splace Resom is a complex relaxation space where you can enjoy a water park, spa, and resort all at once with Deoksan hot spring water with a gushing temperature of 49.6 degrees, with a long history of about 600 years. Hot spring water from the government-designated recreational hot spring is supplied to all 406 rooms as well as all water play facilities in the water park, including 15 outdoor baths, water slides, and bade pools, so you can enjoy hot spring water all year round at Splace. In particular, the hot spring water here contains a large amount of silica along with various minerals such as silicon, calcium, and magnesium, which are helpful for skin care, anti-aging, strengthening blood vessels, increasing immunity, and relieving arthritis pain. In addition, there are a variety of things to enjoy, including Lara Golf Club, My Little Place, and Mini Car Land. The resort rooms are composed of six types of rooms, allowing various customer groups such as friends, couples, and families to comfortably stay in a suitable space.

수원시 장안구 송정로에 있는 슬기샘어린이도서관은 2005년 11월 개관,.en: The Seulgi Saem Children's Library, located in Songjeong-ro, Jangan-gu, Suwon, opened in November 2005 and has a children's science exploration center, a multimedia room, exciting space travel, and a variety of up-to-date information contents, playing a role in expanding the knowledge and information of children who are interested in space science. In addition, it is a place where you can experience various things through reading culture programs. The Wise Saem Children's Library also serves as a knowledge information and cultural space established to help children, who can be said to be the future dreamers of Suwon, grow into wise, wise, and upright children. By carrying out various reading culture programs with a library of approximately 140,000 books, we aim to encourage growing youngsters to have dreams, hopes, and curiosity, thereby improving their cultural experience and information mindset in the coming knowledge and information era.

수면 전문 브랜드 시몬스 테라스점은 침대 플래그십 스토어이다. 단순히 침.en: Simmons Terrace, a sleep specialty brand, is a bed flagship store. Beyond simply promoting a bed brand, it is a well-decorated cultural and artistic space. The process of testing beds and the history of beds are on display, and there are plenty of things to enjoy, including Mattress Lab, Heritage Alley where you can see the history at a glance, a hotel-concept showroom, and an outdoor terrace and cafe. It is famous for its large decorated trees during the Christmas season.

시화호는 경기도 시흥시, 안산시, 화성시에 만들어진 인공호수이다. 시화호.en: Sihwa Lake is an artificial lake created in Siheung-si, Ansan-si, and Hwaseong-si, Gyeonggi-do. The name Sihwa Lake is derived from the first letters of Siheung City and Hwaseong City, which are the two ends of the entire seawall. Sihwa Lake once had many problems due to water pollution, but through systematic management to create a space that citizens can use with peace of mind, including establishing a continuous improvement and management system for water quality and maximizing the use of basin resources through restoration and management of the Sihwa Lake ecosystem, it has become a habitat for birds and mudflat creatures that are protected as natural monuments, such as whooper swans, ring-tailed curlews, little plovers, yellow-billed spoonbills, and black-fronted plovers. The tidal power plant installed in the middle of Sihwa Lake can supply households in a city with a population of 500,000. Sihwanarae Rest Area, which can be found while driving along the Sihwa Seawall Road, is crowded with people on weekends visiting the Moon Observatory, which offers a panoramic view of the Sihwa Seawall area. Sihwa Narae Moon Observatory is a local landmark that offers a view of Sihwa Lake and the West Sea. The view from 75 meters high is overwhelming, and the observatory, which resembles a spaceship, is made of tempered glass, so the floor is clearly visible. Below the Moon Observatory is Sihwa Narae Tidal Park, an eco-friendly marine park created using soil and sand generated during construction with the theme of the West Sea waves and the circulation of new and renewable energy, making it a great place to take a walk.

갯골생태공원은 150만 평의 폐염전 부지에 깊숙한 내만갯벌로 형성된 습지.en: Gaetgol Ecological Park is a wetland formed by the deep inner bay tidal flat on the site of a 1.5 million pyeong abandoned salt farm. It was created using the natural ecological resources of the Naeman Tidal Valley and the cultural heritage of an old salt farm. It is a treasure trove of living, breathing natural ecology, and is an eco-friendly ecological park where nature and people come together to provide relaxation to citizens. The tidal channel shows a large difference in tides, a characteristic of the west coast, and the tidal valley and grassland communities formed here show a rare distribution of diverse organisms, and old salt farm sites and salt warehouses bear traces of a disappearing coastal culture. Here, you can observe halophytes such as chives, snails, and sea urchins, as well as various creatures such as red-footed sea crabs and blue crabs. Siheung Gaetgol is a grade 1 ecological environment area in Siheung City due to its beautiful scenery and ecological excellence, and was designated as a national marine wetland protection area in February 2012.

시흥ABC행복학습타운은 전국 최초·최대 3세대가 소통하고, 학습하고, 공.en: Siheung ABC Happy Learning Town is the nation's first and largest complex space of learning, culture, and art where three generations communicate, learn, build a community, and grow. It is a space for learning and growth through learning, a space for communication and empathy through culture and arts, and a community space for three generations to get along. It is conveniently accessible from the city center and close to Sorae Mountain, so the surrounding environment is pleasant. It is equipped with cultural facilities, sports facilities, forest bathing areas, etc. and offers a variety of learning programs.

시흥문화원은 시흥의 전통문화를 개발 및 연구, 조사하고, 문화 및 사회사.en: Siheung Cultural Center was established in 1996 to develop, research, and investigate Siheung's traditional culture and to organize cultural and social projects. On the first floor of the Cultural Center, there is a Siheung History Data Exhibition Hall that opened in May 2003, where various relics showing the history and culture of Siheung are displayed. Siheung Cultural Center operates the Siheung Cultural Heritage Research Group, Lifelong Learning Education Center, Siheung People Promotion Project Promotion Committee, and Festival Promotion Committee. In addition, it holds cultural classes for citizens every year and publishes Siheung Culture as a periodical. Siheung Cultural Center holds the Yeonseong Cultural Festival every year at Siheung Gwangokji Lotus Theme Park. Since it is a famous area for lotus flowers, there are many unique experiences related to it. Various performances and traditional experience programs are prepared, so there are many things to see and enjoy.
