Humanities walking lectures are also held in the first and second half of the year, helping people enjoy culture and increase their level of common sense on the topics of travel, art, and music, which are food for the mind. Siheung Cultural Center is significant as the only comprehensive culture and arts institution in the Siheung region that is leading the preservation and transmission of local traditional culture and the development and promotion of local culture and arts.

성남시 수정구 적푸리로에 위치한 신구대학교식물원은 식물자원을 개발하고 연.en: Shingu University Botanical Garden, located in Jeokpuri-ro, Sujeong-gu, Seongnam-si, opened in May 2003 for the purpose of developing and researching plant resources, and systematically collects, preserves, and exhibits domestic and foreign plants. In addition to plant research, it serves as a practical training center for related departments, as well as gardening-related education and various educational programs that allow ordinary citizens to observe and directly experience nature. The garden cafe located at the entrance has a direct view of the central plaza of the beautiful forest exhibition hall, and the combination of bright flowers creates a leisurely atmosphere. It is a place where plant resources are discovered and researched by systematically collecting, preserving, and exhibiting domestic and foreign plants. It is training arboretum experts (garders) recognized by the country (Korea Forest Service). In addition, by providing plant-related vocational education and environmental education for youth and general citizens, we are contributing to the development of plant culture by providing a place to observe and directly experience nature.

신륵사는 봉미산 기슭에 위치한 여주의 대표적인 사찰이다. 오랜 역사와 웅.en: Silleuksa Temple is a representative temple in Yeoju, located at the foot of Bongmisan Mountain. It boasts a long history, grand scale, and outstanding scenery. It is a branch temple of Yongjusa Temple, the headquarters of the second diocese of the Jogye Order of Korean Buddhism, and has been designated as a traditional temple in Gyeonggi Province. In general, temples are often built in the mountains, but in rare cases, they were built on the riverside overlooking the Namhan River. It is said that it was founded by Master Wonhyo during the reign of King Jinpyeong of Silla, but there is no clear evidence. It is famous as the place where Zen Master Naong stayed during the late Goryeo Dynasty, and is said to have been a large temple spanning over 200 rooms. In the third year of King Seongjong's reign (1472) of the Joseon Dynasty, it was used as a temple for Yeongneung, the tomb of King Sejong the Great, and was called Boeunsa Temple. However, after its significance as a temple faded, it returned to the name Silleuksa Temple. It was also called Byeokjeol because it had a multi-story pagoda made of bricks. It takes about 13 minutes by car from Yeoju IC and Seoyeoju IC. The area around Silleuksa Temple has been developed as a national tourist site, and there are many restaurants nearby, and it is also close to Yeoju Ceramics World, which has the largest ceramics specialty shopping mall in Korea, and the Hwangpo Sailboat Cruise Ship.

신리성지는 한국 천주교의 대표적인 성지중 하나로, 당시, 천주교가 조선.en: Sinri Shrine is one of the representative sacred sites of Korean Catholicism. It is a historical site where priests and believers who played a major role in establishing Catholicism in every corner of Joseon were martyred. When Catholicism began to enter Joseon, Sinri Village was the first area to accept its doctrine, and later, Sinri Village became known as the area that played the biggest role in establishing Catholicism in Joseon. Beautiful and sacred spaces such as Bishop Davlu's retreat, the saints' chapel, the Martyrs' Memorial Hall, and the Martyrs' Art Museum are located in and around the Sinri Shrine.

신세계백화점은 1960년대 초반 근대 백화점의 개념을 처음 도입하고 최초.en: Shinsegae Department Store first introduced the concept of a modern department store in the early 1960s and established the first direct management system. The main branch of Shinsegae Department Store is a symbolic place that represents the traditions and values ​​of Shinsegae. It is the site of the Gyeongseong branch of Mitsukoshi, Korea's first department store, and its long history can be felt in the old, antique architecture. After remodeling in 2007, it is now a luxury hall that claims to be a cultural space. The newly opened main store is a space where you can find brands that enhance the quality of shopping, including the world's three major luxury goods, Hermes, Chanel, and Louis Vuitton, as well as Giorgio Armani Black Label, Denimmania, and Shoeholic, which are exclusively presented by Shinsegae. The editorial store Boon The Shop & Company is operated on the 5th floor to provide differentiated shopping services. Boon the Shop, which can be said to be the original select store in Korea, has been upgraded to include products from young brands and emerging designers. The main store provides a space where shopping and culture come together. Trinity Garden on the 6th floor is famous as a sculpture park where works of art by world-renowned masters are displayed. Works by famous artists such as Alexander Calder, Joan Miró, and Henry Moore, the father of British sculpture, are on display. Water flows between the sculptures and benches are placed here and there, so you can take a break while appreciating the works of art after shopping. Through works that combine traditional and modern aesthetics, we strive to become a cultural space that provides relaxation and inspiration beyond a shopping space.

세계 최대의 백화점으로 기네스북에 오른 신세계 센텀시티는 백화점과 아이스.en: Shinsegae Centum City, listed in the Guinness Book of World Records as the world's largest department store, is the world's largest shopping complex with a department store, ice rink, movie theater, golf range, and Aqualand. Shinsegae Department Store Centum City Branch has 2 underground floors and 9 above-ground floors, with a store area of ​​approximately 126,612 m2 and a total floor area of ​​approximately 293,904 m2. It is a cultural city that contains all the values ​​that enrich our lives, including architecture, art, shopping, and entertainment. There are women's clothing, men's clothing, cosmetics and miscellaneous goods brands, and sports stores. In addition to the stores, there are coral plaza, centum plaza, children's theme park, clothing repair shop, specialty restaurants, dining, cafes, spa land, ice rink, movie theater, etc.

신세계백화점 의정부점은 경기 북부의 대표백화점이다. 의정부시 및 인근 양.en: Shinsegae Department Store Uijeongbu Branch is the representative department store in northern Gyeonggi Province. It is easy to visit from Uijeongbu City and nearby Yangju City, Pocheon City, and Dongducheon City. You can enter the main floor of the 3rd floor of the department store from Uijeongbu Station on Subway Line 1. With a total of 10 floors, various categories such as luxury goods, cosmetics, fashion, F&B, and food markets can be used in one place. Convenient facilities such as a theater, bookstore, hair shop, nail shop, and academy are also included, providing a complex shopping environment that satisfies both shopping and leisure needs.

인천 중구 신포동 일대의 신포시장은 19세기 말 이곳에 자리 잡은 일본인.en: Sinpo Market, located in Sinpo-dong, Jung-gu, Incheon, is said to have started as a place selling high-quality vegetables to Japanese, Chinese, and Westerners who settled here in the late 19th century. As the number of tourists and international merchants visiting Incheon via car ferries and cruise ships increased significantly every year, Sinpo Market, located a short distance from the International Passenger Terminal, was created as an international merchant market linking multinational cultures. In addition, an information desk and self-office will be set up within Sinpo Market to create an international merchant support center, providing trade information, shopping and tourist information, and interpretation to domestic and foreign small traders and tourists visiting Sinpo Market. Sinpo Market continued its existence as small stores gathered one by one during the Japanese colonial period. It was officially registered as a market in 1970 and is currently home to a variety of stores.

실학박물관은 2009년 개관이래 실학 관련 유물과 자료를 수집/보존하며,.en: Since its opening in 2009, the Silhak Museum is the only Silhak-related museum in Korea that has been collecting/preserving and researching/exhibiting Silhak-related relics and materials. As a museum solely focused on Silhak, you can learn, practice, and experience everything about Silhak. In particular, a variety of experience programs are provided for children, and in the special exhibition room on the first floor and exhibition rooms 1 to 3 on the second floor, you can learn from the formation to development of Silhak with beautiful, eye-catching videos. Silhak Cinema, which depicts the stories of Silhak scholars Jeong Yak-yong and Jeong Yak-jeon in animation, provides an exciting time for not only children but also adults. It is not a museum just for viewing, but a museum with everything about Silhak that satisfies the five senses of seeing, hearing, and touching. After viewing the exhibition room, you can experience making a fan, a sundial bracelet, and a rubbing on the first floor. To watch the regular tour while listening to explanations from a professional commentator, just show up on time, whether on weekdays or weekends, without a separate reservation. In addition to regular exhibitions, special exhibitions related to Silhak on various topics are held semi-annually. Right next to the museum are the Jeong Yak-yong Historic Site, the Literature Museum, and the Memorial Hall, so it's a good idea to explore them together.

쌍계사는 신라 성덕왕 21년 삼법스님이 유학을 마치고 돌아올 때, 중국불.en: Ssanggyesa Temple is a temple that was built in the 21st year of King Seongdeok of Silla when the monk Sambeop returned from studying abroad, bringing with him the relics of Huineng, the 6th ancestor of the Zen sect of Chinese Buddhism, and enshrining them. In the 2nd year of King Munseong's reign (840), Jingam Seonsa Hyeso called it Okcheonsa Temple, but it was changed to Ssanggyesa Temple in the 2nd year of King Jeonggang's reign. Ssanggyesa Temple, which burned down during the Japanese invasions of Korea, was rebuilt in 1632 (the 10th year of King Injo’s reign) by Byeok-am Daesa. Among the attractions, the cherry blossoms at Ssanggyesa Temple are especially famous, and other famous places include the Ssanggyeseokmun with the handwriting of the late Choi Chi-won, the Daegongtap Stele of Zen Master Jingam, the natural elm tree in the courtyard of Guksamam in the north, and Bulil Falls, which spans the two valleys of Cheonghakbong and Baekhakbong to the northeast. Meanwhile, Ssanggyesa Temple is a place with a deep connection with tea. It is said that in the 3rd year of the reign of King Heungdeok of Silla (828), Kim Dae-ryeom went as an envoy to the Tang Dynasty and brought the first tea tree seeds and planted them in the area of ​​Ssanggyesa Temple south of Jiri Mountain by royal order.

그리스 산토리니 마을의 건축 미학을 담은 쏠비치 호텔&리조트 삼척은 하얀.en: Sol Beach Hotel & Resort Samcheok, which embodies the architectural aesthetics of the Greek village of Santorini, is inspired by the Greek Cyclatic architectural style, which stands out with its white exterior walls and blue roofs, and blends well with the fantastic sea view. If you slow down step by step to the rhythm of the clear and transparent jade-colored waves, your mind will be healed before you know it. The resort has food and beverage facilities such as restaurants, cafes, and pubs, as well as spas, saunas, shopping, and recreational facilities, so you can enjoy a variety of fun and relaxation.

여주 한글시장 골목에 자리한 씽씽스튜디오는 사장의 젊은 감각과 장인 정신.en: SingSing Studio, located in an alley of Yeoju Hangeul Market, is a unique select shop that combines the owner's youthful sense and craftsmanship. In a sophisticated space like a ‘small art gallery’ in a traditional market, you can find a variety of props containing Yeoju, such as Yeoju rice soap and specialty erasers. In particular, the engraving service, which engraves names or anniversaries on wooden items such as wooden cutting boards, is popular with visitors looking for special travel souvenirs.

아그로랜드 태신목장은 한국 낙농업의 태동기라 할 수 있는 1968년에 설.en: Agroland Taesin Ranch was established in 1968, the birthplace of Korea's dairy industry, and moved to its current location in 1978. In 2004, we began operating a dairy farming experience ranch and opened it to allow visitors to experience a ranch with various livestock. It provides a place to experience the idyllic scenery of a green meadow and with cows in nature. The facilities are diverse, including a ranch experience center, horseback riding experience center, sculpture park, wild flower garden, grassland experience center, ecological pond and walking path, animal farm, budgie cage, Korean beef pasture, and arborvitae maze. Experience programs include riding a tractor train, milking a cow, ranch experience, horseback riding, and ice cream making. Nearby are Myeoncheon-eupseong Fortress, Myeoncheonhyanggyo Confucian School, Hapdeokje Waterside Park, and Hapdeoksuri Folk Museum.

아난티 앳 부산 코브는 부산의 숨은 아름다운 해변을 품은 기장에 위치해.en: Ananti at Busan Cove is located in Gijang, a beautiful hidden beach in Busan, where you can enjoy an exotic and unique experience with the differentiated concept, scale, and service of ‘a perfect resting place in the city’. Ananti at Busan Cove is located in Ananti Cove in the Osiria Tourist Complex, which has recently been in the spotlight as a new tourist attraction in Busan, and has geographical advantages and convenient accessibility to Haeundae Beach, Centum City, and BEXCO. Rooms are equipped with private balconies, so you can enjoy an open ocean view or mountain view with a clear blue sky in the background. You can experience trendy dining at a live cooking station that crosses the East and West, and a multi-party restaurant, and enjoy afternoon tea for a leisurely afternoon at McQueen's Lounge. It has a large banquet hall facing the ocean and space for meetings and events. The grand ballroom can accommodate up to 1,500 people and offers a beautiful ocean view. In particular, you can have a private and exotic wedding at the wedding chapel and ocean terrace with sea views. In the summer, you can choose from an infinity pool that looks like it's facing the sea, an infinity pool for adults only, a kids' pool, or a jacuzzi, depending on your preference, and auxiliary facilities such as a fitness center, sauna, and therapy room are also provided. In winter, there is Ananti Waterhouse, where you can enjoy a natural hot spring bath, and Eternity Journey, which is filled with domestic and foreign books and various props, so you can experience leisure and culture at the same time. In addition, there are a variety of retail shops that will awaken your senses against the background of the coastal promenade along the sea, making it perfect for light shopping during your trip. The bakery cafe Cabine de Poisson, where you can enjoy the sea from up close, is a popular spot to stop by and relax after a walk. Please note that the third Tuesday of every month is a regular holiday.

아르떼뮤지엄 강릉은 디스트릭트가 2021년 12월 강릉 경포호 인근에서.en: Arte Museum Gangneung is the third immersive media art permanent exhibition hall to be presented by District near Gyeongpo Lake in Gangneung in December 2021. In Gangneung, the best of the Eight Scenic Views of the Gwandong Province, under the theme of VALLEY, 12 colorful media art exhibitions reflecting the regional characteristics of Gangwon-do and Gangneung, the backbone of the Baekdudaegan Mountain Range, will be held in a space of 1,500 pyeong. Works created with the theme of ETERNAL NATURE provide a completely immersive experience with visual intensity, sensuous sound, and elegant scent.

국내최대몰입형 미디어아트전시관 아르떼뮤지엄 아르떼뮤지엄은 코엑스 ‘WAV.en: Arte Museum, Korea's Largest Immersive Media Art Exhibition Arte Museum is Korea's largest immersive media art exhibition hall presented by d'strict, a world-class digital design company famous for its COEX 'WAVE' work. In a magnificent space measuring 1,400 pyeong and up to 10 meters, which was used as a speaker manufacturing factory, 16 colorful media art exhibitions created by light and sound are held.

아모레퍼시픽 팩토리 투어는 기업의 핵심 생산 기지인 아모레 뷰티 파크 내.en: The Amore Pacific Factory Tour is a program that tours some facilities within Amore Beauty Park, the company's core production base. The tour is conducted in the form of a free tour, and usually follows the order of raw material garden, archive, and factory. The raw material botanical garden is planted with numerous plants that are used as raw materials for Amore Pacific products, and is decorated in the form of a garden with a pond, greenhouse, and exhibition gallery, so there is a lot to see. Another feature is that the number of people entering is limited, making it easy to view at your leisure. You can look at the product production story at the factory and various materials about the brand at the archive.

아침 고요수목원은 축령산의 빼어난 자연경관을 배경으로 하여 한국의 미를.en: The Morning Calm Arboretum is a horticultural arboretum designed by horticulturally harmonizing gardens filled with Korean beauty, with the outstanding natural scenery of Mt. Chukryeong as the background. It has a variety of unique gardens, and you can enjoy forest bathing under a dense pine tree forest, providing a resting place for city residents. It was named by the designer (Han Sang-kyung, professor of horticulture at Sahmyook University) and opened in May 1996. The 20 themed gardens are connected by beautifully maintained lawns, flower beds, and natural walking paths. In particular, the Sunken Garden, which depicts Korea's beautiful Geumsugangsan Mountain in the shape of the actual terrain of the Korean Peninsula and depicts it with flowers at their peak, is the place that attracts the most attention from tourists. In addition, here you can see over 5,000 species of plants, including over 300 species from Baekdu Mountain. Starting with the movie ‘Letter’, the movies ‘Detective Joseon’, ‘Addiction’, the dramas ‘My Golden Life’, ‘Let’s Hold Hands and Watch the Sunset’, ‘Jugglers’, ‘Monarch’, ‘Black’, ‘School 2017’, ‘The King Loves’, ‘Introverted Boss’, It is known as a filming location for ‘Moonlight Drawn by Clouds,’ ‘Smile, Donghae,’ ‘You’re Beautiful,’ ‘This Man of Love,’ the entertainment show ‘Infinite Challenge,’ and the documentary ‘The Best Success Documentary,’ and many tourists visit. ◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave The ‘Arboretum of Morning Calm,’ which is a filming location for numerous historical dramas such as <Moonlight Drawn by Clouds> and <Moonlight Drawn by Clouds>, is also a filming location for entertainment shows. It is a botanical garden where you can see over 5,000 different types of plants. In spring, summer, and fall, you can see a garden of different colors depending on the season, and in winter, the Five-Colored Starlight Garden Exhibition is displayed with colorful lights. This is one of the tourist destinations that has been loved by Koreans for a very long time. I recommend taking the time to fall in love with nature at this beautiful botanical garden, which shows different appearances each season.

아쿠아플라넷 여수는 전남 여수시 여수 신항 제2부두 인근에 자리한 국내.en: Aqua Planet Yeosu is the second-largest aquarium in Korea, located near Pier 2 of Yeosu New Port in Yeosu-si, Jeollanam-do, and is Asia's largest premium marine theme park. Aqua refers to the grandeur of the sea and the encounter between marine science and humans, and Planet has the meaning of ‘allowing visitors to enjoy the concept of cutting-edge science that can only be felt at Aqua Planet as if they were exploring a space planet themselves.’ We aim to publicize the value of marine culture and ecosystem conservation to the public by showing various marine ecosystems that are not easily accessible in daily life. Aqua Planet Yeosu, designated as the main viewing facility for the ‘2012 Yeosu World Expo’, is an eco-friendly aquarium powered by solar power generation and operates differentiated experiential exhibition spaces such as ‘Ocean Life’, ‘Marine Life’, and ‘Aqua Forest’ on each floor. Over 55,000 marine creatures of over 300 species live here, and species conservation research is being conducted on endangered species such as ‘beluga (white whale)’ and ‘green sea turtle’.

아쿠아플라넷 일산은 경기도 고양 한류월드 조성부지 인근에 자리한 수도권.en: Aqua Planet Ilsan is the largest aquarium in the metropolitan area, located near the Hallyu World construction site in Goyang, Gyeonggi-do, and is particularly notable for being the first aquarium in Korea to combine an indoor zoo. Marine and land creatures from all over the world move in, allowing you to see a variety of creatures such as walruses, ring-tailed lemurs, and hyacinth macaws all in one place. In particular, you can experience a variety of contents that are both fun and educational by operating an amazing magic performance in the large aquarium Deep Blue Ocean, an ocean arena where various ecological briefings are held, and a tree shelter where you can meet animal friends living in the jungle. In addition, it operates a subsidiary business and gift shop.

아해한국전통문화어린이박물관은 유아, 초등학생을 대상으로 한 전통놀이감을.en: Ahae Korean Traditional Culture Children’s Museum is a museum that displays traditional toys for infants and elementary school students. Among the names of the Ahae Korean Traditional Culture Children's Museum, Ahae is the pure Korean word for child. This museum collects, preserves, and exhibits toys from Korea's 5,000-year history, reminding visitors that traditional toys are also a valuable part of history. In the permanent exhibition hall, they are categorized into Bangnori, Skynori, Fieldnori, and Seodangnori. The special exhibition room and educational space provide opportunities to experience etiquette, traditional food, and Korean art. Outdoors, yard toys and forest toys are on display so you can experience a variety of games, and an Ahae forest path has been created.

부산 기장 철마면 아홉산 자락에 위치한 숲으로, 훼손되지 않은 자연환경과.en: This forest is located at the foot of Nine Mountain in Cheolma-myeon, Gijang, Busan, and is a place where you can experience undamaged natural environment and ecology. Artificial forests such as bamboo forests, cypress forests, cedar trees, and ginkgo trees, and natural forests including Geumgang pine trees, which are 100 to 300 years old, make up the Nine Mountain Forest. The total area is a whopping 520,000 ㎡, and it is a private forest that has been maintained for about 400 years. For nature protection, only a limited number of people who have made a reservation in advance are allowed to enter. Unlike amusement parks or amusement parks, viewing is possible only as long as it does not damage nature, but there are also forest experience and play programs for children, and you can also listen to forest explanations.

하회마을은 풍산 류 (柳)씨가 대대로 살아오던 전형적인 집성촌으로 한국.en: Hahoe Village is a typical village where the Pungsan Ryu clan has lived for generations, and is a village where the beauty of traditional Korean houses lives on. Hahoe Village in Andong, which is also the birthplace of the great Confucian scholars of the Joseon Dynasty, Gyeom Ryu Un-ryong and Seoae Ryu Seong-ryong, became even more famous when Queen Elizabeth II of England visited Korea on April 21, 1999, on the third day of her visit, as the home of Korean tradition. The name Hahoe (河回) here comes from the fact that the Nakdong River flows east, forms an S shape, and surrounds the village. To the east, there is a volcano that is a branch of Taebaeksan Mountain, and the end of its trunk extends all the way to the village, forming a very low hill. Because the houses are arranged toward a low area centered on a hill, the left direction of the houses is not constant, and the houses are located in each of the north, south, east and west. In the center of the village, the Ryu family's home is a large tile-roofed house, surrounded by well-preserved thatched-roof houses. The Nakdong River flowing leisurely in front of the village, the beautifully shaped Buyongdae, the endless white sand beach, and the dense old pine forest form a spectacular view. Meanwhile, the waterway in front of Buyongdae has been reopened and ferry boats can be used. In Hahoe Village, the Hahoe Byeolsingut Talnori is held as a permanent performance, and the Andong International Mask Dance Festival is held every fall. The surrounding area has many attractions, including Bongjeongsa Temple, which is said to have been founded during the Silla Dynasty, Gosan Seowon, Gwiraejeong, Gyemyeongsan Mountain Natural Recreation Forest, Hakgasan Natural Recreation Forest, and Waryongsan Mountain. In particular, on July 31, 2010, Hahoe Village in Andong and Yangdong Village in Gyeongju were registered as UNESCO World Heritage Sites as ‘Korean Historical Villages.’ With the registration of the two villages, Korea's World Heritage Sites include Seokguram Grotto, Bulguksa Temple, Haeinsa Tripitaka Koreana, Jongmyo Shrine (1995), Changdeokgung Palace, Suwon Hwaseong (1997), Gyeongju Historic Sites, Gochang, Hwasun, and Ganghwa Dolmen Sites (2000), and Jeju Volcanic Island and Lava Tube (2007). Following the Joseon Royal Tombs (2009), it became the 10th World Heritage Site in total. Hahoe Village's representative foods include Andong soju, Heotjesatbab, which is said to have originated from the many famous Seowons, Andong minced mackerel, and Andong Guksi. ◎ Travel information to experience the charm of the Korean Wave - Drama <Ghost> Numerous fireworks approach on a rope from a cliff 64 meters above sea level. A fire egg floats leisurely in the river, and large fireworks fall like a waterfall down the cliff, accompanied by the sound of ‘fallen flower!’ Seonyu Julbulnori, a Korean-style fireworks festival, is a huge purification ritual that embodies the wishes of those gathered there. Gu San-yeong, who is determined to live entirely of her own will and not for anyone else, smiles brightly in a place where her hopes and wishes shine like starlight even in the midst of the crisis of blindness.

강원 강릉시 견소동에 위치한 길이 500m, 2만㎡의 백사장이 있는 안목.en: Anmok Beach, located in Gyeonso-dong, Gangneung-si, Gangwon-do, has a 500m long, 20,000m2 white sand beach and is a suitable place for families to enjoy a vacation. Anmok Port is right next to the beach, and 23 fishing boats return to port at 9 a.m., catching seaweed in the spring, flounder, flounder, squid, octopus, and clams in the summer, and sandfish, pollack, and rockfish in the fall and winter. At the end of August, when the summer vacation season ends, mackerel chase after anchovies to eat them, and it is often the case that schools of anchovies that wash up on the beach are scooped up with gourds or bandeaus. Additionally, this place has a coffee street where you can enjoy coffee, and is famous as a beach where you can enjoy coffee with a sea view.

안반데기는 해발 1,100m 고산지대로, 떡메로 반죽을 칠 때 사용하는.en: Anbandegi is an alpine area 1,100 meters above sea level, and its name comes from ‘Anban’, a concave and wide wooden base used to knead dough with a rice cake batter, and ‘Degi’, which means flat ground. Beginning in 1965, slash-and-burn farmers settled down by clearing land and clearing the mountains. The steep slopes made mechanical farming impossible, so the fields were cultivated entirely by human power. In 1995, about 28 households of residents, who had farmed the fields for generations, officially purchased the land and became actual owners. This land, measuring about 2 million square meters, has transformed a barren mountainous area into a rich highland cabbage field. Beyond a simple cabbage field, Anbandegi is attracting attention as a landscape created by human labor.

안산농수산물도매시장은 경기도 안산시 상록구에 위치한 도매시장이다. 이른.en: Ansan Agricultural and Marine Products Wholesale Market is a wholesale market located in Sangnok-gu, Ansan-si, Gyeonggi-do. Direct auctions take place early in the morning, and general sales are available from 6 a.m. to 5 p.m. It consists of a fruit and vegetable building, a fisheries building, a vegetable building, a management building, and an auction house, and has an area of ​​28.303㎡. You can purchase seafood such as seafood, salted fish, live fish, and fresh fish, as well as a variety of vegetables and fruits, including radishes and cabbage, at low prices. It has a spacious parking lot and is a short walk from Exit 1 of Handae Station on Subway Line 4, making it easily accessible. It was selected as an excellent seafood wholesale market in the 2019 seafood wholesale market evaluation.

안산문화예술의전당은 안산을 대표하는 문화공간으로, 지하철 4호선 고잔역.en: Ansan Arts Center is a representative cultural space in Ansan, located right across from Exit 1 of Gojan Station on Subway Line 4. Ansan Arts Center is a complex cultural and arts space with three performance halls, including Sunrise Theater, Dalmaji Theater, and Byeolmuri Theater, and one international conference hall, as well as four exhibition rooms. Sunrise Theater is a large-scale multi-purpose performance hall equipped with an elevating stage, a rotating stage, and an orchestra pit, where various indoor performances such as concerts, operas, ballets, and musicals are held. Dalmaji Theater is a medium-sized theater equipped with a raised stage and projection facilities, and is used for plays, dance recitals, chamber music performances and recitals, and movie screenings. Byeolmuri Theater is a small theater with a flexible stage and seats that hosts small-scale plays, Korean traditional music performances, and avant-garde plays. The outdoor performance hall in the front yard of the performance building has a terraced seating capacity of about 1,000 people, and various outdoor performances such as various yard play and popular music performances and movie screenings are held here. In the special exhibition room, exhibitions of paintings, calligraphy, sculpture, photography, and plastic arts are held. There are also two bakery cafes within Ansan Arts Center, so you can conveniently use them before or after the performance.

안산문화원은 안산시 상록구 사동에 있는 지역문화 예술진흥기관이다. 안산문.en: Ansan Cultural Center is a local culture and arts promotion organization located in Sadong, Sangnok-gu, Ansan-si. Ansan Cultural Center became a national pilot cultural center and received permission to establish Ansan Cultural Center as a special corporation under the Local Cultural Center Promotion Act, taking the lead in not only the simple discovery of historical culture but also practical inheritance and education. As part of the local relic collection project that began in 1991, approximately 2,000 relics were collected, and based on these, a local history museum was established on the first floor of Wonsa Temple, allowing many citizens to see the history of Ansan at a glance. The outdoor exhibition hall reproduces and exhibits traditional thatched-roof houses, mills, and water mills from the Ansan region, providing a space for relaxation as well as a space for children to experience traditional culture and a cultural space for adults to satisfy their cultural nostalgia.

2001년 개관된 안산식물원에는 3개의 전시관이 있으며 제1전시관인 열대.en: Ansan Botanical Garden, which opened in 2001, has three exhibition halls. In the first exhibition hall, the Tropical Botanical Garden, you can see over 100 types of tropical plants, including palm trees. At the Central Botanical Garden, the second exhibition hall, you can see 177 species of 11 types of wild flowers from the central region of Korea, including Jingyeongsansu and irises. In the third exhibition hall, Southern Botanical Garden, you will encounter wetland plants and edible plants. The outdoor botanical garden has four types of rose gardens, a fruit tree garden, a wild plant garden, a plant succession garden, and a pond, providing additional attractions. In particular, Ansan Botanical Garden has a pyramid-shaped glass greenhouse that is comparable to greenhouses in famous foreign botanical gardens. Thanks to this, the plants here can breathe green all year round. Ansan Botanical Garden is located within Seongho Park, close to the city center, so it is easily accessible. Nearby, there are Nojeokbong Park and Danwon Sculpture Park, so it is recommended to visit them as well. (Source: Ansan City Culture and Tourism website)

안산 올림픽기념관은 경기도 안산시 단원구에 위치한 문화시설이다. 공연장,.en: Ansan Olympic Memorial Hall is a cultural facility located in Danwon-gu, Ansan-si, Gyeonggi-do. There is a performance hall, a swimming pool, a small theater, and a gymnasium. The performance hall has a capacity of 420 seats and can host various education, events, theater festivals, presentations, and even screen movies for citizens. In addition, a small theater with a capacity of 100 seats offers singing classes and displays commemorative photos of the 1988 Seoul Olympics. Anyone can enjoy swimming in the Olympic swimming pool. It is a place that residents often visit because it has a lot of shade from trees and a good walking path.

선사시대부터 근ㆍ현대에 이르기까지 안산지역의 역사와 문화를 보여주는 곳안.en: A place that shows the history and culture of the Ansan region from prehistoric times to modern times. Ansan is adjacent to the sea and has a large land area, so agriculture and fishing were popular. In particular, it was the center of the literary revival during the reign of King Yeongjo and King Jeongjo, producing many historical figures, and the Local History Museum was established to inform not only Ansan citizens but also local residents outside the area of ​​this historical fact. The museum collects and houses over 2,000 artifacts, including artifacts discovered at cultural heritage sites in the Ansan region, ancient documents, and modern and contemporary folk artifacts.

안성시립 남사당바우덕이풍물단은 우리나라 남사당패의 발생지로서 조선시대 최.en: The Anseong City Namsadang Baudeogi Pungmul Troupe was formed to preserve and globalize Namsadang Nori, a national popular culture, by inheriting the artistic spirit of Anseong “Baudeogi,” who is considered the birthplace of Korea’s Namsadang troupe and the best artist and first entertainer of the Joseon Dynasty. By operating Namsadang Nori as a permanent performance program for the first time in the country, we are taking the lead in popularizing our folk culture in modern society, and are developing and distributing various experience programs using Namsadang Nori. In addition, we are nurturing talent by operating systematic education programs for each function, such as pungmulnori, and promoting our culture by traveling to countries around the world to perform on tour. In addition, we are striving to establish ourselves as the most unique global festival by holding the Baudeogi Festival every year and directly operating various performances and experience activities.

안성시 대덕면 내리 중앙대학교 안성캠퍼스 입구에 세워진 안성맞춤 박물관은.en: The Anseong Machum Museum, built at the entrance to the Anseong Campus of Chung-Ang University in Naeri, Daedeok-myeon, Anseong-si, is a theme museum where you can experience Anseong's rich cultural heritage with a focus on Yugi. It consists of a total of 3 floors, 2 floors above ground and 1 floor underground, and consists of an organic exhibition room, a video room, a special exhibition room, an agricultural history room, a local history room, a seminar room, a research room, and a storage room. The Yugi exhibition room exhibits the history of Yugi, classification of Yugi by production method, model of Yugi production process, gi, bansanggi, arms, and blowing, and various other Yugi used in daily life, and videos were installed here and there to help visitors understand. In particular, you can see detailed explanations about Anseong's history and culture through the touch screen. The agricultural history room displays the history of Anseong agriculture, seasonal farming patterns, and Anseong special products, allowing visitors to learn about Anseong agriculture in the past and present. In the local history room, you can see Anseong culture and history at a glance, including photos of Anseong's old appearance, reproductions of Anseong Market City, Anseong Nam Shrine, and Buddhist cultural assets.* Origin of Anseong Machum We often use the word ‘Anseong Machum’ as a metaphor for a very good fit. This word is used when an object or person goes well together, and it has become synonymous with ‘Anseong Match’ because it was carefully made with organic craftsmanship and excellent workmanship tailored to Anseong and satisfied people’s hearts in terms of quality, shape, and other techniques.

안성문화원은 선열로부터 내려오는 4.1 만세 항쟁의 애국 애족 정신과 남.en: Anseong Cultural Center was established to bring about cultural innovation and reform to preserve the characteristics of the Anseong region and Anseong citizens, based on the patriotic spirit of the April 1st Independence Movement, the spirit of rites of Namsadang Nori, and the craftsmanship of Anseong Yugi, which have been passed down from ancestors. In addition, we are making efforts to preserve, develop, and develop our unique culture through the protection of cultural assets and field trips to historical sites, and to inform our descendants of the lifestyle and culture of our ancestors. It promotes Anseong culture and hosts various events. Major events include the traditional folk song competition, national traditional music competition, Baudeogi Festival, and loyalty, filial piety, and Tao camps for youth. Through various volunteer activities, we help people in need in the region and strive to revitalize the region.

안성팜랜드는 가축들을 직접 만지고 먹이주며 즐거운 체험을 할 수 있는 체.en: Anseong Farmland is an experience ranch where you can have a fun experience touching and feeding livestock. We are conducting an experience program where you can interact with various livestock such as bulls, sheep, geese, pigs, and donkeys. It is a very popular place among family tourists as it has amusement facilities that the whole family can enjoy in the open grassland and educational facilities where you can feel the importance of our country's agricultural and livestock industry with your body and mind.

&nbsp;안성향교는 1532년 창건된 된 향교로, 1932년과 1986.en: Anseong Confucian Confucian Confucian Confucian Confucian School was founded in 1532 and was renovated three times in 1932, 1986, and 1988. Hyanggyo is a national educational institution during the Goryeo and Joseon Dynasties that was established to hold memorial tablets of great Confucian scholars, hold ancestral rites, and educate and enlighten local residents. Existing buildings include Daeseongjeon, Myeongryundang, Dongjae, Seojae, Naesammun, Oesammun, and Punghwaru. The memorial tablets of the 6 sages of the Song Dynasty and the 18 sages of our country are enshrined here. Daeseongjeon is a building with a gable roof, 3 rooms on the front and 2 rooms on the sides. Myeongnyundang is a kind of classroom, and Punghwaru is a kind of auditorium. It is located only in Anseong and Namwon in the country and consists of 11 rooms at the front and 1 room at the side. During the Joseon Dynasty, one instructor was provided with land, tuition, and slaves by the government to teach a maximum of 50 students. However, with the implementation of the new system after Gabogyeongjang, the educational function was lost, and a seokjeon (釋奠) ceremony was held in spring and fall, and incense was burned on the first day and the first full moon. This Hyanggyo is currently designated as a Gyeonggi-do cultural asset, and is operated by one Jeongyo (典校) and Janggui (掌議). The weathered furnace of Anseong Hyanggyo is the largest among the Hyanggyo gate towers of the Joseon Dynasty (buildings with a door at the bottom and an enclosure at the top with the function of looking around all directions). It is a building with an appropriate height and scale that can effectively cover the front of the Hyanggyo from being seen from the outside, taking advantage of the characteristics of the location of a sloping site.

안양 농수산물도매시장은 뛰어난 접근성과 연계성으로 수도권 남부지역의 유통.en: Anyang Agricultural and Marine Products Wholesale Market is a public wholesale market responsible for distribution in the southern region of the metropolitan area with excellent accessibility and connectivity. It is a bustling place frequented by not only wholesalers but also general consumers, and opened in September 1997. It has a fruit and vegetable building, a fruit and vegetables building, and a fisheries building, and is equipped with facilities such as related shopping malls, direct sales malls, frozen ice making, and storage warehouses. Wholesale transactions are conducted through auctions of fruits, vegetables, and marine products in the early morning, and retail transactions targeting general consumers are also conducted during the day. Many consumers visit because they can find high-quality agricultural and marine products delivered directly from the production area in season. In particular, there is a raw fish center, so you can see and purchase raw fish in person and then go to the raw seafood center to taste fresh seafood. Depending on the volume and circumstances of each store, it may close earlier than the announced closing time, so it is recommended to visit at least an hour before closing. It takes about 1 minute by car from Pyeongchon IC, about 5 minutes by car from Pyeongchon Station on Line 4, and is a short distance from the subway station. There is a bus coming at noon. Nearby are Gwanaksan Mountain, Anyang Art Park, Pyeongchon Central Park, Seoul Land, Seoul Grand Park, Let's Run Park Seoul, and Baekun Lake.

안양문화원은 대통령령으로 제정된 지방문화원진흥법시행령에 의해 설립된 공입.en: Anyang Cultural Center is a public corporation established by the Enforcement Decree of the Local Cultural Center Promotion Act enacted by Presidential Decree. Since the 1950s, it has been carrying out enlightenment activities as a self-sustaining organization to protect traditional culture and promote local culture. It was established on January 10, 1970 to inherit and develop the local culture and history of Anyang. We are carrying out local historical material discovery and preservation projects, local cultural festivals and inter-regional cultural content exchange projects, cultural education projects, and living culture and arts revitalization projects.

안양박물관은 안양예술공원(옛 안양유원지) 내에 위치한 시립박물관이다. 2.en: Anyang Museum is a city museum located within Anyang Art Park (formerly Anyang Amusement Park). After opening as Anyang History Museum in Pyeongchon Art Hall in September 2004, the name was changed to Anyang Museum in 2015, and it was moved to its current location and reopened in 2017. Anyang Museum is located within the grounds of Anyang Temple Site, where the name Anyang originated, and embodies the city's identity. It is even more meaningful as it is a remodeled building of a factory designed in 1959 by Kim Chung-up, an architect representing the first generation of Korean modern and contemporary architecture. The permanent exhibition on the second floor of the museum consists of the beginning of life (Prehistoric Age ~ Three Kingdoms Period), the origins of Anyang (Unified Silla ~ Goryeo Dynasty), the transmission of culture (Joseon Dynasty), and the growth of the city (modern and contemporary times), allowing you to see the history and culture of Anyang at a glance. On the rooftop, there is The Terrace, a restaurant and cafe with a panoramic view of Gwanaksan Mountain. In addition, the Anyang Jungchosaji temple support pole, which is designated as a treasure in the outdoor exhibition hall at the entrance to the museum, is the only pole in the country whose year of creation can clearly be seen, as it is rare to have letters engraved on the pole. It is located about 2 minutes by car or 20 minutes on foot from Gwanak Station on Line 1, and there are buses nearby from the subway station, making it easily accessible by public transportation. The Kim Chung-up Architectural Museum and Anyang Art Park are located on the same grounds, and nearby is the Anyang Art Park Food Culture Street, where restaurants and cafes are gathered.

만안구청 부근에 있는 안양아트센터는 안양 시민의 여가와 문화생활 증진을.en: Anyang Art Center, located near Manan-gu Office, was created to promote the leisure and cultural life of Anyang citizens. It opened as Anyang Arts Center in December 1989, underwent extensive remodeling, and was renamed Anyang Art Center and reopened in May 2010. It is operated by Anyang Culture and Arts Foundation. Anyang Arts Center, built with one floor underground and two floors above ground, is a multi-purpose cultural space with three performance halls, including Gwanak Hall [large performance hall], Suri Hall [small performance hall], and an outdoor performance hall, as well as Gallery Midam and a convention hall. The first floor lobby is equipped with convenience facilities such as a service plaza, Café Brahms, and a children's playroom. Gwanak Hall is a two-story, proscenium-style large performance hall that can accommodate 1,126 people (including 13 seats for the disabled). It has an 828㎡ stage and 6 dressing rooms, and can accommodate large-scale performances such as concerts, orchestras, and musicals. Suri Hall is a proscenium-type small performance hall that can accommodate 382 people (including 4 seats for the disabled) and has a 240㎡ stage and two dressing rooms, and can host a variety of performances such as plays, chamber music, and recitals. Gallery Midam is a space where works such as paintings, photography, calligraphy, sculpture, and installation art can be displayed. It is designed with a rail-type moving partition, allowing for free space creation. The convention hall is a multipurpose space for symposiums, seminars, ceremonies, and education, and has three practice rooms as auxiliary facilities. Based on these facilities, Anyang Art Center regularly hosts various cultural events, film screenings, performances, recitals, concerts, and exhibitions. It takes about 8 minutes by car from Sanbon IC and about 10 minutes on foot from Myeonghak Station on Line 1. Nearby are Gwanaksan Mountain, Cheonggyesan Mountain, Gwanggyosan Mountain, Anyang Art Park, Anyang Museum, Kim Chung-up Architecture Museum, Pyeongchon Central Park, Seoul Land, Seoul Grand Park, Let's Run Park Seoul, Gwangmyeong Cave, and Gwangmyeong Edison Museum.

안양천은 다채로운 수생식물과 동물, 그리고 철새들이 드나드는 생태하천으로.en: Anyangcheon Stream is an ecological river where various aquatic plants, animals, and migratory birds come and go. It is a healing space in the city with bicycle paths, walking trails, artificial wetlands, acupressure pads, basketball courts, and rest areas along the riverside. Anyangcheon Stream, which is 34.8km long, is a stream originating from Samseongsan Mountain and tributaries such as Haguicheon Stream of Baekunsan Mountain and Sanboncheon Stream of Gunpo-si, converging in Seoksu-dong, Anyang-si, and flowing into the Han River in the north. Most of this section is famous for its cherry blossoms. Every spring in Anyang, a car-free street is created on the Chunghun Cherry Blossom Road near Chunghun Bridge 2 and the ‘Anyang Chunghun Cherry Blossom Festival’ is held to provide a variety of entertainment. Anyangcheon is also a place where you can enjoy bicycle riding with beautiful scenery. In particular, it is famous as part of the heart course, which is named after the distance traveled because it resembles a heart, so it is visited by many bicycle riders. In addition, where Anyangcheon and Haguicheon meet, you can see the Anyangcheon Ssanggaeul Culture Square and the Anyangcheon Ecological Story Center where you can experience various indoor and outdoor ecological experiential learning programs. Nearby are Pyeongchon Central Park, Seoul Grand Park/Seoul Land, and Baekun Lake. *Heart Course is an intermediate course with a total length of about 66km that starts from the Seoul Hangang Bicycle Path, goes around Tancheon~Yangjaecheon~Haguicheon~Anyangcheon Stream, and then returns to Yeouido Hangang Park.

알파카월드는 청정자연 강원도 홍천의 푸른 숲속에 있으며 자연 그대로의 모.en: Alpaca World is located in the clean green forests of Hongcheon, Gangwon-do, and is an alpaca-themed emotional travel destination where you can meet and interact with animals living in their natural state up close. You can meet about 50 cute alpacas at the 'Andes Ecological Ranch', which recreates the mountainous terrain of the Andes in South America, 'Healing Walk with Alpacas', a representative experience of Alpaca World where you can walk and interact with alpacas through a green forest, 'Alpaca Playground', where you can play and communicate with alpacas in a large grassy plaza, and 'Birds Garden', which makes you feel like you have entered a fairy tale world the moment you open the door. In addition, you can make fun and happy memories at Alpaca World, which is filled with various kinds of animals such as deer, rabbits, goats, ostriches, camels, owls, eagles, and other fun things to do.◎ Travel information that meets the charm of the Korean Wave This is a place that NCT visited to heal through its own content. The members performed a mission here with a ticket to board the cart, and although they were momentarily embarrassed when the alpaca spat, they had fun taking pictures together.

애니포레는 동물과 숲을 만날 수 있는 공간으로 용평 리조트 안에 있다..en: Anyfore is a space where you can meet animals and the forest and is located within Yongpyeong Resort. Anipore is located at 900 to 1,000 meters above sea level, so you can feel refreshing coolness even in the middle of summer and breathe clean air all year round. The name is a combination of the words “animal” and “forest,” meaning a space where animals and the forest coexist. There are two ways to get to Anipore from the ticket office entrance: walking from the Eomhonggil entrance of Balwangsan Mountain (takes 60 minutes) or taking the monorail (takes 10 minutes). From the point where you get off on the monorail, you can choose to visit Gaumbiyu Forest and Alpaca Ranch. Spruce Forest is a forest created by Mona Yongpyeong employees who planted and tended about 1,800 German spruce trees in 1968 in a place that was once the home of slash-and-burn farmers. Spruce trees are familiar to us as Christmas trees. The forest of trees stretching straight into the sky creates an exotic scenery in itself, and the snow-covered spruce forest in winter is especially fantastic. At the alpaca ranch, you can also experience feeding alpacas and other animal farm members. It is said that it takes about 1.5 to 2.5 hours for an adult to tour the entire place, and there are many various things to see and photo spots at every corner of the trail, so if you have time, you can spend an entire day here without getting bored. In addition, they offer various programs such as yoga and forest concerts, so participating in them will be a unique experience. Anyfore also has a restaurant and cafe, so you can grab a quick meal or take a break.

제주 공항에서 불과 10㎞ 정도 달리다 보면 제주를 좀 안다는 이들 사이.en: If you drive just 10km from Jeju Airport, you can come across Aewol Coastal Road, which is famous for being beautiful among those who know Jeju well. The Aewol Coastal Road, which runs along the northwest coastline, is a driving course of approximately 9 km where you can enjoy Jeju's outstanding seascape. There are also well-equipped bicycle paths and walking paths, so you can enjoy a variety of ways, such as cycling and walking, in addition to driving. This road is part of the 16 Jeju Olle Trail courses, and is also famous as a famous spot for bicycle riding and trekking. There are many coastal attractions along the way, such as Gueom Port, Namdori Rest Area, Sineom-ri Breakwater, Gonae Port, Attic Rest Area, and a large rock face, so it is also a good idea to stop by and enjoy the beautiful scenery. In addition, there are many restaurants, cafes, and accommodations, making it a popular Jeju travel destination for travelers.

N Gallery는 작가와 대중에게 작품을 매개로 하여 예술과 더 친밀히.en: N Gallery opened in 2008 to provide artists and the public with a beautiful cultural space where they can communicate more closely with art through the medium of their works. It is playing a dynamic role in the development of domestic art culture and revitalizing exchanges with the international art world by hosting invitational and special exhibitions encompassing both established domestic and foreign artists as well as new artists. It is also advancing into a complex art space through various cultural activities such as corporate events, seminars, and performances as well as art exhibitions. Based on our professional planning ability and network, we are actively supporting the cultural and artistic activities of individuals and companies, and art consulting work that connects them with culture and arts is also actively underway.

아름다운 꾀꼬리가 알을 품고 있는 형상의 산세를 가진 앵자봉(667m)은.en: Aengjabong Peak (667m), which has the shape of a beautiful oriole hatching an egg, is a mountain widely known to Catholics. Catholicism first began to spread in Korea at Aengjabong, and now the entire Aengjabong area is designated as a Catholic sanctuary pilgrimage route. Aengjabong Peak is not a high mountain, but it is a mountain where Catholics lived in hiding in the early days, so the further you go into the mountain, the more you feel as if you have entered a deep valley. For public transportation, take a local bus to Yangpyeong via Gonjiam, take a bus from Gwangju-eup to Usan-ri to the Cheonjin-am parking lot, or take a bus from Gwangju-eup to Geonup-ri and get off at the last stop. By car, drive on the Jungbu Expressway, turn toward Toechon at the Gwangju-Gonjiam Interchange, and go straight for about 9km at the Toechon intersection to reach the Cheonjinam parking lot.

심학산 약천사는 지장보살에게 참회와 기도를 올리는 '지장기도 참회 도량'.en: Simhaksan Yakcheonsa Temple is a temple in Paju known as the ‘Ksitigarbha Prayer Repentance Doryang’ where penance and prayers are offered to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Since the Unification Pharmacist Tathagata Buddha is enshrined, there is a constant flow of people praying for their wishes to be fulfilled, and the activities of spiritual groups such as Buddhist colleges, Ksitigarbha, and choirs are also active. Around the temple, there is Simhaksan Mountain, a natural recreation forest, and a mineral spring, making it a great place to enjoy hiking and relaxation. If you climb along the trail behind Yakcheonsa Temple for about 20 minutes, you will reach the top, where you can enjoy a refreshing view of the Han River, Gimpo, and the Imjin River basin.

제주 약천사는 제주도 서귀포시의 명물이라 불리는 거대 사찰이자 큰 규모의.en: Jeju Yakcheonsa Temple is a large temple known as a specialty of Seogwipo City, Jeju Island, and is a branch temple of Eunhaesa Temple, the headquarters of the 10th Diocese of the Jogye Order of Korean Buddhism, which has a large temple. It was originally a small hermitage named Yaksuam, but because there was a famous mineral spring nearby, it was given the name Yakcheonsa. Hyein, who was appointed as the head priest in 1981, greatly promoted the development of Buddhism, and in 1996, Daejeokgwangjeon, the largest single temple, was built and became famous. Daejeokgwangjeon is a two-story concrete building in the Buddhist architectural style of the early Joseon Dynasty, and a temple bell with text and pictures emphasizing filial piety is hung on the bell tower in front of the temple. In addition, there is also a story that in the 1960s, Confucian scholar Kim Hyeong-gon was praying for 100 days in a small cave for treatment of a medical condition, and after receiving and drinking mineral water in a dream, he restored his health and devoted himself to practicing meditation to repay the Buddha's grace. He built the mineral water hermitage and passed away there. Due to its majestic scale, it is treated as a must-visit tourist course for tourists to Jeju Island, and it also operates a temple stay for domestic and foreigners. Yakcheonsa Temple houses the memorial tablets of King Munjong, the son of King Sejong, Queen Hyeondeok, King Yeongchin, and Lady Lee Bang-ja.

경기도청 북부청사 부근에 위치한 양주문화원은 양주의 향토문화 역사, 지역.en: Yangju Cultural Center, located near the northern building of the Gyeonggi Provincial Office, is a place to inherit and develop Yangju's local cultural history and regional culture. It is carrying out projects to discover and preserve local historical materials, creative local cultural festivals, cultural content exchange projects between regions, cultural education projects, and living culture and arts revitalization projects. Yangju Cultural Center, established in 1961 in accordance with the Local Cultural Center Promotion Act and opened in Dongducheon-eup, Yangju-si, was moved out of the jurisdiction of Yangju-si when Dongducheon-eup was promoted to a city in 1987, and moved to its current location in 1988. The cultural center is equipped with facilities such as classrooms and a multi-purpose room, and operates various cultural events and educational programs. It takes about 30 minutes by car from Songchu IC. Nearby are Jangheung Amusement Park, Gana Art Park, Doori Land, Jang Wook-jin Museum of Art, Feelux Lighting Museum, Hoeam Temple Site, Bukhansan National Park, and ASEAN National Recreational Forest.

양주 소놀이굿은 국가무형문화재 제70호로 양주소놀이굿전수회관은 문화의 보.en: Yangju Sonori Gut is National Intangible Cultural Heritage No. 70, and the Yangju Sonori Gut Preservation Center is a performance hall built with support from the Cultural Heritage Management Bureau for the preservation and transmission of culture. The Sonori gut originated from the worship of cow horses and the Someoknori, an agricultural ritual, and is a performance to pray for a good harvest. Regular performances are held here once a year to showcase their skills to citizens. The building is 198.3㎡ in size and is equipped with the Yangju Sonori Gut Preservation Society office, conference room, practice room, and storage room. There is an outdoor play yard in the front and a parking lot in the back. This space is mainly used by members and is open to the public on the day of the performance.

고려 말 전국 사찰의 총본산이었고 조선 초기 최대 왕실 사찰이던 회암사.en: The Yangju City Hwaamsa Temple Site Museum, established by Yangju City on the site of Hoeamsa Temple, which was the headquarters of all temples in the country in the late Goryeo Dynasty and the largest royal temple in the early Joseon Dynasty, is a historical relic museum established to store and study relics excavated from the Hoeamsa Temple site and educate the next generation through exhibitions. Hoeamsa Temple, which is currently being excavated, is not only large-scale, but is also characterized by an architectural style that resembles a palace.

경기도 북부에 위치한 양주시는 600여 년의 유구한 역사와 전통을 자랑하.en: Yangju City, located in the northern part of Gyeonggi-do, is a historic cultural city boasting a long history and tradition of over 600 years, and preserves important tangible and intangible cultural heritage. Among them, Hoeamsa Temple, located at the foot of Cheonbosan Mountain in Hoeam-dong, occupies an important place in the history of Korean Buddhism as the largest royal temple in the Joseon Dynasty, which received active support from the royal family during the Joseon Dynasty, which aimed for a Confucian society. Although we cannot see the glory of that time now, it is not difficult to imagine the status of Hoeamsa Temple at the time through the relics remaining at the temple site. Yangju City established a comprehensive maintenance plan for the Hoeamsa Temple Site to transform it into the best tourist destination and history education site in northern Gyeonggi Province. In accordance with the comprehensive maintenance plan, projects such as excavation of Hoeamsa Temple site, construction of a museum, and maintenance of ruins and complexes were promoted annually, and the Yangju City Hoeamsa Temple Site Museum opened on October 19, 2012 as part of the project and has reached its current state. The Yangju City Hoeamsa Temple Site Museum reexamines the history and status of Hoeamsa Temple, which was the largest royal temple in the late Goryeo and early Joseon Dynasties. We aim to operate it as a specialized museum that can properly perform its role as a museum through the collection, storage, research, exhibition, and education functions of artifacts, as well as serve as a more progressive historical and cultural center by strengthening public service. In addition, we plan to operate it as a representative museum of Yangju City that contributes to creating an image as a city of culture and arts by using it as a window for cultural exchange with domestic and foreign organizations.

두물머리는 금강산에서 흘러내린 북한강과 강원도 금대봉 기슭 검룡소에서 발.en: Dumulmeori is the place where the Bukhangang River, which flows down from Geumgangsan Mountain, and the Namhangang River, which originates at Geomnyongso at the foot of Geumdaebong in Gangwon-do, meet and is the beginning of the Han River. Yangsu-ri Dumulmeori, with its early morning mist and sunrise, Hwangpo sailboats, and zelkova trees over 400 years old, is a place where scenery that changes beautifully throughout the four seasons awaits. It was selected as one of the top 100 tourist attractions in Korea that Koreans must visit. It is widely known as the first view of the Han River (Dumulgyeong) and as a filming location for various dramas and movies, and is Korea's representative eco-tourism destination visited by numerous domestic and foreign tourists. The beautiful scenery of Dumulmeori has been famous since ancient times, and has been passed down through time, having been preserved in <Dugangseungyudo> by Lee Geon-pil and <Monologue> by Gyeomjae Jeongseon during the Joseon Dynasty. It is an ecological attraction that should be passed down to future generations as a beautiful heritage of Korea and Yangpyeong.

양평 백운봉자연휴양림은 수도권 근교의 숲 속 힐링 공간으로 용문산줄기 백.en: Yangpyeong Baekunbong Natural Recreation Forest is a healing space in a forest near the metropolitan area and is located at the entrance to the Baekunbong hiking trail on the Yongmun Mountain range. A total of 20 lodging facilities, including a house in the forest, and a 20-sided camping deck have been created, and are operated and managed directly by Yangpyeong Corporation. In addition, there is a forest recreation center, camping site, hiking trail, nature trail, physical training center, forest sitz bath facility, wild flower complex, and azalea colony, so it is convenient to use and the scenery is beautiful. The Baekunbong hiking trail within the recreational forest is one of the best hiking trails in the nearby area and is visited by many people.

양평군립미술관은 2011년 개관하여 다양한 프로그램과 수준 높은 현대미술.en: Yangpyeong County Museum of Art opened in 2011 and has been conducting various programs, high-quality contemporary art planning, and creative education programs. It is an art museum built on 8,069㎡ of land in Yanggeun-ri, Yangpyeong-eup, with a building area of ​​4,184㎡, with 3 floors above ground and 1 floor underground. It is equipped with not only an exhibition hall, but also educational facilities, a conference room, a library, a kids' room, a seminar room, and a cafe. It operates educational programs for children, teenagers, and adults, and holds academic seminars and cultural events with different topics every year. Securing space for on-site experiences and planning themed exhibitions are playing a big role in establishing Yangpyeong as a cultural tourism brand. It is located a 14-minute walk from Yangpyeong Station on the Gyeongui-Jungang Line, and there is an insect museum nearby.

양평문화원은 양평지역의 향토문화 창달과 전통문화를 발굴하고 전승, 보존해.en: Yangpyeong Cultural Center is a place that discovers, transmits, and preserves the local culture and traditional culture of the Yangpyeong region, and conducts various cultural events and social education programs for Yangpyeong residents. In addition, it manages cultural assets in the Yangpyeong region, studies local history, opens a cultural school, conducts various programs, and holds cultural events. Cultural events such as the Baekun Cultural Festival, Yongmunsa Ginkgo Tree Festival, and Yangpyeong Dure Nongak Play are held, and the cultural school offers classes on calligraphy, the Four Gentlemen, saxophone, classical guitar, tea ceremonies, and Yangpyeong folk songs. In addition, there is the amateur Yangpyeong Cultural Women's Choir, which carries out music volunteer activities and screens nostalgic movies for free every Thursday at 2 o'clock. Affiliated institutions include Yongmun Branch, Jipyeong Branch, and Local History Research Institute.

용문산과 유명산 사이에 숨은 듯 있는 어비산 자락을 감싸고도는 시원한 계.en: Eobi Valley is a cool valley that surrounds the foot of Eobisan Mountain, which seems to be hidden between Yongmunsan Mountain and Yumyeongsan Mountain. Although it is now nothing more than a stream-like valley, it was said to have been a valley so outstanding that it looked like fish were flying around in the past. That's why the name is Eobi (魚飛). The water depth is just right, and you can go deeper along the wide rocks, and there are fewer people upstream, so you can see the pristine valley. Be careful as the water in the valley may rise after it rains. This well-maintained place, as part of Gyeonggi-do's Clean Valley, was previously used by restaurants as a private property with tables placed along the valley, but has been cleaned up and made available to anyone visiting the valley. A deck road is installed along the valley, and during the peak season, water pours like a fountain from the deck bridge and the center of the valley. Nighttime lights are installed, so you can see a unique scenery at night. The fountain, which is said to be open only during the peak season, is also famous as Gapyeong Ice Wall Valley in the winter. There are restaurants, pensions, and camping sites nearby, making it a good place to eat or relax.

엄미술관은 경기도 화성시 봉담읍에 위치한 현대 미술관이다. 이 미술관은.en: Eom Art Museum is a modern art museum located in Bongdam-eup, Hwaseong-si, Gyeonggi-do. 이 미술관은 다양한 현대 미술 작품을 감상할 수 있는 공간으로, 예술과 문화의 향기를 느낄 수 있는 명소이다. The Uhm Art Museum exhibits works by famous domestic and foreign artists and is highly regarded for its artistic value. In particular, special exhibitions and cultural events held within the museum provide unique experiences to visitors. The museum's clean, modern architectural design creates an atmosphere where art and nature are in harmony. Additionally, the exhibited works leave a deep impression on visitors and stimulate their creativity and emotions. The Uhm Art Museum is an inspirational space for those who love art, and is definitely recommended for those who want to build cultural knowledge.

강천섬유원지 부근에 있는 여성생활사박물관은 우리 선조들이 실생활에 사용하.en: The Women's Life History Museum, located near Gangcheon Textile Resort, is a women's museum that exhibits daily necessities and accessories that our ancestors used in their daily lives. This private museum was built with the sincerity and tenacity of natural dyer Lee Min-jeong and opened in June 2001 with over 3,000 artifacts related to women's lives collected over 30 years. The museum started when, when I was young, I saw a foreign friend holding clothes that his grandmother and mother had worn and was so excited that my mother decided to give them to him. I started collecting them to pass on our traditional culture to the next generation. This is the beginning of the museum. From the beginning, I didn't think about women, but as I gathered them together, there was nothing that wasn't touched by women, and it became the only women's life history museum in Korea. The Women's Life History Museum has two floors. The first floor has special exhibition rooms 1 and 2, a traditional dyeing and dyeing material exhibition room, an education room, and a tea ceremony classroom. The second floor consists of a permanent exhibition room that displays general relics, clothing, furniture, household items, and kitchenware. The outdoor playground has a playground where children can play to their heart's content. The Women's Life History Museum operates a variety of experience and education programs such as a one-night and two-day experience camp, natural dyeing experience, tea ceremony etiquette education, multi-colored mother-of-pearl grip tok making, and traditional calligraphy education under the theme of enjoying culture with relaxation. Various special exhibitions are held every year. It is closed during the winter season from January 1 to 31 every year. The museum is located on the site of the Gangnam branch of the former Gangcheon Elementary School, which was closed, and also serves as the Chaehyeon Natural Dye Research Institute. It is located within about 13 minutes by car from Yeoju IC. Nearby are Silleuksa Temple, Yeongnyeongneung (King Sejong's Yeongneung/King Hyojong's Royal Tomb), Pasaseong Fortress, Mokgah Museum, Yeoju Insect Museum, Hwangpo Sailboat, and Gangcheon Textile Resort.

친구, 연인, 가족 모두가 가슴이 뻥 뚫리는 스릴을 경험할 수 있는 레이.en: Yeosu U-World Theme Park, a racing venue where friends, lovers, and family can all experience heart-pumping thrills, is a multiplex theme park where you can enjoy a luge, an amusement park, an indoor kids park, a teddy bear museum, a BB shooting range, and a laser arena all in one place. The luge theme park located here is Korea's first, and you can enjoy the speed and thrill of the sky track that runs 1.3km in length at a height of 7m above the ground. The luge experience, which awakens your inner running instinct, gives you an even higher feeling by riding the lift. It is also a popular travel destination perfect for raising tension with a 'FUN' date that is not at all obvious.

여수해상케이블카는 바다 위를 통과하여 돌산(섬)과 자산(육지)을 연결하는.en: Yeosu Marine Cable Car is a marine cable car that connects Dolsan (island) and Jasan (land) by passing over the sea. It is the fourth marine cable car to pass over the sea in Asia, following Hong Kong, Singapore, and Vietnam. Close to the city center, you can see cityscapes, night views, sunsets, and the sea at night depending on the time of day. A total of 50 cable cars are in operation, including 15 crystal cabins and 35 regular cabins. The crystal cabin's floor is made of tempered glass, allowing you to view the sea beneath your feet through the transparent floor. In addition, it is a special cabin where you can enjoy the beautiful sea at your feet, allowing you to experience wide-open visual enjoyment and an exhilarating thrill. ◎ This is the place where ‘Wanna One’ Jae-hwan visited on the Yeosu trip with Ji-seong in <Arms Gram>, a travel information web entertainment show that meets the charm of the Korean Wave. The two had a great time listening to music through Bluetooth and drawing each other's portraits in the cabin. Jisung, who was invited to the trip, expressed his gratitude by saying, "Thank you for bringing me, and I think it will be a memory I will never forget."

여수수산시장은 50년 역사의 수산물 전통시장으로, 여수 3대 수산시장 중.en: Yeosu Fish Market is a traditional seafood market with 50 years of history, and is the largest of the three major fish markets in Yeosu. 여수수산시장은 전통시장의 정겨움을 느낄 수 있는 데다가 2011년 현대화시설 작업을 마쳐 쾌적한 분위기를 형성하고 있어 전통시장의 장점과 현대적인 장점을 모두 갖추고 있다. In particular, at the Yeosu Fish Market, you can find fish species that are not easily available in the metropolitan fish markets, such as catfish, rockfish, and mackerel for sashimi, and purchase them at a low price. The market is largely divided into live fish, dried fish, and food. The live fish market boasts fresh seafood using clean seawater through a 400m underwater seawater pipe. The dried fish here are processed directly at a processing plant located on the rooftop of the Yeosu Fish Market building, dried in the sea breeze, and then sold. The food market sells mustard kimchi and salted fish, which are special products of Yeosu. There is also a night market with a variety of food made from fresh seafood, and after the opening of the Viking Night Market in 2016, there are even more things to see and enjoy.

환상적인 바다 전망의 다양한 객실과 예술적 감성에서 익사이팅한 즐길거리까.en: Yeosu Art Land is a total lodging resort that offers a special experience, from various rooms with fantastic sea views and artistic sensibilities to exciting entertainment. There are a variety of art spaces, including the country's largest themed 3D trick art, a 3D museum with a 60m media tunnel, and a sculpture park landscape seen through a 150m rock tunnel. In particular, the 'Midas Hand' extending toward the sea has been selected as a must-take photo wishlist in Korea online and is constantly attracting tourists. In addition, there is also the largest Ferris wheel in Korea where you can enjoy the beautiful sea of ​​Yeosu from 150m above sea level, and activities such as go-karting, trapeze, and ocean skywalk where you can enjoy the thrill. In addition, Yeosu's largest ocean view cafe La Pique, which means 'companion for a long journey', is another work created by Art Land, a must-see course for trips to Yeosu, and has emerged as a must-go course for couple dates, trips to Yeosu, and trips to Jeolla-do. ◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave This is a place where IZ*ONE members carried out various missions and even enjoyed barbecue. <아이즈원의 잇힝 트립2>의 대부분이 촬영된 만큼, 멤버들이 미션을 수행하던 장면을 떠올리며 구경하는 재미가 쏠쏠하다.

양화나루는 여주시 능서면 내양리 양화동과 대신면 초현리를 연결하는 조선시.en: Yanghwa Ferry is a ferry from the Joseon Dynasty that connects Yanghwa-dong, Naeyang-ri, Neungseo-myeon, Yeoju-si, and Chohyeon-ri, Daesin-myeon. There are well-established bike paths and walking paths along the riverside, making it a great place to walk while looking at the beautiful view of the Namhan River. Yanghwa, meaning willow flower, was given the name because there were many pussy willows along the riverside. It was also called Naeyang Naru after the local name of Naeyang-ri, which owned a ferry. Yeoju, located along the Namhan River, has long been a key point for water transportation between Hanyang and the central inland areas of Gangwon-do and Chungcheong-do, with about 12 ferry ports, enabling active exchange of goods and people. In the past, the Namhan River was crowded with boats such as rafts used by sailors who made rafts in Yeongwol and Jeongseon in Gangwon-do and went to Seoul, transfer boats and sailboats that carried salt and exchanged it for beans or tobacco, and Hwangpo sailboats, which were passenger ships that transported people. In particular, Yanghwanaru was used as a major route to the cattle market in Icheon's Goksujang. From nearby parts of Neungseo-myeon and Heungcheon-myeon in Yeoju, Baeksa-myeon and Bubal-eup in Icheon-si, cattle were mainly loaded onto ferry boats at Yanghwa Ferry and traveled to and from the grain harvesting area, but now it is difficult to find traces. Course 6 of Yeoju Yeogang-gil, a river-themed trail in Yeoju, includes Yanghwanaru. It is not easy to find the ferry port as there are no traces left. However, since Yanghwa Ferry is included in the Yeoganggil course and a stamp has been installed nearby, it is recommended to follow the GPS guidance using the Yeoganggil application. If you follow the bike path along the river, you will see two monuments on the side of the road and a marker that says Yanghwa Ferry. There are no convenient facilities such as parking or restrooms, and since it is entirely a rice field, access directly from the village road to the riverside is limited.

경기 여주시 여흥로에 있는 지역 문화 예술 진흥 기관으로 비영리 문화 예.en: It is a local culture and arts promotion organization located in Yeoheung-ro, Yeoju-si, Gyeonggi-do. It is a non-profit culture and arts organization. Yeoju Cultural Center is a place to inherit and develop Yeoju's local cultural history and local culture. It discovers and preserves local historical materials and carries out local cultural events, cultural education activities, and projects to revitalize lifestyle culture and arts. Yeoju Cultural Center, established and opened in 1970 under the Local Cultural Center Promotion Act, moved to its current location in 2012. The cultural center is equipped with facilities such as local exhibition halls, classrooms, conference rooms, data rooms, and theaters, and operates educational projects such as youth cultural schools and liberal arts classes, and holds festivals and various commemorative events. In addition, it was established to improve the quality of cultural life of local residents, disseminate high-quality culture and arts, and contribute to the development of local culture through the development of local culture, research, surveys, holding local cultural events, and active domestic and international exchanges. It takes about 9 minutes by car from Yeoju Station on the Gyeonggang Line. It is adjacent to Silleuksa Temple, and nearby are King Sejong's Yeongneung Royal Tomb, King Hyojong's Yeongneung Royal Tomb, Yeoju Premium Outlet, Pasaseong Fortress, Mok-a Museum, Yeoju Insect Museum, and Hwangpo Sailboat.

1997년 ‘여주군향토사료관’으로 문을 연 여주박물관은 여주의 역사와 민.en: Yeoju Museum, which opened in 1997 as the ‘Yeoju County Local History Museum’, researches, collects, exhibits, and educates Yeoju’s history and folk materials, discovers new academic materials, and plays a role in establishing Yeoju’s identity. 2016년 7월 14일 새롭게 개관한 여마관(신관)의 건립으로 각지에 흩어졌던 여주지역 발굴출토 국가귀속유물을 한자리에 모았다. The Yeoju Museum’s ‘Hwangma Hall’ includes a special exhibition room, Ryu Ju-hyeon’s literature exhibition room, the Namhan River Chief Exhibition Room, and the Joseon Royal Tomb Room, and the new building, ‘Yeoju Museum’, has a Yeoju History Room, a cafeteria, a research room, and a classroom. It has established itself as a space for various cultural experiences encompassing Yeoju's past and present, including holding special exhibitions every year, operating traditional culture education, and operating a museum university. It is also striving to excavate, preserve, and pass down Yeoju's cultural assets through academic research and excavations.

연천군과 강원도 철원군의 경계에 있는 3번 국도, 철원군을 알리는 경계.en: When you cross the small bridge across Chatancheon Stream ahead of the border sign announcing National Highway 3, Cheorwon-gun, on the border of Yeoncheon-gun and Cheorwon-gun, Gangwon-do, a sign informing you of station icicles appears. Station Icicle, which is the end of Course 12 of Pyeonghwa Nuri-gil and is also connected to Course 7 of Pyeonghwa Nuri-gil Bicycle Road, is located in the 28.2km section from Gunnam Flood Control Area to Yeokicicle. Reverse icicles (sung ice) open in abandoned tunnels at the foot of Godae Mountain, and are formed when falling water falls on ice on the ground and grows, or when groundwater rises due to thermal molecular pressure and grows into the ice on the ground. It grows from mid-December and can only be seen until March. Due to safety concerns, it is best to visit outside.

DMZ과 마주한 최북단 연천은 생각만으로도 긴장이 몰려오지만 실상 현장에.en: Just thinking about Yeoncheon, the northernmost area facing the DMZ, makes you feel tense, but when you actually face it, you melt into the peaceful and natural scenery. Yeongang Gallery is a place where you can enjoy the quiet rural scenery and the beautiful scenery of the Imjin River and Hantangang River and sublimate them into art. The former Security Exhibition Hall, located inside the Civilian Control Line in Jung-myeon, Yeoncheon-gun, has been reborn as <Yonkang Gallery>, a culture and art exhibition space. <Yonkang Gallery> is the first art space built within the Civilian Control Line after the armistice, and is a meeting place between the ecology of Yeoncheon, which has been fully preserved under the geopolitical conditions of a border area, and contemporary culture and art. It is a complex space.
