It is 834m high and faces Yumyeongsan Mountain with Seonerchi (Seoneochi) Pass in between. The valleys of the mountains are deep and the forests are thick, creating a recreational forest. It has not been able to see the light of day because it has been obscured by Mt. Yumyeong, but the Jungmisan Mountain Natural Recreation Forest has been created and is a popular weekend hiking destination. It is a small mountain that is good for walking in the metropolitan area. If you start hiking at Seoneochigogae, it only takes 40 minutes to reach the summit along the ridge, so go north up the valley from Yanghyeon Village in Sinbok 3-ri, pass through Anbu, climb to the summit, and then descend to Seoneochigogae. It can also be climbed from Gail-ri, Seorak-myeon, where Gwangbeopsa Temple is located. You can reach the summit by leaving the village at Seoneochigogae Pass, passing the steep pine forest road, climbing to the 6th ridge, and turning left at the fork for about 40 minutes. To get there by public transportation, take a bus from Yangpyeong to Jungmi Mountain or a bus from Munho-ri to Myeongdali. There is no public transportation to the entrance of the recreation forest. To get there by car, pass Paldang Bridge, take National Route 37, turn left 50m in front of Okcheon Rest Area, drive about 10.4km, and go 5.3km further in front of Hanwha Resort to reach Jungmisan Recreational Forest.

중미산자연휴양림은 양평군 옥천면에 위치하고 있으며, 드라이브 코스인 농다.en: Jungmisan Natural Recreation Forest is located in Okcheon-myeon, Yangpyeong-gun. If you go up to Nongdachi Pass, which is a driving course, the dense forest and Namhan River are harmoniously arranged, giving you an open view. When you climb to the top of the mountain, you can enjoy a panoramic view of Yongmunsan Mountain and a beautiful view of Seoul, the Namhangang River, and the Bukhangang River. It is said that Jungmisan Mountain is said to be the second most beautiful after Geumgangsan Mountain, so it was named after Mount Geumgang. Jungmisan Natural Recreation Forest has unique tree houses, rowhouses, forest houses, and camping decks distributed harmoniously, and a forest trail is installed in the center of the recreation forest so you can experience the forest yourself. In particular, not only can you hear informative forest explanations that stimulate your five senses from forest interpreters, but you can also have a more special experience by running forest experience programs and orienteering programs. It is located near Seoul and has excellent accessibility, and places worth visiting nearby include Cheongpyeong Lakeside, Yumyeongsan Natural Recreation Forest, and Yongmunsan National Tourist Complex.

중미산 해발 약 437m 지점에 위치한 중미산천문대는 빛 공해가 적어 서.en: Jungmisan Astronomical Observatory, located approximately 437 meters above sea level on Jungmisan Mountain, has low light pollution and is considered a good place to observe stars near Seoul. Main facilities include an observation dome equipped with a high-performance refracting telescope, an outdoor observation area equipped with a variety of telescopes, and a classroom where astronomy video education is conducted. Various programs, including astronomy and space science experiential learning as well as seasonal constellation and astronomical observation, are operated on a reservation basis.

고양시 일산에 위치한 중산체육공원은 다양한 운동시설 및 산책로가 잘 구비.en: Jungsan Sports Park, located in Ilsan, Goyang-si, is a sports park well-equipped with a variety of sports facilities and trails. It is located at the foot of Gobongsan Mountain and is equipped with complex sports facilities such as a Titan track, a soccer field with artificial turf, a tennis court, a badminton court, and a gateball court. It is a place where people of all ages and genders can enjoy exercising. In 2019, Goyang City’s first free water park was also opened. There is a nice walking trail outside the park, so you can take a refreshing walk.

중원산 동쪽 기슭에서 남쪽으로 흐르는 깊고 맑은 골짜기중원계곡은 용문산.en: Jungwon Valley, a deep and clear valley that flows south from the eastern foot of Jungwonsan Mountain, is located between Jungwonsan Mountain and Doilbong Peak on the east side of Yongmunsan Mountain, and has cute waterfalls, cows, and walls spread throughout the valley. The first waterfall at the entrance is Jungwon Falls, which represents the valley. It is a three-tiered waterfall about 10 meters high and surrounded by strangely shaped cliffs, creating a beautiful scenery. Also, as you walk along the valley road, you will come across Maedungchibong Peak and Suribong Peak, which look like hawks and eagles looking down.

해발 800ｍ의 중원산은 양평의 진산인 용문산 동쪽에 솟아 있다. 웅장한.en: Jungwonsan Mountain, 800 meters above sea level, rises to the east of Yongmunsan Mountain, the true mountain of Yangpyeong. Although it is less well-known due to the reputation of the majestic Yongmunsan Mountain, it is a rocky mountain that is just as majestic as Yongmunsan Mountain. Jungwonsan Mountain, Baekunbong Peak, and Doilbong Peak are peaks with Yongmunsan Mountain as the main peak, and the four mountains rise high above the mountain range, creating a spectacular view. This is why it is called the Geumgang of Gyeonggi-do. Jungwon Mountain is surrounded by beautiful valleys such as Jogyegol and Yonggye Valley to the west and Jungwon Valley and Jungwon Falls to the east, so it is a popular hiking destination for families in the summer. Jungwon Valley is famous for its fields of wild roses and wild chives. In spring, azaleas and bleeding hearts bloom, and in fall, medicinal herbs and wild fruits grow abundantly. Jungwonsan Mountain has four trails that take 4 to 7 hours to walk. Among these, the Jungwon Mountain Parking Lot - Jungwon Waterfall - Charcoal Kiln Site - Stone Pile - Jungwon Mountain Summit - Cliff Observatory - Pine Forest Path is a walking path along the clear and clean Jungwon Valley. The distance is 5 to 6 km. It takes 5 to 6 hours depending on your walking speed. The road to the top after passing Jungwon Falls is quite steep. For the descent, return the way you came, pass Yonggye Valley along the left ridge, and come down to the Yongmunsa Temple parking lot.

쥬쥬랜드는 동물과 로봇, 그리고 사람을 주제로 하는 가족형 종합 테마파크.en: Juju Land is a family-oriented comprehensive theme park featuring animals, robots, and people, and is a space that pursues harmony among them. It is a place where you can learn how to coexist with nature through interaction with various plants and animals indoors and outdoors in a nature-friendly environment. It also provides motivation to experience and become interested in robot technology, the next-generation industry, and take a step forward in becoming an innovative future talent. It is an open zoo where children can experience feeding animals and there are robot performances. It is a place for new ecological education that cannot be experienced anywhere else, where you can get out of the city and communicate with nature, experience IT technology incorporated into daily life, and confirm the possibility and value of coexistence.

지산 포레스트 리조트 스키장은 이천시의 랜드마크 중 한 곳으로 온 가족이.en: Jisan Forest Resort Ski Resort is one of Icheon City's landmarks and is the best comprehensive resort town in the metropolitan area that the whole family can enjoy together. 1996년 12월에 개장한 지산 포레스트 리조트 스키장은 서울에서 가까우면서 경치가 좋고 숙박시설과 스키장, 눈썰매장을 운영해 겨울철이면 동계스포츠를 즐기려는 사람들로 북적인다. The ski resort is equipped with facilities such as a ski slope, sledding slope, rental house, equipment storage, food court, and fire pit zone. The upper-intermediate course is the longest at 1,200m, and there are 10 different slopes with slopes ranging from 7 to 30 degrees, adding to the fun of running on snowy fields. The slope for beginners is equipped with a sunky drift (moving walk) for convenient use. In addition, there is a sledding slope and a separate zone for children and toddlers, and it also operates its own ski and board lesson programs. You must separately check the ski resort's winter opening schedule before visiting. The resort has a total of 55 rooms, 45 condo-type rooms and 10 hotel-type rooms, and auxiliary facilities include a restaurant, convenience store, lecture hall, and billiards room. In particular, hotel-type rooms boast comfortable and elegant interiors. It boasts an eco-friendly landscape, and even outside of the winter ski season, it is attached to the Jisan Country Club, which is operated in conjunction with the Jisan Forest Resort Ski Resort, and is about 15 minutes away from the Icheon Pottery Complex, the hot spring district, and Everland, making it the optimal resort for lodging for linked tourism.

평택이 낳은 근대 국악의 아버지 지영희를 소개하는 전시관으로 국악의 대중.en: This is an exhibition hall that introduces Ji Young-hee, the father of modern Korean traditional music born in Pyeongtaek, and is a place where you can see his achievements that led the popularization, modernization, and globalization of Korean traditional music. It is a comprehensive arts venue that sheds light on the artistic world of Sinawi, the 52nd national intangible cultural asset, and also hosts performances. A large number of extremely valuable and rare relics in the Korean traditional music world are on display, and the exhibition room consists of Ji Young-hee's life, achievements, later years, and pungryu stage. In addition, there is also a corner where you can enjoy music and videos to learn about traditional Pyeongtaek arts such as Utdari Pyeongtaek Nongak and Pyeongtaek folk songs. By visiting the exhibition hall, you can feel that Pyeongtaek is truly the home of Korean sound.

지중해마을은 이국적인 유럽풍 건물이 모여 지중해의 작은 시골 마을을 연상.en: The Mediterranean Village is a place reminiscent of a small rural village in the Mediterranean, with a collection of exotic European-style buildings. This village is a new village created by the residents of this area who were inevitably relocated due to the construction of Asan Tangjeong City. It was built in the middle of Asan Tangjeong City and has a unique and exotic feel, and is nicknamed Blue Crystal Village. The southwestern part of this village, across the road, is decorated in the Provence style of southern France, with its red-roofed castle style, while the southeastern part is modeled after Santorini, Greece, with its circular blue roofs and bright white walls. The most popular place is the photo zone, where you can take pictures with angel wings and a lighthouse-shaped red mailbox in the background. Here, you can enjoy looking at buildings with unique designs and colors, walking through the cute alleys, and browsing various stores such as cafes, prop stores, and clothing stores. Nearby, there are tourist attractions such as Onyang Hot Springs, Hyeonchungsa Temple, and Asangokgyocheon Campground, which can be connected for sightseeing, and Cheonan-Asan Station on the Gyeongbu High-Speed ​​Railway and Janghang Line is not far away.

수원시에는 일반적인 도서관 외에 어린이만을 위한 전용 도서관인 슬기샘,.en: In Suwon City, in addition to general libraries, there are Seulgisaem, Bareunsaem, and Wisdomsaem libraries, which are libraries exclusively for children. Wisdom Saem Children's Library opened in 2005 and is a knowledge information and cultural space established to help children, who can be said to be future dreamers, grow up to be wise, wise, and upright children. It consists of three floors: the first floor is Ongdalsaem, a children's resource room, the second floor is Duresaem, an elementary school resource room, and the third floor is a family resource room, an auditorium, and an environmental energy center. With a collection of approximately 140,000 books, it conducts various reading culture programs to foster the dreams and hopes of growing children and serves as a resting place for citizens.

아시아출판문화 정보 센터에 위치하고 있는 지혜의 숲은 가치 있는 책을 한.en: The Forest of Wisdom, located at the Asian Publishing Culture and Information Center, is a common library where valuable books are gathered together, preserved, protected, managed, and viewed together. Forest of Wisdom is a complex cultural space that has been operated with the foundation's own resources since it was created by the Publishing City Culture Foundation in 2014 with the support of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism. ◎ Travel information to experience the charm of the Korean Wave This is the filming location for the music video of Girls’ Generation’s debut song ‘Into the New World’. Hyoyeon's dance break scene was filmed right here on the outdoor stairs. The unique scenery of the building, which won an architecture award, served as the background for several dramas such as <Romance is a Bonus Book> and <The World of the Married>.

삼국 시대 거열성, 고려 시대 촉석성으로 불렀던 성곽으로 조선 시대에 이.en: It was a castle called Geoyeolseong during the Three Kingdoms period and Chokseokseong during the Goryeo period, and was renamed Jinjuseong during the Joseon Dynasty. The stone-built castle has a circumference of approximately 1,760 m and a height of approximately 5 to 8 m. It is said that there were three wells and springs within the castle, as well as a military warehouse. According to the fortress record written by Ha Ryun (1347-1416) in Dongguk Yeoji Seungnam, only the old ruins remain and it is not known when it was built. However, due to frequent raids by Japanese pirates, it is said that Jinju pastor Kim Jung-gwang had the stone built in the 5th year of King U of Goryeo (1379). Jinjuseong Fortress, which was rebuilt as a fortress to defend against Japanese pirates in the late Goryeo Dynasty, became a gateway to block Japanese pirates from advancing into Honam during the Japanese invasions of Korea in 1592 (25th year of King Seonjo's reign). As one of the three great battles of the Japanese Invasion of Korea, the first battle of Jinju Castle not only defeated nearly 20,000 Japanese enemies with about 3,800 soldiers, but also protected the Honam region, a breadbasket, by protecting this fortress. In the second battle of Jinju Castle in 1593, about 70,000 civil, government, and military soldiers faced 100,000 Japanese soldiers and all surrendered after 11 days of fierce fighting. At this time, Nongae threw himself into the Namgang River holding the enemy general to protect his loyalty. Within the fortress are Chokseokru, Kim Si-min's Jeonseonggakjeok Monument, Uigisa Temple, Seojangdae, Bukjangdae, Changyeolsa Temple, Jinju National Museum, Hoguksa Temple, and an outdoor performance hall.

창리저수지는 농업용수 공급을 위해 조성한 인공 저수지다. 수변 산책로를.en: Changri Reservoir is an artificial reservoir created to supply water for agriculture. It is great to walk along the waterside promenade and enjoy the quiet rural atmosphere and unique scenery throughout the four seasons. The reservoir is also famous as a fishing spot. A variety of fish species, including crucian carp, carp, persimmon, and trout, live here, and you can quietly enjoy fishing by sitting on pedestals of various sizes provided on the waterside. There is also a cafe nearby, so it is a good place to quietly enjoy the water or take a break while drinking coffee.

1863년 처음 안동 장씨와 창원 황씨 등 4가구가 이곳에 정착하였다고.en: It is said that four families, including the Andong Jang clan and the Changwon Hwang clan, first settled here in 1863. It was originally Nabi Island, but was called Beot Island and has been called Udo since the Japanese colonial period. Udo was also far away from Eumjido in the past. However, a pedestrian bridge connecting Eumjido and Udo was installed, improving Udo's accessibility. There are various tourist facilities on and near Udo Island. In particular, you can experience a variety of things at the Fish Ecology Learning Center, Naval History Experience Center, Marine Life Theme Park, and Robot Experience Center at Changwon Marine Park in Eumjido. You can also go fishing at the beach near Udo Island. Additionally, the Marina Breakwater, Changwon Marine Park, Dongseom Island, and Geoga Bridge seen from the Solar Tower Observatory at Changwon Marine Solar Park are truly spectacular.

창조자연사박물관은 1종 전문 자연사박물관으로 기독교 관점의 창조론 중심으.en: Creation Natural History Museum is a first-class specialized natural history museum that explains creationism from a Christian perspective. It exhibits and holds artifacts including 20 types of moving dinosaurs, skeletal dinosaurs, and giant sea lily fossils, as well as 180 fossils, 190 minerals, 180 fish, 6,100 shellfish of 200 species, 500 butterflies and insects of 264 species, 60 birds, 110 liquid immersion specimens, and 60 plants and trees. The origin and scientific names of the fossils and minerals in the museum's collection have been certified by the Future Natural History and Environment Society, and have been certified by the Korean Society for Creation Science, and the museum continues to receive support for information on natural history and creation science. It also regularly appoints professional instructors and operates regular creation science programs. The dinosaurs and skeletal dinosaurs that fill the exhibition hall from the entrance are made so realistically that they catch the eyes of children, and in the outdoor learning area, you can even experience fossil excavation, making it an extremely enjoyable experience for friends who like dinosaurs.

천보산 자연휴양림은 포천시가 포천 시민들의 행복한 휴양을 위해 건립하였다.en: Cheonbosan Natural Recreation Forest was built by Pocheon City for the happy recreation of Pocheon citizens. It opened on November 15, 2011, and was operated as a free trial for Pocheon citizens through a lottery for the first two months. Afterwards, it was officially opened in January 2012 and is now open to the general public. Operation and management is carried out by the Pocheon City Corporation Recreation Facilities Team. The recreational forest's facilities include a forest house and a forest cultural recreation center, making it a complex recreation center. The Forest Culture Recreation Center has 5 4-person rooms and 8 6-person rooms, and the forest house has 7 4-person rooms, 4 8-person rooms, and 4 red clay rooms for 4 people.

천안에 있는 워터파크로 7월~8월 여름 시즌에는 실외풀을 포함해 운영되는.en: This water park in Cheonan is an outdoor water park that includes an outdoor pool that operates during the summer season from July to August. It is equipped with a variety of facilities including a children's pool, wave pool, lazy river, and water slides, and there are spas throughout the place. In addition, there are auxiliary facilities such as a restaurant and an aqua shop that visitors can use comfortably. Food and mats are not allowed to be brought in. Nearby, there are tourist attractions such as the Cheonan Ecological Park and the Cheonan Memorial Tower. Please note that only indoor pools are open during the winter.

천제연 폭포는 한라산에서 시작된 중문천이 바다로 흐르면서 형성된 폭포로,.en: Cheonjeyeon Waterfall is a waterfall formed when the Jungmun Stream, which originates from Hallasan Mountain, flows into the sea, and is located within the Jungmun Tourist Complex. Cheonjeyeon Waterfall is divided into three waterfalls: the first waterfall falls from the columnar joint cliff into Cheonjeyeon (pond), and the second and third waterfalls are formed as the water from Cheonjeyeon flows further downward. The first waterfall is 22m high and Cheonjeyeon water depth is 21m. Although the waterfall does not fall during the dry season, the columnar jointed rock walls and emerald-colored pond are so beautiful that no one, domestic or foreigner, does not take out their camera. 1 There was a theory that cold water would pour from the ceiling of the rock cave near the waterfall, and that if you hit Baekjung or Cheoseo with foreign objects, all diseases would disappear, but swimming is now prohibited and entry is not possible. (Source: Jeju Culture and Tourism website)

김포성당은 1948년 본당으로 승격된 천주교 인천교구 소속의 유서 깊은.en: Gimpo Cathedral is a historic cathedral belonging to the Catholic Diocese of Incheon, which was promoted to a parish in 1948. The old Gimpo Cathedral (stone cathedral), completed in 1957, remains within the precincts and has historical value. This building well preserves the bell tower, pointed arch windows, and granite masonry, which are typical styles of cathedrals built right after the Korean War. In recognition of its architectural significance, it was designated as Korea Registered Cultural Property No. 542 in 2013, and is preserved and managed as a local religious cultural heritage.

청남대는 대청호반에 자리 잡고 있는 청남대는 따뜻한 남쪽의 청와대라는 뜻.en: Cheongnamdae, which means Blue House of the Warm South, is located on the banks of Daecheong Lake and has been used as the official villa of the President of the Republic of Korea since 1983. Past presidents met with various people at Cheongnamdae to discuss regional issues and also welcomed several state guests. The main facilities include a golf course, shade house, heliport, fish farm, okakjeong, and thatched house, centered around the main building. It was used a total of 88 times by five presidents before opening, and was opened to the public on April 18, 2003. Landscaping trees and wildflowers that change their appearance according to the four seasons are another pride of Cheongnamdae. The natural ecosystem is well preserved, and natural monuments such as otters, flying squirrels, wild boars, elk, and raccoons live there, and it is also a destination for various migratory birds.

청련사는 신라 시대에 창건된 경기도 양주시 장흥면의 천년고찰이다. '백성.en: Cheongnyeonsa Temple is a thousand-year-old temple in Jangheung-myeon, Yangju-si, Gyeonggi-do, founded during the Silla Dynasty. It was initially called 'Anjeongsa Temple' with the meaning of 'making the people comfortable and strengthening the country', and has continued to serve as a patriotic Buddhist temple for a long time. There is an old-fashioned yet grand atmosphere throughout the precincts. In Daeungjeon, the wooden seated Amitabha Buddha Triad, a tangible cultural heritage of Gyeonggi-do, is enshrined, and various Buddhist statues can be seen in various other pavilions.

청심평화월드센터는 2012년 3월 22일 개관한 복합문화 예술공간이다..en: Cheongshim Peace World Center is a complex cultural and art space that opened on March 22, 2012. It is a cultural experience space where performances, musicals, special exhibitions, concerts, and festivals leading the global cultural business can be held, as well as conventions, events, and promotions for international business, as well as various domestic and international indoor sports games, educational events, expos, and broadcast commercial filming. It is an indoor performance hall that can simultaneously accommodate 25,000 people, which is 8 times the size of the Sejong Center for the Performing Arts and twice the size of the Olympic gymnastics stadium. It is equipped with facilities such as a theater-style stage system, sound and lighting systems for optimal performances and events, a 4-sided LED display, and sliding chairs. The space on the 3rd basement floor is an indoor set where music videos, advertisements, etc. can be filmed, and various productions using water, smog, etc. are possible depending on the situation.

장흥유원지 초입에 있는 청암민속박물관은 우리 조상들의 삶을 생생히 볼 수.en: Cheongam Folk Museum, located at the entrance to Jangheung Recreation Area, is a museum of modern and contemporary life history where you can vividly see the lives of our ancestors. 7080 It is one of the famous places in Jangheung Amusement Park that is full of retro sensibility that brings back memories and is great for an outing with the family. Cheongam Folk Museum, which opened as a private folk museum, displays over 12,000 lifestyle and folk relics in a large garden. It is an attached facility of Pizza Seonghyoinbang, a famous restaurant. During the heyday when the taste of pizza was known, it was sad to see customers waiting in long lines, so it started as a space where they could look around for a while while waiting. The museum consists of a total of 7 exhibition halls: Hall 1 General Hall (folk goods exhibition), Hall 2 Little Groom Hall (old wedding exhibition), Hall 3 Theme Hall (old shops and classrooms, etc.), Hall 4 Art Hall (traditional craft experience hall), Hall 5 Cheonggyecheon Street View, Hall 6 Seogak Exhibition Hall & Seminar House, Hall 7 Pizza Experience Village & various gift corners. Outdoors, you can see our daily lives such as a blacksmith shop, a well, and a market street scene. The intact model is on display. There are also various folk games such as neolttwigi, jegichagi, and swing riding. Here, adults can reminisce, children can experience the old lifestyles of our ancestors, and they can stop by the jointly operated Pizza Seonghyoinbang to enjoy mugwort crust pizza or relax while drinking tea at the cafe next to the museum. It takes about 9 minutes by car from Songchu IC. Located within the Jangheung Recreation Area, Gana Art Park, Duri Land, Jang Wook-jin Museum of Art, and Songam Space Center are adjacent. Nearby are the Feelux Lighting Museum, Hoeam Temple Site, Bukhansan National Park, and the ASEAN National Recreational Forest.

* 삼국시대 포곡식 석축산성, 상당산성 *상당산성이란 명칭은 삼국시대 백.en: * Sangdangsanseong Fortress, a granary-style stone fortress during the Three Kingdoms Period *The name Sangdangsanseong Fortress appears to have originated from Sangdanghyeon, Baekje, during the Three Kingdoms Period. It is a huge valley-style stone mountain fortress with a circumference of over 4km. It is presumed that Sangdangsanseong Fortress was first built during the Baekje period when it was made of earthen fortress, and there is also a record that Kim Yu-sin's third son, Kim Seo-hyeon (Wonjeonggong), built Seowonsulseong Fortress. Afterwards, it was rebuilt during the Japanese invasions of Korea in the 29th year of King Seonjo's reign during the Joseon Dynasty, and then rebuilt into a stone fortress during the reign of King Sukjong. According to the town newspaper, this mountain fortress was renovated with stone walls in 1716 (the 42nd year of King Sukjong's reign) based on old records, and the names and positions of construction officials at the time are engraved on the gates and walls, including the south gate. The gate tower of the southern gate was restored in 1977. * Structure and construction method of Sangdangsanseong Fortress *The area of ​​the fortress is 12.6ha and the perimeter is 4,400m. It was built using the Naetakgong method, which involves constructing a nearly vertical fortress wall with stones of irregular sizes and piling up the inside with earth and sand, and the height is 4.7m. There were three gates in the east, west, and south. The south gate was made of red stone and a wooden gate tower was built on top of it. Now only the stonework remains, and the gate is 3.5m high and 4.2m wide. The eastern and western gates also had gate towers, and the gate was built in a square shape with samurai stones and was 2.7m high and 2.8m wide. There were dark gates, one each near the east and south gates, and a water outlet in the southeast, but now a reservoir has been created here. The remains of Dongjangdae and Seojangdae remain within the fortress. Sangdangsanseong Fortress is the most representative building symbolizing Cheongju. Even from a distance, the fortress wall, which is clearly visible as if Sangdangsan Mountain is wearing a band on its head, is a sentinel that serves as a fence for the people of Cheongju in times of crisis. The wall that runs along Sangdangsan Mountain's ridge goes around the mountain and has a circumference of 4.2km and a height of 4~5m. It was partially repaired during the Japanese invasions of Korea, and a stone fortress was built with square-cut granite in the 42nd year of King Sukjong's reign (1716). Inside the castle, there were five ponds, three temples, a government building, and a warehouse. Currently, Sangdangsanseong Fortress has three gates: Gongnammun (south gate), Mihomun (west gate), and Jindongmun (east gate), two ammun gates, three chiseongs, and three sugu. Dongjangdae, where the Joseon military used to train, was restored in 1992 and is now replicating its former appearance. If you go around the castle and come down, there is a traditional Hanok village inside the castle. The traditional liquor and bindaetteok you can taste in the traditional village will help relieve the fatigue of climbing the mountain fortress. ※ There is a cultural and tourism interpreter on site, so you can listen to the explanation at any time.◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave - In the drama <Lovers>, ‘Sangdangsanseong Fortress’ is the place where King Injo took refuge due to the invasion of the Qing Dynasty in <Lovers>, and the background is Namhansanseong Fortress. It is also a place where

청평사는 한때 국보로 지정되었던 극락전 건물과 고려 최고의 명필로 꼽히는.en: Cheongpyeongsa Temple is a historic temple with a building called Geungnakjeon, which was once designated as a national treasure, and the Monk Suwon Dynasty written by Tan Yeon, one of the best calligraphers of Goryeo. However, these relics suffered loss during the Korean War. Afterwards, Geungnakjeon was restored in 1975 and Munsuwongi was restored in 2008. In addition, Cheongpyeongsa Temple has well-preserved cultural heritage, including the revolving door, the three-story stone pagoda, the stupa of Jinrakgong Lee Ja-hyeon, and the stupa of Hwanjeokdang. The garden style of the Goryeo Dynasty, which actively utilized the natural terrain around the temple, is also noteworthy. It boasts an outstanding scenery with strangely shaped rocks and waterfalls harmonizing around Yeongji, a rectangular pond. Many writers, including Lee Je-hyeon and Kim Si-seup, came here to stay and leave poems, drawn by this beautiful scenery.

경기도 가평군에 위치한 청평 자연휴양림은 깨끗한 약수물을 마시며 여유롭게.en: Cheongpyeong Natural Recreation Forest, located in Gapyeong-gun, Gyeonggi-do, is a great place to drink clean mineral water, take a leisurely walk, and spend a quiet and leisurely time in nature. The clear blue Cheongpyeong Lakeside seen between pine trees, pine trees, and oak trees, the dense greenery of summer, autumn leaves, and winter snowscapes are spectacular depending on the season, and the sound of water flowing through the land and the sounds of birds make you feel the purity of Mother Nature. There are tables and chairs at the observatory with a panoramic view of Bukhansan Mountain, so you can take a leisurely break if you bring snacks. Most of the nature is intact and it is a shady dirt road, so you can take a cool walk even in the summer. In the pine tree forest path, there are wooden beds where you can lie down and take a forest bath. The hilly path covered with trees has a deck path so it is not inconvenient to take a walk. Registered as a place to provide forest welfare services, it offers a variety of programs tailored to forest welfare service users as well as corporate training programs, making it suitable for education, training, training, outings, nature observation classes at kindergartens and academies, church retreats, and outdoor worship for families as well as each group.

청평호는 북한강을 막아 만든 청평댐이 건설되면서 만들어진 인공 호수이다..en: Cheongpyeong Lake is an artificial lake created when the Cheongpyeong Dam was built to block the Bukhangang River. Not only is the scenery created by the surrounding mountains and clear water of the lake very beautiful, but it is also only 50km away from Seoul, so it has started to develop into a day course tourist destination. Cheongpyeong Lakeside refers to the area around Cheongpyeong Lake, a name given to the beauty of Cheongpyeong Lake and the surrounding mountains, and is one of Gapyeong's eight scenic spots. There are various types of accommodations and leisure facilities near the lake, making it easy to enjoy the different seasons. Cheongpyeong Lake Road is a deck path created by installing rebar pillars on the rocky cliffs of Ulupsan Mountain so that travelers can walk while enjoying the scenery of the rocky mountain and Cheongpyeong Lakeside. You can feel the beauty and excitement of Cheongpyeong Lakeside amidst the rocks that seem to pour down and the open scenery of the Bukhangang River. It is a little-known hidden attraction that boasts even more beautiful scenery when visited on a sunny day, and is also good as a trekking course as part of the Sinseonbong circular trail.

청풍호반 케이블카는 제천의 명소, 청풍호반의 아름다운 경치를 감상할 수.en: Cheongpung Lakeside Cable Car is a place where you can enjoy the beautiful scenery of Cheongpung Lakeside, a famous attraction in Jecheon. It runs a 2.3km round trip from Multae-ri, Cheongpung-myeon to the top of Bibongsan Mountain. It reaches the top of Bibongsan Mountain in about 10 minutes, covering a distance of 2.3km at an average speed of 5m/s. It is named so because it resembles a phoenix bird hatching an egg at the top of Mt. Bibongsan and then flying to find food. In addition, it is a famous mountain located in the center of Cheongpung Lake, 531 meters above sea level, and the view from the top has an outstanding scenery that is similar to the Dadohae Sea. As the first cable car in Korea to operate to the top, children and the elderly can comfortably ride the cable car and enjoy the secret scenery of Cheongpung Lake.

초록산산림욕장은 경기도 화성시 양감면에 위치한 자연 친화적인 힐링 공간이.en: Choroksan Forest Bathing Area is a nature-friendly healing space located in Yanggam-myeon, Hwaseong-si, Gyeonggi-do. This place boasts lush forests and clean air, and offers visitors forest bathing to heal their bodies and minds. Green Mountain Forest Park has well-maintained trails and trekking courses, making it ideal for enjoying a comfortable walk or exercise in nature. In addition, it is a place where you can feel communion with nature by observing various plants and animals. In particular, there is a meditation space and a relaxation space where you can relieve stress and relieve fatigue, so you can spend some leisurely time away from your busy daily life. Green Mountain Forest Bathing Area is a place where you can take care of your health and healing at the same time, and plays an important role in helping you stabilize and recover your mind and body while enjoying nature. This is an ideal resting place not only for families, but also for all nature lovers.

박경리 선생의 대하소설 <토지>의 무대로 유명한 악양 평사리는 섬진강이.en: Akyang Pyeongsa-ri, famous as the setting for Park Kyung-ni’s epic novel “Land,” is a land that benefited from the Seomjingang River. As you enter along the rice field road in Pyeongsa-ri, two pine trees stand tall in the middle of the field and greet you warmly. At the foot of Jiri Mountain, thatched houses spread out like a picture. The tile-roofed house that looks like a whale’s back in the middle of the hill is Choi Champan’s house, which was the setting for Park Kyung-ni’s epic novel “Land.” In Pyeongsa-ri, the setting of Park Kyeong-ni's epic novel Land, from the Donghak Revolution to modern history, Choi Champan's house in the novel is embodied in 14 Hanok buildings, and a set for the drama Land, which reproduces the lifestyle of our people in the late Joseon Dynasty, has also been created. Every fall, the ‘Toji Literature Festival’, a literary festival for writers across the country, is held here, and it has established itself as a literary village.

평사리 풍경을 그대로 담은 고품격 한옥숙박시설 최참판댁 한옥 호텔은 <구.en: Choi Champandaek Hanok Hotel, a high-class Hanok accommodation facility that captures the scenery of Pyeongsa-ri, is famous as the filming location of numerous movies and dramas, including <Moonlight Drawn by Clouds>, <Mr. Sunshine>, and <Hwanhoon>. It is located 10 minutes away from Hwagae Market and 20 minutes away from Ssanggyesa Temple, so it has excellent accessibility to Hadong attractions. Guests staying at the hotel can visit Choi Champan’s house for free. It provides differentiated services with a comfortable interior, high-quality bedding, and a bedroom, living room, and kitchen.

동해시의 명소 추암 촛대바위는 수중의 기암괴석이 바다를 배경으로 함께 어.en: Chuam Chotdaebawi Rock, a famous spot in Donghae City, is a place that amazes with its unexplored scenery where strangely shaped underwater rocks come together against the backdrop of the sea. The sight of strange and exquisite candlestick-like rocks forming a group and soaring into the sky is truly spectacular. The sea surrounding Chotdae Rock and the surrounding strangely shaped rocks changes its appearance from time to time. On days when the waves are rough, it is covered in white foam and resembles the shape of a dragon ascending to heaven, and on days when the waves are calm, it gives the feeling of a deep lake. The sunrise here is so famous that it is crowded with many travelers and photographers. It is said that even Uam Song Si-yeol looked around this place and could not leave it. The sunrise at Chotdae Rock and Hyeongje Rock is often used as the wallpaper for the first verse of the national anthem.

경기도 양평군 용문산 관광단지에 위치한 복고 문화 체험관이다. 1970-.en: It is a retro culture experience center located in the Yongmunsan Tourist Complex in Yangpyeong-gun, Gyeonggi-do. It consists of a total of 8 themes, including street scenes, play culture, and schools in the 1970s and 1980s, and provides over 100 different experiences and memorable photo zones. Yongmunsan Mountain Tourist Complex, where the Youth Museum is located, is a healing tourist destination in Gyeonggi-do that is visited by 1 million people annually. It is loved for its facilities such as the 1,000-year-old ginkgo tree of Yongmunsa Temple and the Yongmunsan Mountain hiking trail at 1,157 meters above sea level.

축령산은 광주산맥이 가평군에 이르러 명지산과 운악산이 솟구치며 내려오다가.en: Chukryeong Mountain is a dark mountain formed right in front of the Han River when the Gwangju Mountain Range reaches Gapyeong-gun and Myeongji Mountain and Unak Mountain rise and fall. It is a mountain with dense forests and a beautiful valley at an altitude of 887.1 m. You can have the opportunity to feel the good feelings of a night with your family in a quiet forest, and you can feel the distinct sense of the seasons, such as azalea flowers at the top of Seori Mountain in spring, cool valleys with a harmony of rocks and forests in summer, beautiful autumn leaves in fall, and snowy scenery in winter. A natural recreation forest was created using the dense forests and valleys of Chukryeong Mountain. It is a place equipped with convenient facilities such as forest bathing areas, rest areas, sports facilities, play facilities, and camping sites. Hiking is only possible through the natural recreation forest. After passing the Natural Recreation Forest Management Office, go up the ridge to the left at the fork outside the recreation forest, pass Suribawi Rock, and go up for about 30 minutes to reach Nami Rock. From Nami Rock, climb the sharp-edged rock ridge to reach the summit. * Legend of Chukryeong Mountain * There is a legend that Taejo Lee Seong-gye, the founder of the Joseon Dynasty, went hunting in the late Goryeo Dynasty and returned without catching a single animal. The herder said that this mountain was a sacred mountain and that a mountain god rite should be held, so he climbed to the top of the mountain, performed a rite to the mountain god, and then went hunting and caught a wild boar. From then on, it is said that it was called Chukryeong Mountain because it was the mountain where ceremonial rituals were held.

* 자연을 벗삼아 휴양할 수 있는 공간, 축령산자연휴양림 *축령산은 남양.en: * Chukryeongsan Natural Recreation Forest, a space where you can relax in nature. *Chuknyeongsan Mountain is a mountain 887.1m above sea level that straddles Namyangju City and Gapyeong-gun. It is a mountain with dense forests and beautiful valleys. There is a legend that Lee Seong-gye, who founded the Joseon Dynasty, came hunting in the late Goryeo Dynasty and was unable to catch a single animal. The herder told him that this mountain was a sacred mountain and that a mountain spirit rite should be held, so he climbed to the top of the mountain, performed a rite, and then caught a wild boar. From then on, it is said that it came to be called Chuknyeongsan Mountain, as it was said to be the mountain where funerals were held. It is a recreational forest that opened on July 1, 1995 and is currently directly managed by Gyeonggi Province. It has a well-maintained 50-year-old pine tree forest, and the pine tree trail at the entrance to the hiking trail to the top of Mt. Chukryeong is so thick that you can't see the sky, giving it a sense of mystery. The 779ha wide forest has a forest bathing area, sports facilities, a water park, a camping site, and a nature observation site, making it a perfect place for family recreation and a suitable place for a one-day hiking course.

활과 부메랑을 형상화한 춘천 삼악산 호수 케이블카는 삼천동에서 의암호를.en: The Chuncheon Samaksan Lake Cable Car, which resembles a bow and boomerang, is a 3.61km cable car that connects Samaksan Mountain from Samcheon-dong to Uiam Lake. The crystal cabin, which adopts the latest model from Austria's Doppelmeier, has a floor made of glass, allowing you to see the beautiful Uiam Lake without any filtering. Pets are allowed except on the Crystal plane and on the walking trails. The observatory you reach across Uiamho Lake has a glass-covered cafe where you can relax and make memories while looking out over the beautiful city of Chuncheon. The Sky Walk Observatory, which can be reached by walking for about 10 minutes along the trail connected to the observatory, is also a must-see. In addition to restaurants, convenience stores, and cafes, the Uiam Lake stop is also equipped with various convenient facilities such as souvenir shops and commemorative photo studios where you can preserve the lingering memories of your trip. ◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave - Entertainment <2 Days in Stone> Riding a cable car floating on the lake is Ive's youth course. As the 3.61km cable car, the longest in Korea, crosses Uiam Lake and goes up to Samaksan Mountain, mountains, lakes, and cities unfold as if flowing. The beautiful scenery comes closer when you board the crystal cabin with a transparent floor. We recommend looking down on Chuncheon from Samaksan Mountain Station (Upper Station) and feeling the refreshing mountain air.

게이트볼장, 족구장 테니스코트 등의 체육 시설이 있고 야간 조명 시설까지.en: There are sports facilities such as a gateball field, foot volleyball court, and tennis court, as well as seven artificial turf soccer fields equipped with night lighting facilities that can be used upon request for rental. There are flat-shaped shaded rest areas here and there, as well as various exercise equipment, a floor fountain, and a children's playground. This theme park operates with CCTV 24 hours a day, so you can use it with peace of mind.

1922년 일제강점기에 개발된 국내 유일 활석 광산으로 기록상 57㎞,.en: Developed during the Japanese colonial period in 1922, it is Korea's only talc mine, with a recorded length of 57 km and an unofficial 87 km, and an underground vertical height of 711 m, making it the largest mine in Asia. Of these, 2.5km out of 57km were developed as tourist destinations, creating light sculptures, performance halls, health therapy, etc. LED neon and various natural lights create a mysterious and mysterious atmosphere, and the temperature is maintained at 11 to 15 degrees all year round, making it a popular tourist destination in the summer. Additionally, the experience of seeing the inside of a cave while kayaking in a lake created by stagnant bedrock water is also gaining popularity. It is the only white jade, talc, and dolomite mine in Korea that was discovered in 1900 and began development during the Japanese colonial period (1922). It is said that talc mined in Chungju during the Joseon Dynasty was used as royal medicine. Talc is still widely used today. High-purity talc is used as a raw material for cosmetics and baby powder, while low-purity talc is used in household products such as lubricants, shoe polish, and toiletries.

칠장산은 높이 492m의 낮은 산인데, 아담하고 아름다운 모습을 지니고.en: Chiljangsan Mountain is a low mountain with a height of 492m, and has a small and beautiful appearance. There is Chiljangsa Temple at the foot, and the temple is surrounded by a dense forest. Recently, many people are visiting Chiljangsan Mountain to enjoy the beautiful scenery of Chiljangsa Temple and light hiking.

경기도 가평읍 경반안로에 위치한 칼봉산자연휴양림은 다른 휴양림에 비해 규.en: Kalbongsan Natural Recreation Forest, located in Gyeongbanan-ro, Gapyeong-eup, Gyeonggi-do, is smaller than other recreational forests, but it is a combination of dense forests and valleys, and is well-maintained so that anyone can use the trails and forest paths without having to use lodging facilities. Kalbongsan Natural Recreation Forest is mainly about walking and lodging rather than swimming or camping in the valley. There are forest houses (1 Geumgang Lantern building, 6 magnolia buildings, 2 Lily buildings, 1 Yeongsanhong building) and Red Clay Rooms (3 Baekrim buildings, 3 bleeding heart flower buildings), which are villa-like accommodations located in the forests of Kalbongsan Mountain, and a forest recreation center (accommodations for forsythia, apple, pomegranate, camellia, etc., as well as a conference room) that are good for groups is in operation. Many people use this place as a vacation spot because they can relax and feel nature in the forest, and the fee is cheap. Each accommodation has a barbecue area, so if you prepare your own food, you can enjoy a cozy meal. In Kalbongsan Mountain Natural Recreation Forest, the Gyeongban Forest Trail, where you can see Geumgyeguk flowers and the beautiful Gyeongban Valley between pine trees and oak trees, begins in front of Geumgang Lantern Lodge. In addition, there is a deck road like an observatory where pine trees stand tall in the recreation forest, so you can walk along a path with a stream flowing in front and a forest behind.

서울 강남구에 위치한 코엑스은 1979년 3월 개관이래 글로벌 전시회와.en: Since its opening in March 1979, COEX, located in Gangnam-gu, Seoul, has established itself as the center of MICE business as a venue for international exchange through hosting global exhibitions and international conferences, and as the best exhibition culture and tourist attraction equipped with global business infrastructure. COEX is equipped with a total of four exhibition halls and 50 conference rooms from the first to fourth floors, as well as the best convenience facilities, a performance hall, and office space. In addition, COEX Artium opened in 2009, New COEX Mall opened in 2014, and Gangnam MICE Special Tourist Zone was designated, making it a global cultural and business platform equipped with an eco-friendly MICE tech system.

코트야드 메리어트 서울 명동은 서울특별시 중심부에 들어선 첫 번째 코트야.en: Courtyard Marriott Seoul Myeongdong is the first Courtyard brand hotel located in the center of Seoul. It faces National Treasure No. 1 Sungnyemun Gate and boasts proximity to Namdaemun Market and Myeong-dong. It boasts a convenient location, about a 5-minute walk from Exit 6 of Euljiro 1-ga Station on Subway Line 2. The main branch of Lotte Department Store is within a 5-minute walk. In addition, Cheonggyecheon is about a 10-minute walk away, Myeongdong Street is about a 5-minute walk away, and Ssamziegil, where you can find various crafts, is about a 20-minute walk away. This hotel provides a variety of facilities and services for travelers, including free wireless Internet in public areas, valet parking, and a cafe. In addition, we always provide the high-quality services unique to Seoul luxury hotels, such as a luxurious bar, room service, dry cleaning, and free parking.

콩치노콩크리트는 파주에 위치한 국내 최대 규모의 순수 음악감상실이다. 1.en: Concino Concrete is Korea’s largest pure music appreciation room located in Paju. Through vintage speakers used in American and German theaters in the 1930s, you can enjoy music of various genres, including jazz and classical music, from a collection of over 10,000 LPs. To allow you to fully concentrate on the music, only bottled water is provided as beverage. The changes of the four seasons unfold beyond the full-length windows, and the sunset seen from the window seat on the second floor is especially beautiful, so it is also called a ‘sunset restaurant.’ We provide a special cultural experience with music through performances held periodically.

타임빌라스 수원은 백화점과 쇼핑몰의 강점을 결합한 컨버전스형 프리미엄 쇼.en: Time Villas Suwon is a convergence-type premium shopping mall that combines the strengths of a department store and a shopping mall. In addition to the largest ‘Nike Rise’ and ‘Adidas Beacon’ stores in the commercial district, it has popular global brands such as ‘Kenzo’, ‘Mulberry’, and ‘Kestify’, and you can experience an overwhelming gourmet curation at ‘Dining Avenue’, a premium food hall that brings together restaurants from all over the country. It is connected to the Suwon Station transfer center, so it is easily accessible, and there is a children's lounge at the kids' specialty center, 'Kinder Universe', so families can enjoy comfortable shopping.

탄천종합운동장 빙상장은 경기도 성남시 분당구에 위치한 실내 스케이트장이다.en: Tancheon Sports Complex Ice Rink is an indoor skating rink located in Bundang-gu, Seongnam-si, Gyeonggi-do. This place is equipped with an international standard ice rink measuring 60m x 30m, so you can enjoy various ice sports such as speed skating and figure skating. The facility has skate rentals, changing rooms, and shower facilities for your convenience. In addition, there is a skating lesson program that everyone from beginners to experts can participate in, which helps improve skills. The Tancheon Sports Complex ice rink has established itself as an important facility that supports a healthy leisure life for local residents.

부산 영도구 태종대는 아름다운 자연경관과 풍부한 역사적 의미를 가진 관광.en: Taejongdae, Yeongdo-gu, Busan, is a tourist destination with beautiful natural scenery and rich historical meaning. This is a representative scenic spot in Busan, boasting a unique scenery with strangely shaped rocks and dense forests. There is an observatory at Taejongdae, where you can enjoy the scenery while looking at the sea in the distance. In addition, the Taejongdae area has various walking trails and paths along the coastline, providing tourists with opportunities to heal in nature. This place is a popular attraction for visitors as it also has historical sites such as Taejongdae Lighthouse and Taejongsa Temple. You can also enjoy the Danubi train at Taejongdae, making it a recommended place for a weekend outing with children and family.

태화강 국가정원은 1급수 생태하천 태화강을 끼고 있는 친환경 생태 정원으.en: Taehwa River National Garden is an eco-friendly ecological garden located along the Taehwa River, a first-class ecological river. It is a key tourist attraction in Ulsan located in the center of the city and can be used without time restrictions. However, the information center, which provides convenience such as publicity and exhibition of the national garden, and garden interpretation, is open from 9:00 to 18:00, and the Milky Way Road, one of the famous attractions of the Taehwagang National Garden, is open from sunset to 23:00 every day. It is built on a riverbed with a total area of ​​835,452㎡ located across Jung-gu and Nam-gu in Ulsan Metropolitan City, and has a total of 6 spaces: Ecology, Bamboo, Seasons, Aquatic, Participation, and Rose of Sharon. In particular, the Simni Bamboo Forest here is famous for the clear sound of bamboo hitting in the wind and the quiet and beautiful paths. In addition, gardening for children and family garden experience programs are being operated. Nearby, there are various tourist attractions where nature and the city are in harmony, including Taehwaru, Cavepia, and the Migratory Bird Promotion Center, as well as Daewangam Park, one of Ulsan's 12 scenic views, Ganjeolgot, where the sun rises first in the East Sea, Bangudae Petroglyphs, which preserve the history and culture of prehistoric times, Sinbulsan Silver Grass Plain, Mongdol Beach in Gangdong and Jujeon, Ulsan Grand Park, and Ulsan Bridge.◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave - Drama <Lee Jae, soon. This is where Lee Jae, who was reincarnated as her mother, visited while reminiscing about her mother. The gardens created under six themes along the Taehwa River all boast beautiful scenery. In the drama, Lee Jae's sad expression contrasting with the scenery brought viewers to tears.

이천 테르메덴이 표방하는 독일식 온천시설은 단순히 목욕 중심으로 짜여있는.en: The German-style hot spring facility advocated by Icheon Termeden is different from the Japanese-style facility, which is simply centered around bathing. It has a natural park surrounded by dense forest on a vast site of over 300,000 square meters (90,750 pyeong) on ​​average. There is a large bath pool where you can enjoy forest bathing and swimming. In addition to the hot springs, it is equipped with various sports facilities, entertainment centers, cultural centers, and various auxiliary facilities. In terms of hot spring bathing methods, most of the conventional hot springs were Japanese-style, where you sit in the bath and then come out, but the German-European style hot springs stimulate each part of the body by spraying water jets installed in the bathe pool, creating a massage effect and helping revitalize the skin. And in the massive bade pool with a water depth of 120 cm and a diameter of 30 m, you can exercise constantly by walking and swimming in the lazy river and circulating water. Termeden is a comprehensive resort with a 16,529 m² (approximately 5,000 pyeong) hot spring spa on a total of 429,754 m² (130,000 pyeong) of land with the goal of realizing such a German-style hot spring. In the future, it will be equipped with a hotel condominium, an arboretum, a golf driving range, and a horseback riding range.

우리나라 3대 사찰의 하나인 통도사는 부처의 진신사리가 모셔져 있는 불보.en: Tongdosa Temple, one of the three major temples in Korea, is a Buddhist temple where the relics of the Buddha are enshrined. According to the records of the temple, it was named Tongdosa because the shape of the mountain on which the temple is located is similar to that of Yeongchwi Mountain in India, where the Buddha preached. Tongdo also means that anyone who wants to become a monk must pass through the Diamond Stairs. It is also said that it was named Tongdosa because it means saving all living beings by reconciling all truths. According to the records of the Samguk Yusa, Monk Jajang of Silla learned Buddhism in the Tang Dynasty, returned, became the great general of Silla, founded Tongdosa Temple according to the king's orders, and spread the Buddhist teachings widely, including overseeing the rules of monks and teaching Buddhist rituals. It is also said that he enshrined the Buddha's relics and built a Diamond Staircase, thereby helping many people who wanted to become monks. The buildings were rebuilt twice after being destroyed by fire during the Japanese invasions of Korea, and except for Daegwangmyeongjeon, all of them are newly built. Tongdosa Temple houses Buddha's relics, so there are no Buddha statues in the main hall. Daeungjeon Hall and Geumgang Stairs are designated as national treasures, and 26 items, including the bronze incense bowl with silver encasement and the Tongdosa Bonbal Pagoda, which are designated as treasures, are housed in the Seongbo Museum in Tongdosa Temple. Tongdosa Temple Stay is a large-scale temple stay that matches the size of the large temple. Starting with temple etiquette taught directly by monks, and ending with explanations of Tongdosa cultural assets provided by Jeokmyeol Doryanghoe, a Tongdosa volunteer group, it provides essential knowledge about the temple in a short period of time. When the sun sets, I carry the lotus lantern I made during the day, enter the palace where the Buddha's relics and robe are kept, and meditate while facing the stupa. Bogung Meditation is a core program of the Tongdosa Temple Stay, to the extent that some people participate in the temple stay just for this experience.

경기도 가평군 설악면 천안리와 양평군 서종면 명달리에 걸쳐 있는 산으로.en: It is a mountain spanning Cheonan-ri, Seorak-myeon, Gapyeong-gun, Gyeonggi-do, and Myeongdal-ri, Seojong-myeon, Yangpyeong-gun. Its height is 650m. Tongbangsan Mountain (通方山) is named so because when you climb up the mountain, you have a clear view in all directions. To the north, Tongbangsan Mountain is connected to Hwayasan Mountain and Pyorubong Peak, and to the south, it is connected to Samtaebong Peak and Jungmisan Mountain. The entire slope of Tongbangsan Mountain is relatively steep, and the stream flowing to the east flows into Byeokgye Stream, and to the west flows Myeongdal Stream. To the northeast of Tongbangsan Mountain is Cheongdarak Valley, to the southeast is Byeokgye Valley, and to the south is Samgak Valley, which is dotted with lakes and springs, creating large valleys in three directions. Tongbangsan Mountain is used as a hiking course along with Samtaebong Mountain, and a linked hike is also possible through Hwayasan Mountain, Tongbangsan Mountain, and Samtaebong Mountain to Jungmisan Mountain. To hike, there is a course that starts at Bangil-ri, passes Samtaebong Peak, climbs to the summit, and then descends to Hanwoojae, and a course that starts at Myeongdal Branch School of Seojong Elementary School, passes through the valley, climbs to the peak through Samtaebong Peak, then passes the 567m peak and Iljuam Rock, and then descends to Nomun-ri. When you stand at the top, you can see the Namhangang River to the south, Yongmunsan Mountain to the southeast, and Ungilsan Mountain to the west. Be careful when hiking because there are slippery paths with fallen leaves, steep uphills, and rocky areas where you have to hold on to a rope.

통영중앙전통시장은 400여 년의 역사를 간직하고 있는 유서 깊은 시장이다.en: Tongyeong Central Traditional Market is a historic market with over 400 years of history. On the hill behind the market is Dongpirang, which is called the Montmartre of the East, and is adjacent to the Sebyeonggwan, built to commemorate the military service of Admiral Yi Sun-sin, and the Gangguan Cultural Center where the turtle ship is displayed. Fresh live fish and dried fish are mainly sold, and there are still shops selling mother-of-pearl lacquerware products, quilted products, and bajigae rice cakes, which are characteristic of the area where 12 workshops were located during the Joseon Dynasty, continuing the tradition of a traditional market. Specialized streets are created for each district, such as live fish specialty street, fresh fish specialty street, side dish specialty street, dried fish street, and honey bread street, so you can enjoy a variety of things to see and eat.

통영 미륵산에 설치된 통영케이블카는 2선(bi-cable) 자동순환식 곤.en: The Tongyeong Cable Car installed at Mireuksan Mountain in Tongyeong is a two-wire (bi-cable) automatic circulation gondola system installed using the latest Swiss technology, and is 1975m long. At an average speed of 4 meters per second, it takes about 9 minutes to reach the upper station, and 48 gondolas, including 47 passenger gondolas and 1 cargo gondola, will circulate. In particular, due to the eco-friendly design, only one intermediate support is installed, which not only protects the environment but also provides a very comfortable ride for passengers. In addition, 47 8-person gondolas continuously transport passengers, allowing passengers to board without delay and enjoy the beautiful scenery of Hallyeo Waterway in privacy with those close to them. With the opening of the pet-friendly cable car, you can ride with your pet.

경기도 김포시 통진읍에 위치한 통진두레문화센터는 제38회 전국민속예술 경.en: The Tongjin Dure Culture Center, located in Tongjin-eup, Gimpo-si, Gyeonggi-do, was established for the succession and development of ''Tongjin Dure Nori'', which won the President's Award at the 38th National Folk Art Contest (1997) and was designated as a designated intangible cultural asset of Gyeonggi-do (1998). Tongjin Durenol is a play of the Duren customs performed during the busy farming season in Ongjeong-ri, Tongjin-eup, Gimpo-si, Gyeonggi-do in the 1960s, and is preserved as a local cultural heritage to this day. In addition, it also serves as a multi-cultural art space that inherits and develops our unique traditional intangible culture and folk art and provides a variety of cultural and artistic services. The first floor of the center has a performance hall, promotional exhibition room, and practice room, and the second floor has an experiential learning room and the Tongjin Durenori Preservation Association office. The performance hall on the first floor is used for performances such as experimental theater, plays, madangnori, and pansori. The promotional exhibition room displays detailed explanations and models of Tongjindurenori along with various relics. In addition, there are various experience programs, including an out-of-school traditional art class and the Tongjindurenori program, where you can learn about intangible cultural assets representing Gimpo. Please refer to the website for more information, including rental inquiries.

통진향교는 경기도 김포시 월곶면 군하리에 있는 향교이며, 1983년 경기.en: Tongjinhyanggyo is a local school located in Gunhari, Wolgot-myeon, Gimpo-si, Gyeonggi-do, and was designated as a cultural property of Gyeonggi-do in 1983. Hyanggyo is a national educational institution during the Goryeo and Joseon Dynasties that was established to hold memorial tablets of great Confucian scholars, hold ancestral rites, and educate and enlighten local residents. It is said that Tongjinhyanggyo was first built in 1127, but it is not certain. Tongjin, meaning [through the ferry], is said to have been an important place protecting the entrance to the Han River during the Joseon Dynasty. During the Joseon Dynasty, students were taught with support from the government, but now the educational function has disappeared and only the ancestral rite function remains. Currently, Hyanggyo is composed of relatively modern buildings, except for Daeseongjeon. Myeongnyundang was newly built after the Korean War, and the Dongjae and Punghwaru, a two-story pavilion, were restored in 1994 and 1995, respectively. Existing buildings include Daeseongjeon with 4 rooms on the front and 3 rooms on the side, Myeongryundang with 5 rooms on the front and 2 rooms on the side, Naesammun (inner three doors), and a study room with 5 rooms on the front and 2 rooms on the side. In Daeseongjeon, memorial tablets of the five saints, the four sages of the Song Dynasty, and the 18 sages of our country are enshrined. During the Joseon Dynasty, one instructor was provided with land, tuition, and slaves by the government to teach a maximum of 30 students. However, with the implementation of the new system after the Gabo Reform, the educational function was lost, and a memorial service was held in the spring and fall, and incense was burned on the first day and the first full moon. This Hyanggyo is designated as a Gyeonggi-do cultural asset, and the operation of the Hyanggyo is in charge of one Jeongyo (典校) and one funeral director (掌議). The layout of the building is in the form of a typical Jeonhakhumyo, with Myeongryundang, an educational space, and Dongjae, a dormitory, in front as you pass through the passage below Punghwaru, and Daeseongjeon, a ancestral rite space, in the back. Entry to the main sanctuary of Tongjinhyanggyo is prohibited to the general public without permission, and experiential activities are possible through reservations. To make a reservation, you must contact the administrator [Hyanggyo Foundation].

보양온천으로 지정된 ‘파라다이스 스파 도고(Paradise Spa DOG.en: ‘Paradise Spa DOGO’, designated as a health hot spring, is a large resort facility opened by Paradise Group in Asan, South Chungcheong Province, the home of hot springs. This place was designated as the first national health hot spring in Chungcheong Province, reviewed and approved by the Ministry of Public Administration and Security. It has a total area of ​​24,622㎡ and can accommodate up to 5,000 people. It is equipped with a bathe pool that also provides hydrotherapy, a large hot spring bath where you can enjoy a sauna in warm sulfur spring water all year round, and various water play facilities. In particular, outdoor event spas with various seasonal themes are popular. During the winter, we offer health-friendly ogapi soup, ginger soup, and tangerine peel soup.

‘New Landmark in Pangyo, PAMEUS MALL 판교에.en: ‘New Landmark in Pangyo, PAMEUS MALL Separately and together in Pangyo’. Farmers Mall aims to be a complex cultural and commercial space where various lifestyles harmonize in harmony in Pangyo, Korea's representative self-sufficient new city. It is equipped with a variety of facilities, including shopping, leisure, cafes, and dining, as well as hotels, theaters, concert halls, medical centers, and galleries that can be enjoyed with children, friends, and lovers, completing an enriching day for residents of the Pangyo area. As the slogan says, ‘Separately, but together in Pangyo,’ daily life and leisure coexist naturally.

임진각은 한국전쟁과 민족 분단의 아픔을 간직한 대한민국의 대표적인 평화관.en: Imjingak is a representative peace tourist site in Korea that retains the pain of the Korean War and national division. There are various war monuments installed here, including the Imjingang River Battle Monument and the American Military Participation Monument. A train that ran to Sinuiju in the north before the Korean War is on display. One of the two bridges of the Imjin Railroad Bridge was destroyed during the war, so only the piers remain. Mangbaedan is a place where displaced people bow to their North Korean families. Imjingak is known as a place where the pain of separated families is felt. Every year, millions of Koreans and foreigners visit Imjingak. This place functions as a unification security tourist site that aspires to unification. It is equipped with facilities such as an exhibition hall, Pyeonghwa Nuri, Peace Gondola, and the Korean War Abductees Memorial Hall. The Imjingak area is a large-scale tourist attraction with a total area of ​​​​140,000 pyeong.

운정호수공원 일원에 위치한 파주놀이구름은 아이들과 온 가족이 함께 즐길.en: Paju PlayCloud, located in the area of ​​Unjeong Lake Park, is a play culture space that reflects the educational philosophy that children and the whole family can enjoy together. After UB Park, which opened in 2007 as a promotional center for Unjeong City, was closed in 2010, Paju Amusement Cloud was created in 2021 in about 10 unused spaces. Paju Play Cloud is an experiential amusement facility with a story. It consists of Sky Hill, Cloud Well, Rainbow Cave, Forest of Fantasy, Valley of the Wind, Dream Village, World of Adventure, Cylindrical Slide, Rainbow Lake, and Firefly Path. It also consists of a variety of media libraries, an interactive multimedia zone, a role play space, and a large ball pool with a slide and adventure bridge. On the other hand, there are books for children to read and a slide, making it a great place for the whole family to relax together.

파주시민회관은 파주시민의 여가와 문화생활 증진을 위해 1994년 9월 개.en: Paju Citizens' Center opened in September 1994 to promote the leisure and cultural life of Paju citizens. It was built with 5 floors above ground and 1 floor underground, and is equipped with a large performance hall that can accommodate up to 900 people, a small performance hall, an outdoor performance hall, and a multi-purpose room. Various cultural events, movie screenings, performances, and concerts are held in the large and small performance halls, and cultural events, performances, and rallies are held in the outdoor performance hall. In the multipurpose room, training, seminars, and exhibitions of art, photography, calligraphy, and crafts are held from time to time. It is located next to Paju City Hall and is about 4 minutes away by car from Geumchon Station on the Gyeongui-Jungang Line, making it easily accessible.

2013년에 개관한 판교박물관은 성남시의 역사를 담은 박물관으로 1600.en: Pangyo Museum, which opened in 2013, is a museum containing the history of Seongnam City and displays and preserves 11 Goguryeo and Baekje stone chamber tombs, evidence of exchanges in Northeast Asia during the Hanseong and Baekje era 1,600 years ago. By relocating and restoring a stone chamber tomb indoors in its original form for the first time in Korea, it is highly regarded as a successful example of cultural property conservation, and it also operates various educational programs as a historical and cultural experience space. - Educational use of history and cultural heritage in connection with curriculum and local history - Promoting understanding of common history and current affairs and enhancing historical mindset - Meeting the rising demand for education by expanding the scope of participants, etc. - Providing opportunities for citizens to participate in culture. and leisure activities - Promoting Seongnam City and museums through various media

팔공산케이블카는 경사가 있고 긴 코스이기에 경치를 구경하면서 동시에 스릴.en: Palgongsan Cable Car is a long and sloped course, so you can enjoy the thrill while enjoying the scenery. The capacity is 6 people, and 24 cars rotate automatically at 40-second intervals. Cable car Jeongsang Station is located at the top of Sillimbong Peak, and is a representative place for blessings and blessings along with Jecheondan Altar at the top of Birobong Peak and Gatbawi Buddha on the east. Cable car Jeongsang Station is located in a straight line with Jecheondan and Daegu World Cup Stadium. It is located in the center of the body of a phoenix in the shape of a phoenix flying up with its wings spread, making it a place with very good energy in terms of feng shui. In addition to the cable car, there are restaurants and cafes where you can eat, and there is also a walking trail so you can enjoy a light walk after taking the cable car. For this reason, many families visit here.

팔달산(八達山)은 해발 128m의 아담한 산으로 광교산 남쪽에 위치한 탑.en: Paldalsan (八達山) is a small mountain with an altitude of 128m. It is a tower-shaped mountain located south of Gwanggyosan, so its old name was Namtapsan. The current name is related to King Taejo Lee Seong-gye. It is said that King Taejo offered a government post to Igo, a scholar of Hallym who was secluded at the foot of Namtap Mountain, but Igo declined, citing the beauty of the mountain. King Taejo became curious and had a painter draw the scenery of Namtapsan Mountain. He said, “It is indeed a beautiful and all-round mountain,” and named it Paldalsan Mountain. On August 15, 1948, the Korean Independence Monument was erected on Jungpo Mountain, the site where the national monument of Noguchi, who died during the Japanese occupation, was destroyed. On March 1, 1969, the Samil Comrades Association erected the Samil Independence Monument on Paldalsan Mountain and moved the Korean Independence Monument to the side of the tower. If you climb Paldalsan Mountain, you can see Suwon at a glance, and you can go trekking in conjunction with Paldalsan Park and Hwaseong Fortress Wall.

팔당호는 경기도 광주시 퇴촌면과 남종면에 걸쳐있는 인공 호수로 1973년.en: Paldang Lake is an artificial lake spanning Toechon-myeon and Namjong-myeon in Gwangju-si, Gyeonggi-do. Since the completion of Paldang Dam in 1973, it has stored approximately 250 million tons of water. Paldang Lake has a water intake station that supplies tap water to Seoul and Gyeonggi regions, and the scenery of the lake seen from the area around the lakeside is beautiful, making Paldang Dam a tourist attraction in Gwangju. In particular, the [Paldangho Drive Course] is a local road course that passes through Namhansanseong Fortress and is a 12km section of local road No. 337 from Gwiyeo-ri, Namjong-myeon, Gwangju to Sucheong-ri, and is famous as one of the top five cherry blossom drive courses selected by Gyeonggi-do. Approximately 3,000 cherry trees along the side of the road harmonize with Paldang Lake, creating awe-inspiring views, and the area is crowded with visitors to view the cherry blossoms in spring. There is a Paldang Observatory on the 9th floor of the Gyeonggi Province Water Resources Headquarters building, where you can see the beautiful view of Paldang Lake at a glance.

경기도 안성시 죽산성지(이진터성지) 뒷산인 팔봉산에 엄지 손가락으로도 흔.en: On Palbongsan Mountain, the mountain behind Juksan Holy Site (Ijinteo Holy Site) in Anseong-si, Gyeonggi-do, there is a rock that can be shaken with your thumb. It is a huge rock with a height of 2.1m at the bottom and a circumference of 10.4m. It is said that during the Japanese occupation, the Japanese tried to remove this rock and flipped it halfway, but it returned to its original position. During team sprint training, nine American soldiers attempted to climb over this rock, but failed. Also, it is said that the rock is slightly resting so that two people from both sides can pass a thread under the rock. Palbongsan Mountain, where Deulbawi Rock is located, has eight famous places since ancient times. It is said that when a roe deer was saved from being chased by a hunter, the roe deer was grateful, so they dug up the ground between the two rocks and built a tomb there, and the descendants prospered. It is said that this is the famous place where the roe deer captured it. Beyond the rock, there is a tomb in front of the rock. According to the villagers, people who are unable to give birth to children can have babies if they apply their intelligence to this rock.

홍천군 서면 팔봉리에 있는 산(해발 327.4m)으로 홍천강이 산의 삼면.en: It is a mountain (327.4m above sea level) located in Palbong-ri, Seo-myeon, Hongcheon-gun. The Hongcheon River surrounds three sides of the mountain. It is one of Korea's 100 famous mountains designated by the Korea Forest Service and one of Hongcheon's eight scenic spots. When you look at the mountain before climbing it, you may think that it is too low compared to its reputation, but when you actually climb the mountain, you will be surprised once again by how challenging the rocky path is. There are eight long peaks along the southern coast of the river, and most of the eight peaks are rocky ridges, so you must be careful as there are sections where you have to climb up with a rope or climb up and down a nearly vertical ladder. Although it is a low mountain, it has many rocks and walls, and the ridge is rough, so it takes a lot of time to hike. There are three courses: Course A (takes 2 hours), which starts from the parking lot of Mt. Palbongsan Tourist Site and climbs to Peak 1 and then descends from Peak 2; Course B (takes 3 hours), which climbs to Peak 7 and then descends (takes 3 hours and 30 minutes). The hiking trail is somewhat rough and slippery, so you must wear hiking shoes and pay attention to safety. Nearby, you can enjoy a variety of leisure activities on Palbongsan Mountain, including a camping site, an outdoor performance hall, and a futsal stadium.

퍼스트가든은 경기도 파주시에 위치한 대규모 복합문화시설이다. 정원, 레스.en: First Garden is a large-scale cultural complex located in Paju, Gyeonggi-do. It is equipped with a variety of facilities including a garden, restaurant, wedding hall, play facilities, and cafe. In particular, the garden is made up of 23 themes, so you can feel different charms depending on the season, and in the evening, you can see the beautiful scenery combined with lighting. It is a great place for a family trip while using the garden playground, which has a little train, merry-go-round, and bumper cars for children to enjoy. First Garden operates a restaurant where you can taste food made with sincerity, and there are Korean and Western restaurants available. You can create special memories at First Garden, where you can experience a variety of experiences. ◎ Travel information to discover the charms of the Korean Wave Many fans are visiting Jimin of BTS for his monthly magazine pictorial at places such as an embroidery garden themed on Greek mythology and a white garden surrounded by white birch trees.

평촌자유공원 내에 있는 평촌아트홀은 안양 시민의 여가와 문화생활 증진을.en: Pyeongchon Art Hall, located within Pyeongchon Jayu Park, opened in September 2004 to promote the leisure and cultural life of Anyang citizens. It is operated by Anyang Culture and Arts Foundation. Pyeongchon Art Hall, which has two floors underground and three floors above ground, is equipped with a two-story performance hall that can accommodate 680 people (including seven seats for the disabled), three special exhibition rooms, an academy, and a cafe. In particular, the performance hall is two-story in size and has a 245㎡ stage and four dressing rooms. It is a concert hall exclusively for classical music, including orchestra, choir, chamber music, and recitals, and has a perfect sound system with no blind spots so that performers and audiences can feel each other's harmony. The special exhibition room consists of three exhibition rooms measuring 282㎡, 340㎡, and 172㎡ respectively, and is designed with a rail-type moving partition, allowing for free space creation. The academy is located on the first and second basement floors of the Art Hall and consists of seven professional classrooms and five personal practice rooms. Various cultural events, performances, and concerts are held frequently at the performance hall, and Pyeongchon Art Hall Academy provides various cultural education programs in humanities, music, dance, and art to citizens. You can apply for the course on the Anyang Culture and Arts Foundation website. It takes about 6 minutes by car from Sanbon IC and about 9 minutes from Geumjeong Station on Lines 1 and 4, and there is a bus that goes from the station to the nearby area. Nearby are Gwanaksan Mountain, Cheonggyesan Mountain, Gwanggyosan Mountain, Anyang Art Park, Anyang Museum, Kim Chung-up Architecture Museum, Pyeongchon Central Park, Seoul Land, Seoul Grand Park, Let's Run Park Seoul, Gwangmyeong Cave, and Gwangmyeong Edison Museum.

평택문화원은 향토문화의 창달과 지역문화진흥을 위해 1953년 사설문화원으.en: Pyeongtaek Cultural Center began as a private cultural center in 1953 to promote local culture and promote local culture, and was established as a corporation in 1971 to the present. Pyeongtaek Cultural Center develops, disseminates, transmits, and promotes local culture, conducts research on local history, and collects historical materials. In addition, various cultural events are held for the development of local culture and cultural education projects are being carried out. Through the operation of the Utdari Cultural Village, local cultural projects such as exhibition planning, operation, experiential learning programs, and festivals are activated, and through the Pyeongtaek City Tour, you can visit every corner of Pyeongtaek, including the Paengseong History Course, Jinwi History Course, Rice (Agriculture) Course, Famous Places Course, and Art Museum Course, and understand and experience the history and culture of the region.

평택시농업생태원은 2018년 10월에 개장하여 114.654㎡ 면적에 농.en: Pyeongtaek City Agricultural Ecology Center opened in October 2018 and has an area of ​​114.654㎡. In addition to agricultural and rural attractions, it has various facilities such as a children's playground and a pet playground, as well as a variety of experiences such as a flower festival, rural cultural experience, agricultural education, and a vegetable garden, becoming a resting place for people. It consists of a variety of spaces, including Eoul Madang, a space where people communicate in harmony with nature in a large lawn plaza, a citizen garden that rents a 3-pyeong vegetable garden for Pyeongtaek citizens, and nine town/village gardens created with the participation of citizens.

평택호는 평택시에 위치한 인공호수로, 다양한 관광 명소와 자연경관이 어우.en: Pyeongtaek Lake is an artificial lake located in Pyeongtaek City, where various tourist attractions and natural scenery come together. This place was created as a tourist complex for Pyeongtaek Lake, and is well-equipped with walking trails, an observatory, and an art museum, providing visitors with a variety of things to enjoy. You can admire the lake while walking on the endless wooden waterside deck around the lake, and there is also Korea's first sound chair where Korean music can be heard.
