Pyeongtaek Lake boasts beautiful scenery with its wide water surface and surrounding nature. In particular, the scenery at sunset is loved by many photographers and tourists. It is an attractive tourist destination that offers a variety of experiences to visitors.

평택호 관광단지는 평택호 주변의 아름다운 경관을 활용하여 다양한 볼거리,.en: Pyeongtaek Lake Tourist Complex is a representative tourist destination in Pyeongtaek, with various attractions, cultural spaces, and convenience facilities created by taking advantage of the beautiful scenery around Pyeongtaek Lake. Facilities such as Pyeongtaek Lake Arts Center, Sandbank Park, Korea Sori Center, Bow Observatory, and Pyeongtaek Folk Song Preservation Society are located within the complex. It is an optimal tourist destination where you can enjoy nature and leisure at the same time, and is considered a popular attraction not only for local residents but also for external tourists.

포네티브 스페이스는 기획 초대전을 중심으로 전시가 이루어지는 갤러리로 지.en: Positive Space is a gallery where exhibitions are centered on special invitation exhibitions and has a two-story structure with the first floor above ground and the first basement. A variety of works can be displayed, including large installations, sculptures, paintings, photographs, and prints. The exhibition lasts approximately 3 weeks every month, and the theme of the exhibition changes each time. It is located along with several galleries in Heyri Village, located in the Paju Unification Garden Special Tourist Zone, making it a good place to visit various places. This is a place where you can see the flow of Korean modern art.

산에 있는 우물이라는 뜻인 산정호수는 이름 그대로 맑은 수질과 아름다운.en: Sanjeong Lake, which means a well in the mountain, boasts clear water and beautiful mountain scenery as its name suggests. It was created as an agricultural reservoir in 1925, and is home to several high mountain peaks including Myeongseongsan Mountain, Jainsa Temple, Deungryong Falls, and Biseon Falls. It was designated as a national tourist site in March 1977 and is visited by many tourists. In particular, the night fog on the lake in spring and fall creates a spectacular view, making the walking path around the lake famous. An amusement park, sculpture park, boat park, swimming pool, sledding slope, etc. were built nearby. (Source: Pocheon Culture and Tourism website)

그림 같은 에메랄드빛 호수, 그 위를 병풍처럼 깎아지른 화강암 절벽! 자.en: A picturesque emerald lake, with granite cliffs rising like a folding screen above it! Pocheon Art Valley, a complex cultural and artistic space where you can appreciate and enjoy art in nature, was an abandoned quarry that no one visited until the 1990s. But now, it has been completely transformed into a healing spot where nature and art come together, with 400,000 people visiting. In particular, since 2014, the Astronomical Science Museum, where you can admire the stars in the night sky, has been opened and has been very popular as a place for experiential education for children and as a date spot for couples.

한탄강 협곡을 감상할 수 있는 흔들형 보행 다리50m 높이에서 한탄강 협.en: A 200m long and 2m wide swinging walking bridge that allows you to view the Hantangang River Gorge from a 50m height. Completed in 2018, it was designed to allow 1,500 adults to cross at the same time. A skywalk was installed on the central floor of the bridge so you can enjoy a thrilling experience. The scenery of the columnar jointed gorge of the Hantangang River, the only basalt erosion river in Korea, seen from the sky bridge, is spectacular.

경상남도 기념물 제17호인 표충사는 임진왜란 때 공을 세운 사명대사(四溟.en: Pyochungsa Temple, Gyeongsangnam-do Monument No. 17, is a temple named by the government to commemorate the loyalty of Master Samyeong, who contributed during the Japanese invasions of Korea. It was rebuilt in 1715 (the 41st year of King Sukjong's reign), but in 1926, all buildings except Eungjinjeon (應眞殿) were destroyed by fire and were rebuilt to this day. Major cultural assets and buildings include the Bronze Hameunhyangwan (National Treasure No. 75), the Three-story Stone Pagoda (Treasure No. 467), local cultural assets such as stone lanterns, Pyochungseowon (表忠書院), and Daegwangjeon (大光殿), and 25 buildings with over 300 relics of Master Samyeong. It is preserved.

풀짚공예박물관은 풀과 짚을 이용해서 만든 민속 생활 도구와 공예품을 수집.en: The Grass and Straw Craft Museum is a place that collects, researches, exhibits and provides education on folk tools and crafts made using grass and straw. It was established in Sinhyeon-ri, Opo-eup, Gwangju-si, Gyeonggi-do in June 2006. Since the ancient agricultural society, the craftsmanship of grass and straw, which was used to make household tools, has been passed down only by word of mouth. Director Jeon Seong-im, who felt sorry for this situation, visited craftsmen across the country to systematically organize the field of crafts using grass and straw, acquired the skills, and studied the characteristics of materials and geographical correlation. Today, when traditional cultural heritage is rapidly disappearing, this museum is continuing research and education activities to make grass and straw crafts a place of education that inherits the traditional values ​​of grass and straw crafts to make them a field of creative craft art that connects from the past to the present and the future.

대부도에서 24km 떨어진 서해의 작은 섬 풍도는 복수초, 노루귀, 변산.en: Pungdo, a small island in the West Sea 24km away from Daebudo Island, is famous for growing many beautiful wild flowers such as Boksucho, Hepatica, Byeonsan Windflower, and Widower Windflower. Because there were many maple trees, it was written as Pungdo (楓島) using the Chinese character for maple (楓) until the end of the Joseon Dynasty. However, due to the lack of farmland and the lack of seafood in the fishing grounds around the island, the name of the island was changed to Pungdo (豊島), which stands for the good harvest. There are a variety of attractions in Pungdo, including Dongmujae, a skyway that touches the sky, the secret garden of Pungdo, a wild flower paradise, a ginkgo tree in Pungdo that is over 500 years old, and Cheongnyeokgol Beach, where the bodies of Qing soldiers washed up during the Battle of Pungdo.

프라움악기박물관은 남양주시 와부읍에 위치한 국내 최초의 서양악기 박물관이.en: Praum Musical Instrument Museum is the first Western musical instrument museum in Korea, located in Wabu-eup, Namyangju-si. The museum has an antique exterior and operates an outdoor garden with a view of the Han River. The first and second floors consist of a permanent exhibition hall, and the exhibition is divided into a keyboard instrument zone, string instrument zone, and wind instrument zone. It interestingly introduces instruments and stories related to the greats of music history, such as Beethoven, Bach, and Stradivarius. Lee Heung-ryeol's belongings are also on permanent display, and you can see about 400 musical materials he composed, including art songs, national songs, and children's songs. The museum has auxiliary facilities such as a special exhibition room, education room, concert hall, musical instrument experience room, and art shop. The ‘Saturday Concert’, a regular concert, is held on the fourth Saturday of every month, where you can enjoy exhibitions and performances. Various educational programs such as ‘Humanities on the Road’ and vacation programs are operated, and detailed information can be found on the website. Seasonal themed performances such as Christmas, year-end events, and Wednesday brunch concerts are also held, and rentals for seminars and concerts are also possible.

프로방스 마을은 1996년 품격 높은 프랑스 레스토랑을 시작으로 아름다운.en: Provence Village, which started as a high-class French restaurant in 1996, is a place where beautiful gardens, murals with stories, and night lights are in harmony. It is a themed village where you can taste food from all over the world, including European bakeries and cafes, Italian restaurants, and Korean food, as well as spaces where you can enjoy leisurely life, including trend-leading fashion, daily necessities, and experience facilities. In the village of Provence, shops operated with different concepts are all organically connected in independent buildings with warm colors. Various shops are located in the village, including a bakery where a master baker bakes every morning for 30 years, a cafe overlooking the garden, a food and beverage store where you can enjoy a variety of tastes from brunch, pork cutlet, and an authentic Italian restaurant to traditional Korean food, a trend-leading household goods and accessory shop, and traditional European clothing rental. In addition, Provence Village is loved by visitors by creating a greenhouse and outdoor garden to provide a resting place where flowers and water coexist, and by planning various festivals, it offers various cultural performances, new experiences, and beautiful events to visitors throughout the four seasons.

하나개해수욕장은 무의도 서쪽에 자리한 갯벌을 품은 해수욕장이다. 하나개는.en: Hanagae Beach is a beach with mud flats located on the west side of Muuido. Hanagae means the largest mudflat. A 1km long fine sandy beach spreads out, and when the water recedes, a wide mud flat is revealed beyond the fine sandy beach. If you dig down a little bit into the mud flat, you will find an abundance of white-fleshed Dongjuk clams, conches, crabs, and clams. The red glow when the sun sets is another spectacular sight at the beach. Hanagae Beach is mainly visited by families, as the water depth is suitable for children to play and there are many convenient facilities such as accommodations, showers, restaurants, and karaoke rooms. There is an amusement park behind the beach, so there are many things to enjoy. At the amusement park, you can enjoy horseback riding, quad biking, and Sea Sky World. Sea Sky World is a new type of extreme leisure sport that involves descending from a high place to a low place as if flying by connecting a 413 m wire from a 25 m high iron tower installed on a white sand beach. Trying fresh seafood at an open-air food stall is also a must-see. This is the filming location for the drama “Stairway to Heaven,” and the filming set remains on one side of the beach, providing another attraction.

나무고아원은 도시개발사업 등으로 버려질 나무들을 옮겨 심고 가꾸어 가로수.en: The Tree Orphanage was created on a site of approximately 89,000㎡ for the purpose of transplanting and nurturing trees that would otherwise be abandoned due to urban development projects and reborn as street trees, parks, and green zone landscaping trees. Currently, rather than receiving tree donations or transplanting them to parks, etc., it is being cultivated as an urban forest (park), and 46 different types of trees, including pine trees, plantain trees, ginkgo trees, and zelkova trees, have been planted. It was created using donated trees from the Gyeonggi area, including 159 pine trees, 300 ginkgo trees damaged by road expansion construction, 1,000 zelkova trees, 1,700 metasequoia trees, and 450 red maple trees. Hanam City is using this tree orphanage as a venue for environmental education to raise awareness of the importance of nature conservation, and it is attracting attention as a new attraction in the metropolitan area in harmony with the nearby Han River. (Source: Hanam City Hall)

하남ICEBOX 아이스링크는 경기도 하남에 위치한 가족 친화적 실내 스케.en: Hanam ICEBOX Ice Rink is a family-friendly indoor skating rink located in Hanam, Gyeonggi-do. Figure, ice hockey, and speed skating classes as well as figure and speed one-day classes and special skating lectures are especially popular. The general opening is every Saturday from 13:00 to 16:00, and anyone can enjoy it freely, so weekend visitors are highly satisfied. The rink consists of two floors, the 2nd and 3rd floors. The 3rd floor is a 3-on-3 ice hockey arena and is spacious and has a high ceiling, providing a comfortable environment. It has seating for approximately 200 spectators, making it ideal for watching games.

하남문화예술회관은 시민의 다양한 문화예술 욕구 충족과 예술인구 저변확대,.en: Hanam Culture and Arts Center was established to satisfy the diverse cultural and artistic needs of citizens, expand the base of the artistic population, and expand cultural space. It is equipped with Geomdan Hall (large theater), named after Geomdan Mountain and Arang, symbols of Hanam, Arang Hall (small theater), an exhibition hall, and Eul Madang (outdoor stage). [Geomdan Hall], a large performance hall representing Hanam, named after Geomdansan Mountain, a symbol and famous landmark of Hanam, is a performance hall with a seating capacity of 911 people and is a comprehensive cultural and artistic space that can efficiently perform various genres such as concerts, plays, movies, operas, ballets, and musicals. The small theater [Arang Hall] is a performance hall named after Arang from [Domi Tale] during the Habaekje period. It is a performance hall with a capacity of 355 people and is a suitable space for performances such as plays, chamber music, and recitals. [Eoul Madang], an outdoor factory that means mingling with each other and becoming one, is a new relaxation space for citizens where they can enjoy the pleasure of watching and participating in street plays, yard plays, and live performances. It is a place where various cultural events and events are possible depending on the nature of the performance, and is the central stage for popular performing arts that quenches the cultural thirst of citizens through communication with the audience. The exhibition hall is a 316.69㎡ space located on the second floor where art, calligraphy, crafts, sculpture, photography, etc. can be displayed, and variable partitions can be installed to create an efficient space. Hanam Culture and Arts Center provides various classes such as musicals, ballet, and dance for elementary, middle, and high school students to help them experience joy through dance and have opportunities to explore career paths. Through the Hanam-type culture and arts support project, adults can also experience customized cultural and arts education programs. In addition, by participating in a project called [Hanam Cultural Charging Station] that provides space for local clubs to produce their own culture, it is greatly helping citizens enjoy art in their daily lives.

하남문화원은 지방문화원 진흥법에 의거하여 지역사회의 계발 및 문화진흥을.en: Hanam Cultural Center was established on June 11, 1996 for the purpose of enlightenment and cultural promotion of the local community in accordance with the Local Cultural Center Promotion Act. We develop, preserve, and transmit local culture, conduct research on local history, conduct research, and collect and preserve historical materials. In addition, we actively hold local cultural events, collect, preserve, and disseminate cultural data, and engage in social education activities about local culture.

풍산동에 위치한 하남수산물시장에서는 남해·서해·동해 등 전국 각지에서 산.en: At Hanam Fishery Market, located in Pungsan-dong, you can find seafood delivered directly from all over the country, including the South Sea, West Sea, and East Sea, all in one place. It is loved by both local residents and visitors as it sells a variety of items, from fresh live fish to dried fish, at reasonable prices. You can eat the purchased seafood by sashimi on the spot, and it can also be packaged. The customer support center is convenient to use as it is equipped with convenient facilities such as a nursing room, education center, and rest area.

하늘공원은 월드컵공원 내에 속해 있는 공원으로, 평화공원, 난지천공원,.en: Haneul Park is a park within World Cup Park, and together with Peace Park, Nanjicheon Park, Nanji Hangang Park, and Noeul Park, it forms one of the five major parks around the World Cup Stadium. It was created for the purpose of restoring the ecological environment and operates its own facilities using natural energy. It consists of a silver grass planting area, a mixed grassland, a rock garden, a sunflower planting area, an observatory rest area, and a wind power generator. It is the closest to the sky among the World Cup parks, and it is a park that shows the change from barren land in a landfill to restoration to nature. The silver silver grass flowers of autumn create a spectacular sight, and you can see the scenery of Seoul, including Bukhansan Mountain and the Han River, at a glance. It is also a famous spot known for its beautiful sunset and night view.

김동리의 소설 역마의 배경이 된 곳으로도 유명한 화개장터는 영호남의 접경.en: Hwagae Market, famous as the setting for Kim Dong-ri's novel Yeokma, is located on the border of the Yeongnam and Honam regions and is a distribution center for marine products and salt from the southern coast, grains from the fertile Honam Plain, wild vegetables and wooden utensils from the foot of Jiri Mountain. They were distributed throughout the country through the developed waterways of Hadong Port and became one of the leading markets in the country during the prosperous period from the mid-Joseon Dynasty until liberation. However, with the development of transportation and distribution structures, it declined and traces of its old appearance disappeared. Hwagae Market is a traditional market held at the confluence of Hwagae Stream and Seomjingang River, which originate from Jiri Mountain, and is a place where oil markets were actively held.

하슬라아트월드는 자연과 사람, 예술이 조화롭게 공존하는 종합예술공간이다..en: Haslla Art World is a comprehensive art space where nature, people, and art coexist in harmony. The 33,000 pyeong sculpture park was created by hand using the slopes and heights of the mountains to minimize damage to nature, with the themes of ‘Fortress Broadleaf Road’, ‘Pine Garden’, ‘Square of Time’, ‘Sea Garden’, ‘Sky Observatory’, and ‘Stone Gallery and Cowdung Art Museum’, and a path was built at an angle to view nature in the most beautiful way and decorated as an art garden. Haslla Art World is a space where artistic work, performances, exhibitions and festivals with domestic and foreign artists provide special experiences and happiness all year long. The indoor art museum includes the ‘Modern Art Museum’, which displays about 200 pieces of modern art, and the ‘Pinocchio & Marionette Museum’, which displays marionette and Pinocchio works collected from various European countries. Haslla Art Museum is currently hosting special exhibitions, invitation exhibitions, and permanent exhibitions, and can be viewed according to the exhibition schedule.◎ Travel information to experience the charm of the Korean Wave - This is the setting for the scene in the drama <Melo Holic> where Yeri organizes her memories with her ex-lover. Selected as a ‘recommended attraction in Gangwon’ by CNN, it is a popular tourist destination where you can admire artwork and take pictures of your life with nature in the background. When I stand at the outdoor exhibition hall where Yeri collected her thoughts and look out at the sea, I feel like my frustrated mind is relieved by the open scenery.

학동 흑진주 몽돌해변은 거제도 남쪽에 위치해 있다. 남해안의 맑고 깨끗한.en: Hakdong Black Jinju Mongdol Beach is located in the south of Geoje Island. The clear and clean water of the southern coast makes a beautiful sound as the waves roll the stones, which was selected as one of the top 100 sounds of nature in Korea. In addition, you can take a cruise ship from the dock located in Mongdol Beach, Black Jinju, Hak-dong, and visit Haegeumgang, which is called the Geumgang of the Sea, and Oedo Island, which is decorated with various exotic tropical forests. It is a place that tourists visiting Geoje Island must visit even if it is not for swimming in the sea. In spring and fall, marine tourists gather at Haegeumgang and Hallyeo Marine National Park, and in summer, vacationers gather from all over the country.

구래동 한강 신도시에 위치한 산책하기 좋은 호수공원이다. 남녀노소 누구나.en: It is a lake park that is great for a walk, located in the Hangang New Town in Gurae-dong. It is a great place for people of all ages and genders to take a walk, exercise, or have a family outing, and there are many spaces designed for citizens. In addition to the walking path, there is a picnic zone where you can pitch a shade tent and rest (permitted from April to October). Silver grass and rocks on the lakeside add charm, and a log house provides a resting area.

대한민국의 20세기 문화는 유난히 큰 변동을 겪었다. 일본이 통치권을 앗.en: South Korea's 20th century culture experienced unusually large changes. From 1910 to the 1940s, when Japan lost sovereignty, to the 1950s when the painful Korean War took place. Until the 1970s and 1980s, when the entire nation came together with one thought: ‘Let’s live well.’ In the hope that those times would not be forgotten for a long time, in 2005, about 70,000 pieces of various visual artifacts collected over 30 years were moved to Heyri Village. The Museum of Modern and Contemporary Korean History, which exudes the scent of the past from the entrance, consists of one underground floor and three above-ground floors, and is Korea's first modern and contemporary history themed museum that recreates an entire village from a different era on each floor.

한국기독교역사박물관은 \"한국 기독교 문화 창달\"이라는 목적을 갖고 1.en: The Korean Christian History Museum was founded in 1955 with the purpose of “promoting Korean Christian culture” and is based on Christian Munsa, which has been carrying out its mission as an inter-denominational document missionary organization. In the process of publishing various good Christian books, including all 16 volumes of the “Great Christian Encyclopedia” compiled by Christian Munsa to commemorate the 100th anniversary of Christian missionary work in Korea, it has published over 100,000 items related to the faith, history, and culture of the Korean church. Valuable data was collected. Here, Hyangsan Elder Han Young-je, the founder of this museum, established the "Hyangsan Christian Culture Research Institute" so that these materials could be used as research materials in academia and religious circles, and on November 11, 2001, he established this museum in Icheon, Gyeonggi-do to expand the scope of opportunities to the general public. Additionally, in 2007, to commemorate the 100th anniversary of the Pyongyang Great Revival Movement, the "Pyongyang Jangdaehyeon Church" was restored in scale on the museum grounds, and it is also provided as a worship experience space in the old chapel so that visitors can experience the restoration of faith and culture of the early church. [Source: Korea Christian History Museum]

한국도로공사수목원은 호남고속도로 순천 기점 170㎞ 지점에 있다. 규모는.en: The Korea Expressway Corporation Arboretum is located 170km from the starting point of Suncheon on the Honam Expressway. It has an area of ​​340,000 m2 and possesses 3,410 species of tree genetic resources. The arboretum operated by the Korea Expressway Corporation supplies trees to restore the natural environment damaged during the construction of highways, collects various plant species and uses them as a nature learning center, and conducts research on the preservation, propagation and dissemination of plants and the development of native plants. The plants held at the Korea Expressway Corporation Arboretum are mainly planted in 'family' units, and are especially convenient for observation as they are divided into the general arboretum, rock garden, medicinal herb garden, wetland garden, wild grass garden, rose garden, Rose of Sharon garden, bamboo garden, textbook garden, southern arboretum, glass greenhouse, and mountain stream garden.

포은 정몽주 묘소 맞은편에 있는 한국등잔박물관은 박물관장 김동휘가 50여.en: The Korea Lantern Museum, located across from the tomb of Poeun Jeong Mong-ju, is a private museum that displays lanterns collected by museum director Kim Dong-hwi for over 50 years. As the only lighting museum in Korea, it is a place where you can see the old lifestyles of our ancestors, making it a popular place for experiential learning not only for individuals but also for students. The cylindrical lighthouse-shaped building, inspired by the Suwon Hwaseong Fortress Wall, has one underground floor and three above-ground floors. The first and second floors are exhibition spaces, and the third floor is a multi-purpose space for seminars and various performances. There is also a farm equipment exhibition room in the annex exhibition hall, and the outdoor exhibition hall is a beautiful garden with a pond and natural stones, making it a good place to take a quick look around and heal. On the first floor of the permanent exhibition hall, under the theme of our fire bowl lamps, the types and purposes of lamps used in each space, such as the kitchen, cold room, living room, and master bedroom, are displayed along with old household items. On the second floor, under the theme of light that protected daily life and light that revealed courtesy, you can see at a glance the styles and characteristics of lamps by era. In addition, the [Local Artist Illumination Exhibition] is held in the special exhibition room on the first floor to introduce local artists who are actively producing works in Gyeonggi-do. The museum operates permanent and special education programs for a variety of children, teenagers, and adults. You can make candles, LED lights, ceramic lamps, etc. to create special memories. Since the tomb of Poeun Jeong Mong-ju is across from it, it is good to visit together. It takes about 17 minutes by car from Mabuk IC. Nearby are the Gyeonggi Provincial Museum, Gyeonggi Provincial Children's Museum, Nam June Paik Art Center, Everland, Korean Folk Village, World Cultural Heritage Suwon Hwaseong Fortress and Yunggeonneung Royal Tomb, Giheung Lake Park, Deokpyeong Dinosaur Arboretum, Starlight Garden Space, and Hantaek Botanical Garden.

칼빈대학교 부근에 있는 한국미술관은 김윤순(1931~2017)이 설립한.en: The Korean Museum of Art, located near Calvin University, is a professional private art museum founded by Kim Yun-soon (1931-2017). Here, modern art pieces are exhibited and the Korean Art Academy is operated. The art museum, with an area of ​​2,281㎡, consists of a total of 5 exhibition rooms, a classroom, an experiential learning room, a cafeteria, an art shop, and an outdoor exhibition hall in a building of 2 floors in the main building and 1st floor in the new building. In addition to permanent exhibitions, exciting and unique special exhibitions are held regularly. The collection consists of approximately 140 pieces, including paintings by Park Saeng-kwang, Kwon Jin-gyu, Lee U-hwan, and Lee Sang-beom, Christo and Robert Rausenberg's Monochrome, Rausenberg's prints, Lee Sang-hyeon's installations, Joseon Dynasty folk paintings, Yoon Gwang-jong's ceramics, Lee Shin-ja's tapestry, Lee Jong-gak's sculptures, Kwak Deok-jun's photography, Kim Eung-hyeon's calligraphy, and Kim Seung-hee's crafts. It takes about 1 minute by car from Mabuk IC and about 8 minutes from Guseong Station on the Suin Bundang Line, and there is a bus that goes there from the station. Nearby are the Gyeonggi Provincial Museum, Gyeonggi Provincial Children's Museum, Korean Folk Village, and Everland.

한국민속촌은 오랜 시간을 거쳐 전승되어 온 우리 문화 속 생활풍속을 한데.en: The Korean Folk Village was established in 1974 to introduce our traditional culture to domestic and foreign tourists by bringing together the daily customs of our culture that have been passed down over a long period of time. The Korean Folk Village, which has high educational and tourist value, has been loved as a traditional cultural tourist destination with vivid cultural experiences and beautiful nature ever since its establishment. Seasonal festivals with various themes and concepts created by reinterpreting traditions, such as Welcome to Joseon and Nostalgic Games, provide special enjoyment.

한국카메라박물관은 사설 카메라 전문 박물관으로 사진작가이자 사업가인 김종.en: The Korea Camera Museum is a private camera museum founded by photographer and businessman Kim Jong-se. The exhibition hall consists of a special exhibition hall, main exhibition hall, and secondary exhibition hall. Including more than 3,000 cameras, 6,000 different lenses, glass negatives, early magic lanterns, photo printing equipment, and various accessories, the museum holds over 15,000 artifacts. Among the relics, cameras that contributed to the development of cameras are on display, from the Camera Obscura and Camera Lucida, the original cameras, to relics from the period when the camera and daguerreotype photography were first invented in the world in 1839, to cutting-edge modern cameras. A characteristic feature is that the exhibition space is arranged so that the inside of most of the cameras on display can be seen. The museum is large enough to be ranked among the top 5 private camera museums in the world, and the items on display are diverse.

곽금올레길이라고도 부르는 한담해안산택로는 애월항에서 곽지과물해변까지 해안.en: Handam Coastal Mountain Trail, also called Gwakgeum Olle Trail, is a walking trail built along the coast from Aewol Port to Gwakji Gwamul Beach. It is beautiful as it harmonizes with the surrounding landscape. The total length is 1.2km, and you can walk along the coastal path with waves crashing right next to it. It is also one of the ‘Hidden Secrets of Jeju City’ announced in 2009 by Jeju City, which selected 31 representative places in the Jeju City area in addition to existing tourist attractions. The strangely shaped rocks created by hardened lava attract attention, and the winding path along the black rock coast adds fun to the walk. Another attractive point of this place is that it is located on the west side of Jeju Island, so you can enjoy beautiful sunsets.

제주시 연동 1100 도로변 광이 오름 기슭에 위치한 한라수목원은 제주도.en: Halla Arboretum, located at the foot of Gwangi Oreum at 1100 Road in Yeondong, Jeju City, is an arboretum where plants such as Jeju Island's native tree species and subtropical plants are planted and displayed. It serves as a place for education and research for students and professionals, and is also loved as a themed tourist attraction. In particular, in 2000, the Ministry of Environment designated this place as a conservation organization other than a habitat for endangered protected wild plants. A total of 1,321 species (530 woody species, 791 herbaceous species) and over 100,000 plants are on display, including plants subject to protection such as wild orchids, orchids, perilla leaves, and jujubes, which are designated as endangered plants by the Ministry of Environment. It provides a place for preservation of genetic resources of Jeju Island's native plants and learning and research, and provides a resting place for the province and citizens and is used as a tourist resource.◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave - Entertainment <Hyori's Bed and Breakfast> Hyori's Bed and Breakfast, which has become a symbol of living in Jeju, is a filming location for the arboretum where over 1,100 species of plants, including Jeju's native tree species and subtropical plants, are planted and displayed. There are many endangered species and rare plants, but it is great for a light walk and healing. The 50,000 pyeong forest bathing area provides a resting space like a forest in the city for tourists and Jeju residents. The outdoor promenade is open until 11 p.m., making it a good place to take a walk at night.

한반도를 빼닮아 붙여진 이름으로 한반도 지형을 감싸고 흐르는 감입곡류하천.en: The name was given because it closely resembles the Korean Peninsula, and it was created by the erosion of intrusive rivers that flow around the topography of the Korean Peninsula. Here, you can see the limestone observed in this area, the submerged Sogang River, the process by which the topography of the Korean Peninsula was created, dolines, and the uses of limestone. (Source: Gangwon Paleozoic National Geopark)

한옥기술 전시관 ''한옥새움''은 우리나라 전통 한옥에 대한 역사부터 현.en: Hanok Technology Exhibition Hall ''Hanok Saeum'' is a place that introduces and displays the past and present of Hanok, from the history of Korea's traditional Hanok to new Hanok incorporating modern technology. Hanok Saeum refers to the construction of a Hanok with new technology to suit modern times. It was opened in 2017 to promote the uniqueness and excellence of Hanok. The exhibition hall strives to contribute to the popularization of Hanok by organizing two themed exhibition rooms with media and experience, as well as a multi-purpose room where special lectures and experiences about Hanok are available. The first exhibition room provides explanations on learning about Hanok, Hanok technology, and research on new Hanok, and the second exhibition room introduces the process of building new Hanok and information about Hanok in Suwon City. Rather than an exhibition hall, it feels like experiencing Hanok in a wonderful Hanok village, and is a place where meaningful visits are made by everyone from children to seniors preparing to return to farming.

재단법인 한택식물원은 1979년 설립이래 20만평의 규모에 자생식물 2,.en: Since its establishment in 1979, Hantaek Botanical Garden is the largest comprehensive botanical garden in Korea with a total of 7.3 million plants, including 2,400 native plants and 7,300 exotic plants, on an area of ​​200,000 pyeong. In addition to possessing a variety of domestic and foreign plant species, it is equipped with systematic research activities through the Botanical Research Institute, mutual exchanges with domestic and foreign botanical gardens, and modernized facilities. In addition, we have been designated as a <rare and endangered plant habitat and other conservation organization> by the Ministry of Environment and have been continuously promoting projects to conserve Korean native plants and restore their native habitats, and are conducting various experiences and exhibitions to learn about nature. Hantaek Botanical Garden has beautiful gardens designed to fit the natural environment, such as the Natural Ecological Garden, Aquatic Botanical Garden, Wall Garden Rock Garden, and Silver Grass Garden, as well as Daylily Garden, Bibichu Garden, and Iris Garden that display various plant species. It also has 36 unique gardens, including the Australian Greenhouse with the baobab tree seen in The Little Prince, the South African Greenhouse, the Herb Carnivorous Plant Greenhouse, and lawn flower beds and rest areas where you can feel comfortable rest and relaxation.

&nbsp;향림옹기박물관은 한국옹기의 과학적 우수성과 아름다운 조형미를.en: In order to promote the scientific excellence and beautiful formative beauty of Korean pottery at home and abroad, the Hyanglim Pottery Museum was established in Heyri Art Village in 2004 after collecting for over 20 years and opened as an pottery exhibition hall and gallery. Afterwards, important pottery for various purposes was reinforced, collected, and organized, and it was officially registered as a museum in 2009 (Gyeonggi Province Registration No. 09-Park-08), making it Korea's representative pottery museum. In addition, it was registered as an institution subject to career certification in 2005, and is being reborn as an educational museum that trains the academic experts needed for the museum and produces arts and crafts artists. Hyanglim Pottery Museum seeks to be reborn as an important cultural and artistic space that helps us understand the real life of the past in the present through pottery, a relic that contains Korea's unique simple beauty, and fosters new, future-oriented creative thinking. We aim to publicize the value of traditional cultural heritage by transforming it into an educational place to learn and understand history and a creative open cultural space to experience and enjoy. The exhibition room is a space where you can appreciate the diverse and beautiful Korean pottery that looks different in each region. You can also appreciate pottery props used in daily life from the late Joseon Dynasty to before 1950, as well as large pottery such as pottery coffins used as coffins for bodies, large rainwater jars over 1m 30cm in height, chimneys and lotus houses. Pottery is a unique culture unique to the Korean people and has been mainly used as storage containers for fermented foods and grains. Unlike celadon or white porcelain, which had an aristocratic character, it was closely integrated into the lives of the common people and developed rapidly during the Joseon Dynasty. Such pottery has the advantage of being able to store food for a long time. This is because the soil contains numerous sand grains, which absorb air and release moisture inside, so pottery is also called a breathing vessel. Additionally, the black smoke produced during firing in the kiln gets lodged in the clay of the pottery and acts as a preservative. Since the late 1960s, pottery culture has been gradually declining due to the advent of plastic and stainless steel and changes in living space and eating habits. The Hanhyangrim Pottery Museum seeks to shed new light on the disappearing uses and beauty of Korean pottery from a modern perspective by collecting and exhibiting pottery, an earthenware vessel made and used during the Joseon Dynasty from the late Joseon Dynasty until the 1950s.

설악 워터피아는 천연 온천수를 이용한 온천욕과 워터파크를 갖춘 종합 온천.en: Seorak Waterpia is a comprehensive hot spring theme park with hot spring baths using natural hot spring water and a water park. It is a space where the whole family can heal with spas and hot springs that soothe tired bodies and minds along with exciting water play. The water park can be used all year round and operates a variety of attractions. You can experience the ultimate in excitement, including Shark Wave, where you can experience 18 different types of waves, Atlantis, where 1.2 tons of water falls from a basket, Maelstrom, which plunges from a height of 17 meters and rotates in zigzags, and the thrilling World Alley. Torrent River, a large lazy river, allows you to enjoy the rapids and high waves of the valley while leaving your body in the flowing water. The Aqua Building Bade Pool is a hydrotherapy space that relieves fatigue accumulated throughout the body. Various hydrotherapy programs, such as hydropocket, neck shower, and body massage, further enhance the effectiveness of natural restorative hot spring water. Additionally, there is a 25m long regular pool lane outdoors so you can enjoy swimming all year round. The spa building has an indoor wave pool, Shark Blue, so you can enjoy waves crashing back and forth and left and right even on rainy days. Seorak Waterpia's special outdoor hot spring facility, Spa Valley, modeled after famous hot springs around the world, is also popular.

제주올레 19코스를 걷다 보면 에메랄드빛 보석을 품고 있는 함덕해수욕장을.en: If you walk along Jeju Olle Course 19, you can come across Hamdeok Beach, which has emerald jewels. Hamdeok Beach, located in Hamdeok-ri, Jocheon-eup, Jeju City, is also called ‘Hamdeokseo Ubong Beach’ thanks to the towering oreum (Seoubong Peak) that stands right next to the beach. Although it is only 20km away from Jeju Airport, the moment you arrive here, you feel like you have arrived in another country. The tall palm trees that welcome you from the entrance, the emerald sea contrasting with the white sand, and the clear water and white waves that transparently reflect even the sand and seaweed. Among the numerous beaches on Jeju Island, the three beaches with the prettiest sea colors are definitely Hyeopjae, Gimnyeong, and Hamdeok Beach. The water is clear and shallow, making it a good summer resort for families. The western side of the beach is connected by a sky bridge, allowing you to experience the experience of walking on the sea. The lawn, which is great for picnics, and the walking trail where you can enjoy the sea safely at night are attractive, so there is a constant flow of visitors all year round. Especially in summer, it is open at night, so you can enjoy Jeju's blue nights at the sea. Seoubong Peak, located right next to it, presents picturesque scenery every season with yellow rape flowers in spring and green in summer. If you climb Seoubong Peak, you can enjoy the luxury of a panoramic view of Hamdeok Beach. If the weather is good, it is the best viewing point from which you can overlook Hallasan Mountain and the eastern oreums.

함박산중앙공원은 고덕신도시에 위치한 생태형 복합문화공원으로, 함박산공원과.en: Hambaksan Central Park is an ecological complex cultural park located in Godeok New Town and is connected to Hambaksan Park. It was built on an area of ​​approximately 671,000 m2, and the ecological value was increased by preserving the egret habitat. It consists of five spaces, including the Global Zone, Five Senses Healing Zone, Eco Experience Zone, Art Theme Zone, and Waterside Leisure Zone, and is equipped with various facilities such as Orchard Garden, Silgaecheon, Sports Field, and Music Fountain. The trails and tracks are well-maintained, making them great for walking or running, and benches are placed here and there, making them ideal for resting.

해동 용궁사는 1376년 공민왕(恭民王)의 왕사(王師)였던 나옹대사(懶翁.en: Haedong Yonggungsa Temple was founded in 1376 by Master Naong, the royal preceptor of King Gongmin. It is one of the three great Avalokitesvara sacred sites in Korea. It contains the deep meaning of faith through the harmony of the sea, dragon, and Avalokitesvara Buddha. Anyone who prays sincerely must do so. It is famous as a place where you can receive a visionary dream and have your wish come true. It was destroyed by fire during the Japanese invasions of Korea and rebuilt by Ungang of Tongdosa Temple in the early 1930s. In 1974, monk Jeongam became the head priest of this temple and prayed for the restoration of the temple as Avalokitesvara. He said he saw Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva dressed in white ascending to heaven riding a dragon in a dream, so the name of the temple was changed to Haedong Yonggungsa Temple. Existing buildings include Daeungjeon, Gulbeopdang, Yongwangdang (Yonggungdan), Beomjonggak, and Yosachae. The cave hall next to Daeungjeon is called Mireukjeon and has been enshrining a seated stone Buddha of Maitreya since its founding. It is called Deuknambul because it is said that if a person without descendants prays, he or she will obtain descendants. There is a four lion stone pagoda in front of the main hall.

제주 동쪽 해가 뜨는 방향의 해안도로라는 의미의 해맞이해안로는 제주시 구.en: The Sunrise Coastal Road, which means the coastal road in the direction of the rising sun in the east of Jeju, is a road of approximately 27.8 km along the coast from Gimnyeong-ri, Gujwa-eup, Jeju-si to Ojo-ri, Seongsan-eup, Seogwipo-si. If you go along the Sunrise Coastal Road, which is included in Course 21 of the Olle Trail, you will reach Seongsan Ilchulbong, a famous sunrise spot, and it is a road that travelers visiting Jeju always pass by. It is connected to Gimnyeong - Woljeong-ri - Sehwa - Hado - Jongdal-ri - Seongsan Ilchulbong, so it is easily accessible as you can visit Jeju's restaurants, cafes, and attractions along the way. The biggest attraction of Sunrise Coastal Road, a must-visit when coming to Jeju, is that you can enjoy the endless view of the Jeju sea.

해밀톤 호텔은 1973년 개관하여 최상의 서비스를 제공하는 대한민국 대표.en: Hamilton Hotel opened in 1973 and has been pursuing continuous change under the vision of growing into Korea's representative hotel providing the best service. Accordingly, a large-scale remodeling was carried out in 2015, and more sophisticated and sophisticated services and facilities are being created to improve service quality across all sectors. We will grow into a global hotel representing Korea and further increase its service value. It is very convenient to use public transportation, including the subway and airport bus, and has excellent accessibility to downtown Seoul and downtown tourist attractions. In particular, it is located within a 15-minute drive from Gangnam, the financial and business center, and Seoul's major tourist attractions such as Myeongdong, Dongdaemun, Gwanghwamun, and Namsan are located close by. We provide relaxation and enjoyable travel through differentiated services such as state-of-the-art facilities including an outdoor swimming pool, banquet hall, fitness center, and sauna.

해수워터피아는 사우나, 찜질방 외에도 피트니스클럽, 소극장, 공연장을 갖.en: Haesu Waterpia is a leisure complex that features a fitness club, a small theater, and a performance hall in addition to a sauna and jjimjilbang. We use clean seawater drawn from natural rock 250 meters underground. The 3rd floor is a women's sauna, and the 6th floor is a men's sauna with various themed baths (seawater bath, cold seawater bath, event bath, hot bath, jade hot bath, green tea bath, massage bath, quick freeze bath, sauna (red clay, amethyst dew, germanium), sleeping room, etc. The 4th floor is centered around the central hall and has a restaurant, coffee shop, golden charcoal room, red clay room, jade water room, Eskimium room, and a performance hall. If you go around the 5th floor balcony overlooking the 4th floor, there is a sauna corner, PC room, massage & skin shop, women's sleeping room, and women-only lounge. There are various themed saunas such as oxygen room, aroma room, forest bath, and diamond room.

미스터 토일렛 심재덕은 세계화장실협회 창립을 기념하고자 30여 년간 살던.en: To commemorate the founding of the World Toilet Association, Mr. Toilet Shim Jae-deok tore down the house he had lived in for 30 years and built a toilet-shaped house, which he named Haewoojae. Haewoojae means ‘a house where one can relieve one’s worries’ and comes from Haewooso, which refers to a bathroom in a temple. Construction was based on the design of architect Ko Ki-woong in 2007 and was completed that year. Haewoojae, a toilet-shaped house, was recognized as the largest toilet sculpture by the Guinness Book of World Records and the Korea Record Institute in 2007, and has received attention from major domestic and foreign media. After Mr. Toilet Shim Jae-deok's death, his family donated it to Suwon City in honor of his wishes, and to honor his wishes, Suwon City remodeled it and reborn it as Haewoojae, the Suwon City Toilet Culture Exhibition Hall. There are interesting toilet-related sculptures in front of the museum, and you can experience toilet etiquette with children through the Haewoojae Children's Experience Center.

해운대는 부산 해운대구 동쪽 바닷가에 있는 동백[冬柏] 섬을 지칭하지만.en: Haeundae refers to Dongbaek Island on the east coast of Haeundae-gu, Busan, but today it refers to the area including the coastline and hills called ‘Dalmaji-gil’. Dalmaji-gil, also known as the Montmartre of Busan, has long been a famous attraction representing the region with its spectacular scenery of the blue sea, white sand beach, camellia forest, and pine forest, and is also one of the eight scenic spots of Busan. The evening moon seen from Haeundae Dalmaji Hill and Cheongsapo is said to have an elegance and was included in the Eight Scenic Views of Korea. The road from Haeundae Beach to Songjeong Beach is also called ‘15 Valleys’ and forms a driving course. Here, you can fully enjoy the atmosphere of the sea combined with the moonlight, especially on the first full moon of the year. Additionally, Dalmaji Hill has been created in the middle of the street. Here, there is a garden monument built with natural stone, and in particular, Haewoljeong [海月亭], the Moon View Pavilion, is built in the style of an old pavilion, adding to the antique atmosphere.

해운대시장은 해운대해수욕장과 인접해 있어 피서철에 많은 관광객들이 찾는.en: Haeundae Market is adjacent to Haeundae Beach, so it is a popular attraction visited by many tourists during the summer vacation season. This is a traditional market where tourists visiting Haeundae Beach, one of Busan's largest tourist destinations, visit for food and shopping. Haeundae Market has been in operation since the 1910s, and was refurbished with a modern look in 2008 through a market maintenance project. It handles a variety of items such as daily necessities, marine products, and fruits, and the front of the store is crowded with people waiting for the nationally famous tteokbokki, fried food, kalguksu, pretzel, and pork soup. Various types of side dishes, raw fish, grilled eel, etc. are also popular, so it can be said to be a market full of food and attractions. In addition to Haeundae Beach, there are various tourist attractions such as Dongbaek Island, Nurimaru, and Dalmaji Road near the market. ◎ Travel information to experience the charm of the Korean Wave - Haeundae Market, where Mongolian mother and Nam-soon from the drama <Strong Woman Gangnam-soon> enjoyed their outing in Busan, is so full of the smell of grilling eels that it is also called ‘Eel Alley’. Not only can you enjoy fresh seafood, but it is also close to the beach, so you can always feel the lively market atmosphere.

해운대해수욕장은 넓은 백사장과 아름다운 해안선을 자랑하고 있으며 얕은 수.en: Haeundae Beach boasts a wide white sand beach and beautiful coastline, and has the optimal conditions for a beach with shallow water depth and calm waves. When you think of Busan, the first place that comes to mind is Haeundae Beach, which is a representative tourist attraction in Busan. It is also the place where the largest crowd of people in Korea gathers every year, so much so that it is used as a measure of the number of vacationers in the summer. In particular, it is famous as a beach with a modern and sophisticated atmosphere, with large and small buildings and luxury hotels rising up around the coastline, so it is crowded with young people not only during summer vacation but all year round, and is well known to foreign tourists, so it is a place visited by many foreigners. Haeundae Beach holds a moon viewing festival every year on the first full moon of the year. In addition, the Polar Bear Swimming Competition, which is held every winter, has already become a representative winter festival. In addition, various large and small events are held, such as the Sand Art Exhibition and the Busan Sea Festival. In addition, there are many things to see around the beach, such as Dongbaek Island, Oryukdo Island, an aquarium, a yacht stadium, and BEXCO Dalmaji Hill. ◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave - This is where Nam-soon from the drama <Strong Woman Gang Nam-soon> had a great time making the word ‘sea’ with seashells on the sand with her Mongolian mother and taking pictures together.

해움미술관은 미술현장에 몸담아온 설립자의 경륜에 따라 2013년에 개관한.en: Haeum Museum of Art is Suwon City's first private art museum, opened in 2013 following the founder's experience in the art field. The museum is a creative art distribution center that responds to the needs of local residents by opening cultural consensus on small things rather than grand things. In addition to its mission of discovering and supporting artists with artistic sensibilities, the museum also conducts various programs that arouse cultural sensitivity in the local community. We will continue to do our best to expand new horizons for contemporary art and build a solid foundation for local art. The mission for that role begins with an interest in the local community. The museum's hope is to fill the warmth of art between visitors and artists through the stem, and hope that the value of our lives and daily lives will be enriched through art.

해인사는 우리나라 3대 사찰의 하나로 신라 애장왕 3년에 순응, 이정 두.en: Haeinsa Temple, one of the three major temples in Korea, was founded in the 3rd year of King Aejang of Silla by two monks, Sunshil and Yijeong. It is also famous as a Dharma Buddhist temple, originating from the Haein Samadhi of the Avatamsaka Sutra. King Taejo of Goryeo made this temple the national temple of Goryeo and bestowed 500 pieces of paper in return for helping Huirang, who stayed at this temple, by rejecting Gyeon Hwon of Later Baekje. Haeinsa Temple is a Buddhist temple and one of the ten Hwaeom temples. ‘Haein’ is derived from Haein Samadhi in the Avatamsaka Sutra, and Haeinsa Temple is a dojo established to proclaim the Avatamsaka ideology. The reason why Haeinsa Temple is called Beopbo Temple, one of the Three Jeweled Temples in Korea, is because the Beopbo, the Goryeo Tripitaka Koreana, is stored in the Tripitaka Koreana Panjeon at Haeinsa Temple. Haeinsa Temple has many halls, including Tripitaka Koreana Panjeon, Daejeokgwangjeon, Myeongbujeon, Doksungak, and Eungjinjeon. Affiliated hermitages include Wondangam Hermitage, Hongjeam Hermitage, Yongtap Seonwon, Gounam Hermitage, Ganwolam Hermitage, and Cheongnyangsa Temple.

행주산성은 경기도 고양시 덕양구 행주내동 덕양산의 7, 8부 능선에 쌓은.en: Haengjusanseong Fortress is a Temoe-style fortress built using dirt on the 7th and 8th ridges of Deogyangsan Mountain in Haengjunae-dong, Deogyang-gu, Goyang-si, Gyeonggi-do. It is a dual structure of a small inner castle surrounding the top of Deogyangsan Mountain and an outer castle surrounding the valley extending to the north, making use of the steep cliffs of the river and surrounding a wide plain extending to the east, north, and west. In the fortress, pieces of red-brown soft pottery and gray-blue hard pottery from the Three Kingdoms period, as well as tile pieces with fishbone patterns and hand-shaped patterns engraved on them, appear to have been used until the Goryeo period. During the Japanese Invasion of Korea, General Kwon Yul defeated 30,000 Japanese soldiers with 2,300 soldiers, including volunteer soldiers and soldiers. Ritual ceremonies and various other cultural events are held every year to commemorate the Battle of Haengju by Dowonsu Kwon Yul, Duke of Chungjang, who played a major role in defeating the Japanese army and bringing the country out of crisis. At this ceremony, which is held at Chungjangsa Temple, where the portrait of Governor Kwon Yul is enshrined, incense is burned and rites are held to summon the general's spirit. It is a place where you can learn about the love and wisdom of our ancestors for their country.

고양 인재개발원 주변 한강변 공원으로 2000년 고양 인재개발원 건립과.en: This is a park along the Han River near the Goyang Human Resources Development Center and was created in 2000 with the construction of the Goyang Human Resources Development Center. This place is as open as a playground, and you can enjoy the view of the Han River from the wide lawn or sit on the lawn and relax. In 2016, an observatory was installed and a road was built along the Han River to allow access to the white sandy beach of the Han River. The place where the military guard post was renovated is a historical park with a waterfront space (Laundry Head) where you can view the Han River and migratory birds, a military guard post observatory (Haenghojeong), a barbed wire photo zone, and a pinwheel hill. Since you can park your car in the parking lot for free, many people visit to see the night view of the Han River. The 18.2km course of Daedeok Ecological Park ~ Haengjusanseong Historical Park ~ County Patrol Road ~ Janghang Wetland has been designated as one of the top 10 ecological theme tours. Various festivals and events are held and it is used as a leisure space for citizens, and part of the park is the Haengjusanseong Nuri-gil course, which goes around Haengjusanseong Fortress. Because it is a circular route, the starting and ending points are the same, and the entrance may be a bit difficult as there are many stairs, but after about 10 minutes, you can see Palgakjeong Pavilion, Jingangjeong Pavilion, Chunguijeong Pavilion, Deogyangjeong Pavilion, and the Monument to the Battle of Haengju. You can leisurely look around in about an hour and a half. Additionally, Banghwa Bridge, located to the left of the historical park, is a famous sunset spot and many people flock there at dusk. It is a place where you can feel nature and learn about history along the beautiful Han River.

여수 향일암은 대한불교조계종 제19교구 말사이며, 연간 100만여 명이.en: Hyangiram Hermitage in Yeosu is a subsidiary temple of the 19th diocese of the Jogye Order of Korean Buddhism, and is a tourist attraction and a place for Avalokitesvara prayers visited by about 1 million people annually. Master Wonhyo visited Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara in person and built Wontongam Hermitage on the spot, and during the reign of King Sukjong of the Joseon Dynasty, Master Inmuk called it Hyangilam Hermitage. This place was transformed into a temple by restoring and constructing Wontongbojeon, Samseonggak, Gwaneumjeon, Yongwangjeon, Jonggak, and the Seawater Avalokitesvara Statue. Daeungjeon (Wontongbojeon), Jongmuso (Yeongguam), and Jonggak, which were destroyed by fire on December 20, 2009, were restored and held an inauguration ceremony on May 6, 2012. The view of the sunrise on the horizon of the South Sea is spectacular, so it is called Hyangilam Hermitage. Also, the surrounding rock is shaped like a turtle's back, so it is also called Yeongguam Hermitage.

관광농원인 허브아일랜드(329,000㎡) 내 식물원과 전시실(110,00.en: It is the largest herb botanical garden in the country registered as a first-class specialized museum (botanical garden) with a botanical garden and exhibition hall (110,000 ㎡) within the tourist farm Herb Island (329,000 ㎡). Over 250 types of herbs and various plants are planted in the Herb and Plant Museum, so you can see bright and green plants throughout the four seasons. The Herb and Plant Museum consists of a total of four indoor exhibition halls and an outdoor exhibition hall. There are herbs and plants at the center of each exhibition hall, making viewing fun and being used as a healing space as well as a place for children's ecological experience education.

허심청은 편안하고 즐거운 온천욕과 휴식 및 체력단련을 통한 건강증진을 추.en: Heosimcheong is a new type of urban hot spring health land that pursues health improvement through comfortable and enjoyable hot spring bathing, relaxation, and physical training. It was born in October 1991 as part of Busan City's urban redevelopment project. Heosimcheong's hot spring bath is the largest hot spring facility in Asia, with a total area of ​​4,297.54 m² and can accommodate 3,000 people at the same time. The large hot spring bath has over 40 types of baths with different effects, including longevity bath, hoemok bath, celadon bath, cave bath, and open-air bath, as well as event baths with different natural ingredients and herbal medicine depending on the season. There are various bathing courses that can be used freely according to individual constitution and age. Equipped with a large open hot spring bath, a ceiling that allows natural light, and a beautiful interior view with artistic design, it provides relaxation that can only be enjoyed at Heosimcheong, and you can enjoy a comfortable rest with your family in the jjimjilbang and auxiliary facilities.

헤이리 예술마을은 15만 평 규모로 통일동산 관광특구 내에 위치해 있다..en: Heyri Art Village has an area of ​​150,000 pyeong and is located within the Unification Garden Special Tourist Zone. Dreaming of creating the most beautiful village on earth, about 300 creators and artists from various fields who have met certain qualifications and passed the screening live in a community village. Heyri is a special community village with an integrated concept of production, exhibition, sales, and residence of culture and art. There are numerous galleries, museums, exhibition halls, performance halls, small theaters, cafes, restaurants, bookstores, guest houses, art shops, and creative spaces for artists. The etymology of Heyri Village comes from the phrase ‘e hey e heyri’ in the latter part of the Geumsan-ri farm song sung in the nearby area. Heyri was the third cultural district in Korea to be designated as a cultural district in December 2009, following Insa-dong (2002) and Daehakro (2004). Architects designed buildings that harmonize with nature according to the basic principles of not using paint and not building higher than three stories above ground. So, a trip to Heyri begins with appreciating the architecture. A variety of buildings stand out, showing off their individuality, including buildings with no distinction between inside and outside, buildings built at an angle to take advantage of the topography, and buildings that are irregular rather than square. The road in Heyri is not straight, but follows the curves created by nature, and is not even paved with asphalt. The best way to explore Heyri Village is to stroll along this road. If you come across an interesting building while taking a walk, you can capture it with your camera and then go into the art museum you come across and admire the works. 60% of all buildings in Heyri are open to the public as places for creation and cultural enjoyment. This is the regulation of Heyri Village, and the biggest beneficiaries of this regulation are the visitors. Even when visitors are looking around Heyri Village, creative activities are taking place in Heyri Village. In Heyri Village, various cultural and artistic events are held depending on the season, in which famous domestic and foreign cultural and artistic organizations participate or are invited. Therefore, Heyri Village is known as a place to visit with friendly people, and at the same time as a village that strives to promote culture and arts. You can also visit nearby Odusan Unification Observatory and Provence Village.

커피박물관에는 전 세계에서 수집한 1,600년대부터 최근까지 5세기에 걸.en: The Coffee Museum displays coffee relics collected from all over the world that have been used by humans for five centuries, from the 1600s to the present. In particular, it is a historical data museum where you can see the world's one-of-a-kind coffee relics and old, valuable exhibits donated by coffee museums in other countries. The Coffee Museum consists of a cafe on the first floor and a coffee museum on the second and third floors. On the second floor, you can take a look at the history of coffee, the process of making coffee, and how espresso machines have changed, and on the third floor, you can also explore a space where you can learn about the characteristics of coffee by place of origin. You can also see various coffee trees growing in a separate coffee research center and coffee cultivation house. In addition to visiting the museum, you can experience roasting your own green coffee beans and experience hand drip coffee, which is made by hand instead of coffee drawn from a machine.

현대백화점 중동점은 패션·뷰티·리빙·F&amp;B 등 다양한 브랜드가 입.en: Hyundai Department Store Jungdong branch is a shopping complex with various brands including fashion, beauty, living, and F&B. The first floor is lined with global luxury brands, and pop-up stores are also operated from time to time. Each floor is comprised of global fashion, women's and men's fashion, kids' and sports, living, and restaurant areas, and is also equipped with a cultural center and cultural hall. The annex ‘Uplex’ is operated mainly by young fashion, SPA, and sports brands, and CGV Bucheon is located on the upper floor.

현대백화점 킨텍스점은 주엽역과 킨텍스역 인근에 위치한 백화점이다. 현대백.en: Hyundai Department Store KINTEX branch is a department store located near Juyeop Station and KINTEX Station. Hyundai Department Store's cultural performance venues, Culture Hall and Gallery H, are equipped with a variety of brands, including food, sports, outdoor, cosmetics, and women's and men's fashion. Unlike other stores that use English signboards, such as HYUNDAI DEPARTMENT STORE or THE HYUNDAI, it is characterized by using a Korean signboard that says ‘Hyundai Department Store’. Nearby are Hyundai Motor Studio Goyang and One Mount, so there are plenty of things to enjoy nearby.

현대백화점 판교점은 판교신도시 백현동에 위치한 수도권 최대 규모의 프리미.en: Hyundai Department Store Pangyo branch is the largest premium department store in the metropolitan area, located in Baekhyeon-dong, Pangyo New Town, and aims to be a ‘lifestyle landmark.’ It is differentiated with complex content encompassing ‘open street space’ and ‘culture, food, living, and fashion.’ Global brands and leading domestic designer brands coexist, and spaces tailored to each generation stand out, such as the ‘Food Hall’ on the basement level, the ‘Kids & Family Zone’ on the 5th floor, and the ‘Topaz Hall’ on the 10th floor. It is Hyundai Department Store’s flagship store that innovates customer experience in various spaces.

호미곶은 한반도의 최동단에 위치, 한반도 지형상 호랑이 꼬리에 해당하는.en: Homigot is located at the easternmost tip of the Korean Peninsula and corresponds to the tail of a tiger in terms of the Korean Peninsula's topography. It is said that Kim Jeong-ho, a mountaineer, surveyed and measured this place seven times while creating Daedongyeojido and confirmed that it was the easternmost part of Korea. It is the place where the sun rises first, and nationally designated Sunrise Festivals were held twice in 2000 and 2001, and the Korean Sunrise Festival is held every year. In the sunrise plaza created here, there is an eternal ember that preserves the eternal fire by combining the last sunlight of the millennium, the first sunlight of Fiji Island, which is the international date line, and the beginning sunlight of Homigot here. There is the hand of Sangsaeng, a large bronze sculpture that symbolizes harmony and coexistence in the shape of the right and left hands on the sea and land, respectively, and the statue of Yeonorangseo, the main character of the local folktale handed down in the Samguk Yusa. The hand of coexistence is a symbol commemorating the Homigot Sunrise Festival, a national event. The Hand of Sangsaeng, which is the left hand on land and the right hand on the sea, is a sculpture created with the intention of all citizens helping each other to live together in the new millennium. The two hands symbolize coexistence. The flower bed of the sacred flower stand is an image of the sun, and the two circular rings symbolize unity. The two hands of coexistence embody the commemorative spirit of reconciliation and offset in the new millennium.

호반아트리움은 2025년에 경기도 과천시로 이전 및 개관한 문화예술 플랫.en: Hoban Atrium is a culture and arts platform that was relocated and opened in Gwacheon-si, Gyeonggi-do in 2025. ‘Atrium’ is an architectural term meaning a central garden derived from ancient Roman architecture, and Hoban Atrium aims for ‘art experienced together’. It goes beyond the static form of an art museum and emphasizes art that viewers directly experience. In addition, it offers a variety of cultural and artistic activities, including exhibitions and performances, various classes to change daily life, and children's education programs using the five senses. The Hoban Atrium is a center that connects the local community and the art world, and has established itself as a friendly and long-term space for visitors. It is being reborn as an art museum that adds cultural richness to the local community and provides more innovative and diverse experiences to citizens.

우리나라 최초의 사립미술관인 호암미술관은 삼성그룹의 창업주인 故 호암(湖.en: Ho-Am Art Museum, Korea's first private art museum, opened on April 22, 1982, based on 1,200 pieces of Korean art collected over 30 years by the late Ho-am Lee Byeong-cheol, founder of Samsung Group. Ho-Am Art Museum consists of the main building in the form of a traditional Korean house, the 20,000 pyeong 『Korean Traditional Garden Heewon』, the 『Bourdelle Garden』 where large-scale sculptures by Bourdelle, a master of modern French sculpture, are displayed, and the 『Waterside Square』 and 『Stone Man's Path』 around the lake. There is a tea house in Heewon where you can leisurely enjoy a cup of tea, and there is a lounge on the second floor of the museum, where you can take a break after viewing the exhibition and enjoy a panoramic view of Heewon. Additionally, the museum parking lot is equipped with convenience facilities such as a concession stand and souvenir shop for the convenience of visitors.

호텔 농심은 동래관광호텔이란 사명으로 국내 호텔 업계의 여명기인 1960.en: Hotel Nongshim, with the mission of being the Dongrae Tourist Hotel, opened in 1960, at the dawn of the domestic hotel industry, as the first modern lodging facility among tourist hotels south of the Han River in the heart of Dongrae Oncheonjang, a famous hot spring, and has been loved by domestic and foreign customers for its comfortable and friendly service for over 50 years. In August 2002, the name was changed to ‘Hotel Nongshim’ and a new hot spring resort type luxury tourist hotel with 240 rooms was built and opened. Hotel Nongshim, which has received love and praise from numerous distinguished guests and political and business figures since its opening, was designated as an APEC summit accommodation in 2005, providing an opportunity to raise the hotel's status once again by providing world-class service, as well as an upgraded international competitiveness. We provide rooms with 100% natural hot spring water for a healthier and more comfortable rest, a food and beverage venue where you can enjoy a variety of tastes, and a banquet hall that adds a special touch. We provide special memories to our customers through sincere service. In particular, Heosimcheong Broi with a differentiated concept where you can enjoy authentic German beer, and Heosimcheong, which boasts the largest scale in Asia as a hot spring bathing facility that is popular among domestic and foreign tourists as a hot spring attraction, is one of the special attractions that can only be found at Hotel Nongshim. Hotel Nongshim, located in a transportation hub adjacent to famous tourist attractions such as Dongrae CC, Busan CC, Dongraesanseong Fortress, Beomeosa Temple, Geumgang Park, Chungnyeolsa Temple, and Geumjeongsan Mountain, as well as Yangsan, Jeonggwan, Gimhae Airport, and Express Bus Terminal, will be the best resting place for customers' tourism and business travel.

화개정원은 약 18만 본의 수목과 관목류, 초화류가 식재된 인천 최초의.en: Hwagae Garden is Incheon's first local garden with about 180,000 trees, shrubs, and flowers planted, and was registered on April 24, 2023. With the concept of ‘a garden containing the history and nature of Gyodong Island that has been accumulated over a long period of time,’ it is composed of five themes, including a water garden, a garden of history and culture, a garden of memories, a garden of peace, and a garden of healing, and presents various natural beauties. Hwagaesan Observatory, located within the garden, is the largest skywalk-type observatory in the country, offering a panoramic view of the Yeonbaek Plain of Hwanghae-do, North Korea, and the Ganghwa-gun Dadohae, which are 7km away. In particular, the skywalk with a transparent floor provides a unique thrill and a special view. The observatory was designed in the shape of the black-faced spoonbill, the military bird of Ganghwa-gun, and its beak and eyes are made in the shape of looking toward North Korea, carrying the symbolic meaning of ‘flight toward the North, which is close enough to be touched but cannot be reached.’

화담숲은 서울에서 40분 거리, 경기도 광주에 위치한 생태수목원이다. 대.en: Hwadam Forest is an ecological arboretum located in Gwangju, Gyeonggi-do, 40 minutes from Seoul. Over 4,300 species of domestic and foreign native and introduced plants were created in 16 theme gardens on the land. The Hwadam of Hwadam Forest means sharing friendly stories, and Hwadam Forest aims to be an ecological space where humans and nature can communicate. We preserved the vegetation of our forest as much as possible and created an eco-friendly ecological space so that anyone who loves nature can comfortably visit it. In addition, thanks to the fact that it was created by preserving the natural topography and vegetation as much as possible, you can see a variety of trees naturally located along the valleys and ridges of Nogobong Peak. For the disabled, the elderly, and children who want to go for a walk but are unable to do so due to physical discomfort, the entire 5km forest walking path has been created with gentle slopes so that they can enjoy nature and heal comfortably in a stroller or wheelchair, making it very popular with families.

유소년전용 야구장, 화성 드림파크야구장국내 최대 규모의 유소년야구장 '화.en: Youth-only baseball field, Hwaseong Dream Park Baseball StadiumThe largest youth baseball stadium in Korea, 'Hwaseong Dream Park Baseball Stadium' consists of a total of 8 baseball fields, including 4 little baseball fields, 3 junior baseball fields, and a women's baseball field. In addition, a plaza and park have been created that can be used as a rest area and event venue.

화성시 팔탄에 위치한 우리꽃식물원은 사계절에 약 1,100여종의 식물을.en: Our Flower Botanical Garden, located in Paltan, Hwaseong-si, is a botanical garden where you can see about 1,100 species of plants in all four seasons. The Four Seasons Museum, a glass greenhouse built in Korea's traditional Hanok style, is created in the environment of the central region, so you can see different plants in each season. In addition, you can see about 300 types of plants, including the stone mountain that symbolizes Korea's five famous mountains, the roots of the birch tree where wishes come true, and tree ferns. In addition, there is an ecological pond where you can see wetland plants and aquatic plants, a medicinal garden where you can learn about the appearance and medicinal effects of various plants, and a theme garden where you can feel the autumn atmosphere with sedges such as silver grass and pink muhly planted. In particular, spaces for children include a play forest with zip lines and slides, a fountain plaza where you can enjoy water play in midsummer, and various experience programs for children such as raising marimo, sand art, and experiencing edible flowers. There is. The back of the Woori Flower Botanical Garden is connected to the Deunggo Mountain hiking trail, so you can take a walk around the garden for about 30 minutes. The botanical garden provides cultural and tourism commentary, so you can hear stories about grass, trees, and flowers.

화성지역의 문화와 역사를 담은 박물관이다. 1층 어린이 문화실은 각종 체.en: This is a museum containing the culture and history of the Hwaseong region. The children's culture room on the first floor offers various experiences. It operates a permanent exhibition room and a special exhibition room. The Living Culture Room and the History and Culture Room are spaces where you can encounter the history and lifestyle of the Hwaseong people who lived in harmony with nature. The tug-of-war rope used for the tug-of-war event in Gian-dong, Hwaseong region, where fishing villages and farming villages coexisted, is located in the center. You can take a look at the self-salting method of making condensed salt by boiling water during the Joseon Dynasty. When you enter the History and Culture Room, you will see a space that deals with the history of Hwaseong, including the various cultural assets located in Hwaseong and Hwaseong's education.

행궁은 정조가 현륭원에 행차할 때 임시 거처로 사용하던 곳으로 그 어느.en: Temporary palace was used as a temporary residence by King Jeongjo when he visited Hyeonryungwon. It was larger and more magnificent than any other temporary palace and was so useful that it even gave rise to the term ‘sub-gung’ of Gyeongbokgung Palace. In the 18th to 20th years of King Jeongjo's reign, Hwaseong Fortress was built and a temporary palace was built on the east side of Paldalsan Mountain, which was normally used as the Yusubu (current city hall) government office. Hwaseong is connected by four gate towers: Changnyongmun (east), Hwaseomun (west), Paldalmun (south), and Janganmun (north). Not only was it selected as a World Heritage Site due to its outstanding architecture, but it is also evaluated as Korea's first new city development example. King Jeongjo, the 22nd king of the Joseon Dynasty, moved the tomb to Suwon (current Hwaseong-si), which was considered the most famous site at the time when his father, Crown Prince Sado, ended his life tragically in a dungeon. He also moved the residents who lived around the tomb to its current location under Paldalsan Mountain and built a city and fortress. Experience the Korean archery in Hwaseong, ringing Hyowon's bell at the top of Paldalsan Mountain, and various traditional cultural experiences at Haenggung Palace help you gain a three-dimensional approach to our cultural assets. In addition, you can enjoy a variety of experiences, such as trying on Dae Jang Geum's costume and getting a wish fulfillment tree and stamps.

2013년 조성된 화악터널 쌈지공원은 가평군 북면 화악리, 해발 870m.en: Hwaak Tunnel Ssamzie Park, created in 2013, is an observatory park located at 870m above sea level in Hwaak-ri, Buk-myeon, Gapyeong-gun. During the day, you can view the ridge of Hwaaksan Mountain and the panoramic view of Gapyeong, and at night, you can enjoy the starlight pouring down in the clean mountains with little light pollution. Since it was introduced through MBC's 'I Live Alone' broadcast in 2020, it has become known as a star-gazing spot, and travelers and astronomical observation enthusiasts are continuing to visit it. Meanwhile, the nearby Hwaak Mountain uphill course is the most difficult uphill course in Korea and is popular among bicycle enthusiasts as a challenge course.

화암사는 강원도 고성군 신평리에 위치한 사찰로, 신라 제36대 혜공왕 5.en: Hwaamsa Temple is a temple located in Sinpyeong-ri, Goseong-gun, Gangwon-do, and was founded by Master Jinpyo in the 5th year of the reign of King Hyegong, the 36th king of Silla (769). Since then, it has been repeatedly destroyed and rebuilt by fire. It was destroyed in the first year of King Injo's reign (1623) in the Joseon Dynasty, but rebuilt in the third year of King Injo's reign (1625). In the first year of King Gojong's reign (1864), it was moved to its current location under Subawi and its name was changed to 'Suamsa Temple.' Afterwards, in 1912, the name was changed again to ‘Hwaamsa Temple.’ It was once again destroyed by fire during the Korean War, and only the temple hall was later restored. In preparation for the 1991 World Jamboree, the existing building was demolished and completely rebuilt, which is what it is today. Currently, Hwaamsa Temple has buildings such as Iljumun, Daeungjeon, Samseonggak, Myeongbujeon, and Yosachae, and a stupa and some staircase stones that appear to have been built in the late Joseon Dynasty also remain. A six-panel folding screen with a statue of Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara bestowed by King Jeongjo was handed down to this temple, but its whereabouts after liberation are unknown. In addition, there is a record that there were 15 stupas, including the Jugamdang stupa, and a total of 16 camps, including the Jinpyodang camp. The temple is located in clean Hwaam Valley at the foot of Sinseonbong Peak, and the surrounding scenery, including Subawi Rock and Ulsanbawi Rock, is beautiful. There are many places to visit nearby, including Sinseonbong Peak, World Jamboree Center, and condominiums. In addition, there is a traditional teahouse within the temple, so enjoying traditional tea in a quiet mountain temple can be a special experience.◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave - Entertainment <Summer Vacation> Hwaamsa Temple is the place where actors Jeong Yu-mi and Choi Woo-sik experienced a temple stay in the tvN entertainment program <Summer Vacation>. The two spent a healing time escaping from their daily lives and finding peace of mind through various temple experiences, such as worshiping and having tea with monks. This place, surrounded by nature in a quiet atmosphere, is recommended as a special travel destination where you can rest your body and mind.

가평군 외서면과 양평군 서정면에 걸쳐 있는 해발 755m의 산\"화야산은.en: Hwayasan is a 755m-altitude mountain that straddles Oeseo-myeon, Gapyeong-gun and Seojeong-myeon, Yangpyeong-gun. Hwayasan is a 755m-high mountain that straddles Oeseo-myeon, Gapyeong-gun and Seojeong-myeon, Yangpyeong-gun. The Bukhangang River forms Cheongpyeong Lake on the north side of the mountain and flows parallel to the south, so the view while hiking is beautiful. The view while hiking is beautiful. It is built on the western ridge and Pyorubong (709m) located at the northern end of the summit. Godongsan Mountain (600m) can be said to be a peak attached to Hwayasan Mountain, and the forest is thick and the valley is deep, so you can enjoy hiking at any time. It takes more than 4 hours to hike, so you can enjoy the taste of winter hiking because there is a lot of snow in winter.

화엄사는 구례읍에서 동쪽으로 5.4㎞ 떨어진 곳, 민족의 영산인 지리산.en: Hwaeomsa Temple is a thousand-year-old temple located 5.4km east of Gurye-eup, at the foot of Jirisan Mountain, the sacred mountain of the nation.
